book.notes: Old Testament original is the Hebrew Masoretic text; New Testament original is the SBL Greek text. Transliteration is automatic and flagged. Hebrew verse numbering can differ from KJV numbering in a few psalms.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹר֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/מִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vytsv mshh vzqny yshr'l 't h'm l'mr shmr 't khl hmtsvh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm hyvm
verses.translation: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה בַּ/יּוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֒ אֶל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑/ךְ וַ/הֲקֵמֹתָ֤ לְ/ךָ֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֔וֹת וְ/שַׂדְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם בַּ/שִּֽׂיד
verses.translit: vhyh byvm 'shr t'brv 't hyrdn 'l h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh vhqmt lkh 'bnym gdlvt vshdt 'tm bshyd
verses.translation: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:

verses.original: וְ/כָתַבְתָּ֣ עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ן אֶֽת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֛י הַ/תּוֹרָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את בְּ/עָבְרֶ֑/ךָ לְמַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ תָּבֹ֨א אֶל הָ/אָ֜רֶץ אֲֽשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֣י/ךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לְ/ךָ֗ אֶ֣רֶץ זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּ/דְבַ֔שׁ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי אֲבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vkhtbt 'lyhn 't khl dbry htvrh hz't b'brkh lm'n 'shr tb' 'l h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lhy 'btykh lkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֮ בְּ/עָבְרְ/כֶ֣ם אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֒ תָּקִ֜ימוּ אֶת הָ/אֲבָנִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם הַ/יּ֖וֹם בְּ/הַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל וְ/שַׂדְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖/ם בַּ/שִּֽׂיד
verses.translit: vhyh b'brkhm 't hyrdn tqymv 't h'bnym h'lh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm hyvm bhr 'ybl vshdt 'vtm bshyd
verses.translation: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.

verses.original: וּ/בָנִ֤יתָ שָּׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ מִזְבַּ֣ח אֲבָנִ֔ים לֹא תָנִ֥יף עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם בַּרְזֶֽל
verses.translit: vbnyt shm mzbch lyhvh 'lhykh mzbch 'bnym l' tnyf 'lyhm brzl
verses.translation: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.

verses.original: אֲבָנִ֤ים שְׁלֵמוֹת֙ תִּבְנֶ֔ה אֶת מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הַעֲלִ֤יתָ עָלָי/ו֙ עוֹלֹ֔ת לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'bnym shlmvt tbnh 't mzbch yhvh 'lhykh vh'lyt 'lyv 'vlt lyhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt build the altar of the LORD thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD thy God:

verses.original: וְ/זָבַחְתָּ֥ שְׁלָמִ֖ים וְ/אָכַ֣לְתָּ שָּׁ֑ם וְ/שָׂ֣מַחְתָּ֔ לִ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vzbcht shlmym v'khlt shm vshmcht lpny yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.

verses.original: וְ/כָתַבְתָּ֣ עַל הָ/אֲבָנִ֗ים אֶֽת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֛י הַ/תּוֹרָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את בַּאֵ֥ר הֵיטֵֽב
verses.translit: vkhtbt 'l h'bnym 't khl dbry htvrh hz't b'r hytb
verses.translation: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אֶ֥ל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הַסְכֵּ֤ת וּ/שְׁמַע֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ נִהְיֵ֣יתָֽ לְ/עָ֔ם לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vydbr mshh vhkhhnym hlvym 'l khl yshr'l l'mr hskht vshm' yshr'l hyvm hzh nhyyt l'm lyhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֣מַעְתָּ֔ בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת מִצְוֺתָ/ו֙ וְ/אֶת חֻקָּ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vshm't bqvl yhvh 'lhykh v'shyt 't mtsvtv v't chqyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm
verses.translation: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytsv mshh 't h'm byvm hhv' l'mr
verses.translation: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

verses.original: אֵ֠לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֞וּ לְ/בָרֵ֤ךְ אֶת הָ/עָם֙ עַל הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים בְּ/עָבְרְ/כֶ֖ם אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן שִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְ/לֵוִ֣י וִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וְ/יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וְ/יוֹסֵ֥ף וּ/בִנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: 'lh y'mdv lbrkh 't h'm 'l hr grzym b'brkhm 't hyrdn shm'vn vlvy vyhvdh vyshshkhr vyvsf vbnymn
verses.translation: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֥וּ עַל הַ/קְּלָלָ֖ה בְּ/הַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל רְאוּבֵן֙ גָּ֣ד וְ/אָשֵׁ֔ר וּ/זְבוּלֻ֖ן דָּ֥ן וְ/נַפְתָּלִֽי
verses.translit: v'lh y'mdv 'l hqllh bhr 'ybl r'vbn gd v'shr vzbvln dn vnptly
verses.translation: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

verses.original: וְ/עָנ֣וּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם וְ/אָֽמְר֛וּ אֶל כָּל אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ק֥וֹל רָֽם
verses.translit: v'nv hlvym v'mrv 'l khl 'ysh yshr'l qvl rm
verses.translation: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,

verses.original: אָר֣וּר הָ/אִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂה֩ פֶ֨סֶל וּ/מַסֵּכָ֜ה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה מַעֲשֵׂ֛ה יְדֵ֥י חָרָ֖שׁ וְ/שָׂ֣ם בַּ/סָּ֑תֶר וְ/עָנ֧וּ כָל הָ/עָ֛ם וְ/אָמְר֖וּ אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr h'ysh 'shr y'shh psl vmskhh tv'bt yhvh m'shh ydy chrsh vshm bstr v'nv khl h'm v'mrv 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the LORD , the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place . And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַקְלֶ֥ה אָבִ֖י/ו וְ/אִמּ֑/וֹ וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr mqlh 'byv v'mv v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַסִּ֖יג גְּב֣וּל רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr msyg gbvl r'hv v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַשְׁגֶּ֥ה עִוֵּ֖ר בַּ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr mshgh 'vr bdrkh v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֗וּר מַטֶּ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט גֵּר יָת֖וֹם וְ/אַלְמָנָ֑ה וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr mth mshpt gr ytvm v'lmnh v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֔י/ו כִּ֥י גִלָּ֖ה כְּנַ֣ף אָבִ֑י/ו וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr shkhb 'm 'sht 'byv khy glh khnf 'byv v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that lieth with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם כָּל בְּהֵמָ֑ה וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr shkhb 'm khl bhmh v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם אֲחֹת֔/וֹ בַּת אָבִ֖י/ו א֣וֹ בַת אִמּ֑/וֹ וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr shkhb 'm 'chtv bt 'byv 'v bt 'mv v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם חֹֽתַנְתּ֑/וֹ וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr shkhb 'm chtntv v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַכֵּ֥ה רֵעֵ֖/הוּ בַּ/סָּ֑תֶר וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr mkhh r'hv bstr v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָרוּר֙ לֹקֵ֣חַ שֹׁ֔חַד לְ/הַכּ֥וֹת נֶ֖פֶשׁ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr lqch shchd lhkhvt npsh dm nqy v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: אָר֗וּר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא יָקִ֛ים אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/תּוֹרָֽה הַ/זֹּ֖את לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת אוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/אָמַ֥ר כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rvr 'shr l' yqym 't dbry htvrh hz't l'shvt 'vtm v'mr khl h'm 'mn
verses.translation: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִם שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּ/קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לִ/שְׁמֹ֤ר לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּ֑וֹם וּ/נְתָ֨נְ/ךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ עֶלְי֔וֹן עַ֖ל כָּל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhyh 'm shmv' tshm' bqvl yhvh 'lhykh lshmr l'shvt 't khl mtsvtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm vntnkh yhvh 'lhykh 'lyvn 'l khl gvyy h'rts
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:

verses.original: וּ/בָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛י/ךָ כָּל הַ/בְּרָכ֥וֹת הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/הִשִּׂיגֻ֑/ךָ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֔ע בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vb'v 'lykh khl hbrkhvt h'lh vhshygkh khy tshm' bqvl yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בָּ/עִ֑יר וּ/בָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: brvkh 'th b'yr vbrvkh 'th bshdh
verses.translation: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.

verses.original: בָּר֧וּךְ פְּרִֽי בִטְנְ/ךָ֛ וּ/פְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְ/ךָ֖ וּ/פְרִ֣י בְהֶמְתֶּ֑/ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/עַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: brvkh pry btnkh vpry 'dmtkh vpry bhmtkh shgr 'lpykh v'shtrvt ts'nkh
verses.translation: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

verses.translit: brvkh tn'kh vmsh'rtkh
verses.translation: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּ/בֹאֶ֑/ךָ וּ/בָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּ/צֵאתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: brvkh 'th bb'kh vbrvkh 'th bts'tkh
verses.translation: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

verses.original: יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת אֹיְבֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/קָּמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔י/ךָ נִגָּפִ֖ים לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ בְּ/דֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ יֵצְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/בְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים יָנ֥וּסוּ לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: ytn yhvh 't 'ybykh hqmym 'lykh ngpym lpnykh bdrkh 'chd yts'v 'lykh vbshb'h drkhym ynvsv lpnykh
verses.translation: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.

verses.original: יְצַ֨ו יְהוָ֤ה אִתְּ/ךָ֙ אֶת הַ/בְּרָכָ֔ה בַּ/אֲסָמֶ֕י/ךָ וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑/ךָ וּ/בֵ֣רַכְ/ךָ֔ בָּ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: ytsv yhvh 'tkh 't hbrkhh b'smykh vbkhl mshlch ydkh vbrkhkh b'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh
verses.translation: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

verses.original: יְקִֽימְ/ךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה ל/וֹ֙ לְ/עַ֣ם קָד֔וֹשׁ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע לָ֑/ךְ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הָלַכְתָּ֖ בִּ/דְרָכָֽי/ו
verses.translit: yqymkh yhvh lv l'm qdvsh kh'shr nshb' lkh khy tshmr 't mtsvt yhvh 'lhykh vhlkht bdrkhyv
verses.translation: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.

verses.original: וְ/רָאוּ֙ כָּל עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה נִקְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/יָֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: vr'v khl 'my h'rts khy shm yhvh nqr' 'lykh vyr'v mmkh
verses.translation: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD ; and they shall be afraid of thee.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹתִֽרְ/ךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ לְ/טוֹבָ֔ה בִּ/פְרִ֧י בִטְנְ/ךָ֛ וּ/בִ/פְרִ֥י בְהַמְתְּ/ךָ֖ וּ/בִ/פְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑/ךָ עַ֚ל הָ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַ/אֲבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ לָ֥/תֶת לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhvtrkh yhvh ltvbh bpry btnkh vbpry bhmtkh vbpry 'dmtkh 'l h'dmh 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykh ltt lkh
verses.translation: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

verses.original: יִפְתַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה לְ֠/ךָ אֶת אוֹצָר֨/וֹ הַ/טּ֜וֹב אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם לָ/תֵ֤ת מְטַֽר אַרְצְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/עִתּ֔/וֹ וּ/לְ/בָרֵ֕ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הִלְוִ֨יתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וְ/אַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א תִלְוֶֽה
verses.translit: yptch yhvh lkh 't 'vtsrv htvb 't hshmym ltt mtr 'rtskh b'tv vlbrkh 't khl m'shh ydkh vhlvyt gvym rbym v'th l' tlvh
verses.translation: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.

verses.original: וּ/נְתָֽנְ/ךָ֨ יְהוָ֤ה לְ/רֹאשׁ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א לְ/זָנָ֔ב וְ/הָיִ֨יתָ֙ רַ֣ק לְ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וְ/לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לְ/מָ֑טָּה כִּֽי תִשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֛ הַ/יּ֖וֹם לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר וְ/לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: vntnkh yhvh lr'sh vl' lznb vhyyt rq lm'lh vl' thyh lmth khy tshm' 'l mtsvt yhvh 'lhykh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm lshmr vl'shvt
verses.translation: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִ/כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם הַ/יּ֖וֹם יָמִ֣ין וּ/שְׂמֹ֑אול לָ/לֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים לְ/עָבְדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vl' tsvr mkhl hdbrym 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm hyvm ymyn vshm'vl llkht 'chry 'lhym 'chrym l'bdm
verses.translation: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִם לֹ֤א תִשְׁמַע֙ בְּ/קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לִ/שְׁמֹ֤ר לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתָ֣י/ו וְ/חֻקֹּתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּ֑וֹם וּ/בָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛י/ךָ כָּל הַ/קְּלָל֥וֹת הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/הִשִּׂיגֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyh 'm l' tshm' bqvl yhvh 'lhykh lshmr l'shvt 't khl mtsvtyv vchqtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm vb'v 'lykh khl hqllvt h'lh vhshygvkh
verses.translation: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:

verses.original: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בָּ/עִ֑יר וְ/אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: 'rvr 'th b'yr v'rvr 'th bshdh
verses.translation: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.

verses.original: אָר֥וּר טַנְאֲ/ךָ֖ וּ/מִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'rvr tn'kh vmsh'rtkh
verses.translation: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.

verses.original: אָר֥וּר פְּרִֽי בִטְנְ/ךָ֖ וּ/פְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑/ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/עַשְׁתְּר֥וֹת צֹאנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'rvr pry btnkh vpry 'dmtkh shgr 'lpykh v'shtrvt ts'nkh
verses.translation: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.

verses.original: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּ/בֹאֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּ/צֵאתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'rvr 'th bb'kh v'rvr 'th bts'tkh
verses.translation: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.

verses.original: יְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה בְּ֠/ךָ אֶת הַ/מְּאֵרָ֤ה אֶת הַ/מְּהוּמָה֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּגְעֶ֔רֶת בְּ/כָל מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמֶדְ/ךָ֤ וְ/עַד אֲבָדְ/ךָ֙ מַהֵ֔ר מִ/פְּנֵ֛י רֹ֥עַ מַֽעֲלָלֶ֖י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתָּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: yshlch yhvh bkh 't hm'rh 't hmhvmh v't hmg'rt bkhl mshlch ydkh 'shr t'shh 'd hshmdkh v'd 'bdkh mhr mpny r' m'llykh 'shr 'zbtny
verses.translation: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.

verses.original: יַדְבֵּ֧ק יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/ךָ֖ אֶת הַ/דָּ֑בֶר עַ֚ד כַּלֹּת֣/וֹ אֹֽתְ/ךָ֔ מֵ/עַל֙ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: ydbq yhvh bkh 't hdbr 'd khltv 'tkh m'l h'dmh 'shr 'th b' shmh lrshth
verses.translation: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.

verses.original: יַכְּ/כָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה בַּ/שַּׁחֶ֨פֶת וּ/בַ/קַּדַּ֜חַת וּ/בַ/דַּלֶּ֗קֶת וּ/בַֽ/חַרְחֻר֙ וּ/בַ/חֶ֔רֶב וּ/בַ/שִּׁדָּפ֖וֹן וּ/בַ/יֵּרָק֑וֹן וּ/רְדָפ֖וּ/ךָ עַ֥ד אָבְדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: ykhkhh yhvh bshchpt vbqdcht vbdlqt vbchrchr vbchrb vbshdpvn vbyrqvn vrdpvkh 'd 'bdkh
verses.translation: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֥וּ שָׁמֶ֛י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל רֹאשְׁ/ךָ֖ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְ/הָ/אָ֥רֶץ אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתֶּ֖י/ךָ בַּרְזֶֽל
verses.translit: vhyv shmykh 'shr 'l r'shkh nchsht vh'rts 'shr tchtykh brzl
verses.translation: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.

verses.original: יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מְטַ֥ר אַרְצְ/ךָ֖ אָבָ֣ק וְ/עָפָ֑ר מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ יֵרֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔י/ךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: ytn yhvh 't mtr 'rtskh 'bq v'pr mn hshmym yrd 'lykh 'd hshmdkh
verses.translation: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

verses.original: יִתֶּנְ/ךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה נִגָּף֮ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶי/ךָ֒ בְּ/דֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ תֵּצֵ֣א אֵלָ֔י/ו וּ/בְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים תָּנ֣וּס לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וְ/הָיִ֣יתָ לְ/זַעֲוָ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: ytnkh yhvh ngf lpny 'ybykh bdrkh 'chd tts' 'lyv vbshb'h drkhym tnvs lpnyv vhyyt lz'vh lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts
verses.translation: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָֽתְ/ךָ֙ לְ/מַאֲכָ֔ל לְ/כָל ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֣ת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/אֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד
verses.translit: vhyth nbltkh lm'khl lkhl 'vf hshmym vlbhmt h'rts v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.

verses.original: יַכְּ/כָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּ/שְׁחִ֤ין מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ ו/ב/עפלים וּ/בַ/טְּחֹרִ֔ים וּ/בַ/גָּרָ֖ב וּ/בֶ/חָ֑רֶס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תוּכַ֖ל לְ/הֵרָפֵֽא
verses.translit: ykhkhh yhvh bshchyn mtsrym vb'plym vbtchrym vbgrb vbchrs 'shr l' tvkhl lhrp'
verses.translation: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.

verses.original: יַכְּ/כָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/שִׁגָּע֖וֹן וּ/בְ/עִוָּר֑וֹן וּ/בְ/תִמְה֖וֹן לֵבָֽב
verses.translit: ykhkhh yhvh bshg'vn vb'vrvn vbtmhvn lbb
verses.translation: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:

verses.original: וְ/הָיִ֜יתָ מְמַשֵּׁ֣שׁ בַּֽ/צָּהֳרַ֗יִם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְמַשֵּׁ֤שׁ הָ/עִוֵּר֙ בָּ/אֲפֵלָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחַ אֶת דְּרָכֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הָיִ֜יתָ אַ֣ךְ עָשׁ֧וּק וְ/גָז֛וּל כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֖ים וְ/אֵ֥ין מוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: vhyyt mmshsh btshrym kh'shr ymshsh h'vr b'plh vl' ttslych 't drkhykh vhyyt 'kh 'shvq vgzvl khl hymym v'yn mvshy'
verses.translation: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee .

verses.original: אִשָּׁ֣ה תְאָרֵ֗שׂ וְ/אִ֤ישׁ אַחֵר֙ ישגל/נה יִשְׁכָּבֶ֔/נָּה בַּ֥יִת תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְ/לֹא תֵשֵׁ֣ב בּ֑/וֹ כֶּ֥רֶם תִּטַּ֖ע וְ/לֹ֥א תְחַלְּלֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'shh t'rsh v'ysh 'chr yshglnh yshkhbnh byt tbnh vl' tshb bv khrm tt' vl' tchllnv
verses.translation: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.

verses.original: שׁוֹרְ/ךָ֞ טָב֣וּחַ לְ/עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/לֹ֣א תֹאכַל֮ מִמֶּ/נּוּ֒ חֲמֹֽרְ/ךָ֙ גָּז֣וּל מִ/לְּ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/לֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב לָ֑/ךְ צֹֽאנְ/ךָ֙ נְתֻנ֣וֹת לְ/אֹיְבֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אֵ֥ין לְ/ךָ֖ מוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: shvrkh tbvch l'ynykh vl' t'khl mmnv chmrkh gzvl mlpnykh vl' yshvb lkh ts'nkh ntnvt l'ybykh v'yn lkh mvshy'
verses.translation: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them .

verses.original: בָּנֶ֨י/ךָ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֜י/ךָ נְתֻנִ֨ים לְ/עַ֤ם אַחֵר֙ וְ/עֵינֶ֣י/ךָ רֹא֔וֹת וְ/כָל֥וֹת אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּל הַ/יּ֑וֹם וְ/אֵ֥ין לְ/אֵ֖ל יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bnykh vbntykh ntnym l'm 'chr v'ynykh r'vt vkhlvt 'lyhm khl hyvm v'yn l'l ydkh
verses.translation: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.

verses.original: פְּרִ֤י אַדְמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ וְ/כָל יְגִ֣יעֲ/ךָ֔ יֹאכַ֥ל עַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יָדָ֑עְתָּ וְ/הָיִ֗יתָ רַ֛ק עָשׁ֥וּק וְ/רָצ֖וּץ כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: pry 'dmtkh vkhl ygy'kh y'khl 'm 'shr l' yd't vhyyt rq 'shvq vrtsvts khl hymym
verses.translation: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:

verses.original: וְ/הָיִ֖יתָ מְשֻׁגָּ֑ע מִ/מַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: vhyyt mshg' mmr'h 'ynykh 'shr tr'h
verses.translation: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

verses.original: יַכְּ/כָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּ/שְׁחִ֣ין רָ֗ע עַל הַ/בִּרְכַּ֨יִם֙ וְ/עַל הַ/שֹּׁקַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תוּכַ֖ל לְ/הֵרָפֵ֑א מִ/כַּ֥ף רַגְלְ/ךָ֖ וְ/עַ֥ד קָדְקֳדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: ykhkhh yhvh bshchyn r' 'l hbrkhym v'l hshqym 'shr l' tvkhl lhrp' mkhf rglkh v'd qdqdkh
verses.translation: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.

verses.original: יוֹלֵ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֹֽתְ/ךָ֗ וְ/אֶֽת מַלְכְּ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּקִ֣ים עָלֶ֔י/ךָ אֶל גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָדַ֖עְתָּ אַתָּ֣ה וַ/אֲבֹתֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/עָבַ֥דְתָּ שָּׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ וָ/אָֽבֶן
verses.translit: yvlkh yhvh 'tkh v't mlkhkh 'shr tqym 'lykh 'l gvy 'shr l' yd't 'th v'btykh v'bdt shm 'lhym 'chrym 'ts v'bn
verses.translation: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.

verses.original: וְ/הָיִ֣יתָ לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה לְ/מָשָׁ֖ל וְ/לִ/שְׁנִינָ֑ה בְּ/כֹל֙ הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר יְנַהֶגְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vhyyt lshmh lmshl vlshnynh bkhl h'mym 'shr ynhgkh yhvh shmh
verses.translation: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.

verses.original: זֶ֥רַע רַ֖ב תּוֹצִ֣יא הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וּ/מְעַ֣ט תֶּאֱסֹ֔ף כִּ֥י יַחְסְלֶ֖/נּוּ הָ/אַרְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: zr' rb tvtsy' hshdh vm't t'sf khy ychslnv h'rbh
verses.translation: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.

verses.original: כְּרָמִ֥ים תִּטַּ֖ע וְ/עָבָ֑דְתָּ וְ/יַ֤יִן לֹֽא תִשְׁתֶּה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תֶאֱגֹ֔ר כִּ֥י תֹאכְלֶ֖/נּוּ הַ/תֹּלָֽעַת
verses.translit: khrmym tt' v'bdt vyyn l' tshth vl' t'gr khy t'khlnv htl't
verses.translation: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them , but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.

verses.original: זֵיתִ֛ים יִהְי֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/כָל גְּבוּלֶ֑/ךָ וְ/שֶׁ֨מֶן֙ לֹ֣א תָס֔וּךְ כִּ֥י יִשַּׁ֖ל זֵיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: zytym yhyv lkh bkhl gbvlkh vshmn l' tsvkh khy yshl zytkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit .

verses.original: בָּנִ֥ים וּ/בָנ֖וֹת תּוֹלִ֑יד וְ/לֹא יִהְי֣וּ לָ֔/ךְ כִּ֥י יֵלְכ֖וּ בַּ/שֶּֽׁבִי
verses.translit: bnym vbnvt tvlyd vl' yhyv lkh khy ylkhv bshby
verses.translation: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.

verses.original: כָּל עֵצְ/ךָ֖ וּ/פְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑/ךָ יְיָרֵ֖שׁ הַ/צְּלָצַֽל
verses.translit: khl 'tskh vpry 'dmtkh yyrsh htsltsl
verses.translation: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.

verses.original: הַ/גֵּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/קִרְבְּ/ךָ֔ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖י/ךָ מַ֣עְלָ/ה מָּ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/אַתָּ֥ה תֵרֵ֖ד מַ֥טָּה מָּֽטָּה
verses.translit: hgr 'shr bqrbkh y'lh 'lykh m'lh m'lh v'th trd mth mth
verses.translation: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.

verses.original: ה֣וּא יַלְוְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה לֹ֣א תַלְוֶ֑/נּוּ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְ/רֹ֔אשׁ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְ/זָנָֽב
verses.translit: hv' ylvkh v'th l' tlvnv hv' yhyh lr'sh v'th thyh lznb
verses.translation: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜י/ךָ כָּל הַ/קְּלָל֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה וּ/רְדָפ֨וּ/ךָ֙ וְ/הִשִּׂיג֔וּ/ךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָ֑/ךְ כִּי לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ בְּ/קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לִ/שְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥י/ו וְ/חֻקֹּתָ֖י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vb'v 'lykh khl hqllvt h'lh vrdpvkh vhshygvkh 'd hshmdkh khy l' shm't bqvl yhvh 'lhykh lshmr mtsvtyv vchqtyv 'shr tsvkh
verses.translation: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:

verses.original: וְ/הָי֣וּ בְ/ךָ֔ לְ/א֖וֹת וּ/לְ/מוֹפֵ֑ת וּֽ/בְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vhyv bkh l'vt vlmvpt vbzr'kh 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.

verses.original: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא עָבַ֨דְתָּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֖ה וּ/בְ/ט֣וּב לֵבָ֑ב מֵ/רֹ֖ב כֹּֽל
verses.translit: tcht 'shr l' 'bdt 't yhvh 'lhykh bshmchh vbtvb lbb mrb khl
verses.translation: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;

verses.original: וְ/עָבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת אֹיְבֶ֗י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשַׁלְּחֶ֤/נּוּ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔/ךְ בְּ/רָעָ֧ב וּ/בְ/צָמָ֛א וּ/בְ/עֵירֹ֖ם וּ/בְ/חֹ֣סֶר כֹּ֑ל וְ/נָתַ֞ן עֹ֤ל בַּרְזֶל֙ עַל צַוָּארֶ֔/ךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִיד֖/וֹ אֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'bdt 't 'ybykh 'shr yshlchnv yhvh bkh br'b vbtsm' vb'yrm vbchsr khl vntn 'l brzl 'l tsv'rkh 'd hshmydv 'tkh
verses.translation: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.

verses.original: יִשָּׂ֣א יְהוָה֩ עָלֶ֨י/ךָ גּ֤וֹי מֵ/רָחוֹק֙ מִ/קְצֵ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִדְאֶ֖ה הַ/נָּ֑שֶׁר גּ֕וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תִשְׁמַ֖ע לְשֹׁנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ysh' yhvh 'lykh gvy mrchvq mqtsh h'rts kh'shr yd'h hnshr gvy 'shr l' tshm' lshnv
verses.translation: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;

verses.original: גּ֖וֹי עַ֣ז פָּנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא יִשָּׂ֤א פָנִים֙ לְ/זָקֵ֔ן וְ/נַ֖עַר לֹ֥א יָחֹֽן
verses.translit: gvy 'z pnym 'shr l' ysh' pnym lzqn vn'r l' ychn
verses.translation: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:

verses.original: וְ֠/אָכַל פְּרִ֨י בְהֶמְתְּ/ךָ֥ וּ/פְרִֽי אַדְמָתְ/ךָ֮ עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָ/ךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יַשְׁאִ֜יר לְ/ךָ֗ דָּגָן֙ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/יִצְהָ֔ר שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/עַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֑/ךָ עַ֥ד הַאֲבִיד֖/וֹ אֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'khl pry bhmtkh vpry 'dmtkh 'd hshmdkh 'shr l' ysh'yr lkh dgn tyrvsh vytshr shgr 'lpykh v'shtrt ts'nkh 'd h'bydv 'tkh
verses.translation: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.

verses.original: וְ/הֵצַ֨ר לְ/ךָ֜ בְּ/כָל שְׁעָרֶ֗י/ךָ עַ֣ד רֶ֤דֶת חֹמֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/גְּבֹה֣וֹת וְ/הַ/בְּצֻר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּ/הֵ֖ן בְּ/כָל אַרְצֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הֵצַ֤ר לְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/כָל שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כָ֨ל אַרְצְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhtsr lkh bkhl sh'rykh 'd rdt chmtykh hgbhvt vhbtsrvt 'shr 'th btch bhn bkhl 'rtskh vhtsr lkh bkhl sh'rykh bkhl 'rtskh 'shr ntn yhvh 'lhykh lkh
verses.translation: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.

verses.original: וְ/אָכַלְתָּ֣ פְרִֽי בִטְנְ/ךָ֗ בְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן לְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ בְּ/מָצוֹר֙ וּ/בְ/מָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁר יָצִ֥יק לְ/ךָ֖ אֹיְבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'khlt pry btnkh bshr bnykh vbntykh 'shr ntn lkh yhvh 'lhykh bmtsvr vbmtsvq 'shr ytsyq lkh 'ybkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:

verses.original: הָ/אִישׁ֙ הָ/רַ֣ךְ בְּ/ךָ֔ וְ/הֶ/עָנֹ֖ג מְאֹ֑ד תֵּרַ֨ע עֵינ֤/וֹ בְ/אָחִי/ו֙ וּ/בְ/אֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיק֔/וֹ וּ/בְ/יֶ֥תֶר בָּנָ֖י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹתִֽיר
verses.translit: h'ysh hrkh bkh vh'ng m'd tr' 'ynv b'chyv vb'sht chyqv vbytr bnyv 'shr yvtyr
verses.translation: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:

verses.original: מִ/תֵּ֣ת לְ/אַחַ֣ד מֵ/הֶ֗ם מִ/בְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנָי/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל מִ/בְּלִ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר ל֖/וֹ כֹּ֑ל בְּ/מָצוֹר֙ וּ/בְ/מָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְ/ךָ֛ אֹיִבְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/כָל שְׁעָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: mtt l'chd mhm mbshr bnyv 'shr y'khl mbly hsh'yr lv khl bmtsvr vbmtsvq 'shr ytsyq lkh 'ybkh bkhl sh'rykh
verses.translation: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.

verses.original: הָ/רַכָּ֨ה בְ/ךָ֜ וְ/הָ/עֲנֻגָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא נִסְּתָ֤ה כַף רַגְלָ/הּ֙ הַצֵּ֣ג עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מֵ/הִתְעַנֵּ֖ג וּ/מֵ/רֹ֑ךְ תֵּרַ֤ע עֵינָ/הּ֙ בְּ/אִ֣ישׁ חֵיקָ֔/הּ וּ/בִ/בְנָ֖/הּ וּ/בְ/בִתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hrkhh bkh vh'ngh 'shr l' nsth khf rglh htsg 'l h'rts mht'ng vmrkh tr' 'ynh b'ysh chyqh vbbnh vbbth
verses.translation: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/שִׁלְיָתָ֞/הּ הַ/יּוֹצֵ֣ת מִ/בֵּ֣ין רַגְלֶ֗י/הָ וּ/בְ/בָנֶ֨י/הָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּלֵ֔ד כִּֽי תֹאכְלֵ֥/ם בְּ/חֹֽסֶר כֹּ֖ל בַּ/סָּ֑תֶר בְּ/מָצוֹר֙ וּ/בְ/מָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְ/ךָ֛ אֹיִבְ/ךָ֖ בִּ/שְׁעָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vbshlyth hyvtst mbyn rglyh vbbnyh 'shr tld khy t'khlm bchsr khl bstr bmtsvr vbmtsvq 'shr ytsyq lkh 'ybkh bsh'rykh
verses.translation: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.

verses.original: אִם לֹ֨א תִשְׁמֹ֜ר לַ/עֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי֙ הַ/תּוֹרָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את הַ/כְּתוּבִ֖ים בַּ/סֵּ֣פֶר הַ/זֶּ֑ה לְ֠/יִרְאָה אֶת הַ/שֵּׁ֞ם הַ/נִּכְבָּ֤ד וְ/הַ/נּוֹרָא֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm l' tshmr l'shvt 't khl dbry htvrh hz't hkhtvbym bspr hzh lyr'h 't hshm hnkhbd vhnvr' hzh 't yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;

verses.original: וְ/הִפְלָ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֶת מַכֹּ֣תְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אֵ֖ת מַכּ֣וֹת זַרְעֶ֑/ךָ מַכּ֤וֹת גְּדֹלוֹת֙ וְ/נֶ֣אֱמָנ֔וֹת וָ/חֳלָיִ֥ם רָעִ֖ים וְ/נֶאֱמָנִֽים
verses.translit: vhpl' yhvh 't mkhtkh v't mkhvt zr'kh mkhvt gdlvt vn'mnvt vchlym r'ym vn'mnym
verses.translation: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.

verses.original: וְ/הֵשִׁ֣יב בְּ/ךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל מַדְוֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגֹ֖רְתָּ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/דָבְק֖וּ בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhshyb bkh 't khl mdvh mtsrym 'shr ygrt mpnyhm vdbqv bkh
verses.translation: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם כָּל חֳלִי֙ וְ/כָל מַכָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א כָת֔וּב בְּ/סֵ֖פֶר הַ/תּוֹרָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֑את יַעְלֵ֤/ם יְהוָה֙ עָלֶ֔י/ךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: gm khl chly vkhl mkhh 'shr l' khtvb bspr htvrh hz't y'lm yhvh 'lykh 'd hshmdkh
verses.translation: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ בִּ/מְתֵ֣י מְעָ֔ט תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱיִיתֶ֔ם כְּ/כוֹכְבֵ֥י הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם לָ/רֹ֑ב כִּי לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vnsh'rtm bmty m't tcht 'shr hyytm khkhvkhby hshmym lrb khy l' shm't bqvl yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.

verses.original: וְ֠/הָיָה כַּ/אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֨שׂ יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֗ם לְ/הֵיטִ֣יב אֶתְ/כֶם֮ וּ/לְ/הַרְבּ֣וֹת אֶתְ/כֶם֒ כֵּ֣ן יָשִׂ֤ישׂ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם לְ/הַאֲבִ֥יד אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם וּ/לְ/הַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/נִסַּחְתֶּם֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr shsh yhvh 'lykhm lhytyb 'tkhm vlhrbvt 'tkhm khn yshysh yhvh 'lykhm lh'byd 'tkhm vlhshmyd 'tkhm vnschtm m'l h'dmh 'shr 'th b' shmh lrshth
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.

verses.original: וֶ/הֱפִֽיצְ/ךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ בְּ/כָל הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים מִ/קְצֵ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/עַד קְצֵ֣ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/עָבַ֨דְתָּ שָּׁ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא יָדַ֛עְתָּ אַתָּ֥ה וַ/אֲבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ עֵ֥ץ וָ/אָֽבֶן
verses.translit: vhpytskh yhvh bkhl h'mym mqtsh h'rts v'd qtsh h'rts v'bdt shm 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l' yd't 'th v'btykh 'ts v'bn
verses.translation: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/גּוֹיִ֤ם הָ/הֵם֙ לֹ֣א תַרְגִּ֔יעַ וְ/לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנ֖וֹחַ לְ/כַף רַגְלֶ֑/ךָ וְ/נָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה לְ/ךָ֥ שָׁם֙ לֵ֣ב רַגָּ֔ז וְ/כִלְי֥וֹן עֵינַ֖יִם וְ/דַֽאֲב֥וֹן נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: vbgvym hhm l' trgy' vl' yhyh mnvch lkhf rglkh vntn yhvh lkh shm lb rgz vkhlyvn 'ynym vd'bvn npsh
verses.translation: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:

verses.original: וְ/הָי֣וּ חַיֶּ֔י/ךָ תְּלֻאִ֥ים לְ/ךָ֖ מִ/נֶּ֑גֶד וּ/פָֽחַדְתָּ֙ לַ֣יְלָה וְ/יוֹמָ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ין בְּ/חַיֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyv chyykh tl'ym lkh mngd vpchdt lylh vyvmm vl' t'myn bchyykh
verses.translation: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:

verses.original: בַּ/בֹּ֤קֶר תֹּאמַר֙ מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן עֶ֔רֶב וּ/בָ/עֶ֥רֶב תֹּאמַ֖ר מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן בֹּ֑קֶר מִ/פַּ֤חַד לְבָֽבְ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְחָ֔ד וּ/מִ/מַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: bbqr t'mr my ytn 'rb vb'rb t'mr my ytn bqr mpchd lbbkh 'shr tpchd vmmr'h 'ynykh 'shr tr'h
verses.translation: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

verses.original: וֶֽ/הֱשִֽׁיבְ/ךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה מִצְרַיִם֮ בָּ/אֳנִיּוֹת֒ בַּ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּֽי לְ/ךָ֔ לֹא תֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לִ/רְאֹתָ֑/הּ וְ/הִתְמַכַּרְתֶּ֨ם שָׁ֧ם לְ/אֹיְבֶ֛י/ךָ לַ/עֲבָדִ֥ים וְ/לִ/שְׁפָח֖וֹת וְ/אֵ֥ין קֹנֶֽה
verses.translit: vhshybkh yhvh mtsrym b'nyvt bdrkh 'shr 'mrty lkh l' tsyf 'vd lr'th vhtmkhrtm shm l'ybykh l'bdym vlshpchvt v'yn qnh
verses.translation: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשָׂ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה לְ/עֵֽינֵי/כֶם֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְ/פַרְעֹ֥ה וּ/לְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/כָל אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh 'l khl yshr'l vy'mr 'lhm 'tm r'ytm 't khl 'shr 'shh yhvh l'ynykhm b'rts mtsrym lpr'h vlkhl 'bdyv vlkhl 'rtsv
verses.translation: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

verses.original: הַ/מַּסּוֹת֙ הַ/גְּדֹלֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ הָ/אֹתֹ֧ת וְ/הַ/מֹּפְתִ֛ים הַ/גְּדֹלִ֖ים הָ/הֵֽם
verses.translit: hmsvt hgdlt 'shr r'v 'ynykh h'tt vhmptym hgdlym hhm
verses.translation: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא נָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה לָ/כֶ֥ם לֵב֙ לָ/דַ֔עַת וְ/עֵינַ֥יִם לִ/רְא֖וֹת וְ/אָזְנַ֣יִם לִ/שְׁמֹ֑עַ עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vl' ntn yhvh lkhm lb ld't v'ynym lr'vt v'znym lshm' 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:

verses.original: וָ/אוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר לֹֽא בָל֤וּ שַׂלְמֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ מֵ/עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נַֽעַלְ/ךָ֥ לֹֽא בָלְתָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֥ל רַגְלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'vlkh 'tkhm 'rb'ym shnh bmdbr l' blv shlmtykhm m'lykhm vn'lkh l' blth m'l rglkh
verses.translation: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.

verses.original: לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אֲכַלְתֶּ֔ם וְ/יַ֥יִן וְ/שֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א שְׁתִיתֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lchm l' 'khltm vyyn vshkhr l' shtytm lm'n td'v khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א סִיחֹ֣ן מֶֽלֶךְ חֶ֠שְׁבּוֹן וְ/ע֨וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֧ן לִ/קְרָאתֵ֛/נוּ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה וַ/נַּכֵּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vtb'v 'l hmqvm hzh vyts' sychn mlkh chshbvn v'vg mlkh hbshn lqr'tnv lmlchmh vnkhm
verses.translation: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/נִּקַּח֙ אֶת אַרְצָ֔/ם וַ/נִּתְּנָ֣/הּ לְ/נַחֲלָ֔ה לָ/רֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְ/לַ/גָּדִ֑י וְ/לַ/חֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֥בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשִּֽׁי
verses.translit: vnqch 't 'rtsm vntnh lnchlh lr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy shbt hmnshy
verses.translation: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֶת דִּבְרֵי֙ הַ/בְּרִ֣ית הַ/זֹּ֔את וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑/ם לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֽׂוּ/ן
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't dbry hbryt hz't v'shytm 'tm lm'n tshkhylv 't khl 'shr t'shvn
verses.translation: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.original: אַתֶּ֨ם נִצָּבִ֤ים הַ/יּוֹם֙ כֻּלְּ/כֶ֔ם לִ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם רָאשֵׁי/כֶ֣ם שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֗ם זִקְנֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/שֹׁ֣טְרֵי/כֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'tm ntsbym hyvm khlkhm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm r'shykhm shbtykhm zqnykhm vshtrykhm khl 'ysh yshr'l
verses.translation: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.

verses.original: טַפְּ/כֶ֣ם נְשֵׁי/כֶ֔ם וְ/גֵ֣רְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֶ֑י/ךָ מֵ/חֹטֵ֣ב עֵצֶ֔י/ךָ עַ֖ד שֹׁאֵ֥ב מֵימֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tpkhm nshykhm vgrkh 'shr bqrb mchnykh mchtb 'tsykh 'd sh'b mymykh
verses.translation: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,

verses.original: לְ/עָבְרְ/ךָ֗ בִּ/בְרִ֛ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/בְ/אָלָת֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ כֹּרֵ֥ת עִמְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: l'brkh bbryt yhvh 'lhykh vb'ltv 'shr yhvh 'lhykh khrt 'mkh hyvm
verses.translation: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן הָקִֽים אֹתְ/ךָ֩ הַ/יּ֨וֹם ל֜/וֹ לְ/עָ֗ם וְ/ה֤וּא יִֽהְיֶה לְּ/ךָ֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר לָ֑/ךְ וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּע֙ לַ/אֲבֹתֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֥ם לְ/יִצְחָ֖ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: lm'n hqym 'tkh hyvm lv l'm vhv' yhyh lkh l'lhym kh'shr dbr lkh vkh'shr nshb' l'btykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb
verses.translation: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֥א אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם לְ/בַדְּ/כֶ֑ם אָנֹכִ֗י כֹּרֵת֙ אֶת הַ/בְּרִ֣ית הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/אֶת הָ/אָלָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vl' 'tkhm lbdkhm 'nkhy khrt 't hbryt hz't v't h'lh hz't
verses.translation: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אֶת אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֶשְׁנ֜/וֹ פֹּ֗ה עִמָּ֨/נוּ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד הַ/יּ֔וֹם לִ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/אֵ֨ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵינֶ֛/נּוּ פֹּ֖ה עִמָּ֥/נוּ הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: khy 't 'shr yshnv ph 'mnv 'md hyvm lpny yhvh 'lhynv v't 'shr 'ynnv ph 'mnv hyvm
verses.translation: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתֶּ֣ם יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁ֖בְנוּ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר עָבַ֛רְנוּ בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲבַרְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: khy 'tm yd'tm 't 'shr yshbnv b'rts mtsrym v't 'shr 'brnv bqrb hgvym 'shr 'brtm
verses.translation: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:

verses.original: וַ/תִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת שִׁקּ֣וּצֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת גִּלֻּלֵי/הֶ֑ם עֵ֣ץ וָ/אֶ֔בֶן כֶּ֥סֶף וְ/זָהָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִמָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vtr'v 't shqvtsyhm v't gllyhm 'ts v'bn khsf vzhb 'shr 'mhm
verses.translation: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;

verses.original: פֶּן יֵ֣שׁ בָּ֠/כֶם אִ֣ישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁ֞ה א֧וֹ מִשְׁפָּחָ֣ה אוֹ שֵׁ֗בֶט אֲשֶׁר֩ לְבָב֨/וֹ פֹנֶ֤ה הַ/יּוֹם֙ מֵ/עִם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת לַ/עֲבֹ֔ד אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֖י הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/הֵ֑ם פֶּן יֵ֣שׁ בָּ/כֶ֗ם שֹׁ֛רֶשׁ פֹּרֶ֥ה רֹ֖אשׁ וְ/לַעֲנָֽה
verses.translit: pn ysh bkhm 'ysh 'v 'shh 'v mshpchh 'v shbt 'shr lbbv pnh hyvm m'm yhvh 'lhynv llkht l'bd 't 'lhy hgvym hhm pn ysh bkhm shrsh prh r'sh vl'nh
verses.translation: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֡ה בְּ/שָׁמְע/וֹ֩ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֨י הָֽ/אָלָ֜ה הַ/זֹּ֗את וְ/הִתְבָּרֵ֨ךְ בִּ/לְבָב֤/וֹ לֵ/אמֹר֙ שָׁל֣וֹם יִֽהְיֶה לִּ֔/י כִּ֛י בִּ/שְׁרִר֥וּת לִבִּ֖/י אֵלֵ֑ךְ לְמַ֛עַן סְפ֥וֹת הָ/רָוָ֖ה אֶת הַ/צְּמֵאָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh bshm'v 't dbry h'lh hz't vhtbrkh blbbv l'mr shlvm yhyh ly khy bshrrvt lby 'lkh lm'n spvt hrvh 't htsm'h
verses.translation: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;

verses.original: לֹא יֹאבֶ֣ה יְהוָה֮ סְלֹ֣חַֽ ל/וֹ֒ כִּ֣י אָ֠ז יֶעְשַׁ֨ן אַף יְהוָ֤ה וְ/קִנְאָת/וֹ֙ בָּ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֔וּא וְ/רָ֤בְצָה בּ/וֹ֙ כָּל הָ֣/אָלָ֔ה הַ/כְּתוּבָ֖ה בַּ/סֵּ֣פֶר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וּ/מָחָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת שְׁמ֔/וֹ מִ/תַּ֖חַת הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: l' y'bh yhvh slch lv khy 'z y'shn 'f yhvh vqn'tv b'ysh hhv' vrbtsh bv khl h'lh hkhtvbh bspr hzh vmchh yhvh 't shmv mtcht hshmym
verses.translation: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:

verses.original: וְ/הִבְדִּיל֤/וֹ יְהוָה֙ לְ/רָעָ֔ה מִ/כֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ/כֹל֙ אָל֣וֹת הַ/בְּרִ֔ית הַ/כְּתוּבָ֕ה בְּ/סֵ֥פֶר הַ/תּוֹרָ֖ה הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vhbdylv yhvh lr'h mkhl shbty yshr'l khkhl 'lvt hbryt hkhtvbh bspr htvrh hzh
verses.translation: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֞ר הַ/דּ֣וֹר הָֽ/אַחֲר֗וֹן בְּנֵי/כֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָק֨וּמוּ֙ מֵ/אַ֣חֲרֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הַ֨/נָּכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֖א מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֑ה וְ֠/רָאוּ אֶת מַכּ֞וֹת הָ/אָ֤רֶץ הַ/הִוא֙ וְ/אֶת תַּ֣חֲלֻאֶ֔י/הָ אֲשֶׁר חִלָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'mr hdvr h'chrvn bnykhm 'shr yqvmv m'chrykhm vhnkhry 'shr yb' m'rts rchvqh vr'v 't mkhvt h'rts hhv' v't tchl'yh 'shr chlh yhvh bh
verses.translation: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:

verses.original: גָּפְרִ֣ית וָ/מֶלַח֮ שְׂרֵפָ֣ה כָל אַרְצָ/הּ֒ לֹ֤א תִזָּרַע֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תַצְמִ֔חַ וְ/לֹֽא יַעֲלֶ֥ה בָ֖/הּ כָּל עֵ֑שֶׂב כְּֽ/מַהְפֵּכַ֞ת סְדֹ֤ם וַ/עֲמֹרָה֙ אַדְמָ֣ה ו/צביים וּ/צְבוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הָפַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/אַפּ֖/וֹ וּ/בַ/חֲמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: gpryt vmlch shrph khl 'rtsh l' tzr' vl' ttsmch vl' y'lh bh khl 'shb khmhpkht sdm v'mrh 'dmh vtsbyym vtsbvym 'shr hpkh yhvh b'pv vbchmtv
verses.translation: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it; hath made it sick

verses.original: וְ/אָֽמְרוּ֙ כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם עַל מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה כָּ֖כָה לָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את מֶ֥ה חֳרִ֛י הָ/אַ֥ף הַ/גָּד֖וֹל הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'mrv khl hgvym 'l mh 'shh yhvh khkhh l'rts hz't mh chry h'f hgdvl hzh
verses.translation: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

verses.original: וְ/אָ֣מְר֔וּ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽזְב֔וּ אֶת בְּרִ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתָ֑/ם אֲשֶׁר֙ כָּרַ֣ת עִמָּ֔/ם בְּ/הוֹצִיא֥/וֹ אֹתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'mrv 'l 'shr 'zbv 't bryt yhvh 'lhy 'btm 'shr khrt 'mm bhvtsy'v 'tm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֗וּ וַ/יַּֽעַבְדוּ֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֖וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם אֱלֹהִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יְדָע֔וּ/ם וְ/לֹ֥א חָלַ֖ק לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vylkhv vy'bdv 'lhym 'chrym vyshtchvv lhm 'lhym 'shr l' yd'vm vl' chlq lhm
verses.translation: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/הִ֑וא לְ/הָבִ֤יא עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/קְּלָלָ֔ה הַ/כְּתוּבָ֖ה בַּ/סֵּ֥פֶר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh b'rts hhv' lhby' 'lyh 't khl hqllh hkhtvbh bspr hzh
verses.translation: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּשֵׁ֤/ם יְהוָה֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל אַדְמָתָ֔/ם בְּ/אַ֥ף וּ/בְ/חֵמָ֖ה וּ/בְ/קֶ֣צֶף גָּד֑וֹל וַ/יַּשְׁלִכֵ֛/ם אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ אַחֶ֖רֶת כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vytshm yhvh m'l 'dmtm b'f vbchmh vbqtsf gdvl vyshlkhm 'l 'rts 'chrt khyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:

verses.original: הַ֨/נִּסְתָּרֹ֔ת לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/הַ/נִּגְלֹ֞ת לָ֤ׄ/נׄוּׄ וּׄ/לְׄ/בָׄנֵׄ֨יׄ/נׄוּׄ֙ עַד עוֹלָ֔ם לַ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֖י הַ/תּוֹרָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: hnstrt lyhvh 'lhynv vhnglt lnv vlbnynv 'd 'vlm l'shvt 't khl dbry htvrh hz't
verses.translation: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ כִֽי יָבֹ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜י/ךָ כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה הַ/בְּרָכָה֙ וְ/הַ/קְּלָלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/הֲשֵׁבֹתָ֙ אֶל לְבָבֶ֔/ךָ בְּ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִדִּיחֲ/ךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vhyh khy yb'v 'lykh khl hdbrym h'lh hbrkhh vhqllh 'shr ntty lpnykh vhshbt 'l lbbkh bkhl hgvym 'shr hdychkh yhvh 'lhykh shmh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבְתָּ֞ עַד יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֣ בְ/קֹל֔/וֹ כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּ֑וֹם אַתָּ֣ה וּ/בָנֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כָל לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vshbt 'd yhvh 'lhykh vshm't bqlv khkhl 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm 'th vbnykh bkhl lbbkh vbkhl npshkh
verses.translation: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֨ב יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ אֶת שְׁבוּתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/רִחֲמֶ֑/ךָ וְ/שָׁ֗ב וְ/קִבֶּצְ/ךָ֙ מִ/כָּל הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֱפִֽיצְ/ךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vshb yhvh 'lhykh 't shbvtkh vrchmkh vshb vqbtskh mkhl h'mym 'shr hpytskh yhvh 'lhykh shmh
verses.translation: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.

verses.original: אִם יִהְיֶ֥ה נִֽדַּחֲ/ךָ֖ בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם מִ/שָּׁ֗ם יְקַבֶּצְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/מִ/שָּׁ֖ם יִקָּחֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'm yhyh ndchkh bqtsh hshmym mshm yqbtskh yhvh 'lhykh vmshm yqchkh
verses.translation: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:

verses.original: וֶ/הֱבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֞ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ אֶל הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָרְשׁ֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ וִֽ/ירִשְׁתָּ֑/הּ וְ/הֵיטִֽבְ/ךָ֥ וְ/הִרְבְּ/ךָ֖ מֵ/אֲבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhby'kh yhvh 'lhykh 'l h'rts 'shr yrshv 'btykh vyrshth vhytbkh vhrbkh m'btykh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

verses.original: וּ/מָ֨ל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ אֶת לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ וְ/אֶת לְבַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑/ךָ לְ/אַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ בְּ/כָל לְבָבְ/ךָ֥ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ לְמַ֥עַן חַיֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vml yhvh 'lhykh 't lbbkh v't lbb zr'kh l'hbh 't yhvh 'lhykh bkhl lbbkh vbkhl npshkh lm'n chyykh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַן֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֵ֥ת כָּל הָ/אָל֖וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה עַל אֹיְבֶ֥י/ךָ וְ/עַל שֹׂנְאֶ֖י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רְדָפֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: vntn yhvh 'lhykh 't khl h'lvt h'lh 'l 'ybykh v'l shn'ykh 'shr rdpvkh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה תָשׁ֔וּב וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֖ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וְ/עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'th tshvb vshm't bqvl yhvh v'shyt 't khl mtsvtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm
verses.translation: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD , and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹתִֽירְ/ךָ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֣ל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֗/ךָ בִּ/פְרִ֨י בִטְנְ/ךָ֜ וּ/בִ/פְרִ֧י בְהֶמְתְּ/ךָ֛ וּ/בִ/פְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְ/ךָ֖ לְ/טוֹבָ֑ה כִּ֣י יָשׁ֣וּב יְהוָ֗ה לָ/שׂ֤וּשׂ עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לְ/ט֔וֹב כַּ/אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֖שׂ עַל אֲבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhvtyrkh yhvh 'lhykh bkhl m'shh ydkh bpry btnkh vbpry bhmtkh vbpry 'dmtkh ltvbh khy yshvb yhvh lshvsh 'lykh ltvb kh'shr shsh 'l 'btykh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֗ע בְּ/קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לִ/שְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָי/ו֙ וְ/חֻקֹּתָ֔י/ו הַ/כְּתוּבָ֕ה בְּ/סֵ֥פֶר הַ/תּוֹרָ֖ה הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ֤י תָשׁוּב֙ אֶל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כָל לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy tshm' bqvl yhvh 'lhykh lshmr mtsvtyv vchqtyv hkhtvbh bspr htvrh hzh khy tshvb 'l yhvh 'lhykh bkhl lbbkh vbkhl npshkh
verses.translation: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

verses.original: כִּ֚י הַ/מִּצְוָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּ֑וֹם לֹֽא נִפְלֵ֥את הִוא֙ מִמְּ/ךָ֔ וְ/לֹ֥א רְחֹקָ֖ה הִֽוא
verses.translit: khy hmtsvh hz't 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm l' npl't hv' mmkh vl' rchqh hv'
verses.translation: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.

verses.original: לֹ֥א בַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם הִ֑וא לֵ/אמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲלֶה לָּ֤/נוּ הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יְמָ/ה֙ וְ/יִקָּחֶ֣/הָ לָּ֔/נוּ וְ/יַשְׁמִעֵ֥/נוּ אֹתָ֖/הּ וְ/נַעֲשֶֽׂ/נָּה
verses.translit: l' bshmym hv' l'mr my y'lh lnv hshmymh vyqchh lnv vyshm'nv 'th vn'shnh
verses.translation: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא מֵ/עֵ֥בֶר לַ/יָּ֖ם הִ֑וא לֵ/אמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲבָר לָ֜/נוּ אֶל עֵ֤בֶר הַ/יָּם֙ וְ/יִקָּחֶ֣/הָ לָּ֔/נוּ וְ/יַשְׁמִעֵ֥/נוּ אֹתָ֖/הּ וְ/נַעֲשֶֽׂ/נָּה
verses.translit: vl' m'br lym hv' l'mr my y'br lnv 'l 'br hym vyqchh lnv vyshm'nv 'th vn'shnh
verses.translation: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

verses.original: כִּֽי קָר֥וֹב אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ הַ/דָּבָ֖ר מְאֹ֑ד בְּ/פִ֥י/ךָ וּ/בִֽ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ לַ/עֲשֹׂתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy qrvb 'lykh hdbr m'd bpykh vblbbkh l'shtv
verses.translation: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.

verses.original: רְאֵ֨ה נָתַ֤תִּי לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם אֶת הַֽ/חַיִּ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/טּ֑וֹב וְ/אֶת הַ/מָּ֖וֶת וְ/אֶת הָ/רָֽע
verses.translit: r'h ntty lpnykh hyvm 't hchyym v't htvb v't hmvt v't hr'
verses.translation: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֮ הַ/יּוֹם֒ לְ/אַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת בִּ/דְרָכָ֔י/ו וְ/לִ/שְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֺתָ֥י/ו וְ/חֻקֹּתָ֖י/ו וּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֑י/ו וְ/חָיִ֣יתָ וְ/רָבִ֔יתָ וּ/בֵֽרַכְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בָּ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm l'hbh 't yhvh 'lhykh llkht bdrkhyv vlshmr mtsvtyv vchqtyv vmshptyv vchyyt vrbyt vbrkhkh yhvh 'lhykh b'rts 'shr 'th b' shmh lrshth
verses.translation: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

verses.original: וְ/אִם יִפְנֶ֥ה לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֣א תִשְׁמָ֑ע וְ/נִדַּחְתָּ֗ וְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֛יתָ לֵ/אלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים וַ/עֲבַדְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'm ypnh lbbkh vl' tshm' vndcht vhshtchvyt l'lhym 'chrym v'bdtm
verses.translation: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;

verses.original: הִגַּ֤דְתִּי לָ/כֶם֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵד֑וּ/ן לֹא תַאֲרִיכֻ֤/ן יָמִים֙ עַל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה עֹבֵר֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָ/בֹ֥א שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hgdty lkhm hyvm khy 'bd t'bdvn l' t'rykhn ymym 'l h'dmh 'shr 'th 'br 't hyrdn lb' shmh lrshth
verses.translation: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

verses.original: הַעִידֹ֨תִי בָ/כֶ֣ם הַ/יּוֹם֮ אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָרֶץ֒ הַ/חַיִּ֤ים וְ/הַ/מָּ֨וֶת֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ הַ/בְּרָכָ֖ה וְ/הַ/קְּלָלָ֑ה וּ/בָֽחַרְתָּ֙ בַּֽ/חַיִּ֔ים לְמַ֥עַן תִּחְיֶ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה וְ/זַרְעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: h'ydty bkhm hyvm 't hshmym v't h'rts hchyym vhmvt ntty lpnykh hbrkhh vhqllh vbchrt bchyym lm'n tchyh 'th vzr'kh
verses.translation: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:

verses.original: לְ/אַֽהֲבָה֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לִ/שְׁמֹ֥עַ בְּ/קֹל֖/וֹ וּ/לְ/דָבְקָה ב֑/וֹ כִּ֣י ה֤וּא חַיֶּ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/אֹ֣רֶךְ יָמֶ֔י/ךָ לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת עַל הָ/אֲדָמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה לַ/אֲבֹתֶ֛י/ךָ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֛ם לְ/יִצְחָ֥ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: l'hbh 't yhvh 'lhykh lshm' bqlv vldbqh bv khy hv' chyykh v'rkh ymykh lshbt 'l h'dmh 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb ltt lhm
verses.translation: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vylkh mshh vydbr 't hdbrym h'lh 'l khl yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם בֶּן מֵאָה֩ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם לֹא אוּכַ֥ל ע֖וֹד לָ/צֵ֣את וְ/לָ/ב֑וֹא וַֽ/יהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔/י לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm bn m'h v'shrym shnh 'nkhy hyvm l' 'vkhl 'vd lts't vlbv' vyhvh 'mr 'ly l' t'br 't hyrdn hzh
verses.translation: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

verses.original: יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ ה֣וּא עֹבֵ֣ר לְ/פָנֶ֗י/ךָ הֽוּא יַשְׁמִ֞יד אֶת הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ/אֵ֛לֶּה מִ/לְּ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ וִֽ/ירִשְׁתָּ֑/ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ ה֚וּא עֹבֵ֣ר לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhykh hv' 'br lpnykh hv' yshmyd 't hgvym h'lh mlpnykh vyrshtm yhvsh' hv' 'br lpnykh kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה לְ/סִיח֥וֹן וּ/לְ/ע֛וֹג מַלְכֵ֥י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י וּ/לְ/אַרְצָ֑/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁמִ֖יד אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'shh yhvh lhm kh'shr 'shh lsychvn vl'vg mlkhy h'mry vl'rtsm 'shr hshmyd 'tm
verses.translation: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

verses.original: וּ/נְתָנָ֥/ם יְהוָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָ/הֶ֔ם כְּ/כָל הַ/מִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vntnm yhvh lpnykhm v'shytm lhm khkhl hmtsvh 'shr tsvyty 'tkhm
verses.translation: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

verses.original: חִזְק֣וּ וְ/אִמְצ֔וּ אַל תִּֽירְא֥וּ וְ/אַל תַּעַרְצ֖וּ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ ה֚וּא הַ/הֹלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔/ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֥א יַעַזְבֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: chzqv v'mtsv 'l tyr'v v'l t'rtsv mpnyhm khy yhvh 'lhykh hv' hhlkh 'mkh l' yrpkh vl' y'zbkh
verses.translation: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִֽ/יהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו לְ/עֵינֵ֣י כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶ/אֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבוֹא֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֶל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַ/אֲבֹתָ֖/ם לָ/תֵ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תַּנְחִילֶ֥/נָּה אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh lyhvsh' vy'mr 'lyv l'yny khl yshr'l chzq v'mts khy 'th tbv' 't h'm hzh 'l h'rts 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btm ltt lhm v'th tnchylnh 'vtm
verses.translation: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֞ה ה֣וּא הַ/הֹלֵ֣ךְ לְ/פָנֶ֗י/ךָ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔/ךְ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑/ךָּ לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א וְ/לֹ֥א תֵחָֽת
verses.translit: vyhvh hv' hhlkh lpnykh hv' yhyh 'mkh l' yrpkh vl' y'zbkh l' tyr' vl' tcht
verses.translation: And the LORD , he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶת הַ/תּוֹרָ֣ה הַ/זֹּאת֒ וַֽ/יִּתְּנָ֗/הּ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הַ/נֹּ֣שְׂאִ֔ים אֶת אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֶל כָּל זִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhtb mshh 't htvrh hz't vytnh 'l hkhhnym bny lvy hnsh'ym 't 'rvn bryt yhvh v'l khl zqny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and unto all the elders of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֥ו מֹשֶׁ֖ה אוֹתָ֣/ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מִ/קֵּ֣ץ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים בְּ/מֹעֵ֛ד שְׁנַ֥ת הַ/שְּׁמִטָּ֖ה בְּ/חַ֥ג הַ/סֻּכּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vytsv mshh 'vtm l'mr mqts shb' shnym bm'd shnt hshmth bchg hskhvt
verses.translation: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

verses.original: בְּ/ב֣וֹא כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֵ/רָאוֹת֙ אֶת פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֑ר תִּקְרָ֞א אֶת הַ/תּוֹרָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֛את נֶ֥גֶד כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/אָזְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: bbv' khl yshr'l lr'vt 't pny yhvh 'lhykh bmqvm 'shr ybchr tqr' 't htvrh hz't ngd khl yshr'l b'znyhm
verses.translation: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

verses.original: הַקְהֵ֣ל אֶת הָ/עָ֗ם הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְ/הַ/נָּשִׁים֙ וְ/הַ/טַּ֔ף וְ/גֵרְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֑י/ךָ לְמַ֨עַן יִשְׁמְע֜וּ וּ/לְמַ֣עַן יִלְמְד֗וּ וְ/יָֽרְאוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/שָֽׁמְר֣וּ לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֖י הַ/תּוֹרָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: hqhl 't h'm h'nshym vhnshym vhtf vgrkh 'shr bsh'rykh lm'n yshm'v vlm'n ylmdv vyr'v 't yhvh 'lhykhm vshmrv l'shvt 't khl dbry htvrh hz't
verses.translation: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יָדְע֗וּ יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ וְ/לָ֣מְד֔וּ לְ/יִרְאָ֖ה אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vbnyhm 'shr l' yd'v yshm'v vlmdv lyr'h 't yhvh 'lhykhm khl hymym 'shr 'tm chyym 'l h'dmh 'shr 'tm 'brym 't hyrdn shmh lrshth
verses.translation: And that their children, which have not known any thing , may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה הֵ֣ן קָרְב֣וּ יָמֶי/ךָ֮ לָ/מוּת֒ קְרָ֣א אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וְ/הִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וַ/אֲצַוֶּ֑/נּוּ וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ מֹשֶׁה֙ וִֽ/יהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַ/יִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh hn qrbv ymykh lmvt qr' 't yhvsh' vhtytsbv b'hl mv'd v'tsvnv vylkh mshh vyhvsh' vytytsbv b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה בָּ/אֹ֖הֶל בְּ/עַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֑ן וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֛ד עַמּ֥וּד הֶ/עָנָ֖ן עַל פֶּ֥תַח הָ/אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh b'hl b'mvd 'nn vy'md 'mvd h'nn 'l ptch h'hl
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה הִנְּ/ךָ֥ שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם אֲבֹתֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/קָם֩ הָ/עָ֨ם הַ/זֶּ֜ה וְ/זָנָ֣ה אַחֲרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵֽכַר הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא בָא שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ בְּ/קִרְבּ֔/וֹ וַ/עֲזָבַ֕/נִי וְ/הֵפֵר֙ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh hnkh shkhb 'm 'btykh vqm h'm hzh vznh 'chry 'lhy nkhr h'rts 'shr hv' b' shmh bqrbv v'zbny vhpr 't bryty 'shr khrty 'tv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

verses.original: וְ/חָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֣/י ב֣/וֹ בַ/יּוֹם הַ֠/הוּא וַ/עֲזַבְתִּ֞י/ם וְ/הִסְתַּרְתִּ֨י פָנַ֤/י מֵ/הֶם֙ וְ/הָיָ֣ה לֶֽ/אֱכֹ֔ל וּ/מְצָאֻ֛/הוּ רָע֥וֹת רַבּ֖וֹת וְ/צָר֑וֹת וְ/אָמַר֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא הֲ/לֹ֗א עַ֣ל כִּֽי אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהַ/י֙ בְּ/קִרְבִּ֔/י מְצָא֖וּ/נִי הָ/רָע֥וֹת הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vchrh 'py bv byvm hhv' v'zbtym vhstrty pny mhm vhyh l'khl vmts'hv r'vt rbvt vtsrvt v'mr byvm hhv' hl' 'l khy 'yn 'lhy bqrby mts'vny hr'vt h'lh
verses.translation: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֗י הַסְתֵּ֨ר אַסְתִּ֤יר פָּנַ/י֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא עַ֥ל כָּל הָ/רָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י פָנָ֔ה אֶל אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: v'nkhy hstr 'styr pny byvm hhv' 'l khl hr'h 'shr 'shh khy pnh 'l 'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה כִּתְב֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ אֶת הַ/שִּׁירָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/לַמְּדָ֥/הּ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׂימָ֣/הּ בְּ/פִי/הֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּהְיֶה לִּ֜/י הַ/שִּׁירָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֛את לְ/עֵ֖ד בִּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'th khtbv lkhm 't hshyrh hz't vlmdh 't bny yshr'l shymh bpyhm lm'n thyh ly hshyrh hz't l'd bbny yshr'l
verses.translation: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֲבִיאֶ֜/נּוּ אֶֽל הָ/אֲדָמָ֣ה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לַ/אֲבֹתָ֗י/ו זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּ/דְבַ֔שׁ וְ/אָכַ֥ל וְ/שָׂבַ֖ע וְ/דָשֵׁ֑ן וּ/פָנָ֞ה אֶל אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ וַ/עֲבָד֔וּ/ם וְ/נִ֣אֲצ֔וּ/נִי וְ/הֵפֵ֖ר אֶת בְּרִיתִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'by'nv 'l h'dmh 'shr nshb'ty l'btyv zbt chlb vdbsh v'khl vshb' vdshn vpnh 'l 'lhym 'chrym v'bdvm vn'tsvny vhpr 't bryty
verses.translation: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

verses.original: וְ֠/הָיָה כִּֽי תִמְצֶ֨אןָ אֹת֜/וֹ רָע֣וֹת רַבּוֹת֮ וְ/צָרוֹת֒ וְ֠/עָנְתָה הַ/שִּׁירָ֨ה הַ/זֹּ֤את לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ לְ/עֵ֔ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכַ֖ח מִ/פִּ֣י זַרְע֑/וֹ כִּ֧י יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶת יִצְר֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֤וּא עֹשֶׂה֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם בְּ/טֶ֣רֶם אֲבִיאֶ֔/נּוּ אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבָּֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: vhyh khy tmts'n 'tv r'vt rbvt vtsrvt v'nth hshyrh hz't lpnyv l'd khy l' tshkhch mpy zr'v khy yd'ty 't ytsrv 'shr hv' 'shh hyvm btrm 'by'nv 'l h'rts 'shr nshb'ty
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת הַ/שִּׁירָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַֽ/יְלַמְּדָ֖/הּ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhtb mshh 't hshyrh hz't byvm hhv' vylmdh 't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֞ו אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֗וּן וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ חֲזַ֣ק וֶֽ/אֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבִיא֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vytsv 't yhvsh' bn nvn vy'mr chzq v'mts khy 'th tby' 't bny yshr'l 'l h'rts 'shr nshb'ty lhm v'nkhy 'hyh 'mkh
verses.translation: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְּ/כַלּ֣וֹת מֹשֶׁ֗ה לִ/כְתֹּ֛ב אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/תּוֹרָֽה הַ/זֹּ֖את עַל סֵ֑פֶר עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy khkhlvt mshh lkhtb 't dbry htvrh hz't 'l spr 'd tmm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם נֹ֥שְׂאֵ֛י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytsv mshh 't hlvym nsh'y 'rvn bryt yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , saying,

verses.original: לָקֹ֗חַ אֵ֣ת סֵ֤פֶר הַ/תּוֹרָה֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/שַׂמְתֶּ֣ם אֹת֔/וֹ מִ/צַּ֛ד אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָֽיָה שָׁ֥ם בְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/עֵֽד
verses.translit: lqch 't spr htvrh hzh vshmtm 'tv mtsd 'rvn bryt yhvh 'lhykhm vhyh shm bkh l'd
verses.translation: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶֽת מֶרְיְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אֶֽת עָרְפְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/קָּשֶׁ֑ה הֵ֣ן בְּ/עוֹדֶ/נִּי֩ חַ֨י עִמָּ/כֶ֜ם הַ/יּ֗וֹם מַמְרִ֤ים הֱיִתֶם֙ עִם יְהֹוָ֔ה וְ/אַ֖ף כִּי אַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'nkhy yd'ty 't mrykh v't 'rpkh hqshh hn b'vdny chy 'mkhm hyvm mmrym hytm 'm yhvh v'f khy 'chry mvty
verses.translation: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD ; and how much more after my death?

verses.original: הַקְהִ֧ילוּ אֵלַ֛/י אֶת כָּל זִקְנֵ֥י שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/שֹׁטְרֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/אֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ/אָזְנֵי/הֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וְ/אָעִ֣ידָה בָּ֔/ם אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hqhylv 'ly 't khl zqny shbtykhm vshtrykhm v'dbrh b'znyhm 't hdbrym h'lh v''ydh bm 't hshmym v't h'rts
verses.translation: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי אַחֲרֵ֤י מוֹתִ/י֙ כִּֽי הַשְׁחֵ֣ת תַּשְׁחִת֔וּ/ן וְ/סַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן הַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/קָרָ֨את אֶתְ/כֶ֤ם הָֽ/רָעָה֙ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֣ית הַ/יָּמִ֔ים כִּֽי תַעֲשׂ֤וּ אֶת הָ/רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְ/הַכְעִיס֖/וֹ בְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy yd'ty 'chry mvty khy hshcht tshchtvn vsrtm mn hdrkh 'shr tsvyty 'tkhm vqr't 'tkhm hr'h b'chryt hymym khy t'shv 't hr' b'yny yhvh lhkh'ysv bm'shh ydykhm
verses.translation: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves , and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּ/אָזְנֵי֙ כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/שִּׁירָ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vydbr mshh b'zny khl qhl yshr'l 't dbry hshyrh hz't 'd tmm
verses.translation: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וַ/אֲדַבֵּ֑רָה וְ/תִשְׁמַ֥ע הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אִמְרֵי פִֽ/י
verses.translit: h'zynv hshmym v'dbrh vtshm' h'rts 'mry py
verses.translation: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

verses.original: יַעֲרֹ֤ף כַּ/מָּטָר֙ לִקְחִ֔/י תִּזַּ֥ל כַּ/טַּ֖ל אִמְרָתִ֑/י כִּ/שְׂעִירִ֣ם עֲלֵי דֶ֔שֶׁא וְ/כִ/רְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי עֵֽשֶׂב
verses.translit: y'rf khmtr lqchy tzl khtl 'mrty khsh'yrm 'ly dsh' vkhrbybym 'ly 'shb
verses.translation: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

verses.original: כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א הָב֥וּ גֹ֖דֶל לֵ/אלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: khy shm yhvh 'qr' hbv gdl l'lhynv
verses.translation: Because I will publish the name of the LORD : ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

verses.original: הַ/צּוּר֙ תָּמִ֣ים פָּעֳל֔/וֹ כִּ֥י כָל דְּרָכָ֖י/ו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אֵ֤ל אֱמוּנָה֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין עָ֔וֶל צַדִּ֥יק וְ/יָשָׁ֖ר הֽוּא
verses.translit: htsvr tmym p'lv khy khl drkhyv mshpt 'l 'mvnh v'yn 'vl tsdyq vyshr hv'
verses.translation: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

verses.original: שִׁחֵ֥ת ל֛/וֹ לֹ֖א בָּנָ֣י/ו מוּמָ֑/ם דּ֥וֹר עִקֵּ֖שׁ וּ/פְתַלְתֹּֽל
verses.translit: shcht lv l' bnyv mvmm dvr 'qsh vptltl
verses.translation: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.

verses.original: הֲ לַ/יְהוָה֙ תִּגְמְלוּ זֹ֔את עַ֥ם נָבָ֖ל וְ/לֹ֣א חָכָ֑ם הֲ/לוֹא הוּא֙ אָבִ֣י/ךָ קָּנֶ֔/ךָ ה֥וּא עָֽשְׂ/ךָ֖ וַֽ/יְכֹנְנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: h lyhvh tgmlv z't 'm nbl vl' chkhm hlv' hv' 'bykh qnkh hv' 'shkh vykhnnkh
verses.translation: Do ye thus requite the LORD , O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ יְמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם בִּ֖ינוּ שְׁנ֣וֹת דּוֹר וָ/ד֑וֹר שְׁאַ֤ל אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/יַגֵּ֔דְ/ךָ זְקֵנֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/יֹ֥אמְרוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: zkhr ymvt 'vlm bynv shnvt dvr vdvr sh'l 'bykh vygdkh zqnykh vy'mrv lkh
verses.translation: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.

verses.original: בְּ/הַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּ/הַפְרִיד֖/וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְ/מִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bhnchl 'lyvn gvym bhprydv bny 'dm ytsb gblt 'mym lmspr bny yshr'l
verses.translation: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֛י חֵ֥לֶק יְהֹוָ֖ה עַמּ֑/וֹ יַעֲקֹ֖ב חֶ֥בֶל נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy chlq yhvh 'mv y'qb chbl nchltv
verses.translation: For the LORD’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

verses.original: יִמְצָאֵ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִדְבָּ֔ר וּ/בְ/תֹ֖הוּ יְלֵ֣ל יְשִׁמֹ֑ן יְסֹֽבְבֶ֨/נְהוּ֙ יְב֣וֹנְנֵ֔/הוּ יִצְּרֶ֖/נְהוּ כְּ/אִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ymts'hv b'rts mdbr vbthv yll yshmn ysbbnhv ybvnnhv ytsrnhv kh'yshvn 'ynv
verses.translation: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

verses.original: כְּ/נֶ֨שֶׁר֙ יָעִ֣יר קִנּ֔/וֹ עַל גּוֹזָלָ֖י/ו יְרַחֵ֑ף יִפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפָי/ו֙ יִקָּחֵ֔/הוּ יִשָּׂאֵ֖/הוּ עַל אֶבְרָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khnshr y'yr qnv 'l gvzlyv yrchf yprsh khnpyv yqchhv ysh'hv 'l 'brtv
