verses.translation: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה בָּדָ֣ד יַנְחֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/אֵ֥ין עִמּ֖/וֹ אֵ֥ל נֵכָֽר
verses.translit: yhvh bdd ynchnv v'yn 'mv 'l nkhr
verses.translation: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.

verses.original: יַרְכִּבֵ֨/הוּ֙ עַל במותי בָּ֣מֳתֵי אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יֹּאכַ֖ל תְּנוּבֹ֣ת שָׂדָ֑י וַ/יֵּנִקֵ֤/הֽוּ דְבַשׁ֙ מִ/סֶּ֔לַע וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן מֵ/חַלְמִ֥ישׁ צֽוּר
verses.translit: yrkhbhv 'l bmvty bmty 'rts vy'khl tnvbt shdy vynqhv dbsh msl' vshmn mchlmysh tsvr
verses.translation: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

verses.original: חֶמְאַ֨ת בָּקָ֜ר וַ/חֲלֵ֣ב צֹ֗אן עִם חֵ֨לֶב כָּרִ֜ים וְ/אֵילִ֤ים בְּנֵֽי בָשָׁן֙ וְ/עַתּוּדִ֔ים עִם חֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת חִטָּ֑ה וְ/דַם עֵנָ֖ב תִּשְׁתֶּה חָֽמֶר
verses.translit: chm't bqr vchlb ts'n 'm chlb khrym v'ylym bny bshn v'tvdym 'm chlb khlyvt chth vdm 'nb tshth chmr
verses.translation: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ן יְשֻׁרוּן֙ וַ/יִּבְעָ֔ט שָׁמַ֖נְתָּ עָבִ֣יתָ כָּשִׂ֑יתָ וַ/יִּטֹּשׁ֙ אֱל֣וֹהַ עָשָׂ֔/הוּ וַ/יְנַבֵּ֖ל צ֥וּר יְשֻׁעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshmn yshrvn vyb't shmnt 'byt khshyt vytsh 'lvh 'shhv vynbl tsvr ysh'tv
verses.translation: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

verses.original: יַקְנִאֻ֖/הוּ בְּ/זָרִ֑ים בְּ/תוֹעֵבֹ֖ת יַכְעִיסֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: yqn'hv bzrym btv'bt ykh'yshv
verses.translation: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods , with abominations provoked they him to anger.

verses.original: יִזְבְּח֗וּ לַ/שֵּׁדִים֙ לֹ֣א אֱלֹ֔הַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א יְדָע֑וּ/ם חֲדָשִׁים֙ מִ/קָּרֹ֣ב בָּ֔אוּ לֹ֥א שְׂעָר֖וּ/ם אֲבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: yzbchv lshdym l' 'lh 'lhym l' yd'vm chdshym mqrb b'v l' sh'rvm 'btykhm
verses.translation: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

verses.original: צ֥וּר יְלָדְ/ךָ֖ תֶּ֑שִׁי וַ/תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֵ֥ל מְחֹלְלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: tsvr yldkh tshy vtshkhch 'l mchllkh
verses.translation: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יִּנְאָ֑ץ מִ/כַּ֥עַס בָּנָ֖י/ו וּ/בְנֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh vyn'ts mkh's bnyv vbntyv
verses.translation: And when the LORD saw it , he abhorred them , because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אַסְתִּ֤ירָה פָנַ/י֙ מֵ/הֶ֔ם אֶרְאֶ֖ה מָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֑/ם כִּ֣י ד֤וֹר תַּהְפֻּכֹת֙ הֵ֔מָּה בָּנִ֖ים לֹא אֵמֻ֥ן בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'styrh pny mhm 'r'h mh 'chrytm khy dvr thpkht hmh bnym l' 'mn bm
verses.translation: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.

verses.original: הֵ֚ם קִנְא֣וּ/נִי בְ/לֹא אֵ֔ל כִּעֲס֖וּ/נִי בְּ/הַבְלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/אֲנִי֙ אַקְנִיאֵ֣/ם בְּ/לֹא עָ֔ם בְּ/ג֥וֹי נָבָ֖ל אַכְעִיסֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: hm qn'vny bl' 'l kh'svny bhblyhm v'ny 'qny'm bl' 'm bgvy nbl 'kh'ysm
verses.translation: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

verses.original: כִּי אֵשׁ֙ קָדְחָ֣ה בְ/אַפִּ֔/י וַ/תִּיקַ֖ד עַד שְׁא֣וֹל תַּחְתִּ֑ית וַ/תֹּ֤אכַל אֶ֨רֶץ֙ וִֽ/יבֻלָ֔/הּ וַ/תְּלַהֵ֖ט מוֹסְדֵ֥י הָרִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'sh qdchh b'py vtyqd 'd sh'vl tchtyt vt'khl 'rts vyblh vtlht mvsdy hrym
verses.translation: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

verses.original: אַסְפֶּ֥ה עָלֵ֖י/מוֹ רָע֑וֹת חִצַּ֖/י אֲכַלֶּה בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'sph 'lymv r'vt chtsy 'khlh bm
verses.translation: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

verses.original: מְזֵ֥י רָעָ֛ב וּ/לְחֻ֥מֵי רֶ֖שֶׁף וְ/קֶ֣טֶב מְרִירִ֑י וְ/שֶׁן בְּהֵמוֹת֙ אֲשַׁלַּח בָּ֔/ם עִם חֲמַ֖ת זֹחֲלֵ֥י עָפָֽר
verses.translit: mzy r'b vlchmy rshf vqtb mryry vshn bhmvt 'shlch bm 'm chmt zchly 'pr
verses.translation: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

verses.original: מִ/חוּץ֙ תְּשַׁכֶּל חֶ֔רֶב וּ/מֵ/חֲדָרִ֖ים אֵימָ֑ה גַּם בָּחוּר֙ גַּם בְּתוּלָ֔ה יוֹנֵ֖ק עִם אִ֥ישׁ שֵׂיבָֽה
verses.translit: mchvts tshkhl chrb vmchdrym 'ymh gm bchvr gm btvlh yvnq 'm 'ysh shybh
verses.translation: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.

verses.original: אָמַ֖רְתִּי אַפְאֵי/הֶ֑ם אַשְׁבִּ֥יתָה מֵ/אֱנ֖וֹשׁ זִכְרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'mrty 'p'yhm 'shbyth m'nvsh zkhrm
verses.translation: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

verses.original: לוּלֵ֗י כַּ֤עַס אוֹיֵב֙ אָג֔וּר פֶּֽן יְנַכְּר֖וּ צָרֵ֑י/מוֹ פֶּן יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ יָדֵ֣י/נוּ רָ֔מָה וְ/לֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה פָּעַ֥ל כָּל זֹֽאת
verses.translit: lvly kh's 'vyb 'gvr pn ynkhrv tsrymv pn y'mrv ydynv rmh vl' yhvh p'l khl z't
verses.translation: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this. hath done

verses.original: כִּי ג֛וֹי אֹבַ֥ד עֵצ֖וֹת הֵ֑מָּה וְ/אֵ֥ין בָּ/הֶ֖ם תְּבוּנָֽה
verses.translit: khy gvy 'bd 'tsvt hmh v'yn bhm tbvnh
verses.translation: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

verses.original: ל֥וּ חָכְמ֖וּ יַשְׂכִּ֣ילוּ זֹ֑את יָבִ֖ינוּ לְ/אַחֲרִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lv chkhmv yshkhylv z't ybynv l'chrytm
verses.translation: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

verses.original: אֵיכָ֞ה יִרְדֹּ֤ף אֶחָד֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּ/שְׁנַ֖יִם יָנִ֣יסוּ רְבָבָ֑ה אִם לֹא֙ כִּי צוּרָ֣/ם מְכָרָ֔/ם וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה הִסְגִּירָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'ykhh yrdf 'chd 'lf vshnym ynysv rbbh 'm l' khy tsvrm mkhrm vyhvh hsgyrm
verses.translation: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?

verses.original: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א כְ/צוּרֵ֖/נוּ צוּרָ֑/ם וְ/אֹיְבֵ֖י/נוּ פְּלִילִֽים
verses.translit: khy l' khtsvrnv tsvrm v'ybynv plylym
verses.translation: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

verses.original: כִּֽי מִ/גֶּ֤פֶן סְדֹם֙ גַּפְנָ֔/ם וּ/מִ/שַּׁדְמֹ֖ת עֲמֹרָ֑ה עֲנָבֵ֨/מוֹ֙ עִנְּבֵי ר֔וֹשׁ אַשְׁכְּלֹ֥ת מְרֹרֹ֖ת לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: khy mgpn sdm gpnm vmshdmt 'mrh 'nbmv 'nby rvsh 'shkhlt mrrt lmv
verses.translation: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:

verses.original: חֲמַ֥ת תַּנִּינִ֖ם יֵינָ֑/ם וְ/רֹ֥אשׁ פְּתָנִ֖ים אַכְזָֽר
verses.translit: chmt tnynm yynm vr'sh ptnym 'khzr
verses.translation: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא ה֖וּא כָּמֻ֣ס עִמָּ/דִ֑י חָתֻ֖ם בְּ/אוֹצְרֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: hl' hv' khms 'mdy chtm b'vtsrty
verses.translation: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

verses.original: לִ֤/י נָקָם֙ וְ/שִׁלֵּ֔ם לְ/עֵ֖ת תָּמ֣וּט רַגְלָ֑/ם כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם אֵידָ֔/ם וְ/חָ֖שׁ עֲתִדֹ֥ת לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: ly nqm vshlm l't tmvt rglm khy qrvb yvm 'ydm vchsh 'tdt lmv
verses.translation: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

verses.original: כִּֽי יָדִ֤ין יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔/וֹ וְ/עַל עֲבָדָ֖י/ו יִתְנֶחָ֑ם כִּ֤י יִרְאֶה֙ כִּי אָ֣זְלַת יָ֔ד וְ/אֶ֖פֶס עָצ֥וּר וְ/עָזֽוּב
verses.translit: khy ydyn yhvh 'mv v'l 'bdyv ytnchm khy yr'h khy 'zlt yd v'ps 'tsvr v'zvb
verses.translation: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֖ר אֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑י/מוֹ צ֖וּר חָסָ֥יוּ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'mr 'y 'lhymv tsvr chsyv bv
verses.translation: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר חֵ֤לֶב זְבָחֵ֨י/מוֹ֙ יֹאכֵ֔לוּ יִשְׁתּ֖וּ יֵ֣ין נְסִיכָ֑/ם יָק֨וּמוּ֙ וְ/יַעְזְרֻ/כֶ֔ם יְהִ֥י עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם סִתְרָֽה
verses.translit: 'shr chlb zbchymv y'khlv yshtv yyn nsykhm yqvmv vy'zrkhm yhy 'lykhm strh
verses.translation: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.

verses.original: רְא֣וּ עַתָּ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י אֲנִי֙ ה֔וּא וְ/אֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּ/דִ֑י אֲנִ֧י אָמִ֣ית וַ/אֲחַיֶּ֗ה מָחַ֨צְתִּי֙ וַ/אֲנִ֣י אֶרְפָּ֔א וְ/אֵ֥ין מִ/יָּדִ֖/י מַצִּֽיל
verses.translit: r'v 'th khy 'ny 'ny hv' v'yn 'lhym 'mdy 'ny 'myt v'chyh mchtsty v'ny 'rp' v'yn mydy mtsyl
verses.translation: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶל שָׁמַ֖יִם יָדִ֑/י וְ/אָמַ֕רְתִּי חַ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י לְ/עֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khy 'sh' 'l shmym ydy v'mrty chy 'nkhy l'lm
verses.translation: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

verses.original: אִם שַׁנּוֹתִי֙ בְּרַ֣ק חַרְבִּ֔/י וְ/תֹאחֵ֥ז בְּ/מִשְׁפָּ֖ט יָדִ֑/י אָשִׁ֤יב נָקָם֙ לְ/צָרָ֔/י וְ/לִ/מְשַׂנְאַ֖/י אֲשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: 'm shnvty brq chrby vt'chz bmshpt ydy 'shyb nqm ltsry vlmshn'y 'shlm
verses.translation: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.

verses.original: אַשְׁכִּ֤יר חִצַּ/י֙ מִ/דָּ֔ם וְ/חַרְבִּ֖/י תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֑ר מִ/דַּ֤ם חָלָל֙ וְ/שִׁבְיָ֔ה מֵ/רֹ֖אשׁ פַּרְע֥וֹת אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: 'shkhyr chtsy mdm vchrby t'khl bshr mdm chll vshbyh mr'sh pr'vt 'vyb
verses.translation: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

verses.original: הַרְנִ֤ינוּ גוֹיִם֙ עַמּ֔/וֹ כִּ֥י דַם עֲבָדָ֖י/ו יִקּ֑וֹם וְ/נָקָם֙ יָשִׁ֣יב לְ/צָרָ֔י/ו וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר אַדְמָת֖/וֹ עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hrnynv gvym 'mv khy dm 'bdyv yqvm vnqm yshyb ltsryv vkhpr 'dmtv 'mv
verses.translation: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/שִּׁירָֽה הַ/זֹּ֖את בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם ה֖וּא וְ/הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן נֽוּן
verses.translit: vyb' mshh vydbr 't khl dbry hshyrh hz't b'zny h'm hv' vhvsh' bn nvn
verses.translation: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְ/דַבֵּ֛ר אֶת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhl mshh ldbr 't khl hdbrym h'lh 'l khl yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ שִׂ֣ימוּ לְבַבְ/כֶ֔ם לְ/כָל הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵעִ֥יד בָּ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּ֑וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תְּצַוֻּ/ם֙ אֶת בְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם לִ/שְׁמֹ֣ר לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֖י הַ/תּוֹרָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm shymv lbbkhm lkhl hdbrym 'shr 'nkhy m'yd bkhm hyvm 'shr ttsvm 't bnykhm lshmr l'shvt 't khl dbry htvrh hz't
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא דָבָ֨ר רֵ֥ק הוּא֙ מִ/כֶּ֔ם כִּי ה֖וּא חַיֵּי/כֶ֑ם וּ/בַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה תַּאֲרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ עַל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy l' dbr rq hv' mkhm khy hv' chyykhm vbdbr hzh t'rykhv ymym 'l h'dmh 'shr 'tm 'brym 't hyrdn shmh lrshth
verses.translation: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּ/עֶ֛צֶם הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh b'tsm hyvm hzh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

verses.original: עֲלֵ֡ה אֶל הַר֩ הָ/עֲבָרִ֨ים הַ/זֶּ֜ה הַר נְב֗וֹ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וּ/רְאֵה֙ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַ/אֲחֻזָּֽה
verses.translit: 'lh 'l hr h'brym hzh hr nbv 'shr b'rts mv'b 'shr 'l pny yrchv vr'h 't 'rts khn'n 'shr 'ny ntn lbny yshr'l l'chzh
verses.translation: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:

verses.original: וּ/מֻ֗ת בָּ/הָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עֹלֶ֣ה שָׁ֔מָּ/ה וְ/הֵאָסֵ֖ף אֶל עַמֶּ֑י/ךָ כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר מֵ֞ת אַהֲרֹ֤ן אָחִ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/הֹ֣ר הָ/הָ֔ר וַ/יֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל עַמָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmt bhr 'shr 'th 'lh shmh vh'sf 'l 'mykh kh'shr mt 'hrn 'chykh bhr hhr vy'sf 'l 'myv
verses.translation: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

verses.original: עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מְעַלְתֶּ֜ם בִּ֗/י בְּ/תוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/מֵֽי מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר צִ֑ן עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא קִדַּשְׁתֶּם֙ אוֹתִ֔/י בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'l 'shr m'ltm by btvkh bny yshr'l bmy mrybt qdsh mdbr tsn 'l 'shr l' qdshtm 'vty btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֥י מִ/נֶּ֖גֶד תִּרְאֶ֣ה אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ לֹ֣א תָב֔וֹא אֶל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֖ן לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy mngd tr'h 't h'rts vshmh l' tbv' 'l h'rts 'shr 'ny ntn lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֣את הַ/בְּרָכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בֵּרַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אִ֥ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לִ/פְנֵ֖י מוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vz't hbrkhh 'shr brkh mshh 'ysh h'lhym 't bny yshr'l lpny mvtv
verses.translation: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה מִ/סִּינַ֥י בָּא֙ וְ/זָרַ֤ח מִ/שֵּׂעִיר֙ לָ֔/מוֹ הוֹפִ֨יעַ֙ מֵ/הַ֣ר פָּארָ֔ן וְ/אָתָ֖ה מֵ/רִבְבֹ֣ת קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִֽ/ימִינ֕/וֹ אשדת אֵ֥שׁ דָּ֖ת לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh msyny b' vzrch msh'yr lmv hvpy' mhr p'rn v'th mrbbt qdsh mymynv 'shdt 'sh dt lmv
verses.translation: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.

verses.original: אַ֚ף חֹבֵ֣ב עַמִּ֔ים כָּל קְדֹשָׁ֖י/ו בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הֵם֙ תֻּכּ֣וּ לְ/רַגְלֶ֔/ךָ יִשָּׂ֖א מִ/דַּבְּרֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'f chbb 'mym khl qdshyv bydkh vhm tkhv lrglkh ysh' mdbrtykh
verses.translation: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.

verses.original: תּוֹרָ֥ה צִוָּה לָ֖/נוּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה קְהִלַּ֥ת יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: tvrh tsvh lnv mshh mvrshh qhlt y'qb
verses.translation: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י בִ/ישֻׁר֖וּן מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ/הִתְאַסֵּף֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם יַ֖חַד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy byshrvn mlkh bht'sf r'shy 'm ychd shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

verses.original: יְחִ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן וְ/אַל יָמֹ֑ת וִ/יהִ֥י מְתָ֖י/ו מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: ychy r'vbn v'l ymt vyhy mtyv mspr
verses.translation: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֣את לִֽ/יהוּדָה֮ וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ שְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ ק֣וֹל יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/אֶל עַמּ֖/וֹ תְּבִיאֶ֑/נּוּ יָדָי/ו֙ רָ֣ב ל֔/וֹ וְ/עֵ֥זֶר מִ/צָּרָ֖י/ו תִּהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vz't lyhvdh vy'mr shm' yhvh qvl yhvdh v'l 'mv tby'nv ydyv rb lv v'zr mtsryv thyh
verses.translation: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD , the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/לֵוִ֣י אָמַ֔ר תֻּמֶּ֥י/ךָ וְ/אוּרֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ חֲסִידֶ֑/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִסִּית/וֹ֙ בְּ/מַסָּ֔ה תְּרִיבֵ֖/הוּ עַל מֵ֥י מְרִיבָֽה
verses.translit: vllvy 'mr tmykh v'vrykh l'ysh chsydkh 'shr nsytv bmsh trybhv 'l my mrybh
verses.translation: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;

verses.original: הָ/אֹמֵ֞ר לְ/אָבִ֤י/ו וּ/לְ/אִמּ/וֹ֙ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת אֶחָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א הִכִּ֔יר וְ/אֶת בנ/ו בָּנָ֖י/ו לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע כִּ֤י שָֽׁמְרוּ֙ אִמְרָתֶ֔/ךָ וּ/בְרִֽיתְ/ךָ֖ יִנְצֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: h'mr l'byv vl'mv l' r'ytyv v't 'chyv l' hkhyr v't bnv bnyv l' yd' khy shmrv 'mrtkh vbrytkh yntsrv
verses.translation: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.

verses.original: יוֹר֤וּ מִשְׁפָּטֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לְ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/תוֹרָתְ/ךָ֖ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יָשִׂ֤ימוּ קְטוֹרָה֙ בְּ/אַפֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/כָלִ֖יל עַֽל מִזְבְּחֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yvrv mshptykh ly'qb vtvrtkh lyshr'l yshymv qtvrh b'pkh vkhlyl 'l mzbchkh
verses.translation: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.

verses.original: בָּרֵ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ חֵיל֔/וֹ וּ/פֹ֥עַל יָדָ֖י/ו תִּרְצֶ֑ה מְחַ֨ץ מָתְנַ֧יִם קָמָ֛י/ו וּ/מְשַׂנְאָ֖י/ו מִן יְקוּמֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: brkh yhvh chylv vp'l ydyv trtsh mchts mtnym qmyv vmshn'yv mn yqvmvn
verses.translation: Bless, LORD , his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

verses.original: לְ/בִנְיָמִ֣ן אָמַ֔ר יְדִ֣יד יְהֹוָ֔ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָ/בֶ֖טַח עָלָ֑י/ו חֹפֵ֤ף עָלָי/ו֙ כָּל הַ/יּ֔וֹם וּ/בֵ֥ין כְּתֵיפָ֖י/ו שָׁכֵֽן
verses.translit: lbnymn 'mr ydyd yhvh yshkhn lbtch 'lyv chpf 'lyv khl hyvm vbyn khtypyv shkhn
verses.translation: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/יוֹסֵ֣ף אָמַ֔ר מְבֹרֶ֥כֶת יְהֹוָ֖ה אַרְצ֑/וֹ מִ/מֶּ֤גֶד שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִ/טָּ֔ל וּ/מִ/תְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֥צֶת תָּֽחַת
verses.translit: vlyvsf 'mr mbrkht yhvh 'rtsv mmgd shmym mtl vmthvm rbtst tcht
verses.translation: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מֶּ֖גֶד תְּבוּאֹ֣ת שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וּ/מִ/מֶּ֖גֶד גֶּ֥רֶשׁ יְרָחִֽים
verses.translit: vmmgd tbv't shmsh vmmgd grsh yrchym
verses.translation: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/רֹ֖אשׁ הַרְרֵי קֶ֑דֶם וּ/מִ/מֶּ֖גֶד גִּבְע֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vmr'sh hrry qdm vmmgd gb'vt 'vlm
verses.translation: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מֶּ֗גֶד אֶ֚רֶץ וּ/מְלֹאָ֔/הּ וּ/רְצ֥וֹן שֹׁכְנִ֖י סְנֶ֑ה תָּב֨וֹאתָ/ה֙ לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּ/לְ/קָדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmmgd 'rts vml'h vrtsvn shkhny snh tbv'th lr'sh yvsf vlqdqd nzyr 'chyv
verses.translation: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.

verses.original: בְּכ֨וֹר שׁוֹר֜/וֹ הָדָ֣ר ל֗/וֹ וְ/קַרְנֵ֤י רְאֵם֙ קַרְנָ֔י/ו בָּ/הֶ֗ם עַמִּ֛ים יְנַגַּ֥ח יַחְדָּ֖ו אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הֵם֙ רִבְב֣וֹת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/הֵ֖ם אַלְפֵ֥י מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: bkhvr shvrv hdr lv vqrny r'm qrnyv bhm 'mym yngch ychdv 'psy 'rts vhm rbbvt 'prym vhm 'lpy mnshh
verses.translation: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/זְבוּלֻ֣ן אָמַ֔ר שְׂמַ֥ח זְבוּלֻ֖ן בְּ/צֵאתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר בְּ/אֹהָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vlzbvln 'mr shmch zbvln bts'tkh vyshshkhr b'hlykh
verses.translation: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.

verses.original: עַמִּים֙ הַר יִקְרָ֔אוּ שָׁ֖ם יִזְבְּח֣וּ זִבְחֵי צֶ֑דֶק כִּ֣י שֶׁ֤פַע יַמִּים֙ יִינָ֔קוּ וּ/שְׂפוּנֵ֖י טְמ֥וּנֵי חֽוֹל
verses.translit: 'mym hr yqr'v shm yzbchv zbchy tsdq khy shp' ymym yynqv vshpvny tmvny chvl
verses.translation: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/גָ֣ד אָמַ֔ר בָּר֖וּךְ מַרְחִ֣יב גָּ֑ד כְּ/לָבִ֣יא שָׁכֵ֔ן וְ/טָרַ֥ף זְר֖וֹעַ אַף קָדְקֹֽד
verses.translit: vlgd 'mr brvkh mrchyb gd khlby' shkhn vtrf zrv' 'f qdqd
verses.translation: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא רֵאשִׁית֙ ל֔/וֹ כִּי שָׁ֛ם חֶלְקַ֥ת מְחֹקֵ֖ק סָפ֑וּן וַ/יֵּתֵא֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם צִדְקַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֖י/ו עִם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyr' r'shyt lv khy shm chlqt mchqq spvn vyt' r'shy 'm tsdqt yhvh 'shh vmshptyv 'm yshr'l
verses.translation: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD , and his judgments with Israel.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/דָ֣ן אָמַ֔ר דָּ֖ן גּ֣וּר אַרְיֵ֑ה יְזַנֵּ֖ק מִן הַ/בָּשָֽׁן
verses.translit: vldn 'mr dn gvr 'ryh yznq mn hbshn
verses.translation: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/נַפְתָּלִ֣י אָמַ֔ר נַפְתָּלִי֙ שְׂבַ֣ע רָצ֔וֹן וּ/מָלֵ֖א בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה יָ֥ם וְ/דָר֖וֹם יְרָֽשָׁ/ה
verses.translit: vlnptly 'mr nptly shb' rtsvn vml' brkht yhvh ym vdrvm yrshh
verses.translation: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD : possess thou the west and the south.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אָשֵׁ֣ר אָמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ מִ/בָּנִ֖ים אָשֵׁ֑ר יְהִ֤י רְצוּי֙ אֶחָ֔י/ו וְ/טֹבֵ֥ל בַּ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן רַגְלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl'shr 'mr brvkh mbnym 'shr yhy rtsvy 'chyv vtbl bshmn rglv
verses.translation: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

verses.original: בַּרְזֶ֥ל וּ/נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מִנְעָלֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/כְ/יָמֶ֖י/ךָ דָּבְאֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: brzl vnchsht mn'lykh vkhymykh db'kh
verses.translation: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be .

verses.original: אֵ֥ין כָּ/אֵ֖ל יְשֻׁר֑וּן רֹכֵ֤ב שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ בְ/עֶזְרֶ֔/ךָ וּ/בְ/גַאֲוָת֖/וֹ שְׁחָקִֽים
verses.translit: 'yn kh'l yshrvn rkhb shmym b'zrkh vbg'vtv shchqym
verses.translation: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.

verses.original: מְעֹנָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי קֶ֔דֶם וּ/מִ/תַּ֖חַת זְרֹעֹ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וַ/יְגָ֧רֶשׁ מִ/פָּנֶ֛י/ךָ אוֹיֵ֖ב וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַשְׁמֵֽד
verses.translit: m'nh 'lhy qdm vmtcht zr't 'vlm vygrsh mpnykh 'vyb vy'mr hshmd
verses.translation: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכֹּן֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בֶּ֤טַח בָּדָד֙ עֵ֣ין יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ דָּגָ֣ן וְ/תִיר֑וֹשׁ אַף שָׁמָ֖י/ו יַֽעַרְפוּ טָֽל
verses.translit: vyshkhn yshr'l btch bdd 'yn y'qb 'l 'rts dgn vtyrvsh 'f shmyv y'rpv tl
verses.translation: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֶ֨י/ךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל מִ֣י כָמ֗וֹ/ךָ עַ֚ם נוֹשַׁ֣ע בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן עֶזְרֶ֔/ךָ וַ/אֲשֶׁר חֶ֖רֶב גַּאֲוָתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/יִכָּֽחֲשׁ֤וּ אֹיְבֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לָ֔/ךְ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה עַל בָּמוֹתֵ֥י/מוֹ תִדְרֹֽךְ
verses.translit: 'shrykh yshr'l my khmvkh 'm nvsh' byhvh mgn 'zrkh v'shr chrb g'vtkh vykhchshv 'ybykh lkh v'th 'l bmvtymv tdrkh
verses.translation: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD , the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל מֹשֶׁ֜ה מֵֽ/עַרְבֹ֤ת מוֹאָב֙ אֶל הַ֣ר נְב֔וֹ רֹ֚אשׁ הַ/פִּסְגָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וַ/יַּרְאֵ֨/הוּ יְהוָ֧ה אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֶת הַ/גִּלְעָ֖ד עַד דָּֽן
verses.translit: vy'l mshh m'rbt mv'b 'l hr nbv r'sh hpsgh 'shr 'l pny yrchv vyr'hv yhvh 't khl h'rts 't hgl'd 'd dn
verses.translation: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְ/אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יָּ֥ם הָ/אַחֲרֽוֹן
verses.translit: v't khl nptly v't 'rts 'prym vmnshh v't khl 'rts yhvdh 'd hym h'chrvn
verses.translation: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/נֶּ֗גֶב וְֽ/אֶת הַ/כִּכָּ֞ר בִּקְעַ֧ת יְרֵח֛וֹ עִ֥יר הַ/תְּמָרִ֖ים עַד צֹֽעַר
verses.translit: v't hngb v't hkhkhr bq't yrchv 'yr htmrym 'd ts'r
verses.translation: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗י/ו זֹ֤את הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּעְתִּי לְ/אַבְרָהָ֨ם לְ/יִצְחָ֤ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּ/ה הֶרְאִיתִ֣י/ךָ בְ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyv z't h'rts 'shr nshb'ty l'brhm lytschq vly'qb l'mr lzr'kh 'tnnh hr'ytykh b'ynykh vshmh l' t'br
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨מָת שָׁ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מוֹאָ֖ב עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vymt shm mshh 'bd yhvh b'rts mv'b 'l py yhvh
verses.translation: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֨ר אֹת֤/וֹ בַ/גַּיְ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב מ֖וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֑וֹר וְ/לֹֽא יָדַ֥ע אִישׁ֙ אֶת קְבֻ֣רָת֔/וֹ עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyqbr 'tv bgy b'rts mv'b mvl byt p'vr vl' yd' 'ysh 't qbrtv 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

verses.original: וּ/מֹשֶׁ֗ה בֶּן מֵאָ֧ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּ/מֹת֑/וֹ לֹֽא כָהֲתָ֥ה עֵינ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹא נָ֥ס לֵחֹֽ/ה
verses.translit: vmshh bn m'h v'shrym shnh bmtv l' khhth 'ynv vl' ns lchh
verses.translation: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְכּוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וַֽ/יִּתְּמ֔וּ יְמֵ֥י בְכִ֖י אֵ֥בֶל מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vybkhv bny yshr'l 't mshh b'rbt mv'b shlshym yvm vytmv ymy bkhy 'bl mshh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.

verses.original: וִֽ/יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֗וּן מָלֵא֙ ר֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֔ה כִּֽי סָמַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת יָדָ֖י/ו עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֨וּ אֵלָ֤י/ו בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyhvsh' bn nvn ml' rvch chkhmh khy smkh mshh 't ydyv 'lyv vyshm'v 'lyv bny yshr'l vy'shv kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא קָ֨ם נָבִ֥יא ע֛וֹד בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּ/מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְדָע֣/וֹ יְהוָ֔ה פָּנִ֖ים אֶל פָּנִֽים
verses.translit: vl' qm nby' 'vd byshr'l khmshh 'shr yd'v yhvh pnym 'l pnym
verses.translation: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

verses.original: לְ/כָל הָ֨/אֹת֜וֹת וְ/הַ/מּוֹפְתִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר שְׁלָח/וֹ֙ יְהוָ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְ/פַרְעֹ֥ה וּ/לְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/כָל אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lkhl h'tvt vhmvptym 'shr shlchv yhvh l'shvt b'rts mtsrym lpr'h vlkhl 'bdyv vlkhl 'rtsv
verses.translation: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

verses.original: וּ/לְ/כֹל֙ הַ/יָּ֣ד הַ/חֲזָקָ֔ה וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל הַ/מּוֹרָ֣א הַ/גָּד֑וֹל אֲשֶׁר֙ עָשָׂ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vlkhl hyd hchzqh vlkhl hmvr' hgdvl 'shr 'shh mshh l'yny khl yshr'l
verses.translation: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֛י מ֥וֹת מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֔וּן מְשָׁרֵ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry mvt mshh 'bd yhvh vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' bn nvn mshrt mshh l'mr
verses.translation: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדִּ֖/י מֵ֑ת וְ/עַתָּה֩ ק֨וּם עֲבֹ֜ר אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַ/זֶּ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֶל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/הֶ֖ם לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: mshh 'bdy mt v'th qvm 'br 't hyrdn hzh 'th vkhl h'm hzh 'l h'rts 'shr 'nkhy ntn lhm lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.

verses.original: כָּל מָק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף רַגְלְ/כֶ֛ם בּ֖/וֹ לָ/כֶ֣ם נְתַתִּ֑י/ו כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: khl mqvm 'shr tdrkh khf rglkhm bv lkhm nttyv kh'shr dbrty 'l mshh
verses.translation: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

verses.original: מֵ/הַ/מִּדְבָּר֩ וְ/הַ/לְּבָנ֨וֹן הַ/זֶּ֜ה וְֽ/עַד הַ/נָּהָ֧ר הַ/גָּד֣וֹל נְהַר פְּרָ֗ת כֹּ֚ל אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ/חִתִּ֔ים וְ/עַד הַ/יָּ֥ם הַ/גָּד֖וֹל מְב֣וֹא הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶ֖ה גְּבוּלְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: mhmdbr vhlbnvn hzh v'd hnhr hgdvl nhr prt khl 'rts hchtym v'd hym hgdvl mbv' hshmsh yhyh gbvlkhm
verses.translation: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

verses.original: לֹֽא יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑י/ךָ כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיִ֤יתִי עִם מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔/ךְ לֹ֥א אַרְפְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: l' ytytsb 'ysh lpnykh khl ymy chyykh kh'shr hyyty 'm mshh 'hyh 'mkh l' 'rpkh vl' ''zbkh
verses.translation: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

verses.original: חֲזַ֖ק וֶ/אֱמָ֑ץ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תַּנְחִיל֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֶת הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַ/אֲבוֹתָ֖/ם לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: chzq v'mts khy 'th tnchyl 't h'm hzh 't h'rts 'shr nshb'ty l'bvtm ltt lhm
verses.translation: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

verses.original: רַק֩ חֲזַ֨ק וֶֽ/אֱמַ֜ץ מְאֹ֗ד לִ/שְׁמֹ֤ר לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ כְּ/כָל הַ/תּוֹרָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוְּ/ךָ֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֔/י אַל תָּס֥וּר מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ יָמִ֣ין וּ/שְׂמֹ֑אול לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֔יל בְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: rq chzq v'mts m'd lshmr l'shvt khkhl htvrh 'shr tsvkh mshh 'bdy 'l tsvr mmnv ymyn vshm'vl lm'n tshkhyl bkhl 'shr tlkh
verses.translation: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

verses.original: לֹֽא יָמ֡וּשׁ סֵפֶר֩ הַ/תּוֹרָ֨ה הַ/זֶּ֜ה מִ/פִּ֗י/ךָ וְ/הָגִ֤יתָ בּ/וֹ֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לַ֔יְלָה לְמַ֨עַן֙ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּ/כָל הַ/כָּת֖וּב בּ֑/וֹ כִּי אָ֛ז תַּצְלִ֥יחַ אֶת דְּרָכֶ֖/ךָ וְ/אָ֥ז תַּשְׂכִּֽיל
verses.translit: l' ymvsh spr htvrh hzh mpykh vhgyt bv yvmm vlylh lm'n tshmr l'shvt khkhl hkhtvb bv khy 'z ttslych 't drkhkh v'z tshkhyl
verses.translation: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֤וֹא צִוִּיתִ֨י/ךָ֙ חֲזַ֣ק וֶ/אֱמָ֔ץ אַֽל תַּעֲרֹ֖ץ וְ/אַל תֵּחָ֑ת כִּ֤י עִמְּ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: hlv' tsvytykh chzq v'mts 'l t'rts v'l tcht khy 'mkh yhvh 'lhykh bkhl 'shr tlkh
verses.translation: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אֶת שֹׁטְרֵ֥י הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytsv yhvsh' 't shtry h'm l'mr
verses.translation: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

verses.original: עִבְר֣וּ בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֗ה וְ/צַוּ֤וּ אֶת הָ/עָם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הָכִ֥ינוּ לָ/כֶ֖ם צֵידָ֑ה כִּ֞י בְּ/ע֣וֹד שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים אַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִים֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַ/זֶּ֔ה לָ/בוֹא֙ לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'brv bqrb hmchnh vtsvv 't h'm l'mr hkhynv lkhm tsydh khy b'vd shlsht ymym 'tm 'brym 't hyrdn hzh lbv' lrsht 't h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykhm ntn lkhm lrshth
verses.translation: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.

verses.original: וְ/לָ/רֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְ/לַ/גָּדִ֔י וְ/לַ/חֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vlr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy shbt hmnshh 'mr yhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

verses.original: זָכוֹר֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֥ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶם֙ מֵנִ֣יחַ לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/נָתַ֥ן לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: zkhvr 't hdbr 'shr tsvh 'tkhm mshh 'bd yhvh l'mr yhvh 'lhykhm mnych lkhm vntn lkhm 't h'rts hz't
verses.translation: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

verses.original: נְשֵׁי/כֶ֣ם טַפְּ/כֶם֮ וּ/מִקְנֵי/כֶם֒ יֵשְׁב֕וּ בָּ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֥ן לָ/כֶ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ/אַתֶּם֩ תַּעַבְר֨וּ חֲמֻשִׁ֜ים לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֲחֵי/כֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ל גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַ/חַ֔יִל וַ/עֲזַרְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: nshykhm tpkhm vmqnykhm yshbv b'rts 'shr ntn lkhm mshh b'br hyrdn v'tm t'brv chmshym lpny 'chykhm khl gbvry hchyl v'zrtm 'vtm
verses.translation: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר יָנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֥ה לַֽ/אֲחֵי/כֶם֮ כָּ/כֶם֒ וְ/יָרְשׁ֣וּ גַם הֵ֔מָּה אֶת הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֣ן לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/שַׁבְתֶּ֞ם לְ/אֶ֤רֶץ יְרֻשַּׁתְ/כֶם֙ וִֽ/ירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔/הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣ן לָ/כֶ֗ם מֹשֶׁה֙ עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/עֵ֥בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרַ֥ח הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: 'd 'shr ynych yhvh l'chykhm khkhm vyrshv gm hmh 't h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykhm ntn lhm vshbtm l'rts yrshtkhm vyrshtm 'vth 'shr ntn lkhm mshh 'bd yhvh b'br hyrdn mzrch hshmsh
verses.translation: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD’s servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲנ֔וּ אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ֨/נוּ֙ נַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְ/אֶֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֖/נוּ נֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vy'nv 't yhvsh' l'mr khl 'shr tsvytnv n'shh v'l khl 'shr tshlchnv nlkh
verses.translation: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

verses.original: כְּ/כֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֖ן נִשְׁמַ֣ע אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ רַ֠ק יִֽהְיֶ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: khkhl 'shr shm'nv 'l mshh khn nshm' 'lykh rq yhyh yhvh 'lhykh 'mkh kh'shr hyh 'm mshh
verses.translation: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

verses.original: כָּל אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַמְרֶ֣ה אֶת פִּ֗י/ךָ וְ/לֹֽא יִשְׁמַ֧ע אֶת דְּבָרֶ֛י/ךָ לְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר תְּצַוֶּ֖/נּוּ יוּמָ֑ת רַ֖ק חֲזַ֥ק וֶ/אֱמָֽץ
verses.translit: khl 'ysh 'shr ymrh 't pykh vl' yshm' 't dbrykh lkhl 'shr ttsvnv yvmt rq chzq v'mts
verses.translation: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֠וּן מִֽן הַ/שִּׁטִּ֞ים שְׁנַֽיִם אֲנָשִׁ֤ים מְרַגְּלִים֙ חֶ֣רֶשׁ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לְכ֛וּ רְא֥וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/אֶת יְרִיח֑וֹ וַ/יֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ וַ֠/יָּבֹאוּ בֵּית אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֛ה וּ/שְׁמָ֥/הּ רָחָ֖ב וַ/יִּשְׁכְּבוּ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvsh' bn nvn mn hshtym shnym 'nshym mrglym chrsh l'mr lkhv r'v 't h'rts v't yrychv vylkhv vyb'v byt 'shh zvnh vshmh rchb vyshkhbv shmh
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣אָמַ֔ר לְ/מֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיח֖וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה אֲ֠נָשִׁים בָּ֣אוּ הֵ֧נָּה הַ/לַּ֛יְלָה מִ/בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַ/חְפֹּ֥ר אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr lmlkh yrychv l'mr hnh 'nshym b'v hnh hlylh mbny yshr'l lchpr 't h'rts
verses.translation: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרִיח֔וֹ אֶל רָחָ֖ב לֵ/אמֹ֑ר ה֠וֹצִיאִי הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֨ים הַ/בָּאִ֤ים אֵלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣אוּ לְ/בֵיתֵ֔/ךְ כִּ֛י לַ/חְפֹּ֥ר אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּֽאוּ
verses.translit: vyshlch mlkh yrychv 'l rchb l'mr hvtsy'y h'nshym hb'ym 'lykh 'shr b'v lbytkh khy lchpr 't khl h'rts b'v
verses.translation: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֧ח הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֛ה אֶת שְׁנֵ֥י הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַֽ/תִּצְפְּנ֑/וֹ וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר כֵּ֗ן בָּ֤אוּ אֵלַ/י֙ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי מֵ/אַ֥יִן הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vtqch h'shh 't shny h'nshym vttspnv vt'mr khn b'v 'ly h'nshym vl' yd'ty m'yn hmh
verses.translation: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י הַ/שַּׁ֜עַר לִ/סְגּ֗וֹר בַּ/חֹ֨שֶׁךְ֙ וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים יָצָ֔אוּ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי אָ֥נָה הָלְכ֖וּ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֑ים רִדְפ֥וּ מַהֵ֛ר אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֖ם כִּ֥י תַשִּׂיגֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy hsh'r lsgvr bchshkh vh'nshym yts'v l' yd'ty 'nh hlkhv h'nshym rdpv mhr 'chryhm khy tshygvm
verses.translation: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

verses.original: וְ/הִ֖יא הֶעֱלָ֣תַ/ם הַ/גָּ֑גָ/ה וַֽ/תִּטְמְנֵ/ם֙ בְּ/פִשְׁתֵּ֣י הָ/עֵ֔ץ הָ/עֲרֻכ֥וֹת לָ֖/הּ עַל הַ/גָּֽג
verses.translit: vhy' h'ltm hggh vttmnm bpshty h'ts h'rkhvt lh 'l hgg
verses.translation: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים רָדְפ֤וּ אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶם֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן עַ֖ל הַֽ/מַּעְבְּר֑וֹת וְ/הַ/שַּׁ֣עַר סָגָ֔רוּ אַחֲרֵ֕י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יָצְא֥וּ הָ/רֹדְפִ֖ים אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vh'nshym rdpv 'chryhm drkh hyrdn 'l hm'brvt vhsh'r sgrv 'chry kh'shr yts'v hrdpym 'chryhm
verses.translation: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֖מָּה טֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁכָּב֑וּ/ן וְ/הִ֛יא עָלְתָ֥ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל הַ/גָּֽג
verses.translit: vhmh trm yshkhbvn vhy' 'lth 'lyhm 'l hgg
verses.translation: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/כִֽי נָפְלָ֤ה אֵֽימַתְ/כֶם֙ עָלֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/כִ֥י נָמֹ֛גוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l h'nshym yd'ty khy ntn yhvh lkhm 't h'rts vkhy nplh 'ymtkhm 'lynv vkhy nmgv khl yshby h'rts mpnykhm
verses.translation: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר הוֹבִ֨ישׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת מֵ֤י יַם סוּף֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/צֵאתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֡ם לִ/שְׁנֵי֩ מַלְכֵ֨י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֜י אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּ/עֵ֤בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ לְ/סִיחֹ֣ן וּ/לְ/ע֔וֹג אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱרַמְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy shm'nv 't 'shr hvbysh yhvh 't my ym svf mpnykhm bts'tkhm mmtsrym v'shr 'shytm lshny mlkhy h'mry 'shr b'br hyrdn lsychn vl'vg 'shr hchrmtm 'vtm
verses.translation: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

verses.original: וַ/נִּשְׁמַע֙ וַ/יִּמַּ֣ס לְבָבֵ֔/נוּ וְ/לֹא קָ֨מָה ע֥וֹד ר֛וּחַ בְּ/אִ֖ישׁ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם ה֤וּא אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם מִ/מַּ֔עַל וְ/עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/תָּֽחַת
verses.translit: vnshm' vyms lbbnv vl' qmh 'vd rvch b'ysh mpnykhm khy yhvh 'lhykhm hv' 'lhym bshmym mm'l v'l h'rts mtcht
verses.translation: And as soon as we had heard these things , our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הִשָּֽׁבְעוּ נָ֥א לִ/י֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה כִּי עָשִׂ֥יתִי עִמָּ/כֶ֖ם חָ֑סֶד וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם גַּם אַתֶּ֜ם עִם בֵּ֤ית אָבִ/י֙ חֶ֔סֶד וּ/נְתַתֶּ֥ם לִ֖/י א֥וֹת אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: v'th hshb'v n' ly byhvh khy 'shyty 'mkhm chsd v'shytm gm 'tm 'm byt 'by chsd vnttm ly 'vt 'mt
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD , since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

verses.original: וְ/הַחֲיִתֶ֞ם אֶת אָבִ֣/י וְ/אֶת אִמִּ֗/י וְ/אֶת אַחַ/י֙ וְ/אֶת אחות/י אַחְיוֹתַ֔/י וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/הִצַּלְתֶּ֥ם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵ֖י/נוּ מִ/מָּֽוֶת
verses.translit: vhchytm 't 'by v't 'my v't 'chy v't 'chvty 'chyvty v't khl 'shr lhm vhtsltm 't npshtynv mmvt
verses.translation: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמְרוּ לָ֣/הּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים נַפְשֵׁ֤/נוּ תַחְתֵּי/כֶם֙ לָ/מ֔וּת אִ֚ם לֹ֣א תַגִּ֔ידוּ אֶת דְּבָרֵ֖/נוּ זֶ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֗ה בְּ/תֵת יְהוָ֥ה לָ֨/נוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/עָשִׂ֥ינוּ עִמָּ֖/ךְ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ/אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: vy'mrv lh h'nshym npshnv tchtykhm lmvt 'm l' tgydv 't dbrnv zh vhyh btt yhvh lnv 't h'rts v'shynv 'mkh chsd v'mt
verses.translation: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

verses.original: וַ/תּוֹרִדֵ֥/ם בַּ/חֶ֖בֶל בְּעַ֣ד הַֽ/חַלּ֑וֹן כִּ֤י בֵיתָ/הּ֙ בְּ/קִ֣יר הַֽ/חוֹמָ֔ה וּ/בַֽ/חוֹמָ֖ה הִ֥יא יוֹשָֽׁבֶת
verses.translit: vtvrdm bchbl b'd hchlvn khy byth bqyr hchvmh vbchvmh hy' yvshbt
verses.translation: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ הָ/הָ֣רָ/ה לֵּ֔כוּ פֶּֽן יִפְגְּע֥וּ בָ/כֶ֖ם הָ/רֹדְפִ֑ים וְ/נַחְבֵּתֶ֨ם שָׁ֜מָּ/ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עַ֚ד שׁ֣וֹב הָ/רֹֽדְפִ֔ים וְ/אַחַ֖ר תֵּלְכ֥וּ לְ/דַרְכְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vt'mr lhm hhrh lkhv pn ypg'v bkhm hrdpym vnchbtm shmh shlsht ymym 'd shvb hrdpym v'chr tlkhv ldrkhkhm
verses.translation: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖י/הָ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֑ים נְקִיִּ֣ם אֲנַ֔חְנוּ מִ/שְּׁבֻעָתֵ֥/ךְ הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyh h'nshym nqym 'nchnv mshb'tkh hzh 'shr hshb'tnv
verses.translation: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ בָאִ֖ים בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ אֶת תִּקְוַ֡ת חוּט֩ הַ/שָּׁנִ֨י הַ/זֶּ֜ה תִּקְשְׁרִ֗י בַּֽ/חַלּוֹן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹרַדְתֵּ֣/נוּ ב֔/וֹ וְ/אֶת אָבִ֨י/ךְ וְ/אֶת אִמֵּ֜/ךְ וְ/אֶת אַחַ֗יִ/ךְ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔י/ךְ תַּאַסְפִ֥י אֵלַ֖יִ/ךְ הַ/בָּֽיְתָ/ה
verses.translit: hnh 'nchnv b'ym b'rts 't tqvt chvt hshny hzh tqshry bchlvn 'shr hvrdtnv bv v't 'bykh v't 'mkh v't 'chykh v't khl byt 'bykh t'spy 'lykh hbyth
verses.translation: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֡ה כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא֩ מִ/דַּלְתֵ֨י בֵיתֵ֧/ךְ הַ/ח֛וּצָ/ה דָּמ֥/וֹ בְ/רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ וַ/אֲנַ֣חְנוּ נְקִיִּ֑ם וְ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽהְיֶ֤ה אִתָּ/ךְ֙ בַּ/בַּ֔יִת דָּמ֣/וֹ בְ/רֹאשֵׁ֔/נוּ אִם יָ֖ד תִּֽהְיֶה בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh khl 'shr yts' mdlty bytkh hchvtsh dmv br'shv v'nchnv nqym vkhl 'shr yhyh 'tkh bbyt dmv br'shnv 'm yd thyh bv
verses.translation: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.

verses.original: וְ/אִם תַּגִּ֖ידִי אֶת דְּבָרֵ֣/נוּ זֶ֑ה וְ/הָיִ֣ינוּ נְקִיִּ֔ם מִ/שְּׁבֻעָתֵ֖/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: v'm tgydy 't dbrnv zh vhyynv nqym mshb'tkh 'shr hshb'tnv
verses.translation: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כְּ/דִבְרֵי/כֶ֣ם כֶּן ה֔וּא וַֽ/תְּשַׁלְּחֵ֖/ם וַ/יֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַ/תִּקְשֹׁ֛ר אֶת תִּקְוַ֥ת הַ/שָּׁנִ֖י בַּ/חַלּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vt'mr khdbrykhm khn hv' vtshlchm vylkhv vtqshr 't tqvt hshny bchlvn
verses.translation: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכוּ֙ וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ הָ/הָ֔רָ/ה וַ/יֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים עַד שָׁ֖בוּ הָ/רֹדְפִ֑ים וַ/יְבַקְשׁ֧וּ הָ/רֹדְפִ֛ים בְּ/כָל הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ וְ/לֹ֥א מָצָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vylkhv vyb'v hhrh vyshbv shm shlsht ymym 'd shbv hrdpym vybqshv hrdpym bkhl hdrkh vl' mts'v
verses.translation: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֜בוּ שְׁנֵ֤י הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ וַ/יֵּרְד֣וּ מֵֽ/הָ/הָ֔ר וַ/יַּעַבְרוּ֙ וַ/יָּבֹ֔אוּ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נ֑וּן וַ/יְסַ֨פְּרוּ ל֔/וֹ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/מֹּצְא֖וֹת אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshbv shny h'nshym vyrdv mhhr vy'brv vyb'v 'l yhvsh' bn nvn vysprv lv 't khl hmts'vt 'vtm
verses.translation: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ כִּֽי נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יָדֵ֖/נוּ אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/גַם נָמֹ֛גוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/פָּנֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l yhvsh' khy ntn yhvh bydnv 't khl h'rts vgm nmgv khl yshby h'rts mpnynv
verses.translation: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּם֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ בַּ/בֹּ֜קֶר וַ/יִּסְע֣וּ מֵֽ/הַ/שִּׁטִּ֗ים וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ עַד הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן ה֖וּא וְ/כָל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּלִ֥נוּ שָׁ֖ם טֶ֥רֶם יַעֲבֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: vyshkhm yhvsh' bbqr vys'v mhshtym vyb'v 'd hyrdn hv' vkhl bny yshr'l vylnv shm trm y'brv
verses.translation: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י מִ/קְצֵ֖ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַ/יַּעַבְר֥וּ הַ/שֹּׁטְרִ֖ים בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhy mqtsh shlsht ymym vy'brv hshtrym bqrb hmchnh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

verses.original: וַ/יְצַוּוּ֮ אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם לֵ/אמֹר֒ כִּ/רְאֽוֹתְ/כֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאִ֖ים אֹת֑/וֹ וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם תִּסְעוּ֙ מִ/מְּק֣וֹמְ/כֶ֔ם וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֖ם אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vytsvv 't h'm l'mr khr'vtkhm 't 'rvn bryt yhvh 'lhykhm vhkhhnym hlvym nsh'ym 'tv v'tm ts'v mmqvmkhm vhlkhtm 'chryv
verses.translation: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ רָח֣וֹק יִהְיֶ֗ה בֵּֽינֵי/כֶם֙ ו/בינ/ו וּ/בֵינָ֔י/ו כְּ/אַלְפַּ֥יִם אַמָּ֖ה בַּ/מִּדָּ֑ה אַֽל תִּקְרְב֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו לְמַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר תֵּֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ בָ֔/הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֧א עֲבַרְתֶּ֛ם בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִ/תְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם
verses.translit: 'kh rchvq yhyh bynykhm vbynv vbynyv kh'lpym 'mh bmdh 'l tqrbv 'lyv lm'n 'shr td'v 't hdrkh 'shr tlkhv bh khy l' 'brtm bdrkh mtmvl shlshvm
verses.translation: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל הָ/עָ֖ם הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ כִּ֣י מָחָ֗ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֖ם נִפְלָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l h'm htqdshv khy mchr y'shh yhvh bqrbkhm npl'vt
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים לֵ/אמֹ֔ר שְׂאוּ֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הַ/בְּרִ֔ית וְ/עִבְר֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הַ/בְּרִ֔ית וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l hkhhnym l'mr sh'v 't 'rvn hbryt v'brv lpny h'm vysh'v 't 'rvn hbryt vylkhv lpny h'm
verses.translation: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ גַּדֶּלְ/ךָ֔ בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵֽדְע֔וּ/ן כִּ֗י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֛יתִי עִם מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' hyvm hzh 'chl gdlkh b'yny khl yshr'l 'shr yd'vn khy kh'shr hyyty 'm mshh 'hyh 'mkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֗ה תְּצַוֶּה֙ אֶת הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרֽוֹן הַ/בְּרִ֖ית לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כְּ/בֹאֲ/כֶ֗ם עַד קְצֵה֙ מֵ֣י הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן בַּ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן תַּעֲמֹֽדוּ
verses.translit: v'th ttsvh 't hkhhnym nsh'y 'rvn hbryt l'mr khb'khm 'd qtsh my hyrdn byrdn t'mdv
verses.translation: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל גֹּ֣שׁוּ הֵ֔נָּה וְ/שִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l bny yshr'l gshv hnh vshm'v 't dbry yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּ/זֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ/ן כִּ֛י אֵ֥ל חַ֖י בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הוֹרֵ֣שׁ יוֹרִ֣ישׁ מִ֠/פְּנֵי/כֶם אֶת הַ/כְּנַעֲנִ֨י וְ/אֶת הַ/חִתִּ֜י וְ/אֶת הַ/חִוִּ֗י וְ/אֶת הַ/פְּרִזִּי֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/גִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י וְ/הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' bz't td'vn khy 'l chy bqrbkhm vhvrsh yvrysh mpnykhm 't hkhn'ny v't hchty v't hchvy v't hprzy v't hgrgshy vh'mry vhybvsy
verses.translation: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ אֲר֣וֹן הַ/בְּרִ֔ית אֲד֖וֹן כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ עֹבֵ֥ר לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֖ם בַּ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: hnh 'rvn hbryt 'dvn khl h'rts 'br lpnykhm byrdn
verses.translation: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה קְח֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ שְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר אִ֔ישׁ מִ/שִּׁבְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לַ/שָּֽׁבֶט
verses.translit: v'th qchv lkhm shny 'shr 'ysh mshbty yshr'l 'ysh 'chd 'ysh 'chd lshbt
verses.translation: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֡ה כְּ/נ֣וֹחַ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵ֣י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאֵי֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה אֲד֤וֹן כָּל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ בְּ/מֵ֣י הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן מֵ֤י הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ יִכָּ֣רֵת֔וּ/ן הַ/מַּ֥יִם הַ/יֹּרְדִ֖ים מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/יַעַמְד֖וּ נֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vhyh khnvch khpvt rgly hkhhnym nsh'y 'rvn yhvh 'dvn khl h'rts bmy hyrdn my hyrdn ykhrtvn hmym hyrdym mlm'lh vy'mdv nd 'chd
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD , the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ/נְסֹ֤עַ הָ/עָם֙ מֵ/אָ֣הֳלֵי/הֶ֔ם לַ/עֲבֹ֖ר אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים נֹֽשְׂאֵ֛י הָ/אָר֥וֹן הַ/בְּרִ֖ית לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy bns' h'm m'hlyhm l'br 't hyrdn vhkhhnym nsh'y h'rvn hbryt lpny h'm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

verses.original: וּ/כְ/ב֞וֹא נֹשְׂאֵ֤י הָֽ/אָרוֹן֙ עַד הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְ/רַגְלֵ֤י הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָֽ/אָר֔וֹן נִטְבְּל֖וּ בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה הַ/מָּ֑יִם וְ/הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן מָלֵא֙ עַל כָּל גְּדוֹתָ֔י/ו כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י קָצִֽיר
verses.translit: vkhbv' nsh'y h'rvn 'd hyrdn vrgly hkhhnym nsh'y h'rvn ntblv bqtsh hmym vhyrdn ml' 'l khl gdvtyv khl ymy qtsyr
verses.translation: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַמְד֡וּ הַ/מַּיִם֩ הַ/יֹּרְדִ֨ים מִ/לְ/מַ֜עְלָ/ה קָ֣מוּ נֵד אֶחָ֗ד הַרְחֵ֨ק מְאֹ֜ד ב/אדם מֵֽ/אָדָ֤ם הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִ/צַּ֣ד צָֽרְתָ֔ן וְ/הַ/יֹּרְדִ֗ים עַ֣ל יָ֧ם הָ/עֲרָבָ֛ה יָם הַ/מֶּ֖לַח תַּ֣מּוּ נִכְרָ֑תוּ וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם עָבְר֖וּ נֶ֥גֶד יְרִיחֽוֹ
verses.translit: vy'mdv hmym hyrdym mlm'lh qmv nd 'chd hrchq m'd b'dm m'dm h'yr 'shr mtsd tsrtn vhyrdym 'l ym h'rbh ym hmlch tmv nkhrtv vh'm 'brv ngd yrychv
verses.translation: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַמְד֣וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹ֠שְׂאֵי הָ/אָר֨וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֜ה בֶּ/חָֽרָבָ֛ה בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן הָכֵ֑ן וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עֹֽבְרִים֙ בֶּ/חָ֣רָבָ֔ה עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר תַּ֨מּוּ֙ כָּל הַ/גּ֔וֹי לַ/עֲבֹ֖ר אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mdv hkhhnym nsh'y h'rvn bryt yhvh bchrbh btvkh hyrdn hkhn vkhl yshr'l 'brym bchrbh 'd 'shr tmv khl hgvy l'br 't hyrdn
verses.translation: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר תַּ֣מּוּ כָל הַ/גּ֔וֹי לַ/עֲב֖וֹר אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr tmv khl hgvy l'bvr 't hyrdn vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

verses.original: קְח֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ מִן הָ/עָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֲנָשִׁ֑ים אִישׁ אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ אֶחָ֖ד מִ/שָּֽׁבֶט
verses.translit: qchv lkhm mn h'm shnym 'shr 'nshym 'ysh 'chd 'ysh 'chd mshbt
verses.translation: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,

verses.original: וְ/צַוּ֣וּ אוֹתָ/ם֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ שְׂאֽוּ לָ/כֶ֨ם מִ/זֶּ֜ה מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן מִ/מַּצַּב֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֔ים הָכִ֖ין שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֲבָנִ֑ים וְ/הַעֲבַרְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתָ/ם֙ עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִנַּחְתֶּ֣ם אוֹתָ֔/ם בַּ/מָּל֕וֹן אֲשֶׁר תָּלִ֥ינוּ ב֖/וֹ הַ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vtsvv 'vtm l'mr sh'v lkhm mzh mtvkh hyrdn mmtsb rgly hkhhnym hkhyn shtym 'shrh 'bnym vh'brtm 'vtm 'mkhm vhnchtm 'vtm bmlvn 'shr tlynv bv hlylh
verses.translation: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ אֶל שְׁנֵ֤ים הֶֽ/עָשָׂר֙ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵכִ֖ין מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִישׁ אֶחָ֥ד אִישׁ אֶחָ֖ד מִ/שָּֽׁבֶט
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvsh' 'l shnym h'shr 'ysh 'shr hkhyn mbny yshr'l 'ysh 'chd 'ysh 'chd mshbt
verses.translation: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עִ֠בְרוּ לִ/פְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֖ם אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ/הָרִ֨ימוּ לָ/כֶ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶ֤בֶן אַחַת֙ עַל שִׁכְמ֔/וֹ לְ/מִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm yhvsh' 'brv lpny 'rvn yhvh 'lhykhm 'l tvkh hyrdn vhrymv lkhm 'ysh 'bn 'cht 'l shkhmv lmspr shbty bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן תִּֽהְיֶ֛ה זֹ֥את א֖וֹת בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי יִשְׁאָל֨וּ/ן בְּנֵי/כֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מָ֛ה הָ/אֲבָנִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lm'n thyh z't 'vt bqrbkhm khy ysh'lvn bnykhm mchr l'mr mh h'bnym h'lh lkhm
verses.translation: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם לָ/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִכְרְת֜וּ מֵימֵ֤י הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ מִ/פְּנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/עָבְר/וֹ֙ בַּ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן נִכְרְת֖וּ מֵ֣י הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֠/הָיוּ הָ/אֲבָנִ֨ים הָ/אֵ֧לֶּה לְ/זִכָּר֛וֹן לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'mrtm lhm 'shr nkhrtv mymy hyrdn mpny 'rvn bryt yhvh b'brv byrdn nkhrtv my hyrdn vhyv h'bnym h'lh lzkhrvn lbny yshr'l 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD ; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂוּ כֵ֣ן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֒ וַ/יִּשְׂא֡וּ שְׁתֵּֽי עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה אֲבָנִ֜ים מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לְ/מִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּעֲבִר֤וּ/ם עִמָּ/ם֙ אֶל הַ/מָּל֔וֹן וַ/יַּנִּח֖וּ/ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'shv khn bny yshr'l kh'shr tsvh yhvsh' vysh'v shty 'shrh 'bnym mtvkh hyrdn kh'shr dbr yhvh 'l yhvsh' lmspr shbty bny yshr'l vy'brvm 'mm 'l hmlvn vynchvm shm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּ֧ים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֲבָנִ֗ים הֵקִ֣ים יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֒ תַּ֗חַת מַצַּב֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הַ/בְּרִ֑ית וַ/יִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vshtym 'shrh 'bnym hqym yhvsh' btvkh hyrdn tcht mtsb rgly hkhhnym nsh'y 'rvn hbryt vyhyv shm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֞ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י הָ/אָר֗וֹן עֹמְדִים֮ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֒ עַ֣ד תֹּ֣ם כָּֽל הַ֠/דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַ/יְמַהֲר֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: vhkhhnym nsh'y h'rvn 'mdym btvkh hyrdn 'd tm khl hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh 't yhvsh' ldbr 'l h'm khkhl 'shr tsvh mshh 't yhvsh' vymhrv h'm vy'brv
verses.translation: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר תַּ֥ם כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם לַֽ/עֲב֑וֹר וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֧ר אֲרוֹן יְהוָ֛ה וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr tm khl h'm l'bvr vy'br 'rvn yhvh vhkhhnym lpny h'm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

verses.original: וַ֠/יַּעַבְרוּ בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֨ן וּ/בְנֵי גָ֜ד וַ/חֲצִ֨י שֵׁ֤בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁה֙ חֲמֻשִׁ֔ים לִ/פְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'brv bny r'vbn vbny gd vchtsy shbt hmnshh chmshym lpny bny yshr'l kh'shr dbr 'lyhm mshh
verses.translation: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:

verses.original: כְּ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֣י הַ/צָּבָ֑א עָבְר֞וּ לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֶ֖ל עַֽרְב֥וֹת יְרִיחֽוֹ
verses.translit: kh'rb'ym 'lf chlvtsy htsb' 'brv lpny yhvh lmlchmh 'l 'rbvt yrychv
verses.translation: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא גִּדַּ֤ל יְהוָה֙ אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּֽרְא֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יָרְא֥וּ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה כָּל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: byvm hhv' gdl yhvh 't yhvsh' b'yny khl yshr'l vyr'v 'tv kh'shr yr'v 't mshh khl ymy chyyv
verses.translation: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

verses.original: צַוֵּה֙ אֶת הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָ/עֵד֑וּת וְ/יַעֲל֖וּ מִן הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: tsvh 't hkhhnym nsh'y 'rvn h'dvt vy'lv mn hyrdn
verses.translation: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אֶת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹ֑ר עֲל֖וּ מִן הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vytsv yhvsh' 't hkhhnym l'mr 'lv mn hyrdn
verses.translation: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.

verses.original: וַ֠/יְהִי ב/עלות כַּ/עֲל֨וֹת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֜ים נֹשְׂאֵ֨י אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן נִתְּק֗וּ כַּפּוֹת֙ רַגְלֵ֣י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֶ֖ל הֶ/חָרָבָ֑ה וַ/יָּשֻׁ֤בוּ מֵֽי הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ לִ/מְקוֹמָ֔/ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ כִ/תְמוֹל שִׁלְשׁ֖וֹם עַל כָּל גְּדוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy b'lvt kh'lvt hkhhnym nsh'y 'rvn bryt yhvh mtvkh hyrdn ntqv khpvt rgly hkhhnym 'l hchrbh vyshbv my hyrdn lmqvmm vylkhv khtmvl shlshvm 'l khl gdvtyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עָ֗ם עָלוּ֙ מִן הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן בֶּ/עָשׂ֖וֹר לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן וַֽ/יַּחֲנוּ֙ בַּ/גִּלְגָּ֔ל בִּ/קְצֵ֖ה מִזְרַ֥ח יְרִיחֽוֹ
verses.translit: vh'm 'lv mn hyrdn b'shvr lchdsh hr'shvn vychnv bglgl bqtsh mzrch yrychv
verses.translation: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ שְׁתֵּ֨ים עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה הָֽ/אֲבָנִים֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקְח֖וּ מִן הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן הֵקִ֥ים יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בַּ/גִּלְגָּֽל
verses.translit: v't shtym 'shrh h'bnym h'lh 'shr lqchv mn hyrdn hqym yhvsh' bglgl
verses.translation: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁר֩ יִשְׁאָל֨וּ/ן בְּנֵי/כֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ אֶת אֲבוֹתָ֣/ם לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מָ֖ה הָ/אֲבָנִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr 'shr ysh'lvn bnykhm mchr 't 'bvtm l'mr mh h'bnym h'lh
verses.translation: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?

verses.original: וְ/הוֹדַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת בְּנֵי/כֶ֣ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בַּ/יַּבָּשָׁה֙ עָבַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vhvd'tm 't bnykhm l'mr bybshh 'br yshr'l 't hyrdn hzh
verses.translation: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר הוֹבִישׁ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֜ם אֶת מֵ֧י הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֛ן מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֖ם עַֽד עָבְרְ/כֶ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֧ם לְ/יַם ס֛וּף אֲשֶׁר הוֹבִ֥ישׁ מִ/פָּנֵ֖י/נוּ עַד עָבְרֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'shr hvbysh yhvh 'lhykhm 't my hyrdn mpnykhm 'd 'brkhm kh'shr 'shh yhvh 'lhykhm lym svf 'shr hvbysh mpnynv 'd 'brnv
verses.translation: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

verses.original: לְ֠מַעַן דַּ֜עַת כָּל עַמֵּ֤י הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶת יַ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י חֲזָקָ֖ה הִ֑יא לְמַ֧עַן יְרָאתֶ֛ם אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: lm'n d't khl 'my h'rts 't yd yhvh khy chzqh hy' lm'n yr'tm 't yhvh 'lhykhm khl hymym
verses.translation: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD , that it is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ כָּל מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֡י אֲשֶׁר֩ בְּ/עֵ֨בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֜ן יָ֗מָּ/ה וְ/כָל מַלְכֵ֤י הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/יָּ֔ם אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר הוֹבִ֨ישׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת מֵ֧י הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֛ן מִ/פְּנֵ֥י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד עבר/נו עָבְרָ֑/ם וַ/יִּמַּ֣ס לְבָבָ֗/ם וְ/לֹא הָ֨יָה בָ֥/ם עוֹד֙ ר֔וּחַ מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' khl mlkhy h'mry 'shr b'br hyrdn ymh vkhl mlkhy hkhn'ny 'shr 'l hym 't 'shr hvbysh yhvh 't my hyrdn mpny bny yshr'l 'd 'brnv 'brm vyms lbbm vl' hyh bm 'vd rvch mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עֲשֵׂ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ חַֽרְב֣וֹת צֻרִ֑ים וְ/שׁ֛וּב מֹ֥ל אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁנִֽית
verses.translit: b't hhy' 'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' 'shh lkh chrbvt tsrym vshvb ml 't bny yshr'l shnyt
verses.translation: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַשׂ ל֥/וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ חַֽרְב֣וֹת צֻרִ֑ים וַ/יָּ֨מָל֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל גִּבְעַ֖ת הָ/עֲרָלֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'sh lv yhvsh' chrbvt tsrym vyml 't bny yshr'l 'l gb't h'rlvt
verses.translation: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֥ה הַ/דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר מָ֣ל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כָּל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/יֹּצֵא֩ מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם הַ/זְּכָרִ֜ים כֹּ֣ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה מֵ֤תוּ בַ/מִּדְבָּר֙ בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ בְּ/צֵאתָ֖/ם מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vzh hdbr 'shr ml yhvsh' khl h'm hyts' mmtsrym hzkhrym khl 'nshy hmlchmh mtv bmdbr bdrkh bts'tm mmtsrym
verses.translation: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

verses.original: כִּֽי מֻלִ֣ים הָי֔וּ כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם הַ/יֹּֽצְאִ֑ים וְ/כָל הָ֠/עָם הַ/יִּלֹּדִ֨ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֥ר בַּ/דֶּ֛רֶךְ בְּ/צֵאתָ֥/ם מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם לֹא מָֽלוּ
verses.translit: khy mlym hyv khl h'm hyts'ym vkhl h'm hyldym bmdbr bdrkh bts'tm mmtsrym l' mlv
verses.translation: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה הָלְכ֣וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֒ עַד תֹּ֨ם כָּל הַ/גּ֜וֹי אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ הַ/יֹּצְאִ֣ים מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָה֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֞י הַרְאוֹתָ֣/ם אֶת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהוָ֤ה לַֽ/אֲבוֹתָ/ם֙ לָ֣/תֶת לָ֔/נוּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: khy 'rb'ym shnh hlkhv bny yshr'l bmdbr 'd tm khl hgvy 'nshy hmlchmh hyts'ym mmtsrym 'shr l' shm'v bqvl yhvh 'shr nshb' yhvh lhm lblty hr'vtm 't h'rts 'shr nshb' yhvh l'bvtm ltt lnv 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh
verses.translation: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD : unto whom the LORD sware that he would not shew them the land, which the LORD sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶם֙ הֵקִ֣ים תַּחְתָּ֔/ם אֹתָ֖/ם מָ֣ל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כִּי עֲרֵלִ֣ים הָי֔וּ כִּ֛י לֹא מָ֥לוּ אוֹתָ֖/ם בַּ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: v't bnyhm hqym tchtm 'tm ml yhvsh' khy 'rlym hyv khy l' mlv 'vtm bdrkh
verses.translation: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י כַּ/אֲשֶׁר תַּ֥מּוּ כָל הַ/גּ֖וֹי לְ/הִמּ֑וֹל וַ/יֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּ֛/ם בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה עַ֥ד חֲיוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr tmv khl hgvy lhmvl vyshbv tchtm bmchnh 'd chyvtm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַ/יּ֗וֹם גַּלּ֛וֹתִי אֶת חֶרְפַּ֥ת מִצְרַ֖יִם מֵ/עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/יִּקְרָ֞א שֵׁ֣ם הַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ גִּלְגָּ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' hyvm glvty 't chrpt mtsrym m'lykhm vyqr' shm hmqvm hhv' glgl 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחֲנ֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/גִּלְגָּ֑ל וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֶת הַ/פֶּ֡סַח בְּ/אַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֥וֹם לַ/חֹ֛דֶשׁ בָּ/עֶ֖רֶב בְּ/עַֽרְב֥וֹת יְרִיחֽוֹ
verses.translit: vychnv bny yshr'l bglgl vy'shv 't hpsch b'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh b'rb b'rbvt yrychv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אכְל֜וּ מֵ/עֲב֥וּר הָ/אָ֛רֶץ מִ/מָּֽחֳרַ֥ת הַ/פֶּ֖סַח מַצּ֣וֹת וְ/קָל֑וּי בְּ/עֶ֖צֶם הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'khlv m'bvr h'rts mmchrt hpsch mtsvt vqlvy b'tsm hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁבֹּ֨ת הַ/מָּ֜ן מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֗ת בְּ/אָכְלָ/ם֙ מֵ/עֲב֣וּר הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה ע֛וֹד לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מָ֑ן וַ/יֹּאכְל֗וּ מִ/תְּבוּאַת֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בַּ/שָּׁנָ֖ה הַ/הִֽיא
verses.translit: vyshbt hmn mmchrt b'khlm m'bvr h'rts vl' hyh 'vd lbny yshr'l mn vy'khlv mtbv't 'rts khn'n bshnh hhy'
verses.translation: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּֽ/הְי֣וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ בִּ/ירִיחוֹ֒ וַ/יִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָי/ו֙ וַ/יַּ֔רְא וְ/הִנֵּה אִישׁ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד לְ/נֶגְדּ֔/וֹ וְ/חַרְבּ֥/וֹ שְׁלוּפָ֖ה בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֵלָי/ו֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ הֲ/לָ֥/נוּ אַתָּ֖ה אִם לְ/צָרֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vyhy bhyvt yhvsh' byrychv vysh' 'ynyv vyr' vhnh 'ysh 'md lngdv vchrbv shlvph bydv vylkh yhvsh' 'lyv vy'mr lv hlnv 'th 'm ltsrynv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לֹ֗א כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י שַׂר צְבָֽא יְהוָ֖ה עַתָּ֣ה בָ֑אתִי וַ/יִּפֹּל֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ אֶל פָּנָ֥י/ו אַ֨רְצָ/ה֙ וַ/יִּשְׁתָּ֔חוּ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ מָ֥ה אֲדֹנִ֖/י מְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל עַבְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr l' khy 'ny shr tsb' yhvh 'th b'ty vypl yhvsh' 'l pnyv 'rtsh vyshtchv vy'mr lv mh 'dny mdbr 'l 'bdv
verses.translation: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ שַׂר צְבָ֨א יְהוָ֜ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ שַׁל נַֽעַלְ/ךָ֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֣י הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד עָלָ֖י/ו קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֑וּא וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr shr tsb' yhvh 'l yhvsh' shl n'lkh m'l rglkh khy hmqvm 'shr 'th 'md 'lyv qdsh hv' vy'sh yhvsh' khn
verses.translation: And the captain of the LORD’s host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.

verses.original: וִֽ/ירִיחוֹ֙ סֹגֶ֣רֶת וּ/מְסֻגֶּ֔רֶת מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ין יוֹצֵ֖א וְ/אֵ֥ין בָּֽא
verses.translit: vyrychv sgrt vmsgrt mpny bny yshr'l 'yn yvts' v'yn b'
verses.translation: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי בְ/יָֽדְ/ךָ֔ אֶת יְרִיח֖וֹ וְ/אֶת מַלְכָּ֑/הּ גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י הֶ/חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' r'h ntty bydkh 't yrychv v't mlkhh gbvry hchyl
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

verses.original: וְ/סַבֹּתֶ֣ם אֶת הָ/עִ֗יר כֹּ֚ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַקֵּ֥יף אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כֹּ֥ה תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vsbtm 't h'yr khl 'nshy hmlchmh hqyf 't h'yr p'm 'cht khh t'shh shsht ymym
verses.translation: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁבְעָ֣ה כֹהֲנִ֡ים יִשְׂאוּ֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַ/יּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָ/אָר֔וֹן וּ/בַ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י תָּסֹ֥בּוּ אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְ/הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים יִתְקְע֖וּ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vshb'h khhnym ysh'v shb'h shvprvt hyvblym lpny h'rvn vbyvm hshby'y tsbv 't h'yr shb' p'mym vhkhhnym ytq'v bshvprvt
verses.translation: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams’ horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה בִּ/מְשֹׁ֣ךְ בְּ/קֶ֣רֶן הַ/יּוֹבֵ֗ל ב/שמע/כם כְּ/שָׁמְעֲ/כֶם֙ אֶת ק֣וֹל הַ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר יָרִ֥יעוּ כָל הָ/עָ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וְ/נָ֨פְלָ֜ה חוֹמַ֤ת הָ/עִיר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔י/הָ וְ/עָל֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ נֶגְדּֽ/וֹ
