verses.translit: vhyh bmshkh bqrn hyvbl bshm'khm khshm'khm 't qvl hshvpr yry'v khl h'm trv'h gdvlh vnplh chvmt h'yr tchtyh v'lv h'm 'ysh ngdv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן נוּן֙ אֶל הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם שְׂא֖וּ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הַ/בְּרִ֑ית וְ/שִׁבְעָ֣ה כֹֽהֲנִ֗ים יִשְׂאוּ֙ שִׁבְעָ֤ה שֽׁוֹפְרוֹת֙ יוֹבְלִ֔ים לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvsh' bn nvn 'l hkhhnym vy'mr 'lhm sh'v 't 'rvn hbryt vshb'h khhnym ysh'v shb'h shvprvt yvblym lpny 'rvn yhvh
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD .

verses.original: ו/יאמרו וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם עִבְר֖וּ וְ/סֹ֣בּוּ אֶת הָ/עִ֑יר וְ/הֶ֣/חָל֔וּץ יַעֲבֹ֕ר לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv vy'mr 'l h'm 'brv vsbv 't h'yr vhchlvts y'br lpny 'rvn yhvh
verses.translation: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כֶּ/אֱמֹ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ אֶל הָ/עָם֒ וְ/שִׁבְעָ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֤וֹת הַ/יּֽוֹבְלִים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עָבְר֕וּ וְ/תָקְע֖וּ בַּ/שּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַֽ/אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הֹלֵ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy kh'mr yhvsh' 'l h'm vshb'h hkhhnym nsh'ym shb'h shvprvt hyvblym lpny yhvh 'brv vtq'v bshvprvt v'rvn bryt yhvh hlkh 'chryhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns passed on before the LORD , and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

verses.original: וְ/הֶ/חָל֣וּץ הֹלֵ֔ךְ לִ/פְנֵי֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים תקעו תֹּקְעֵ֖י הַ/שּֽׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְ/הַֽ/מְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הָ/אָר֔וֹן הָל֖וֹךְ וְ/תָק֥וֹעַ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhchlvts hlkh lpny hkhhnym tq'v tq'y hshvprvt vhm'sf hlkh 'chry h'rvn hlvkh vtqv' bshvprvt
verses.translation: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/עָם֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לֹ֤א תָרִ֨יעוּ֙ וְ/לֹֽא תַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ אֶת קוֹלְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹא יֵצֵ֥א מִ/פִּי/כֶ֖ם דָּבָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֣וֹם אָמְרִ֧/י אֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם הָרִ֖יעוּ וַ/הֲרִיעֹתֶֽם
verses.translit: v't h'm tsvh yhvsh' l'mr l' try'v vl' tshmy'v 't qvlkhm vl' yts' mpykhm dbr 'd yvm 'mry 'lykhm hry'v vhry'tm
verses.translation: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

verses.original: וַ/יַּסֵּ֤ב אֲרוֹן יְהוָה֙ אֶת הָ/עִ֔יר הַקֵּ֖ף פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַ/יָּלִ֖ינוּ בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vysb 'rvn yhvh 't h'yr hqf p'm 'cht vyb'v hmchnh vylynv bmchnh
verses.translation: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֥ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshkhm yhvsh' bbqr vysh'v hkhhnym 't 'rvn yhvh
verses.translation: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/שִׁבְעָ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֡ים נֹשְׂאִים֩ שִׁבְעָ֨ה שׁוֹפְר֜וֹת הַ/יֹּבְלִ֗ים לִ/פְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הֹלְכִ֣ים הָל֔וֹךְ וְ/תָקְע֖וּ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וְ/הֶ/חָלוּץ֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/הַֽ/מְאַסֵּ֗ף הֹלֵךְ֙ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה הולך הָל֖וֹךְ וְ/תָק֥וֹעַ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vshb'h hkhhnym nsh'ym shb'h shvprvt hyblym lpny 'rvn yhvh hlkhym hlvkh vtq'v bshvprvt vhchlvts hlkh lpnyhm vhm'sf hlkh 'chry 'rvn yhvh hvlkh hlvkh vtqv' bshvprvt
verses.translation: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD , the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

verses.original: וַ/יָּסֹ֨בּוּ אֶת הָ/עִ֜יר בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/שֵּׁנִי֙ פַּ֣עַם אַחַ֔ת וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vysbv 't h'yr byvm hshny p'm 'cht vyshbv hmchnh khh 'shv shsht ymym
verses.translation: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֨מוּ֙ כַּ/עֲל֣וֹת הַ/שַּׁ֔חַר וַ/יָּסֹ֧בּוּ אֶת הָ/עִ֛יר כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֥ט הַ/זֶּ֖ה שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים רַ֚ק בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא סָבְב֥וּ אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshby'y vyshkhmv kh'lvt hshchr vysbv 't h'yr khmshpt hzh shb' p'mym rq byvm hhv' sbbv 't h'yr shb' p'mym
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/פַּ֣עַם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔ית תָּקְע֥וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּ/שּׁוֹפָר֑וֹת וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֶל הָ/עָם֙ הָרִ֔יעוּ כִּֽי נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyhy bp'm hshby'yt tq'v hkhhnym bshvprvt vy'mr yhvsh' 'l h'm hry'v khy ntn yhvh lkhm 't h'yr
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֨ה הָ/עִ֥יר חֵ֛רֶם הִ֥יא וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר בָּ֖/הּ לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה רַק֩ רָחָ֨ב הַ/זּוֹנָ֜ה תִּֽחְיֶ֗ה הִ֚יא וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֣/הּ בַּ/בַּ֔יִת כִּ֣י הֶחְבְּאַ֔תָה אֶת הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: vhyth h'yr chrm hy' vkhl 'shr bh lyhvh rq rchb hzvnh tchyh hy' vkhl 'shr 'th bbyt khy hchb'th 't hml'khym 'shr shlchnv
verses.translation: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the LORD : only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

verses.original: וְ/רַק אַתֶּם֙ שִׁמְר֣וּ מִן הַ/חֵ֔רֶם פֶּֽן תַּחֲרִ֖ימוּ וּ/לְקַחְתֶּ֣ם מִן הַ/חֵ֑רֶם וְ/שַׂמְתֶּ֞ם אֶת מַחֲנֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/חֵ֔רֶם וַ/עֲכַרְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vrq 'tm shmrv mn hchrm pn tchrymv vlqchtm mn hchrm vshmtm 't mchnh yshr'l lchrm v'khrtm 'vtv
verses.translation: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֣ל כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֗ב וּ/כְלֵ֤י נְחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ וּ/בַרְזֶ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ ה֖וּא לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה אוֹצַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: vkhl khsf vzhb vkhly nchsht vbrzl qdsh hv' lyhvh 'vtsr yhvh ybv'
verses.translation: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the LORD : they shall come into the treasury of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣רַע הָ/עָ֔ם וַֽ/יִּתְקְע֖וּ בַּ/שֹּֽׁפָר֑וֹת וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ הָ/עָ֜ם אֶת ק֣וֹל הַ/שּׁוֹפָ֗ר וַ/יָּרִ֤יעוּ הָ/עָם֙ תְּרוּעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַ/תִּפֹּ֨ל הַֽ/חוֹמָ֜ה תַּחְתֶּ֗י/הָ וַ/יַּ֨עַל הָ/עָ֤ם הָ/עִ֨ירָ/ה֙ אִ֣ישׁ נֶגְדּ֔/וֹ וַֽ/יִּלְכְּד֖וּ אֶת הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyr' h'm vytq'v bshprvt vyhy khshm' h'm 't qvl hshvpr vyry'v h'm trv'h gdvlh vtpl hchvmh tchtyh vy'l h'm h'yrh 'ysh ngdv vylkhdv 't h'yr
verses.translation: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּחֲרִ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ/עִ֔יר מֵ/אִישׁ֙ וְ/עַד אִשָּׁ֔ה מִ/נַּ֖עַר וְ/עַד זָקֵ֑ן וְ/עַ֨ד שׁ֥וֹר וָ/שֶׂ֛ה וַ/חֲמ֖וֹר לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vychrymv 't khl 'shr b'yr m'ysh v'd 'shh mn'r v'd zqn v'd shvr vshh vchmvr lpy chrb
verses.translation: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/שְׁנַ֨יִם הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֜ים הַֽ/מְרַגְּלִ֤ים אֶת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בֹּ֖אוּ בֵּית הָ/אִשָּׁ֣ה הַ/זּוֹנָ֑ה וְ/הוֹצִ֨יאוּ מִ/שָּׁ֤ם אֶת הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לָ֔/הּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּעְתֶּ֖ם לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vlshnym h'nshym hmrglym 't h'rts 'mr yhvsh' b'v byt h'shh hzvnh vhvtsy'v mshm 't h'shh v't khl 'shr lh kh'shr nshb'tm lh
verses.translation: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot’s house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ הַ/נְּעָרִ֣ים הַֽ/מְרַגְּלִ֗ים וַ/יֹּצִ֡יאוּ אֶת רָ֠חָב וְ/אֶת אָבִ֨י/הָ וְ/אֶת אִמָּ֤/הּ וְ/אֶת אַחֶ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לָ֔/הּ וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל מִשְׁפְּחוֹתֶ֖י/הָ הוֹצִ֑יאוּ וַ/יַּ֨נִּיח֔וּ/ם מִ/ח֖וּץ לְ/מַחֲנֵ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyb'v hn'rym hmrglym vytsy'v 't rchb v't 'byh v't 'mh v't 'chyh v't khl 'shr lh v't khl mshpchvtyh hvtsy'v vynychvm mchvts lmchnh yshr'l
verses.translation: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עִ֛יר שָׂרְפ֥וּ בָ/אֵ֖שׁ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר בָּ֑/הּ רַ֣ק הַ/כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/הַ/זָּהָ֗ב וּ/כְלֵ֤י הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ וְ/הַ/בַּרְזֶ֔ל נָתְנ֖וּ אוֹצַ֥ר בֵּית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vh'yr shrpv b'sh vkhl 'shr bh rq hkhsf vhzhb vkhly hnchsht vhbrzl ntnv 'vtsr byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת רָחָ֣ב הַ֠/זּוֹנָה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֨ית אָבִ֤י/הָ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לָ/הּ֙ הֶחֱיָ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַ/תֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ֤י הֶחְבִּ֨יאָה֙ אֶת הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לְ/רַגֵּ֥ל אֶת יְרִיחֽוֹ
verses.translit: v't rchb hzvnh v't byt 'byh v't khl 'shr lh hchyh yhvsh' vtshb bqrb yshr'l 'd hyvm hzh khy hchby'h 't hml'khym 'shr shlch yhvsh' lrgl 't yrychv
verses.translation: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father’s household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁבַּ֣ע יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִ֖יא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אָר֨וּר הָ/אִ֜ישׁ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָקוּם֙ וּ/בָנָ֞ה אֶת הָ/עִ֤יר הַ/זֹּאת֙ אֶת יְרִיח֔וֹ בִּ/בְכֹר֣/וֹ יְיַסְּדֶ֔/נָּה וּ/בִ/צְעִיר֖/וֹ יַצִּ֥יב דְּלָתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyshb' yhvsh' b't hhy' l'mr 'rvr h'ysh lpny yhvh 'shr yqvm vbnh 't h'yr hz't 't yrychv bbkhrv yysdnh vbts'yrv ytsyb dltyh
verses.translation: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the LORD , that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַ/יְהִ֥י שָׁמְע֖/וֹ בְּ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh 't yhvsh' vyhy shm'v bkhl h'rts
verses.translation: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְעֲל֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מַ֖עַל בַּ/חֵ֑רֶם וַ/יִּקַּ֡ח עָכָ֣ן בֶּן כַּרְמִי֩ בֶן זַבְדִּ֨י בֶן זֶ֜רַח לְ/מַטֵּ֤ה יְהוּדָה֙ מִן הַ/חֵ֔רֶם וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בִּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vym'lv bny yshr'l m'l bchrm vyqch 'khn bn khrmy bn zbdy bn zrch lmth yhvdh mn hchrm vychr 'f yhvh bbny yshr'l
verses.translation: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מִֽ/ירִיח֗וֹ הָ/עַ֞י אֲשֶׁ֨ר עִם בֵּ֥ית אָ֨וֶן֙ מִ/קֶּ֣דֶם לְ/בֵֽית אֵ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר עֲל֖וּ וְ/רַגְּל֣וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַֽ/יַּעֲלוּ֙ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַֽ/יְרַגְּל֖וּ אֶת הָ/עָֽי
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvsh' 'nshym myrychv h'y 'shr 'm byt 'vn mqdm lbyt 'l vy'mr 'lyhm l'mr 'lv vrglv 't h'rts vy'lv h'nshym vyrglv 't h'y
verses.translation: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָי/ו֮ אַל יַ֣עַל כָּל הָ/עָם֒ כְּ/אַלְפַּ֣יִם אִ֗ישׁ א֚וֹ כִּ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ יַעֲל֖וּ וְ/יַכּ֣וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֑י אַל תְּיַגַּע שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם כִּ֥י מְעַ֖ט הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vyshbv 'l yhvsh' vy'mrv 'lyv 'l y'l khl h'm kh'lpym 'ysh 'v khshlsht 'lpym 'ysh y'lv vykhv 't h'y 'l tyg' shmh 't khl h'm khy m't hmh
verses.translation: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֤וּ מִן הָ/עָם֙ שָׁ֔מָּ/ה כִּ/שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יָּנֻ֕סוּ לִ/פְנֵ֖י אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָ/עָֽי
verses.translit: vy'lv mn h'm shmh khshlsht 'lpym 'ysh vynsv lpny 'nshy h'y
verses.translation: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּ֨וּ מֵ/הֶ֜ם אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָ/עַ֗י כִּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁה֙ אִ֔ישׁ וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפ֞וּ/ם לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/שַּׁ֨עַר֙ עַד הַ/שְּׁבָרִ֔ים וַ/יַּכּ֖וּ/ם בַּ/מּוֹרָ֑ד וַ/יִּמַּ֥ס לְבַב הָ/עָ֖ם וַ/יְהִ֥י לְ/מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vykhv mhm 'nshy h'y khshlshym vshshh 'ysh vyrdpvm lpny hsh'r 'd hshbrym vykhvm bmvrd vyms lbb h'm vyhy lmym
verses.translation: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרַ֨ע יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ שִׂמְלֹתָ֗י/ו וַ/יִּפֹּל֩ עַל פָּנָ֨י/ו אַ֜רְצָ/ה לִ/פְנֵ֨י אֲר֤וֹן יְהוָה֙ עַד הָ/עֶ֔רֶב ה֖וּא וְ/זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ עָפָ֖ר עַל רֹאשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvsh' shmltyv vypl 'l pnyv 'rtsh lpny 'rvn yhvh 'd h'rb hv' vzqny yshr'l vy'lv 'pr 'l r'shm
verses.translation: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֲהָ֣הּ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה לָ֠/מָה הֵעֲבַ֨רְתָּ הַעֲבִ֜יר אֶת הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָ/תֵ֥ת אֹתָ֛/נוּ בְּ/יַ֥ד הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י לְ/הַאֲבִידֵ֑/נוּ וְ/לוּ֙ הוֹאַ֣לְנוּ וַ/נֵּ֔שֶׁב בְּ/עֵ֖בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'hh 'dny yhvh lmh h'brt h'byr 't h'm hzh 't hyrdn ltt 'tnv byd h'mry lh'bydnv vlv hv'lnv vnshb b'br hyrdn
verses.translation: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord GOD , wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

verses.original: בִּ֖י אֲדֹנָ֑/י מָ֣ה אֹמַ֔ר אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָפַ֧ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֹ֖רֶף לִ/פְנֵ֥י אֹיְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: by 'dny mh 'mr 'chry 'shr hpkh yshr'l 'rf lpny 'ybyv
verses.translation: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׁמְע֣וּ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֗י וְ/כֹל֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/נָסַ֣בּוּ עָלֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/הִכְרִ֥יתוּ אֶת שְׁמֵ֖/נוּ מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וּ/מַֽה תַּעֲשֵׂ֖ה לְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֥ הַ/גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vyshm'v hkhn'ny vkhl yshby h'rts vnsbv 'lynv vhkhrytv 't shmnv mn h'rts vmh t'shh lshmkh hgdvl
verses.translation: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it , and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ קֻ֣ם לָ֑/ךְ לָ֣/מָּה זֶּ֔ה אַתָּ֖ה נֹפֵ֥ל עַל פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' qm lkh lmh zh 'th npl 'l pnykh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?

verses.original: חָטָא֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/גַם֙ עָבְר֣וּ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/גַ֤ם לָֽקְחוּ֙ מִן הַ/חֵ֔רֶם וְ/גַ֤ם גָּֽנְבוּ֙ וְ/גַ֣ם כִּֽחֲשׁ֔וּ וְ/גַ֖ם שָׂ֥מוּ בִ/כְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: cht' yshr'l vgm 'brv 't bryty 'shr tsvyty 'vtm vgm lqchv mn hchrm vgm gnbv vgm khchshv vgm shmv bkhlyhm
verses.translation: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֨א יֻכְל֜וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לָ/קוּם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם עֹ֗רֶף יִפְנוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּ֥י הָי֖וּ לְ/חֵ֑רֶם לֹ֤א אוֹסִיף֙ לִֽ/הְי֣וֹת עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם אִם לֹ֥א תַשְׁמִ֛ידוּ הַ/חֵ֖רֶם מִֽ/קִּרְבְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' ykhlv bny yshr'l lqvm lpny 'ybyhm 'rf ypnv lpny 'ybyhm khy hyv lchrm l' 'vsyf lhyvt 'mkhm 'm l' tshmydv hchrm mqrbkhm
verses.translation: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

verses.original: קֻ֚ם קַדֵּ֣שׁ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְ/מָחָ֑ר כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל חֵ֤רֶם בְּ/קִרְבְּ/ךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֣א תוּכַ֗ל לָ/קוּם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶ֔י/ךָ עַד הֲסִירְ/כֶ֥ם הַ/חֵ֖רֶם מִֽ/קִּרְבְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: qm qdsh 't h'm v'mrt htqdshv lmchr khy khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l chrm bqrbkh yshr'l l' tvkhl lqvm lpny 'ybykh 'd hsyrkhm hchrm mqrbkhm
verses.translation: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.

verses.original: וְ/נִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם בַּ/בֹּ֖קֶר לְ/שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָיָ֡ה הַ/שֵּׁבֶט֩ אֲשֶׁר יִלְכְּדֶ֨/נּוּ יְהוָ֜ה יִקְרַ֣ב לַ/מִּשְׁפָּח֗וֹת וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּחָ֞ה אֲשֶֽׁר יִלְכְּדֶ֤/נָּה יְהוָה֙ תִּקְרַ֣ב לַ/בָּתִּ֔ים וְ/הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִלְכְּדֶ֣/נּוּ יְהוָ֔ה יִקְרַ֖ב לַ/גְּבָרִֽים
verses.translit: vnqrbtm bbqr lshbtykhm vhyh hshbt 'shr ylkhdnv yhvh yqrb lmshpchvt vhmshpchh 'shr ylkhdnh yhvh tqrb lbtym vhbyt 'shr ylkhdnv yhvh yqrb lgbrym
verses.translation: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ הַ/נִּלְכָּ֣ד בַּ/חֵ֔רֶם יִשָּׂרֵ֣ף בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ אֹת֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֑/וֹ כִּ֤י עָבַר֙ אֶת בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְ/כִֽי עָשָׂ֥ה נְבָלָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhyh hnlkhd bchrm yshrf b'sh 'tv v't khl 'shr lv khy 'br 't bryt yhvh vkhy 'shh nblh byshr'l
verses.translation: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD , and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֤ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יַּקְרֵ֥ב אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִ/שְׁבָטָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּלָּכֵ֖ד שֵׁ֥בֶט יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyshkhm yhvsh' bbqr vyqrb 't yshr'l lshbtyv vylkhd shbt yhvdh
verses.translation: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֕ד אֵ֖ת מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַ/זַּרְחִ֑י וַ/יַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַ/זַּרְחִי֙ לַ/גְּבָרִ֔ים וַ/יִּלָּכֵ֖ד זַבְדִּֽי
verses.translit: vyqrb 't mshpcht yhvdh vylkhd 't mshpcht hzrchy vyqrb 't mshpcht hzrchy lgbrym vylkhd zbdy
verses.translation: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֥ב אֶת בֵּית֖/וֹ לַ/גְּבָרִ֑ים וַ/יִּלָּכֵ֗ד עָכָ֞ן בֶּן כַּרְמִ֧י בֶן זַבְדִּ֛י בֶּן זֶ֖רַח לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyqrb 't bytv lgbrym vylkhd 'khn bn khrmy bn zbdy bn zrch lmth yhvdh
verses.translation: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל עָכָ֗ן בְּנִ/י֙ שִֽׂים נָ֣א כָב֗וֹד לַֽ/יהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/תֶן ל֣/וֹ תוֹדָ֑ה וְ/הַגֶּד נָ֥א לִ/י֙ מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אַל תְּכַחֵ֖ד מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l 'khn bny shym n' khbvd lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l vtn lv tvdh vhgd n' ly mh 'shyt 'l tkhchd mmny
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַן עָכָ֛ן אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אָמְנָ֗ה אָנֹכִ֤י חָטָ֨אתִי֙ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/כָ/זֹ֥את וְ/כָ/זֹ֖את עָשִֽׂיתִי
verses.translit: vy'n 'khn 't yhvsh' vy'mr 'mnh 'nkhy cht'ty lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l vkhz't vkhz't 'shyty
verses.translation: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:

verses.original: ו/אראה וָ/אֵ֣רֶא בַ/שָּׁלָ֡ל אַדֶּ֣רֶת שִׁנְעָר֩ אַחַ֨ת טוֹבָ֜ה וּ/מָאתַ֧יִם שְׁקָלִ֣ים כֶּ֗סֶף וּ/לְשׁ֨וֹן זָהָ֤ב אֶחָד֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים שְׁקָלִים֙ מִשְׁקָל֔/וֹ וָֽ/אֶחְמְדֵ֖/ם וָֽ/אֶקָּחֵ֑/ם וְ/הִנָּ֨/ם טְמוּנִ֥ים בָּ/אָ֛רֶץ בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/אָֽהֳלִ֖/י וְ/הַ/כֶּ֥סֶף תַּחְתֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'r'h v'r' bshll 'drt shn'r 'cht tvbh vm'tym shqlym khsf vlshvn zhb 'chd chmshym shqlym mshqlv v'chmdm v'qchm vhnm tmvnym b'rts btvkh h'hly vhkhsf tchtyh
verses.translation: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים וַ/יָּרֻ֖צוּ הָ/אֹ֑הֱלָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה טְמוּנָ֛ה בְּ/אָהֳל֖/וֹ וְ/הַ/כֶּ֥סֶף תַּחְתֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvsh' ml'khym vyrtsv h'hlh vhnh tmvnh b'hlv vhkhsf tchtyh
verses.translation: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּחוּ/ם֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הָ/אֹ֔הֶל וַ/יְבִאוּ/ם֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וְ/אֶ֖ל כָּל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּצִּקֻ֖/ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqchvm mtvkh h'hl vyb'vm 'l yhvsh' v'l khl bny yshr'l vytsqm lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ אֶת עָכָ֣ן בֶּן זֶ֡רַח וְ/אֶת הַ/כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/אֶת הָ/אַדֶּ֣רֶת וְֽ/אֶת לְשׁ֣וֹן הַ/זָּהָ֡ב וְֽ/אֶת בָּנָ֡י/ו וְֽ/אֶת בְּנֹתָ֡י/ו וְ/אֶת שׁוֹר/וֹ֩ וְ/אֶת חֲמֹר֨/וֹ וְ/אֶת צֹאנ֤/וֹ וְ/אֶֽת אָהֳל/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם עֵ֥מֶק עָכֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyqch yhvsh' 't 'khn bn zrch v't hkhsf v't h'drt v't lshvn hzhb v't bnyv v't bntyv v't shvrv v't chmrv v't ts'nv v't 'hlv v't khl 'shr lv vkhl yshr'l 'mv vy'lv 'tm 'mq 'khvr
verses.translation: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ מֶ֣ה עֲכַרְתָּ֔/נוּ יַעְכֳּרְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יִּרְגְּמ֨וּ אֹת֤/וֹ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶ֔בֶן וַ/יִּשְׂרְפ֤וּ אֹתָ/ם֙ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ וַ/יִּסְקְל֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם בָּ/אֲבָנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' mh 'khrtnv y'khrkh yhvh byvm hzh vyrgmv 'tv khl yshr'l 'bn vyshrpv 'tm b'sh vysqlv 'tm b'bnym
verses.translation: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקִ֨ימוּ עָלָ֜י/ו גַּל אֲבָנִ֣ים גָּד֗וֹל עַ֚ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וַ/יָּ֥שָׁב יְהוָ֖ה מֵ/חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑/וֹ עַל כֵּ֠ן קָרָ֞א שֵׁ֣ם הַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ עֵ֣מֶק עָכ֔וֹר עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyqymv 'lyv gl 'bnym gdvl 'd hyvm hzh vyshb yhvh mchrvn 'pv 'l khn qr' shm hmqvm hhv' 'mq 'khvr 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אַל תִּירָ֣א וְ/אַל תֵּחָ֔ת קַ֣ח עִמְּ/ךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל עַ֣ם הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/ק֖וּם עֲלֵ֣ה הָ/עָ֑י רְאֵ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֗ אֶת מֶ֤לֶךְ הָ/עַי֙ וְ/אֶת עַמּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֶת עִיר֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' 'l tyr' v'l tcht qch 'mkh 't khl 'm hmlchmh vqvm 'lh h'y r'h ntty bydkh 't mlkh h'y v't 'mv v't 'yrv v't 'rtsv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֨יתָ לָ/עַ֜י וּ/לְ/מַלְכָּ֗/הּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֤יתָ לִֽ/ירִיחוֹ֙ וּ/לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/הּ רַק שְׁלָלָ֥/הּ וּ/בְהֶמְתָּ֖/הּ תָּבֹ֣זּוּ לָ/כֶ֑ם שִׂים לְ/ךָ֥ אֹרֵ֛ב לָ/עִ֖יר מֵ/אַחֲרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'shyt l'y vlmlkhh kh'shr 'shyt lyrychv vlmlkhh rq shllh vbhmth tbzv lkhm shym lkh 'rb l'yr m'chryh
verses.translation: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧קָם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וְ/כָל עַ֥ם הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה לַ/עֲל֣וֹת הָ/עָ֑י וַ/יִּבְחַ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֤לֶף אִישׁ֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַ/חַ֔יִל וַ/יִּשְׁלָחֵ֖/ם לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vyqm yhvsh' vkhl 'm hmlchmh l'lvt h'y vybchr yhvsh' shlshym 'lf 'ysh gbvry hchyl vyshlchm lylh
verses.translation: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֨ו אֹתָ֜/ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר רְ֠אוּ אַתֶּ֞ם אֹרְבִ֤ים לָ/עִיר֙ מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י הָ/עִ֔יר אַל תַּרְחִ֥יקוּ מִן הָ/עִ֖יר מְאֹ֑ד וִ/הְיִיתֶ֥ם כֻּלְּ/כֶ֖ם נְכֹנִֽים
verses.translit: vytsv 'tm l'mr r'v 'tm 'rbym l'yr m'chry h'yr 'l trchyqv mn h'yr m'd vhyytm khlkhm nkhnym
verses.translation: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֔/י נִקְרַ֖ב אֶל הָ/עִ֑יר וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּֽי יֵצְא֤וּ לִ/קְרָאתֵ֨/נוּ֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ/רִֽאשֹׁנָ֔ה וְ/נַ֖סְנוּ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'ny vkhl h'm 'shr 'ty nqrb 'l h'yr vhyh khy yts'v lqr'tnv kh'shr br'shnh vnsnv lpnyhm
verses.translation: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

verses.original: וְ/יָצְא֣וּ אַחֲרֵ֗י/נוּ עַ֣ד הַתִּיקֵ֤/נוּ אוֹתָ/ם֙ מִן הָ/עִ֔יר כִּ֣י יֹֽאמְר֔וּ נָסִ֣ים לְ/פָנֵ֔י/נוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּ/רִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְ/נַ֖סְנוּ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyts'v 'chrynv 'd htyqnv 'vtm mn h'yr khy y'mrv nsym lpnynv kh'shr br'shnh vnsnv lpnyhm
verses.translation: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם תָּקֻ֨מוּ֙ מֵ/הָ֣/אוֹרֵ֔ב וְ/הוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֖ם אֶת הָ/עִ֑יר וּ/נְתָנָ֛/הּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tm tqmv mh'vrb vhvrshtm 't h'yr vntnh yhvh 'lhykhm bydkhm
verses.translation: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה כְּ/תָפְשְׂ/כֶ֣ם אֶת הָ/עִ֗יר תַּצִּ֤יתוּ אֶת הָ/עִיר֙ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ רְא֖וּ צִוִּ֥יתִי אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh khtpshkhm 't h'yr ttsytv 't h'yr b'sh khdbr yhvh t'shv r'v tsvyty 'tkhm
verses.translation: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלָחֵ֣/ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל הַ/מַּאְרָ֔ב וַ/יֵּשְׁב֗וּ בֵּ֧ין בֵּֽית אֵ֛ל וּ/בֵ֥ין הָ/עַ֖י מִ/יָּ֣ם לָ/עָ֑י וַ/יָּ֧לֶן יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ בַּ/לַּ֥יְלָה הַ/ה֖וּא בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyshlchm yhvsh' vylkhv 'l hm'rb vyshbv byn byt 'l vbyn h'y mym l'y vyln yhvsh' blylh hhv' btvkh h'm
verses.translation: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֤ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יִּפְקֹ֖ד אֶת הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יַּ֨עַל ה֜וּא וְ/זִקְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עָ֖ם הָ/עָֽי
verses.translit: vyshkhm yhvsh' bbqr vypqd 't h'm vy'l hv' vzqny yshr'l lpny h'm h'y
verses.translation: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֨ם הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֗/וֹ עָלוּ֙ וַֽ/יִּגְּשׁ֔וּ וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ נֶ֣גֶד הָ/עִ֑יר וַֽ/יַּחֲנוּ֙ מִ/צְּפ֣וֹן לָ/עַ֔י וְ/הַ/גַּ֖י בינ/ו בֵּינָ֥י/ו וּ/בֵין הָ/עָֽי
verses.translit: vkhl h'm hmlchmh 'shr 'tv 'lv vygshv vyb'v ngd h'yr vychnv mtspvn l'y vhgy bynv bynyv vbyn h'y
verses.translation: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֕ח כַּ/חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם אוֹתָ֜/ם אֹרֵ֗ב בֵּ֧ין בֵּֽית אֵ֛ל וּ/בֵ֥ין הָ/עַ֖י מִ/יָּ֥ם לָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyqch khchmsht 'lpym 'ysh vyshm 'vtm 'rb byn byt 'l vbyn h'y mym l'yr
verses.translation: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of the city.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֨ימוּ הָ/עָ֜ם אֶת כָּל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֙ מִ/צְּפ֣וֹן לָ/עִ֔יר וְ/אֶת עֲקֵב֖/וֹ מִ/יָּ֣ם לָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יֵּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ בַּ/לַּ֥יְלָה הַ/ה֖וּא בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הָ/עֵֽמֶק
verses.translit: vyshymv h'm 't khl hmchnh 'shr mtspvn l'yr v't 'qbv mym l'yr vylkh yhvsh' blylh hhv' btvkh h'mq
verses.translation: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כִּ/רְא֣וֹת מֶֽלֶךְ הָ/עַ֗י וַֽ/יְמַהֲר֡וּ וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֡ימוּ וַ/יֵּצְא֣וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי הָ/עִ֣יר לִ/קְרַֽאת יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לַֽ/מִּלְחָמָ֞ה ה֧וּא וְ/כָל עַמּ֛/וֹ לַ/מּוֹעֵ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָֽ/עֲרָבָ֑ה וְ/הוּא֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּֽי אֹרֵ֥ב ל֖/וֹ מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֥י הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt mlkh h'y vymhrv vyshkhymv vyts'v 'nshy h'yr lqr't yshr'l lmlchmh hv' vkhl 'mv lmv'd lpny h'rbh vhv' l' yd' khy 'rb lv m'chry h'yr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it , that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.

verses.original: וַ/יִּנָּֽגְע֛וּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יָּנֻ֖סוּ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vyng'v yhvsh' vkhl yshr'l lpnyhm vynsv drkh hmdbr
verses.translation: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזָּעֲק֗וּ כָּל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר ב/עיר בָּ/עַ֔י לִ/רְדֹּ֖ף אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַ/יִּנָּתְק֖וּ מִן הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyz'qv khl h'm 'shr b'yr b'y lrdf 'chryhm vyrdpv 'chry yhvsh' vyntqv mn h'yr
verses.translation: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא נִשְׁאַ֣ר אִ֗ישׁ בָּ/עַי֙ וּ/בֵ֣ית אֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יָצְא֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּעַזְב֤וּ אֶת הָ/עִיר֙ פְּתוּחָ֔ה וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' nsh'r 'ysh b'y vbyt 'l 'shr l' yts'v 'chry yshr'l vy'zbv 't h'yr ptvchh vyrdpv 'chry yshr'l
verses.translation: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ נְ֠טֵה בַּ/כִּיד֤וֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּ/יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ אֶל הָ/עַ֔י כִּ֥י בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶ֑/נָּה וַ/יֵּ֧ט יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ בַּ/כִּיד֥וֹן אֲשֶׁר בְּ/יָד֖/וֹ אֶל הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' nth bkhydvn 'shr bydkh 'l h'y khy bydkh 'tnnh vyt yhvsh' bkhydvn 'shr bydv 'l h'yr
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אוֹרֵ֡ב קָם֩ מְהֵרָ֨ה מִ/מְּקוֹמ֤/וֹ וַ/יָּר֨וּצוּ֙ כִּ/נְט֣וֹת יָד֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ הָ/עִ֖יר וַֽ/יִּלְכְּד֑וּ/הָ וַֽ/יְמַהֲר֔וּ וַ/יַּצִּ֥יתוּ אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vh'vrb qm mhrh mmqvmv vyrvtsv khntvt ydv vyb'v h'yr vylkhdvh vymhrv vytsytv 't h'yr b'sh
verses.translation: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנ֣וּ אַנְשֵׁי֩ הָ/עַ֨י אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֜ם וַ/יִּרְא֗וּ וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה עָלָ֜ה עֲשַׁ֤ן הָ/עִיר֙ הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יְמָ/ה וְ/לֹא הָיָ֨ה בָ/הֶ֥ם יָדַ֛יִם לָ/נ֖וּס הֵ֣נָּה וָ/הֵ֑נָּה וְ/הָ/עָם֙ הַ/נָּ֣ס הַ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר נֶהְפַּ֖ךְ אֶל הָ/רוֹדֵֽף
verses.translit: vypnv 'nshy h'y 'chryhm vyr'v vhnh 'lh 'shn h'yr hshmymh vl' hyh bhm ydym lnvs hnh vhnh vh'm hns hmdbr nhpkh 'l hrvdf
verses.translation: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

verses.original: וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ וְ/כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל רָא֗וּ כִּֽי לָכַ֤ד הָֽ/אֹרֵב֙ אֶת הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/כִ֥י עָלָ֖ה עֲשַׁ֣ן הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יָּשֻׁ֕בוּ וַ/יַּכּ֖וּ אֶת אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָ/עָֽי
verses.translit: vyhvsh' vkhl yshr'l r'v khy lkhd h'rb 't h'yr vkhy 'lh 'shn h'yr vyshbv vykhv 't 'nshy h'y
verses.translation: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה יָצְא֤וּ מִן הָ/עִיר֙ לִ/קְרָאתָ֔/ם וַ/יִּֽהְי֤וּ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בַּ/תָּ֔וֶךְ אֵ֥לֶּה מִ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה מִ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יַּכּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔/ם עַד בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר ל֖/וֹ שָׂרִ֥יד וּ/פָלִֽיט
verses.translit: v'lh yts'v mn h'yr lqr'tm vyhyv lyshr'l btvkh 'lh mzh v'lh mzh vykhv 'vtm 'd blty hsh'yr lv shryd vplyt
verses.translation: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ הָ/עַ֖י תָּ֣פְשׂוּ חָ֑י וַ/יַּקְרִ֥בוּ אֹת֖/וֹ אֶל יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ
verses.translit: v't mlkh h'y tpshv chy vyqrbv 'tv 'l yhvsh'
verses.translation: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְּ/כַלּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל לַ/הֲרֹג֩ אֶת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֨י הָ/עַ֜י בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְדָפ֣וּ/ם בּ֔/וֹ וַֽ/יִּפְּל֥וּ כֻלָּ֛/ם לְ/פִי חֶ֖רֶב עַד תֻּמָּ֑/ם וַ/יָּשֻׁ֤בוּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הָ/עַ֔י וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ אֹתָ֖/הּ לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vyhy khkhlvt yshr'l lhrg 't khl yshby h'y bshdh bmdbr 'shr rdpvm bv vyplv khlm lpy chrb 'd tmm vyshbv khl yshr'l h'y vykhv 'th lpy chrb
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כָל הַ/נֹּ֨פְלִ֜ים בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ מֵ/אִ֣ישׁ וְ/עַד אִשָּׁ֔ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף כֹּ֖ל אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָ/עָֽי
verses.translit: vyhy khl hnplym byvm hhv' m'ysh v'd 'shh shnym 'shr 'lf khl 'nshy h'y
verses.translation: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.

verses.original: וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ לֹֽא הֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָטָ֖ה בַּ/כִּיד֑וֹן עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱרִ֔ים אֵ֖ת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/עָֽי
verses.translit: vyhvsh' l' hshyb ydv 'shr nth bkhydvn 'd 'shr hchrym 't khl yshby h'y
verses.translation: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

verses.original: רַ֣ק הַ/בְּהֵמָ֗ה וּ/שְׁלַל֙ הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/הִ֔יא בָּזְז֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה אֶת יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ
verses.translit: rq hbhmh vshll h'yr hhy' bzzv lhm yshr'l khdbr yhvh 'shr tsvh 't yhvsh'
verses.translation: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֥ף יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶת הָ/עָ֑י וַ/יְשִׂימֶ֤/הָ תֵּל עוֹלָם֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyshrf yhvsh' 't h'y vyshymh tl 'vlm shmmh 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מֶ֧לֶךְ הָ/עַ֛י תָּלָ֥ה עַל הָ/עֵ֖ץ עַד עֵ֣ת הָ/עָ֑רֶב וּ/כְ/ב֣וֹא הַ/שֶּׁמֶשׁ֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וַ/יֹּרִ֧ידוּ אֶת נִבְלָת֣/וֹ מִן הָ/עֵ֗ץ וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֤יכוּ אוֹתָ/הּ֙ אֶל פֶּ֨תַח֙ שַׁ֣עַר הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יָּקִ֤ימוּ עָלָי/ו֙ גַּל אֲבָנִ֣ים גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v't mlkh h'y tlh 'l h'ts 'd 't h'rb vkhbv' hshmsh tsvh yhvsh' vyrydv 't nbltv mn h'ts vyshlykhv 'vth 'l ptch sh'r h'yr vyqymv 'lyv gl 'bnym gdvl 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִבְנֶ֤ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּ/הַ֖ר עֵיבָֽל
verses.translit: 'z ybnh yhvsh' mzbch lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l bhr 'ybl
verses.translation: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּה֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֜ה אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ/כָּתוּב֙ בְּ/סֵ֨פֶר֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִזְבַּח֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים שְׁלֵמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא הֵנִ֥יף עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ן בַּרְזֶ֑ל וַ/יַּעֲל֨וּ עָלָ֤י/ו עֹלוֹת֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וַֽ/יִּזְבְּח֖וּ שְׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh mshh 'bd yhvh 't bny yshr'l khkhtvb bspr tvrt mshh mzbch 'bnym shlmvt 'shr l' hnyf 'lyhn brzl vy'lv 'lyv 'lvt lyhvh vyzbchv shlmym
verses.translation: As Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD , and sacrificed peace offerings.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתָּב שָׁ֖ם עַל הָ/אֲבָנִ֑ים אֵ֗ת מִשְׁנֵה֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּתַ֔ב לִ/פְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhtb shm 'l h'bnym 't mshnh tvrt mshh 'shr khtb lpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וּ/זְקֵנָ֡י/ו וְ/שֹׁטְרִ֣ים וְ/שֹׁפְטָ֡י/ו עֹמְדִ֣ים מִ/זֶּ֣ה וּ/מִ/זֶּ֣ה לָ/אָר֡וֹן נֶגֶד֩ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם נֹשְׂאֵ֣י אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֗ה כַּ/גֵּר֙ כָּֽ/אֶזְרָ֔ח חֶצְי/וֹ֙ אֶל מ֣וּל הַר גְּרִזִ֔ים וְ/הַֽ/חֶצְי֖/וֹ אֶל מ֣וּל הַר עֵיבָ֑ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֗ה לְ/בָרֵ֛ךְ אֶת הָ/עָ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ/רִאשֹׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l vzqnyv vshtrym vshptyv 'mdym mzh vmzh l'rvn ngd hkhhnym hlvym nsh'y 'rvn bryt yhvh khgr kh'zrch chtsyv 'l mvl hr grzym vhchtsyv 'l mvl hr 'ybl kh'shr tsvh mshh 'bd yhvh lbrkh 't h'm yshr'l br'shnh
verses.translation: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן קָרָא֙ אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/תּוֹרָ֔ה הַ/בְּרָכָ֖ה וְ/הַ/קְּלָלָ֑ה כְּ/כָל הַ/כָּת֖וּב בְּ/סֵ֥פֶר הַ/תּוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: v'chry khn qr' 't khl dbry htvrh hbrkhh vhqllh khkhl hkhtvb bspr htvrh
verses.translation: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

verses.original: לֹֽא הָיָ֣ה דָבָ֔ר מִ/כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא קָרָ֜א יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ נֶ֣גֶד כָּל קְהַ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/הַ/נָּשִׁ֣ים וְ/הַ/טַּ֔ף וְ/הַ/גֵּ֖ר הַ/הֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּ/קִרְבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: l' hyh dbr mkhl 'shr tsvh mshh 'shr l' qr' yhvsh' ngd khl qhl yshr'l vhnshym vhtf vhgr hhlkh bqrbm
verses.translation: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ כָּֽל הַ/מְּלָכִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ בְּ/עֵ֨בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֜ן בָּ/הָ֣ר וּ/בַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֗ה וּ/בְ/כֹל֙ ח֚וֹף הַ/יָּ֣ם הַ/גָּד֔וֹל אֶל מ֖וּל הַ/לְּבָנ֑וֹן הַֽ/חִתִּי֙ וְ/הָ֣/אֱמֹרִ֔י הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַ/פְּרִזִּ֔י הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' khl hmlkhym 'shr b'br hyrdn bhr vbshplh vbkhl chvf hym hgdvl 'l mvl hlbnvn hchty vh'mry hkhn'ny hprzy hchvy vhybvsy
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְקַבְּצ֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו לְ/הִלָּחֵ֥ם עִם יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְ/עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל פֶּ֖ה אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vytqbtsv ychdv lhlchm 'm yhvsh' v'm yshr'l ph 'chd
verses.translation: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

verses.original: וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֨י גִבְע֜וֹן שָׁמְע֗וּ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ לִֽ/ירִיח֖וֹ וְ/לָ/עָֽי
verses.translit: vyshby gb'vn shm'v 't 'shr 'shh yhvsh' lyrychv vl'y
verses.translation: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֤וּ גַם הֵ֨מָּה֙ בְּ/עָרְמָ֔ה וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ וַ/יִּצְטַיָּ֑רוּ וַ/יִּקְח֞וּ שַׂקִּ֤ים בָּלִים֙ לַ/חֲמ֣וֹרֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/נֹאד֥וֹת יַ֨יִן֙ בָּלִ֔ים וּ/מְבֻקָּעִ֖ים וּ/מְצֹרָרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'shv gm hmh b'rmh vylkhv vytstyrv vyqchv shqym blym lchmvryhm vn'dvt yyn blym vmbq'ym vmtsrrym
verses.translation: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

verses.original: וּ/נְעָל֨וֹת בָּל֤וֹת וּ/מְטֻלָּאוֹת֙ בְּ/רַגְלֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/שְׂלָמ֥וֹת בָּל֖וֹת עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/כֹל֙ לֶ֣חֶם צֵידָ֔/ם יָבֵ֖שׁ הָיָ֥ה נִקֻּדִֽים
verses.translit: vn'lvt blvt vmtl'vt brglyhm vshlmvt blvt 'lyhm vkhl lchm tsydm ybsh hyh nqdym
verses.translation: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֧וּ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה הַ/גִּלְגָּ֑ל וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜י/ו וְ/אֶל אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ/אֶ֤רֶץ רְחוֹקָה֙ בָּ֔אנוּ וְ/עַתָּ֖ה כִּרְתוּ לָ֥/נוּ בְרִֽית
verses.translit: vylkhv 'l yhvsh' 'l hmchnh hglgl vy'mrv 'lyv v'l 'ysh yshr'l m'rts rchvqh b'nv v'th khrtv lnv bryt
verses.translation: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.

verses.original: ו/יאמרו וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל הַ/חִוִּ֑י אוּלַ֗י בְּ/קִרְבִּ/י֙ אַתָּ֣ה יוֹשֵׁ֔ב וְ/אֵ֖יךְ אכרות אֶֽכְרָת לְ/ךָ֥ בְרִֽית
verses.translit: vy'mrv vy'mr 'ysh yshr'l 'l hchvy 'vly bqrby 'th yvshb v'ykh 'khrvt 'khrt lkh bryt
verses.translation: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֧ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ מִ֥י אַתֶּ֖ם וּ/מֵ/אַ֥יִן תָּבֹֽאוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l yhvsh' 'bdykh 'nchnv vy'mr 'lhm yhvsh' my 'tm vm'yn tb'v
verses.translation: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו מֵ/אֶ֨רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֤ה מְאֹד֙ בָּ֣אוּ עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ כִּֽי שָׁמַ֣עְנוּ שָׁמְע֔/וֹ וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּ/מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv m'rts rchvqh m'd b'v 'bdykh lshm yhvh 'lhykh khy shm'nv shm'v v't khl 'shr 'shh bmtsrym
verses.translation: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה לִ/שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן לְ/סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן וּ/לְ/ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֖ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/עַשְׁתָּרֽוֹת
verses.translit: v't khl 'shr 'shh lshny mlkhy h'mry 'shr b'br hyrdn lsychvn mlkh chshbvn vl'vg mlkh hbshn 'shr b'shtrvt
verses.translation: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלֵ֡י/נוּ זְֽקֵינֵי/נוּ֩ וְ/כָל יֹשְׁבֵ֨י אַרְצֵ֜/נוּ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר קְח֨וּ בְ/יֶדְ/כֶ֤ם צֵידָה֙ לַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וּ/לְכ֖וּ לִ/קְרָאתָ֑/ם וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ עַבְדֵי/כֶ֣ם אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וְ/עַתָּ֖ה כִּרְתוּ לָ֥/נוּ בְרִֽית
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lynv zqynynv vkhl yshby 'rtsnv l'mr qchv bydkhm tsydh ldrkh vlkhv lqr'tm v'mrtm 'lyhm 'bdykhm 'nchnv v'th khrtv lnv bryt
verses.translation: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה לַחְמֵ֗/נוּ חָ֞ם הִצְטַיַּ֤דְנוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ מִ/בָּ֣תֵּ֔י/נוּ בְּ/י֥וֹם צֵאתֵ֖/נוּ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/עַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָבֵ֔שׁ וְ/הָיָ֖ה נִקֻּדִֽים
verses.translit: zh lchmnv chm htstydnv 'tv mbtynv byvm ts'tnv llkht 'lykhm v'th hnh ybsh vhyh nqdym
verses.translation: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה נֹאד֤וֹת הַ/יַּ֨יִן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִלֵּ֣אנוּ חֲדָשִׁ֔ים וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה הִתְבַּקָּ֑עוּ וְ/אֵ֤לֶּה שַׂלְמוֹתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וּ/נְעָלֵ֔י/נוּ בָּל֕וּ מֵ/רֹ֥ב הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: v'lh n'dvt hyyn 'shr ml'nv chdshym vhnh htbq'v v'lh shlmvtynv vn'lynv blv mrb hdrkh m'd
verses.translation: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֥וּ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִ/צֵּידָ֑/ם וְ/אֶת פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א שָׁאָֽלוּ
verses.translit: vyqchv h'nshym mtsydm v't py yhvh l' sh'lv
verses.translation: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ לָ/הֶ֤ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ שָׁל֔וֹם וַ/יִּכְרֹ֥ת לָ/הֶ֛ם בְּרִ֖ית לְ/חַיּוֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יִּשָּׁבְע֣וּ לָ/הֶ֔ם נְשִׂיאֵ֖י הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh lhm yhvsh' shlvm vykhrt lhm bryt lchyvtm vyshb'v lhm nshy'y h'dh
verses.translation: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מִ/קְצֵה֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֕י אֲשֶׁר כָּרְת֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּרִ֑ית וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֗וּ כִּי קְרֹבִ֥ים הֵם֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו וּ/בְ/קִרְבּ֖/וֹ הֵ֥ם יֹשְׁבִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy mqtsh shlsht ymym 'chry 'shr khrtv lhm bryt vyshm'v khy qrbym hm 'lyv vbqrbv hm yshbym
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֣וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַ/יָּבֹ֛אוּ אֶל עָרֵי/הֶ֖ם בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י וְ/עָרֵי/הֶם֙ גִּבְע֣וֹן וְ/הַ/כְּפִירָ֔ה וּ/בְאֵר֖וֹת וְ/קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים
verses.translit: vys'v bny yshr'l vyb'v 'l 'ryhm byvm hshlyshy v'ryhm gb'vn vhkhpyrh vb'rvt vqryt y'rym
verses.translation: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א הִכּוּ/ם֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי נִשְׁבְּע֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה בַּֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּלֹּ֥נוּ כָל הָ/עֵדָ֖ה עַל הַ/נְּשִׂיאִֽים
verses.translit: vl' hkhvm bny yshr'l khy nshb'v lhm nshy'y h'dh byhvh 'lhy yshr'l vylnv khl h'dh 'l hnshy'ym
verses.translation: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ כָל הַ/נְּשִׂיאִים֙ אֶל כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְנוּ לָ/הֶ֔ם בַּֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/עַתָּ֕ה לֹ֥א נוּכַ֖ל לִ/נְגֹּ֥עַ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv khl hnshy'ym 'l khl h'dh 'nchnv nshb'nv lhm byhvh 'lhy yshr'l v'th l' nvkhl lng' bhm
verses.translation: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.

verses.original: זֹ֛את נַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/הַחֲיֵ֣ה אוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹֽא יִֽהְיֶ֤ה עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ קֶ֔צֶף עַל הַ/שְּׁבוּעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְנוּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: z't n'shh lhm vhchyh 'vtm vl' yhyh 'lynv qtsf 'l hshbv'h 'shr nshb'nv lhm
verses.translation: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֧וּ אֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם הַ/נְּשִׂיאִ֖ים יִֽחְי֑וּ וַ֠/יִּֽהְיוּ חֹטְבֵ֨י עֵצִ֤ים וְ/שֹֽׁאֲבֵי מַ֨יִם֙ לְ/כָל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבְּר֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם הַ/נְּשִׂיאִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyhm hnshy'ym ychyv vyhyv chtby 'tsym vsh'by mym lkhl h'dh kh'shr dbrv lhm hnshy'ym
verses.translation: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א לָ/הֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לָ/מָּה֩ רִמִּיתֶ֨ם אֹתָ֜/נוּ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר רְחוֹקִ֨ים אֲנַ֤חְנוּ מִ/כֶּם֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֥/נוּ יֹשְׁבִֽים
verses.translit: vyqr' lhm yhvsh' vydbr 'lyhm l'mr lmh rmytm 'tnv l'mr rchvqym 'nchnv mkhm m'd v'tm bqrbnv yshbym
verses.translation: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה אֲרוּרִ֣ים אַתֶּ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֨ת מִ/כֶּ֜ם עֶ֗בֶד וְ/חֹטְבֵ֥י עֵצִ֛ים וְ/שֹֽׁאֲבֵי מַ֖יִם לְ/בֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th 'rvrym 'tm vl' ykhrt mkhm 'bd vchtby 'tsym vsh'by mym lbyt 'lhy
verses.translation: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲנ֨וּ אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ כִּי֩ הֻגֵּ֨ד הֻגַּ֤ד לַ/עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֔/וֹ לָ/תֵ֤ת לָ/כֶם֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/לְ/הַשְׁמִ֛יד אֶת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/נִּירָ֨א מְאֹ֤ד לְ/נַפְשֹׁתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם וַֽ/נַּעֲשֵׂ֖ה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'nv 't yhvsh' vy'mrv khy hgd hgd l'bdykh 't 'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhykh 't mshh 'bdv ltt lkhm 't khl h'rts vlhshmyd 't khl yshby h'rts mpnykhm vnyr' m'd lnpshtynv mpnykhm vn'shh 't hdbr hzh
verses.translation: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה הִנְ/נ֣וּ בְ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ כַּ/טּ֨וֹב וְ/כַ/יָּשָׁ֧ר בְּ/עֵינֶ֛י/ךָ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ֖/נוּ עֲשֵֽׂה
verses.translit: v'th hnnv bydkh khtvb vkhyshr b'ynykh l'shvt lnv 'shh
verses.translation: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ לָ/הֶ֖ם כֵּ֑ן וַ/יַּצֵּ֥ל אוֹתָ֛/ם מִ/יַּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/לֹ֥א הֲרָגֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: vy'sh lhm khn vytsl 'vtm myd bny yshr'l vl' hrgvm
verses.translation: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֨/ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא חֹטְבֵ֥י עֵצִ֛ים וְ/שֹׁ֥אֲבֵי מַ֖יִם לָֽ/עֵדָ֑ה וּ/לְ/מִזְבַּ֤ח יְהוָה֙ עַד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחָֽר
verses.translit: vytnm yhvsh' byvm hhv' chtby 'tsym vsh'by mym l'dh vlmzbch yhvh 'd hyvm hzh 'l hmqvm 'shr ybchr
verses.translation: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD , even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲדֹֽנִי צֶ֜דֶק מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם כִּֽי לָכַ֨ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ אֶת הָ/עַי֮ וַ/יַּחֲרִימָ/הּ֒ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה לִֽ/ירִיחוֹ֙ וּ/לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/הּ כֵּן עָשָׂ֥ה לָ/עַ֖י וּ/לְ/מַלְכָּ֑/הּ וְ/כִ֨י הִשְׁלִ֜ימוּ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י גִבְעוֹן֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּֽהְי֖וּ בְּ/קִרְבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 'dny tsdq mlkh yrvshlm khy lkhd yhvsh' 't h'y vychrymh kh'shr 'shh lyrychv vlmlkhh khn 'shh l'y vlmlkhh vkhy hshlymv yshby gb'vn 't yshr'l vyhyv bqrbm
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽירְא֣וּ מְאֹ֔ד כִּ֣י עִ֤יר גְּדוֹלָה֙ גִּבְע֔וֹן כְּ/אַחַ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֑ה וְ/כִ֨י הִ֤יא גְדוֹלָה֙ מִן הָ/עַ֔י וְ/כָל אֲנָשֶׁ֖י/הָ גִּבֹּרִֽים
verses.translit: vyyr'v m'd khy 'yr gdvlh gb'vn kh'cht 'ry hmmlkhh vkhy hy' gdvlh mn h'y vkhl 'nshyh gbrym
verses.translation: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֲדֹנִי צֶ֜דֶק מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֶל הוֹהָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ חֶ֠בְרוֹן וְ/אֶל פִּרְאָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ יַרְמ֜וּת וְ/אֶל יָפִ֧יעַ מֶֽלֶךְ לָכִ֛ישׁ וְ/אֶל דְּבִ֥יר מֶֽלֶךְ עֶגְל֖וֹן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyshlch 'dny tsdq mlkh yrvshlm 'l hvhm mlkh chbrvn v'l pr'm mlkh yrmvt v'l ypy' mlkh lkhysh v'l dbyr mlkh 'glvn l'mr
verses.translation: Wherefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

verses.original: עֲלֽוּ אֵלַ֣/י וְ/עִזְרֻ֔/נִי וְ/נַכֶּ֖ה אֶת גִּבְע֑וֹן כִּֽי הִשְׁלִ֥ימָה אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְ/אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'lv 'ly v'zrny vnkhh 't gb'vn khy hshlymh 't yhvsh' v't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּאָסְפ֨וּ וַֽ/יַּעֲל֜וּ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֗י מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם מֶֽלֶךְ חֶבְר֤וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ יַרְמוּת֙ מֶֽלֶךְ לָכִ֣ישׁ מֶֽלֶךְ עֶגְל֔וֹן הֵ֖ם וְ/כָל מַֽחֲנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַֽ/יַּחֲנוּ֙ עַל גִּבְע֔וֹן וַ/יִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'spv vy'lv chmsht mlkhy h'mry mlkh yrvshlm mlkh chbrvn mlkh yrmvt mlkh lkhysh mlkh 'glvn hm vkhl mchnyhm vychnv 'l gb'vn vylchmv 'lyh
verses.translation: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֣וּ אַנְשֵׁי֩ גִבְע֨וֹן אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶה֙ הַ/גִּלְגָּ֣לָ/ה לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַל תֶּ֥רֶף יָדֶ֖י/ךָ מֵֽ/עֲבָדֶ֑י/ךָ עֲלֵ֧ה אֵלֵ֣י/נוּ מְהֵרָ֗ה וְ/הוֹשִׁ֤יעָ/ה לָּ֨/נוּ֙ וְ/עָזְרֵ֔/נוּ כִּ֚י נִקְבְּצ֣וּ אֵלֵ֔י/נוּ כָּל מַלְכֵ֥י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vyshlchv 'nshy gb'vn 'l yhvsh' 'l hmchnh hglglh l'mr 'l trf ydykh m'bdykh 'lh 'lynv mhrh vhvshy'h lnv v'zrnv khy nqbtsv 'lynv khl mlkhy h'mry yshby hhr
verses.translation: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ מִן הַ/גִּלְגָּ֗ל ה֚וּא וְ/כָל עַ֤ם הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וְ/כֹ֖ל גִּבּוֹרֵ֥י הֶ/חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vy'l yhvsh' mn hglgl hv' vkhl 'm hmlchmh 'mv vkhl gbvry hchyl
verses.translation: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אַל תִּירָ֣א מֵ/הֶ֔ם כִּ֥י בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֖ נְתַתִּ֑י/ם לֹֽא יַעֲמֹ֥ד אִ֛ישׁ מֵ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' 'l tyr' mhm khy bydkh nttym l' y'md 'ysh mhm bpnykh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֧א אֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ פִּתְאֹ֑ם כָּל הַ/לַּ֕יְלָה עָלָ֖ה מִן הַ/גִּלְגָּֽל
verses.translit: vyb' 'lyhm yhvsh' pt'm khl hlylh 'lh mn hglgl
verses.translation: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.

verses.original: וַ/יְהֻמֵּ֤/ם יְהוָה֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/ם מַכָּֽה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בְּ/גִבְע֑וֹן וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפֵ֗/ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ מַעֲלֵ֣ה בֵית חוֹרֹ֔ן וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/ם עַד עֲזֵקָ֖ה וְ/עַד מַקֵּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyhmm yhvh lpny yshr'l vykhm mkhh gdvlh bgb'vn vyrdpm drkh m'lh byt chvrn vykhm 'd 'zqh v'd mqdh
verses.translation: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י בְּ/נֻסָ֣/ם מִ/פְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הֵ֞ם בְּ/מוֹרַ֤ד בֵּית חוֹרֹן֙ וַֽ/יהוָ֡ה הִשְׁלִ֣יךְ עֲלֵי/הֶם֩ אֲבָנִ֨ים גְּדֹל֧וֹת מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֛יִם עַד עֲזֵקָ֖ה וַ/יָּמֻ֑תוּ רַבִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁר מֵ֨תוּ֙ בְּ/אַבְנֵ֣י הַ/בָּרָ֔ד מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרְג֛וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vyhy bnsm mpny yshr'l hm bmvrd byt chvrn vyhvh hshlykh 'lyhm 'bnym gdlvt mn hshmym 'd 'zqh vymtv rbym 'shr mtv b'bny hbrd m'shr hrgv bny yshr'l bchrb
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה בְּ/י֗וֹם תֵּ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֱמֹרִ֔י לִ/פְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/עֵינֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שֶׁ֚מֶשׁ בְּ/גִבְע֣וֹן דּ֔וֹם וְ/יָרֵ֖חַ בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק אַיָּלֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'z ydbr yhvsh' lyhvh byvm tt yhvh 't h'mry lpny bny yshr'l vy'mr l'yny yshr'l shmsh bgb'vn dvm vyrch b'mq 'ylvn
verses.translation: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּדֹּ֨ם הַ/שֶּׁ֜מֶשׁ וְ/יָרֵ֣חַ עָמָ֗ד עַד יִקֹּ֥ם גּוֹי֙ אֹֽיְבָ֔י/ו הֲ/לֹא הִ֥יא כְתוּבָ֖ה עַל סֵ֣פֶר הַ/יָּשָׁ֑ר וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֤ד הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ בַּ/חֲצִ֣י הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/לֹא אָ֥ץ לָ/ב֖וֹא כְּ/י֥וֹם תָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vydm hshmsh vyrch 'md 'd yqm gvy 'ybyv hl' hy' khtvbh 'l spr hyshr vy'md hshmsh bchtsy hshmym vl' 'ts lbv' khyvm tmym
verses.translation: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֨א הָיָ֜ה כַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ לְ/פָנָ֣י/ו וְ/אַחֲרָ֔י/ו לִ/שְׁמֹ֥עַ יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/ק֣וֹל אִ֑ישׁ כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה נִלְחָ֖ם לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' hyh khyvm hhv' lpnyv v'chryv lshm' yhvh bqvl 'ysh khy yhvh nlchm lyshr'l
verses.translation: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ֔/וֹ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה הַ/גִּלְגָּֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshb yhvsh' vkhl yshr'l 'mv 'l hmchnh hglglh
verses.translation: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

verses.original: וַ/יָּנֻ֕סוּ חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת הַ/מְּלָכִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יֵּחָבְא֥וּ בַ/מְּעָרָ֖ה בְּ/מַקֵּדָֽה
verses.translit: vynsv chmsht hmlkhym h'lh vychb'v bm'rh bmqdh
verses.translation: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֖ד לִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר נִמְצְאוּ֙ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת הַ/מְּלָכִ֔ים נֶחְבְּאִ֥ים בַּ/מְּעָרָ֖ה בְּ/מַקֵּדָֽה
verses.translit: vygd lyhvsh' l'mr nmts'v chmsht hmlkhym nchb'ym bm'rh bmqdh
verses.translation: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ גֹּ֛לּוּ אֲבָנִ֥ים גְּדֹל֖וֹת אֶל פִּ֣י הַ/מְּעָרָ֑ה וְ/הַפְקִ֧ידוּ עָלֶ֛י/הָ אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לְ/שָׁמְרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' glv 'bnym gdlvt 'l py hm'rh vhpqydv 'lyh 'nshym lshmrm
verses.translation: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּם֙ אַֽל תַּעֲמֹ֔דוּ רִדְפוּ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/זִנַּבְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָ֑/ם אַֽל תִּתְּנ֗וּ/ם לָ/בוֹא֙ אֶל עָ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּ֧י נְתָנָ֛/ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tm 'l t'mdv rdpv 'chry 'ybykhm vznbtm 'vtm 'l ttnvm lbv' 'l 'ryhm khy ntnm yhvh 'lhykhm bydkhm
verses.translation: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כְּ/כַלּ֨וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְ/הַכּוֹתָ֛/ם מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה מְאֹ֖ד עַד תֻּמָּ֑/ם וְ/הַ/שְּׂרִידִים֙ שָׂרְד֣וּ מֵ/הֶ֔ם וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל עָרֵ֥י הַ/מִּבְצָֽר
verses.translit: vyhy khkhlvt yhvsh' vbny yshr'l lhkhvtm mkhh gdvlh m'd 'd tmm vhshrydym shrdv mhm vyb'v 'l 'ry hmbtsr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁבוּ֩ כָל הָ/עָ֨ם אֶל הַ/מַּחֲנֶ֧ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ מַקֵּדָ֖ה בְּ/שָׁל֑וֹם לֹֽא חָרַ֞ץ לִ/בְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְ/אִ֖ישׁ אֶת לְשֹׁנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshbv khl h'm 'l hmchnh 'l yhvsh' mqdh bshlvm l' chrts lbny yshr'l l'ysh 't lshnv
verses.translation: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ פִּתְח֖וּ אֶת פִּ֣י הַ/מְּעָרָ֑ה וְ/הוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֵלַ֗/י אֶת חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת הַ/מְּלָכִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה מִן הַ/מְּעָרָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' ptchv 't py hm'rh vhvtsy'v 'ly 't chmsht hmlkhym h'lh mn hm'rh
verses.translation: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עֲשׂוּ כֵ֔ן וַ/יֹּצִ֣יאוּ אֵלָ֗י/ו אֶת חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת הַ/מְּלָכִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה מִן הַ/מְּעָרָ֑ה אֵ֣ת מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֶת מֶ֤לֶךְ חֶבְרוֹן֙ אֶת מֶ֣לֶךְ יַרְמ֔וּת אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ לָכִ֖ישׁ אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ עֶגְלֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'shv khn vytsy'v 'lyv 't chmsht hmlkhym h'lh mn hm'rh 't mlkh yrvshlm 't mlkh chbrvn 't mlkh yrmvt 't mlkh lkhysh 't mlkh 'glvn
verses.translation: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

verses.original: וַ֠/יְהִי כְּֽ/הוֹצִיאָ֞/ם אֶת הַ/מְּלָכִ֣ים הָ/אֵלֶּה֮ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֒ וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל כָּל אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר אֶל קְצִינֵ֞י אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ הֶ/הָלְכ֣וּא אִתּ֔/וֹ קִרְב֗וּ שִׂ֚ימוּ אֶת רַגְלֵי/כֶ֔ם עַֽל צַוְּארֵ֖י הַ/מְּלָכִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַֽ/יִּקְרְב֔וּ וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶת רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל צַוְּארֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy khhvtsy'm 't hmlkhym h'lh 'l yhvsh' vyqr' yhvsh' 'l khl 'ysh yshr'l vy'mr 'l qtsyny 'nshy hmlchmh hhlkhv' 'tv qrbv shymv 't rglykhm 'l tsv'ry hmlkhym h'lh vyqrbv vyshymv 't rglyhm 'l tsv'ryhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ אַל תִּֽירְא֖וּ וְ/אַל תֵּחָ֑תּוּ חִזְק֣וּ וְ/אִמְצ֔וּ כִּ֣י כָ֗כָה יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְ/כָל אֹ֣יְבֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם נִלְחָמִ֥ים אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm yhvsh' 'l tyr'v v'l tchtv chzqv v'mtsv khy khkhh y'shh yhvh lkhl 'ybykhm 'shr 'tm nlchmym 'vtm
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֵּ֨/ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אַֽחֲרֵי כֵן֙ וַ/יְמִיתֵ֔/ם וַ/יִּתְלֵ֕/ם עַ֖ל חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה עֵצִ֑ים וַ/יִּֽהְי֛וּ תְּלוּיִ֥ם עַל הָ/עֵצִ֖ים עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vykhm yhvsh' 'chry khn vymytm vytlm 'l chmshh 'tsym vyhyv tlvym 'l h'tsym 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י לְ/עֵ֣ת בּ֣וֹא הַ/שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ צִוָּ֤ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ וַ/יֹּֽרִידוּ/ם֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/עֵצִ֔ים וַ/יַּ֨שְׁלִכֻ֔/ם אֶל הַ/מְּעָרָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֶחְבְּאוּ שָׁ֑ם וַ/יָּשִׂ֜מוּ אֲבָנִ֤ים גְּדֹלוֹת֙ עַל פִּ֣י הַ/מְּעָרָ֔ה עַד עֶ֖צֶם הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyhy l't bv' hshmsh tsvh yhvsh' vyrydvm m'l h'tsym vyshlkhm 'l hm'rh 'shr nchb'v shm vyshmv 'bnym gdlvt 'l py hm'rh 'd 'tsm hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth, which remain until this very day.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מַקֵּדָה֩ לָכַ֨ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא וַ/יַּכֶּ֣/הָ לְ/פִי חֶרֶב֮ וְ/אֶת מַלְכָּ/הּ֒ הֶחֱרִ֣ם אוֹתָ֗/ם וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/נֶּ֨פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֔/הּ לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖יר שָׂרִ֑יד וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ מַקֵּדָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְ/מֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיחֽוֹ
verses.translit: v't mqdh lkhd yhvsh' byvm hhv' vykhh lpy chrb v't mlkhh hchrm 'vtm v't khl hnpsh 'shr bh l' hsh'yr shryd vy'sh lmlkh mqdh kh'shr 'shh lmlkh yrychv
verses.translation: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ וְ/כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛/וֹ מִ/מַּקֵּדָ֖ה לִבְנָ֑ה וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם עִם לִבְנָֽה
verses.translit: vy'br yhvsh' vkhl yshr'l 'mv mmqdh lbnh vylchm 'm lbnh
verses.translation: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה גַּם אוֹתָ֜/הּ בְּ/יַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל וְ/אֶת מַלְכָּ/הּ֒ וַ/יַּכֶּ֣/הָ לְ/פִי חֶ֗רֶב וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/נֶּ֨פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֔/הּ לֹֽא הִשְׁאִ֥יר בָּ֖/הּ שָׂרִ֑יד וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/הּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְ/מֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיחֽוֹ
verses.translit: vytn yhvh gm 'vth byd yshr'l v't mlkhh vykhh lpy chrb v't khl hnpsh 'shr bh l' hsh'yr bh shryd vy'sh lmlkhh kh'shr 'shh lmlkh yrychv
verses.translation: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛/וֹ מִ/לִּבְנָ֖ה לָכִ֑ישָׁ/ה וַ/יִּ֣חַן עָלֶ֔י/הָ וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'br yhvsh' vkhl yshr'l 'mv mlbnh lkhyshh vychn 'lyh vylchm bh
verses.translation: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶת לָכִ֜ישׁ בְּ/יַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדָ/הּ֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י וַ/יַּכֶּ֣/הָ לְ/פִי חֶ֔רֶב וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/נֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֑/הּ כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה לְ/לִבְנָֽה
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 't lkhysh byd yshr'l vylkhdh byvm hshny vykhh lpy chrb v't khl hnpsh 'shr bh khkhl 'shr 'shh llbnh
verses.translation: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

verses.original: אָ֣ז עָלָ֗ה הֹרָם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גֶּ֔זֶר לַ/עְזֹ֖ר אֶת לָכִ֑ישׁ וַ/יַּכֵּ֤/הוּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ וְ/אֶת עַמּ֔/וֹ עַד בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר ל֖/וֹ שָׂרִֽיד
verses.translit: 'z 'lh hrm mlkh gzr l'zr 't lkhysh vykhhv yhvsh' v't 'mv 'd blty hsh'yr lv shryd
verses.translation: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ר יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛/וֹ מִ/לָּכִ֖ישׁ עֶגְלֹ֑נָ/ה וַ/יַּחֲנ֣וּ עָלֶ֔י/הָ וַ/יִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'br yhvsh' vkhl yshr'l 'mv mlkhysh 'glnh vychnv 'lyh vylchmv 'lyh
verses.translation: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּלְכְּד֜וּ/הָ בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ וַ/יַּכּ֣וּ/הָ לְ/פִי חֶ֔רֶב וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הַ/נֶּ֣פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֔/הּ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא הֶחֱרִ֑ים כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה לְ/לָכִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vylkhdvh byvm hhv' vykhvh lpy chrb v't khl hnpsh 'shr bh byvm hhv' hchrym khkhl 'shr 'shh llkhysh
verses.translation: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל יְ֠הוֹשֻׁעַ וְ/כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֛/וֹ מֵ/עֶגְל֖וֹנָ/ה חֶבְר֑וֹנָ/ה וַ/יִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'l yhvsh' vkhl yshr'l 'mv m'glvnh chbrvnh vylchmv 'lyh
verses.translation: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְכְּד֣וּ/הָ וַ/יַּכּֽוּ/הָ לְ/פִי חֶ֠רֶב וְ/אֶת מַלְכָּ֨/הּ וְ/אֶת כָּל עָרֶ֜י/הָ וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/נֶּ֤פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּ/הּ֙ לֹֽא הִשְׁאִ֣יר שָׂרִ֔יד כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה לְ/עֶגְל֑וֹן וַ/יַּחֲרֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔/הּ וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/נֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vylkhdvh vykhvh lpy chrb v't mlkhh v't khl 'ryh v't khl hnpsh 'shr bh l' hsh'yr shryd khkhl 'shr 'shh l'glvn vychrm 'vth v't khl hnpsh 'shr bh
verses.translation: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧שָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֖/וֹ דְּבִ֑רָ/ה וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyshb yhvsh' vkhl yshr'l 'mv dbrh vylchm 'lyh
verses.translation: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדָ֞/הּ וְ/אֶת מַלְכָּ֤/הּ וְ/אֶת כָּל עָרֶ֨י/הָ֙ וַ/יַּכּ֣וּ/ם לְ/פִי חֶ֔רֶב וַֽ/יַּחֲרִ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת כָּל נֶ֣פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֔/הּ לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖יר שָׂרִ֑יד כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה לְ/חֶבְר֗וֹן כֵּן עָשָׂ֤ה לִ/דְבִ֨רָ/ה֙ וּ/לְ/מַלְכָּ֔/הּ וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לְ/לִבְנָ֖ה וּ/לְ/מַלְכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vylkhdh v't mlkhh v't khl 'ryh vykhvm lpy chrb vychrymv 't khl npsh 'shr bh l' hsh'yr shryd kh'shr 'shh lchbrvn khn 'shh ldbrh vlmlkhh vkh'shr 'shh llbnh vlmlkhh
verses.translation: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֶּ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֡רֶץ הָ/הָר֩ וְ/הַ/נֶּ֨גֶב וְ/הַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֜ה וְ/הָ/אֲשֵׁד֗וֹת וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל מַלְכֵי/הֶ֔ם לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖יר שָׂרִ֑יד וְ/אֵ֤ת כָּל הַ/נְּשָׁמָה֙ הֶחֱרִ֔ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhh yhvsh' 't khl h'rts hhr vhngb vhshplh vh'shdvt v't khl mlkhyhm l' hsh'yr shryd v't khl hnshmh hchrym kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֵּ֧/ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ מִ/קָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ וְ/עַד עַזָּ֑ה וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל אֶ֥רֶץ גֹּ֖שֶׁן וְ/עַד גִּבְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vykhm yhvsh' mqdsh brn' v'd 'zh v't khl 'rts gshn v'd gb'vn
verses.translation: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל הַ/מְּלָכִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ וְ/אֶת אַרְצָ֔/ם לָכַ֥ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כִּ֗י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נִלְחָ֖ם לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v't khl hmlkhym h'lh v't 'rtsm lkhd yhvsh' p'm 'cht khy yhvh 'lhy yshr'l nlchm lyshr'l
verses.translation: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ֔/וֹ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה הַ/גִּלְגָּֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshb yhvsh' vkhl yshr'l 'mv 'l hmchnh hglglh
verses.translation: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֖עַ יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ חָצ֑וֹר וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל יוֹבָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מָד֔וֹן וְ/אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ שִׁמְר֖וֹן וְ/אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ אַכְשָֽׁף
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' ybyn mlkh chtsvr vyshlch 'l yvbb mlkh mdvn v'l mlkh shmrvn v'l mlkh 'khshf
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶל הַ/מְּלָכִ֞ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִ/צְּפ֗וֹן בָּ/הָ֧ר וּ/בָ/עֲרָבָ֛ה נֶ֥גֶב כִּֽנֲר֖וֹת וּ/בַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֑ה וּ/בְ/נָפ֥וֹת דּ֖וֹר מִ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: v'l hmlkhym 'shr mtspvn bhr vb'rbh ngb khnrvt vbshplh vbnpvt dvr mym
verses.translation: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

verses.original: הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִ/מִּזְרָ֣ח וּ/מִ/יָּ֔ם וְ/הָ/אֱמֹרִ֧י וְ/הַ/חִתִּ֛י וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֥י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֖י בָּ/הָ֑ר וְ/הַֽ/חִוִּי֙ תַּ֣חַת חֶרְמ֔וֹן בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ הַ/מִּצְפָּֽה
verses.translit: hkhn'ny mmzrch vmym vh'mry vhchty vhprzy vhybvsy bhr vhchvy tcht chrmvn b'rts hmtsph
verses.translation: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֣וּ הֵ֗ם וְ/כָל מַֽחֲנֵי/הֶם֙ עִמָּ֔/ם עַם רָ֕ב כַּ/ח֛וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל שְׂפַת הַ/יָּ֖ם לָ/רֹ֑ב וְ/ס֥וּס וָ/רֶ֖כֶב רַב מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyts'v hm vkhl mchnyhm 'mm 'm rb khchvl 'shr 'l shpt hym lrb vsvs vrkhb rb m'd
verses.translation: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּ֣עֲד֔וּ כֹּ֖ל הַ/מְּלָכִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ וַ/יַּחֲנ֤וּ יַחְדָּו֙ אֶל מֵ֣י מֵר֔וֹם לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyv'dv khl hmlkhym h'lh vyb'v vychnv ychdv 'l my mrvm lhlchm 'm yshr'l
verses.translation: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֣ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ אַל תִּירָ֣א מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶם֒ כִּֽי מָחָ֞ר כָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/זֹּ֗את אָנֹכִ֞י נֹתֵ֧ן אֶת כֻּלָּ֛/ם חֲלָלִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶת סוּסֵי/הֶ֣ם תְּעַקֵּ֔ר וְ/אֶת מַרְכְּבֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhvsh' 'l tyr' mpnyhm khy mchr kh't hz't 'nkhy ntn 't khlm chllym lpny yshr'l 't svsyhm t'qr v't mrkhbtyhm tshrf b'sh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ וְ/כָל עַם֩ הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֨ה עִמּ֧/וֹ עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם עַל מֵ֥י מֵר֖וֹם פִּתְאֹ֑ם וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyb' yhvsh' vkhl 'm hmlchmh 'mv 'lyhm 'l my mrvm pt'm vyplv bhm
verses.translation: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֨/ם יְהוָ֥ה בְּ/יַֽד יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ וַ/יַּכּוּ/ם֒ וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפ֞וּ/ם עַד צִיד֣וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וְ/עַד֙ מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת מַ֔יִם וְ/עַד בִּקְעַ֥ת מִצְפֶּ֖ה מִזְרָ֑חָ/ה וַ/יַּכֻּ֕/ם עַד בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר לָ/הֶ֖ם שָׂרִֽיד
verses.translit: vytnm yhvh byd yshr'l vykhvm vyrdpvm 'd tsydvn rbh v'd mshrpvt mym v'd bq't mtsph mzrchh vykhm 'd blty hsh'yr lhm shryd
