verses.translation: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ לָ/הֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָֽמַר ל֖/וֹ יְהוָ֑ה אֶת סוּסֵי/הֶ֣ם עִקֵּ֔ר וְ/אֶת מַרְכְּבֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם שָׂרַ֥ף בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'sh lhm yhvsh' kh'shr 'mr lv yhvh 't svsyhm 'qr v't mrkhbtyhm shrf b'sh
verses.translation: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בָּ/עֵ֤ת הַ/הִיא֙ וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֣ד אֶת חָצ֔וֹר וְ/אֶת מַלְכָּ֖/הּ הִכָּ֣ה בֶ/חָ֑רֶב כִּֽי חָצ֣וֹר לְ/פָנִ֔ים הִ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ כָּל הַ/מַּמְלָכ֥וֹת הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyshb yhvsh' b't hhy' vylkhd 't chtsvr v't mlkhh hkhh bchrb khy chtsvr lpnym hy' r'sh khl hmmlkhvt h'lh
verses.translation: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

verses.original: וַ֠/יַּכּוּ אֶת כָּל הַ/נֶּ֨פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֤/הּ לְ/פִי חֶ֨רֶב֙ הַֽחֲרֵ֔ם לֹ֥א נוֹתַ֖ר כָּל נְשָׁמָ֑ה וְ/אֶת חָצ֖וֹר שָׂרַ֥ף בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vykhv 't khl hnpsh 'shr bh lpy chrb hchrm l' nvtr khl nshmh v't chtsvr shrf b'sh
verses.translation: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת כָּל עָרֵ֣י הַ/מְּלָכִֽים הָ֠/אֵלֶּה וְֽ/אֶת כָּל מַלְכֵי/הֶ֞ם לָכַ֧ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/ם לְ/פִי חֶ֖רֶב הֶחֱרִ֣ים אוֹתָ֑/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v't khl 'ry hmlkhym h'lh v't khl mlkhyhm lkhd yhvsh' vykhm lpy chrb hchrym 'vtm kh'shr tsvh mshh 'bd yhvh
verses.translation: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

verses.original: רַ֣ק כָּל הֶ/עָרִ֗ים הָ/עֹֽמְדוֹת֙ עַל תִּלָּ֔/ם לֹ֥א שְׂרָפָ֖/ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל זוּלָתִ֛י אֶת חָצ֥וֹר לְ/בַדָּ֖/הּ שָׂרַ֥ף יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ
verses.translit: rq khl h'rym h'mdvt 'l tlm l' shrpm yshr'l zvlty 't chtsvr lbdh shrf yhvsh'
verses.translation: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.

verses.original: וְ֠/כֹל שְׁלַ֞ל הֶ/עָרִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ וְ/הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה בָּזְז֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֣ק אֶֽת כָּל הָ/אָדָ֞ם הִכּ֣וּ לְ/פִי חֶ֗רֶב עַד הִשְׁמִדָ/ם֙ אוֹתָ֔/ם לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖ירוּ כָּל נְשָׁמָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl shll h'rym h'lh vhbhmh bzzv lhm bny yshr'l rq 't khl h'dm hkhv lpy chrb 'd hshmdm 'vtm l' hsh'yrv khl nshmh
verses.translation: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֔/וֹ כֵּן צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְ/כֵן֙ עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לֹֽא הֵסִ֣יר דָּבָ֔ר מִ/כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh 'bdv khn tsvh mshh 't yhvsh' vkhn 'shh yhvsh' l' hsyr dbr mkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֗את הָ/הָ֤ר וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/נֶּ֨גֶב֙ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/גֹּ֔שֶׁן וְ/אֶת הַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וְ/אֶת הָ/עֲרָבָ֑ה וְ/אֶת הַ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּ/שְׁפֵלָתֹֽ/ה
verses.translit: vyqch yhvsh' 't khl h'rts hz't hhr v't khl hngb v't khl 'rts hgshn v't hshplh v't h'rbh v't hr yshr'l vshplth
verses.translation: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;

verses.original: מִן הָ/הָ֤ר הֶֽ/חָלָק֙ הָ/עוֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֔יר וְ/עַד בַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּ/בִקְעַ֣ת הַ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן תַּ֖חַת הַר חֶרְמ֑וֹן וְ/אֵ֤ת כָּל מַלְכֵי/הֶם֙ לָכַ֔ד וַ/יַּכֵּ֖/ם וַ/יְמִיתֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: mn hhr hchlq h'vlh sh'yr v'd b'l gd bbq't hlbnvn tcht hr chrmvn v't khl mlkhyhm lkhd vykhm vymytm
verses.translation: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.

verses.original: יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת כָּל הַ/מְּלָכִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: ymym rbym 'shh yhvsh' 't khl hmlkhym h'lh mlchmh
verses.translation: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

verses.original: לֹֽא הָיְתָ֣ה עִ֗יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלִ֨ימָה֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלְתִּ֥י הַ/חִוִּ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן אֶת הַ/כֹּ֖ל לָקְח֥וּ בַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: l' hyth 'yr 'shr hshlymh 'l bny yshr'l blty hchvy yshby gb'vn 't hkhl lqchv bmlchmh
verses.translation: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה הָיְתָ֡ה לְ/חַזֵּ֣ק אֶת לִבָּ/ם֩ לִ/קְרַ֨את הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֤ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְמַ֣עַן הַֽחֲרִימָ֔/ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י הֱיוֹת לָ/הֶ֖ם תְּחִנָּ֑ה כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן הַשְׁמִידָ֔/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: khy m't yhvh hyth lchzq 't lbm lqr't hmlchmh 't yshr'l lm'n hchrymm lblty hyvt lhm tchnh khy lm'n hshmydm kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא וַ/יַּכְרֵ֤ת אֶת הָֽ/עֲנָקִים֙ מִן הָ/הָ֤ר מִן חֶבְרוֹן֙ מִן דְּבִ֣ר מִן עֲנָ֔ב וּ/מִ/כֹּל֙ הַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/מִ/כֹּ֖ל הַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עִם עָרֵי/הֶ֖ם הֶחֱרִימָ֥/ם יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ
verses.translit: vyb' yhvsh' b't hhy' vykhrt 't h'nqym mn hhr mn chbrvn mn dbr mn 'nb vmkhl hr yhvdh vmkhl hr yshr'l 'm 'ryhm hchrymm yhvsh'
verses.translation: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.

verses.original: לֹֽא נוֹתַ֣ר עֲנָקִ֔ים בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֗ק בְּ/עַזָּ֛ה בְּ/גַ֥ת וּ/בְ/אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד נִשְׁאָֽרוּ
verses.translit: l' nvtr 'nqym b'rts bny yshr'l rq b'zh bgt vb'shdvd nsh'rv
verses.translation: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֒ וַ/יִּתְּנָ/הּ֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ לְ/נַחֲלָ֧ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כְּ/מַחְלְקֹתָ֖/ם לְ/שִׁבְטֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הָ/אָ֥רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה מִ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch yhvsh' 't khl h'rts khkhl 'shr dbr yhvh 'l mshh vytnh yhvsh' lnchlh lyshr'l khmchlqtm lshbtyhm vh'rts shqth mmlchmh
verses.translation: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת אַרְצָ֔/ם בְּ/עֵ֥בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרְחָ֣/ה הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ מִ/נַּ֤חַל אַרְנוֹן֙ עַד הַ֣ר חֶרְמ֔וֹן וְ/כָל הָ/עֲרָבָ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: v'lh mlkhy h'rts 'shr hkhv bny yshr'l vyrshv 't 'rtsm b'br hyrdn mzrchh hshmsh mnchl 'rnvn 'd hr chrmvn vkhl h'rbh mzrchh
verses.translation: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

verses.original: סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י הַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן מֹשֵׁ֡ל מֵ/עֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל שְׂפַת נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְ/ת֤וֹךְ הַ/נַּ֨חַל֙ וַ/חֲצִ֣י הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד וְ/עַד֙ יַבֹּ֣ק הַ/נַּ֔חַל גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: sychvn mlkh h'mry hyvshb bchshbvn mshl m'rv'r 'shr 'l shpt nchl 'rnvn vtvkh hnchl vchtsy hgl'd v'd ybq hnchl gbvl bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עֲרָבָה֩ עַד יָ֨ם כִּנְר֜וֹת מִזְרָ֗חָ/ה וְ֠/עַד יָ֣ם הָ/עֲרָבָ֤ה יָם הַ/מֶּ֨לַח֙ מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמ֑וֹת וּ/מִ֨/תֵּימָ֔ן תַּ֖חַת אַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַ/פִּסְגָּֽה
verses.translit: vh'rbh 'd ym khnrvt mzrchh v'd ym h'rbh ym hmlch mzrchh drkh byt hyshmvt vmtymn tcht 'shdvt hpsgh
verses.translation: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:

verses.original: וּ/גְב֗וּל ע֚וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֔ן מִ/יֶּ֖תֶר הָ/רְפָאִ֑ים הַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/עַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּ/בְ/אֶדְרֶֽעִי
verses.translit: vgbvl 'vg mlkh hbshn mytr hrp'ym hyvshb b'shtrvt vb'dr'y
verses.translation: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

verses.original: וּ֠/מֹשֵׁל בְּ/הַ֨ר חֶרְמ֤וֹן וּ/בְ/סַלְכָה֙ וּ/בְ/כָל הַ/בָּשָׁ֔ן עַד גְּב֥וּל הַ/גְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְ/הַ/מַּעֲכָתִ֑י וַ/חֲצִי֙ הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד גְּב֖וּל סִיח֥וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vmshl bhr chrmvn vbslkhh vbkhl hbshn 'd gbvl hgshvry vhm'khty vchtsy hgl'd gbvl sychvn mlkh chshbvn
verses.translation: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֛ה וּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הִכּ֑וּ/ם וַֽ֠/יִּתְּנָ/הּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֜ה יְרֻשָּׁ֗ה לָ/רֻֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְ/לַ/גָּדִ֔י וְ/לַ/חֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֥בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: mshh 'bd yhvh vbny yshr'l hkhvm vytnh mshh 'bd yhvh yrshh lr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy shbt hmnshh
verses.translation: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אָ֡רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּ/עֵ֤בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ יָ֔מָּ/ה מִ/בַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּ/בִקְעַ֣ת הַ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן וְ/עַד הָ/הָ֥ר הֶ/חָלָ֖ק הָ/עֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֑ירָ/ה וַ/יִּתְּנָ֨/הּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לְ/שִׁבְטֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרֻשָּׁ֖ה כְּ/מַחְלְקֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'lh mlkhy h'rts 'shr hkhh yhvsh' vbny yshr'l b'br hyrdn ymh mb'l gd bbq't hlbnvn v'd hhr hchlq h'lh sh'yrh vytnh yhvsh' lshbty yshr'l yrshh khmchlqtm
verses.translation: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

verses.translit: bhr vbshplh vb'rbh vb'shdvt vbmdbr vbngb hchty h'mry vhkhn'ny hprzy hchvy vhybvsy
verses.translation: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיח֖וֹ אֶחָ֑ד מֶ֧לֶךְ הָ/עַ֛י אֲשֶׁר מִ/צַּ֥ד בֵּֽית אֵ֖ל אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh yrychv 'chd mlkh h'y 'shr mtsd byt 'l 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חֶבְר֖וֹן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh yrvshlm 'chd mlkh chbrvn 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ יַרְמוּת֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ לָכִ֖ישׁ אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh yrmvt 'chd mlkh lkhysh 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ עֶגְלוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ גֶּ֖זֶר אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh 'glvn 'chd mlkh gzr 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ דְּבִר֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ גֶּ֖דֶר אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh dbr 'chd mlkh gdr 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ חָרְמָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עֲרָ֖ד אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh chrmh 'chd mlkh 'rd 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ לִבְנָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עֲדֻלָּ֖ם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh lbnh 'chd mlkh 'dlm 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ מַקֵּדָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ בֵּֽית אֵ֖ל אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh mqdh 'chd mlkh byt 'l 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ תַּפּ֨וּחַ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חֵ֖פֶר אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh tpvch 'chd mlkh chpr 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲפֵק֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ לַ/שָּׁר֖וֹן אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh 'pq 'chd mlkh lshrvn 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ מָדוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חָצ֖וֹר אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh mdvn 'chd mlkh chtsvr 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ שִׁמְר֤וֹן מְראוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַכְשָׁ֖ף אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh shmrvn mr'vn 'chd mlkh 'khshf 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ תַּעְנַךְ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ מְגִדּ֖וֹ אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh t'nkh 'chd mlkh mgdv 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ קֶ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶֽלֶךְ יָקְנֳעָ֥ם לַ/כַּרְמֶ֖ל אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh qdsh 'chd mlkh yqn'm lkhrml 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ דּ֛וֹר לְ/נָפַ֥ת דּ֖וֹר אֶחָ֑ד מֶֽלֶךְ גּוֹיִ֥ם לְ/גִלְגָּ֖ל אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh dvr lnpt dvr 'chd mlkh gvym lglgl 'chd
verses.translation: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ תִּרְצָ֖ה אֶחָ֑ד כָּל מְלָכִ֖ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: mlkh trtsh 'chd khl mlkhym shlshym v'chd
verses.translation: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.

verses.original: וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּ/יָּמִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗י/ו אַתָּ֤ה זָקַ֨נְתָּה֙ בָּ֣אתָ בַ/יָּמִ֔ים וְ/הָ/אָ֛רֶץ נִשְׁאֲרָ֥ה הַרְבֵּֽה מְאֹ֖ד לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyhvsh' zqn b' bymym vy'mr yhvh 'lyv 'th zqnth b't bymym vh'rts nsh'rh hrbh m'd lrshth
verses.translation: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.

verses.original: זֹ֥את הָ/אָ֖רֶץ הַ/נִּשְׁאָ֑רֶת כָּל גְּלִיל֥וֹת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְ/כָל הַ/גְּשׁוּרִֽי
verses.translit: z't h'rts hnsh'rt khl glylvt hplshtym vkhl hgshvry
verses.translation: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,

verses.original: מִֽן הַ/שִּׁיח֞וֹר אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֗יִם וְ/עַ֨ד גְּב֤וּל עֶקְרוֹן֙ צָפ֔וֹנָ/ה לַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י תֵּחָשֵׁ֑ב חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים הָ/עַזָּתִ֤י וְ/הָ/אַשְׁדּוֹדִי֙ הָ/אֶשְׁקְלוֹנִ֣י הַ/גִּתִּ֔י וְ/הָ/עֶקְרוֹנִ֖י וְ/הָ/עַוִּֽים
verses.translit: mn hshychvr 'shr 'l pny mtsrym v'd gbvl 'qrvn tspvnh lkhn'ny tchshb chmsht srny plshtym h'zty vh'shdvdy h'shqlvny hgty vh'qrvny vh'vym
verses.translation: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:

verses.original: מִ/תֵּימָ֞ן כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֗י וּ/מְעָרָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַ/צִּידֹנִ֖ים עַד אֲפֵ֑קָ/ה עַ֖ד גְּב֥וּל הָ/אֱמֹרִֽי
verses.translit: mtymn khl 'rts hkhn'ny vm'rh 'shr ltsydnym 'd 'pqh 'd gbvl h'mry
verses.translation: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/גִּבְלִ֗י וְ/כָל הַ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מִ/בַּ֣עַל גָּ֔ד תַּ֖חַת הַר חֶרְמ֑וֹן עַ֖ד לְב֥וֹא חֲמָֽת
verses.translit: vh'rts hgbly vkhl hlbnvn mzrch hshmsh mb'l gd tcht hr chrmvn 'd lbv' chmt
verses.translation: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.

verses.original: כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ֠/הָר מִֽן הַ/לְּבָנ֞וֹן עַד מִשְׂרְפֹ֥ת מַ֨יִם֙ כָּל צִ֣ידֹנִ֔ים אָֽנֹכִי֙ אוֹרִישֵׁ֔/ם מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק הַפִּלֶ֤/הָ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּֽ/נַחֲלָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khl yshby hhr mn hlbnvn 'd mshrpt mym khl tsydnym 'nkhy 'vryshm mpny bny yshr'l rq hplh lyshr'l bnchlh kh'shr tsvytykh
verses.translation: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה חַלֵּ֞ק אֶת הָ/אָ֧רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֛את בְּ/נַחֲלָ֖ה לְ/תִשְׁעַ֣ת הַ/שְּׁבָטִ֑ים וַ/חֲצִ֖י הַ/שֵּׁ֥בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: v'th chlq 't h'rts hz't bnchlh ltsh't hshbtym vchtsy hshbt hmnshh
verses.translation: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

verses.original: עִמּ֗/וֹ הָ/רֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְ/הַ/גָּדִ֔י לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָ֑/ם אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן לָ/הֶ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּ/עֵ֤בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָ/הֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'mv hr'vbny vhgdy lqchv nchltm 'shr ntn lhm mshh b'br hyrdn mzrchh kh'shr ntn lhm mshh 'bd yhvh
verses.translation: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;

verses.original: מֵ/עֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל שְׂפַת נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְ/הָ/עִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּ/תוֹךְ הַ/נַּ֛חַל וְ/כָל הַ/מִּישֹׁ֥ר מֵידְבָ֖א עַד דִּיבֽוֹן
verses.translit: m'rv'r 'shr 'l shpt nchl 'rnvn vh'yr 'shr btvkh hnchl vkhl hmyshr mydb' 'd dybvn
verses.translation: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֗ל עָרֵי֙ סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּ/חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן עַד גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vkhl 'ry sychvn mlkh h'mry 'shr mlkh bchshbvn 'd gbvl bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.original: וְ/הַ/גִּלְעָ֞ד וּ/גְב֧וּל הַ/גְּשׁוּרִ֣י וְ/הַ/מַּעֲכָתִ֗י וְ/כֹ֨ל הַ֥ר חֶרְמ֛וֹן וְ/כָל הַ/בָּשָׁ֖ן עַד סַלְכָֽה
verses.translit: vhgl'd vgbvl hgshvry vhm'khty vkhl hr chrmvn vkhl hbshn 'd slkhh
verses.translation: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;

verses.original: כָּל מַמְלְכ֥וּת עוֹג֙ בַּ/בָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר מָלַ֥ךְ בְּ/עַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּ/בְ/אֶדְרֶ֑עִי ה֤וּא נִשְׁאַר֙ מִ/יֶּ֣תֶר הָ/רְפָאִ֔ים וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַ/יֹּרִשֵֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: khl mmlkhvt 'vg bbshn 'shr mlkh b'shtrvt vb'dr'y hv' nsh'r mytr hrp'ym vykhm mshh vyrshm
verses.translation: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א הוֹרִ֨ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת הַ/גְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּעֲכָתִ֑י וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב גְּשׁ֤וּר וּ/מַֽעֲכָת֙ בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vl' hvryshv bny yshr'l 't hgshvry v't hm'khty vyshb gshvr vm'kht bqrb yshr'l 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

verses.original: רַ֚ק לְ/שֵׁ֣בֶט הַ/לֵּוִ֔י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖ן נַחֲלָ֑ה אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: rq lshbt hlvy l' ntn nchlh 'shy yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hv' nchltv kh'shr dbr lv
verses.translation: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vytn mshh lmth bny r'vbn lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י לָ/הֶ֜ם הַ/גְּב֗וּל מֵ/עֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל שְׂפַת נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְ/הָ/עִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּ/תוֹךְ הַ/נַּ֛חַל וְ/כָל הַ/מִּישֹׁ֖ר עַל מֵידְבָֽא
verses.translit: vyhy lhm hgbvl m'rv'r 'shr 'l shpt nchl 'rnvn vh'yr 'shr btvkh hnchl vkhl hmyshr 'l mydb'
verses.translation: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;

verses.original: חֶשְׁבּ֥וֹן וְ/כָל עָרֶ֖י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/מִּישֹׁ֑ר דִּיבוֹן֙ וּ/בָמ֣וֹת בַּ֔עַל וּ/בֵ֖ית בַּ֥עַל מְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: chshbvn vkhl 'ryh 'shr bmyshr dybvn vbmvt b'l vbyt b'l m'vn
verses.translation: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

verses.original: וְ/יַ֥הְצָ/ה וּ/קְדֵמֹ֖ת וּ/מֵפָֽעַת
verses.translit: vyhtsh vqdmt vmp't
verses.translation: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

verses.original: וְ/קִרְיָתַ֣יִם וְ/שִׂבְמָ֔ה וְ/צֶ֥רֶת הַשַּׁ֖חַר בְּ/הַ֥ר הָ/עֵֽמֶק
verses.translit: vqrytym vshbmh vtsrt hshchr bhr h'mq
verses.translation: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,

verses.original: וּ/בֵ֥ית פְּע֛וֹר וְ/אַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַ/פִּסְגָּ֖ה וּ/בֵ֥ית הַיְשִׁמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbyt p'vr v'shdvt hpsgh vbyt hyshmvt
verses.translation: And Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַ/מִּישֹׁ֔ר וְ/כָֽל מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּ/חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֹת֣/וֹ וְ/אֶת נְשִׂיאֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן אֶת אֱוִ֤י וְ/אֶת רֶ֨קֶם֙ וְ/אֶת צ֤וּר וְ/אֶת חוּר֙ וְ/אֶת רֶ֔בַע נְסִיכֵ֣י סִיח֔וֹן יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vkhl 'ry hmyshr vkhl mmlkhvt sychvn mlkh h'mry 'shr mlkh bchshbvn 'shr hkhh mshh 'tv v't nshy'y mdyn 't 'vy v't rqm v't tsvr v't chvr v't rb' nsykhy sychvn yshby h'rts
verses.translation: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בִּלְעָ֥ם בֶּן בְּע֖וֹר הַ/קּוֹסֵ֑ם הָרְג֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב אֶל חַלְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v't bl'm bn b'vr hqvsm hrgv bny yshr'l bchrb 'l chllyhm
verses.translation: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י גְּבוּל֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּ/גְב֑וּל זֹ֣את נַחֲלַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי רְאוּבֵן֙ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔/ם הֶ/עָרִ֖ים וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vyhy gbvl bny r'vbn hyrdn vgbvl z't nchlt bny r'vbn lmshpchtm h'rym vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof . This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ לְ/מַטֵּה גָ֔ד לִ/בְנֵי גָ֖ד לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vytn mshh lmth gd lbny gd lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י לָ/הֶם֙ הַ/גְּב֔וּל יַעְזֵר֙ וְ/כָל עָרֵ֣י הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד וַ/חֲצִ֕י אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן עַד עֲרוֹעֵ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י רַבָּֽה
verses.translit: vyhy lhm hgbvl y'zr vkhl 'ry hgl'd vchtsy 'rts bny 'mvn 'd 'rv'r 'shr 'l pny rbh
verses.translation: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/חֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עַד רָמַ֥ת הַ/מִּצְפֶּ֖ה וּ/בְטֹנִ֑ים וּ/מִֽ/מַּחֲנַ֖יִם עַד גְּב֥וּל לִדְבִֽר
verses.translit: vmchshbvn 'd rmt hmtsph vbtnym vmmchnym 'd gbvl ldbr
verses.translation: And from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;

verses.original: וּ/בָ/עֵ֡מֶק בֵּ֣ית הָרָם֩ וּ/בֵ֨ית נִמְרָ֜ה וְ/סֻכּ֣וֹת וְ/צָפ֗וֹן יֶ֚תֶר מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּ/גְבֻ֑ל עַד קְצֵה֙ יָם כִּנֶּ֔רֶת עֵ֥בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: vb'mq byt hrm vbyt nmrh vskhvt vtspvn ytr mmlkhvt sychvn mlkh chshbvn hyrdn vgbl 'd qtsh ym khnrt 'br hyrdn mzrchh
verses.translation: And in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.

verses.original: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵי גָ֖ד לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם הֶ/עָרִ֖ים וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: z't nchlt bny gd lmshpchtm h'rym vchtsryhm
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לַ/חֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֗י לַ/חֲצִ֛י מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vytn mshh lchtsy shbt mnshh vyhy lchtsy mth bny mnshh lmshpchvtm
verses.translation: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗/ם מִ/מַּחֲנַ֨יִם כָּֽל הַ/בָּשָׁ֜ן כָּֽל מַמְלְכ֣וּת ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֗ן וְ/כָל חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/בָּשָׁ֖ן שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyhy gbvlm mmchnym khl hbshn khl mmlkhvt 'vg mlkh hbshn vkhl chvt y'yr 'shr bbshn shshym 'yr
verses.translation: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:

verses.original: וַ/חֲצִ֤י הַ/גִּלְעָד֙ וְ/עַשְׁתָּר֣וֹת וְ/אֶדְרֶ֔עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלְכ֥וּת ע֖וֹג בַּ/בָּשָׁ֑ן לִ/בְנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לַ/חֲצִ֥י בְנֵֽי מָכִ֖יר לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vchtsy hgl'd v'shtrvt v'dr'y 'ry mmlkhvt 'vg bbshn lbny mkhyr bn mnshh lchtsy bny mkhyr lmshpchvtm
verses.translation: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.

verses.original: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁר נִחַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/עַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֑ב מֵ/עֵ֛בֶר לְ/יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: 'lh 'shr nchl mshh b'rbvt mv'b m'br lyrdn yrychv mzrchh
verses.translation: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/שֵׁ֨בֶט֙ הַ/לֵּוִ֔י לֹֽא נָתַ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה נַחֲלָ֑ה יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָתָ֔/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vlshbt hlvy l' ntn mshh nchlh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hv' nchltm kh'shr dbr lhm
verses.translation: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁר נָחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִֽחֲל֜וּ אוֹתָ֗/ם אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֔וּן וְ/רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַ/מַּטּ֖וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'lh 'shr nchlv bny yshr'l b'rts khn'n 'shr nchlv 'vtm 'l'zr hkhhn vyhvsh' bn nvn vr'shy 'bvt hmtvt lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.

verses.original: בְּ/גוֹרַ֖ל נַחֲלָתָ֑/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְ/תִשְׁעַ֥ת הַ/מַּטּ֖וֹת וַ/חֲצִ֥י הַ/מַּטֶּֽה
verses.translit: bgvrl nchltm kh'shr tsvh yhvh byd mshh ltsh't hmtvt vchtsy hmth
verses.translation: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.

verses.original: כִּֽי נָתַ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה נַחֲלַ֨ת שְׁנֵ֤י הַ/מַּטּוֹת֙ וַ/חֲצִ֣י הַ/מַּטֶּ֔ה מֵ/עֵ֖בֶר לַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ/לַ֨/לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹֽא נָתַ֥ן נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy ntn mshh nchlt shny hmtvt vchtsy hmth m'br lyrdn vllvym l' ntn nchlh btvkhm
verses.translation: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.

verses.original: כִּֽי הָי֧וּ בְנֵֽי יוֹסֵ֛ף שְׁנֵ֥י מַטּ֖וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְ/אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְ/לֹֽא נָתְנוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק לַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם בָּ/אָ֗רֶץ כִּ֤י אִם עָרִים֙ לָ/שֶׁ֔בֶת וּ/מִ֨גְרְשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם לְ/מִקְנֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/לְ/קִנְיָנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy hyv bny yvsf shny mtvt mnshh v'prym vl' ntnv chlq llvym b'rts khy 'm 'rym lshbt vmgrshyhm lmqnyhm vlqnynm
verses.translation: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יַּחְלְק֖וּ אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh khn 'shv bny yshr'l vychlqv 't h'rts
verses.translation: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְּשׁ֨וּ בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֤ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ בַּ/גִּלְגָּ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו כָּלֵ֥ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֖ה הַ/קְּנִזִּ֑י אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֡עְתָּ אֶֽת הַ/דָּבָר֩ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַ֧ל אֹדוֹתַ֛/י וְ/עַ֥ל אֹדוֹתֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vygshv bny yhvdh 'l yhvsh' bglgl vy'mr 'lyv khlb bn ypnh hqnzy 'th yd't 't hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'l mshh 'ysh h'lhym 'l 'dvty v'l 'dvtykh bqdsh brn'
verses.translation: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.

verses.original: בֶּן אַרְבָּעִ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה אָנֹכִ֗י בִּ֠/שְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֥ה אֹתִ֛/י מִ/קָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לְ/רַגֵּ֣ל אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וָ/אָשֵׁ֤ב אֹת/וֹ֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר עִם לְבָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: bn 'rb'ym shnh 'nkhy bshlch mshh 'bd yhvh 'ty mqdsh brn' lrgl 't h'rts v'shb 'tv dbr kh'shr 'm lbby
verses.translation: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָל֣וּ עִמִּ֔/י הִמְסִ֖יו אֶת לֵ֣ב הָ/עָ֑ם וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתִי אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'chy 'shr 'lv 'my hmsyv 't lb h'm v'nkhy ml'ty 'chry yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/הוּא֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ אִם לֹ֗א הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דָּרְכָ֤ה רַגְלְ/ךָ֙ בָּ֔/הּ לְ/ךָ֨ תִֽהְיֶ֧ה לְ/נַחֲלָ֛ה וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֖י/ךָ עַד עוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתָ אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshb' mshh byvm hhv' l'mr 'm l' h'rts 'shr drkhh rglkh bh lkh thyh lnchlh vlbnykh 'd 'vlm khy ml't 'chry yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children’s for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּה֩ הֶחֱיָ֨ה יְהוָ֣ה אוֹתִ/י֮ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּר֒ זֶה֩ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנָ֗ה מֵ֠/אָז דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֥ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/עַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֣י הַ/יּ֔וֹם בֶּן חָמֵ֥שׁ וּ/שְׁמוֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: v'th hnh hchyh yhvh 'vty kh'shr dbr zh 'rb'ym vchmsh shnh m'z dbr yhvh 't hdbr hzh 'l mshh 'shr hlkh yshr'l bmdbr v'th hnh 'nkhy hyvm bn chmsh vshmvnym shnh
verses.translation: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.

verses.original: עוֹדֶ֨/נִּי הַ/יּ֜וֹם חָזָ֗ק כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/י֨וֹם שְׁלֹ֤חַ אוֹתִ/י֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּ/כֹ֥חִ/י אָ֖ז וּ/כְ/כֹ֣חִ/י עָ֑תָּה לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְ/לָ/צֵ֥את וְ/לָ/בֽוֹא
verses.translit: 'vdny hyvm chzq kh'shr byvm shlch 'vty mshh khkhchy 'z vkhkhchy 'th lmlchmh vlts't vlbv'
verses.translation: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה תְּנָ/ה לִּ/י֙ אֶת הָ/הָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא כִּ֣י אַתָּֽה שָׁמַעְתָּ֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא כִּֽי עֲנָקִ֣ים שָׁ֗ם וְ/עָרִים֙ גְּדֹל֣וֹת בְּצֻר֔וֹת אוּלַ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אוֹתִ/י֙ וְ/ה֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔י/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th tnh ly 't hhr hzh 'shr dbr yhvh byvm hhv' khy 'th shm't byvm hhv' khy 'nqym shm v'rym gdlvt btsrvt 'vly yhvh 'vty vhvrshtym kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְבָרְכֵ֖/הוּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת חֶבְר֛וֹן לְ/כָלֵ֥ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֖ה לְ/נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: vybrkhhv yhvsh' vytn 't chbrvn lkhlb bn ypnh lnchlh
verses.translation: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֣ן הָיְתָֽה חֶ֠בְרוֹן לְ/כָלֵ֨ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֤ה הַ/קְּנִזִּי֙ לְֽ/נַחֲלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִלֵּ֔א אַחֲרֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'l khn hyth chbrvn lkhlb bn ypnh hqnzy lnchlh 'd hyvm hzh y'n 'shr ml' 'chry yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֨ם חֶבְר֤וֹן לְ/פָנִים֙ קִרְיַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע הָ/אָדָ֧ם הַ/גָּד֛וֹל בָּ/עֲנָקִ֖ים ה֑וּא וְ/הָ/אָ֥רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה מִ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vshm chbrvn lpnym qryt 'rb' h'dm hgdvl b'nqym hv' vh'rts shqth mmlchmh
verses.translation: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י הַ/גּוֹרָ֗ל לְ/מַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם אֶל גְּב֨וּל אֱד֧וֹם מִדְבַּר צִ֛ן נֶ֖גְבָּ/ה מִ/קְצֵ֥ה תֵימָֽן
verses.translit: vyhy hgvrl lmth bny yhvdh lmshpchtm 'l gbvl 'dvm mdbr tsn ngbh mqtsh tymn
verses.translation: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י לָ/הֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִ/קְצֵ֖ה יָ֣ם הַ/מֶּ֑לַח מִן הַ/לָּשֹׁ֖ן הַ/פֹּנֶ֥ה נֶֽגְבָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy lhm gbvl ngb mqtsh ym hmlch mn hlshn hpnh ngbh
verses.translation: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:

verses.original: וְ֠/יָצָא אֶל מִ/נֶּ֜גֶב לְ/מַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְ/עָ֣בַר צִ֔נָ/ה וְ/עָלָ֥ה מִ/נֶּ֖גֶב לְ/קָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְ/עָבַ֤ר חֶצְרוֹן֙ וְ/עָלָ֣ה אַדָּ֔רָ/ה וְ/נָסַ֖ב הַ/קַּרְקָֽעָ/ה
verses.translit: vyts' 'l mngb lm'lh 'qrbym v'br tsnh v'lh mngb lqdsh brn' v'br chtsrvn v'lh 'drh vnsb hqrq'h
verses.translation: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:

verses.original: וְ/עָבַ֣ר עַצְמ֗וֹנָ/ה וְ/יָצָא֙ נַ֣חַל מִצְרַ֔יִם ו/היה וְ/הָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַ/גְּב֖וּל יָ֑מָּ/ה זֶה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב
verses.translit: v'br 'tsmvnh vyts' nchl mtsrym vhyh vhyv tts'vt hgbvl ymh zh yhyh lkhm gbvl ngb
verses.translation: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

verses.original: וּ/גְב֥וּל קֵ֨דְמָ/ה֙ יָ֣ם הַ/מֶּ֔לַח עַד קְצֵ֖ה הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וּ/גְב֞וּל לִ/פְאַ֤ת צָפ֨וֹנָ/ה֙ מִ/לְּשׁ֣וֹן הַ/יָּ֔ם מִ/קְצֵ֖ה הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vgbvl qdmh ym hmlch 'd qtsh hyrdn vgbvl lp't tspvnh mlshvn hym mqtsh hyrdn
verses.translation: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:

verses.original: וְ/עָלָ֤ה הַ/גְּבוּל֙ בֵּ֣ית חָגְלָ֔ה וְ/עָבַ֕ר מִ/צְּפ֖וֹן לְ/בֵ֣ית הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְ/עָלָ֣ה הַ/גְּב֔וּל אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן רְאוּבֵֽן
verses.translit: v'lh hgbvl byt chglh v'br mtspvn lbyt h'rbh v'lh hgbvl 'bn bhn bn r'vbn
verses.translation: And the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:

verses.original: וְ/עָלָ֨ה הַ/גְּב֥וּל דְּבִרָ/ה֮ מֵ/עֵ֣מֶק עָכוֹר֒ וְ/צָפ֜וֹנָ/ה פֹּנֶ֣ה אֶל הַ/גִּלְגָּ֗ל אֲשֶׁר נֹ֨כַח֙ לְ/מַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִ/נֶּ֖גֶב לַ/נָּ֑חַל וְ/עָבַ֤ר הַ/גְּבוּל֙ אֶל מֵי עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְ/הָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖י/ו אֶל עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל
verses.translit: v'lh hgbvl dbrh m'mq 'khvr vtspvnh pnh 'l hglgl 'shr nkhch lm'lh 'dmym 'shr mngb lnchl v'br hgbvl 'l my 'yn shmsh vhyv tts'tyv 'l 'yn rgl
verses.translation: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel:

verses.original: וְ/עָלָ֨ה הַ/גְּב֜וּל גֵּ֣י בֶן הִנֹּ֗ם אֶל כֶּ֤תֶף הַ/יְבוּסִי֙ מִ/נֶּ֔גֶב הִ֖יא יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/עָלָ֨ה הַ/גְּב֜וּל אֶל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/הָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר עַל פְּנֵ֤י גֵֽי הִנֹּם֙ יָ֔מָּ/ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּ/קְצֵ֥ה עֵֽמֶק רְפָאִ֖ים צָפֹֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: v'lh hgbvl gy bn hnm 'l khtf hybvsy mngb hy' yrvshlm v'lh hgbvl 'l r'sh hhr 'shr 'l pny gy hnm ymh 'shr bqtsh 'mq rp'ym tspnh
verses.translation: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:

verses.original: וְ/תָאַ֨ר הַ/גְּב֜וּל מֵ/רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/הָ֗ר אֶל מַעְיַן֙ מֵ֣י נֶפְתּ֔וֹחַ וְ/יָצָ֖א אֶל עָרֵ֣י הַר עֶפְר֑וֹן וְ/תָאַ֤ר הַ/גְּבוּל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔ה הִ֖יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים
verses.translit: vt'r hgbvl mr'sh hhr 'l m'yn my nptvch vyts' 'l 'ry hr 'prvn vt'r hgbvl b'lh hy' qryt y'rym
verses.translation: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim:

verses.original: וְ/נָסַב֩ הַ/גְּב֨וּל מִ/בַּעֲלָ֥ה יָ֨מָּ/ה֙ אֶל הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר וְ/עָבַ֕ר אֶל כֶּ֧תֶף הַר יְעָרִ֛ים מִ/צָּפ֖וֹנָ/ה הִ֣יא כְסָל֑וֹן וְ/יָרַ֥ד בֵּֽית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְ/עָבַ֥ר תִּמְנָֽה
verses.translit: vnsb hgbvl mb'lh ymh 'l hr sh'yr v'br 'l khtf hr y'rym mtspvnh hy' khslvn vyrd byt shmsh v'br tmnh
verses.translation: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֨א הַ/גְּב֜וּל אֶל כֶּ֣תֶף עֶקְרוֹן֮ צָפוֹנָ/ה֒ וְ/תָאַ֤ר הַ/גְּבוּל֙ שִׁכְּר֔וֹנָ/ה וְ/עָבַ֥ר הַר הַֽ/בַּעֲלָ֖ה וְ/יָצָ֣א יַבְנְאֵ֑ל וְ/הָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַ/גְּב֖וּל יָֽמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyts' hgbvl 'l khtf 'qrvn tspvnh vt'r hgbvl shkhrvnh v'br hr hb'lh vyts' ybn'l vhyv tts'vt hgbvl ymh
verses.translation: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

verses.original: וּ/גְב֣וּל יָ֔ם הַ/יָּ֥מָּ/ה הַ/גָּד֖וֹל וּ/גְב֑וּל זֶ֠ה גְּב֧וּל בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֛ה סָבִ֖יב לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vgbvl ym hymh hgdvl vgbvl zh gbvl bny yhvdh sbyb lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof . This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/כָלֵ֣ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֗ה נָ֤תַן חֵ֨לֶק֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽ/יהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע אֲבִ֥י הָ/עֲנָ֖ק הִ֥יא חֶבְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vlkhlb bn ypnh ntn chlq btvkh bny yhvdh 'l py yhvh lyhvsh' 't qryt 'rb' 'by h'nq hy' chbrvn
verses.translation: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤רֶשׁ מִ/שָּׁם֙ כָּלֵ֔ב אֶת שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הָ/עֲנָ֑ק אֶת שֵׁשַׁ֤י וְ/אֶת אֲחִימַן֙ וְ/אֶת תַּלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָ/עֲנָֽק
verses.translit: vyrsh mshm khlb 't shlvshh bny h'nq 't shshy v't 'chymn v't tlmy ylydy h'nq
verses.translation: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל מִ/שָּׁ֔ם אֶל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּבִ֑ר וְ/שֵׁם דְּבִ֥ר לְ/פָנִ֖ים קִרְיַת סֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: vy'l mshm 'l yshby dbr vshm dbr lpnym qryt spr
verses.translation: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר כָּלֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּ֥ה אֶת קִרְיַת סֵ֖פֶר וּ/לְכָדָ֑/הּ וְ/נָתַ֥תִּי ל֛/וֹ אֶת עַכְסָ֥ה בִתִּ֖/י לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr khlb 'shr ykhh 't qryt spr vlkhdh vntty lv 't 'khsh bty l'shh
verses.translation: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדָ֛/הּ עָתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן קְנַ֖ז אֲחִ֣י כָלֵ֑ב וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֛/וֹ אֶת עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vylkhdh 'tny'l bn qnz 'chy khlb vytn lv 't 'khsh btv l'shh
verses.translation: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בְּ/בוֹאָ֗/הּ וַ/תְּסִיתֵ֨/הוּ֙ לִ/שְׁא֤וֹל מֵֽ/אֵת אָבִ֨י/הָ֙ שָׂדֶ֔ה וַ/תִּצְנַ֖ח מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/חֲמ֑וֹר וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר לָ֥/הּ כָּלֵ֖ב מַה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyhy bbv'h vtsythv lsh'vl m't 'byh shdh vttsnch m'l hchmvr vy'mr lh khlb mh lkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as she came unto him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֜אמֶר תְּנָ/ה לִּ֣/י בְרָכָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ הַ/נֶּ֨גֶב֙ נְתַתָּ֔/נִי וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ה לִ֖/י גֻּלֹּ֣ת מָ֑יִם וַ/יִּתֶּן לָ֗/הּ אֵ֚ת גֻּלֹּ֣ת עִלִּיּ֔וֹת וְ/אֵ֖ת גֻּלֹּ֥ת תַּחְתִּיּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vt'mr tnh ly brkhh khy 'rts hngb nttny vntth ly glt mym vytn lh 't glt 'lyvt v't glt tchtyvt
verses.translation: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי יְהוּדָ֖ה לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bny yhvdh lmshpchtm
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֣וּ הֶ/עָרִ֗ים מִ/קְצֵה֙ לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל גְּב֥וּל אֱד֖וֹם בַּ/נֶּ֑גְבָּ/ה קַבְצְאֵ֥ל וְ/עֵ֖דֶר וְ/יָגֽוּר
verses.translit: vyhyv h'rym mqtsh lmth bny yhvdh 'l gbvl 'dvm bngbh qbts'l v'dr vygvr
verses.translation: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

verses.original: וְ/קִינָ֥ה וְ/דִֽימוֹנָ֖ה וְ/עַדְעָדָֽה
verses.translit: vqynh vdymvnh v'd'dh
verses.translation: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

verses.original: וְ/קֶ֥דֶשׁ וְ/חָצ֖וֹר וְ/יִתְנָֽן
verses.translit: vqdsh vchtsvr vytnn
verses.translation: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

verses.original: זִ֥יף וָ/טֶ֖לֶם וּ/בְעָלֽוֹת
verses.translit: zyf vtlm vb'lvt
verses.translation: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

verses.original: וְ/חָצ֤וֹר חֲדַתָּה֙ וּ/קְרִיּ֔וֹת חֶצְר֖וֹן הִ֥יא חָצֽוֹר
verses.translit: vchtsvr chdth vqryvt chtsrvn hy' chtsvr
verses.translation: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,

verses.original: אֲמָ֥ם וּ/שְׁמַ֖ע וּ/מוֹלָדָֽה
verses.translit: 'mm vshm' vmvldh
verses.translation: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

verses.original: וַ/חֲצַ֥ר גַּדָּ֛ה וְ/חֶשְׁמ֖וֹן וּ/בֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט
verses.translit: vchtsr gdh vchshmvn vbyt plt
verses.translation: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,

verses.original: וַ/חֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּ/בְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וּ/בִזְיוֹתְיָֽה
verses.translit: vchtsr shv'l vb'r shb' vbzyvtyh
verses.translation: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,

verses.original: בַּעֲלָ֥ה וְ/עִיִּ֖ים וָ/עָֽצֶם
verses.translit: b'lh v'yym v'tsm
verses.translation: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

verses.original: וְ/אֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּ/כְסִ֖יל וְ/חָרְמָֽה
verses.translit: v'ltvld vkhsyl vchrmh
verses.translation: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

verses.original: וְ/צִֽקְלַ֥ג וּ/מַדְמַנָּ֖ה וְ/סַנְסַנָּֽה
verses.translit: vtsqlg vmdmnh vsnsnh
verses.translation: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

verses.original: וּ/לְבָא֥וֹת וְ/שִׁלְחִ֖ים וְ/עַ֣יִן וְ/רִמּ֑וֹן כָּל עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וָ/תֵ֖שַׁע וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vlb'vt vshlchym v'yn vrmvn khl 'rym 'shrym vtsh' vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:

verses.original: בַּ/שְּׁפֵלָ֑ה אֶשְׁתָּא֥וֹל וְ/צָרְעָ֖ה וְ/אַשְׁנָֽה
verses.translit: bshplh 'sht'vl vtsr'h v'shnh
verses.translation: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

verses.original: וְ/זָנ֨וֹחַ֙ וְ/עֵ֣ין גַּנִּ֔ים תַּפּ֖וּחַ וְ/הָ/עֵינָֽם
verses.translit: vznvch v'yn gnym tpvch vh'ynm
verses.translation: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

verses.original: יַרְמוּת֙ וַ/עֲדֻלָּ֔ם שׂוֹכֹ֖ה וַ/עֲזֵקָֽה
verses.translit: yrmvt v'dlm shvkhh v'zqh
verses.translation: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

verses.original: וְ/שַׁעֲרַ֨יִם֙ וַ/עֲדִיתַ֔יִם וְ/הַ/גְּדֵרָ֖ה וּ/גְדֵרֹתָ֑יִם עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּֽע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vsh'rym v'dytym vhgdrh vgdrtym 'rym 'rb' 'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:

verses.original: צְנָ֥ן וַ/חֲדָשָׁ֖ה וּ/מִגְדַּל גָּֽד
verses.translit: tsnn vchdshh vmgdl gd
verses.translation: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

verses.original: וְ/דִלְעָ֥ן וְ/הַ/מִּצְפֶּ֖ה וְ/יָקְתְאֵֽל
verses.translit: vdl'n vhmtsph vyqt'l
verses.translation: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

verses.original: לָכִ֥ישׁ וּ/בָצְקַ֖ת וְ/עֶגְלֽוֹן
verses.translit: lkhysh vbtsqt v'glvn
verses.translation: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

verses.original: וְ/כַבּ֥וֹן וְ/לַחְמָ֖ס וְ/כִתְלִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vkhbvn vlchms vkhtlysh
verses.translation: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

verses.original: וּ/גְדֵר֕וֹת בֵּית דָּג֥וֹן וְ/נַעֲמָ֖ה וּ/מַקֵּדָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vgdrvt byt dgvn vn'mh vmqdh 'rym shsh 'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:

verses.original: לִבְנָ֥ה וָ/עֶ֖תֶר וְ/עָשָֽׁן
verses.translit: lbnh v'tr v'shn
verses.translation: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

verses.original: וְ/יִפְתָּ֥ח וְ/אַשְׁנָ֖ה וּ/נְצִֽיב
verses.translit: vyptch v'shnh vntsyb
verses.translation: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

verses.original: וּ/קְעִילָ֥ה וְ/אַכְזִ֖יב וּ/מָֽרֵאשָׁ֑ה עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vq'ylh v'khzyb vmr'shh 'rym tsh' vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:

verses.original: עֶקְר֥וֹן וּ/בְנֹתֶ֖י/הָ וַ/חֲצֵרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: 'qrvn vbntyh vchtsryh
verses.translation: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:

verses.original: מֵ/עֶקְר֖וֹן וָ/יָ֑מָּ/ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר עַל יַ֥ד אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: m'qrvn vymh khl 'shr 'l yd 'shdvd vchtsryhn
verses.translation: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:

verses.original: אַשְׁדּ֞וֹד בְּנוֹתֶ֣י/הָ וַ/חֲצֵרֶ֗י/הָ עַזָּ֥ה בְּנוֹתֶ֥י/הָ וַ/חֲצֵרֶ֖י/הָ עַד נַ֣חַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הַ/יָּ֥ם ה/גבול הַ/גָּד֖וֹל וּ/גְבֽוּל
verses.translit: 'shdvd bnvtyh vchtsryh 'zh bnvtyh vchtsryh 'd nchl mtsrym vhym hgbvl hgdvl vgbvl
verses.translation: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:

verses.original: וּ/בָ/הָ֑ר שָׁמִ֥יר וְ/יַתִּ֖יר וְ/שׂוֹכֹֽה
verses.translit: vbhr shmyr vytyr vshvkhh
verses.translation: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

verses.original: וְ/דַנָּ֥ה וְ/קִרְיַת סַנָּ֖ה הִ֥יא דְבִֽר
verses.translit: vdnh vqryt snh hy' dbr
verses.translation: And Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which is Debir,

verses.original: וַ/עֲנָ֥ב וְ/אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖ה וְ/עָנִֽים
verses.translit: v'nb v'shtmh v'nym
verses.translation: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

verses.original: וְ/גֹ֥שֶׁן וְ/חֹלֹ֖ן וְ/גִלֹ֑ה עָרִ֥ים אַֽחַת עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vgshn vchln vglh 'rym 'cht 'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:

verses.original: אֲרַ֥ב וְ/רוּמָ֖ה וְ/אֶשְׁעָֽן
verses.translit: 'rb vrvmh v'sh'n
verses.translation: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

verses.original: ו/ינים וְ/יָנ֥וּם וּ/בֵית תַּפּ֖וּחַ וַ/אֲפֵֽקָה
verses.translit: vynym vynvm vbyt tpvch v'pqh
verses.translation: And Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

verses.original: וְ/חֻמְטָ֗ה וְ/קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן וְ/צִיעֹ֑ר עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vchmth vqryt 'rb' hy' chbrvn vtsy'r 'rym tsh' vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:

verses.original: מָע֥וֹן כַּרְמֶ֖ל וָ/זִ֥יף וְ/יוּטָּֽה
verses.translit: m'vn khrml vzyf vyvth
verses.translation: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

verses.original: וְ/יִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְ/יָקְדְעָ֖ם וְ/זָנֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: vyzr''l vyqd'm vznvch
verses.translation: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

verses.original: הַ/קַּ֖יִן גִּבְעָ֣ה וְ/תִמְנָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: hqyn gb'h vtmnh 'rym 'shr vchtsryhn
verses.translation: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:

verses.original: חַלְח֥וּל בֵּֽית צ֖וּר וּ/גְדֽוֹר
verses.translit: chlchvl byt tsvr vgdvr
verses.translation: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

verses.original: וּ/מַעֲרָ֥ת וּ/בֵית עֲנ֖וֹת וְ/אֶלְתְּקֹ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vm'rt vbyt 'nvt v'ltqn 'rym shsh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:

verses.original: קִרְיַת בַּ֗עַל הִ֛יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים וְ/הָֽ/רַבָּ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שְׁתַּ֖יִם וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: qryt b'l hy' qryt y'rym vhrbh 'rym shtym vchtsryhn
verses.translation: Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:

verses.original: בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר בֵּ֚ית הָעֲרָבָ֔ה מִדִּ֖ין וּ/סְכָכָֽה
verses.translit: bmdbr byt h'rbh mdyn vskhkhh
verses.translation: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נִּבְשָׁ֥ן וְ/עִיר הַ/מֶּ֖לַח וְ/עֵ֣ין גֶּ֑דִי עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vhnbshn v'yr hmlch v'yn gdy 'rym shsh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/יְבוּסִי֙ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לֹֽא יוכלו יָכְל֥וּ בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֖ה לְ/הֽוֹרִישָׁ֑/ם וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב הַ/יְבוּסִ֜י אֶת בְּנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v't hybvsy yvshby yrvshlm l' yvkhlv ykhlv bny yhvdh lhvryshm vyshb hybvsy 't bny yhvdh byrvshlm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א הַ/גּוֹרָ֜ל לִ/בְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ מִ/יַּרְדֵּ֣ן יְרִיח֔וֹ לְ/מֵ֥י יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָ֑חָ/ה הַ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר עֹלֶ֧ה מִ/ירִיח֛וֹ בָּ/הָ֖ר בֵּֽית אֵֽל
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl lbny yvsf myrdn yrychv lmy yrychv mzrchh hmdbr 'lh myrychv bhr byt 'l
verses.translation: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth-el,

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֥א מִ/בֵּֽית אֵ֖ל ל֑וּזָ/ה וְ/עָבַ֛ר אֶל גְּב֥וּל הָ/אַרְכִּ֖י עֲטָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyts' mbyt 'l lvzh v'br 'l gbvl h'rkhy 'trvt
verses.translation: And goeth out from Beth-el to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,

verses.original: וְ/יָֽרַד יָ֜מָּ/ה אֶל גְּב֣וּל הַ/יַּפְלֵטִ֗י עַ֣ד גְּב֧וּל בֵּית חוֹרֹ֛ן תַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְ/עַד גָּ֑זֶר וְ/הָי֥וּ תצאת/ו תֹצְאֹתָ֖י/ו יָֽמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyrd ymh 'l gbvl hyplty 'd gbvl byt chvrn tchtvn v'd gzr vhyv tts'tv tts'tyv ymh
verses.translation: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.

verses.original: וַ/יִּנְחֲל֥וּ בְנֵי יוֹסֵ֖ף מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה וְ/אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vynchlv bny yvsf mnshh v'prym
verses.translation: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל בְּנֵֽי אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל נַחֲלָתָ/ם֙ מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַד בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyhy gbvl bny 'prym lmshpchtm vyhy gbvl nchltm mzrchh 'trvt 'dr 'd byt chvrn 'lyvn
verses.translation: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper;

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֨א הַ/גְּב֜וּל הַ/יָּ֗מָּ/ה הַֽ/מִּכְמְתָת֙ מִ/צָּפ֔וֹן וְ/נָסַ֧ב הַ/גְּב֛וּל מִזְרָ֖חָ/ה תַּאֲנַ֣ת שִׁלֹ֑ה וְ/עָבַ֣ר אוֹת֔/וֹ מִ/מִּזְרַ֖ח יָנֽוֹחָ/ה
verses.translit: vyts' hgbvl hymh hmkhmtt mtspvn vnsb hgbvl mzrchh t'nt shlh v'br 'vtv mmzrch ynvchh
verses.translation: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;

verses.original: וְ/יָרַ֥ד מִ/יָּנ֖וֹחָ/ה עֲטָר֣וֹת וְ/נַעֲרָ֑תָ/ה וּ/פָגַע֙ בִּֽ/ירִיח֔וֹ וְ/יָצָ֖א הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyrd mynvchh 'trvt vn'rth vpg' byrychv vyts' hyrdn
verses.translation: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

verses.original: מִ/תַּפּ֜וּחַ יֵלֵ֨ךְ הַ/גְּב֥וּל יָ֨מָּ/ה֙ נַ֣חַל קָנָ֔ה וְ/הָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖י/ו הַ/יָּ֑מָּ/ה זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: mtpvch ylkh hgbvl ymh nchl qnh vhyv tts'tyv hymh z't nchlt mth bny 'prym lmshpchtm
verses.translation: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.

verses.original: וְ/הֶ/עָרִ֗ים הַ/מִּבְדָּלוֹת֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כָּֽל הֶ/עָרִ֖ים וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vh'rym hmbdlvt lbny 'prym btvkh nchlt bny mnshh khl h'rym vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א הוֹרִ֔ישׁוּ אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י הַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּ/גָ֑זֶר וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֜י בְּ/קֶ֤רֶב אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וַ/יְהִ֖י לְ/מַס עֹבֵֽד
verses.translit: vl' hvryshv 't hkhn'ny hyvshb bgzr vyshb hkhn'ny bqrb 'prym 'd hyvm hzh vyhy lms 'bd
verses.translation: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י הַ/גּוֹרָל֙ לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּי ה֖וּא בְּכ֣וֹר יוֹסֵ֑ף לְ/מָכִיר֩ בְּכ֨וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה אֲבִ֣י הַ/גִּלְעָ֗ד כִּ֣י ה֤וּא הָיָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽ/יְהִי ל֖/וֹ הַ/גִּלְעָ֥ד וְ/הַ/בָּשָֽׁן
verses.translit: vyhy hgvrl lmth mnshh khy hv' bkhvr yvsf lmkhyr bkhvr mnshh 'by hgl'd khy hv' hyh 'ysh mlchmh vyhy lv hgl'd vhbshn
verses.translation: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

verses.original: וַ֠/יְהִי לִ/בְנֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה הַ/נּוֹתָרִים֮ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ/ם֒ לִ/בְנֵ֨י אֲבִיעֶ֜זֶר וְ/לִ/בְנֵי חֵ֗לֶק וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֤י אַשְׂרִיאֵל֙ וְ/לִ/בְנֵי שֶׁ֔כֶם וְ/לִ/בְנֵי חֵ֖פֶר וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אֵ֠לֶּה בְּנֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה בֶּן יוֹסֵ֛ף הַ/זְּכָרִ֖ים לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy lbny mnshh hnvtrym lmshpchtm lbny 'by'zr vlbny chlq vlbny 'shry'l vlbny shkhm vlbny chpr vlbny shmyd' 'lh bny mnshh bn yvsf hzkhrym lmshpchtm
verses.translation: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/צְלָפְחָד֩ בֶּן חֵ֨פֶר בֶּן גִּלְעָ֜ד בֶּן מָכִ֣יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא הָ֥יוּ ל֛/וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם בָּנ֑וֹת וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔י/ו מַחְלָ֣ה וְ/נֹעָ֔ה חָגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְ/תִרְצָֽה
verses.translit: vltslpchd bn chpr bn gl'd bn mkhyr bn mnshh l' hyv lv bnym khy 'm bnvt v'lh shmvt bntyv mchlh vn'h chglh mlkhh vtrtsh
verses.translation: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרַ֡בְנָה לִ/פְנֵי֩ אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֗וּן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/נְּשִׂיאִים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָֽ/תֶת לָ֥/נוּ נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ אַחֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן לָ/הֶ֜ם אֶל פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ נַֽחֲלָ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֥י אֲבִי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vtqrbnh lpny 'l'zr hkhhn vlpny yhvsh' bn nvn vlpny hnshy'ym l'mr yhvh tsvh 't mshh ltt lnv nchlh btvkh 'chynv vytn lhm 'l py yhvh nchlh btvkh 'chy 'byhn
verses.translation: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ חַבְלֵֽי מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה לְ/בַ֞ד מֵ/אֶ֤רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָד֙ וְ/הַ/בָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵ/עֵ֥בֶר לַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyplv chbly mnshh 'shrh lbd m'rts hgl'd vhbshn 'shr m'br lyrdn
verses.translation: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;

verses.original: כִּ֚י בְּנ֣וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה נָחֲל֥וּ נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ בָּנָ֑י/ו וְ/אֶ֨רֶץ֙ הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד הָיְתָ֥ה לִ/בְנֵֽי מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה הַ/נּֽוֹתָרִֽים
verses.translit: khy bnvt mnshh nchlv nchlh btvkh bnyv v'rts hgl'd hyth lbny mnshh hnvtrym
verses.translation: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י גְבוּל מְנַשֶּׁה֙ מֵֽ/אָשֵׁ֔ר הַֽ/מִּכְמְתָ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם וְ/הָלַ֤ךְ הַ/גְּבוּל֙ אֶל הַ/יָּמִ֔ין אֶל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י עֵ֥ין תַּפּֽוּחַ
verses.translit: vyhy gbvl mnshh m'shr hmkhmtt 'shr 'l pny shkhm vhlkh hgbvl 'l hymyn 'l yshby 'yn tpvch
verses.translation: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

verses.original: לִ/מְנַשֶּׁ֕ה הָיְתָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ תַּפּ֑וּחַ וְ/תַפּ֛וּחַ אֶל גְּב֥וּל מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לִ/בְנֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: lmnshh hyth 'rts tpvch vtpvch 'l gbvl mnshh lbny 'prym
verses.translation: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;

verses.original: וְ/יָרַ֣ד הַ/גְּבוּל֩ נַ֨חַל קָנָ֜ה נֶ֣גְבָּ/ה לַ/נַּ֗חַל עָרִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ לְ/אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ עָרֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וּ/גְב֤וּל מְנַשֶּׁה֙ מִ/צְּפ֣וֹן לַ/נַּ֔חַל וַ/יְהִ֥י תֹצְאֹתָ֖י/ו הַ/יָּֽמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyrd hgbvl nchl qnh ngbh lnchl 'rym h'lh l'prym btvkh 'ry mnshh vgbvl mnshh mtspvn lnchl vyhy tts'tyv hymh
verses.translation: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:

verses.original: נֶ֣גְבָּ/ה לְ/אֶפְרַ֗יִם וְ/צָפ֨וֹנָ/ה֙ לִ/מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה וַ/יְהִ֥י הַ/יָּ֖ם גְּבוּל֑/וֹ וּ/בְ/אָשֵׁר֙ יִפְגְּע֣וּ/ן מִ/צָּפ֔וֹן וּ/בְ/יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר מִ/מִּזְרָֽח
verses.translit: ngbh l'prym vtspvnh lmnshh vyhy hym gbvlv vb'shr ypg'vn mtspvn vbyshshkhr mmzrch
verses.translation: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י לִ/מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה בְּ/יִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּ/בְ/אָשֵׁ֗ר בֵּית שְׁאָ֣ן וּ֠/בְנוֹתֶי/הָ וְ/יִבְלְעָ֨ם וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֜י/הָ וְֽ/אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֧י דֹ֣אר וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֗י/הָ וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֤י עֵֽין דֹּר֙ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֤י תַעְנַךְ֙ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֥י מְגִדּ֖וֹ וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֑י/הָ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַ/נָּֽפֶת
verses.translit: vyhy lmnshh byshshkhr vb'shr byt sh'n vbnvtyh vybl'm vbnvtyh v't yshby d'r vbnvtyh vyshby 'yn dr vbntyh vyshby t'nkh vbntyh vyshby mgdv vbnvtyh shlsht hnpt
verses.translation: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א יָכְלוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְ/הוֹרִ֖ישׁ אֶת הֶֽ/עָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יּ֨וֹאֶל֙ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י לָ/שֶׁ֖בֶת בָּ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vl' ykhlv bny mnshh lhvrysh 't h'rym h'lh vyv'l hkhn'ny lshbt b'rts hz't
verses.translation: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֗י כִּ֤י חָֽזְקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּתְּנ֥וּ אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י לָ/מַ֑ס וְ/הוֹרֵ֖שׁ לֹ֥א הוֹרִישֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khy chzqv bny yshr'l vytnv 't hkhn'ny lms vhvrsh l' hvryshv
verses.translation: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְדַבְּרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מַדּוּעַ֩ נָתַ֨תָּה לִּ֜/י נַחֲלָ֗ה גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ וְ/חֶ֣בֶל אֶחָ֔ד וַֽ/אֲנִ֣י עַם רָ֔ב עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר עַד כֹּ֖ה בֵּֽרְכַ֥/נִי יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vydbrv bny yvsf 't yhvsh' l'mr mdv' ntth ly nchlh gvrl 'chd vchbl 'chd v'ny 'm rb 'd 'shr 'd khh brkhny yhvh
verses.translation: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ אִם עַם רַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ עֲלֵ֣ה לְ/ךָ֣ הַ/יַּ֔עְרָ/ה וּ/בֵרֵאתָ֤ לְ/ךָ֙ שָׁ֔ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/פְּרִזִּ֖י וְ/הָֽ/רְפָאִ֑ים כִּֽי אָ֥ץ לְ/ךָ֖ הַר אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm yhvsh' 'm 'm rb 'th 'lh lkh hy'rh vbr't lkh shm b'rts hprzy vhrp'ym khy 'ts lkh hr 'prym
verses.translation: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לֹֽא יִמָּ֥צֵא לָ֖/נוּ הָ/הָ֑ר וְ/רֶ֣כֶב בַּרְזֶ֗ל בְּ/כָל הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֣ב בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ הָ/עֵ֔מֶק לַֽ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּ/בֵית שְׁאָן֙ וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/לַֽ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל
verses.translit: vy'mrv bny yvsf l' ymts' lnv hhr vrkhb brzl bkhl hkhn'ny hyshb b'rts h'mq l'shr bbyt sh'n vbnvtyh vl'shr b'mq yzr''l
verses.translation: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Beth-shean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף לְ/אֶפְרַ֥יִם וְ/לִ/מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר עַם רַ֣ב אַתָּ֗ה וְ/כֹ֤חַ גָּדוֹל֙ לָ֔/ךְ לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ גּוֹרָ֥ל אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l byt yvsf l'prym vlmnshh l'mr 'm rb 'th vkhch gdvl lkh l' yhyh lkh gvrl 'chd
verses.translation: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ֤ר יִֽהְיֶה לָּ/ךְ֙ כִּֽי יַ֣עַר ה֔וּא וּ/בֵ֣רֵאת֔/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֑י/ו כִּֽי תוֹרִ֣ישׁ אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֗י כִּ֣י רֶ֤כֶב בַּרְזֶל֙ ל֔/וֹ כִּ֥י חָזָ֖ק הֽוּא
verses.translit: khy hr yhyh lkh khy y'r hv' vbr'tv vhyh lkh tts'tyv khy tvrysh 't hkhn'ny khy rkhb brzl lv khy chzq hv'
verses.translation: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ כָּל עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֥ינוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/הָ/אָ֥רֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁ֖ה לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqhlv khl 'dt bny yshr'l shlh vyshkhynv shm 't 'hl mv'd vh'rts nkhbshh lpnyhm
verses.translation: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּֽתְרוּ֙ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא חָלְק֖וּ אֶת נַֽחֲלָתָ֑/ם שִׁבְעָ֖ה שְׁבָטִֽים
verses.translit: vyvtrv bbny yshr'l 'shr l' chlqv 't nchltm shb'h shbtym
verses.translation: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַד אָ֨נָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם מִתְרַפִּ֔ים לָ/בוֹא֙ לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָ/כֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l bny yshr'l 'd 'nh 'tm mtrpym lbv' lrsht 't h'rts 'shr ntn lkhm yhvh 'lhy 'bvtykhm
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

verses.original: הָב֥וּ לָ/כֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַ/שָּׁ֑בֶט וְ/אֶשְׁלָחֵ֗/ם וְ/יָקֻ֜מוּ וְ/יִֽתְהַלְּכ֥וּ בָ/אָ֛רֶץ וְ/יִכְתְּב֥וּ אוֹתָ֛/הּ לְ/פִ֥י נַֽחֲלָתָ֖/ם וְ/יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: hbv lkhm shlshh 'nshym lshbt v'shlchm vyqmv vythlkhv b'rts vykhtbv 'vth lpy nchltm vyb'v 'ly
verses.translation: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.

verses.original: וְ/הִֽתְחַלְּק֥וּ אֹתָ֖/הּ לְ/שִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֑ים יְהוּדָ֞ה יַעֲמֹ֤ד עַל גְּבוּל/וֹ֙ מִ/נֶּ֔גֶב וּ/בֵ֥ית יוֹסֵ֛ף יַעַמְד֥וּ עַל גְּבוּלָ֖/ם מִ/צָּפֽוֹן
verses.translit: vhtchlqv 'th lshb'h chlqym yhvdh y'md 'l gbvlv mngb vbyt yvsf y'mdv 'l gbvlm mtspvn
verses.translation: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֞ם תִּכְתְּב֤וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֔ים וַֽ/הֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖/י הֵ֑נָּה וְ/יָרִ֨יתִי לָ/כֶ֤ם גּוֹרָל֙ פֹּ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v'tm tkhtbv 't h'rts shb'h chlqym vhb'tm 'ly hnh vyryty lkhm gvrl ph lpny yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

verses.original: כִּ֠י אֵֽין חֵ֤לֶק לַ/לְוִיִּם֙ בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֔ם כִּֽי כְהֻנַּ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה נַחֲלָת֑/וֹ וְ/גָ֡ד וּ/רְאוּבֵ֡ן וַ/חֲצִי֩ שֵׁ֨בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗/ם מֵ/עֵ֤בֶר לַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָ/הֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'yn chlq llvym bqrbkhm khy khhnt yhvh nchltv vgd vr'vbn vchtsy shbt hmnshh lqchv nchltm m'br lyrdn mzrchh 'shr ntn lhm mshh 'bd yhvh
verses.translation: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֥מוּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַ/יֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַ/יְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ אֶת הַ/הֹלְכִים֩ לִ/כְתֹּ֨ב אֶת הָ/אָ֜רֶץ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לְ֠כוּ וְ/הִתְהַלְּכ֨וּ בָ/אָ֜רֶץ וְ/כִתְב֤וּ אוֹתָ/הּ֙ וְ/שׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלַ֔/י וּ֠/פֹה אַשְׁלִ֨יךְ לָ/כֶ֥ם גּוֹרָ֛ל לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/שִׁלֹֽה
verses.translit: vyqmv h'nshym vylkhv vytsv yhvsh' 't hhlkhym lkhtb 't h'rts l'mr lkhv vhthlkhv b'rts vkhtbv 'vth vshvbv 'ly vph 'shlykh lkhm gvrl lpny yhvh bshlh
verses.translation: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֤וּ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ וַ/יַּעַבְר֣וּ בָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יִּכְתְּב֧וּ/הָ לֶֽ/עָרִ֛ים לְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה חֲלָקִ֖ים עַל סֵ֑פֶר וַ/יָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁלֹֽה
verses.translit: vylkhv h'nshym vy'brv b'rts vykhtbvh l'rym lshb'h chlqym 'l spr vyb'v 'l yhvsh' 'l hmchnh shlh
verses.translation: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁלֵךְ֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ גּוֹרָ֛ל בְּ/שִׁלֹ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יְחַלֶּק שָׁ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ אֶת הָ/אָ֛רֶץ לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּ/מַחְלְקֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshlkh lhm yhvsh' gvrl bshlh lpny yhvh vychlq shm yhvsh' 't h'rts lbny yshr'l khmchlqtm
verses.translation: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD : and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗עַל גּוֹרַ֛ל מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ גְּב֣וּל גּֽוֹרָלָ֔/ם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/בֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: vy'l gvrl mth bny bnymn lmshpchtm vyts' gbvl gvrlm byn bny yhvdh vbyn bny yvsf
verses.translation: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י לָ/הֶ֧ם הַ/גְּב֛וּל לִ/פְאַ֥ת צָפ֖וֹנָ/ה מִן הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ/עָלָ֣ה הַ/גְּבוּל֩ אֶל כֶּ֨תֶף יְרִיח֜וֹ מִ/צָּפ֗וֹן וְ/עָלָ֤ה בָ/הָר֙ יָ֔מָּ/ה ו/היה וְ/הָיוּ֙ תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔י/ו מִדְבַּ֖רָ/ה בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: vyhy lhm hgbvl lp't tspvnh mn hyrdn v'lh hgbvl 'l khtf yrychv mtspvn v'lh bhr ymh vhyh vhyv tts'tyv mdbrh byt 'vn
verses.translation: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

verses.original: וְ/עָבַר֩ מִ/שָּׁ֨ם הַ/גְּב֜וּל ל֗וּזָ/ה אֶל כֶּ֤תֶף ל֨וּזָ/ה֙ נֶ֔גְבָּ/ה הִ֖יא בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל וְ/יָרַ֤ד הַ/גְּבוּל֙ עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַל הָ/הָ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר מִ/נֶּ֥גֶב לְ/בֵית חֹר֖וֹן תַּחְתּֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'br mshm hgbvl lvzh 'l khtf lvzh ngbh hy' byt 'l vyrd hgbvl 'trvt 'dr 'l hhr 'shr mngb lbyt chrvn tchtvn
verses.translation: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Beth-el, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth-adar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth-horon.

verses.original: וְ/תָאַ֣ר הַ/גְּבוּל֩ וְ/נָסַ֨ב לִ/פְאַת יָ֜ם נֶ֗גְבָּ/ה מִן הָ/הָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י בֵית חֹרוֹן֮ נֶגְבָּ/ה֒ ו/היה וְ/הָי֣וּ תֹֽצְאֹתָ֗י/ו אֶל קִרְיַת בַּ֨עַל֙ הִ֚יא קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים עִ֖יר בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה זֹ֖את פְּאַת יָֽם
verses.translit: vt'r hgbvl vnsb lp't ym ngbh mn hhr 'shr 'l pny byt chrvn ngbh vhyh vhyv tts'tyv 'l qryt b'l hy' qryt y'rym 'yr bny yhvdh z't p't ym
verses.translation: And the border was drawn thence , and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

verses.original: וּ/פְאַת נֶ֕גְבָּ/ה מִ/קְצֵ֖ה קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים וְ/יָצָ֤א הַ/גְּבוּל֙ יָ֔מָּ/ה וְ/יָצָ֕א אֶל מַעְיַ֖ן מֵ֥י נֶפְתּֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: vp't ngbh mqtsh qryt y'rym vyts' hgbvl ymh vyts' 'l m'yn my nptvch
verses.translation: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

verses.original: וְ/יָרַ֨ד הַ/גְּב֜וּל אֶל קְצֵ֣ה הָ/הָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל פְּנֵי֙ גֵּ֣י בֶן הִנֹּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִ֖ים צָפ֑וֹנָ/ה וְ/יָרַד֩ גֵּ֨י הִנֹּ֜ם אֶל כֶּ֤תֶף הַ/יְבוּסִי֙ נֶ֔גְבָּ/ה וְ/יָרַ֖ד עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל
verses.translit: vyrd hgbvl 'l qtsh hhr 'shr 'l pny gy bn hnm 'shr b'mq rp'ym tspvnh vyrd gy hnm 'l khtf hybvsy ngbh vyrd 'yn rgl
verses.translation: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En-rogel,

verses.original: וְ/תָאַ֣ר מִ/צָּפ֗וֹן וְ/יָצָא֙ עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְ/יָצָא֙ אֶל גְּלִיל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר נֹ֖כַח מַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֑ים וְ/יָרַ֕ד אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן רְאוּבֵֽן
verses.translit: vt'r mtspvn vyts' 'yn shmsh vyts' 'l glylvt 'shr nkhch m'lh 'dmym vyrd 'bn bhn bn r'vbn
verses.translation: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

verses.original: וְ/עָבַ֛ר אֶל כֶּ֥תֶף מוּל הָֽ/עֲרָבָ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָ/ה וְ/יָרַ֖ד הָ/עֲרָבָֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: v'br 'l khtf mvl h'rbh tspvnh vyrd h'rbth
verses.translation: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

verses.original: וְ/עָבַ֨ר הַ/גְּב֜וּל אֶל כֶּ֣תֶף בֵּית חָגְלָה֮ צָפוֹנָ/ה֒ ו/היה וְ/הָי֣וּ תצאותי/ו תֹּצְא֣וֹת הַ/גְּב֗וּל אֶל לְשׁ֤וֹן יָם הַ/מֶּ֨לַח֙ צָפ֔וֹנָ/ה אֶל קְצֵ֥ה הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן נֶ֑גְבָּ/ה זֶ֖ה גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב
verses.translit: v'br hgbvl 'l khtf byt chglh tspvnh vhyh vhyv tts'vtyv tts'vt hgbvl 'l lshvn ym hmlch tspvnh 'l qtsh hyrdn ngbh zh gbvl ngb
verses.translation: And the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֥ן יִגְבֹּל אֹת֖/וֹ לִ/פְאַת קֵ֑דְמָ/ה זֹ֡את נַחֲלַת֩ בְּנֵ֨י בִנְיָמִ֧ן לִ/גְבֽוּלֹתֶ֛י/הָ סָבִ֖יב לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyrdn ygbl 'tv lp't qdmh z't nchlt bny bnymn lgbvltyh sbyb lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֣וּ הֶֽ/עָרִ֗ים לְ/מַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם יְרִיח֥וֹ וּ/בֵית חָגְלָ֖ה וְ/עֵ֥מֶק קְצִֽיץ
verses.translit: vhyv h'rym lmth bny bnymn lmshpchvtyhm yrychv vbyt chglh v'mq qtsyts
verses.translation: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

verses.original: וּ/בֵ֧ית הָֽעֲרָבָ֛ה וּ/צְמָרַ֖יִם וּ/בֵֽית אֵֽל
verses.translit: vbyt h'rbh vtsmrym vbyt 'l
verses.translation: And Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עַוִּ֥ים וְ/הַ/פָּרָ֖ה וְ/עָפְרָֽה
verses.translit: vh'vym vhprh v'prh
verses.translation: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

verses.original: וּ/כְפַ֧ר העמני הָֽעַמֹּנָ֛ה וְ/הָֽ/עָפְנִ֖י וָ/גָ֑בַע עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vkhpr h'mny h'mnh vh'pny vgb' 'rym shtym 'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:

verses.original: גִּבְע֥וֹן וְ/הָֽ/רָמָ֖ה וּ/בְאֵרֽוֹת
verses.translit: gb'vn vhrmh vb'rvt
verses.translation: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מִּצְפֶּ֥ה וְ/הַ/כְּפִירָ֖ה וְ/הַ/מֹּצָֽה
verses.translit: vhmtsph vhkhpyrh vhmtsh
verses.translation: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

verses.original: וְ/רֶ֥קֶם וְ/יִרְפְּאֵ֖ל וְ/תַרְאֲלָֽה
verses.translit: vrqm vyrp'l vtr'lh
verses.translation: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

verses.original: וְ/צֵלַ֡ע הָאֶ֜לֶף וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֨י הִ֤יא יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ גִּבְעַ֣ת קִרְיַ֔ת עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּֽע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶ֑ן זֹ֛את נַֽחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vtsl' h'lf vhybvsy hy' yrvshlm gb't qryt 'rym 'rb' 'shrh vchtsryhn z't nchlt bny bnymn lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֞א הַ/גּוֹרָ֤ל הַ/שֵּׁנִי֙ לְ/שִׁמְע֔וֹן לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑/ם וַֽ/יְהִי֙ נַֽחֲלָתָ֔/ם בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl hshny lshm'vn lmth bny shm'vn lmshpchvtm vyhy nchltm btvkh nchlt bny yhvdh
verses.translation: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/נַֽחֲלָתָ֑/ם בְּאֵֽר שֶׁ֥בַע וְ/שֶׁ֖בַע וּ/מוֹלָדָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy lhm bnchltm b'r shb' vshb' vmvldh
verses.translation: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

verses.original: וַ/חֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּ/בָלָ֖ה וָ/עָֽצֶם
verses.translit: vchtsr shv'l vblh v'tsm
