verses.translation: And Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

verses.original: וְ/אֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּ/בְת֖וּל וְ/חָרְמָֽה
verses.translit: v'ltvld vbtvl vchrmh
verses.translation: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

verses.original: וְ/צִֽקְלַ֥ג וּ/בֵית הַמַּרְכָּב֖וֹת וַ/חֲצַ֥ר סוּסָֽה
verses.translit: vtsqlg vbyt hmrkhbvt vchtsr svsh
verses.translation: And Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

verses.original: וּ/בֵ֥ית לְבָא֖וֹת וְ/שָֽׁרוּחֶ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vbyt lb'vt vshrvchn 'rym shlsh 'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:

verses.original: עַ֥יִן רִמּ֖וֹן וָ/עֶ֣תֶר וְ/עָשָׁ֑ן עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּ֖ע וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: 'yn rmvn v'tr v'shn 'rym 'rb' vchtsryhn
verses.translation: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַֽ/חֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר סְבִיבוֹת֙ הֶֽ/עָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה עַד בַּֽעֲלַ֥ת בְּאֵ֖ר רָ֣אמַת נֶ֑גֶב זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vkhl hchtsrym 'shr sbybvt h'rym h'lh 'd b'lt b'r r'mt ngb z't nchlt mth bny shm'vn lmshpchtm
verses.translation: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

verses.original: מֵ/חֶ֨בֶל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחֲלַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי הָיָ֞ה חֵ֤לֶק בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָה֙ רַ֣ב מֵ/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּנְחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי שִׁמְע֖וֹן בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ נַחֲלָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: mchbl bny yhvdh nchlt bny shm'vn khy hyh chlq bny yhvdh rb mhm vynchlv bny shm'vn btvkh nchltm
verses.translation: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ הַ/גּוֹרָ֣ל הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִ/בְנֵ֥י זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל נַחֲלָתָ֖/ם עַד שָׂרִֽיד
verses.translit: vy'l hgvrl hshlyshy lbny zbvln lmshpchtm vyhy gbvl nchltm 'd shryd
verses.translation: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:

verses.original: וְ/עָלָ֨ה גְבוּלָ֧/ם לַ/יָּ֛מָּ/ה וּ/מַרְעֲלָ֖ה וּ/פָגַ֣ע בְּ/דַבָּ֑שֶׁת וּ/פָגַע֙ אֶל הַ/נַּ֔חַל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י יָקְנְעָֽם
verses.translit: v'lh gbvlm lymh vmr'lh vpg' bdbsht vpg' 'l hnchl 'shr 'l pny yqn'm
verses.translation: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֣ב מִ/שָּׂרִ֗יד קֵ֚דְמָ/ה מִזְרַ֣ח הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ עַל גְּב֥וּל כִּסְלֹ֖ת תָּבֹ֑ר וְ/יָצָ֥א אֶל הַ/דָּֽבְרַ֖ת וְ/עָלָ֥ה יָפִֽיעַ
verses.translit: vshb mshryd qdmh mzrch hshmsh 'l gbvl khslt tbr vyts' 'l hdbrt v'lh ypy'
verses.translation: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,

verses.original: וּ/מִ/שָּׁ֤ם עָבַר֙ קֵ֣דְמָ/ה מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה גִּתָּ֥/ה חֵ֖פֶר עִתָּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְ/יָצָ֛א רִמּ֥וֹן הַ/מְּתֹאָ֖ר הַ/נֵּעָֽה
verses.translit: vmshm 'br qdmh mzrchh gth chpr 'th qtsyn vyts' rmvn hmt'r hn'h
verses.translation: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goeth out to Remmon-methoar to Neah;

verses.original: וְ/נָסַ֤ב אֹת/וֹ֙ הַ/גְּב֔וּל מִ/צְּפ֖וֹן חַנָּתֹ֑ן וְ/הָיוּ֙ תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔י/ו גֵּ֖י יִפְתַּח אֵֽל
verses.translit: vnsb 'tv hgbvl mtspvn chntn vhyv tts'tyv gy yptch 'l
verses.translation: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el:

verses.original: וְ/קַטָּ֤ת וְ/נַֽהֲלָל֙ וְ/שִׁמְר֔וֹן וְ/יִדְאֲלָ֖ה וּ/בֵ֣ית לָ֑חֶם עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vqtt vnhll vshmrvn vyd'lh vbyt lchm 'rym shtym 'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth-lehem: twelve cities with their villages.

verses.original: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑/ם הֶֽ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: z't nchlt bny zbvln lmshpchvtm h'rym h'lh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

verses.original: לְ/יִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר יָצָ֖א הַ/גּוֹרָ֣ל הָֽ/רְבִיעִ֑י לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lyshshkhr yts' hgvrl hrby'y lbny yshshkhr lmshpchvtm
verses.translation: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑/ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אלָ/ה וְ/הַ/כְּסוּלֹ֖ת וְ/שׁוּנֵֽם
verses.translit: vyhy gbvlm yzr''lh vhkhsvlt vshvnm
verses.translation: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

verses.original: וַ/חֲפָרַ֥יִם וְ/שִׁיאֹ֖ן וַ/אֲנָחֲרַֽת
verses.translit: vchprym vshy'n v'nchrt
verses.translation: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,

verses.original: וְ/הָֽ/רַבִּ֥ית וְ/קִשְׁי֖וֹן וָ/אָֽבֶץ
verses.translit: vhrbyt vqshyvn v'bts
verses.translation: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

verses.original: וְ/רֶ֧מֶת וְ/עֵין גַּנִּ֛ים וְ/עֵ֥ין חַדָּ֖ה וּ/בֵ֥ית פַּצֵּֽץ
verses.translit: vrmt v'yn gnym v'yn chdh vbyt ptsts
verses.translation: And Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;

verses.original: וּ/פָגַע֩ הַ/גְּב֨וּל בְּ/תָב֤וֹר ו/שחצומ/ה וְ/שַׁחֲצִ֨ימָ/ה֙ וּ/בֵ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְ/הָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת גְּבוּלָ֖/ם הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vpg' hgbvl btbvr vshchtsvmh vshchtsymh vbyt shmsh vhyv tts'vt gbvlm hyrdn 'rym shsh 'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם הֶ/עָרִ֖ים וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bny yshshkhr lmshpchtm h'rym vchtsryhn
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ הַ/גּוֹרָ֣ל הַֽ/חֲמִישִׁ֔י לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי אָשֵׁ֖ר לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl hchmyshy lmth bny 'shr lmshpchvtm
verses.translation: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑/ם חֶלְקַ֥ת וַ/חֲלִ֖י וָ/בֶ֥טֶן וְ/אַכְשָֽׁף
verses.translit: vyhy gbvlm chlqt vchly vbtn v'khshf
verses.translation: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

verses.original: וְ/אַֽלַמֶּ֥לֶךְ וְ/עַמְעָ֖ד וּ/מִשְׁאָ֑ל וּ/פָגַ֤ע בְּ/כַרְמֶל֙ הַ/יָּ֔מָּ/ה וּ/בְ/שִׁיח֖וֹר לִבְנָֽת
verses.translit: v'lmlkh v'm'd vmsh'l vpg' bkhrml hymh vbshychvr lbnt
verses.translation: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֨ב מִזְרַ֣ח הַ/שֶּׁמֶשׁ֮ בֵּ֣ית דָּגֹן֒ וּ/פָגַ֣ע בִּ֠/זְבֻלוּן וּ/בְ/גֵ֨י יִפְתַּח אֵ֥ל צָפ֛וֹנָ/ה בֵּ֥ית הָעֵ֖מֶק וּ/נְעִיאֵ֑ל וְ/יָצָ֥א אֶל כָּב֖וּל מִ/שְּׂמֹֽאל
verses.translit: vshb mzrch hshmsh byt dgn vpg' bzblvn vbgy yptch 'l tspvnh byt h'mq vn'y'l vyts' 'l khbvl mshm'l
verses.translation: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,

verses.original: וְ/עֶבְרֹ֥ן וּ/רְחֹ֖ב וְ/חַמּ֣וֹן וְ/קָנָ֑ה עַ֖ד צִיד֥וֹן רַבָּֽה
verses.translit: v'brn vrchb vchmvn vqnh 'd tsydvn rbh
verses.translation: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֤ב הַ/גְּבוּל֙ הָֽ/רָמָ֔ה וְ/עַד עִ֖יר מִבְצַר צֹ֑ר וְ/שָׁ֤ב הַ/גְּבוּל֙ חֹסָ֔ה ו/יהיו וְ/הָי֧וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֛י/ו הַ/יָּ֖מָּ/ה מֵ/חֶ֥בֶל אַכְזִֽיבָ/ה
verses.translit: vshb hgbvl hrmh v'd 'yr mbtsr tsr vshb hgbvl chsh vyhyv vhyv tts'tyv hymh mchbl 'khzybh
verses.translation: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:

verses.original: וְ/עֻמָ֥ה וַ/אֲפֵ֖ק וּ/רְחֹ֑ב עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֖יִם וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: v'mh v'pq vrchb 'rym 'shrym vshtym vchtsryhn
verses.translation: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי אָשֵׁ֖ר לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bny 'shr lmshpchtm h'rym h'lh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י יָצָ֖א הַ/גּוֹרָ֣ל הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֑י לִ/בְנֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lbny nptly yts' hgvrl hshshy lbny nptly lmshpchtm
verses.translation: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗/ם מֵ/חֵ֨לֶף מֵֽ/אֵל֜וֹן בְּ/צַעֲנַנִּ֗ים וַ/אֲדָמִ֥י הַנֶּ֛קֶב וְ/יַבְנְאֵ֖ל עַד לַקּ֑וּם וַ/יְהִ֥י תֹצְאֹתָ֖י/ו הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyhy gbvlm mchlf m'lvn bts'nnym v'dmy hnqb vybn'l 'd lqvm vyhy tts'tyv hyrdn
verses.translation: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֨ב הַ/גְּב֥וּל יָ֨מָּ/ה֙ אַזְנ֣וֹת תָּב֔וֹר וְ/יָצָ֥א מִ/שָּׁ֖ם חוּקֹ֑קָ/ה וּ/פָגַ֨ע בִּ/זְבֻל֜וּן מִ/נֶּ֗גֶב וּ/בְ/אָשֵׁר֙ פָּגַ֣ע מִ/יָּ֔ם וּ/בִ֣/יהוּדָ֔ה הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרַ֥ח הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vshb hgbvl ymh 'znvt tbvr vyts' mshm chvqqh vpg' bzblvn mngb vb'shr pg' mym vbyhvdh hyrdn mzrch hshmsh
verses.translation: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.

verses.original: וְ/עָרֵ֖י מִבְצָ֑ר הַ/צִּדִּ֣ים צֵ֔ר וְ/חַמַּ֖ת רַקַּ֥ת וְ/כִנָּֽרֶת
verses.translit: v'ry mbtsr htsdym tsr vchmt rqt vkhnrt
verses.translation: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

verses.original: וַ/אֲדָמָ֥ה וְ/הָ/רָמָ֖ה וְ/חָצֽוֹר
verses.translit: v'dmh vhrmh vchtsvr
verses.translation: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

verses.original: וְ/קֶ֥דֶשׁ וְ/אֶדְרֶ֖עִי וְ/עֵ֥ין חָצֽוֹר
verses.translit: vqdsh v'dr'y v'yn chtsvr
verses.translation: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

verses.original: וְ/יִרְאוֹן֙ וּ/מִגְדַּל אֵ֔ל חֳרֵ֥ם וּ/בֵית עֲנָ֖ת וּ/בֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ עָרִ֥ים תְּשַֽׁע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vyr'vn vmgdl 'l chrm vbyt 'nt vbyt shmsh 'rym tsh' 'shrh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: And Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם הֶ/עָרִ֖ים וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bny nptly lmshpchtm h'rym vchtsryhn
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי דָ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם יָצָ֖א הַ/גּוֹרָ֥ל הַ/שְּׁבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: lmth bny dn lmshpchtm yts' hgvrl hshby'y
verses.translation: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י גְּב֣וּל נַחֲלָתָ֑/ם צָרְעָ֥ה וְ/אֶשְׁתָּא֖וֹל וְ/עִ֥יר שָֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vyhy gbvl nchltm tsr'h v'sht'vl v'yr shmsh
verses.translation: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

verses.original: וְ/שַֽׁעֲלַבִּ֥ין וְ/אַיָּל֖וֹן וְ/יִתְלָֽה
verses.translit: vsh'lbyn v'ylvn vytlh
verses.translation: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,

verses.original: וְ/אֵיל֥וֹן וְ/תִמְנָ֖תָ/ה וְ/עֶקְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'ylvn vtmnth v'qrvn
verses.translation: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,

verses.original: וְ/אֶלְתְּקֵ֥ה וְ/גִבְּת֖וֹן וּ/בַעֲלָֽת
verses.translit: v'ltqh vgbtvn vb'lt
verses.translation: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

verses.original: וִ/יהֻ֥ד וּ/בְנֵֽי בְרַ֖ק וְ/גַת רִמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyhd vbny brq vgt rmvn
verses.translation: And Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,

verses.original: וּ/מֵ֥י הַיַּרְק֖וֹן וְ/הָֽ/רַקּ֑וֹן עִֽם הַ/גְּב֖וּל מ֥וּל יָפֽוֹ
verses.translit: vmy hyrqvn vhrqvn 'm hgbvl mvl ypv
verses.translation: And Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א גְבוּל בְּנֵי דָ֖ן מֵ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ בְנֵֽי דָ֠ן וַ/יִּלָּחֲמ֨וּ עִם לֶ֜שֶׁם וַ/יִּלְכְּד֥וּ אוֹתָ֣/הּ וַ/יַּכּ֧וּ אוֹתָ֣/הּ לְ/פִי חֶ֗רֶב וַ/יִּֽרְשׁ֤וּ אוֹתָ/הּ֙ וַ/יֵּ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔/הּ וַ/יִּקְרְא֤וּ לְ/לֶ֨שֶׁם֙ דָּ֔ן כְּ/שֵׁ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֲבִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyts' gbvl bny dn mhm vy'lv bny dn vylchmv 'm lshm vylkhdv 'vth vykhv 'vth lpy chrb vyrshv 'vth vyshbv bh vyqr'v llshm dn khshm dn 'byhm
verses.translation: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

verses.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי דָ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם הֶֽ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: z't nchlt mth bny dn lmshpchtm h'rym h'lh vchtsryhn
verses.translation: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַלּ֥וּ לִ/נְחֹל אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לִ/גְבֽוּלֹתֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל נַחֲלָ֛ה לִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן נ֖וּן בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vykhlv lnchl 't h'rts lgbvltyh vytnv bny yshr'l nchlh lyhvsh' bn nvn btvkhm
verses.translation: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:

verses.original: עַל פִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה נָ֣תְנוּ ל֗/וֹ אֶת הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔ל אֶת תִּמְנַת סֶ֖רַח בְּ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/יִּבְנֶ֥ה אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'l py yhvh ntnv lv 't h'yr 'shr sh'l 't tmnt srch bhr 'prym vybnh 't h'yr vyshb bh
verses.translation: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַ/נְּחָלֹ֡ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִחֲל֣וּ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֪עַ בִּן נ֟וּן וְ/רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ/אָב֣וֹת לְ/מַטּוֹת֩ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בְּ/גוֹרָ֤ל בְּ/שִׁלֹה֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַ/יְכַלּ֕וּ מֵֽ/חַלֵּ֖ק אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'lh hnchlt 'shr nchlv 'l'zr hkhhn vyhvsh' bn nvn vr'shy h'bvt lmtvt bny yshr'l bgvrl bshlh lpny yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd vykhlv mchlq 't h'rts
verses.translation: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l yhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר תְּנ֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ אֶת עָרֵ֣י הַ/מִּקְלָ֔ט אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr tnv lkhm 't 'ry hmqlt 'shr dbrty 'lykhm byd mshh
verses.translation: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:

verses.original: לָ/נ֥וּס שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ רוֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה נֶ֥פֶשׁ בִּ/שְׁגָגָ֖ה בִּ/בְלִי דָ֑עַת וְ/הָי֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ לְ/מִקְלָ֔ט מִ/גֹּאֵ֖ל הַ/דָּֽם
verses.translit: lnvs shmh rvtsch mkhh npsh bshggh bbly d't vhyv lkhm lmqlt mg'l hdm
verses.translation: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

verses.original: וְ/נָ֞ס אֶל אַחַ֣ת מֵ/הֶ/עָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה וְ/עָמַד֙ פֶּ֚תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/דִבֶּ֛ר בְּ/אָזְנֵ֛י זִקְנֵ֥י הָ/עִֽיר הַ/הִ֖יא אֶת דְּבָרָ֑י/ו וְ/אָסְפ֨וּ אֹת֤/וֹ הָ/עִ֨ירָ/ה֙ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/נָתְנוּ ל֥/וֹ מָק֖וֹם וְ/יָשַׁ֥ב עִמָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vns 'l 'cht mh'rym h'lh v'md ptch sh'r h'yr vdbr b'zny zqny h'yr hhy' 't dbryv v'spv 'tv h'yrh 'lyhm vntnv lv mqvm vyshb 'mm
verses.translation: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֨י יִרְדֹּ֜ף גֹּאֵ֤ל הַ/דָּם֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹֽא יַסְגִּ֥רוּ אֶת הָ/רֹצֵ֖חַ בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ כִּ֤י בִ/בְלִי דַ֨עַת֙ הִכָּ֣ה אֶת רֵעֵ֔/הוּ וְ/לֹֽא שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖/וֹ מִ/תְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם
verses.translit: vkhy yrdf g'l hdm 'chryv vl' ysgrv 't hrtsch bydv khy bbly d't hkhh 't r'hv vl' shn' hv' lv mtmvl shlshvm
verses.translation: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.

verses.original: וְ/יָשַׁ֣ב בָּ/עִ֣יר הַ/הִ֗יא עַד עָמְד֞/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֤י הָֽ/עֵדָה֙ לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֔ט עַד מוֹת֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֑ם אָ֣ז יָשׁ֣וּב הָ/רוֹצֵ֗חַ וּ/בָ֤א אֶל עִיר/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶל בֵּית֔/וֹ אֶל הָ/עִ֖יר אֲשֶׁר נָ֥ס מִ/שָּֽׁם
verses.translit: vyshb b'yr hhy' 'd 'mdv lpny h'dh lmshpt 'd mvt hkhhn hgdvl 'shr yhyh bymym hhm 'z yshvb hrvtsch vb' 'l 'yrv v'l bytv 'l h'yr 'shr ns mshm
verses.translation: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְדִּ֜שׁוּ אֶת קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּ/גָּלִיל֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְ/אֶת שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְ/אֶת קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּ/הַ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyqdshv 't qdsh bglyl bhr nptly v't shkhm bhr 'prym v't qryt 'rb' hy' chbrvn bhr yhvdh
verses.translation: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/עֵ֜בֶר לְ/יַרְדֵּ֤ן יְרִיחוֹ֙ מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה נָתְנ֞וּ אֶת בֶּ֧צֶר בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֛ר בַּ/מִּישֹׁ֖ר מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן וְ/אֶת רָאמֹ֤ת בַּ/גִּלְעָד֙ מִ/מַּטֵּה גָ֔ד וְ/אֶת גלון גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּ/בָּשָׁ֖ן מִ/מַּטֵּ֥ה מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: vm'br lyrdn yrychv mzrchh ntnv 't btsr bmdbr bmyshr mmth r'vbn v't r'mt bgl'd mmth gd v't glvn gvln bbshn mmth mnshh
verses.translation: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הָיוּ֩ עָרֵ֨י הַ/מּֽוּעָדָ֜ה לְ/כֹ֣ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/לַ/גֵּר֙ הַ/גָּ֣ר בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/ם לָ/נ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּ/ה כָּל מַכֵּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּ/שְׁגָגָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֣א יָמ֗וּת בְּ/יַד֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּ֔ם עַד עָמְד֖/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: 'lh hyv 'ry hmv'dh lkhl bny yshr'l vlgr hgr btvkhm lnvs shmh khl mkhh npsh bshggh vl' ymvt byd g'l hdm 'd 'mdv lpny h'dh
verses.translation: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּגְּשׁ֗וּ רָאשֵׁי֙ אֲב֣וֹת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אֶל אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נ֑וּן וְ/אֶל רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַ/מַּטּ֖וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vygshv r'shy 'bvt hlvym 'l 'l'zr hkhhn v'l yhvsh' bn nvn v'l r'shy 'bvt hmtvt lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבְּר֨וּ אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם בְּ/שִׁלֹ֗ה בְּ/אֶ֤רֶץ כְּנַ֨עַן֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה בְ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָֽ/תֶת לָ֥/נוּ עָרִ֖ים לָ/שָׁ֑בֶת וּ/מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶ֖ן לִ/בְהֶמְתֵּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vydbrv 'lyhm bshlh b'rts khn'n l'mr yhvh tsvh byd mshh ltt lnv 'rym lshbt vmgrshyhn lbhmtnv
verses.translation: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לַ/לְוִיִּ֛ם מִ/נַּחֲלָתָ֖/ם אֶל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/אֶת מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vytnv bny yshr'l llvym mnchltm 'l py yhvh 't h'rym h'lh v't mgrshyhn
verses.translation: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD , these cities and their suburbs.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א הַ/גּוֹרָ֖ל לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַ/קְּהָתִ֑י וַ/יְהִ֡י לִ/בְנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן מִן הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה יְ֠הוּדָה וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֨ה הַ/שִּׁמְעֹנִ֜י וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֤ה בִנְיָמִן֙ בַּ/גּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl lmshpcht hqhty vyhy lbny 'hrn hkhhn mn hlvym mmth yhvdh vmmth hshm'ny vmmth bnymn bgvrl 'rym shlsh 'shrh
verses.translation: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֗ים מִ/מִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מַטֵּֽה אֶ֠פְרַיִם וּֽ/מִ/מַּטֵּה דָ֞ן וּ/מֵ/חֲצִ֨י מַטֵּ֧ה מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּ/גּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר
verses.translit: vlbny qht hnvtrym mmshpcht mth 'prym vmmth dn vmchtsy mth mnshh bgvrl 'rym 'shr
verses.translation: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִ/מִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת מַטֵּֽה יִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּֽה אָ֠שֵׁר וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י וּ֠/מֵ/חֲצִי מַטֵּ֨ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בַ/בָּשָׁן֙ בַּ/גּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה
verses.translit: vlbny grshvn mmshpchvt mth yshshkhr vmmth 'shr vmmth nptly vmchtsy mth mnshh bbshn bgvrl 'rym shlsh 'shrh
verses.translation: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֗/ם מִ/מַּטֵּ֨ה רְאוּבֵ֤ן וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּה גָד֙ וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה
verses.translit: lbny mrry lmshpchtm mmth r'vbn vmmth gd vmmth zbvln 'rym shtym 'shrh
verses.translation: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/אֶת מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶ֑ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֖ה בַּ/גּוֹרָֽל
verses.translit: vytnv bny yshr'l llvym 't h'rym h'lh v't mgrshyhn kh'shr tsvh yhvh byd mshh bgvrl
verses.translation: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֗וּ מִ/מַּטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן אֵ֚ת הֶֽ/עָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָ֥א אֶתְ/הֶ֖ן בְּ/שֵֽׁם
verses.translit: vytnv mmth bny yhvdh vmmth bny shm'vn 't h'rym h'lh 'shr yqr' 'thn bshm
verses.translation: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן מִ/מִּשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַ/קְּהָתִ֖י מִ/בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י כִּ֥י לָ/הֶ֛ם הָיָ֥ה הַ/גּוֹרָ֖ל רִיאשֹׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy lbny 'hrn mmshpchvt hqhty mbny lvy khy lhm hyh hgvrl ry'shnh
verses.translation: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ לָ/הֶ֜ם אֶת קִרְיַת֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אֲבִ֧י הָֽ/עֲנ֛וֹק הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּ/הַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֖/הָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vytnv lhm 't qryt 'rb' 'by h'nvq hy' chbrvn bhr yhvdh v't mgrshh sbybtyh
verses.translation: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת שְׂדֵ֥ה הָ/עִ֖יר וְ/אֶת חֲצֵרֶ֑י/הָ נָֽתְנ֛וּ לְ/כָלֵ֥ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֖ה בַּ/אֲחֻזָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't shdh h'yr v't chtsryh ntnv lkhlb bn ypnh b'chztv
verses.translation: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן נָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶת עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָ/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת חֶבְר֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ וְ/אֶת לִבְנָ֖ה וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vlbny 'hrn hkhhn ntnv 't 'yr mqlt hrtsch 't chbrvn v't mgrshh v't lbnh v't mgrshh
verses.translation: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת יַתִּר֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ וְ/אֶת אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: v't ytr v't mgrshh v't 'shtm' v't mgrshh
verses.translation: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת חֹלֹן֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ וְ/אֶת דְּבִ֖ר וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: v't chln v't mgrshh v't dbr v't mgrshh
verses.translation: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עַ֣יִן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֗/הָ וְ/אֶת יֻטָּה֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ אֶת בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֣ים תֵּ֔שַׁע מֵ/אֵ֕ת שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/שְּׁבָטִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: v't 'yn v't mgrshh v't yth v't mgrshh 't byt shmsh v't mgrshh 'rym tsh' m't shny hshbtym h'lh
verses.translation: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֶת גִּבְע֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ אֶת גֶּ֖בַע וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth bnymn 't gb'vn v't mgrshh 't gb' v't mgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,

verses.original: אֶת עֲנָתוֹת֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ וְ/אֶת עַלְמ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע
verses.translit: 't 'ntvt v't mgrshh v't 'lmvn v't mgrshh 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.original: כָּל עָרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עָרִ֖ים וּ/מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: khl 'ry bny 'hrn hkhhnym shlsh 'shrh 'rym vmgrshyhn
verses.translation: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי קְהָת֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִ/בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַֽ/יְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גֽוֹרָלָ֔/ם מִ/מַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vlmshpchvt bny qht hlvym hnvtrym mbny qht vyhy 'ry gvrlm mmth 'prym
verses.translation: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ לָ/הֶ֜ם אֶת עִ֨יר מִקְלַ֧ט הָ/רֹצֵ֛חַ אֶת שְׁכֶ֥ם וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֖/הָ בְּ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְ/אֶת גֶּ֖זֶר וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vytnv lhm 't 'yr mqlt hrtsch 't shkhm v't mgrshh bhr 'prym v't gzr v't mgrshh
verses.translation: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת קִבְצַ֨יִם֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית חוֹרֹ֖ן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע
verses.translit: v't qbtsym v't mgrshh v't byt chvrn v't mgrshh 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּ֨טֵּה דָ֔ן אֶֽת אֶלְתְּקֵ֖א וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ אֶֽת גִּבְּת֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth dn 't 'ltq' v't mgrshh 't gbtvn v't mgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,

verses.original: אֶת אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ אֶת גַּת רִמּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע
verses.translit: 't 'ylvn v't mgrshh 't gt rmvn v't mgrshh 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽ/מַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת תַּעְנַךְ֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ וְ/אֶת גַּת רִמּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vmmchtsyt mth mnshh 't t'nkh v't mgrshh v't gt rmvn v't mgrshh 'rym shtym
verses.translation: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.

verses.original: כָּל עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וּ/מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶ֑ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת בְּנֵֽי קְהָ֖ת הַ/נּוֹתָרִֽים
verses.translit: khl 'rym 'shr vmgrshyhn lmshpchvt bny qht hnvtrym
verses.translation: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁוֹן֮ מִ/מִּשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַ/לְוִיִּם֒ מֵ/חֲצִ֞י מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה אֶת עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָ/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת גלון גּוֹלָ֤ן בַּ/בָּשָׁן֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ וְ/אֶֽת בְּעֶשְׁתְּרָ֖ה וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים שְׁתָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vlbny grshvn mmshpcht hlvym mchtsy mth mnshh 't 'yr mqlt hrtsch 't glvn gvln bbshn v't mgrshh v't b'shtrh v't mgrshh 'rym shtym
verses.translation: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh-terah with her suburbs; two cities.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר אֶת קִשְׁי֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ אֶת דָּֽבְרַ֖ת וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth yshshkhr 't qshyvn v't mgrshh 't dbrt v't mgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,

verses.original: אֶת יַרְמוּת֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ אֶת עֵ֥ין גַּנִּ֖ים וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע
verses.translit: 't yrmvt v't mgrshh 't 'yn gnym v't mgrshh 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En-gannim with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת מִשְׁאָ֖ל וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ אֶת עַבְדּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth 'shr 't msh'l v't mgrshh 't 'bdvn v't mgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,

verses.original: אֶת חֶלְקָת֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ וְ/אֶת רְחֹ֖ב וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע
verses.translit: 't chlqt v't mgrshh v't rchb v't mgrshh 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֨ה נַפְתָּלִ֜י אֶת עִ֣יר מִקְלַ֣ט הָֽ/רֹצֵ֗חַ אֶת קֶ֨דֶשׁ בַּ/גָּלִ֤יל וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֨/הָ֙ וְ/אֶת חַמֹּ֥ת דֹּאר֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ וְ/אֶת קַרְתָּ֖ן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים שָׁלֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: vmmth nptly 't 'yr mqlt hrtsch 't qdsh bglyl v't mgrshh v't chmt d'r v't mgrshh v't qrtn v't mgrshh 'rym shlsh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.

verses.original: כָּל עָרֵ֥י הַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר וּ/מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: khl 'ry hgrshny lmshpchtm shlsh 'shrh 'yr vmgrshyhn
verses.translation: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי מְרָרִי֮ הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם הַ/נּוֹתָרִים֒ מֵ/אֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֶֽת יָקְנְעָ֖ם וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ אֶת קַרְתָּ֖ה וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vlmshpchvt bny mrry hlvym hnvtrym m't mth zbvln 't yqn'm v't mgrshh 't qrth v't mgrshh
verses.translation: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,

verses.original: אֶת דִּמְנָה֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ אֶֽת נַהֲלָ֖ל וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע
verses.translit: 't dmnh v't mgrshh 't nhll v't mgrshh 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶת בֶּ֖צֶר וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ וְ/אֶת יַ֖הְצָ/ה וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth r'vbn 't btsr v't mgrshh v't yhtsh v't mgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,

verses.original: אֶת קְדֵמוֹת֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ וְ/אֶת מֵיפָ֖עַת וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע
verses.translit: 't qdmvt v't mgrshh v't myp't v't mgrshh 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּה גָ֗ד אֶת עִיר֙ מִקְלַ֣ט הָ/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֶת רָמֹ֥ת בַּ/גִּלְעָ֖ד וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ וְ/אֶֽת מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁ/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth gd 't 'yr mqlt hrtsch 't rmt bgl'd v't mgrshh v't mchnym v't mgrshh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

verses.original: אֶת חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔/הָ אֶת יַעְזֵ֖ר וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑/הָ כָּל עָרִ֖ים אַרְבַּֽע
verses.translit: 't chshbvn v't mgrshh 't y'zr v't mgrshh khl 'rym 'rb'
verses.translation: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.

verses.original: כָּל הֶ֨/עָרִ֜ים לִ/בְנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔/ם הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֖ים מִ/מִּשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וַ/יְהִי֙ גּוֹרָלָ֔/ם עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה
verses.translit: khl h'rym lbny mrry lmshpchtm hnvtrym mmshpchvt hlvym vyhy gvrlm 'rym shtym 'shrh
verses.translation: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל עָרֵ֣י הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָרִ֛ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֖ה וּ/מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: khl 'ry hlvym btvkh 'chzt bny yshr'l 'rym 'rb'ym vshmnh vmgrshyhn
verses.translation: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.

verses.original: תִּֽהְיֶ֨ינָה֙ הֶ/עָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה עִ֣יר עִ֔יר וּ/מִגְרָשֶׁ֖י/הָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑י/הָ כֵּ֖ן לְ/כָל הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: thyynh h'rym h'lh 'yr 'yr vmgrshyh sbybtyh khn lkhl h'rym h'lh
verses.translation: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָ/תֵ֣ת לַ/אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יִּרָשׁ֖וּ/הָ וַ/יֵּ֥שְׁבוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vytn yhvh lyshr'l 't khl h'rts 'shr nshb' ltt l'bvtm vyrshvh vyshbv bh
verses.translation: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨נַח יְהוָ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ מִ/סָּבִ֔יב כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַ/אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹא עָ֨מַד אִ֤ישׁ בִּ/פְנֵי/הֶם֙ מִ/כָּל אֹ֣יְבֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל אֹ֣יְבֵי/הֶ֔ם נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vynch yhvh lhm msbyb khkhl 'shr nshb' l'bvtm vl' 'md 'ysh bpnyhm mkhl 'ybyhm 't khl 'ybyhm ntn yhvh bydm
verses.translation: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

verses.original: לֹֽא נָפַ֣ל דָּבָ֔ר מִ/כֹּל֙ הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/טּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַ/כֹּ֖ל בָּֽא
verses.translit: l' npl dbr mkhl hdbr htvb 'shr dbr yhvh 'l byt yshr'l hkhl b'
verses.translation: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

verses.original: אָ֚ז יִקְרָ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לָ/רֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְ/לַ/גָּדִ֑י וְ/לַ/חֲצִ֖י מַטֵּ֥ה מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: 'z yqr' yhvsh' lr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy mth mnshh
verses.translation: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֣ם שְׁמַרְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה וַ/תִּשְׁמְע֣וּ בְ/קוֹלִ֔/י לְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm 'tm shmrtm 't khl 'shr tsvh 'tkhm mshh 'bd yhvh vtshm'v bqvly lkhl 'shr tsvyty 'tkhm
verses.translation: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

verses.original: לֹֽא עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ם אֶת אֲחֵי/כֶ֗ם זֶ֚ה יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֕ם אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֕רֶת מִצְוַ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' 'zbtm 't 'chykhm zh ymym rbym 'd hyvm hzh vshmrtm 't mshmrt mtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ לַֽ/אֲחֵי/כֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/עַתָּ֡ה פְּנוּ֩ וּ/לְכ֨וּ לָ/כֶ֜ם לְ/אָהֳלֵי/כֶ֗ם אֶל אֶ֨רֶץ֙ אֲחֻזַּתְ/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣ן לָ/כֶ֗ם מֹשֶׁה֙ עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/עֵ֖בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: v'th hnych yhvh 'lhykhm l'chykhm kh'shr dbr lhm v'th pnv vlkhv lkhm l'hlykhm 'l 'rts 'chztkhm 'shr ntn lkhm mshh 'bd yhvh b'br hyrdn
verses.translation: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.

verses.original: רַ֣ק שִׁמְר֣וּ מְאֹ֗ד לַ/עֲשׂ֨וֹת אֶת הַ/מִּצְוָ֣ה וְ/אֶת הַ/תּוֹרָה֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶם֮ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָה֒ לְ֠/אַהֲבָה אֶת יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֜ם וְ/לָ/לֶ֧כֶת בְּ/כָל דְּרָכָ֛י/ו וְ/לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/דָבְקָה ב֑/וֹ וּ/לְ/עָבְד֕/וֹ בְּ/כָל לְבַבְ/כֶ֖ם וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשְׁ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: rq shmrv m'd l'shvt 't hmtsvh v't htvrh 'shr tsvh 'tkhm mshh 'bd yhvh l'hbh 't yhvh 'lhykhm vllkht bkhl drkhyv vlshmr mtsvtyv vldbqh bv vl'bdv bkhl lbbkhm vbkhl npshkhm
verses.translation: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְבָרְכֵ֖/ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֔/ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ אֶל אָהֳלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vybrkhm yhvsh' vyshlchm vylkhv 'l 'hlyhm
verses.translation: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

verses.original: וְ/לַ/חֲצִ֣י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה נָתַ֣ן מֹשֶׁה֮ בַּ/בָּשָׁן֒ וּ/לְ/חֶצְי֗/וֹ נָתַ֤ן יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ עִם אֲחֵי/הֶ֔ם מ/עבר בְּ/עֵ֥בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן יָ֑מָּ/ה וְ֠/גַם כִּ֣י שִׁלְּחָ֧/ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֖ם וַ/יְבָרֲכֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vlchtsy shbt hmnshh ntn mshh bbshn vlchtsyv ntn yhvsh' 'm 'chyhm m'br b'br hyrdn ymh vgm khy shlchm yhvsh' 'l 'hlyhm vybrkhm
verses.translation: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר בִּ/נְכָסִ֨ים רַבִּ֜ים שׁ֤וּבוּ אֶל אָֽהֳלֵי/כֶם֙ וּ/בְ/מִקְנֶ֣ה רַב מְאֹ֔ד בְּ/כֶ֨סֶף וּ/בְ/זָהָ֜ב וּ/בִ/נְחֹ֧שֶׁת וּ/בְ/בַרְזֶ֛ל וּ/בִ/שְׂלָמ֖וֹת הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד חִלְק֥וּ שְׁלַל אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֖ם עִם אֲחֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm l'mr bnkhsym rbym shvbv 'l 'hlykhm vbmqnh rb m'd bkhsf vbzhb vbnchsht vbbrzl vbshlmvt hrbh m'd chlqv shll 'ybykhm 'm 'chykhm
verses.translation: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֣בוּ וַ/יֵּלְכ֡וּ בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֨ן וּ/בְנֵי גָ֜ד וַ/חֲצִ֣י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה מֵ/אֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/שִּׁלֹ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן לָ/לֶ֜כֶת אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָ֗ד אֶל אֶ֤רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֹֽאחֲזוּ בָ֔/הּ עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyshbv vylkhv bny r'vbn vbny gd vchtsy shbt hmnshh m't bny yshr'l mshlh 'shr b'rts khn'n llkht 'l 'rts hgl'd 'l 'rts 'chztm 'shr n'chzv bh 'l py yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶל גְּלִיל֣וֹת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַ/יִּבְנ֣וּ בְנֵי רְאוּבֵ֣ן וּ/בְנֵי גָ֡ד וַ/חֲצִ֣י שֵׁבֶט֩ הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁ֨ה שָׁ֤ם מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ עַל הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן מִזְבֵּ֥חַ גָּד֖וֹל לְ/מַרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l glylvt hyrdn 'shr b'rts khn'n vybnv bny r'vbn vbny gd vchtsy shbt hmnshh shm mzbch 'l hyrdn mzbch gdvl lmr'h
verses.translation: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה בָנ֣וּ בְנֵֽי רְאוּבֵ֣ן וּ/בְנֵי גָ֡ד וַ/חֲצִי֩ שֵׁ֨בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֶל מוּל֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֶל גְּלִילוֹת֙ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל עֵ֖בֶר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshm'v bny yshr'l l'mr hnh bnv bny r'vbn vbny gd vchtsy shbt hmnshh 't hmzbch 'l mvl 'rts khn'n 'l glylvt hyrdn 'l 'br bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ כָּל עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה לַ/עֲל֥וֹת עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לַ/צָּבָֽא
verses.translit: vyshm'v bny yshr'l vyqhlv khl 'dt bny yshr'l shlh l'lvt 'lyhm ltsb'
verses.translation: And when the children of Israel heard of it , the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֨וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֧ן וְ/אֶל בְּנֵי גָ֛ד וְ/אֶל חֲצִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָ֑ד אֶת פִּינְחָ֖ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vyshlchv bny yshr'l 'l bny r'vbn v'l bny gd v'l chtsy shbt mnshh 'l 'rts hgl'd 't pynchs bn 'l'zr hkhhn
verses.translation: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

verses.original: וַ/עֲשָׂרָ֤ה נְשִׂאִים֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ נָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד נָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אָ֔ב לְ/כֹ֖ל מַטּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אִ֨ישׁ רֹ֧אשׁ בֵּית אֲבוֹתָ֛/ם הֵ֖מָּה לְ/אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'shrh nsh'ym 'mv nshy' 'chd nshy' 'chd lbyt 'b lkhl mtvt yshr'l v'ysh r'sh byt 'bvtm hmh l'lpy yshr'l
verses.translation: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֧ן וְ/אֶל בְּנֵי גָ֛ד וְ/אֶל חֲצִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יְדַבְּר֥וּ אִתָּ֖/ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l bny r'vbn v'l bny gd v'l chtsy shbt mnshh 'l 'rts hgl'd vydbrv 'tm l'mr
verses.translation: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמְר֞וּ כֹּ֣ל עֲדַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה מָֽה הַ/מַּ֤עַל הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר מְעַלְתֶּם֙ בֵּ/אלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָ/שׁ֣וּב הַ/יּ֔וֹם מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה בִּ/בְנֽוֹתְ/כֶ֤ם לָ/כֶם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לִ/מְרָדְ/כֶ֥ם הַ/יּ֖וֹם בַּ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mrv khl 'dt yhvh mh hm'l hzh 'shr m'ltm b'lhy yshr'l lshvb hyvm m'chry yhvh bbnvtkhm lkhm mzbch lmrdkhm hyvm byhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD , What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD , in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD ?

verses.original: הַ/מְעַט לָ֨/נוּ֙ אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן פְּע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא הִטַּהַ֨רְנוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֥י הַ/נֶּ֖גֶף בַּ/עֲדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hm't lnv 't 'vn p'vr 'shr l' hthrnv mmnv 'd hyvm hzh vyhy hngf b'dt yhvh
verses.translation: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD ,

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּם֙ תָּשֻׁ֣בוּ הַ/יּ֔וֹם מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֗ה אַתֶּ֞ם תִּמְרְד֤וּ הַ/יּוֹם֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה וּ/מָחָ֕ר אֶֽל כָּל עֲדַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִקְצֹֽף
verses.translit: v'tm tshbv hyvm m'chry yhvh vhyh 'tm tmrdv hyvm byhvh vmchr 'l khl 'dt yshr'l yqtsf
verses.translation: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD ? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD , that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אַ֨ךְ אִם טְמֵאָ֜ה אֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְ/כֶ֗ם עִבְר֨וּ לָ/כֶ֜ם אֶל אֶ֨רֶץ אֲחֻזַּ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָֽׁכַן שָׁם֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הֵאָחֲז֖וּ בְּ/תוֹכֵ֑/נוּ וּ/בַֽ/יהוָ֣ה אַל תִּמְרֹ֗דוּ וְ/אֹתָ֨/נוּ֙ אֶל תִּמְרֹ֔דוּ בִּ/בְנֹֽתְ/כֶ֤ם לָ/כֶם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ מִֽ/בַּלְעֲדֵ֔י מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v'kh 'm tm'h 'rts 'chztkhm 'brv lkhm 'l 'rts 'chzt yhvh 'shr shkhn shm mshkhn yhvh vh'chzv btvkhnv vbyhvh 'l tmrdv v'tnv 'l tmrdv bbntkhm lkhm mzbch mbl'dy mzbch yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD , wherein the LORD’s tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD , nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא עָכָ֣ן בֶּן זֶ֗רַח מָ֤עַל מַ֨עַל֙ בַּ/חֵ֔רֶם וְ/עַֽל כָּל עֲדַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָ֣יָה קָ֑צֶף וְ/הוּא֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֔ד לֹ֥א גָוַ֖ע בַּ/עֲוֺנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hlv' 'khn bn zrch m'l m'l bchrm v'l khl 'dt yshr'l hyh qtsf vhv' 'ysh 'chd l' gv' b'vnv
verses.translation: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲנוּ֙ בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֣ן וּ/בְנֵי גָ֔ד וַ/חֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֔וּ אֶת רָאשֵׁ֖י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'nv bny r'vbn vbny gd vchtsy shbt hmnshh vydbrv 't r'shy 'lpy yshr'l
verses.translation: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

verses.original: אֵל֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים יְהוָ֜ה אֵ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֤ים יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא יֹדֵ֔עַ וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ה֣וּא יֵדָ֑ע אִם בְּ/מֶ֤רֶד וְ/אִם בְּ/מַ֨עַל֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה אַל תּוֹשִׁיעֵ֖/נוּ הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'l 'lhym yhvh 'l 'lhym yhvh hv' yd' vyshr'l hv' yd' 'm bmrd v'm bm'l byhvh 'l tvshy'nv hyvm hzh
verses.translation: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD , (save us not this day,)

verses.original: לִ/בְנ֥וֹת לָ֨/נוּ֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לָ/שׁ֖וּב מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אִם לְ/הַעֲל֨וֹת עָלָ֜י/ו עוֹלָ֣ה וּ/מִנְחָ֗ה וְ/אִם לַ/עֲשׂ֤וֹת עָלָי/ו֙ זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֔ים יְהוָ֖ה ה֥וּא יְבַקֵּֽשׁ
verses.translit: lbnvt lnv mzbch lshvb m'chry yhvh v'm lh'lvt 'lyv 'vlh vmnchh v'm l'shvt 'lyv zbchy shlmym yhvh hv' ybqsh
verses.translation: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD , or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֤א מִ/דְּאָגָה֙ מִ/דָּבָ֔ר עָשִׂ֥ינוּ אֶת זֹ֖את לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מָחָ֗ר יֹאמְר֨וּ בְנֵי/כֶ֤ם לְ/בָנֵ֨י/נוּ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מַה לָּ/כֶ֕ם וְ/לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'm l' md'gh mdbr 'shynv 't z't l'mr mchr y'mrv bnykhm lbnynv l'mr mh lkhm vlyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?

verses.original: וּ/גְב֣וּל נָֽתַן יְ֠הוָה בֵּינֵ֨/נוּ וּ/בֵינֵי/כֶ֜ם בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֤ן וּ/בְנֵי גָד֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֵין לָ/כֶ֥ם חֵ֖לֶק בַּֽ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/הִשְׁבִּ֤יתוּ בְנֵי/כֶם֙ אֶת בָּנֵ֔י/נוּ לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י יְרֹ֥א אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vgbvl ntn yhvh bynnv vbynykhm bny r'vbn vbny gd 't hyrdn 'yn lkhm chlq byhvh vhshbytv bnykhm 't bnynv lblty yr' 't yhvh
verses.translation: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD : so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/נֹּ֕אמֶר נַעֲשֶׂה נָּ֣א לָ֔/נוּ לִ/בְנ֖וֹת אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ לֹ֥א לְ/עוֹלָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א לְ/זָֽבַח
verses.translit: vn'mr n'shh n' lnv lbnvt 't hmzbch l' l'vlh vl' lzbch
verses.translation: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

verses.original: כִּי֩ עֵ֨ד ה֜וּא בֵּינֵ֣י/נוּ וּ/בֵינֵי/כֶ֗ם וּ/בֵ֣ין דֹּרוֹתֵי/נוּ֮ אַחֲרֵי/נוּ֒ לַ/עֲבֹ֞ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו בְּ/עֹלוֹתֵ֥י/נוּ וּ/בִ/זְבָחֵ֖י/נוּ וּ/בִ/שְׁלָמֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/לֹא יֹאמְר֨וּ בְנֵי/כֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ לְ/בָנֵ֔י/נוּ אֵין לָ/כֶ֥ם חֵ֖לֶק בַּ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'd hv' bynynv vbynykhm vbyn drvtynv 'chrynv l'bd 't 'bdt yhvh lpnyv b'lvtynv vbzbchynv vbshlmynv vl' y'mrv bnykhm mchr lbnynv 'yn lkhm chlq byhvh
verses.translation: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/נֹּ֕אמֶר וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּֽי יֹאמְר֥וּ אֵלֵ֛י/נוּ וְ/אֶל דֹּרֹתֵ֖י/נוּ מָחָ֑ר וְ/אָמַ֡רְנוּ רְא֣וּ אֶת תַּבְנִית֩ מִזְבַּ֨ח יְהוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֗י/נוּ לֹ֤א לְ/עוֹלָה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א לְ/זֶ֔בַח כִּי עֵ֣ד ה֔וּא בֵּינֵ֖י/נוּ וּ/בֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vn'mr vhyh khy y'mrv 'lynv v'l drtynv mchr v'mrnv r'v 't tbnyt mzbch yhvh 'shr 'shv 'bvtynv l' l'vlh vl' lzbch khy 'd hv' bynynv vbynykhm
verses.translation: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again , Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD , which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.

verses.original: חָלִילָ/ה֩ לָּ֨/נוּ מִמֶּ֜/נּוּ לִ/מְרֹ֣ד בַּֽ/יהוָ֗ה וְ/לָ/שׁ֤וּב הַ/יּוֹם֙ מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לִ/בְנ֣וֹת מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לְ/עֹלָ֖ה לְ/מִנְחָ֣ה וּ/לְ/זָ֑בַח מִ/לְּ/בַ֗ד מִזְבַּח֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י מִשְׁכָּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: chlylh lnv mmnv lmrd byhvh vlshvb hyvm m'chry yhvh lbnvt mzbch l'lh lmnchh vlzbch mlbd mzbch yhvh 'lhynv 'shr lpny mshkhnv
verses.translation: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD , and turn this day from following the LORD , to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֞ע פִּֽינְחָ֣ס הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וּ/נְשִׂיאֵ֨י הָ/עֵדָ֜ה וְ/רָאשֵׁ֨י אַלְפֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ אֶת הַ֨/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר דִּבְּר֛וּ בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֥ן וּ/בְנֵי גָ֖ד וּ/בְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַ/יִּיטַ֖ב בְּ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshm' pynchs hkhhn vnshy'y h'dh vr'shy 'lpy yshr'l 'shr 'tv 't hdbrym 'shr dbrv bny r'vbn vbny gd vbny mnshh vyytb b'ynyhm
verses.translation: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר פִּֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֡ן אֶל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֨ן וְ/אֶל בְּנֵי גָ֜ד וְ/אֶל בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה הַ/יּ֤וֹם יָדַ֨עְנוּ֙ כִּֽי בְ/תוֹכֵ֣/נוּ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא מְעַלְתֶּ֥ם בַּֽ/יהוָ֖ה הַ/מַּ֣עַל הַ/זֶּ֑ה אָ֗ז הִצַּלְתֶּ֛ם אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/יַּ֥ד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr pynchs bn 'l'zr hkhhn 'l bny r'vbn v'l bny gd v'l bny mnshh hyvm yd'nv khy btvkhnv yhvh 'shr l' m'ltm byhvh hm'l hzh 'z htsltm 't bny yshr'l myd yhvh
verses.translation: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD : now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב פִּֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן וְ/הַ/נְּשִׂיאִ֡ים מֵ/אֵ֣ת בְּנֵֽי רְאוּבֵן֩ וּ/מֵ/אֵ֨ת בְּנֵי גָ֜ד מֵ/אֶ֧רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָ֛ד אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּשִׁ֥בוּ אוֹתָ֖/ם דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vyshb pynchs bn 'l'zr hkhhn vhnshy'ym m't bny r'vbn vm't bny gd m'rts hgl'd 'l 'rts khn'n 'l bny yshr'l vyshbv 'vtm dbr
verses.translation: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

verses.original: וַ/יִּיטַ֣ב הַ/דָּבָ֗ר בְּ/עֵינֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יְבָרֲכ֥וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֣א אָמְר֗וּ לַ/עֲל֤וֹת עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א לְ/שַׁחֵת֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֥ן וּ/בְנֵי גָ֖ד יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyytb hdbr b'yny bny yshr'l vybrkhv 'lhym bny yshr'l vl' 'mrv l'lvt 'lyhm ltsb' lshcht 't h'rts 'shr bny r'vbn vbny gd yshbym bh
verses.translation: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּקְרְא֛וּ בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֥ן וּ/בְנֵי גָ֖ד לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כִּ֣י עֵ֥ד הוּא֙ בֵּֽינֹתֵ֔י/נוּ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyqr'v bny r'vbn vbny gd lmzbch khy 'd hv' byntynv khy yhvh h'lhym
verses.translation: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִ/יָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֧ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִ/כָּל אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֖ם מִ/סָּבִ֑יב וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy mymym rbym 'chry 'shr hnych yhvh lyshr'l mkhl 'ybyhm msbyb vyhvsh' zqn b' bymym
verses.translation: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ/זְקֵנָי/ו֙ וּ/לְ/רָאשָׁ֔י/ו וּ/לְ/שֹׁפְטָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/שֹֽׁטְרָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם אֲנִ֣י זָקַ֔נְתִּי בָּ֖אתִי בַּ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvsh' lkhl yshr'l lzqnyv vlr'shyv vlshptyv vlshtryv vy'mr 'lhm 'ny zqnty b'ty bymym
verses.translation: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֗ם אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֛ם לְ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֔ם ה֖וּא הַ/נִּלְחָ֥ם לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tm r'ytm 't khl 'shr 'shh yhvh 'lhykhm lkhl hgvym h'lh mpnykhm khy yhvh 'lhykhm hv' hnlchm lkhm
verses.translation: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God is he that hath fought for you.

verses.original: רְאוּ֩ הִפַּ֨לְתִּי לָ/כֶ֜ם אֶֽת הַ֠/גּוֹיִם הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֛לֶּה בְּ/נַחֲלָ֖ה לְ/שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֑ם מִן הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן וְ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְרַ֔תִּי וְ/הַ/יָּ֥ם הַ/גָּד֖וֹל מְב֥וֹא הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: r'v hplty lkhm 't hgvym hnsh'rym h'lh bnchlh lshbtykhm mn hyrdn vkhl hgvym 'shr hkhrty vhym hgdvl mbv' hshmsh
verses.translation: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.

verses.original: וַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֗ם ה֚וּא יֶהְדֳּפֵ֣/ם מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הוֹרִ֥ישׁ אֹתָ֖/ם מִ/לִּ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם וִֽ/ירִשְׁתֶּם֙ אֶת אַרְצָ֔/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhvh 'lhykhm hv' yhdpm mpnykhm vhvrysh 'tm mlpnykhm vyrshtm 't 'rtsm kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lhykhm lkhm
verses.translation: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.

verses.original: וַ/חֲזַקְתֶּ֣ם מְאֹ֔ד לִ/שְׁמֹ֣ר וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/כָּת֔וּב בְּ/סֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י סוּר מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ יָמִ֥ין וּ/שְׂמֹֽאול
verses.translit: vchzqtm m'd lshmr vl'shvt 't khl hkhtvb bspr tvrt mshh lblty svr mmnv ymyn vshm'vl
verses.translation: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

verses.original: לְ/בִלְתִּי בוֹא֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם וּ/בְ/שֵׁ֨ם אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֤ם לֹא תַזְכִּ֨ירוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֔יעוּ וְ/לֹ֣א תַעַבְד֔וּ/ם וְ/לֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: lblty bv' bgvym h'lh hnsh'rym h'lh 'tkhm vbshm 'lhyhm l' tzkhyrv vl' tshby'v vl' t'bdvm vl' tshtchvv lhm
verses.translation: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them , neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

verses.original: כִּ֛י אִם בַּ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם תִּדְבָּ֑קוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy 'm byhvh 'lhykhm tdbqv kh'shr 'shytm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֤וֹרֶשׁ יְהוָה֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם גּוֹיִ֖ם גְּדֹלִ֣ים וַ/עֲצוּמִ֑ים וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם לֹא עָ֤מַד אִישׁ֙ בִּ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyvrsh yhvh mpnykhm gvym gdlym v'tsvmym v'tm l' 'md 'ysh bpnykhm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day. …: or, Then the LORD will drive

verses.original: אִישׁ אֶחָ֥ד מִ/כֶּ֖ם יִרְדָּף אָ֑לֶף כִּ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֗ם ה֚וּא הַ/נִּלְחָ֣ם לָ/כֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'ysh 'chd mkhm yrdf 'lf khy yhvh 'lhykhm hv' hnlchm lkhm kh'shr dbr lkhm
verses.translation: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְ/נַפְשֹֽׁתֵי/כֶ֑ם לְ/אַהֲבָ֖ה אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vnshmrtm m'd lnpshtykhm l'hbh 't yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם שׁ֣וֹב תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ וּ/דְבַקְתֶּם֙ בְּ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הִֽתְחַתַּנְתֶּ֥ם בָּ/הֶ֛ם וּ/בָאתֶ֥ם בָּ/הֶ֖ם וְ/הֵ֥ם בָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'm shvb tshvbv vdbqtm bytr hgvym h'lh hnsh'rym h'lh 'tkhm vhtchtntm bhm vb'tm bhm vhm bkhm
verses.translation: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

verses.original: יָד֨וֹעַ֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוֹסִ֜יף יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֗ם לְ/הוֹרִ֛ישׁ אֶת הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה מִ/לִּ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָי֨וּ לָ/כֶ֜ם לְ/פַ֣ח וּ/לְ/מוֹקֵ֗שׁ וּ/לְ/שֹׁטֵ֤ט בְּ/צִדֵּי/כֶם֙ וְ/לִ/צְנִנִ֣ים בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֔ם עַד אֲבָדְ/כֶ֗ם מֵ֠/עַל הָ/אֲדָמָ֤ה הַ/טּוֹבָה֙ הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָ/כֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: ydv' td'v khy l' yvsyf yhvh 'lhykhm lhvrysh 't hgvym h'lh mlpnykhm vhyv lkhm lpch vlmvqsh vlshtt btsdykhm vltsnnym b'ynykhm 'd 'bdkhm m'l h'dmh htvbh hz't 'shr ntn lkhm yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י הוֹלֵךְ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם בְּ/דֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וִ/ידַעְתֶּ֞ם בְּ/כָל לְבַבְ/כֶ֣ם וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֗ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא נָפַל֩ דָּבָ֨ר אֶחָ֜ד מִ/כֹּ֣ל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הַ/טּוֹבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶם֙ עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם הַ/כֹּל֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ/כֶ֔ם לֹֽא נָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ דָּבָ֥ר אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vhnh 'nkhy hvlkh hyvm bdrkh khl h'rts vyd'tm bkhl lbbkhm vbkhl npshkhm khy l' npl dbr 'chd mkhl hdbrym htvbym 'shr dbr yhvh 'lhykhm 'lykhm hkhl b'v lkhm l' npl mmnv dbr 'chd
verses.translation: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁר בָּ֤א עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ כָּל הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/טּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם כֵּן֩ יָבִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הָ/רָ֔ע עַד הַשְׁמִיד֣/וֹ אוֹתְ/כֶ֗ם מֵ֠/עַל הָ/אֲדָמָ֤ה הַ/טּוֹבָה֙ הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָ/כֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr b' 'lykhm khl hdbr htvb 'shr dbr yhvh 'lhykhm 'lykhm khn yby' yhvh 'lykhm 't khl hdbr hr' 'd hshmydv 'vtkhm m'l h'dmh htvbh hz't 'shr ntn lkhm yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

verses.original: בְּ֠/עָבְרְ/כֶם אֶת בְּרִ֨ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶם֒ וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/חָרָ֤ה אַף יְהוָה֙ בָּ/כֶ֔ם וַ/אֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֔ה מֵ/עַל֙ הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר נָתַ֥ן לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: b'brkhm 't bryt yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr tsvh 'tkhm vhlkhtm v'bdtm 'lhym 'chrym vhshtchvytm lhm vchrh 'f yhvh bkhm v'bdtm mhrh m'l h'rts htvbh 'shr ntn lkhm
verses.translation: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֶסֹ֧ף יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת כָּל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁכֶ֑מָ/ה וַ/יִּקְרָא֩ לְ/זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּ/לְ/רָאשָׁ֗י/ו וּ/לְ/שֹֽׁפְטָי/ו֙ וּ/לְ/שֹׁ֣טְרָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sf yhvsh' 't khl shbty yshr'l shkhmh vyqr' lzqny yshr'l vlr'shyv vlshptyv vlshtryv vytytsbv lpny h'lhym
verses.translation: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֗ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֗ר יָשְׁב֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ מֵֽ/עוֹלָ֔ם תֶּ֛רַח אֲבִ֥י אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַ/אֲבִ֣י נָח֑וֹר וַ/יַּעַבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l khl h'm khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l b'br hnhr yshbv 'bvtykhm m'vlm trch 'by 'brhm v'by nchvr vy'bdv 'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

verses.original: וָ֠/אֶקַּח אֶת אֲבִי/כֶ֤ם אֶת אַבְרָהָם֙ מֵ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֔ר וָ/אוֹלֵ֥ךְ אוֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/כָל אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן ו/ארב וָ/אַרְבֶּה֙ אֶת זַרְע֔/וֹ וָֽ/אֶתֶּן ל֖/וֹ אֶת יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: v'qch 't 'bykhm 't 'brhm m'br hnhr v'vlkh 'vtv bkhl 'rts khn'n v'rb v'rbh 't zr'v v'tn lv 't ytschq
verses.translation: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתֵּ֣ן לְ/יִצְחָ֔ק אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְ/אֶת עֵשָׂ֑ו וָ/אֶתֵּ֨ן לְ/עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶת הַ֤ר שֵׂעִיר֙ לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת אוֹת֔/וֹ וְ/יַעֲקֹ֥ב וּ/בָנָ֖י/ו יָרְד֥וּ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'tn lytschq 't y'qb v't 'shv v'tn l'shv 't hr sh'yr lrsht 'vtv vy'qb vbnyv yrdv mtsrym
verses.translation: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁלַ֞ח אֶת מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְ/אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ וָ/אֶגֹּ֣ף אֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּ/קִרְבּ֑/וֹ וְ/אַחַ֖ר הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'shlch 't mshh v't 'hrn v'gf 't mtsrym kh'shr 'shyty bqrbv v'chr hvts'ty 'tkhm
verses.translation: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

verses.original: וָֽ/אוֹצִ֤יא אֶת אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וַ/תָּבֹ֖אוּ הַ/יָּ֑מָּ/ה וַ/יִּרְדְּפ֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם אַחֲרֵ֧י אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֛ם בְּ/רֶ֥כֶב וּ/בְ/פָרָשִׁ֖ים יַם סֽוּף
verses.translit: v'vtsy' 't 'bvtykhm mmtsrym vtb'v hymh vyrdpv mtsrym 'chry 'bvtykhm brkhb vbprshym ym svf
verses.translation: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם מַֽאֲפֵ֜ל בֵּינֵי/כֶ֣ם וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/מִּצְרִ֗ים וַ/יָּבֵ֨א עָלָ֤י/ו אֶת הַ/יָּם֙ וַ/יְכַסֵּ֔/הוּ וַ/תִּרְאֶ֨ינָה֙ עֵינֵי/כֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/תֵּשְׁב֥וּ בַ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vyts'qv 'l yhvh vyshm m'pl bynykhm vbyn hmtsrym vyb' 'lyv 't hym vykhshv vtr'ynh 'ynykhm 't 'shr 'shyty bmtsrym vtshbv bmdbr ymym rbym
verses.translation: And when they cried unto the LORD , he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

verses.original: ו/אבא/ה וָ/אָבִ֣יא אֶתְ/כֶ֗ם אֶל אֶ֤רֶץ הָ/אֱמֹרִי֙ הַ/יּוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַ/יִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם וָ/אֶתֵּ֨ן אוֹתָ֤/ם בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶם֙ וַ/תִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת אַרְצָ֔/ם וָ/אַשְׁמִידֵ֖/ם מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'b'h v'by' 'tkhm 'l 'rts h'mry hyvshb b'br hyrdn vylchmv 'tkhm v'tn 'vtm bydkhm vtyrshv 't 'rtsm v'shmydm mpnykhm
verses.translation: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם בָּלָ֤ק בֶּן צִפּוֹר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א לְ/בִלְעָ֥ם בֶּן בְּע֖וֹר לְ/קַלֵּ֥ל אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqm blq bn tspvr mlkh mv'b vylchm byshr'l vyshlch vyqr' lbl'm bn b'vr lqll 'tkhm
verses.translation: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֥א אָבִ֖יתִי לִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ לְ/בִלְעָ֑ם וַ/יְבָ֤רֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ֙ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וָ/אַצִּ֥ל אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/יָּדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' 'byty lshm' lbl'm vybrkh brvkh 'tkhm v'tsl 'tkhm mydv
verses.translation: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

verses.original: וַ/תַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֮ וַ/תָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל יְרִיחוֹ֒ וַ/יִּלָּחֲמ֣וּ בָ/כֶ֣ם בַּעֲלֵֽי יְ֠רִיחוֹ הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֨י וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֜י וְ/הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֗י וְ/הַֽ/חִתִּי֙ וְ/הַ/גִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י הַֽ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֑י וָ/אֶתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vt'brv 't hyrdn vtb'v 'l yrychv vylchmv bkhm b'ly yrychv h'mry vhprzy vhkhn'ny vhchty vhgrgshy hchvy vhybvsy v'tn 'vtm bydkhm
verses.translation: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁלַ֤ח לִ/פְנֵי/כֶם֙ אֶת הַ/צִּרְעָ֔ה וַ/תְּגָ֤רֶשׁ אוֹתָ/ם֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם שְׁנֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֑י לֹ֥א בְ/חַרְבְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֥א בְ/קַשְׁתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'shlch lpnykhm 't htsr'h vtgrsh 'vtm mpnykhm shny mlkhy h'mry l' bchrbkh vl' bqshtkh
verses.translation: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתֵּ֨ן לָ/כֶ֜ם אֶ֣רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יָגַ֣עְתָּ בָּ֗/הּ וְ/עָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא בְנִיתֶ֔ם וַ/תֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּ/הֶ֑ם כְּרָמִ֤ים וְ/זֵיתִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא נְטַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם אֹכְלִֽים
verses.translit: v'tn lkhm 'rts 'shr l' yg't bh v'rym 'shr l' bnytm vtshbv bhm khrmym vzytym 'shr l' nt'tm 'tm 'khlym
verses.translation: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה יְר֧אוּ אֶת יְהוָ֛ה וְ/עִבְד֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/תָמִ֣ים וּ/בֶֽ/אֱמֶ֑ת וְ/הָסִ֣ירוּ אֶת אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֩ עָבְד֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֜ם בְּ/עֵ֤בֶר הַ/נָּהָר֙ וּ/בְ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/עִבְד֖וּ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th yr'v 't yhvh v'bdv 'tv btmym vb'mt vhsyrv 't 'lhym 'shr 'bdv 'bvtykhm b'br hnhr vbmtsrym v'bdv 't yhvh
verses.translation: Now therefore fear the LORD , and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִם֩ רַ֨ע בְּֽ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֜ם לַ/עֲבֹ֣ד אֶת יְהוָ֗ה בַּחֲר֨וּ לָ/כֶ֣ם הַ/יּוֹם֮ אֶת מִ֣י תַעֲבֹדוּ/ן֒ אִ֣ם אֶת אֱלֹהִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר עָבְד֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ ב/עבר מֵ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֔ר וְ/אִם֙ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בְּ/אַרְצָ֑/ם וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י וּ/בֵיתִ֔/י נַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm r' b'ynykhm l'bd 't yhvh bchrv lkhm hyvm 't my t'bdvn 'm 't 'lhym 'shr 'bdv 'bvtykhm 'shr b'br m'br hnhr v'm 't 'lhy h'mry 'shr 'tm yshbym b'rtsm v'nkhy vbyty n'bd 't yhvh
verses.translation: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD , choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַן הָ/עָם֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר חָלִ֣ילָ/ה לָּ֔/נוּ מֵ/עֲזֹ֖ב אֶת יְהוָ֑ה לַ/עֲבֹ֖ד אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'n h'm vy'mr chlylh lnv m'zb 't yhvh l'bd 'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD , to serve other gods;

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ הוּא֩ הַ/מַּעֲלֶ֨ה אֹתָ֧/נוּ וְ/אֶת אֲבוֹתֵ֛י/נוּ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִ/בֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֑ים וַ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְ/עֵינֵ֗י/נוּ אֶת הָ/אֹת֤וֹת הַ/גְּדֹלוֹת֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְרֵ֗/נוּ בְּ/כָל הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֣כְנוּ בָ֔/הּ וּ/בְ/כֹל֙ הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָבַ֖רְנוּ בְּ/קִרְבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhynv hv' hm'lh 'tnv v't 'bvtynv m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym v'shr 'shh l'ynynv 't h'tvt hgdlvt h'lh vyshmrnv bkhl hdrkh 'shr hlkhnv bh vbkhl h'mym 'shr 'brnv bqrbm
verses.translation: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

verses.original: וַ/יְגָ֨רֶשׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת כָּל הָ/עַמִּ֗ים וְ/אֶת הָ/אֱמֹרִ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/פָּנֵ֑י/נוּ גַּם אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ נַעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כִּי ה֖וּא אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vygrsh yhvh 't khl h'mym v't h'mry yshb h'rts mpnynv gm 'nchnv n'bd 't yhvh khy hv' 'lhynv
verses.translation: And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD ; for he is our God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל הָ/עָ֗ם לֹ֤א תֽוּכְלוּ֙ לַ/עֲבֹ֣ד אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים קְדֹשִׁ֖ים ה֑וּא אֵֽל קַנּ֣וֹא ה֔וּא לֹֽא יִשָּׂ֥א לְ/פִשְׁעֲ/כֶ֖ם וּ/לְ/חַטֹּאותֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l h'm l' tvkhlv l'bd 't yhvh khy 'lhym qdshym hv' 'l qnv' hv' l' ysh' lpsh'khm vlcht'vtykhm
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD : for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תַֽעַזְבוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵכָ֑ר וְ/שָׁ֨ב וְ/הֵרַ֤ע לָ/כֶם֙ וְ/כִלָּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י אֲשֶׁר הֵיטִ֥יב לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy t'zbv 't yhvh v'bdtm 'lhy nkhr vshb vhr' lkhm vkhlh 'tkhm 'chry 'shr hytyb lkhm
verses.translation: If ye forsake the LORD , and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ לֹ֕א כִּ֥י אֶת יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲבֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr h'm 'l yhvsh' l' khy 't yhvh n'bd
verses.translation: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל הָ/עָ֗ם עֵדִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ בָּ/כֶ֔ם כִּֽי אַתֶּ֞ם בְּחַרְתֶּ֥ם לָ/כֶ֛ם אֶת יְהוָ֖ה לַ/עֲבֹ֣ד אוֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ עֵדִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l h'm 'dym 'tm bkhm khy 'tm bchrtm lkhm 't yhvh l'bd 'vtv vy'mrv 'dym
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD , to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה הָסִ֛ירוּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַ/נֵּכָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הַטּוּ֙ אֶת לְבַבְ/כֶ֔ם אֶל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'th hsyrv 't 'lhy hnkhr 'shr bqrbkhm vhtv 't lbbkhm 'l yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now therefore put away, said he , the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ נַעֲבֹ֔ד וּ/בְ/קוֹל֖/וֹ נִשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'm 'l yhvsh' 't yhvh 'lhynv n'bd vbqvlv nshm'
verses.translation: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרֹ֨ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ בְּרִ֛ית לָ/עָ֖ם בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם ל֛/וֹ חֹ֥ק וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֖ט בִּ/שְׁכֶֽם
verses.translit: vykhrt yhvsh' bryt l'm byvm hhv' vyshm lv chq vmshpt bshkhm
verses.translation: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֤ב יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה בְּ/סֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יִּקַּח֙ אֶ֣בֶן גְּדוֹלָ֔ה וַ/יְקִימֶ֣/הָ שָּׁ֔ם תַּ֚חַת הָֽ/אַלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/מִקְדַּ֥שׁ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vykhtb yhvsh' 't hdbrym h'lh bspr tvrt 'lhym vyqch 'bn gdvlh vyqymh shm tcht h'lh 'shr bmqdsh yhvh
verses.translation: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֗ם הִנֵּ֨ה הָ/אֶ֤בֶן הַ/זֹּאת֙ תִּֽהְיֶה בָּ֣/נוּ לְ/עֵדָ֔ה כִּֽי הִ֣יא שָׁמְעָ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל אִמְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עִמָּ֑/נוּ וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה בָ/כֶם֙ לְ/עֵדָ֔ה פֶּֽן תְּכַחֲשׁ֖וּ/ן בֵּ/אלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvsh' 'l khl h'm hnh h'bn hz't thyh bnv l'dh khy hy' shm'h 't khl 'mry yhvh 'shr dbr 'mnv vhyth bkhm l'dh pn tkhchshvn b'lhykhm
verses.translation: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֤ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לְ/נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvsh' 't h'm 'ysh lnchltv
verses.translation: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וַ/יָּ֛מָת יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן נ֖וּן עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה בֶּן מֵאָ֥ה וָ/עֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry hdbrym h'lh vymt yhvsh' bn nvn 'bd yhvh bn m'h v'shr shnym
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD , died, being an hundred and ten years old.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְּר֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ בִּ/גְב֣וּל נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ בְּ/תִמְנַת סֶ֖רַח אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/הַר אֶפְרָ֑יִם מִ/צְּפ֖וֹן לְ/הַר גָּֽעַשׁ
verses.translit: vyqbrv 'tv bgbvl nchltv btmnt srch 'shr bhr 'prym mtspvn lhr g'sh
verses.translation: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְ/כֹ֣ל יְמֵ֣י הַ/זְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדְע֗וּ אֵ֚ת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'bd yshr'l 't yhvh khl ymy yhvsh' vkhl ymy hzqnym 'shr h'rykhv ymym 'chry yhvsh' v'shr yd'v 't khl m'shh yhvh 'shr 'shh lyshr'l
verses.translation: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD , that he had done for Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עַצְמ֣וֹת י֠וֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱל֨וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל מִ/מִּצְרַיִם֮ קָבְר֣וּ בִ/שְׁכֶם֒ בְּ/חֶלְקַ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָנָ֧ה יַעֲקֹ֛ב מֵ/אֵ֛ת בְּנֵֽי חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּ/מֵאָ֣ה קְשִׂיטָ֑ה וַ/יִּֽהְי֥וּ לִ/בְנֵֽי יוֹסֵ֖ף לְ/נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: v't 'tsmvt yvsf 'shr h'lv bny yshr'l mmtsrym qbrv bshkhm bchlqt hshdh 'shr qnh y'qb m't bny chmvr 'by shkhm bm'h qshyth vyhyv lbny yvsf lnchlh
