verses.translation: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

verses.original: וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֖ן מֵ֑ת וַ/יִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֗/וֹ בְּ/גִבְעַת֙ פִּֽינְחָ֣ס בְּנ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּן ל֖/וֹ בְּ/הַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'l'zr bn 'hrn mt vyqbrv 'tv bgb't pynchs bnv 'shr ntn lv bhr 'prym
verses.translation: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַֽ/יִּשְׁאֲלוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּ/יהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מִ֣י יַעֲלֶה לָּ֧/נוּ אֶל הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֛י בַּ/תְּחִלָּ֖ה לְ/הִלָּ֥חֶם בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry mvt yhvsh' vysh'lv bny yshr'l byhvh l'mr my y'lh lnv 'l hkhn'ny btchlh lhlchm bv
verses.translation: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD , saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֣ה יַעֲלֶ֑ה הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh yhvdh y'lh hnh ntty 't h'rts bydv
verses.translation: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָה֩ לְ/שִׁמְע֨וֹן אָחִ֜י/ו עֲלֵ֧ה אִתִּ֣/י בְ/גוֹרָלִ֗/י וְ/נִֽלָּחֲמָה֙ בַּֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְ/הָלַכְתִּ֧י גַם אֲנִ֛י אִתְּ/ךָ֖ בְּ/גוֹרָלֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ אִתּ֖/וֹ שִׁמְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh lshm'vn 'chyv 'lh 'ty bgvrly vnlchmh bkhn'ny vhlkhty gm 'ny 'tkh bgvrlkh vylkh 'tv shm'vn
verses.translation: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת הַ/כְּנַעֲנִ֥י וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֖י בְּ/יָדָ֑/ם וַ/יַּכּ֣וּ/ם בְּ/בֶ֔זֶק עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vy'l yhvdh vytn yhvh 't hkhn'ny vhprzy bydm vykhvm bbzq 'shrt 'lpym 'ysh
verses.translation: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

verses.original: וַֽ֠/יִּמְצְאוּ אֶת אֲדֹנִ֥י בֶ֨זֶק֙ בְּ/בֶ֔זֶק וַ/יִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ בּ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּכּ֕וּ אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י וְ/אֶת הַ/פְּרִזִּֽי
verses.translit: vymts'v 't 'dny bzq bbzq vylchmv bv vykhv 't hkhn'ny v't hprzy
verses.translation: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨נָס֙ אֲדֹ֣נִי בֶ֔זֶק וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אַחֲרָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּאחֲז֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ וַֽ/יְקַצְּצ֔וּ אֶת בְּהֹנ֥וֹת יָדָ֖י/ו וְ/רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyns 'dny bzq vyrdpv 'chryv vy'chzv 'tv vyqtstsv 't bhnvt ydyv vrglyv
verses.translation: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹֽנִי בֶ֗זֶק שִׁבְעִ֣ים מְלָכִ֡ים בְּֽהֹנוֹת֩ יְדֵי/הֶ֨ם וְ/רַגְלֵי/הֶ֜ם מְקֻצָּצִ֗ים הָי֤וּ מְלַקְּטִים֙ תַּ֣חַת שֻׁלְחָנִ֔/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי כֵּ֥ן שִׁלַּם לִ֖/י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יְבִיאֻ֥/הוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַ/יָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'dny bzq shb'ym mlkhym bhnvt ydyhm vrglyhm mqtstsym hyv mlqtym tcht shlchny kh'shr 'shyty khn shlm ly 'lhym vyby'hv yrvshlm vymt shm
verses.translation: And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלָּחֲמ֤וּ בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָה֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יִּלְכְּד֣וּ אוֹתָ֔/הּ וַ/יַּכּ֖וּ/הָ לְ/פִי חָ֑רֶב וְ/אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר שִׁלְּח֥וּ בָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vylchmv bny yhvdh byrvshlm vylkhdv 'vth vykhvh lpy chrb v't h'yr shlchv b'sh
verses.translation: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֗ר יָֽרְדוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם בַּֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֑י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָ/הָ֔ר וְ/הַ/נֶּ֖גֶב וְ/הַ/שְּׁפֵלָֽה
verses.translit: v'chr yrdv bny yhvdh lhlchm bkhn'ny yvshb hhr vhngb vhshplh
verses.translation: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּ/חֶבְר֔וֹן וְ/שֵׁם חֶבְר֥וֹן לְ/פָנִ֖ים קִרְיַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֑ע וַ/יַּכּ֛וּ אֶת שֵׁשַׁ֥י וְ/אֶת אֲחִימַ֖ן וְ/אֶת תַּלְמָֽי
verses.translit: vylkh yhvdh 'l hkhn'ny hyvshb bchbrvn vshm chbrvn lpnym qryt 'rb' vykhv 't shshy v't 'chymn v't tlmy
verses.translation: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם אֶל יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּבִ֑יר וְ/שֵׁם דְּבִ֥יר לְ/פָנִ֖ים קִרְיַת סֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: vylkh mshm 'l yvshby dbyr vshm dbyr lpnym qryt spr
verses.translation: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר כָּלֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּ֥ה אֶת קִרְיַת סֵ֖פֶר וּ/לְכָדָ֑/הּ וְ/נָתַ֥תִּי ל֛/וֹ אֶת עַכְסָ֥ה בִתִּ֖/י לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr khlb 'shr ykhh 't qryt spr vlkhdh vntty lv 't 'khsh bty l'shh
verses.translation: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדָ/הּ֙ עָתְנִיאֵ֣ל בֶּן קְנַ֔ז אֲחִ֥י כָלֵ֖ב הַ/קָּטֹ֣ן מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֛/וֹ אֶת עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vylkhdh 'tny'l bn qnz 'chy khlb hqtn mmnv vytn lv 't 'khsh btv l'shh
verses.translation: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בְּ/בוֹאָ֗/הּ וַ/תְּסִיתֵ֨/הוּ֙ לִ/שְׁא֤וֹל מֵֽ/אֵת אָבִ֨י/הָ֙ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וַ/תִּצְנַ֖ח מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/חֲמ֑וֹר וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר לָ֥/הּ כָּלֵ֖ב מַה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyhy bbv'h vtsythv lsh'vl m't 'byh hshdh vttsnch m'l hchmvr vy'mr lh khlb mh lkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when she came to him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜/וֹ הָֽבָ/ה לִּ֣/י בְרָכָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ הַ/נֶּ֨גֶב֙ נְתַתָּ֔/נִי וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ה לִ֖/י גֻּלֹּ֣ת מָ֑יִם וַ/יִּתֶּן לָ֣/הּ כָּלֵ֗ב אֵ֚ת גֻּלֹּ֣ת עִלִּ֔ית וְ/אֵ֖ת גֻּלֹּ֥ת תַּחְתִּֽית
verses.translit: vt'mr lv hbh ly brkhh khy 'rts hngb nttny vntth ly glt mym vytn lh khlb 't glt 'lyt v't glt tchtyt
verses.translation: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י קֵינִי֩ חֹתֵ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה עָל֨וּ מֵ/עִ֤יר הַ/תְּמָרִים֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִדְבַּ֣ר יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/נֶ֣גֶב עֲרָ֑ד וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vbny qyny chtn mshh 'lv m'yr htmrym 't bny yhvdh mdbr yhvdh 'shr bngb 'rd vylkh vyshb 't h'm
verses.translation: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת שִׁמְע֣וֹן אָחִ֔י/ו וַ/יַּכּ֕וּ אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב צְפַ֑ת וַ/יַּחֲרִ֣ימוּ אוֹתָ֔/הּ וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שֵׁם הָ/עִ֖יר חָרְמָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh yhvdh 't shm'vn 'chyv vykhv 't hkhn'ny yvshb tspt vychrymv 'vth vyqr' 't shm h'yr chrmh
verses.translation: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֤ד יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת עַזָּ֣ה וְ/אֶת גְּבוּלָ֔/הּ וְ/אֶֽת אַשְׁקְל֖וֹן וְ/אֶת גְּבוּלָ֑/הּ וְ/אֶת עֶקְר֖וֹן וְ/אֶת גְּבוּלָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vylkhd yhvdh 't 'zh v't gbvlh v't 'shqlvn v't gbvlh v't 'qrvn v't gbvlh
verses.translation: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶתּ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֖רֶשׁ אֶת הָ/הָ֑ר כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְ/הוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/עֵ֔מֶק כִּי רֶ֥כֶב בַּרְזֶ֖ל לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh 't yhvdh vyrsh 't hhr khy l' lhvrysh 't yshby h'mq khy rkhb brzl lhm
verses.translation: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ לְ/כָלֵב֙ אֶת חֶבְר֔וֹן כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם אֶת שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י הָ/עֲנָֽק
verses.translit: vytnv lkhlb 't chbrvn kh'shr dbr mshh vyvrsh mshm 't shlshh bny h'nq
verses.translation: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/יְבוּסִי֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לֹ֥א הוֹרִ֖ישׁוּ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב הַ/יְבוּסִ֜י אֶת בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v't hybvsy yshb yrvshlm l' hvryshv bny bnymn vyshb hybvsy 't bny bnymn byrvshlm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֧וּ בֵית יוֹסֵ֛ף גַּם הֵ֖ם בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'lv byt yvsf gm hm byt 'l vyhvh 'mm
verses.translation: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Beth-el: and the LORD was with them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּתִ֥ירוּ בֵית יוֹסֵ֖ף בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֑ל וְ/שֵׁם הָ/עִ֥יר לְ/פָנִ֖ים לֽוּז
verses.translit: vytyrv byt yvsf bbyt 'l vshm h'yr lpnym lvz
verses.translation: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth-el. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְאוּ֙ הַ/שֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ יוֹצֵ֣א מִן הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֗/וֹ הַרְאֵ֤/נוּ נָא֙ אֶת מְב֣וֹא הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/עָשִׂ֥ינוּ עִמְּ/ךָ֖ חָֽסֶד
verses.translit: vyr'v hshmrym 'ysh yvts' mn h'yr vy'mrv lv hr'nv n' 't mbv' h'yr v'shynv 'mkh chsd
verses.translation: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְאֵ/ם֙ אֶת מְב֣וֹא הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר לְ/פִי חָ֑רֶב וְ/אֶת הָ/אִ֥ישׁ וְ/אֶת כָּל מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֖/וֹ שִׁלֵּֽחוּ
verses.translit: vyr'm 't mbv' h'yr vykhv 't h'yr lpy chrb v't h'ysh v't khl mshpchtv shlchv
verses.translation: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ הָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֶ֖רֶץ הַ/חִתִּ֑ים וַ/יִּ֣בֶן עִ֗יר וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמָ/הּ֙ ל֔וּז ה֣וּא שְׁמָ֔/הּ עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vylkh h'ysh 'rts hchtym vybn 'yr vyqr' shmh lvz hv' shmh 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא הוֹרִ֣ישׁ מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה אֶת בֵּית שְׁאָ֣ן וְ/אֶת בְּנוֹתֶי/הָ֮ וְ/אֶת תַּעְנַ֣ךְ וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֶי/הָ֒ וְ/אֶת ישב יֹשְׁבֵ֨י ד֜וֹר וְ/אֶת בְּנוֹתֶ֗י/הָ וְ/אֶת יוֹשְׁבֵ֤י יִבְלְעָם֙ וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת יוֹשְׁבֵ֥י מְגִדּ֖וֹ וְ/אֶת בְּנוֹתֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יּ֨וֹאֶל֙ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י לָ/שֶׁ֖בֶת בָּ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vl' hvrysh mnshh 't byt sh'n v't bnvtyh v't t'nkh v't bntyh v't yshb yshby dvr v't bnvtyh v't yvshby ybl'm v't bntyh v't yvshby mgdv v't bnvtyh vyv'l hkhn'ny lshbt b'rts hz't
verses.translation: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כִּֽי חָזַ֣ק יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י לָ/מַ֑ס וְ/הוֹרֵ֖ישׁ לֹ֥א הוֹרִישֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khy chzq yshr'l vyshm 't hkhn'ny lms vhvrysh l' hvryshv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.

verses.original: וְ/אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ לֹ֣א הוֹרִ֔ישׁ אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י הַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּ/גָ֑זֶר וַ/יֵּ֧שֶׁב הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֛י בְּ/קִרְבּ֖/וֹ בְּ/גָֽזֶר
verses.translit: v'prym l' hvrysh 't hkhn'ny hyvshb bgzr vyshb hkhn'ny bqrbv bgzr
verses.translation: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

verses.original: זְבוּלֻ֗ן לֹ֤א הוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י קִטְר֔וֹן וְ/אֶת יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י נַהֲלֹ֑ל וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ בְּ/קִרְבּ֔/וֹ וַ/יִּֽהְי֖וּ לָ/מַֽס
verses.translit: zbvln l' hvrysh 't yvshby qtrvn v't yvshby nhll vyshb hkhn'ny bqrbv vyhyv lms
verses.translation: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.

verses.original: אָשֵׁ֗ר לֹ֤א הוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י עַכּ֔וֹ וְ/אֶת יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י צִיד֑וֹן וְ/אֶת אַחְלָ֤ב וְ/אֶת אַכְזִיב֙ וְ/אֶת חֶלְבָּ֔ה וְ/אֶת אֲפִ֖יק וְ/אֶת רְחֹֽב
verses.translit: 'shr l' hvrysh 't yshby 'khv v't yvshby tsydvn v't 'chlb v't 'khzyb v't chlbh v't 'pyq v't rchb
verses.translation: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ הָ/אָ֣שֵׁרִ֔י בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֖י לֹ֥א הוֹרִישֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshb h'shry bqrb hkhn'ny yshby h'rts khy l' hvryshv
verses.translation: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.

verses.original: נַפְתָּלִ֗י לֹֽא הוֹרִ֞ישׁ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֤י בֵֽית שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ וְ/אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵית עֲנָ֔ת וַ/יֵּ֕שֶׁב בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֤י בֵֽית שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ וּ/בֵ֣ית עֲנָ֔ת הָי֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם לָ/מַֽס
verses.translit: nptly l' hvrysh 't yshby byt shmsh v't yshby byt 'nt vyshb bqrb hkhn'ny yshby h'rts vyshby byt shmsh vbyt 'nt hyv lhm lms
verses.translation: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became tributaries unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְחֲצ֧וּ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֛י אֶת בְּנֵי דָ֖ן הָ/הָ֑רָ/ה כִּי לֹ֥א נְתָנ֖/וֹ לָ/רֶ֥דֶת לָ/עֵֽמֶק
verses.translit: vylchtsv h'mry 't bny dn hhrh khy l' ntnv lrdt l'mq
verses.translation: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:

verses.original: וַ/יּ֤וֹאֶל הָֽ/אֱמֹרִי֙ לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת בְּ/הַר חֶ֔רֶס בְּ/אַיָּל֖וֹן וּ/בְ/שַֽׁעַלְבִ֑ים וַ/תִּכְבַּד֙ יַ֣ד בֵּית יוֹסֵ֔ף וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ לָ/מַֽס
verses.translit: vyv'l h'mry lshbt bhr chrs b'ylvn vbsh'lbym vtkhbd yd byt yvsf vyhyv lms
verses.translation: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

verses.original: וּ/גְבוּל֙ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י מִֽ/מַּעֲלֵ֖ה עַקְרַבִּ֑ים מֵ/הַ/סֶּ֖לַע וָ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vgbvl h'mry mm'lh 'qrbym mhsl' vm'lh
verses.translation: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַל מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֛ה מִן הַ/גִּלְגָּ֖ל אֶל הַ/בֹּכִ֑ים וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אַעֲלֶ֨ה אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם מִ/מִּצְרַ֗יִם וָ/אָבִ֤יא אֶתְ/כֶם֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי֙ לַ/אֲבֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וָ/אֹמַ֕ר לֹֽא אָפֵ֧ר בְּרִיתִ֛/י אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'l ml'kh yhvh mn hglgl 'l hbkhym vy'mr ''lh 'tkhm mmtsrym v'by' 'tkhm 'l h'rts 'shr nshb'ty l'btykhm v'mr l' 'pr bryty 'tkhm l'vlm
verses.translation: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם לֹֽא תִכְרְת֤וּ בְרִית֙ לְ/יֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את מִזְבְּחוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם תִּתֹּצ֑וּ/ן וְ/לֹֽא שְׁמַעְתֶּ֥ם בְּ/קֹלִ֖/י מַה זֹּ֥את עֲשִׂיתֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tm l' tkhrtv bryt lyvshby h'rts hz't mzbchvtyhm tttsvn vl' shm'tm bqly mh z't 'shytm
verses.translation: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אָמַ֔רְתִּי לֹֽא אֲגָרֵ֥שׁ אוֹתָ֖/ם מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָי֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ לְ/צִדִּ֔ים וֵ/אלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם יִהְי֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/מוֹקֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vgm 'mrty l' 'grsh 'vtm mpnykhm vhyv lkhm ltsdym v'lhyhm yhyv lkhm lmvqsh
verses.translation: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/דַבֵּ֞ר מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֶֽל כָּל בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ הָ/עָ֛ם אֶת קוֹלָ֖/ם וַ/יִּבְכּֽוּ
verses.translit: vyhy khdbr ml'kh yhvh 't hdbrym h'lh 'l khl bny yshr'l vysh'v h'm 't qvlm vybkhv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּקְרְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא בֹּכִ֑ים וַ/יִּזְבְּחוּ שָׁ֖ם לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr'v shm hmqvm hhv' bkhym vyzbchv shm lyhvh
verses.translation: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֥ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶת הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אִ֥ישׁ לְ/נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ לָ/רֶ֥שֶׁת אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvsh' 't h'm vylkhv bny yshr'l 'ysh lnchltv lrsht 't h'rts
verses.translation: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַבְד֤וּ הָ/עָם֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְ/כֹ֣ל יְמֵ֣י הַ/זְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשׁ֔וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָא֗וּ אֵ֣ת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'bdv h'm 't yhvh khl ymy yhvsh' vkhl ymy hzqnym 'shr h'rykhv ymym 'chry yhvshv' 'shr r'v 't khl m'shh yhvh hgdvl 'shr 'shh lyshr'l
verses.translation: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD , that he did for Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛מָת יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן נ֖וּן עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה בֶּן מֵאָ֥ה וָ/עֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vymt yhvsh' bn nvn 'bd yhvh bn m'h v'shr shnym
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD , died, being an hundred and ten years old.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְּר֤וּ אוֹת/וֹ֙ בִּ/גְב֣וּל נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ בְּ/תִמְנַת חֶ֖רֶס בְּ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם מִ/צְּפ֖וֹן לְ/הַר גָּֽעַשׁ
verses.translit: vyqbrv 'vtv bgbvl nchltv btmnt chrs bhr 'prym mtspvn lhr g'sh
verses.translation: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

verses.original: וְ/גַם֙ כָּל הַ/דּ֣וֹר הַ/ה֔וּא נֶאֶסְפ֖וּ אֶל אֲבוֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּקָם֩ דּ֨וֹר אַחֵ֜ר אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא יָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/גַם֙ אֶת הַֽ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vgm khl hdvr hhv' n'spv 'l 'bvtyv vyqm dvr 'chr 'chryhm 'shr l' yd'v 't yhvh vgm 't hm'shh 'shr 'shh lyshr'l
verses.translation: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD , nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת הַ/בְּעָלִֽים
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l 't hr' b'yny yhvh vy'bdv 't hb'lym
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD , and served Baalim:

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַזְב֞וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֗/ם הַ/מּוֹצִ֣יא אוֹתָ/ם֮ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַ/יֵּלְכ֞וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֗ים מֵ/אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽ/עַמִּים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיב֣וֹתֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יַּכְעִ֖סוּ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'zbv 't yhvh 'lhy 'bvtm hmvtsy' 'vtm m'rts mtsrym vylkhv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym m'lhy h'mym 'shr sbybvtyhm vyshtchvv lhm vykh'sv 't yhvh
verses.translation: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַזְב֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּעַבְד֥וּ לַ/בַּ֖עַל וְ/לָ/עַשְׁתָּרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'zbv 't yhvh vy'bdv lb'l vl'shtrvt
verses.translation: And they forsook the LORD , and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ/ם֙ בְּ/יַד שֹׁסִ֔ים וַ/יָּשֹׁ֖סּוּ אוֹתָ֑/ם וַֽ/יִּמְכְּרֵ֞/ם בְּ/יַ֤ד אֽוֹיְבֵי/הֶם֙ מִ/סָּבִ֔יב וְ/לֹֽא יָכְל֣וּ ע֔וֹד לַ/עֲמֹ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י אוֹיְבֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh byshr'l vytnm byd shsym vyshsv 'vtm vymkhrm byd 'vybyhm msbyb vl' ykhlv 'vd l'md lpny 'vybyhm
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

verses.original: בְּ/כֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָצְא֗וּ יַד יְהוָה֙ הָיְתָה בָּ֣/ם לְ/רָעָ֔ה כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לָ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֵּ֥צֶר לָ/הֶ֖ם מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: bkhl 'shr yts'v yd yhvh hyth bm lr'h kh'shr dbr yhvh vkh'shr nshb' yhvh lhm vytsr lhm m'd
verses.translation: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥קֶם יְהוָ֖ה שֹֽׁפְטִ֑ים וַ/יּ֣וֹשִׁיע֔וּ/ם מִ/יַּ֖ד שֹׁסֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqm yhvh shptym vyvshy'vm myd shsyhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֤ם אֶל שֹֽׁפְטֵי/הֶם֙ לֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ כִּ֣י זָנ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן הַ/דֶּ֜רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָלְכ֧וּ אֲבוֹתָ֛/ם לִ/שְׁמֹ֥עַ מִצְוֺת יְהוָ֖ה לֹא עָ֥שׂוּ כֵֽן
verses.translit: vgm 'l shptyhm l' shm'v khy znv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym vyshtchvv lhm srv mhr mn hdrkh 'shr hlkhv 'bvtm lshm' mtsvt yhvh l' 'shv khn
verses.translation: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD ; but they did not so.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי הֵקִ֨ים יְהוָ֥ה לָ/הֶם֮ שֹֽׁפְטִים֒ וְ/הָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ עִם הַ/שֹּׁפֵ֔ט וְ/הֽוֹשִׁיעָ/ם֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י הַ/שּׁוֹפֵ֑ט כִּֽי יִנָּחֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ מִ/נַּֽאֲקָתָ֔/ם מִ/פְּנֵ֥י לֹחֲצֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/דֹחֲקֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhy hqym yhvh lhm shptym vhyh yhvh 'm hshpt vhvshy'm myd 'ybyhm khl ymy hshvpt khy ynchm yhvh mn'qtm mpny lchtsyhm vdchqyhm
verses.translation: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בְּ/מ֣וֹת הַ/שּׁוֹפֵ֗ט יָשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ וְ/הִשְׁחִ֣יתוּ מֵֽ/אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם לָ/לֶ֗כֶת אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְ/עָבְדָ֖/ם וּ/לְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם לֹ֤א הִפִּ֨ילוּ֙ מִ/מַּ֣עַלְלֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/מִ/דַּרְכָּ֖/ם הַ/קָּשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vhyh bmvt hshvpt yshbv vhshchytv m'bvtm llkht 'chry 'lhym 'chrym l'bdm vlhshtchvt lhm l' hpylv mm'llyhm vmdrkhm hqshh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֜וּ הַ/גּ֣וֹי הַ/זֶּ֗ה אֶת בְּרִיתִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֣יתִי אֶת אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ לְ/קוֹלִֽ/י
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh byshr'l vy'mr y'n 'shr 'brv hgvy hzh 't bryty 'shr tsvyty 't 'bvtm vl' shm'v lqvly
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;

verses.original: גַּם אֲנִי֙ לֹ֣א אוֹסִ֔יף לְ/הוֹרִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם מִן הַ/גּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁר עָזַ֥ב יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: gm 'ny l' 'vsyf lhvrysh 'ysh mpnyhm mn hgvym 'shr 'zb yhvsh' vymt
verses.translation: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:

verses.original: לְמַ֛עַן נַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖/ם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲ/שֹׁמְרִ֣ים הֵם֩ אֶת דֶּ֨רֶךְ יְהוָ֜ה לָ/לֶ֣כֶת בָּ֗/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר שָׁמְר֥וּ אֲבוֹתָ֖/ם אִם לֹֽא
verses.translit: lm'n nsvt bm 't yshr'l hshmrym hm 't drkh yhvh llkht bm kh'shr shmrv 'bvtm 'm l'
verses.translation: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it , or not.

verses.original: וַ/יַּנַּ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י הוֹרִישָׁ֖/ם מַהֵ֑ר וְ/לֹ֥א נְתָנָ֖/ם בְּ/יַד יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ
verses.translit: vynch yhvh 't hgvym h'lh lblty hvryshm mhr vl' ntnm byd yhvsh'
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֤לֶּה הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִנִּ֣יחַ יְהוָ֔ה לְ/נַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖/ם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֚ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יָדְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: v'lh hgvym 'shr hnych yhvh lnsvt bm 't yshr'l 't khl 'shr l' yd'v 't khl mlchmvt khn'n
verses.translation: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

verses.original: רַ֗ק לְמַ֨עַן֙ דַּ֚עַת דֹּר֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/לַמְּדָ֖/ם מִלְחָמָ֑ה רַ֥ק אֲשֶׁר לְ/פָנִ֖ים לֹ֥א יְדָעֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: rq lm'n d't drvt bny yshr'l llmdm mlchmh rq 'shr lpnym l' yd'vm
verses.translation: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;

verses.original: חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וְ/כָל הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְ/הַ/צִּ֣ידֹנִ֔י וְ/הַ֣/חִוִּ֔י יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַ֣ר הַ/לְּבָנ֑וֹן מֵ/הַר֙ בַּ֣עַל חֶרְמ֔וֹן עַ֖ד לְב֥וֹא חֲמָֽת
verses.translit: chmsht srny plshtym vkhl hkhn'ny vhtsydny vhchvy yshb hr hlbnvn mhr b'l chrmvn 'd lbv' chmt
verses.translation: Namely , five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon unto the entering in of Hamath.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּהְי֕וּ לְ/נַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖/ם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָ/דַ֗עַת הֲ/יִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה אֶת אֲבוֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyhyv lnsvt bm 't yshr'l ld't hyshm'v 't mtsvt yhvh 'shr tsvh 't 'bvtm byd mshh
verses.translation: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD , which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יָשְׁב֖וּ בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֑י הַ/חִתִּ֤י וְ/הָֽ/אֱמֹרִי֙ וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֔י וְ/הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l yshbv bqrb hkhn'ny hchty vh'mry vhprzy vhchvy vhybvsy
verses.translation: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֨וּ אֶת בְּנוֹתֵי/הֶ֤ם לָ/הֶם֙ לְ/נָשִׁ֔ים וְ/אֶת בְּנוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם נָתְנ֣וּ לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqchv 't bnvtyhm lhm lnshym v't bnvtyhm ntnv lbnyhm vy'bdv 't 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶת הָ/רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַֽ/יִּשְׁכְּח֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת הַ/בְּעָלִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הָ/אֲשֵׁרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l 't hr' b'yny yhvh vyshkhchv 't yhvh 'lhyhm vy'bdv 't hb'lym v't h'shrvt
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD , and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽ/יִּמְכְּרֵ֗/ם בְּ/יַד֙ כּוּשַׁ֣ן רִשְׁעָתַ֔יִם מֶ֖לֶךְ אֲרַ֣ם נַהֲרָ֑יִם וַ/יַּעַבְד֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת כּוּשַׁ֥ן רִשְׁעָתַ֖יִם שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh byshr'l vymkhrm byd khvshn rsh'tym mlkh 'rm nhrym vy'bdv bny yshr'l 't khvshn rsh'tym shmnh shnym
verses.translation: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushan-rishathaim eight years.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְעֲק֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יָּ֨קֶם יְהוָ֥ה מוֹשִׁ֛יעַ לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַ/יּֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑/ם אֵ֚ת עָתְנִיאֵ֣ל בֶּן קְנַ֔ז אֲחִ֥י כָלֵ֖ב הַ/קָּטֹ֥ן מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vyz'qv bny yshr'l 'l yhvh vyqm yhvh mvshy' lbny yshr'l vyvshy'm 't 'tny'l bn qnz 'chy khlb hqtn mmnv
verses.translation: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD , the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֨י עָלָ֥י/ו רֽוּחַ יְהוָה֮ וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ אֶת כּוּשַׁ֥ן רִשְׁעָתַ֖יִם מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַ/תָּ֣עָז יָד֔/וֹ עַ֖ל כּוּשַׁ֥ן רִשְׁעָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vthy 'lyv rvch yhvh vyshpt 't yshr'l vyts' lmlchmh vytn yhvh bydv 't khvshn rsh'tym mlkh 'rm vt'z ydv 'l khvshn rsh'tym
verses.translation: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushan-rishathaim.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּ֖מָת עָתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן קְנַֽז
verses.translit: vtshqt h'rts 'rb'ym shnh vymt 'tny'l bn qnz
verses.translation: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּסִ֨פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יְחַזֵּ֨ק יְהוָ֜ה אֶת עֶגְל֤וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹאָב֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ל כִּֽי עָשׂ֥וּ אֶת הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyspv bny yshr'l l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh vychzq yhvh 't 'glvn mlkh mv'b 'l yshr'l 'l khy 'shv 't hr' b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD : and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֣ף אֵלָ֔י/ו אֶת בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן וַ/עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יַּךְ֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּֽירְשׁ֖וּ אֶת עִ֥יר הַ/תְּמָרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sf 'lyv 't bny 'mvn v'mlq vylkh vykh 't yshr'l vyyrshv 't 'yr htmrym
verses.translation: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַבְד֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת עֶגְל֣וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vy'bdv bny yshr'l 't 'glvn mlkh mv'b shmvnh 'shrh shnh
verses.translation: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְעֲק֣וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ אֶל יְהוָה֒ וַ/יָּקֶם֩ יְהוָ֨ה לָ/הֶ֜ם מוֹשִׁ֗יעַ אֶת אֵה֤וּד בֶּן גֵּרָא֙ בֶּן הַ/יְמִינִ֔י אִ֥ישׁ אִטֵּ֖ר יַד יְמִינ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֨וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל בְּ/יָד/וֹ֙ מִנְחָ֔ה לְ/עֶגְל֖וֹן מֶ֥לֶךְ מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vyz'qv bny yshr'l 'l yhvh vyqm yhvh lhm mvshy' 't 'hvd bn gr' bn hymyny 'ysh 'tr yd ymynv vyshlchv bny yshr'l bydv mnchh l'glvn mlkh mv'b
verses.translation: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD , the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַשׂ֩ ל֨/וֹ אֵה֜וּד חֶ֗רֶב וְ/לָ֛/הּ שְׁנֵ֥י פֵי֖וֹת גֹּ֣מֶד אָרְכָּ֑/הּ וַ/יַּחְגֹּ֤ר אוֹתָ/הּ֙ מִ/תַּ֣חַת לְ/מַדָּ֔י/ו עַ֖ל יֶ֥רֶךְ יְמִינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh lv 'hvd chrb vlh shny pyvt gmd 'rkhh vychgr 'vth mtcht lmdyv 'l yrkh ymynv
verses.translation: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה לְ/עֶגְל֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֑ב וְ/עֶגְל֕וֹן אִ֥ישׁ בָּרִ֖יא מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyqrb 't hmnchh l'glvn mlkh mv'b v'glvn 'ysh bry' m'd
verses.translation: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּלָּ֔ה לְ/הַקְרִ֖יב אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֑ה וַ/יְשַׁלַּח֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַ/מִּנְחָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr khlh lhqryb 't hmnchh vyshlch 't h'm nsh'y hmnchh
verses.translation: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.

verses.original: וְ/ה֣וּא שָׁ֗ב מִן הַ/פְּסִילִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶת הַ/גִּלְגָּ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר דְּבַר סֵ֥תֶר לִ֛/י אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הָ֔ס וַ/יֵּֽצְאוּ֙ מֵֽ/עָלָ֔י/ו כָּל הָ/עֹמְדִ֖ים עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhv' shb mn hpsylym 'shr 't hglgl vy'mr dbr str ly 'lykh hmlkh vy'mr hs vyts'v m'lyv khl h'mdym 'lyv
verses.translation: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

verses.original: וְ/אֵה֣וּד בָּ֣א אֵלָ֗י/ו וְ/הֽוּא יֹ֠שֵׁב בַּ/עֲלִיַּ֨ת הַ/מְּקֵרָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ֙ לְ/בַדּ֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵה֔וּד דְּבַר אֱלֹהִ֥ים לִ֖/י אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יָּ֖קָם מֵ/עַ֥ל הַ/כִּסֵּֽא
verses.translit: v'hvd b' 'lyv vhv' yshb b'lyt hmqrh 'shr lv lbdv vy'mr 'hvd dbr 'lhym ly 'lykh vyqm m'l hkhs'
verses.translation: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֵהוּד֙ אֶת יַ֣ד שְׂמֹאל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּח֙ אֶת הַ/חֶ֔רֶב מֵ/עַ֖ל יֶ֣רֶךְ יְמִינ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּתְקָעֶ֖/הָ בְּ/בִטְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch 'hvd 't yd shm'lv vyqch 't hchrb m'l yrkh ymynv vytq'h bbtnv
verses.translation: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א גַֽם הַ/נִּצָּ֜ב אַחַ֣ר הַ/לַּ֗הַב וַ/יִּסְגֹּ֤ר הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ בְּעַ֣ד הַ/לַּ֔הַב כִּ֣י לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ף הַ/חֶ֖רֶב מִ/בִּטְנ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א הַֽ/פַּרְשְׁדֹֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: vyb' gm hntsb 'chr hlhb vysgr hchlb b'd hlhb khy l' shlf hchrb mbtnv vyts' hprshdnh
verses.translation: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א אֵה֖וּד הַֽ/מִּסְדְּר֑וֹנָ/ה וַ/יִּסְגֹּ֞ר דַּלְת֧וֹת הָ/עַלִיָּ֛ה בַּעֲד֖/וֹ וְ/נָעָֽל
verses.translit: vyts' 'hvd hmsdrvnh vysgr dltvt h'lyh b'dv vn'l
verses.translation: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.

verses.original: וְ/ה֤וּא יָצָא֙ וַ/עֲבָדָ֣י/ו בָּ֔אוּ וַ/יִּרְא֕וּ וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה דַּלְת֥וֹת הָ/עֲלִיָּ֖ה נְעֻל֑וֹת וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אַ֣ךְ מֵסִ֥יךְ ה֛וּא אֶת רַגְלָ֖י/ו בַּ/חֲדַ֥ר הַ/מְּקֵרָֽה
verses.translit: vhv' yts' v'bdyv b'v vyr'v vhnh dltvt h'lyh n'lvt vy'mrv 'kh msykh hv' 't rglyv bchdr hmqrh
verses.translation: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.

verses.original: וַ/יָּחִ֣ילוּ עַד בּ֔וֹשׁ וְ/הְנֵּ֛ה אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ פֹתֵ֖חַ דַּלְת֣וֹת הָֽ/עֲלִיָּ֑ה וַ/יִּקְח֤וּ אֶת הַ/מַּפְתֵּ֨חַ֙ וַ/יִּפְתָּ֔חוּ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ אֲדֹ֣נֵי/הֶ֔ם נֹפֵ֥ל אַ֖רְצָ/ה מֵֽת
verses.translit: vychylv 'd bvsh vhnh 'ynnv ptch dltvt h'lyh vyqchv 't hmptch vyptchv vhnh 'dnyhm npl 'rtsh mt
verses.translation: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

verses.original: וְ/אֵה֥וּד נִמְלַ֖ט עַ֣ד הִֽתְמַהְמְהָ֑/ם וְ/הוּא֙ עָבַ֣ר אֶת הַ/פְּסִילִ֔ים וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֖ט הַ/שְּׂעִירָֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: v'hvd nmlt 'd htmhmhm vhv' 'br 't hpsylym vymlt hsh'yrth
verses.translation: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בְּ/בוֹא֔/וֹ וַ/יִּתְקַ֥ע בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/יֵּרְד֨וּ עִמּ֧/וֹ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִן הָ/הָ֖ר וְ/ה֥וּא לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy bbv'v vytq' bshvpr bhr 'prym vyrdv 'mv bny yshr'l mn hhr vhv' lpnyhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ רִדְפ֣וּ אַחֲרַ֔/י כִּֽי נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֧ה אֶת אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֛ם אֶת מוֹאָ֖ב בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶ֑ם וַ/יֵּרְד֣וּ אַחֲרָ֗י/ו וַֽ/יִּלְכְּד֞וּ אֶת מַעְבְּר֤וֹת הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ לְ/מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/לֹֽא נָתְנ֥וּ אִ֖ישׁ לַ/עֲבֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm rdpv 'chry khy ntn yhvh 't 'ybykhm 't mv'b bydkhm vyrdv 'chryv vylkhdv 't m'brvt hyrdn lmv'b vl' ntnv 'ysh l'br
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּ֨וּ אֶת מוֹאָ֜ב בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא כַּ/עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ אִ֔ישׁ כָּל שָׁמֵ֖ן וְ/כָל אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑יִל וְ/לֹ֥א נִמְלַ֖ט אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vykhv 't mv'b b't hhy' kh'shrt 'lpym 'ysh khl shmn vkhl 'ysh chyl vl' nmlt 'ysh
verses.translation: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.

verses.original: וַ/תִּכָּנַ֤ע מוֹאָב֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא תַּ֖חַת יַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/תִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָ/אָ֖רֶץ שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vtkhn' mv'b byvm hhv' tcht yd yshr'l vtshqt h'rts shmvnym shnh
verses.translation: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרָ֤י/ו הָיָה֙ שַׁמְגַּ֣ר בֶּן עֲנָ֔ת וַ/יַּ֤ךְ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ שֵֽׁשׁ מֵא֣וֹת אִ֔ישׁ בְּ/מַלְמַ֖ד הַ/בָּקָ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֥שַׁע גַּם ה֖וּא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'chryv hyh shmgr bn 'nt vykh 't plshtym shsh m'vt 'ysh bmlmd hbqr vysh' gm hv' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּסִ֨פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֵה֖וּד מֵֽת
verses.translit: vyspv bny yshr'l l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh v'hvd mt
verses.translation: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD , when Ehud was dead.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְכְּרֵ֣/ם יְהוָ֗ה בְּ/יַד֙ יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּ/חָצ֑וֹר וְ/שַׂר צְבָא/וֹ֙ סִֽיסְרָ֔א וְ/ה֥וּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בַּ/חֲרֹ֥שֶׁת הַגּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vymkhrm yhvh byd ybyn mlkh khn'n 'shr mlkh bchtsvr vshr tsb'v sysr' vhv' yvshb bchrsht hgvym
verses.translation: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֠י תְּשַׁ֨ע מֵא֤וֹת רֶֽכֶב בַּרְזֶל֙ ל֔/וֹ וְ֠/הוּא לָחַ֞ץ אֶת בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/חָזְקָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyts'qv bny yshr'l 'l yhvh khy tsh' m'vt rkhb brzl lv vhv' lchts 't bny yshr'l bchzqh 'shrym shnh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD : for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.

verses.original: וּ/דְבוֹרָה֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה נְבִיאָ֔ה אֵ֖שֶׁת לַפִּיד֑וֹת הִ֛יא שֹׁפְטָ֥ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִֽיא
verses.translit: vdbvrh 'shh nby'h 'sht lpydvt hy' shpth 't yshr'l b't hhy'
verses.translation: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

verses.original: וְ֠/הִיא יוֹשֶׁ֨בֶת תַּֽחַת תֹּ֜מֶר דְּבוֹרָ֗ה בֵּ֧ין הָ/רָמָ֛ה וּ/בֵ֥ין בֵּֽית אֵ֖ל בְּ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ אֵלֶ֛י/הָ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vhy' yvshbt tcht tmr dbvrh byn hrmh vbyn byt 'l bhr 'prym vy'lv 'lyh bny yshr'l lmshpt
verses.translation: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַ/תִּקְרָא֙ לְ/בָרָ֣ק בֶּן אֲבִינֹ֔עַם מִ/קֶּ֖דֶשׁ נַפְתָּלִ֑י וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו הֲ/לֹ֥א צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֵ֤ךְ וּ/מָֽשַׁכְתָּ֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר תָּב֔וֹר וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֣ עִמְּ/ךָ֗ עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ אִ֔ישׁ מִ/בְּנֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִ֖י וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֥י זְבֻלֽוּן
verses.translit: vtshlch vtqr' lbrq bn 'byn'm mqdsh nptly vt'mr 'lyv hl' tsvh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l lkh vmshkht bhr tbvr vlqcht 'mkh 'shrt 'lpym 'ysh mbny nptly vmbny zblvn
verses.translation: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

verses.original: וּ/מָשַׁכְתִּ֨י אֵלֶ֜י/ךָ אֶל נַ֣חַל קִישׁ֗וֹן אֶת סִֽיסְרָא֙ שַׂר צְבָ֣א יָבִ֔ין וְ/אֶת רִכְבּ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת הֲמוֹנ֑/וֹ וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/הוּ בְּ/יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vmshkhty 'lykh 'l nchl qyshvn 't sysr' shr tsb' ybyn v't rkhbv v't hmvnv vnttyhv bydkh
verses.translation: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ בָּרָ֔ק אִם תֵּלְכִ֥י עִמִּ֖/י וְ/הָלָ֑כְתִּי וְ/אִם לֹ֥א תֵלְכִ֛י עִמִּ֖/י לֹ֥א אֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh brq 'm tlkhy 'my vhlkhty v'm l' tlkhy 'my l' 'lkh
verses.translation: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֜אמֶר הָלֹ֧ךְ אֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֗/ךְ אֶ֚פֶס כִּי֩ לֹ֨א תִֽהְיֶ֜ה תִּֽפְאַרְתְּ/ךָ֗ עַל הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה הוֹלֵ֔ךְ כִּ֣י בְֽ/יַד אִשָּׁ֔ה יִמְכֹּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶת סִֽיסְרָ֑א וַ/תָּ֧קָם דְּבוֹרָ֛ה וַ/תֵּ֥לֶך עִם בָּרָ֖ק קֶֽדְשָׁ/ה
verses.translit: vt'mr hlkh 'lkh 'mkh 'ps khy l' thyh tp'rtkh 'l hdrkh 'shr 'th hvlkh khy byd 'shh ymkhr yhvh 't sysr' vtqm dbvrh vtlkh 'm brq qdshh
verses.translation: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

verses.original: וַ/יַּזְעֵ֨ק בָּרָ֜ק אֶת זְבוּלֻ֤ן וְ/אֶת נַפְתָּלִי֙ קֶ֔דְשָׁ/ה וַ/יַּ֣עַל בְּ/רַגְלָ֔י/ו עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אַלְפֵ֖י אִ֑ישׁ וַ/תַּ֥עַל עִמּ֖/וֹ דְּבוֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vyz'q brq 't zbvln v't nptly qdshh vy'l brglyv 'shrt 'lpy 'ysh vt'l 'mv dbvrh
verses.translation: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.

verses.original: וְ/חֶ֤בֶר הַ/קֵּינִי֙ נִפְרָ֣ד מִ/קַּ֔יִן מִ/בְּנֵ֥י חֹבָ֖ב חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֣ט אָהֳל֔/וֹ עַד אֵל֥וֹן ב/צענים בְּ/צַעֲנַנִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶת קֶֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vchbr hqyny nprd mqyn mbny chbb chtn mshh vyt 'hlv 'd 'lvn bts'nym bts'nnym 'shr 't qdsh
verses.translation: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֖דוּ לְ/סִֽיסְרָ֑א כִּ֥י עָלָ֛ה בָּרָ֥ק בֶּן אֲבִינֹ֖עַם הַר תָּבֽוֹר
verses.translit: vygdv lsysr' khy 'lh brq bn 'byn'm hr tbvr
verses.translation: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.

verses.original: וַ/יַּזְעֵ֨ק סִֽיסְרָ֜א אֶת כָּל רִכְבּ֗/וֹ תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֣כֶב בַּרְזֶ֔ל וְ/אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑/וֹ מֵ/חֲרֹ֥שֶׁת הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֶל נַ֥חַל קִישֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vyz'q sysr' 't khl rkhbv tsh' m'vt rkhb brzl v't khl h'm 'shr 'tv mchrsht hgvym 'l nchl qyshvn
verses.translation: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמֶר֩ דְּבֹרָ֨ה אֶל בָּרָ֜ק ק֗וּם כִּ֣י זֶ֤ה הַ/יּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת סִֽיסְרָא֙ בְּ/יָדֶ֔/ךָ הֲ/לֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה יָצָ֣א לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֵּ֤רֶד בָּרָק֙ מֵ/הַ֣ר תָּב֔וֹר וַ/עֲשֶׂ֧רֶת אֲלָפִ֛ים אִ֖ישׁ אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vt'mr dbrh 'l brq qvm khy zh hyvm 'shr ntn yhvh 't sysr' bydkh hl' yhvh yts' lpnykh vyrd brq mhr tbvr v'shrt 'lpym 'ysh 'chryv
verses.translation: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣הָם יְ֠הוָה אֶת סִֽיסְרָ֨א וְ/אֶת כָּל הָ/רֶ֧כֶב וְ/אֶת כָּל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֛ה לְ/פִי חֶ֖רֶב לִ/פְנֵ֣י בָרָ֑ק וַ/יֵּ֧רֶד סִֽיסְרָ֛א מֵ/עַ֥ל הַ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֖ה וַ/יָּ֥נָס בְּ/רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhm yhvh 't sysr' v't khl hrkhb v't khl hmchnh lpy chrb lpny brq vyrd sysr' m'l hmrkhbh vyns brglyv
verses.translation: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.

verses.original: וּ/בָרָ֗ק רָדַ֞ף אַחֲרֵ֤י הָ/רֶ֨כֶב֙ וְ/אַחֲרֵ֣י הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה עַ֖ד חֲרֹ֣שֶׁת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַ/יִּפֹּ֞ל כָּל מַחֲנֵ֤ה סִֽיסְרָא֙ לְ/פִי חֶ֔רֶב לֹ֥א נִשְׁאַ֖ר עַד אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vbrq rdf 'chry hrkhb v'chry hmchnh 'd chrsht hgvym vypl khl mchnh sysr' lpy chrb l' nsh'r 'd 'chd
verses.translation: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.

verses.original: וְ/סִֽיסְרָא֙ נָ֣ס בְּ/רַגְלָ֔י/ו אֶל אֹ֣הֶל יָעֵ֔ל אֵ֖שֶּׁת חֶ֣בֶר הַ/קֵּינִ֑י כִּ֣י שָׁל֗וֹם בֵּ֚ין יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ חָצ֔וֹר וּ/בֵ֕ין בֵּ֖ית חֶ֥בֶר הַ/קֵּינִֽי
verses.translit: vsysr' ns brglyv 'l 'hl y'l 'sht chbr hqyny khy shlvm byn ybyn mlkh chtsvr vbyn byt chbr hqyny
verses.translation: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּצֵ֣א יָעֵל֮ לִ/קְרַ֣את סִֽיסְרָא֒ וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו סוּרָ֧/ה אֲדֹנִ֛/י סוּרָ֥/ה אֵלַ֖/י אַל תִּירָ֑א וַ/יָּ֤סַר אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ הָ/אֹ֔הֱלָ/ה וַ/תְּכַסֵּ֖/הוּ בַּ/שְּׂמִיכָֽה
verses.translit: vtts' y'l lqr't sysr' vt'mr 'lyv svrh 'dny svrh 'ly 'l tyr' vysr 'lyh h'hlh vtkhshv bshmykhh
verses.translation: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלֶ֛י/הָ הַשְׁקִי/נִי נָ֥א מְעַט מַ֖יִם כִּ֣י צָמֵ֑אתִי וַ/תִּפְתַּ֞ח אֶת נֹ֧אוד הֶ/חָלָ֛ב וַ/תַּשְׁקֵ֖/הוּ וַ/תְּכַסֵּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh hshqyny n' m't mym khy tsm'ty vtptch 't n'vd hchlb vtshqhv vtkhshv
verses.translation: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔י/הָ עֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָ/אֹ֑הֶל וְ/הָיָה֩ אִם אִ֨ישׁ יָב֜וֹא וּ/שְׁאֵלֵ֗/ךְ וְ/אָמַ֛ר הֲ/יֵֽשׁ פֹּ֥ה אִ֖ישׁ וְ/אָמַ֥רְתְּ אָֽיִן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh 'md ptch h'hl vhyh 'm 'ysh ybv' vsh'lkh v'mr hysh ph 'ysh v'mrt 'yn
verses.translation: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֣ח יָעֵ֣ל אֵֽשֶׁת חֶ֠בֶר אֶת יְתַ֨ד הָ/אֹ֜הֶל וַ/תָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת הַ/מַּקֶּ֣בֶת בְּ/יָדָ֗/הּ וַ/תָּב֤וֹא אֵלָי/ו֙ בַּ/לָּ֔אט וַ/תִּתְקַ֤ע אֶת הַ/יָּתֵד֙ בְּ/רַקָּת֔/וֹ וַ/תִּצְנַ֖ח בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הֽוּא נִרְדָּ֥ם וַ/יָּ֖עַף וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vtqch y'l 'sht chbr 't ytd h'hl vtshm 't hmqbt bydh vtbv' 'lyv bl't vttq' 't hytd brqtv vttsnch b'rts vhv' nrdm vy'f vymt
verses.translation: Then Jael Heber’s wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה בָרָק֮ רֹדֵ֣ף אֶת סִֽיסְרָא֒ וַ/תֵּצֵ֤א יָעֵל֙ לִ/קְרָאת֔/וֹ וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ לֵ֣ךְ וְ/אַרְאֶ֔/ךָּ אֶת הָ/אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֵלֶ֔י/הָ וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה סִֽיסְרָא֙ נֹפֵ֣ל מֵ֔ת וְ/הַ/יָּתֵ֖ד בְּ/רַקָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhnh brq rdf 't sysr' vtts' y'l lqr'tv vt'mr lv lkh v'r'kh 't h'ysh 'shr 'th mbqsh vyb' 'lyh vhnh sysr' npl mt vhytd brqtv
verses.translation: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent , behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכְנַ֤ע אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא אֵ֖ת יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ כְּנָ֑עַן לִ/פְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhn' 'lhym byvm hhv' 't ybyn mlkh khn'n lpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֜לֶךְ יַ֤ד בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הָל֣וֹךְ וְ/קָשָׁ֔ה עַ֖ל יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ כְּנָ֑עַן עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְרִ֔יתוּ אֵ֖ת יָבִ֥ין מֶֽלֶךְ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vtlkh yd bny yshr'l hlvkh vqshh 'l ybyn mlkh khn'n 'd 'shr hkhrytv 't ybyn mlkh khn'n
verses.translation: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֣שַׁר דְּבוֹרָ֔ה וּ/בָרָ֖ק בֶּן אֲבִינֹ֑עַם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vtshr dbvrh vbrq bn 'byn'm byvm hhv' l'mr
verses.translation: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

verses.original: בִּ/פְרֹ֤עַ פְּרָעוֹת֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/הִתְנַדֵּ֖ב עָ֑ם בָּרֲכ֖וּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bpr' pr'vt byshr'l bhtndb 'm brkhv yhvh
verses.translation: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ מְלָכִ֔ים הַאֲזִ֖ינוּ רֹֽזְנִ֑ים אָֽנֹכִ֗י לַֽ/יהוָה֙ אָנֹכִ֣י אָשִׁ֔ירָה אֲזַמֵּ֕ר לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: shm'v mlkhym h'zynv rznym 'nkhy lyhvh 'nkhy 'shyrh 'zmr lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD ; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה בְּ/צֵאתְ/ךָ֤ מִ/שֵּׂעִיר֙ בְּ/צַעְדְּ/ךָ֙ מִ/שְּׂדֵ֣ה אֱד֔וֹם אֶ֣רֶץ רָעָ֔שָׁה גַּם שָׁמַ֖יִם נָטָ֑פוּ גַּם עָבִ֖ים נָ֥טְפוּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: yhvh bts'tkh msh'yr bts'dkh mshdh 'dvm 'rts r'shh gm shmym ntpv gm 'bym ntpv mym
verses.translation: LORD , when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.

verses.original: הָרִ֥ים נָזְל֖וּ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה זֶ֣ה סִינַ֔י מִ/פְּנֵ֕י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hrym nzlv mpny yhvh zh syny mpny yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: The mountains melted from before the LORD , even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: בִּ/ימֵ֞י שַׁמְגַּ֤ר בֶּן עֲנָת֙ בִּ/ימֵ֣י יָעֵ֔ל חָדְל֖וּ אֳרָח֑וֹת וְ/הֹלְכֵ֣י נְתִיב֔וֹת יֵלְכ֕וּ אֳרָח֖וֹת עֲקַלְקַלּֽוֹת
verses.translit: bymy shmgr bn 'nt bymy y'l chdlv 'rchvt vhlkhy ntybvt ylkhv 'rchvt 'qlqlvt
verses.translation: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.

verses.original: חָדְל֧וּ פְרָז֛וֹן בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חָדֵ֑לּוּ עַ֤ד שַׁ/קַּ֨מְתִּי֙ דְּבוֹרָ֔ה שַׁ/קַּ֥מְתִּי אֵ֖ם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: chdlv przvn byshr'l chdlv 'd shqmty dbvrh shqmty 'm byshr'l
verses.translation: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.

verses.original: יִבְחַר֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חֲדָשִׁ֔ים אָ֖ז לָחֶ֣ם שְׁעָרִ֑ים מָגֵ֤ן אִם יֵֽרָאֶה֙ וָ/רֹ֔מַח בְּ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: ybchr 'lhym chdshym 'z lchm sh'rym mgn 'm yr'h vrmch b'rb'ym 'lf byshr'l
verses.translation: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

verses.original: לִבִּ/י֙ לְ/חוֹקְקֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/מִּֽתְנַדְּבִ֖ים בָּ/עָ֑ם בָּרֲכ֖וּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lby lchvqqy yshr'l hmtndbym b'm brkhv yhvh
verses.translation: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD .

verses.original: רֹכְבֵי֩ אֲתֹנ֨וֹת צְחֹר֜וֹת יֹשְׁבֵ֧י עַל מִדִּ֛ין וְ/הֹלְכֵ֥י עַל דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִֽׂיחוּ
verses.translit: rkhby 'tnvt tschrvt yshby 'l mdyn vhlkhy 'l drkh shychv
verses.translation: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.

verses.original: מִ/קּ֣וֹל מְחַֽצְצִ֗ים בֵּ֚ין מַשְׁאַבִּ֔ים שָׁ֤ם יְתַנּוּ֙ צִדְק֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה צִדְקֹ֥ת פִּרְזֹנ֖/וֹ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָ֛ז יָרְד֥וּ לַ/שְּׁעָרִ֖ים עַם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mqvl mchtstsym byn msh'bym shm ytnv tsdqvt yhvh tsdqt prznv byshr'l 'z yrdv lsh'rym 'm yhvh
verses.translation: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD , even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.

verses.original: עוּרִ֤י עוּרִי֙ דְּבוֹרָ֔ה ע֥וּרִי ע֖וּרִי דַּבְּרִי שִׁ֑יר ק֥וּם בָּרָ֛ק וּֽ/שֲׁבֵ֥ה שֶׁבְיְ/ךָ֖ בֶּן אֲבִינֹֽעַם
verses.translit: 'vry 'vry dbvrh 'vry 'vry dbry shyr qvm brq vshbh shbykh bn 'byn'm
verses.translation: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.

verses.original: אָ֚ז יְרַ֣ד שָׂרִ֔יד לְ/אַדִּירִ֖ים עָ֑ם יְהוָ֕ה יְרַד לִ֖/י בַּ/גִּבּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: 'z yrd shryd l'dyrym 'm yhvh yrd ly bgbvrym
verses.translation: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.

verses.original: מִנִּ֣י אֶפְרַ֗יִם שָׁרְשָׁ/ם֙ בַּ/עֲמָלֵ֔ק אַחֲרֶ֥י/ךָ בִנְיָמִ֖ין בַּֽ/עֲמָמֶ֑י/ךָ מִנִּ֣י מָכִ֗יר יָֽרְדוּ֙ מְחֹ֣קְקִ֔ים וּ/מִ֨/זְּבוּלֻ֔ן מֹשְׁכִ֖ים בְּ/שֵׁ֥בֶט סֹפֵֽר
verses.translit: mny 'prym shrshm b'mlq 'chrykh bnymyn b'mmykh mny mkhyr yrdv mchqqym vmzbvln mshkhym bshbt spr
verses.translation: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.

verses.original: וְ/שָׂרַ֤/י בְּ/יִשָּׂשכָר֙ עִם דְּבֹרָ֔ה וְ/יִשָּׂשכָר֙ כֵּ֣ן בָּרָ֔ק בָּ/עֵ֖מֶק שֻׁלַּ֣ח בְּ/רַגְלָ֑י/ו בִּ/פְלַגּ֣וֹת רְאוּבֵ֔ן גְּדֹלִ֖ים חִקְקֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: vshry byshshkhr 'm dbrh vyshshkhr khn brq b'mq shlch brglyv bplgvt r'vbn gdlym chqqy lb
verses.translation: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.

verses.original: לָ֣/מָּה יָשַׁ֗בְתָּ בֵּ֚ין הַֽ/מִּשְׁפְּתַ֔יִם לִ/שְׁמֹ֖עַ שְׁרִק֣וֹת עֲדָרִ֑ים לִ/פְלַגּ֣וֹת רְאוּבֵ֔ן גְּדוֹלִ֖ים חִקְרֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: lmh yshbt byn hmshptym lshm' shrqvt 'drym lplgvt r'vbn gdvlym chqry lb
verses.translation: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.

verses.original: גִּלְעָ֗ד בְּ/עֵ֤בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ שָׁכֵ֔ן וְ/דָ֕ן לָ֥/מָּה יָג֖וּר אֳנִיּ֑וֹת אָשֵׁ֗ר יָשַׁב֙ לְ/ח֣וֹף יַמִּ֔ים וְ/עַ֥ל מִפְרָצָ֖י/ו יִשְׁכּֽוֹן
verses.translit: gl'd b'br hyrdn shkhn vdn lmh ygvr 'nyvt 'shr yshb lchvf ymym v'l mprtsyv yshkhvn
verses.translation: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.

verses.original: זְבֻל֗וּן עַ֣ם חֵרֵ֥ף נַפְשׁ֛/וֹ לָ/מ֖וּת וְ/נַפְתָּלִ֑י עַ֖ל מְרוֹמֵ֥י שָׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: zblvn 'm chrf npshv lmvt vnptly 'l mrvmy shdh
verses.translation: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.

verses.original: בָּ֤אוּ מְלָכִים֙ נִלְחָ֔מוּ אָ֤ז נִלְחֲמוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י כְנַ֔עַן בְּ/תַעְנַ֖ךְ עַל מֵ֣י מְגִדּ֑וֹ בֶּ֥צַע כֶּ֖סֶף לֹ֥א לָקָֽחוּ
verses.translit: b'v mlkhym nlchmv 'z nlchmv mlkhy khn'n bt'nkh 'l my mgdv bts' khsf l' lqchv
verses.translation: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.

verses.original: מִן שָׁמַ֖יִם נִלְחָ֑מוּ הַ/כּֽוֹכָבִים֙ מִ/מְּסִלּוֹתָ֔/ם נִלְחֲמ֖וּ עִם סִיסְרָֽא
verses.translit: mn shmym nlchmv hkhvkhbym mmslvtm nlchmv 'm sysr'
verses.translation: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

verses.original: נַ֤חַל קִישׁוֹן֙ גְּרָפָ֔/ם נַ֥חַל קְדוּמִ֖ים נַ֣חַל קִישׁ֑וֹן תִּדְרְכִ֥י נַפְשִׁ֖/י עֹֽז
verses.translit: nchl qyshvn grpm nchl qdvmym nchl qyshvn tdrkhy npshy 'z
verses.translation: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.

verses.original: אָ֥ז הָלְמ֖וּ עִקְּבֵי ס֑וּס מִֽ/דַּהֲר֖וֹת דַּהֲר֥וֹת אַבִּירָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'z hlmv 'qby svs mdhrvt dhrvt 'byryv
verses.translation: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.

verses.original: א֣וֹרוּ מֵר֗וֹז אָמַר֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֹ֥רוּ אָר֖וֹר יֹשְׁבֶ֑י/הָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא בָ֨אוּ֙ לְ/עֶזְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְ/עֶזְרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/גִּבּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: 'vrv mrvz 'mr ml'kh yhvh 'rv 'rvr yshbyh khy l' b'v l'zrt yhvh l'zrt yhvh bgbvrym
verses.translation: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD , curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the LORD , to the help of the LORD against the mighty.

verses.original: תְּבֹרַךְ֙ מִ/נָּשִׁ֔ים יָעֵ֕ל אֵ֖שֶׁת חֶ֣בֶר הַ/קֵּינִ֑י מִ/נָּשִׁ֥ים בָּ/אֹ֖הֶל תְּבֹרָֽךְ
verses.translit: tbrkh mnshym y'l 'sht chbr hqyny mnshym b'hl tbrkh
verses.translation: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

verses.original: מַ֥יִם שָׁאַ֖ל חָלָ֣ב נָתָ֑נָה בְּ/סֵ֥פֶל אַדִּירִ֖ים הִקְרִ֥יבָה חֶמְאָֽה
verses.translit: mym sh'l chlb ntnh bspl 'dyrym hqrybh chm'h
verses.translation: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

verses.original: יָדָ/הּ֙ לַ/יָּתֵ֣ד תִּשְׁלַ֔חְנָה וִֽ/ימִינָ֖/הּ לְ/הַלְמ֣וּת עֲמֵלִ֑ים וְ/הָלְמָ֤ה סִֽיסְרָא֙ מָחֲקָ֣ה רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וּ/מָחֲצָ֥ה וְ/חָלְפָ֖ה רַקָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ydh lytd tshlchnh vymynh lhlmvt 'mlym vhlmh sysr' mchqh r'shv vmchtsh vchlph rqtv
verses.translation: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ין רַגְלֶ֔י/הָ כָּרַ֥ע נָפַ֖ל שָׁכָ֑ב בֵּ֤ין רַגְלֶ֨י/הָ֙ כָּרַ֣ע נָפָ֔ל בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֔ע שָׁ֖ם נָפַ֥ל שָׁדֽוּד
verses.translit: byn rglyh khr' npl shkhb byn rglyh khr' npl b'shr khr' shm npl shdvd
verses.translation: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

verses.original: בְּעַד֩ הַ/חַלּ֨וֹן נִשְׁקְפָ֧ה וַ/תְּיַבֵּ֛ב אֵ֥ם סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּעַ֣ד הָֽ/אֶשְׁנָ֑ב מַדּ֗וּעַ בֹּשֵׁ֤שׁ רִכְבּ/וֹ֙ לָ/ב֔וֹא מַדּ֣וּעַ אֶֽחֱר֔וּ פַּעֲמֵ֖י מַרְכְּבוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: b'd hchlvn nshqph vtybb 'm sysr' b'd h'shnb mdv' bshsh rkhbv lbv' mdv' 'chrv p'my mrkhbvtyv
verses.translation: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

verses.original: חַכְמ֥וֹת שָׂרוֹתֶ֖י/הָ תַּעֲנֶ֑ינָּה אַף הִ֕יא תָּשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרֶ֖י/הָ לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: chkhmvt shrvtyh t'nynh 'f hy' tshyb 'mryh lh
verses.translation: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֨א יִמְצְא֜וּ יְחַלְּק֣וּ שָׁלָ֗ל רַ֤חַם רַחֲמָתַ֨יִם֙ לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ גֶּ֔בֶר שְׁלַ֤ל צְבָעִים֙ לְ/סִ֣יסְרָ֔א שְׁלַ֥ל צְבָעִ֖ים רִקְמָ֑ה צֶ֥בַע רִקְמָתַ֖יִם לְ/צַוְּארֵ֥י שָׁלָֽל
verses.translit: hl' ymts'v ychlqv shll rchm rchmtym lr'sh gbr shll tsb'ym lsysr' shll tsb'ym rqmh tsb' rqmtym ltsv'ry shll
verses.translation: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?

verses.original: כֵּ֠ן יֹאבְד֤וּ כָל אוֹיְבֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֹ֣הֲבָ֔י/ו כְּ/צֵ֥את הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ בִּ/גְבֻרָת֑/וֹ וַ/תִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: khn y'bdv khl 'vybykh yhvh v'hbyv khts't hshmsh bgbrtv vtshqt h'rts 'rb'ym shnh
verses.translation: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD : but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֧וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֧/ם יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יַד מִדְיָ֖ן שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l hr' b'yny yhvh vytnm yhvh byd mdyn shb' shnym
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD : and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֥עָז יַד מִדְיָ֖ן עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ/פְּנֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן עָשֽׂוּ לָ/הֶ֣ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת הַ/מִּנְהָרוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֶּֽ/הָרִ֔ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּעָר֖וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּצָדֽוֹת
verses.translit: vt'z yd mdyn 'l yshr'l mpny mdyn 'shv lhm bny yshr'l 't hmnhrvt 'shr bhrym v't hm'rvt v't hmtsdvt
verses.translation: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֖ה אִם זָרַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/עָלָ֨ה מִדְיָ֧ן וַֽ/עֲמָלֵ֛ק וּ/בְנֵי קֶ֖דֶם וְ/עָל֥וּ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhyh 'm zr' yshr'l v'lh mdyn v'mlq vbny qdm v'lv 'lyv
verses.translation: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;

verses.original: וַ/יַּחֲנ֣וּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם וַ/יַּשְׁחִ֨יתוּ֙ אֶת יְב֣וּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ עַד בּוֹאֲ/ךָ֖ עַזָּ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא יַשְׁאִ֤ירוּ מִֽחְיָה֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/שֶׂ֥ה וָ/שׁ֖וֹר וַ/חֲמֽוֹר
verses.translit: vychnv 'lyhm vyshchytv 't ybvl h'rts 'd bv'kh 'zh vl' ysh'yrv mchyh byshr'l vshh vshvr vchmvr
verses.translation: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.

verses.original: כִּ֡י הֵם֩ וּ/מִקְנֵי/הֶ֨ם יַעֲל֜וּ וְ/אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֗ם יבאו וּ/בָ֤אוּ כְ/דֵֽי אַרְבֶּה֙ לָ/רֹ֔ב וְ/לָ/הֶ֥ם וְ/לִ/גְמַלֵּי/הֶ֖ם אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ בָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/שַׁחֲתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy hm vmqnyhm y'lv v'hlyhm yb'v vb'v khdy 'rbh lrb vlhm vlgmlyhm 'yn mspr vyb'v b'rts lshchth
verses.translation: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּדַּ֧ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מְאֹ֖ד מִ/פְּנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֑ן וַ/יִּזְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vydl yshr'l m'd mpny mdyn vyz'qv bny yshr'l 'l yhvh
verses.translation: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כִּֽי זָעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְהוָ֑ה עַ֖ל אֹד֥וֹת מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: vyhy khy z'qv bny yshr'l 'l yhvh 'l 'dvt mdyn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֧ח יְהוָ֛ה אִ֥ישׁ נָבִ֖יא אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לָ/הֶ֜ם כֹּה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָנֹכִ֞י הֶעֱלֵ֤יתִי אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וָ/אֹצִ֥יא אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/בֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh 'ysh nby' 'l bny yshr'l vy'mr lhm khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'nkhy h'lyty 'tkhm mmtsrym v'tsy' 'tkhm mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: That the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;

verses.original: וָ/אַצִּ֤ל אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/מִ/יַּ֖ד כָּל לֹחֲצֵי/כֶ֑ם וָ/אֲגָרֵ֤שׁ אוֹתָ/ם֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם וָ/אֶתְּנָ֥/ה לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת אַרְצָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'tsl 'tkhm myd mtsrym vmyd khl lchtsykhm v'grsh 'vtm mpnykhm v'tnh lkhm 't 'rtsm
verses.translation: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;

verses.original: וָ/אֹמְרָ֣/ה לָ/כֶ֗ם אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֔ם לֹ֤א תִֽירְאוּ֙ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יוֹשְׁבִ֣ים בְּ/אַרְצָ֑/ם וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּ/קוֹלִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'mrh lkhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm l' tyr'v 't 'lhy h'mry 'shr 'tm yvshbym b'rtsm vl' shm'tm bqvly
verses.translation: And I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֞א מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ תַּ֤חַת הָֽ/אֵלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/עָפְרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/יוֹאָ֖שׁ אֲבִ֣י הָֽעֶזְרִ֑י וְ/גִדְע֣וֹן בְּנ֗/וֹ חֹבֵ֤ט חִטִּים֙ בַּ/גַּ֔ת לְ/הָנִ֖יס מִ/פְּנֵ֥י מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: vyb' ml'kh yhvh vyshb tcht h'lh 'shr b'prh 'shr lyv'sh 'by h'zry vgd'vn bnv chbt chtym bgt lhnys mpny mdyn
verses.translation: And there came an angel of the LORD , and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi-ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֥א אֵלָ֖י/ו מַלְּאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו יְהוָ֥ה עִמְּ/ךָ֖ גִּבּ֥וֹר הֶ/חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyv ml'kh yhvh vy'mr 'lyv yhvh 'mkh gbvr hchyl
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֤י/ו גִּדְעוֹן֙ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔/י וְ/יֵ֤שׁ יְהוָה֙ עִמָּ֔/נוּ וְ/לָ֥/מָּה מְצָאַ֖תְ/נוּ כָּל זֹ֑את וְ/אַיֵּ֣ה כָֽל נִפְלְאֹתָ֡י/ו אֲשֶׁר֩ סִפְּרוּ לָ֨/נוּ אֲבוֹתֵ֜י/נוּ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הֲ/לֹ֤א מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ הֶעֱלָ֣/נוּ יְהוָ֔ה וְ/עַתָּה֙ נְטָשָׁ֣/נוּ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/נוּ בְּ/כַף מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv gd'vn by 'dny vysh yhvh 'mnv vlmh mts'tnv khl z't v'yh khl npl'tyv 'shr sprv lnv 'bvtynv l'mr hl' mmtsrym h'lnv yhvh v'th ntshnv yhvh vytnnv bkhf mdyn
verses.translation: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤פֶן אֵלָי/ו֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לֵ֚ךְ בְּ/כֹחֲ/ךָ֣ זֶ֔ה וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתָּ֥ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/כַּ֣ף מִדְיָ֑ן הֲ/לֹ֖א שְׁלַחְתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vypn 'lyv yhvh vy'mr lkh bkhchkh zh vhvsh't 't yshr'l mkhf mdyn hl' shlchtykh
verses.translation: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנָ֔/י בַּ/מָּ֥ה אוֹשִׁ֖יעַ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנֵּ֤ה אַלְפִּ/י֙ הַ/דַּ֣ל בִּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה וְ/אָנֹכִ֥י הַ/צָּעִ֖יר בְּ/בֵ֥ית אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv by 'dny bmh 'vshy' 't yshr'l hnh 'lpy hdl bmnshh v'nkhy hts'yr bbyt 'by
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אֶהְיֶ֖ה עִמָּ֑/ךְ וְ/הִכִּיתָ֥ אֶת מִדְיָ֖ן כְּ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv yhvh khy 'hyh 'mkh vhkhyt 't mdyn kh'ysh 'chd
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו אִם נָ֛א מָצָ֥אתִי חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ לִּ/י֙ א֔וֹת שָׁ/אַתָּ֖ה מְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'm n' mts'ty chn b'ynykh v'shyt ly 'vt sh'th mdbr 'my
verses.translation: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.

verses.original: אַל נָ֨א תָמֻ֤שׁ מִ/זֶּה֙ עַד בֹּאִ֣/י אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הֹֽצֵאתִי֙ אֶת מִנְחָתִ֔/י וְ/הִנַּחְתִּ֖י לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר אָנֹכִ֥י אֵשֵׁ֖ב עַ֥ד שׁוּבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l n' tmsh mzh 'd b'y 'lykh vhts'ty 't mnchty vhnchty lpnykh vy'mr 'nkhy 'shb 'd shvbkh
verses.translation: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.

verses.original: וְ/גִדְע֣וֹן בָּ֗א וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ גְּדִֽי עִזִּים֙ וְ/אֵיפַת קֶ֣מַח מַצּ֔וֹת הַ/בָּשָׂר֙ שָׂ֣ם בַּ/סַּ֔ל וְ/הַ/מָּרַ֖ק שָׂ֣ם בַּ/פָּר֑וּר וַ/יּוֹצֵ֥א אֵלָ֛י/ו אֶל תַּ֥חַת הָ/אֵלָ֖ה וַ/יַּגַּֽשׁ
verses.translit: vgd'vn b' vy'sh gdy 'zym v'ypt qmch mtsvt hbshr shm bsl vhmrq shm bprvr vyvts' 'lyv 'l tcht h'lh vygsh
verses.translation: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו מַלְאַ֣ךְ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים קַ֣ח אֶת הַ/בָּשָׂ֤ר וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּצּוֹת֙ וְ/הַנַּח֙ אֶל הַ/סֶּ֣לַע הַלָּ֔ז וְ/אֶת הַ/מָּרַ֖ק שְׁפ֑וֹךְ וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv ml'kh h'lhym qch 't hbshr v't hmtsvt vhnch 'l hsl' hlz v't hmrq shpvkh vy'sh khn
verses.translation: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה אֶת קְצֵ֤ה הַ/מִּשְׁעֶ֨נֶת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וַ/יִּגַּ֥ע בַּ/בָּשָׂ֖ר וּ/בַ/מַּצּ֑וֹת וַ/תַּ֨עַל הָ/אֵ֜שׁ מִן הַ/צּ֗וּר וַ/תֹּ֤אכַל אֶת הַ/בָּשָׂר֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּצּ֔וֹת וּ/מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה הָלַ֖ךְ מֵ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshlch ml'kh yhvh 't qtsh hmsh'nt 'shr bydv vyg' bbshr vbmtsvt vt'l h'sh mn htsvr vt'khl 't hbshr v't hmtsvt vml'kh yhvh hlkh m'ynyv
verses.translation: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא גִּדְע֔וֹן כִּֽי מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה ה֑וּא וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר גִּדְע֗וֹן אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה כִּֽי עַל כֵּ֤ן רָאִ֨יתִי֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה פָּנִ֖ים אֶל פָּנִֽים
verses.translit: vyr' gd'vn khy ml'kh yhvh hv' vy'mr gd'vn 'hh 'dny yhvh khy 'l khn r'yty ml'kh yhvh pnym 'l pnym
verses.translation: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the LORD , Gideon said, Alas, O Lord GOD ! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר ל֧/וֹ יְהוָ֛ה שָׁל֥וֹם לְ/ךָ֖ אַל תִּירָ֑א לֹ֖א תָּמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mr lv yhvh shlvm lkh 'l tyr' l' tmvt
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבֶן֩ שָׁ֨ם גִּדְע֤וֹן מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרָא ל֥/וֹ יְהוָ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם עַ֚ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה עוֹדֶ֕/נּוּ בְּ/עָפְרָ֖ת אֲבִ֥י הָעֶזְרִֽי
verses.translit: vybn shm gd'vn mzbch lyhvh vyqr' lv yhvh shlvm 'd hyvm hzh 'vdnv b'prt 'by h'zry
verses.translation: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD , and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites. send peace

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֮ בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/הוּא֒ וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣/וֹ יְהוָ֗ה קַ֤ח אֶת פַּר הַ/שּׁוֹר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/אָבִ֔י/ךָ וּ/פַ֥ר הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖י שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וְ/הָרַסְתָּ֗ אֶת מִזְבַּ֤ח הַ/בַּ֨עַל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/אָבִ֔י/ךָ וְ/אֶת הָ/אֲשֵׁרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר עָלָ֖י/ו תִּכְרֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhy blylh hhv' vy'mr lv yhvh qch 't pr hshvr 'shr l'bykh vpr hshny shb' shnym vhrst 't mzbch hb'l 'shr l'bykh v't h'shrh 'shr 'lyv tkhrt
verses.translation: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father’s young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:

verses.original: וּ/בָנִ֨יתָ מִזְבֵּ֜חַ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ עַ֣ל רֹ֧אשׁ הַ/מָּע֛וֹז הַ/זֶּ֖ה בַּ/מַּֽעֲרָכָ֑ה וְ/לָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/פָּ֣ר הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י וְ/הַעֲלִ֣יתָ עוֹלָ֔ה בַּ/עֲצֵ֥י הָ/אֲשֵׁרָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּכְרֹֽת
verses.translit: vbnyt mzbch lyhvh 'lhykh 'l r'sh hm'vz hzh bm'rkhh vlqcht 't hpr hshny vh'lyt 'vlh b'tsy h'shrh 'shr tkhrt
verses.translation: And build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח גִּדְע֜וֹן עֲשָׂרָ֤ה אֲנָשִׁים֙ מֵֽ/עֲבָדָ֔י/ו וַ/יַּ֕עַשׂ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלָ֖י/ו יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֡י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָרֵא֩ אֶת בֵּ֨ית אָבִ֜י/ו וְ/אֶת אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָ/עִ֛יר מֵ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת יוֹמָ֖ם וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vyqch gd'vn 'shrh 'nshym m'bdyv vy'sh kh'shr dbr 'lyv yhvh vyhy kh'shr yr' 't byt 'byv v't 'nshy h'yr m'shvt yvmm vy'sh lylh
verses.translation: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father’s household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֜ימוּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָ/עִיר֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה נֻתַּץ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/בַּ֔עַל וְ/הָ/אֲשֵׁרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר עָלָ֖י/ו כֹּרָ֑תָה וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/פָּ֣ר הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י הֹֽעֲלָ֔ה עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ הַ/בָּנֽוּי
verses.translit: vyshkhymv 'nshy h'yr bbqr vhnh ntts mzbch hb'l vh'shrh 'shr 'lyv khrth v't hpr hshny h'lh 'l hmzbch hbnvy
verses.translation: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֔/הוּ מִ֥י עָשָׂ֖ה הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַֽ/יִּדְרְשׁוּ֙ וַ/יְבַקְשׁ֔וּ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ גִּדְעוֹן֙ בֶּן יוֹאָ֔שׁ עָשָׂ֖ה הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'l r'hv my 'shh hdbr hzh vydrshv vybqshv vy'mrv gd'vn bn yv'sh 'shh hdbr hzh
verses.translation: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָ/עִיר֙ אֶל יוֹאָ֔שׁ הוֹצֵ֥א אֶת בִּנְ/ךָ֖ וְ/יָמֹ֑ת כִּ֤י נָתַץ֙ אֶת מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/בַּ֔עַל וְ/כִ֥י כָרַ֖ת הָ/אֲשֵׁרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'nshy h'yr 'l yv'sh hvts' 't bnkh vymt khy ntts 't mzbch hb'l vkhy khrt h'shrh 'shr 'lyv
verses.translation: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֡שׁ לְ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁר עָמְד֨וּ עָלָ֜י/ו הַ/אַתֶּ֣ם תְּרִיב֣וּ/ן לַ/בַּ֗עַל אִם אַתֶּם֙ תּוֹשִׁיע֣וּ/ן אוֹת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥יב ל֛/וֹ יוּמַ֖ת עַד הַ/בֹּ֑קֶר אִם אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוּא֙ יָ֣רֶב ל֔/וֹ כִּ֥י נָתַ֖ץ אֶֽת מִזְבְּחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'sh lkhl 'shr 'mdv 'lyv h'tm trybvn lb'l 'm 'tm tvshy'vn 'vtv 'shr yryb lv yvmt 'd hbqr 'm 'lhym hv' yrb lv khy ntts 't mzbchv
verses.translation: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא ל֥/וֹ בַ/יּוֹם הַ/ה֖וּא יְרֻבַּ֣עַל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יָ֤רֶב בּ/וֹ֙ הַ/בַּ֔עַל כִּ֥י נָתַ֖ץ אֶֽת מִזְבְּחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqr' lv byvm hhv' yrb'l l'mr yrb bv hb'l khy ntts 't mzbchv
verses.translation: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.

verses.original: וְ/כָל מִדְיָ֧ן וַ/עֲמָלֵ֛ק וּ/בְנֵי קֶ֖דֶם נֶאֶסְפ֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו וַ/יַּעַבְר֥וּ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל
verses.translit: vkhl mdyn v'mlq vbny qdm n'spv ychdv vy'brv vychnv b'mq yzr''l
verses.translation: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.

verses.original: וְ/ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה לָבְשָׁ֖ה אֶת גִּדְע֑וֹן וַ/יִּתְקַע֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַ/יִזָּעֵ֥ק אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vrvch yhvh lbshh 't gd'vn vytq' bshvpr vyz'q 'by'zr 'chryv
verses.translation: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abi-ezer was gathered after him.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְאָכִים֙ שָׁלַ֣ח בְּ/כָל מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה וַ/יִזָּעֵ֥ק גַּם ה֖וּא אַחֲרָ֑י/ו וּ/מַלְאָכִ֣ים שָׁלַ֗ח בְּ/אָשֵׁ֤ר וּ/בִ/זְבֻלוּן֙ וּ/בְ/נַפְתָּלִ֔י וַֽ/יַּעֲל֖וּ לִ/קְרָאתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vml'khym shlch bkhl mnshh vyz'q gm hv' 'chryv vml'khym shlch b'shr vbzblvn vbnptly vy'lv lqr'tm
verses.translation: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר גִּדְע֖וֹן אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים אִם יֶשְׁ/ךָ֞ מוֹשִׁ֧יעַ בְּ/יָדִ֛/י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr gd'vn 'l h'lhym 'm yshkh mvshy' bydy 't yshr'l kh'shr dbrt
verses.translation: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֗י מַצִּ֛יג אֶת גִּזַּ֥ת הַ/צֶּ֖מֶר בַּ/גֹּ֑רֶן אִ֡ם טַל֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה עַֽל הַ/גִּזָּ֜ה לְ/בַדָּ֗/הּ וְ/עַל כָּל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ חֹ֔רֶב וְ/יָדַעְתִּ֗י כִּֽי תוֹשִׁ֧יעַ בְּ/יָדִ֛/י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy mtsyg 't gzt htsmr bgrn 'm tl yhyh 'l hgzh lbdh v'l khl h'rts chrb vyd'ty khy tvshy' bydy 't yshr'l kh'shr dbrt
verses.translation: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside , then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
