verses.original: וַ/יְהִי כֵ֕ן וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּם֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יָּ֖זַר אֶת הַ/גִּזָּ֑ה וַ/יִּ֤מֶץ טַל֙ מִן הַ/גִּזָּ֔ה מְל֥וֹא הַ/סֵּ֖פֶל מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy khn vyshkhm mmchrt vyzr 't hgzh vymts tl mn hgzh mlv' hspl mym
verses.translation: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר גִּדְעוֹן֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אַל יִ֤חַר אַפְּ/ךָ֙ בִּ֔/י וַ/אֲדַבְּרָ֖ה אַ֣ךְ הַ/פָּ֑עַם אֲנַסֶּ֤ה נָּא רַק הַ/פַּ֨עַם֙ בַּ/גִּזָּ֔ה יְהִי נָ֨א חֹ֤רֶב אֶל הַ/גִּזָּה֙ לְ/בַדָּ֔/הּ וְ/עַל כָּל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ יִֽהְיֶה טָּֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr gd'vn 'l h'lhym 'l ychr 'pkh by v'dbrh 'kh hp'm 'nsh n' rq hp'm bgzh yhy n' chrb 'l hgzh lbdh v'l khl h'rts yhyh tl
verses.translation: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ אֱלֹהִ֛ים כֵּ֖ן בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יְהִי חֹ֤רֶב אֶל הַ/גִּזָּה֙ לְ/בַדָּ֔/הּ וְ/עַל כָּל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ הָ֥יָה טָֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh 'lhym khn blylh hhv' vyhy chrb 'l hgzh lbdh v'l khl h'rts hyh tl
verses.translation: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם יְרֻבַּ֜עַל ה֣וּא גִדְע֗וֹן וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ עַל עֵ֣ין חֲרֹ֑ד וּ/מַחֲנֵ֤ה מִדְיָן֙ הָיָה ל֣/וֹ מִ/צָּפ֔וֹן מִ/גִּבְעַ֥ת הַ/מּוֹרֶ֖ה בָּ/עֵֽמֶק
verses.translit: vyshkhm yrb'l hv' gd'vn vkhl h'm 'shr 'tv vychnv 'l 'yn chrd vmchnh mdyn hyh lv mtspvn mgb't hmvrh b'mq
verses.translation: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל גִּדְע֔וֹן רַ֗ב הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֔/ךְ מִ/תִּתִּ֥/י אֶת מִדְיָ֖ן בְּ/יָדָ֑/ם פֶּן יִתְפָּאֵ֨ר עָלַ֤/י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יָדִ֖/י הוֹשִׁ֥יעָה לִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l gd'vn rb h'm 'shr 'tkh mtty 't mdyn bydm pn ytp'r 'ly yshr'l l'mr ydy hvshy'h ly
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה קְרָ֨א נָ֜א בְּ/אָזְנֵ֤י הָ/עָם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מִֽי יָרֵ֣א וְ/חָרֵ֔ד יָשֹׁ֥ב וְ/יִצְפֹּ֖ר מֵ/הַ֣ר הַ/גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב מִן הָ/עָ֗ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ/שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וַ/עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים נִשְׁאָֽרוּ
verses.translit: v'th qr' n' b'zny h'm l'mr my yr' vchrd yshb vytspr mhr hgl'd vyshb mn h'm 'shrym vshnym 'lf v'shrt 'lpym nsh'rv
verses.translation: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל גִּדְע֗וֹן עוֹד֮ הָ/עָ֣ם רָב֒ הוֹרֵ֤ד אוֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל הַ/מַּ֔יִם וְ/אֶצְרְפֶ֥/נּוּ לְ/ךָ֖ שָׁ֑ם וְ/הָיָ֡ה אֲשֶׁר֩ אֹמַ֨ר אֵלֶ֜י/ךָ זֶ֣ה יֵלֵ֣ךְ אִתָּ֗/ךְ ה֚וּא יֵלֵ֣ךְ אִתָּ֔/ךְ וְ/כֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר אֹמַ֜ר אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ זֶ֚ה לֹא יֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔/ךְ ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l gd'vn 'vd h'm rb hvrd 'vtm 'l hmym v'tsrpnv lkh shm vhyh 'shr 'mr 'lykh zh ylkh 'tkh hv' ylkh 'tkh vkhl 'shr 'mr 'lykh zh l' ylkh 'mkh hv' l' ylkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֥וֹרֶד אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל הַ/מָּ֑יִם וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל גִּדְע֗וֹן כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר יָלֹק֩ בִּ/לְשׁוֹנ֨/וֹ מִן הַ/מַּ֜יִם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר יָלֹ֣ק הַ/כֶּ֗לֶב תַּצִּ֤יג אוֹת/וֹ֙ לְ/בָ֔ד וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יִכְרַ֥ע עַל בִּרְכָּ֖י/ו לִ/שְׁתּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyvrd 't h'm 'l hmym vy'mr yhvh 'l gd'vn khl 'shr ylq blshvnv mn hmym kh'shr ylq hkhlb ttsyg 'vtv lbd vkhl 'shr ykhr' 'l brkhyv lshtvt
verses.translation: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מִסְפַּ֞ר הַֽ/מֲלַקְקִ֤ים בְּ/יָדָ/ם֙ אֶל פִּי/הֶ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וְ/כֹל֙ יֶ֣תֶר הָ/עָ֔ם כָּרְע֥וּ עַל בִּרְכֵי/הֶ֖ם לִ/שְׁתּ֥וֹת מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy mspr hmlqqym bydm 'l pyhm shlsh m'vt 'ysh vkhl ytr h'm khr'v 'l brkhyhm lshtvt mym
verses.translation: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל גִּדְע֗וֹן בִּ/שְׁלֹשׁ֩ מֵא֨וֹת הָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַֽ/מֲלַקְקִים֙ אוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י אֶת מִדְיָ֖ן בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֔ם יֵלְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לִ/מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l gd'vn bshlsh m'vt h'ysh hmlqqym 'vshy' 'tkhm vntty 't mdyn bydkh vkhl h'm ylkhv 'ysh lmqmv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֣וּ אֶת צֵדָה֩ הָ/עָ֨ם בְּ/יָדָ֜/ם וְ/אֵ֣ת שׁוֹפְרֹֽתֵי/הֶ֗ם וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלַּח֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/אֹֽהָלָ֔י/ו וּ/בִ/שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת הָ/אִ֖ישׁ הֶֽחֱזִ֑יק וּ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִדְיָ֔ן הָ֥יָה ל֖/וֹ מִ/תַּ֥חַת בָּ/עֵֽמֶק
verses.translit: vyqchv 't tsdh h'm bydm v't shvprtyhm v't khl 'ysh yshr'l shlch 'ysh l'hlyv vbshlsh m'vt h'ysh hchzyq vmchnh mdyn hyh lv mtcht b'mq
verses.translation: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/ה֔וּא וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ יְהוָ֔ה ק֖וּם רֵ֣ד בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה כִּ֥י נְתַתִּ֖י/ו בְּ/יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyhy blylh hhv' vy'mr 'lyv yhvh qvm rd bmchnh khy nttyv bydkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.

verses.original: וְ/אִם יָרֵ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לָ/רֶ֑דֶת רֵ֥ד אַתָּ֛ה וּ/פֻרָ֥ה נַעַרְ/ךָ֖ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: v'm yr' 'th lrdt rd 'th vprh n'rkh 'l hmchnh
verses.translation: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:

verses.original: וְ/שָֽׁמַעְתָּ֙ מַה יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ וְ/אַחַר֙ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יָדֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/יָרַדְתָּ֖ בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֤רֶד הוּא֙ וּ/פֻרָ֣ה נַעֲר֔/וֹ אֶל קְצֵ֥ה הַ/חֲמֻשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vshm't mh ydbrv v'chr tchzqnh ydykh vyrdt bmchnh vyrd hv' vprh n'rv 'l qtsh hchmshym 'shr bmchnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.

verses.original: וּ/מִדְיָ֨ן וַ/עֲמָלֵ֤ק וְ/כָל בְּנֵי קֶ֨דֶם֙ נֹפְלִ֣ים בָּ/עֵ֔מֶק כָּ/אַרְבֶּ֖ה לָ/רֹ֑ב וְ/לִ/גְמַלֵּי/הֶם֙ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֔ר כַּ/ח֛וֹל שֶׁ/עַל שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יָּ֖ם לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vmdyn v'mlq vkhl bny qdm nplym b'mq kh'rbh lrb vlgmlyhm 'yn mspr khchvl sh'l shpt hym lrb
verses.translation: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א גִדְע֔וֹן וְ/הִ֨נֵּה אִ֔ישׁ מְסַפֵּ֥ר לְ/רֵעֵ֖/הוּ חֲל֑וֹם וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר הִנֵּ֧ה חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֗מְתִּי וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה צלול צְלִ֜יל לֶ֤חֶם שְׂעֹרִים֙ מִתְהַפֵּךְ֙ בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה מִדְיָ֔ן וַ/יָּבֹ֣א עַד הָ֠/אֹהֶל וַ/יַּכֵּ֧/הוּ וַ/יִּפֹּ֛ל וַ/יַּהַפְכֵ֥/הוּ לְ/מַ֖עְלָ/ה וְ/נָפַ֥ל הָ/אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: vyb' gd'vn vhnh 'ysh mspr lr'hv chlvm vy'mr hnh chlvm chlmty vhnh tslvl tslyl lchm sh'rym mthpkh bmchnh mdyn vyb' 'd h'hl vykhhv vypl vyhpkhhv lm'lh vnpl h'hl
verses.translation: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן רֵעֵ֤/הוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ין זֹ֔את בִּלְתִּ֗י אִם חֶ֛רֶב גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן יוֹאָ֖שׁ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נָתַ֤ן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ אֶת מִדְיָ֖ן וְ/אֶת כָּל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'n r'hv vy'mr 'yn z't blty 'm chrb gd'vn bn yv'sh 'ysh yshr'l ntn h'lhym bydv 't mdyn v't khl hmchnh
verses.translation: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ גִּדְע֜וֹן אֶת מִסְפַּ֧ר הַ/חֲל֛וֹם וְ/אֶת שִׁבְר֖/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁתָּ֑חוּ וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב֙ אֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ק֔וּמוּ כִּֽי נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶ֖ם אֶת מַחֲנֵ֥ה מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' gd'vn 't mspr hchlvm v't shbrv vyshtchv vyshb 'l mchnh yshr'l vy'mr qvmv khy ntn yhvh bydkhm 't mchnh mdyn
verses.translation: And it was so , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֛חַץ אֶת שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת הָ/אִ֖ישׁ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֑ים וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן שׁוֹפָר֤וֹת בְּ/יַד כֻּלָּ/ם֙ וְ/כַדִּ֣ים רֵקִ֔ים וְ/לַפִּדִ֖ים בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/כַּדִּֽים
verses.translit: vychts 't shlsh m'vt h'ysh shlshh r'shym vytn shvprvt byd khlm vkhdym rqym vlpdym btvkh hkhdym
verses.translation: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man’s hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם מִמֶּ֥/נִּי תִרְא֖וּ וְ/כֵ֣ן תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֥י בָא֙ בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה כַ/אֲשֶׁר אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה כֵּ֥ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ/ן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm mmny tr'v vkhn t'shv vhnh 'nkhy b' bqtsh hmchnh vhyh kh'shr ''shh khn t'shvn
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that , as I do, so shall ye do.

verses.original: וְ/תָקַעְתִּי֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר אָנֹכִ֖י וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֑/י וּ/תְקַעְתֶּ֨ם בַּ/שּׁוֹפָר֜וֹת גַּם אַתֶּ֗ם סְבִיבוֹת֙ כָּל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַ/יהוָ֥ה וּ/לְ/גִדְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vtq'ty bshvpr 'nkhy vkhl 'shr 'ty vtq'tm bshvprvt gm 'tm sbybvt khl hmchnh v'mrtm lyhvh vlgd'vn
verses.translation: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the LORD , and of Gideon.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א גִ֠דְעוֹן וּ/מֵאָה אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֜/וֹ בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֗ה רֹ֚אשׁ הָ/אַשְׁמֹ֣רֶת הַ/תִּֽיכוֹנָ֔ה אַ֛ךְ הָקֵ֥ם הֵקִ֖ימוּ אֶת הַ/שֹּֽׁמְרִ֑ים וַֽ/יִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּ/שּׁ֣וֹפָר֔וֹת וְ/נָפ֥וֹץ הַ/כַּדִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyb' gd'vn vm'h 'ysh 'shr 'tv bqtsh hmchnh r'sh h'shmrt htykhvnh 'kh hqm hqymv 't hshmrym vytq'v bshvprvt vnpvts hkhdym 'shr bydm
verses.translation: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.

verses.original: וַֽ֠/יִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָ/רָאשִׁ֥ים בַּ/שּֽׁוֹפָרוֹת֮ וַ/יִּשְׁבְּר֣וּ הַ/כַּדִּים֒ וַ/יַּחֲזִ֤יקוּ בְ/יַד שְׂמאוֹלָ/ם֙ בַּ/לַּפִּדִ֔ים וּ/בְ/יַ֨ד יְמִינָ֔/ם הַ/שּׁוֹפָר֖וֹת לִ/תְק֑וֹעַ וַֽ/יִּקְרְא֔וּ חֶ֥רֶב לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה וּ/לְ/גִדְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vytq'v shlsht hr'shym bshvprvt vyshbrv hkhdym vychzyqv byd shm'vlm blpdym vbyd ymynm hshvprvt ltqv' vyqr'v chrb lyhvh vlgd'vn
verses.translation: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD , and of Gideon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו סָבִ֖יב לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַ/יָּ֧רָץ כָּל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֛ה וַ/יָּרִ֖יעוּ ו/יניסו וַ/יָּנֽוּסוּ
verses.translit: vy'mdv 'ysh tchtyv sbyb lmchnh vyrts khl hmchnh vyry'v vynysv vynvsv
verses.translation: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp: and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְקְעוּ֮ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֣וֹת הַ/שּׁוֹפָרוֹת֒ וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ת חֶ֥רֶב אִ֛ישׁ בְּ/רֵעֵ֖/הוּ וּ/בְ/כָל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַ/יָּ֨נָס הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֜ה עַד בֵּ֤ית הַשִּׁטָּה֙ צְֽרֵרָ֔תָ/ה עַ֛ד שְׂפַת אָבֵ֥ל מְחוֹלָ֖ה עַל טַבָּֽת
verses.translit: vytq'v shlsh m'vt hshvprvt vyshm yhvh 't chrb 'ysh br'hv vbkhl hmchnh vyns hmchnh 'd byt hshth tsrrth 'd shpt 'bl mchvlh 'l tbt
verses.translation: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man’s sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Beth-shittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abel-meholah, unto Tabbath.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצָּעֵ֧ק אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִ/נַּפְתָּלִ֥י וּ/מִן אָשֵׁ֖ר וּ/מִן כָּל מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: vyts'q 'ysh yshr'l mnptly vmn 'shr vmn khl mnshh vyrdpv 'chry mdyn
verses.translation: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְאָכִ֡ים שָׁלַ֣ח גִּדְעוֹן֩ בְּ/כָל הַ֨ר אֶפְרַ֜יִם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר רְד֞וּ לִ/קְרַ֤את מִדְיָן֙ וְ/לִכְד֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ אֶת הַ/מַּ֔יִם עַ֛ד בֵּ֥ית בָּרָ֖ה וְ/אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַ/יִּצָּעֵ֞ק כָּל אִ֤ישׁ אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ וַ/יִּלְכְּד֣וּ אֶת הַ/מַּ֔יִם עַ֛ד בֵּ֥ית בָּרָ֖ה וְ/אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vml'khym shlch gd'vn bkhl hr 'prym l'mr rdv lqr't mdyn vlkhdv lhm 't hmym 'd byt brh v't hyrdn vyts'q khl 'ysh 'prym vylkhdv 't hmym 'd byt brh v't hyrdn
verses.translation: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּלְכְּד֡וּ שְׁנֵֽי שָׂרֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן אֶת עֹרֵ֣ב וְ/אֶת זְאֵ֗ב וַ/יַּהַרְג֨וּ אֶת עוֹרֵ֤ב בְּ/צוּר עוֹרֵב֙ וְ/אֶת זְאֵב֙ הָרְג֣וּ בְ/יֶֽקֶב זְאֵ֔ב וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אֶל מִדְיָ֑ן וְ/רֹאשׁ עֹרֵ֣ב וּ/זְאֵ֔ב הֵבִ֨יאוּ֙ אֶל גִּדְע֔וֹן מֵ/עֵ֖בֶר לַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vylkhdv shny shry mdyn 't 'rb v't z'b vyhrgv 't 'vrb btsvr 'vrb v't z'b hrgv byqb z'b vyrdpv 'l mdyn vr'sh 'rb vz'b hby'v 'l gd'vn m'br lyrdn
verses.translation: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜י/ו אִ֣ישׁ אֶפְרַ֗יִם מָֽה הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔/נוּ לְ/בִלְתִּי֙ קְרֹ֣אות לָ֔/נוּ כִּ֥י הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְ/הִלָּחֵ֣ם בְּ/מִדְיָ֑ן וַ/יְרִיב֥וּ/ן אִתּ֖/וֹ בְּ/חָזְקָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv 'ysh 'prym mh hdbr hzh 'shyt lnv lblty qr'vt lnv khy hlkht lhlchm bmdyn vyrybvn 'tv bchzqh
verses.translation: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם מֶה עָשִׂ֥יתִי עַתָּ֖ה כָּ/כֶ֑ם הֲ/ל֗וֹא ט֛וֹב עֹלְל֥וֹת אֶפְרַ֖יִם מִ/בְצִ֥יר אֲבִיעֶֽזֶר
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm mh 'shyty 'th khkhm hlv' tvb 'llvt 'prym mbtsyr 'by'zr
verses.translation: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi-ezer?

verses.original: בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶם֩ נָתַ֨ן אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת שָׂרֵ֤י מִדְיָן֙ אֶת עֹרֵ֣ב וְ/אֶת זְאֵ֔ב וּ/מַה יָּכֹ֖לְתִּי עֲשׂ֣וֹת כָּ/כֶ֑ם אָ֗ז רָפְתָ֤ה רוּחָ/ם֙ מֵֽ/עָלָ֔י/ו בְּ/דַבְּר֖/וֹ הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: bydkhm ntn 'lhym 't shry mdyn 't 'rb v't z'b vmh ykhlty 'shvt khkhm 'z rpth rvchm m'lyv bdbrv hdbr hzh
verses.translation: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א גִדְע֖וֹן הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑נָ/ה עֹבֵ֣ר ה֗וּא וּ/שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֤וֹת הָ/אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ עֲיֵפִ֖ים וְ/רֹדְפִֽים
verses.translit: vyb' gd'vn hyrdnh 'br hv' vshlsh m'vt h'ysh 'shr 'tv 'ypym vrdpym
verses.translation: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְ/אַנְשֵׁ֣י סֻכּ֔וֹת תְּנוּ נָא֙ כִּכְּר֣וֹת לֶ֔חֶם לָ/עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/רַגְלָ֑/י כִּי עֲיֵפִ֣ים הֵ֔ם וְ/אָנֹכִ֗י רֹדֵ֛ף אַחֲרֵ֛י זֶ֥בַח וְ/צַלְמֻנָּ֖ע מַלְכֵ֥י מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr l'nshy skhvt tnv n' khkhrvt lchm l'm 'shr brgly khy 'ypym hm v'nkhy rdf 'chry zbch vtslmn' mlkhy mdyn
verses.translation: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ שָׂרֵ֣י סֻכּ֔וֹת הֲ֠/כַף זֶ֧בַח וְ/צַלְמֻנָּ֛ע עַתָּ֖ה בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ כִּֽי נִתֵּ֥ן לִֽ/צְבָאֲ/ךָ֖ לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vy'mr shry skhvt hkhf zbch vtslmn' 'th bydkh khy ntn ltsb'kh lchm
verses.translation: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר גִּדְע֔וֹן לָ/כֵ֗ן בְּ/תֵ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֶת זֶ֥בַח וְ/אֶת צַלְמֻנָּ֖ע בְּ/יָדִ֑/י וְ/דַשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת בְּשַׂרְ/כֶ֔ם אֶת קוֹצֵ֥י הַ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר וְ/אֶת הַֽ/בַּרְקֳנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr gd'vn lkhn btt yhvh 't zbch v't tslmn' bydy vdshty 't bshrkhm 't qvtsy hmdbr v't hbrqnym
verses.translation: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַל מִ/שָּׁם֙ פְּנוּאֵ֔ל וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּ/זֹ֑את וַ/יַּעֲנ֤וּ אוֹת/וֹ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י פְנוּאֵ֔ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָנ֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י סֻכּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'l mshm pnv'l vydbr 'lyhm khz't vy'nv 'vtv 'nshy pnv'l kh'shr 'nv 'nshy skhvt
verses.translation: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם לְ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י פְנוּאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בְּ/שׁוּבִ֣/י בְ/שָׁל֔וֹם אֶתֹּ֖ץ אֶת הַ/מִּגְדָּ֥ל הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr gm l'nshy pnv'l l'mr bshvby bshlvm 'tts 't hmgdl hzh
verses.translation: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֨בַח וְ/צַלְמֻנָּ֜ע בַּ/קַּרְקֹ֗ר וּ/מַחֲנֵי/הֶ֤ם עִמָּ/ם֙ כַּ/חֲמֵ֤שֶׁת עָשָׂר֙ אֶ֔לֶף כֹּ֚ל הַ/נּ֣וֹתָרִ֔ים מִ/כֹּ֖ל מַחֲנֵ֣ה בְנֵי קֶ֑דֶם וְ/הַ/נֹּ֣פְלִ֔ים מֵאָ֨ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vzbch vtslmn' bqrqr vmchnyhm 'mm khchmsht 'shr 'lf khl hnvtrym mkhl mchnh bny qdm vhnplym m'h v'shrym 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb
verses.translation: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל גִּדְע֗וֹן דֶּ֚רֶךְ הַ/שְּׁכוּנֵ֣י בָֽ/אֳהָלִ֔ים מִ/קֶּ֥דֶם לְ/נֹ֖בַח וְ/יָגְבֳּהָ֑ה וַ/יַּךְ֙ אֶת הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְ/הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה הָ֥יָה בֶֽטַח
verses.translit: vy'l gd'vn drkh hshkhvny b'hlym mqdm lnbch vygbhh vykh 't hmchnh vhmchnh hyh btch
verses.translation: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.

verses.original: וַ/יָּנ֗וּסוּ זֶ֚בַח וְ/צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֖ף אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֞ד אֶת שְׁנֵ֣י מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן אֶת זֶ֨בַח֙ וְ/אֶת צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע וְ/כָל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה הֶחֱרִֽיד
verses.translit: vynvsv zbch vtslmn' vyrdf 'chryhm vylkhd 't shny mlkhy mdyn 't zbch v't tslmn' vkhl hmchnh hchryd
verses.translation: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛שָׁב גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן יוֹאָ֖שׁ מִן הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה מִֽ/לְ/מַעֲלֵ֖ה הֶ/חָֽרֶס
verses.translit: vyshb gd'vn bn yv'sh mn hmlchmh mlm'lh hchrs
verses.translation: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up ,

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְכָּד נַ֛עַר מֵ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י סֻכּ֖וֹת וַ/יִּשְׁאָלֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֨ב אֵלָ֜י/ו אֶת שָׂרֵ֤י סֻכּוֹת֙ וְ/אֶת זְקֵנֶ֔י/הָ שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֖ה אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vylkhd n'r m'nshy skhvt vysh'lhv vykhtb 'lyv 't shry skhvt v't zqnyh shb'ym vshb'h 'ysh
verses.translation: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֶל אַנְשֵׁ֣י סֻכּ֔וֹת וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֖ה זֶ֣בַח וְ/צַלְמֻנָּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר֩ חֵרַפְתֶּ֨ם אוֹתִ֜/י לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הֲ֠/כַף זֶ֣בַח וְ/צַלְמֻנָּ֤ע עַתָּה֙ בְּ/יָדֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֥י נִתֵּ֛ן לַ/אֲנָשֶׁ֥י/ךָ הַ/יְּעֵפִ֖ים לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vyb' 'l 'nshy skhvt vy'mr hnh zbch vtslmn' 'shr chrptm 'vty l'mr hkhf zbch vtslmn' 'th bydkh khy ntn l'nshykh hy'pym lchm
verses.translation: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֙ אֶת זִקְנֵ֣י הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/אֶת קוֹצֵ֥י הַ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר וְ/אֶת הַֽ/בַּרְקֳנִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֣דַע בָּ/הֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אַנְשֵׁ֥י סֻכּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqch 't zqny h'yr v't qvtsy hmdbr v't hbrqnym vyd' bhm 't 'nshy skhvt
verses.translation: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מִגְדַּ֥ל פְּנוּאֵ֖ל נָתָ֑ץ וַֽ/יַּהֲרֹ֖ג אֶת אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: v't mgdl pnv'l ntts vyhrg 't 'nshy h'yr
verses.translation: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל זֶ֨בַח֙ וְ/אֶל צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע אֵיפֹה֙ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲרַגְתֶּ֖ם בְּ/תָב֑וֹר וַֽ/יֹּאמרוּ֙ כָּמ֣וֹ/ךָ כְמוֹ/הֶ֔ם אֶחָ֕ד כְּ/תֹ֖אַר בְּנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l zbch v'l tslmn' 'yph h'nshym 'shr hrgtm btbvr vy'mrv khmvkh khmvhm 'chd kht'r bny hmlkh
verses.translation: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art , so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר אַחַ֥/י בְּנֵֽי אִמִּ֖/י הֵ֑ם חַי יְהוָ֗ה ל֚וּ הַחֲיִתֶ֣ם אוֹתָ֔/ם לֹ֥א הָרַ֖גְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'chy bny 'my hm chy yhvh lv hchytm 'vtm l' hrgty 'tkhm
verses.translation: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְ/יֶ֣תֶר בְּכוֹר֔/וֹ ק֖וּם הֲרֹ֣ג אוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹא שָׁלַ֨ף הַ/נַּ֤עַר חַרְבּ/וֹ֙ כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔א כִּ֥י עוֹדֶ֖/נּוּ נָֽעַר
verses.translit: vy'mr lytr bkhvrv qvm hrg 'vtm vl' shlf hn'r chrbv khy yr' khy 'vdnv n'r
verses.translation: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר זֶ֣בַח וְ/צַלְמֻנָּ֗ע ק֤וּם אַתָּה֙ וּ/פְגַע בָּ֔/נוּ כִּ֥י כָ/אִ֖ישׁ גְּבוּרָת֑/וֹ וַ/יָּ֣קָם גִּדְע֗וֹן וַֽ/יַּהֲרֹג֙ אֶת זֶ֣בַח וְ/אֶת צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע וַ/יִּקַּח֙ אֶת הַ/שַּׂ֣הֲרֹנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/צַוְּארֵ֥י גְמַלֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr zbch vtslmn' qvm 'th vpg' bnv khy kh'ysh gbvrtv vyqm gd'vn vyhrg 't zbch v't tslmn' vyqch 't hshhrnym 'shr btsv'ry gmlyhm
verses.translation: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels’ necks.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל גִּדְע֔וֹן מְשָׁל בָּ֨/נוּ֙ גַּם אַתָּ֔ה גַּם בִּנְ/ךָ֖ גַּ֣ם בֶּן בְּנֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֥י הוֹשַׁעְתָּ֖/נוּ מִ/יַּ֥ד מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh yshr'l 'l gd'vn mshl bnv gm 'th gm bnkh gm bn bnkh khy hvsh'tnv myd mdyn
verses.translation: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ גִּדְע֔וֹן לֹֽא אֶמְשֹׁ֤ל אֲנִי֙ בָּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא יִמְשֹׁ֥ל בְּנִ֖/י בָּ/כֶ֑ם יְהוָ֖ה יִמְשֹׁ֥ל בָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm gd'vn l' 'mshl 'ny bkhm vl' ymshl bny bkhm yhvh ymshl bkhm
verses.translation: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֜ם גִּדְע֗וֹן אֶשְׁאֲלָ֤ה מִ/כֶּם֙ שְׁאֵלָ֔ה וּ/תְנוּ לִ֕/י אִ֖ישׁ נֶ֣זֶם שְׁלָל֑/וֹ כִּֽי נִזְמֵ֤י זָהָב֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם כִּ֥י יִשְׁמְעֵאלִ֖ים הֵֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm gd'vn 'sh'lh mkhm sh'lh vtnv ly 'ysh nzm shllv khy nzmy zhb lhm khy yshm''lym hm
verses.translation: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ נָת֣וֹן נִתֵּ֑ן וַֽ/יִּפְרְשׂוּ֙ אֶת הַ/שִּׂמְלָ֔ה וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֣יכוּ שָׁ֔מָּ/ה אִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥זֶם שְׁלָלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mrv ntvn ntn vyprshv 't hshmlh vyshlykhv shmh 'ysh nzm shllv
verses.translation: And they answered, We will willingly give them . And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מִשְׁקַ֞ל נִזְמֵ֤י הַ/זָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔ל אֶ֥לֶף וּ/שְׁבַע מֵא֖וֹת זָהָ֑ב לְ֠/בַד מִן הַ/שַּׂהֲרֹנִ֨ים וְ/הַ/נְּטִפ֜וֹת וּ/בִגְדֵ֣י הָ/אַרְגָּמָ֗ן שֶׁ/עַל֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֔ן וּ/לְ/בַד֙ מִן הָ֣/עֲנָק֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/צַוְּארֵ֥י גְמַלֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy mshql nzmy hzhb 'shr sh'l 'lf vshb' m'vt zhb lbd mn hshhrnym vhntpvt vbgdy h'rgmn sh'l mlkhy mdyn vlbd mn h'nqvt 'shr btsv'ry gmlyhm
verses.translation: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels’ necks.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַשׂ֩ אוֹת֨/וֹ גִדְע֜וֹן לְ/אֵפ֗וֹד וַ/יַּצֵּ֨ג אוֹת֤/וֹ בְ/עִיר/וֹ֙ בְּ/עָפְרָ֔ה וַ/יִּזְנ֧וּ כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אַחֲרָ֖י/ו שָׁ֑ם וַ/יְהִ֛י לְ/גִדְע֥וֹן וּ/לְ/בֵית֖/וֹ לְ/מוֹקֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'sh 'vtv gd'vn l'pvd vytsg 'vtv b'yrv b'prh vyznv khl yshr'l 'chryv shm vyhy lgd'vn vlbytv lmvqsh
verses.translation: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכָּנַ֣ע מִדְיָ֗ן לִ/פְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לֹ֥א יָסְפ֖וּ לָ/שֵׂ֣את רֹאשָׁ֑/ם וַ/תִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בִּ/ימֵ֥י גִדְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vykhn' mdyn lpny bny yshr'l vl' yspv lsh't r'shm vtshqt h'rts 'rb'ym shnh bymy gd'vn
verses.translation: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֛לֶךְ יְרֻבַּ֥עַל בֶּן יוֹאָ֖שׁ וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkh yrb'l bn yv'sh vyshb bbytv
verses.translation: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/גִדְע֗וֹן הָיוּ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים בָּנִ֔ים יֹצְאֵ֖י יְרֵכ֑/וֹ כִּֽי נָשִׁ֥ים רַבּ֖וֹת הָ֥יוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vlgd'vn hyv shb'ym bnym yts'y yrkhv khy nshym rbvt hyv lv
verses.translation: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.

verses.original: וּ/פִֽילַגְשׁ/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/שְׁכֶ֔ם יָֽלְדָה לּ֥/וֹ גַם הִ֖יא בֵּ֑ן וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vpylgshv 'shr bshkhm yldh lv gm hy' bn vyshm 't shmv 'bymlkh
verses.translation: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛מָת גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן יוֹאָ֖שׁ בְּ/שֵׂיבָ֣ה טוֹבָ֑ה וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֗ר בְּ/קֶ֨בֶר֙ יוֹאָ֣שׁ אָבִ֔י/ו בְּ/עָפְרָ֖ה אֲבִ֥י הָֽעֶזְרִֽי
verses.translit: vymt gd'vn bn yv'sh bshybh tvbh vyqbr bqbr yv'sh 'byv b'prh 'by h'zry
verses.translation: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ מֵ֣ת גִּדְע֔וֹן וַ/יָּשׁ֨וּבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּזְנ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַ/בְּעָלִ֑ים וַ/יָּשִׂ֧ימוּ לָ/הֶ֛ם בַּ֥עַל בְּרִ֖ית לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr mt gd'vn vyshvbv bny yshr'l vyznv 'chry hb'lym vyshymv lhm b'l bryt l'lhym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baal-berith their god.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א זָֽכְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם הַ/מַּצִּ֥יל אוֹתָ֛/ם מִ/יַּ֥ד כָּל אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֖ם מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: vl' zkhrv bny yshr'l 't yhvh 'lhyhm hmtsyl 'vtm myd khl 'ybyhm msbyb
verses.translation: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא עָשׂ֣וּ חֶ֔סֶד עִם בֵּ֥ית יְרֻבַּ֖עַל גִּדְע֑וֹן כְּ/כָל הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה עִם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' 'shv chsd 'm byt yrb'l gd'vn khkhl htvbh 'shr 'shh 'm yshr'l
verses.translation: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely , Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ אֲבִימֶ֤לֶךְ בֶּן יְרֻבַּ֨עַל֙ שְׁכֶ֔מָ/ה אֶל אֲחֵ֖י אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֶל כָּל מִשְׁפַּ֛חַת בֵּית אֲבִ֥י אִמּ֖/וֹ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vylkh 'bymlkh bn yrb'l shkhmh 'l 'chy 'mv vydbr 'lyhm v'l khl mshpcht byt 'by 'mv l'mr
verses.translation: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother’s brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

verses.original: דַּבְּרוּ נָ֞א בְּ/אָזְנֵ֨י כָל בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶם֮ מַה טּ֣וֹב לָ/כֶם֒ הַ/מְשֹׁ֨ל בָּ/כֶ֜ם שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ כֹּ֚ל בְּנֵ֣י יְרֻבַּ֔עַל אִם מְשֹׁ֥ל בָּ/כֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וּ/זְכַרְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי עַצְמֵ/כֶם וּ/בְשַׂרְ/כֶ֖ם אָנִֽי
verses.translit: dbrv n' b'zny khl b'ly shkhm mh tvb lkhm hmshl bkhm shb'ym 'ysh khl bny yrb'l 'm mshl bkhm 'ysh 'chd vzkhrtm khy 'tsmkhm vbshrkhm 'ny
verses.translation: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבְּר֨וּ אֲחֵֽי אִמּ֜/וֹ עָלָ֗י/ו בְּ/אָזְנֵי֙ כָּל בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יֵּ֤ט לִבָּ/ם֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ כִּ֥י אָמְר֖וּ אָחִ֥י/נוּ הֽוּא
verses.translit: vydbrv 'chy 'mv 'lyv b'zny khl b'ly shkhm 't khl hdbrym h'lh vyt lbm 'chry 'bymlkh khy 'mrv 'chynv hv'
verses.translation: And his mother’s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנוּ ל/וֹ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף מִ/בֵּ֖יתּ בַ֣עַל בְּרִ֑ית וַ/יִּשְׂכֹּ֨ר בָּ/הֶ֜ם אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים רֵיקִים֙ וּ/פֹ֣חֲזִ֔ים וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vytnv lv shb'ym khsf mbyt b'l bryt vyshkhr bhm 'bymlkh 'nshym ryqym vpchzym vylkhv 'chryv
verses.translation: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א בֵית אָבִי/ו֙ עָפְרָ֔תָ/ה וַֽ/יַּהֲרֹ֞ג אֶת אֶחָ֧י/ו בְּנֵֽי יְרֻבַּ֛עַל שִׁבְּעִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ עַל אֶ֣בֶן אֶחָ֑ת וַ/יִּוָּתֵ֞ר יוֹתָ֧ם בֶּן יְרֻבַּ֛עַל הַ/קָּטֹ֖ן כִּ֥י נֶחְבָּֽא
verses.translit: vyb' byt 'byv 'prth vyhrg 't 'chyv bny yrb'l shb'ym 'ysh 'l 'bn 'cht vyvtr yvtm bn yrb'l hqtn khy nchb'
verses.translation: And he went unto his father’s house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּאָ֨סְפ֜וּ כָּל בַּעֲלֵ֤י שְׁכֶם֙ וְ/כָל בֵּ֣ית מִלּ֔וֹא וַ/יֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ וַ/יַּמְלִ֥יכוּ אֶת אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ לְ/מֶ֑לֶךְ עִם אֵל֥וֹן מֻצָּ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/שְׁכֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'spv khl b'ly shkhm vkhl byt mlv' vylkhv vymlykhv 't 'bymlkh lmlkh 'm 'lvn mtsb 'shr bshkhm
verses.translation: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֣דוּ לְ/יוֹתָ֗ם וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹד֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הַר גְּרִזִ֔ים וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א קוֹל֖/וֹ וַ/יִּקְרָ֑א וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֗ם שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַ/י֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם וְ/יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vygdv lyvtm vylkh vy'md br'sh hr grzym vysh' qvlv vyqr' vy'mr lhm shm'v 'ly b'ly shkhm vyshm' 'lykhm 'lhym
verses.translation: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.

verses.original: הָל֤וֹךְ הָֽלְכוּ֙ הָ/עֵצִ֔ים לִ/מְשֹׁ֥חַ עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מֶ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ לַ/זַּ֖יִת מלוכ/ה מָלְכָ֥/ה עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: hlvkh hlkhv h'tsym lmshch 'lyhm mlkh vy'mrv lzyt mlvkhh mlkhh 'lynv
verses.translation: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ הַ/זַּ֔יִת הֶ/חֳדַ֨לְתִּי֙ אֶת דִּשְׁנִ֔/י אֲשֶׁר בִּ֛/י יְכַבְּד֥וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְ/הָ֣לַכְתִּ֔י לָ/נ֖וּעַ עַל הָ/עֵצִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm hzyt hchdlty 't dshny 'shr by ykhbdv 'lhym v'nshym vhlkhty lnv' 'l h'tsym
verses.translation: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ הָ/עֵצִ֖ים לַ/תְּאֵנָ֑ה לְכִי אַ֖תְּ מָלְכִ֥י עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'tsym lt'nh lkhy 't mlkhy 'lynv
verses.translation: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ הַ/תְּאֵנָ֔ה הֶ/חֳדַ֨לְתִּי֙ אֶת מָתְקִ֔/י וְ/אֶת תְּנוּבָתִ֖/י הַ/טּוֹבָ֑ה וְ/הָ֣לַכְתִּ֔י לָ/נ֖וּעַ עַל הָ/עֵצִֽים
verses.translit: vt'mr lhm ht'nh hchdlty 't mtqy v't tnvbty htvbh vhlkhty lnv' 'l h'tsym
verses.translation: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ הָ/עֵצִ֖ים לַ/גָּ֑פֶן לְכִי אַ֖תְּ מלוכי מָלְכִ֥י עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'tsym lgpn lkhy 't mlvkhy mlkhy 'lynv
verses.translation: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ הַ/גֶּ֔פֶן הֶ/חֳדַ֨לְתִּי֙ אֶת תִּ֣ירוֹשִׁ֔/י הַֽ/מְשַׂמֵּ֥חַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְ/הָ֣לַכְתִּ֔י לָ/נ֖וּעַ עַל הָ/עֵצִֽים
verses.translit: vt'mr lhm hgpn hchdlty 't tyrvshy hmshmch 'lhym v'nshym vhlkhty lnv' 'l h'tsym
verses.translation: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ כָל הָ/עֵצִ֖ים אֶל הָ/אָטָ֑ד לֵ֥ךְ אַתָּ֖ה מְלָךְ עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv khl h'tsym 'l h'td lkh 'th mlkh 'lynv
verses.translation: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הָ/אָטָד֮ אֶל הָ/עֵצִים֒ אִ֡ם בֶּ/אֱמֶ֣ת אַתֶּם֩ מֹשְׁחִ֨ים אֹתִ֤/י לְ/מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם בֹּ֖אוּ חֲס֣וּ בְ/צִלִּ֑/י וְ/אִם אַ֕יִן תֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מִן הָ֣/אָטָ֔ד וְ/תֹאכַ֖ל אֶת אַרְזֵ֥י הַ/לְּבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr h'td 'l h'tsym 'm b'mt 'tm mshchym 'ty lmlkh 'lykhm b'v chsv btsly v'm 'yn tts' 'sh mn h'td vt'khl 't 'rzy hlbnvn
verses.translation: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אִם בֶּ/אֱמֶ֤ת וּ/בְ/תָמִים֙ עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם וַ/תַּמְלִ֖יכוּ אֶת אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וְ/אִם טוֹבָ֤ה עֲשִׂיתֶם֙ עִם יְרֻבַּ֣עַל וְ/עִם בֵּית֔/וֹ וְ/אִם כִּ/גְמ֥וּל יָדָ֖י/ו עֲשִׂ֥יתֶם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'th 'm b'mt vbtmym 'shytm vtmlykhv 't 'bymlkh v'm tvbh 'shytm 'm yrb'l v'm bytv v'm khgmvl ydyv 'shytm lv
verses.translation: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר נִלְחַ֥ם אָבִ֖/י עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֤ךְ אֶת נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ מִ/נֶּ֔גֶד וַ/יַּצֵּ֥ל אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/יַּ֥ד מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: 'shr nlchm 'by 'lykhm vyshlkh 't npshv mngd vytsl 'tkhm myd mdyn
verses.translation: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֞ם קַמְתֶּ֨ם עַל בֵּ֤ית אָבִ/י֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וַ/תַּהַרְג֧וּ אֶת בָּנָ֛י/ו שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ עַל אֶ֣בֶן אֶחָ֑ת וַ/תַּמְלִ֜יכוּ אֶת אֲבִימֶ֤לֶךְ בֶּן אֲמָת/וֹ֙ עַל בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אֲחִי/כֶ֖ם הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'tm qmtm 'l byt 'by hyvm vthrgv 't bnyv shb'ym 'ysh 'l 'bn 'cht vtmlykhv 't 'bymlkh bn 'mtv 'l b'ly shkhm khy 'chykhm hv'
verses.translation: And ye are risen up against my father’s house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)

verses.original: וְ/אִם בֶּ/אֱמֶ֨ת וּ/בְ/תָמִ֧ים עֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם עִם יְרֻבַּ֥עַל וְ/עִם בֵּית֖/וֹ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה שִׂמְחוּ֙ בַּ/אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְ/יִשְׂמַ֥ח גַּם ה֖וּא בָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'm b'mt vbtmym 'shytm 'm yrb'l v'm bytv hyvm hzh shmchv b'bymlkh vyshmch gm hv' bkhm
verses.translation: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:

verses.original: וְ/אִם אַ֕יִן תֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מֵ/אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְ/תֹאכַ֛ל אֶת בַּעֲלֵ֥י שְׁכֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית מִלּ֑וֹא וְ/תֵצֵ֨א אֵ֜שׁ מִ/בַּעֲלֵ֤י שְׁכֶם֙ וּ/מִ/בֵּ֣ית מִלּ֔וֹא וְ/תֹאכַ֖ל אֶת אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: v'm 'yn tts' 'sh m'bymlkh vt'khl 't b'ly shkhm v't byt mlv' vtts' 'sh mb'ly shkhm vmbyt mlv' vt'khl 't 'bymlkh
verses.translation: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣נָס יוֹתָ֔ם וַ/יִּבְרַ֖ח וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ בְּאֵ֑רָ/ה וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב שָׁ֔ם מִ/פְּנֵ֖י אֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyns yvtm vybrch vylkh b'rh vyshb shm mpny 'bymlkh 'chyv
verses.translation: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧שַׂר אֲבִימֶ֛לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שָׁלֹ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vyshr 'bymlkh 'l yshr'l shlsh shnym
verses.translation: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֱלֹהִים֙ ר֣וּחַ רָעָ֔ה בֵּ֣ין אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ וּ/בֵ֖ין בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם וַ/יִּבְגְּד֥וּ בַעֲלֵי שְׁכֶ֖ם בַּ/אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyshlch 'lhym rvch r'h byn 'bymlkh vbyn b'ly shkhm vybgdv b'ly shkhm b'bymlkh
verses.translation: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:

verses.original: לָ/ב֕וֹא חֲמַ֖ס שִׁבְעִ֣ים בְּנֵֽי יְרֻבָּ֑עַל וְ/דָמָ֗/ם לָ/שׂ֞וּם עַל אֲבִימֶ֤לֶךְ אֲחִי/הֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָרַ֣ג אוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/עַל֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר חִזְּק֥וּ אֶת יָדָ֖י/ו לַ/הֲרֹ֥ג אֶת אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: lbv' chms shb'ym bny yrb'l vdmm lshvm 'l 'bymlkh 'chyhm 'shr hrg 'vtm v'l b'ly shkhm 'shr chzqv 't ydyv lhrg 't 'chyv
verses.translation: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֣ימוּ ל/וֹ֩ בַעֲלֵ֨י שְׁכֶ֜ם מְאָרְבִ֗ים עַ֚ל רָאשֵׁ֣י הֶ/הָרִ֔ים וַ/יִּגְזְל֗וּ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹ֥ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם בַּ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וַ/יֻּגַּ֖ד לַ/אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyshymv lv b'ly shkhm m'rbym 'l r'shy hhrym vygzlv 't khl 'shr y'br 'lyhm bdrkh vygd l'bymlkh
verses.translation: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֞א גַּ֤עַל בֶּן עֶ֨בֶד֙ וְ/אֶחָ֔י/ו וַ/יַּעַבְר֖וּ בִּ/שְׁכֶ֑ם וַ/יִּבְטְחוּ ב֖/וֹ בַּעֲלֵ֥י שְׁכֶֽם
verses.translit: vyb' g'l bn 'bd v'chyv vy'brv bshkhm vybtchv bv b'ly shkhm
verses.translation: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֨וּ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֜ה וַֽ/יִּבְצְר֤וּ אֶת כַּרְמֵי/הֶם֙ וַֽ/יִּדְרְכ֔וּ וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֖וּ הִלּוּלִ֑ים וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱֽלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ וַ/יִּשְׁתּ֔וּ וַֽ/יְקַלְל֖וּ אֶת אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyts'v hshdh vybtsrv 't khrmyhm vydrkhv vy'shv hlvlym vyb'v byt 'lhyhm vy'khlv vyshtv vyqllv 't 'bymlkh
verses.translation: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes , and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר גַּ֣עַל בֶּן עֶ֗בֶד מִֽי אֲבִימֶ֤לֶךְ וּ/מִֽי שְׁכֶם֙ כִּ֣י נַעַבְדֶ֔/נּוּ הֲ/לֹ֥א בֶן יְרֻבַּ֖עַל וּ/זְבֻ֣ל פְּקִיד֑/וֹ עִבְד֗וּ אֶת אַנְשֵׁ֤י חֲמוֹר֙ אֲבִ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם וּ/מַדּ֖וּעַ נַעַבְדֶ֥/נּוּ אֲנָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr g'l bn 'bd my 'bymlkh vmy shkhm khy n'bdnv hl' bn yrb'l vzbl pqydv 'bdv 't 'nshy chmvr 'by shkhm vmdv' n'bdnv 'nchnv
verses.translation: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?

verses.original: וּ/מִ֨י יִתֵּ֜ן אֶת הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ בְּ/יָדִ֔/י וְ/אָסִ֖ירָה אֶת אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לַ/אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ רַבֶּ֥ה צְבָאֲ/ךָ֖ וָ/צֵֽאָ/ה
verses.translit: vmy ytn 't h'm hzh bydy v'syrh 't 'bymlkh vy'mr l'bymlkh rbh tsb'kh vts'h
verses.translation: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֗ע זְבֻל֙ שַׂר הָ/עִ֔יר אֶת דִּבְרֵ֖י גַּ֣עַל בֶּן עָ֑בֶד וַ/יִּ֖חַר אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshm' zbl shr h'yr 't dbry g'l bn 'bd vychr 'pv
verses.translation: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֧ח מַלְאָכִ֛ים אֶל אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ בְּ/תָרְמָ֣ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּה֩ גַ֨עַל בֶּן עֶ֤בֶד וְ/אֶחָי/ו֙ בָּאִ֣ים שְׁכֶ֔מָ/ה וְ/הִנָּ֛/ם צָרִ֥ים אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyshlch ml'khym 'l 'bymlkh btrmh l'mr hnh g'l bn 'bd v'chyv b'ym shkhmh vhnm tsrym 't h'yr 'lykh
verses.translation: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ ק֣וּם לַ֔יְלָה אַתָּ֖ה וְ/הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר אִתָּ֑/ךְ וֶ/אֱרֹ֖ב בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: v'th qvm lylh 'th vh'm 'shr 'tkh v'rb bshdh
verses.translation: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה בַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ כִּ/זְרֹ֣חַ הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ תַּשְׁכִּ֖ים וּ/פָשַׁטְתָּ֣ עַל הָ/עִ֑יר וְ/הִנֵּה ה֞וּא וְ/הָ/עָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ/וֹ֙ יֹצְאִ֣ים אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר תִּמְצָ֥א יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyh bbqr khzrch hshmsh tshkhym vpshtt 'l h'yr vhnh hv' vh'm 'shr 'tv yts'ym 'lykh v'shyt lv kh'shr tmts' ydkh
verses.translation: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧קָם אֲבִימֶ֛לֶךְ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר עִמּ֖/וֹ לָ֑יְלָה וַ/יֶּאֶרְב֣וּ עַל שְׁכֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה רָאשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyqm 'bymlkh vkhl h'm 'shr 'mv lylh vy'rbv 'l shkhm 'rb'h r'shym
verses.translation: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ גַּ֣עַל בֶּן עֶ֔בֶד וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֕ד פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יָּ֧קָם אֲבִימֶ֛לֶךְ וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֖/וֹ מִן הַ/מַּאְרָֽב
verses.translit: vyts' g'l bn 'bd vy'md ptch sh'r h'yr vyqm 'bymlkh vh'm 'shr 'tv mn hm'rb
verses.translation: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא גַּעַל֮ אֶת הָ/עָם֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל זְבֻ֔ל הִנֵּה עָ֣ם יוֹרֵ֔ד מֵ/רָאשֵׁ֖י הֶ/הָרִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ זְבֻ֔ל אֵ֣ת צֵ֧ל הֶ/הָרִ֛ים אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה כָּ/אֲנָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyr' g'l 't h'm vy'mr 'l zbl hnh 'm yvrd mr'shy hhrym vy'mr 'lyv zbl 't tsl hhrym 'th r'h kh'nshym
verses.translation: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨סֶף ע֣וֹד גַּעַל֮ לְ/דַבֵּר֒ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה עָם֙ יֽוֹרְדִ֔ים מֵ/עִ֖ם טַבּ֣וּר הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/רֹאשׁ אֶחָ֣ד בָּ֔א מִ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֵל֥וֹן מְעוֹנְנִֽים
verses.translit: vysf 'vd g'l ldbr vy'mr hnh 'm yvrdym m'm tbvr h'rts vr'sh 'chd b' mdrkh 'lvn m'vnnym
verses.translation: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו זְבֻ֗ל אַיֵּ֨ה אֵפ֥וֹא פִ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאמַ֔ר מִ֥י אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ כִּ֣י נַעַבְדֶ֑/נּוּ הֲ/לֹ֨א זֶ֤ה הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָאַ֣סְתָּה בּ֔/וֹ צֵא נָ֥א עַתָּ֖ה וְ/הִלָּ֥חֶם בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv zbl 'yh 'pv' pykh 'shr t'mr my 'bymlkh khy n'bdnv hl' zh h'm 'shr m'sth bv ts' n' 'th vhlchm bv
verses.translation: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣צֵא גַ֔עַל לִ/פְנֵ֖י בַּעֲלֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם בַּ/אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyts' g'l lpny b'ly shkhm vylchm b'bymlkh
verses.translation: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדְּפֵ֣/הוּ אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ וַ/יָּ֖נָס מִ/פָּנָ֑י/ו וַֽ/יִּפְּל֛וּ חֲלָלִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים עַד פֶּ֥תַח הַ/שָּֽׁעַר
verses.translit: vyrdphv 'bymlkh vyns mpnyv vyplv chllym rbym 'd ptch hsh'r
verses.translation: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ בָּ/ארוּמָ֑ה וַ/יְגָ֧רֶשׁ זְבֻ֛ל אֶת גַּ֥עַל וְ/אֶת אֶחָ֖י/ו מִ/שֶּׁ֥בֶת בִּ/שְׁכֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshb 'bymlkh b'rvmh vygrsh zbl 't g'l v't 'chyv mshbt bshkhm
verses.translation: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א הָ/עָ֖ם הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וַ/יַּגִּ֖דוּ לַ/אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyts' h'm hshdh vygdv l'bymlkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת הָ/עָ֗ם וַֽ/יֶּחֱצֵ/ם֙ לִ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֔ים וַ/יֶּאֱרֹ֖ב בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וַ/יַּ֗רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה הָ/עָם֙ יֹצֵ֣א מִן הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יָּ֥קָם עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם וַ/יַּכֵּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqch 't h'm vychtsm lshlshh r'shym vy'rb bshdh vyr' vhnh h'm yts' mn h'yr vyqm 'lyhm vykhm
verses.translation: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.

verses.original: וַ/אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וְ/הָ/רָאשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֔/וֹ פָּשְׁט֕וּ וַ/יַּ֣עַמְד֔וּ פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר הָ/עִ֑יר וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י הָֽ/רָאשִׁ֗ים פָּֽשְׁט֛וּ עַֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה וַ/יַּכּֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: v'bymlkh vhr'shym 'shr 'mv pshtv vy'mdv ptch sh'r h'yr vshny hr'shym pshtv 'l khl 'shr bshdh vykhvm
verses.translation: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.

verses.original: וַ/אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ נִלְחָ֣ם בָּ/עִ֗יר כֹּ֚ל הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא וַ/יִּלְכֹּד֙ אֶת הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/אֶת הָ/עָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר בָּ֖/הּ הָרָ֑ג וַ/יִּתֹּץ֙ אֶת הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יִּזְרָעֶ֖/הָ מֶֽלַח
verses.translit: v'bymlkh nlchm b'yr khl hyvm hhv' vylkhd 't h'yr v't h'm 'shr bh hrg vytts 't h'yr vyzr'h mlch
verses.translation: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֔וּ כָּֽל בַּעֲלֵ֖י מִֽגְדַּל שְׁכֶ֑ם וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל צְרִ֔יחַ בֵּ֖ית אֵ֥ל בְּרִֽית
verses.translit: vyshm'v khl b'ly mgdl shkhm vyb'v 'l tsrych byt 'l bryt
verses.translation: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that , they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֖ד לַ/אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ כִּ֣י הִֽתְקַבְּצ֔וּ כָּֽל בַּעֲלֵ֖י מִֽגְדַּל שְׁכֶֽם
verses.translit: vygd l'bymlkh khy htqbtsv khl b'ly mgdl shkhm
verses.translation: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ הַר צַלְמ֗וֹן הוּא֮ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ/וֹ֒ וַ/יִּקַּח֩ אֲבִימֶ֨לֶךְ אֶת הַ/קַּרְדֻּמּ֜וֹת בְּ/יָד֗/וֹ וַ/יִּכְרֹת֙ שׂוֹכַ֣ת עֵצִ֔ים וַ/יִּ֨שָּׂאֶ֔/הָ וַ/יָּ֖שֶׂם עַל שִׁכְמ֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר אֶל הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר עִמּ֗/וֹ מָ֤ה רְאִיתֶם֙ עָשִׂ֔יתִי מַהֲר֖וּ עֲשׂ֥וּ כָמֽוֹ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'l 'bymlkh hr tslmvn hv' vkhl h'm 'shr 'tv vyqch 'bymlkh 't hqrdmvt bydv vykhrt shvkht 'tsym vysh'h vyshm 'l shkhmv vy'mr 'l h'm 'shr 'mv mh r'ytm 'shyty mhrv 'shv khmvny
verses.translation: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done .

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרְת֨וּ גַם כָּל הָ/עָ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ שׂוֹכֹ֗/ה וַ/יֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ אַחֲרֵ֤י אֲבִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ וַ/יָּשִׂ֣ימוּ עַֽל הַ/צְּרִ֔יחַ וַ/יַּצִּ֧יתוּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם אֶֽת הַ/צְּרִ֖יחַ בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ וַ/יָּמֻ֜תוּ גַּ֣ם כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֧י מִֽגְדַּל שְׁכֶ֛ם כְּ/אֶ֖לֶף אִ֥ישׁ וְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vykhrtv gm khl h'm 'ysh shvkhh vylkhv 'chry 'bymlkh vyshymv 'l htsrych vytsytv 'lyhm 't htsrych b'sh vymtv gm khl 'nshy mgdl shkhm kh'lf 'ysh v'shh
verses.translation: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל תֵּבֵ֑ץ וַ/יִּ֥חַן בְּ/תֵבֵ֖ץ וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vylkh 'bymlkh 'l tbts vychn btbts vylkhdh
verses.translation: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

verses.original: וּ/מִגְדַּל עֹז֮ הָיָ֣ה בְ/תוֹךְ הָ/עִיר֒ וַ/יָּנֻ֨סוּ שָׁ֜מָּ/ה כָּל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים וְ/הַ/נָּשִׁ֗ים וְ/כֹל֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י הָ/עִ֔יר וַֽ/יִּסְגְּר֖וּ בַּעֲדָ֑/ם וַֽ/יַּעֲל֖וּ עַל גַּ֥ג הַ/מִּגְדָּֽל
verses.translit: vmgdl 'z hyh btvkh h'yr vynsv shmh khl h'nshym vhnshym vkhl b'ly h'yr vysgrv b'dm vy'lv 'l gg hmgdl
verses.translation: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א אֲבִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַד הַ/מִּגְדָּ֔ל וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם בּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּגַּ֛שׁ עַד פֶּ֥תַח הַ/מִּגְדָּ֖ל לְ/שָׂרְפ֥/וֹ בָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyb' 'bymlkh 'd hmgdl vylchm bv vygsh 'd ptch hmgdl lshrpv b'sh
verses.translation: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

verses.original: וַ/תַּשְׁלֵ֞ךְ אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחַ֛ת פֶּ֥לַח רֶ֖כֶב עַל רֹ֣אשׁ אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַ/תָּ֖רִץ אֶת גֻּלְגָּלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtshlkh 'shh 'cht plch rkhb 'l r'sh 'bymlkh vtrts 't glgltv
verses.translation: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and all to brake his skull.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א מְהֵרָ֜ה אֶל הַ/נַּ֣עַר נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֗י/ו וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ שְׁלֹ֤ף חַרְבְּ/ךָ֙ וּ/מ֣וֹתְתֵ֔/נִי פֶּן יֹ֥אמְרוּ לִ֖/י אִשָּׁ֣ה הֲרָגָ֑תְ/הוּ וַ/יִּדְקְרֵ֥/הוּ נַעֲר֖/וֹ וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyqr' mhrh 'l hn'r nsh' khlyv vy'mr lv shlf chrbkh vmvttny pn y'mrv ly 'shh hrgthv vydqrhv n'rv vymt
verses.translation: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֥וּ אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לִ/מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr'v 'ysh yshr'l khy mt 'bymlkh vylkhv 'ysh lmqmv
verses.translation: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שֶׁב אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֵ֖ת רָעַ֣ת אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְ/אָבִ֔י/ו לַ/הֲרֹ֖ג אֶת שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshb 'lhym 't r't 'bymlkh 'shr 'shh l'byv lhrg 't shb'ym 'chyv
verses.translation: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗ת כָּל רָעַת֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י שְׁכֶ֔ם הֵשִׁ֥יב אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/רֹאשָׁ֑/ם וַ/תָּבֹ֣א אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם קִֽלֲלַ֖ת יוֹתָ֥ם בֶּן יְרֻבָּֽעַל
verses.translit: v't khl r't 'nshy shkhm hshyb 'lhym br'shm vtb' 'lyhm qllt yvtm bn yrb'l
verses.translation: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקָם֩ אַחֲרֵ֨י אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ לְ/הוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל תּוֹלָ֧ע בֶּן פּוּאָ֛ה בֶּן דּוֹד֖וֹ אִ֣ישׁ יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר וְ/הֽוּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/שָׁמִ֖יר בְּ/הַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyqm 'chry 'bymlkh lhvshy' 't yshr'l tvl' bn pv'h bn dvdv 'ysh yshshkhr vhv' yshb bshmyr bhr 'prym
verses.translation: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּט֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/שָׁלֹ֖שׁ שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יָּ֖מָת וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּ/שָׁמִֽיר
verses.translit: vyshpt 't yshr'l 'shrym vshlsh shnh vymt vyqbr bshmyr
verses.translation: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם אַחֲרָ֔י/ו יָאִ֖יר הַ/גִּלְעָדִ֑י וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּט֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֖יִם שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyqm 'chryv y'yr hgl'dy vyshpt 't yshr'l 'shrym vshtym shnh
verses.translation: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי ל֞/וֹ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים רֹֽכְבִים֙ עַל שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים עֲיָרִ֔ים וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים עֲיָרִ֖ים לָ/הֶ֑ם לָ/הֶ֞ם יִקְרְא֣וּ חַוֺּ֣ת יָאִ֗יר עַ֚ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vyhy lv shlshym bnym rkhbym 'l shlshym 'yrym vshlshym 'yrym lhm lhm yqr'v chvt y'yr 'd hyvm hzh 'shr b'rts hgl'd
verses.translation: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת יָאִ֔יר וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/קָמֽוֹן
verses.translit: vymt y'yr vyqbr bqmvn
verses.translation: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּסִ֣פוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת הָ/רַע֮ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וַ/יַּעַבְד֣וּ אֶת הַ/בְּעָלִ֣ים וְ/אֶת הָ/עַשְׁתָּר֡וֹת וְ/אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲרָם֩ וְ/אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֨י צִיד֜וֹן וְ/אֵ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֣י מוֹאָ֗ב וְ/אֵת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י בְנֵי עַמּ֔וֹן וְ/אֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יַּעַזְב֥וּ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyspv bny yshr'l l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh vy'bdv 't hb'lym v't h'shtrvt v't 'lhy 'rm v't 'lhy tsydvn v't 'lhy mv'b v't 'lhy bny 'mvn v't 'lhy plshtym vy'zbv 't yhvh vl' 'bdvhv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD , and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD , and served not him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יִּמְכְּרֵ/ם֙ בְּ/יַד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּ/בְ/יַ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh byshr'l vymkhrm byd plshtym vbyd bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּרְעֲצ֤וּ וַ/יְרֹֽצְצוּ֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּ/שָּׁנָ֖ה הַ/הִ֑יא שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה שָׁנָ֗ה אֶֽת כָּל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vyr'tsv vyrtstsv 't bny yshr'l bshnh hhy' shmnh 'shrh shnh 't khl bny yshr'l 'shr b'br hyrdn b'rts h'mry 'shr bgl'd
verses.translation: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַבְר֤וּ בְנֵֽי עַמּוֹן֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן לְ/הִלָּחֵ֛ם גַּם בִּ/יהוּדָ֥ה וּ/בְ/בִנְיָמִ֖ין וּ/בְ/בֵ֣ית אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/תֵּ֥צֶר לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'brv bny 'mvn 't hyrdn lhlchm gm byhvdh vbbnymyn vbbyt 'prym vttsr lyshr'l m'd
verses.translation: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּזְעֲקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר חָטָ֣אנוּ לָ֔/ךְ וְ/כִ֤י עָזַ֨בְנוּ֙ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ וַֽ/נַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת הַ/בְּעָלִֽים
verses.translit: vyz'qv bny yshr'l 'l yhvh l'mr cht'nv lkh vkhy 'zbnv 't 'lhynv vn'bd 't hb'lym
verses.translation: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD , saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.

verses.original: וַ֥/יֹּאמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲ/לֹ֤א מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ וּ/מִן הָ֣/אֱמֹרִ֔י וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן וּ/מִן פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l bny yshr'l hl' mmtsrym vmn h'mry vmn bny 'mvn vmn plshtym
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

verses.original: וְ/צִידוֹנִ֤ים וַֽ/עֲמָלֵק֙ וּ/מָע֔וֹן לָחֲצ֖וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וַ/תִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֵלַ֔/י וָ/אוֹשִׁ֥יעָ/ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/יָּדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vtsydvnym v'mlq vm'vn lchtsv 'tkhm vtts'qv 'ly v'vshy'h 'tkhm mydm
verses.translation: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּם֙ עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ם אוֹתִ֔/י וַ/תַּעַבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים לָ/כֵ֥ן לֹֽא אוֹסִ֖יף לְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tm 'zbtm 'vty vt'bdv 'lhym 'chrym lkhn l' 'vsyf lhvshy' 'tkhm
verses.translation: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.

verses.original: לְכ֗וּ וְ/זַֽעֲקוּ֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּ֖ם בָּ֑/ם הֵ֛מָּה יוֹשִׁ֥יעוּ לָ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/עֵ֥ת צָרַתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lkhv vz'qv 'l h'lhym 'shr bchrtm bm hmh yvshy'v lkhm b't tsrtkhm
verses.translation: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל יְהוָה֙ חָטָ֔אנוּ עֲשֵׂה אַתָּ֣ה לָ֔/נוּ כְּ/כָל הַ/טּ֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ אַ֛ךְ הַצִּילֵ֥/נוּ נָ֖א הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv bny yshr'l 'l yhvh cht'nv 'shh 'th lnv khkhl htvb b'ynykh 'kh htsylnv n' hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD , We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.

verses.original: וַ/יָּסִ֜ירוּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַ/נֵּכָר֙ מִ/קִּרְבָּ֔/ם וַ/יַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/תִּקְצַ֥ר נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ בַּ/עֲמַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vysyrv 't 'lhy hnkhr mqrbm vy'bdv 't yhvh vtqtsr npshv b'ml yshr'l
verses.translation: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD : and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצָּֽעֲקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּ/גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יֵּאָֽסְפוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּ/מִּצְפָּֽה
verses.translit: vyts'qv bny 'mvn vychnv bgl'd vy'spv bny yshr'l vychnv bmtsph
verses.translation: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ הָ/עָ֜ם שָׂרֵ֤י גִלְעָד֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֔/הוּ מִ֣י הָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָחֵ֔ל לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם בִּ/בְנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לְ/רֹ֔אשׁ לְ/כֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'm shry gl'd 'ysh 'l r'hv my h'ysh 'shr ychl lhlchm bbny 'mvn yhyh lr'sh lkhl yshby gl'd
verses.translation: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

verses.original: וְ/יִפְתָּ֣ח הַ/גִּלְעָדִ֗י הָיָה֙ גִּבּ֣וֹר חַ֔יִל וְ/ה֖וּא בֶּן אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד גִּלְעָ֖ד אֶת יִפְתָּֽח
verses.translit: vyptch hgl'dy hyh gbvr chyl vhv' bn 'shh zvnh vyvld gl'd 't yptch
verses.translation: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֧לֶד אֵֽשֶׁת גִּלְעָ֛ד ל֖/וֹ בָּנִ֑ים וַ/יִּגְדְּל֨וּ בְֽנֵי הָ/אִשָּׁ֜ה וַ/יְגָרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת יִפְתָּ֗ח וַ/יֹּ֤אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֙ לֹֽא תִנְחַ֣ל בְּ/בֵית אָבִ֔י/נוּ כִּ֛י בֶּן אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֖רֶת אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vtld 'sht gl'd lv bnym vygdlv bny h'shh vygrshv 't yptch vy'mrv lv l' tnchl bbyt 'bynv khy bn 'shh 'chrt 'th
verses.translation: And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father’s house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְרַ֤ח יִפְתָּח֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י אֶחָ֔י/ו וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ ט֑וֹב וַ/יִּֽתְלַקְּט֤וּ אֶל יִפְתָּח֙ אֲנָשִׁ֣ים רֵיקִ֔ים וַ/יֵּצְא֖וּ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vybrch yptch mpny 'chyv vyshb b'rts tvb vytlqtv 'l yptch 'nshym ryqym vyts'v 'mv
verses.translation: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י מִ/יָּמִ֑ים וַ/יִּלָּחֲמ֥וּ בְנֵֽי עַמּ֖וֹן עִם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy mymym vylchmv bny 'mvn 'm yshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כַּ/אֲשֶׁר נִלְחֲמ֥וּ בְנֵֽי עַמּ֖וֹן עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד לָ/קַ֥חַת אֶת יִפְתָּ֖ח מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr nlchmv bny 'mvn 'm yshr'l vylkhv zqny gl'd lqcht 't yptch m'rts tvb
verses.translation: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לְ/יִפְתָּ֔ח לְכָ֕/ה וְ/הָיִ֥יתָה לָּ֖/נוּ לְ/קָצִ֑ין וְ/נִֽלָּחֲמָ֖ה בִּ/בְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mrv lyptch lkhh vhyyth lnv lqtsyn vnlchmh bbny 'mvn
verses.translation: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִפְתָּח֙ לְ/זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד הֲ/לֹ֤א אַתֶּם֙ שְׂנֵאתֶ֣ם אוֹתִ֔/י וַ/תְּגָרְשׁ֖וּ/נִי מִ/בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑/י וּ/מַדּ֜וּעַ בָּאתֶ֤ם אֵלַ/י֙ עַ֔תָּה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צַ֥ר לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yptch lzqny gl'd hl' 'tm shn'tm 'vty vtgrshvny mbyt 'by vmdv' b'tm 'ly 'th kh'shr tsr lkhm
verses.translation: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father’s house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֩ זִקְנֵ֨י גִלְעָ֜ד אֶל יִפְתָּ֗ח לָ/כֵן֙ עַתָּה֙ שַׁ֣בְנוּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הָלַכְתָּ֣ עִמָּ֔/נוּ וְ/נִלְחַמְתָּ֖ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְ/הָיִ֤יתָ לָּ֨/נוּ֙ לְ/רֹ֔אשׁ לְ/כֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vy'mrv zqny gl'd 'l yptch lkhn 'th shbnv 'lykh vhlkht 'mnv vnlchmt bbny 'mvn vhyyt lnv lr'sh lkhl yshby gl'd
verses.translation: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יִפְתָּ֜ח אֶל זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֗ד אִם מְשִׁיבִ֨ים אַתֶּ֤ם אוֹתִ/י֙ לְ/הִלָּחֵם֙ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וְ/נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אוֹתָ֖/ם לְ/פָנָ֑/י אָנֹכִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr yptch 'l zqny gl'd 'm mshybym 'tm 'vty lhlchm bbny 'mvn vntn yhvh 'vtm lpny 'nkhy 'hyh lkhm lr'sh
verses.translation: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ זִקְנֵֽי גִלְעָ֖ד אֶל יִפְתָּ֑ח יְהוָ֗ה יִהְיֶ֤ה שֹׁמֵ֨עַ֙ בֵּֽינוֹתֵ֔י/נוּ אִם לֹ֥א כִ/דְבָרְ/ךָ֖ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'mrv zqny gl'd 'l yptch yhvh yhyh shm' bynvtynv 'm l' khdbrkh khn n'shh
verses.translation: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ יִפְתָּח֙ עִם זִקְנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וַ/יָּשִׂ֨ימוּ הָ/עָ֥ם אוֹת֛/וֹ עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ וּ/לְ/קָצִ֑ין וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר יִפְתָּ֧ח אֶת כָּל דְּבָרָ֛י/ו לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/מִּצְפָּֽה
verses.translit: vylkh yptch 'm zqny gl'd vyshymv h'm 'vtv 'lyhm lr'sh vlqtsyn vydbr yptch 't khl dbryv lpny yhvh bmtsph
verses.translation: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִפְתָּח֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֖וֹן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מַה לִּ֣/י וָ/לָ֔/ךְ כִּֽי בָ֥אתָ אֵלַ֖/י לְ/הִלָּחֵ֥ם בְּ/אַרְצִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshlch yptch ml'khym 'l mlkh bny 'mvn l'mr mh ly vlkh khy b't 'ly lhlchm b'rtsy
verses.translation: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּ֜וֹן אֶל מַלְאֲכֵ֣י יִפְתָּ֗ח כִּֽי לָקַ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶת אַרְצִ/י֙ בַּ/עֲלוֹת֣/וֹ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם מֵ/אַרְנ֥וֹן וְ/עַד הַ/יַּבֹּ֖ק וְ/עַד הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ/עַתָּ֕ה הָשִׁ֥יבָ/ה אֶתְ/הֶ֖ן בְּ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh bny 'mvn 'l ml'khy yptch khy lqch yshr'l 't 'rtsy b'lvtv mmtsrym m'rnvn v'd hybq v'd hyrdn v'th hshybh 'thn bshlvm
verses.translation: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֥וֹסֶף ע֖וֹד יִפְתָּ֑ח וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyvsf 'vd yptch vyshlch ml'khym 'l mlkh bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יִפְתָּ֑ח לֹֽא לָקַ֤ח יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/אֶת אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr lv khh 'mr yptch l' lqch yshr'l 't 'rts mv'b v't 'rts bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

verses.original: כִּ֖י בַּ/עֲלוֹתָ֣/ם מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֙ עַד יַם ס֔וּף וַ/יָּבֹ֖א קָדֵֽשָׁ/ה
verses.translit: khy b'lvtm mmtsrym vylkh yshr'l bmdbr 'd ym svf vyb' qdshh
verses.translation: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְאָכִ֣ים אֶל מֶלֶךְ֩ אֱד֨וֹם לֵ/אמֹ֜ר אֶעְבְּרָה נָּ֣א בְ/אַרְצֶ֗/ךָ וְ/לֹ֤א שָׁמַע֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֔וֹם וְ/גַ֨ם אֶל מֶ֧לֶךְ מוֹאָ֛ב שָׁלַ֖ח וְ/לֹ֣א אָבָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/קָדֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyshlch yshr'l ml'khym 'l mlkh 'dvm l'mr ''brh n' b'rtskh vl' shm' mlkh 'dvm vgm 'l mlkh mv'b shlch vl' 'bh vyshb yshr'l bqdsh
verses.translation: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר וַ/יָּ֜סָב אֶת אֶ֤רֶץ אֱדוֹם֙ וְ/אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב וַ/יָּבֹ֤א מִ/מִּזְרַח שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ לְ/אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ/ן בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר אַרְנ֑וֹן וְ/לֹא בָ֨אוּ֙ בִּ/גְב֣וּל מוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י אַרְנ֖וֹן גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vylkh bmdbr vysb 't 'rts 'dvm v't 'rts mv'b vyb' mmzrch shmsh l'rts mv'b vychnvn b'br 'rnvn vl' b'v bgbvl mv'b khy 'rnvn gbvl mv'b
verses.translation: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל סִיח֥וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נַעְבְּרָה נָּ֥א בְ/אַרְצְ/ךָ֖ עַד מְקוֹמִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshlch yshr'l ml'khym 'l sychvn mlkh h'mry mlkh chshbvn vy'mr lv yshr'l n'brh n' b'rtskh 'd mqvmy
verses.translation: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא הֶאֱמִ֨ין סִיח֤וֹן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֲבֹ֣ר בִּ/גְבֻל֔/וֹ וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֤ף סִיחוֹן֙ אֶת כָּל עַמּ֔/וֹ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/יָ֑הְצָ/ה וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם עִם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' h'myn sychvn 't yshr'l 'br bgblv vy'sf sychvn 't khl 'mv vychnv byhtsh vylchm 'm yshr'l
verses.translation: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּתֵּן יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת סִיח֧וֹן וְ/אֶת כָּל עַמּ֛/וֹ בְּ/יַ֥ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַ/יַּכּ֑וּ/ם וַ/יִּירַשׁ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֚ת כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/הִֽיא
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 't sychvn v't khl 'mv byd yshr'l vykhvm vyyrsh yshr'l 't khl 'rts h'mry yvshb h'rts hhy'
verses.translation: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣ירְשׁ֔וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל גְּב֣וּל הָ/אֱמֹרִ֑י מֵֽ/אַרְנוֹן֙ וְ/עַד הַ/יַּבֹּ֔ק וּ/מִן הַ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר וְ/עַד הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyyrshv 't khl gbvl h'mry m'rnvn v'd hybq vmn hmdbr v'd hyrdn
verses.translation: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֱמֹרִ֔י מִ/פְּנֵ֖י עַמּ֣/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תִּירָשֶֽׁ/נּוּ
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hvrysh 't h'mry mpny 'mv yshr'l v'th tyrshnv
verses.translation: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֞א אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר יוֹרִֽישְׁ/ךָ֛ כְּמ֥וֹשׁ אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ אוֹת֥/וֹ תִירָ֑שׁ וְ/אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹרִ֜ישׁ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛י/נוּ מִ/פָּנֵ֖י/נוּ אוֹת֥/וֹ נִירָֽשׁ
verses.translit: hl' 't 'shr yvryshkh khmvsh 'lhykh 'vtv tyrsh v't khl 'shr hvrysh yhvh 'lhynv mpnynv 'vtv nyrsh
verses.translation: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הֲ/ט֥וֹב טוֹב֙ אַתָּ֔ה מִ/בָּלָ֥ק בֶּן צִפּ֖וֹר מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֑ב הֲ/ר֥וֹב רָב֙ עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם נִלְחֹ֥ם נִלְחַ֖ם בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th htvb tvb 'th mblq bn tspvr mlkh mv'b hrvb rb 'm yshr'l 'm nlchm nlchm bm
verses.translation: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,

verses.original: בְּ/שֶׁ֣בֶת יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל בְּ/חֶשְׁבּ֨וֹן וּ/בִ/בְנוֹתֶ֜י/הָ וּ/בְ/עַרְע֣וֹר וּ/בִ/בְנוֹתֶ֗י/הָ וּ/בְ/כָל הֶֽ/עָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל יְדֵ֣י אַרְנ֔וֹן שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וּ/מַדּ֥וּעַ לֹֽא הִצַּלְתֶּ֖ם בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִֽיא
verses.translit: bshbt yshr'l bchshbvn vbbnvtyh vb'r'vr vbbnvtyh vbkhl h'rym 'shr 'l ydy 'rnvn shlsh m'vt shnh vmdv' l' htsltm b't hhy'
verses.translation: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?

verses.original: וְ/אָֽנֹכִי֙ לֹֽא חָטָ֣אתִי לָ֔/ךְ וְ/אַתָּ֞ה עֹשֶׂ֥ה אִתִּ֛/י רָעָ֖ה לְ/הִלָּ֣חֶם בִּ֑/י יִשְׁפֹּ֨ט יְהוָ֤ה הַ/שֹּׁפֵט֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/בֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'nkhy l' cht'ty lkh v'th 'shh 'ty r'h lhlchm by yshpt yhvh hshpt hyvm byn bny yshr'l vbyn bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔ע מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן אֶל דִּבְרֵ֣י יִפְתָּ֔ח אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלַ֖ח אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vl' shm' mlkh bny 'mvn 'l dbry yptch 'shr shlch 'lyv
verses.translation: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֤י עַל יִפְתָּח֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֥ר אֶת הַ/גִּלְעָ֖ד וְ/אֶת מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹר֙ אֶת מִצְפֵּ֣ה גִלְעָ֔ד וּ/מִ/מִּצְפֵּ֣ה גִלְעָ֔ד עָבַ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vthy 'l yptch rvch yhvh vy'br 't hgl'd v't mnshh vy'br 't mtsph gl'd vmmtsph gl'd 'br bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּדַּ֨ר יִפְתָּ֥ח נֶ֛דֶר לַ/יהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אִם נָת֥וֹן תִּתֵּ֛ן אֶת בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן בְּ/יָדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vydr yptch ndr lyhvh vy'mr 'm ntvn ttn 't bny 'mvn bydy
verses.translation: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD , and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה הַ/יּוֹצֵ֗א אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵצֵ֜א מִ/דַּלְתֵ֤י בֵיתִ/י֙ לִ/קְרָאתִ֔/י בְּ/שׁוּבִ֥/י בְ/שָׁל֖וֹם מִ/בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וְ/הָיָה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/הַעֲלִיתִ֖/הוּ עוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh hyvts' 'shr yts' mdlty byty lqr'ty bshvby bshlvm mbny 'mvn vhyh lyhvh vh'lythv 'vlh
verses.translation: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD’s , and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֥ר יִפְתָּ֛ח אֶל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן לְ/הִלָּ֣חֶם בָּ֑/ם וַ/יִתְּנֵ֥/ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'br yptch 'l bny 'mvn lhlchm bm vytnm yhvh bydv
verses.translation: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֵּ֡/ם מֵ/עֲרוֹעֵר֩ וְ/עַד בּוֹאֲ/ךָ֨ מִנִּ֜ית עֶשְׂרִ֣ים עִ֗יר וְ/עַד֙ אָבֵ֣ל כְּרָמִ֔ים מַכָּ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יִּכָּֽנְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhm m'rv'r v'd bv'kh mnyt 'shrym 'yr v'd 'bl khrmym mkhh gdvlh m'd vykhn'v bny 'mvn mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א יִפְתָּ֣ח הַ/מִּצְפָּה֮ אֶל בֵּית/וֹ֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה בִתּ/וֹ֙ יֹצֵ֣את לִ/קְרָאת֔/וֹ בְ/תֻפִּ֖ים וּ/בִ/מְחֹל֑וֹת וְ/רַק֙ הִ֣יא יְחִידָ֔ה אֵֽין ל֥/וֹ מִמֶּ֛/נּוּ בֵּ֖ן אוֹ בַֽת
verses.translit: vyb' yptch hmtsph 'l bytv vhnh btv yts't lqr'tv btpym vbmchlvt vrq hy' ychydh 'yn lv mmnv bn 'v bt
verses.translation: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/רְאוֹת֨/וֹ אוֹתָ֜/הּ וַ/יִּקְרַ֣ע אֶת בְּגָדָ֗י/ו וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֲהָ֤הּ בִּתִּ/י֙ הַכְרֵ֣עַ הִכְרַעְתִּ֔/נִי וְ/אַ֖תְּ הָיִ֣יתְ בְּ/עֹֽכְרָ֑/י וְ/אָנֹכִ֗י פָּצִ֤יתִי פִ/י֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל לָ/שֽׁוּב
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vtv 'vth vyqr' 't bgdyv vy'mr 'hh bty hkhr' hkhr'tny v't hyyt b'khry v'nkhy ptsyty py 'l yhvh vl' 'vkhl lshvb
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD , and I cannot go back.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו אָבִ/י֙ פָּצִ֤יתָה אֶת פִּ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֣ה לִ֔/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר יָצָ֣א מִ/פִּ֑י/ךָ אַחֲרֵ֡י אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ לְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֧ה נְקָמ֛וֹת מֵ/אֹיְבֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyv 'by ptsyth 't pykh 'l yhvh 'shh ly kh'shr yts' mpykh 'chry 'shr 'shh lkh yhvh nqmvt m'ybykh mbny 'mvn
verses.translation: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD , do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אָבִ֔י/הָ יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לִּ֖/י הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה הַרְפֵּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜/נִּי שְׁנַ֣יִם חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וְ/אֵֽלְכָה֙ וְ/יָרַדְתִּ֣י עַל הֶֽ/הָרִ֔ים וְ/אֶבְכֶּה֙ עַל בְּתוּלַ֔/י אָנֹכִ֖י ו/רעית/י וְ/רֵעוֹתָֽ/י
