verses.translit: vt'mr 'l 'byh y'shh ly hdbr hzh hrph mmny shnym chdshym v'lkhh vyrdty 'l hhrym v'bkhh 'l btvly 'nkhy vr'yty vr'vty
verses.translation: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לֵ֔כִי וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח אוֹתָ֖/הּ שְׁנֵ֣י חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַ/תֵּ֤לֶךְ הִיא֙ וְ/רֵ֣עוֹתֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תֵּ֥בְךְּ עַל בְּתוּלֶ֖י/הָ עַל הֶ/הָרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr lkhy vyshlch 'vth shny chdshym vtlkh hy' vr'vtyh vtbkh 'l btvlyh 'l hhrym
verses.translation: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י מִ/קֵּ֣ץ שְׁנַ֣יִם חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וַ/תָּ֨שָׁב֙ אֶל אָבִ֔י/הָ וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ לָ֔/הּ אֶת נִדְר֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָדָ֑ר וְ/הִיא֙ לֹא יָדְעָ֣ה אִ֔ישׁ וַ/תְּהִי חֹ֖ק בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy mqts shnym chdshym vtshb 'l 'byh vy'sh lh 't ndrv 'shr ndr vhy' l' yd'h 'ysh vthy chq byshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

verses.original: מִ/יָּמִ֣ים יָמִ֗ימָ/ה תֵּלַ֨כְנָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/תַנּ֕וֹת לְ/בַת יִפְתָּ֖ח הַ/גִּלְעָדִ֑י אַרְבַּ֥עַת יָמִ֖ים בַּ/שָּׁנָֽה
verses.translit: mymym ymymh tlkhnh bnvt yshr'l ltnvt lbt yptch hgl'dy 'rb't ymym bshnh
verses.translation: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצָּעֵק֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֖ר צָפ֑וֹנָ/ה וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ לְ/יִפְתָּ֜ח מַדּ֣וּעַ עָבַ֣רְתָּ לְ/הִלָּחֵ֣ם בִּ/בְנֵי עַמּ֗וֹן וְ/לָ֨/נוּ֙ לֹ֤א קָרָ֨אתָ֙ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת עִמָּ֔/ךְ בֵּיתְ/ךָ֕ נִשְׂרֹ֥ף עָלֶ֖י/ךָ בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyts'q 'ysh 'prym vy'br tspvnh vy'mrv lyptch mdv' 'brt lhlchm bbny 'mvn vlnv l' qr't llkht 'mkh bytkh nshrf 'lykh b'sh
verses.translation: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יִפְתָּח֙ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אִ֣ישׁ רִ֗יב הָיִ֛יתִי אֲנִ֛י וְ/עַמִּ֥/י וּ/בְנֵֽי עַמּ֖וֹן מְאֹ֑ד וָ/אֶזְעַ֣ק אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא הוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖/י מִ/יָּדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yptch 'lyhm 'ysh ryb hyyty 'ny v'my vbny 'mvn m'd v'z'q 'tkhm vl' hvsh'tm 'vty mydm
verses.translation: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶרְאֶ֞ה כִּֽי אֵינְ/ךָ֣ מוֹשִׁ֗יע וָ/אָשִׂ֨ימָ/ה נַפְשִׁ֤/י בְ/כַפִּ/י֙ וָֽ/אֶעְבְּרָ/ה֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֥/ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יָדִ֑/י וְ/לָ/מָ֞ה עֲלִיתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֛/י הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה לְ/הִלָּ֥חֶם בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'r'h khy 'ynkh mvshy' v'shymh npshy bkhpy v''brh 'l bny 'mvn vytnm yhvh bydy vlmh 'lytm 'ly hyvm hzh lhlchm by
verses.translation: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֤ץ יִפְתָּח֙ אֶת כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם אֶת אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/יַּכּוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י גִלְעָ֜ד אֶת אֶפְרַ֗יִם כִּ֤י אָמְרוּ֙ פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ אַתֶּ֔ם גִּלְעָ֕ד בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ אֶפְרַ֖יִם בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: vyqbts yptch 't khl 'nshy gl'd vylchm 't 'prym vykhv 'nshy gl'd 't 'prym khy 'mrv plyty 'prym 'tm gl'd btvkh 'prym btvkh mnshh
verses.translation: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֥ד גִּלְעָ֛ד אֶֽת מַעְבְּר֥וֹת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן לְ/אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְֽ֠/הָיָה כִּ֣י יֹאמְר֞וּ פְּלִיטֵ֤י אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ אֶעֱבֹ֔רָה וַ/יֹּ֨אמְרוּ ל֧/וֹ אַנְשֵֽׁי גִלְעָ֛ד הַֽ/אֶפְרָתִ֥י אַ֖תָּה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶֽר לֹֽא
verses.translit: vylkhd gl'd 't m'brvt hyrdn l'prym vhyh khy y'mrv plyty 'prym ''brh vy'mrv lv 'nshy gl'd h'prty 'th vy'mr l'
verses.translation: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so , that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֩ אֱמָר נָ֨א שִׁבֹּ֜לֶת וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר סִבֹּ֗לֶת וְ/לֹ֤א יָכִין֙ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר כֵּ֔ן וַ/יֹּאחֲז֣וּ אוֹת֔/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁחָט֖וּ/הוּ אֶל מַעְבְּר֣וֹת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַ/יִּפֹּ֞ל בָּ/עֵ֤ת הַ/הִיא֙ מֵֽ/אֶפְרַ֔יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנַ֖יִם אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv 'mr n' shblt vy'mr sblt vl' ykhyn ldbr khn vy'chzv 'vtv vyshchtvhv 'l m'brvt hyrdn vypl b't hhy' m'prym 'rb'ym vshnym 'lf
verses.translation: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט יִפְתָּ֛ח אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וַ/יָּ֗מָת יִפְתָּח֙ הַ/גִּלְעָדִ֔י וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/עָרֵ֥י גִלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vyshpt yptch 't yshr'l shsh shnym vymt yptch hgl'dy vyqbr b'ry gl'd
verses.translation: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט אַֽחֲרָי/ו֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִבְצָ֖ן מִ/בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vyshpt 'chryv 't yshr'l 'btsn mbyt lchm
verses.translation: And after him Ibzan of Beth-lehem judged Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי ל֞/וֹ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים בָּנוֹת֙ שִׁלַּ֣ח הַ/ח֔וּצָ/ה וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּנ֔וֹת הֵבִ֥יא לְ/בָנָ֖י/ו מִן הַ/ח֑וּץ וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy lv shlshym bnym vshlshym bnvt shlch hchvtsh vshlshym bnvt hby' lbnyv mn hchvts vyshpt 't yshr'l shb' shnym
verses.translation: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת אִבְצָ֔ן וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/בֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vymt 'btsn vyqbr bbyt lchm
verses.translation: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Beth-lehem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֤ט אַֽחֲרָי/ו֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵיל֖וֹן הַ/זְּבֽוּלֹנִ֑י וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vyshpt 'chryv 't yshr'l 'ylvn hzbvlny vyshpt 't yshr'l 'shr shnym
verses.translation: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת אֵל֣וֹן הַ/זְּבֽוּלֹנִ֑י וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּ/אַיָּל֖וֹן בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ זְבוּלֻֽן
verses.translit: vymt 'lvn hzbvlny vyqbr b'ylvn b'rts zbvln
verses.translation: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אַחֲרָ֖י/ו אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן הִלֵּ֖ל הַ/פִּרְעָתוֹנִֽי
verses.translit: vyshpt 'chryv 't yshr'l 'bdvn bn hll hpr'tvny
verses.translation: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי ל֞/וֹ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים בָּנִ֗ים וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים רֹכְבִ֖ים עַל שִׁבְעִ֣ים עֲיָרִ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy lv 'rb'ym bnym vshlshym bny bnym rkhbym 'l shb'ym 'yrm vyshpt 't yshr'l shmnh shnym
verses.translation: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛מָת עַבְדּ֥וֹן בֶּן הִלֵּ֖ל הַ/פִּרְעָתוֹנִ֑י וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֤ר בְּ/פִרְעָתוֹן֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ אֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּ/הַ֖ר הָ/עֲמָלֵקִֽי
verses.translit: vymt 'bdvn bn hll hpr'tvny vyqbr bpr'tvn b'rts 'prym bhr h'mlqy
verses.translation: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּסִ֨פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֧/ם יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יַד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyspv bny yshr'l l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh vytnm yhvh byd plshtym 'rb'ym shnh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD ; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֧ד מִ/צָּרְעָ֛ה מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֥חַת הַ/דָּנִ֖י וּ/שְׁמ֣/וֹ מָנ֑וֹחַ וְ/אִשְׁתּ֥/וֹ עֲקָרָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א יָלָֽדָה
verses.translit: vyhy 'ysh 'chd mtsr'h mmshpcht hdny vshmv mnvch v'shtv 'qrh vl' yldh
verses.translation: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֥א מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל הָ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗י/הָ הִנֵּה נָ֤א אַתְּ עֲקָרָה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יָלַ֔דְתְּ וְ/הָרִ֖ית וְ/יָלַ֥דְתְּ בֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyr' ml'kh yhvh 'l h'shh vy'mr 'lyh hnh n' 't 'qrh vl' yldt vhryt vyldt bn
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הִשָּׁ֣מְרִי נָ֔א וְ/אַל תִּשְׁתִּ֖י יַ֣יִן וְ/שֵׁכָ֑ר וְ/אַל תֹּאכְלִ֖י כָּל טָמֵֽא
verses.translit: v'th hshmry n' v'l tshty yyn vshkhr v'l t'khly khl tm'
verses.translation: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנָּ֨/ךְ הָרָ֜ה וְ/יֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֗ן וּ/מוֹרָה֙ לֹא יַעֲלֶ֣ה עַל רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ כִּֽי נְזִ֧יר אֱלֹהִ֛ים יִהְיֶ֥ה הַ/נַּ֖עַר מִן הַ/בָּ֑טֶן וְ/ה֗וּא יָחֵ֛ל לְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/יַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: khy hnkh hrh vyldt bn vmvrh l' y'lh 'l r'shv khy nzyr 'lhym yhyh hn'r mn hbtn vhv' ychl lhvshy' 't yshr'l myd plshtym
verses.translation: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֣א הָ/אִשָּׁ֗ה וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/אִישָׁ/הּ֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ אִ֤ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔/י וּ/מַרְאֵ֕/הוּ כְּ/מַרְאֵ֛ה מַלְאַ֥ךְ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים נוֹרָ֣א מְאֹ֑ד וְ/לֹ֤א שְׁאִלְתִּ֨י/הוּ֙ אֵֽי מִ/זֶּ֣ה ה֔וּא וְ/אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ לֹֽא הִגִּ֥יד לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vtb' h'shh vt'mr l'yshh l'mr 'ysh h'lhym b' 'ly vmr'hv khmr'h ml'kh h'lhym nvr' m'd vl' sh'ltyhv 'y mzh hv' v't shmv l' hgyd ly
verses.translation: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was , neither told he me his name:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔/י הִנָּ֥/ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְ/יֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן וְ/עַתָּ֞ה אַל תִּשְׁתִּ֣י יַ֣יִן וְ/שֵׁכָ֗ר וְ/אַל תֹּֽאכְלִי֙ כָּל טֻמְאָ֔ה כִּֽי נְזִ֤יר אֱלֹהִים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַ/נַּ֔עַר מִן הַ/בֶּ֖טֶן עַד י֥וֹם מוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr ly hnkh hrh vyldt bn v'th 'l tshty yyn vshkhr v'l t'khly khl tm'h khy nzyr 'lhym yhyh hn'r mn hbtn 'd yvm mvtv
verses.translation: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּעְתַּ֥ר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר בִּ֣י אֲדוֹנָ֔/י אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֞ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֗חְתָּ יָבוֹא נָ֥א עוֹד֙ אֵלֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/יוֹרֵ֕/נוּ מַֽה נַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַ/נַּ֥עַר הַ/יּוּלָּֽד
verses.translit: vy'tr mnvch 'l yhvh vy'mr by 'dvny 'ysh h'lhym 'shr shlcht ybv' n' 'vd 'lynv vyvrnv mh n'shh ln'r hyvld
verses.translation: Then Manoah intreated the LORD , and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/ק֣וֹל מָנ֑וֹחַ וַ/יָּבֹ֣א מַלְאַךְ֩ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֨ים ע֜וֹד אֶל הָ/אִשָּׁ֗ה וְ/הִיא֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וּ/מָנ֥וֹחַ אִישָׁ֖/הּ אֵ֥ין עִמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyshm' h'lhym bqvl mnvch vyb' ml'kh h'lhym 'vd 'l h'shh vhy' yvshbt bshdh vmnvch 'yshh 'yn 'mh
verses.translation: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.

verses.original: וַ/תְּמַהֵר֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/תָּ֖רָץ וַ/תַּגֵּ֣ד לְ/אִישָׁ֑/הּ וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו הִנֵּ֨ה נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַ/י֙ הָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥א בַ/יּ֖וֹם אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vtmhr h'shh vtrts vtgd l'yshh vt'mr 'lyv hnh nr'h 'ly h'ysh 'shr b' byvm 'ly
verses.translation: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛קָם וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ מָנ֖וֹחַ אַחֲרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֶל הָ/אִ֔ישׁ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ הַ/אַתָּ֥ה הָ/אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֥רְתָּ אֶל הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אָֽנִי
verses.translit: vyqm vylkh mnvch 'chry 'shtv vyb' 'l h'ysh vy'mr lv h'th h'ysh 'shr dbrt 'l h'shh vy'mr 'ny
verses.translation: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מָנ֔וֹחַ עַתָּ֖ה יָבֹ֣א דְבָרֶ֑י/ךָ מַה יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה מִשְׁפַּט הַ/נַּ֖עַר וּ/מַעֲשֵֽׂ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr mnvch 'th yb' dbrykh mh yhyh mshpt hn'r vm'shhv
verses.translation: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מָנ֑וֹחַ מִ/כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֶל הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה תִּשָּׁמֵֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr ml'kh yhvh 'l mnvch mkhl 'shr 'mrty 'l h'shh tshmr
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.

verses.original: מִ/כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא֩ מִ/גֶּ֨פֶן הַ/יַּ֜יִן לֹ֣א תֹאכַ֗ל וְ/יַ֤יִן וְ/שֵׁכָר֙ אַל תֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וְ/כָל טֻמְאָ֖ה אַל תֹּאכַ֑ל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִ֖י/הָ תִּשְׁמֹֽר
verses.translit: mkhl 'shr yts' mgpn hyyn l' t'khl vyyn vshkhr 'l tsht vkhl tm'h 'l t'khl khl 'shr tsvytyh tshmr
verses.translation: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מָנ֖וֹחַ אֶל מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה נַעְצְרָה נָּ֣א אוֹתָ֔/ךְ וְ/נַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ גְּדִ֥י עִזִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr mnvch 'l ml'kh yhvh n'tsrh n' 'vtkh vn'shh lpnykh gdy 'zym
verses.translation: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD , I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מָנ֗וֹחַ אִם תַּעְצְרֵ֨/נִי֙ לֹא אֹכַ֣ל בְּ/לַחְמֶ֔/ךָ וְ/אִם תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה עֹלָ֔ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה תַּעֲלֶ֑/נָּה כִּ֚י לֹא יָדַ֣ע מָנ֔וֹחַ כִּֽי מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mr ml'kh yhvh 'l mnvch 'm t'tsrny l' 'khl blchmkh v'm t'shh 'lh lyhvh t'lnh khy l' yd' mnvch khy ml'kh yhvh hv'
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה מִ֣י שְׁמֶ֑/ךָ כִּֽי יָבֹ֥א דברי/ך דְבָרְ/ךָ֖ וְ/כִבַּדְנֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr mnvch 'l ml'kh yhvh my shmkh khy yb' dbrykh dbrkh vkhbdnvkh
verses.translation: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD , What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לּ/וֹ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה לָ֥/מָּה זֶּ֖ה תִּשְׁאַ֣ל לִ/שְׁמִ֑/י וְ/הוּא פֶ֛לִאי
verses.translit: vy'mr lv ml'kh yhvh lmh zh tsh'l lshmy vhv' pl'y
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מָנ֜וֹחַ אֶת גְּדִ֤י הָ/עִזִּים֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥עַל עַל הַ/צּ֖וּר לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וּ/מַפְלִ֣א לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת וּ/מָנ֥וֹחַ וְ/אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ רֹאִֽים
verses.translit: vyqch mnvch 't gdy h'zym v't hmnchh vy'l 'l htsvr lyhvh vmpl' l'shvt vmnvch v'shtv r'ym
verses.translation: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD : and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ בַ/עֲל֨וֹת הַ/לַּ֜הַב מֵ/עַ֤ל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יְמָ/ה וַ/יַּ֥עַל מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/לַ֣הַב הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּ/מָנ֤וֹחַ וְ/אִשְׁתּ/וֹ֙ רֹאִ֔ים וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy b'lvt hlhb m'l hmzbch hshmymh vy'l ml'kh yhvh blhb hmzbch vmnvch v'shtv r'ym vyplv 'l pnyhm 'rtsh
verses.translation: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it , and fell on their faces to the ground.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יָ֤סַף עוֹד֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה לְ/הֵרָאֹ֖ה אֶל מָנ֣וֹחַ וְ/אֶל אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ אָ֚ז יָדַ֣ע מָנ֔וֹחַ כִּֽי מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vl' ysf 'vd ml'kh yhvh lhr'h 'l mnvch v'l 'shtv 'z yd' mnvch khy ml'kh yhvh hv'
verses.translation: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ מ֣וֹת נָמ֑וּת כִּ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים רָאִֽינוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr mnvch 'l 'shtv mvt nmvt khy 'lhym r'ynv
verses.translation: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣/וֹ אִשְׁתּ֗/וֹ לוּ֩ חָפֵ֨ץ יְהוָ֤ה לַ/הֲמִיתֵ֨/נוּ֙ לֹֽא לָקַ֤ח מִ/יָּדֵ֨/נוּ֙ עֹלָ֣ה וּ/מִנְחָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א הֶרְאָ֖/נוּ אֶת כָּל אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/כָ/עֵ֕ת לֹ֥א הִשְׁמִיעָ֖/נוּ כָּ/זֹֽאת
verses.translit: vt'mr lv 'shtv lv chpts yhvh lhmytnv l' lqch mydnv 'lh vmnchh vl' hr'nv 't khl 'lh vkh't l' hshmy'nv khz't
verses.translation: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things , nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤לֶד הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ בֵּ֔ן וַ/תִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַ/יִּגְדַּ֣ל הַ/נַּ֔עַר וַֽ/יְבָרְכֵ֖/הוּ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vtld h'shh bn vtqr' 't shmv shmshvn vygdl hn'r vybrkhhv yhvh
verses.translation: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֨חֶל֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה לְ/פַעֲמ֖/וֹ בְּ/מַחֲנֵה דָ֑ן בֵּ֥ין צָרְעָ֖ה וּ/בֵ֥ין אֶשְׁתָּאֹֽל
verses.translit: vtchl rvch yhvh lp'mv bmchnh dn byn tsr'h vbyn 'sht'l
verses.translation: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥רֶד שִׁמְשׁ֖וֹן תִּמְנָ֑תָ/ה וַ/יַּ֥רְא אִשָּׁ֛ה בְּ/תִמְנָ֖תָ/ה מִ/בְּנ֥וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyrd shmshvn tmnth vyr' 'shh btmnth mbnvt plshtym
verses.translation: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗עַל וַ/יַּגֵּד֙ לְ/אָבִ֣י/ו וּ/לְ/אִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אִשָּׁ֛ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְ/תִמְנָ֖תָ/ה מִ/בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וְ/עַתָּ֕ה קְחוּ אוֹתָ֥/הּ לִּ֖/י לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'l vygd l'byv vl'mv vy'mr 'shh r'yty btmnth mbnvt plshtym v'th qchv 'vth ly l'shh
verses.translation: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜/וֹ אָבִ֣י/ו וְ/אִמּ֗/וֹ הַ/אֵין֩ בִּ/בְנ֨וֹת אַחֶ֤י/ךָ וּ/בְ/כָל עַמִּ/י֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה הוֹלֵךְ֙ לָ/קַ֣חַת אִשָּׁ֔ה מִ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים הָ/עֲרֵלִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שִׁמְשׁ֤וֹן אֶל אָבִי/ו֙ אוֹתָ֣/הּ קַֽח לִ֔/י כִּֽי הִ֖יא יָשְׁרָ֥ה בְ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'byv v'mv h'yn bbnvt 'chykh vbkhl 'my 'shh khy 'th hvlkh lqcht 'shh mplshtym h'rlym vy'mr shmshvn 'l 'byv 'vth qch ly khy hy' yshrh b'yny
verses.translation: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

verses.original: וְ/אָבִ֨י/ו וְ/אִמּ֜/וֹ לֹ֣א יָדְע֗וּ כִּ֤י מֵ/יְהוָה֙ הִ֔יא כִּי תֹאֲנָ֥ה הֽוּא מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ מִ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּ/בָ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים מֹשְׁלִ֥ים בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'byv v'mv l' yd'v khy myhvh hy' khy t'nh hv' mbqsh mplshtym vb't hhy' plshtym mshlym byshr'l
verses.translation: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD , that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧רֶד שִׁמְשׁ֛וֹן וְ/אָבִ֥י/ו וְ/אִמּ֖/וֹ תִּמְנָ֑תָ/ה וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ עַד כַּרְמֵ֣י תִמְנָ֔תָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּה֙ כְּפִ֣יר אֲרָי֔וֹת שֹׁאֵ֖ג לִ/קְרָאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyrd shmshvn v'byv v'mv tmnth vyb'v 'd khrmy tmnth vhnh khpyr 'ryvt sh'g lqr'tv
verses.translation: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

verses.original: וַ/תִּצְלַ֨ח עָלָ֜י/ו ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֗ה וַֽ/יְשַׁסְּעֵ֨/הוּ֙ כְּ/שַׁסַּ֣ע הַ/גְּדִ֔י וּ/מְא֖וּמָה אֵ֣ין בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֤א הִגִּיד֙ לְ/אָבִ֣י/ו וּ/לְ/אִמּ֔/וֹ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vttslch 'lyv rvch yhvh vyshs'hv khshs' hgdy vm'vmh 'yn bydv vl' hgyd l'byv vl'mv 't 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֖רֶד וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר לָ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/תִּישַׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י שִׁמְשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vyrd vydbr l'shh vtyshr b'yny shmshvn
verses.translation: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב מִ/יָּמִים֙ לְ/קַחְתָּ֔/הּ וַ/יָּ֣סַר לִ/רְא֔וֹת אֵ֖ת מַפֶּ֣לֶת הָ/אַרְיֵ֑ה וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה עֲדַ֧ת דְּבוֹרִ֛ים בִּ/גְוִיַּ֥ת הָ/אַרְיֵ֖ה וּ/דְבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyshb mymym lqchth vysr lr'vt 't mplt h'ryh vhnh 'dt dbvrym bgvyt h'ryh vdbsh
verses.translation: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדֵּ֣/הוּ אֶל כַּפָּ֗י/ו וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ הָלוֹךְ֙ וְ/אָכֹ֔ל וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל אָבִ֣י/ו וְ/אֶל אִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן לָ/הֶ֖ם וַ/יֹּאכֵ֑לוּ וְ/לֹֽא הִגִּ֣יד לָ/הֶ֔ם כִּ֛י מִ/גְּוִיַּ֥ת הָ/אַרְיֵ֖ה רָדָ֥ה הַ/דְּבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyrdhv 'l khpyv vylkh hlvkh v'khl vylkh 'l 'byv v'l 'mv vytn lhm vy'khlv vl' hgyd lhm khy mgvyt h'ryh rdh hdbsh
verses.translation: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥רֶד אָבִ֖י/הוּ אֶל הָ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ שָׁ֤ם שִׁמְשׁוֹן֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשׂ֖וּ הַ/בַּחוּרִֽים
verses.translit: vyrd 'byhv 'l h'shh vy'sh shm shmshvn mshth khy khn y'shv hbchvrym
verses.translation: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י כִּ/רְאוֹתָ֣/ם אוֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים מֵֽרֵעִ֔ים וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vtm 'vtv vyqchv shlshym mr'ym vyhyv 'tv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן אָחֽוּדָה נָּ֥א לָ/כֶ֖ם חִידָ֑ה אִם הַגֵּ֣ד תַּגִּידוּ֩ אוֹתָ֨/הּ לִ֜/י שִׁבְעַ֨ת יְמֵ֤י הַ/מִּשְׁתֶּה֙ וּ/מְצָאתֶ֔ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י לָ/כֶם֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים סְדִינִ֔ים וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים חֲלִפֹ֥ת בְּגָדִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm shmshvn 'chvdh n' lkhm chydh 'm hgd tgydv 'vth ly shb't ymy hmshth vmts'tm vntty lkhm shlshym sdynym vshlshym chlpt bgdym
verses.translation: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֣א תוּכְלוּ֮ לְ/הַגִּ֣יד לִ/י֒ וּ/נְתַתֶּ֨ם אַתֶּ֥ם לִ/י֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים סְדִינִ֔ים וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים חֲלִיפ֣וֹת בְּגָדִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔/וֹ ח֥וּדָ/ה חִידָתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/נִשְׁמָעֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v'm l' tvkhlv lhgyd ly vnttm 'tm ly shlshym sdynym vshlshym chlypvt bgdym vy'mrv lv chvdh chydtkh vnshm'nh
verses.translation: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֗ם מֵ/הָֽ/אֹכֵל֙ יָצָ֣א מַאֲכָ֔ל וּ/מֵ/עַ֖ז יָצָ֣א מָת֑וֹק וְ/לֹ֥א יָכְל֛וּ לְ/הַגִּ֥יד הַ/חִידָ֖ה שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm mh'khl yts' m'khl vm'z yts' mtvq vl' ykhlv lhgyd hchydh shlsht ymym
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ לְ/אֵֽשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן֙ פַּתִּ֣י אֶת אִישֵׁ֗/ךְ וְ/יַגֶּד לָ֨/נוּ֙ אֶת הַ֣/חִידָ֔ה פֶּן נִשְׂרֹ֥ף אוֹתָ֛/ךְ וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית אָבִ֖י/ךְ בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ הַ/לְ/יָרְשֵׁ֕/נוּ קְרָאתֶ֥ם לָ֖/נוּ הֲ/לֹֽא
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshby'y vy'mrv l'sht shmshvn pty 't 'yshkh vygd lnv 't hchydh pn nshrf 'vtkh v't byt 'bykh b'sh hlyrshnv qr'tm lnv hl'
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson’s wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father’s house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so ?

verses.original: וַ/תֵּבְךְּ֩ אֵ֨שֶׁת שִׁמְשׁ֜וֹן עָלָ֗י/ו וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ רַק שְׂנֵאתַ֨/נִי֙ וְ/לֹ֣א אֲהַבְתָּ֔/נִי הַֽ/חִידָ֥ה חַ֨דְתָּ֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י עַמִּ֔/י וְ/לִ֖/י לֹ֣א הִגַּ֑דְתָּה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֗/הּ הִנֵּ֨ה לְ/אָבִ֧/י וּ/לְ/אִמִּ֛/י לֹ֥א הִגַּ֖דְתִּי וְ/לָ֥/ךְ אַגִּֽיד
verses.translit: vtbkh 'sht shmshvn 'lyv vt'mr rq shn'tny vl' 'hbtny hchydh chdt lbny 'my vly l' hgdth vy'mr lh hnh l'by vl'my l' hgdty vlkh 'gyd
verses.translation: And Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤בְךְּ עָלָי/ו֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַ/יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם הַ/מִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַ/יַּגֶּד לָ/הּ֙ כִּ֣י הֱצִיקַ֔תְ/הוּ וַ/תַּגֵּ֥ד הַ/חִידָ֖ה לִ/בְנֵ֥י עַמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtbkh 'lyv shb't hymym 'shr hyh lhm hmshth vyhy byvm hshby'y vygd lh khy htsyqthv vtgd hchydh lbny 'mh
verses.translation: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הָ/עִ֜יר בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י בְּ/טֶ֨רֶם֙ יָבֹ֣א הַ/חַ֔רְסָ/ה מַה מָּת֣וֹק מִ/דְּבַ֔שׁ וּ/מֶ֥ה עַ֖ז מֵ/אֲרִ֑י וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֔ם לוּלֵא֙ חֲרַשְׁתֶּ֣ם בְּ/עֶגְלָתִ֔/י לֹ֥א מְצָאתֶ֖ם חִידָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv 'nshy h'yr byvm hshby'y btrm yb' hchrsh mh mtvq mdbsh vmh 'z m'ry vy'mr lhm lvl' chrshtm b'glty l' mts'tm chydty
verses.translation: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.

verses.original: וַ/תִּצְלַ֨ח עָלָ֜י/ו ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יֵּ֨רֶד אַשְׁקְל֜וֹן וַ/יַּ֥ךְ מֵ/הֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ וַ/יִּקַּח֙ אֶת חֲלִ֣יצוֹתָ֔/ם וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ הַ/חֲלִיפ֔וֹת לְ/מַגִּידֵ֖י הַ/חִידָ֑ה וַ/יִּ֣חַר אַפּ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּ֖עַל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי/הוּ
verses.translit: vttslch 'lyv rvch yhvh vyrd 'shqlvn vykh mhm shlshym 'ysh vyqch 't chlytsvtm vytn hchlypvt lmgydy hchydh vychr 'pv vy'l byt 'byhv
verses.translation: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father’s house.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֖י אֵ֣שֶׁת שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן לְ/מֵ֣רֵעֵ֔/הוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רֵעָ֖ה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vthy 'sht shmshvn lmr'hv 'shr r'h lv
verses.translation: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י מִ/יָּמִ֜ים בִּ/ימֵ֣י קְצִיר חִטִּ֗ים וַ/יִּפְקֹ֨ד שִׁמְשׁ֤וֹן אֶת אִשְׁתּ/וֹ֙ בִּ/גְדִ֣י עִזִּ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אָבֹ֥אָה אֶל אִשְׁתִּ֖/י הֶ/חָ֑דְרָ/ה וְ/לֹֽא נְתָנ֥/וֹ אָבִ֖י/הָ לָ/בֽוֹא
verses.translit: vyhy mymym bymy qtsyr chtym vypqd shmshvn 't 'shtv bgdy 'zym vy'mr 'b'h 'l 'shty hchdrh vl' ntnv 'byh lbv'
verses.translation: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אָבִ֗י/הָ אָמֹ֤ר אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ כִּי שָׂנֹ֣א שְׂנֵאתָ֔/הּ וָ/אֶתְּנֶ֖/נָּה לְ/מֵרֵעֶ֑/ךָ הֲ/לֹ֨א אֲחֹתָ֤/הּ הַ/קְּטַנָּה֙ טוֹבָ֣ה מִמֶּ֔/נָּה תְּהִי נָ֥א לְ/ךָ֖ תַּחְתֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'byh 'mr 'mrty khy shn' shn'th v'tnnh lmr'kh hl' 'chth hqtnh tvbh mmnh thy n' lkh tchtyh
verses.translation: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן נִקֵּ֥יתִי הַ/פַּ֖עַם מִ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים כִּֽי עֹשֶׂ֥ה אֲנִ֛י עִמָּ֖/ם רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm shmshvn nqyty hp'm mplshtym khy 'shh 'ny 'mm r'h
verses.translation: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֖ד שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֣וֹת שׁוּעָלִ֑ים וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח לַפִּדִ֗ים וַ/יֶּ֤פֶן זָנָב֙ אֶל זָנָ֔ב וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם לַפִּ֥יד אֶחָ֛ד בֵּין שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/זְּנָב֖וֹת בַּ/תָּֽוֶךְ
verses.translit: vylkh shmshvn vylkhd shlsh m'vt shv'lym vyqch lpdym vypn znb 'l znb vyshm lpyd 'chd byn shny hznbvt btvkh
verses.translation: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.

verses.original: וַ/יַּבְעֶר אֵשׁ֙ בַּ/לַּפִּידִ֔ים וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֖ח בְּ/קָמ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יַּבְעֵ֛ר מִ/גָּדִ֥ישׁ וְ/עַד קָמָ֖ה וְ/עַד כֶּ֥רֶם זָֽיִת
verses.translit: vyb'r 'sh blpydym vyshlch bqmvt plshtym vyb'r mgdysh v'd qmh v'd khrm zyt
verses.translation: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּים֮ מִ֣י עָ֣שָׂה זֹאת֒ וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ שִׁמְשׁוֹן֙ חֲתַ֣ן הַ/תִּמְנִ֔י כִּ֚י לָקַ֣ח אֶת אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וַֽ/יִּתְּנָ֖/הּ לְ/מֵרֵעֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יִּשְׂרְפ֥וּ אוֹתָ֛/הּ וְ/אֶת אָבִ֖י/הָ בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mrv plshtym my 'shh z't vy'mrv shmshvn chtn htmny khy lqch 't 'shtv vytnh lmr'hv vy'lv plshtym vyshrpv 'vth v't 'byh b'sh
verses.translation: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן אִֽם תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ/ן כָּ/זֹ֑את כִּ֛י אִם נִקַּ֥מְתִּי בָ/כֶ֖ם וְ/אַחַ֥ר אֶחְדָּֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm shmshvn 'm t'shvn khz't khy 'm nqmty bkhm v'chr 'chdl
verses.translation: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨ךְ אוֹתָ֥/ם שׁ֛וֹק עַל יָרֵ֖ךְ מַכָּ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֣רֶד וַ/יֵּ֔שֶׁב בִּ/סְעִ֖יף סֶ֥לַע עֵיטָֽם
verses.translit: vykh 'vtm shvq 'l yrkh mkhh gdvlh vyrd vyshb bs'yf sl' 'ytm
verses.translation: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּ/יהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּנָּטְשׁ֖וּ בַּ/לֶּֽחִי
verses.translit: vy'lv plshtym vychnv byhvdh vyntshv blchy
verses.translation: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה לָ/מָ֖ה עֲלִיתֶ֣ם עָלֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ לֶ/אֱס֤וֹר אֶת שִׁמְשׁוֹן֙ עָלִ֔ינוּ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת ל֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָ֥שָׂה לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh yhvdh lmh 'lytm 'lynv vy'mrv l'svr 't shmshvn 'lynv l'shvt lv kh'shr 'shh lnv
verses.translation: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרְד֡וּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת֩ אֲלָפִ֨ים אִ֜ישׁ מִֽ/יהוּדָ֗ה אֶל סְעִיף֮ סֶ֣לַע עֵיטָם֒ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לְ/שִׁמְשׁ֗וֹן הֲ/לֹ֤א יָדַ֨עְתָּ֙ כִּֽי מֹשְׁלִ֥ים בָּ֨/נוּ֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּ/מַה זֹּ֖את עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֑/נוּ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֙ עָ֣שׂוּ לִ֔/י כֵּ֖ן עָשִׂ֥יתִי לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyrdv shlsht 'lpym 'ysh myhvdh 'l s'yf sl' 'ytm vy'mrv lshmshvn hl' yd't khy mshlym bnv plshtym vmh z't 'shyt lnv vy'mr lhm kh'shr 'shv ly khn 'shyty lhm
verses.translation: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֙ לֶ/אֱסָרְ/ךָ֣ יָרַ֔דְנוּ לְ/תִתְּ/ךָ֖ בְּ/יַד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן הִשָּׁבְע֣וּ לִ֔/י פֶּֽן תִּפְגְּע֥וּ/ן בִּ֖/י אַתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv l'srkh yrdnv lttkh byd plshtym vy'mr lhm shmshvn hshb'v ly pn tpg'vn by 'tm
verses.translation: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמְרוּ ל֣/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לֹ֚א כִּֽי אָסֹ֤ר נֶֽאֱסָרְ/ךָ֙ וּ/נְתַנּ֣וּ/ךָ בְ/יָדָ֔/ם וְ/הָמֵ֖ת לֹ֣א נְמִיתֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יַּאַסְרֻ֗/הוּ בִּ/שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ עֲבֹתִ֣ים חֲדָשִׁ֔ים וַֽ/יַּעֲל֖וּ/הוּ מִן הַ/סָּֽלַע
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv l'mr l' khy 'sr n'srkh vntnvkh bydm vhmt l' nmytkh vy'srhv bshnym 'btym chdshym vy'lvhv mn hsl'
verses.translation: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.

verses.original: הוּא בָ֣א עַד לֶ֔חִי וּ/פִלְשִׁתִּ֖ים הֵרִ֣יעוּ לִ/קְרָאת֑/וֹ וַ/תִּצְלַ֨ח עָלָ֜י/ו ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֗ה וַ/תִּהְיֶ֨ינָה הָ/עֲבֹתִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל זְרוֹעוֹתָ֗י/ו כַּ/פִּשְׁתִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּעֲר֣וּ בָ/אֵ֔שׁ וַ/יִּמַּ֥סּוּ אֱסוּרָ֖י/ו מֵ/עַ֥ל יָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hv' b' 'd lchy vplshtym hry'v lqr'tv vttslch 'lyv rvch yhvh vthyynh h'btym 'shr 'l zrv'vtyv khpshtym 'shr b'rv b'sh vymsv 'svryv m'l ydyv
verses.translation: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְצָ֥א לְחִֽי חֲמ֖וֹר טְרִיָּ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָד/וֹ֙ וַ/יִּקָּחֶ֔/הָ וַ/יַּךְ בָּ֖/הּ אֶ֥לֶף אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vymts' lchy chmvr tryh vyshlch ydv vyqchh vykh bh 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן בִּ/לְחִ֣י הַ/חֲמ֔וֹר חֲמ֖וֹר חֲמֹרָתָ֑יִם בִּ/לְחִ֣י הַ/חֲמ֔וֹר הִכֵּ֖יתִי אֶ֥לֶף אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr shmshvn blchy hchmvr chmvr chmrtym blchy hchmvr hkhyty 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כְּ/כַלֹּת֣/וֹ לְ/דַבֵּ֔ר וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ הַ/לְּחִ֖י מִ/יָּד֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א לַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא רָ֥מַת לֶֽחִי
verses.translit: vyhy khkhltv ldbr vyshlkh hlchy mydv vyqr' lmqvm hhv' rmt lchy
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramath-lehi.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְמָא֮ מְאֹד֒ וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֶל יְהוָה֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר אַתָּה֙ נָתַ֣תָּ בְ/יַֽד עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ אֶת הַ/תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה הַ/גְּדֹלָ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את וְ/עַתָּה֙ אָמ֣וּת בַּ/צָּמָ֔א וְ/נָפַלְתִּ֖י בְּ/יַ֥ד הָ/עֲרֵלִֽים
verses.translit: vytsm' m'd vyqr' 'l yhvh vy'mr 'th ntt byd 'bdkh 't htshv'h hgdlh hz't v'th 'mvt btsm' vnplty byd h'rlym
verses.translation: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD , and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְקַ֨ע אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת הַ/מַּכְתֵּ֣שׁ אֲשֶׁר בַּ/לֶּ֗חִי וַ/יֵּצְא֨וּ מִמֶּ֤/נּוּ מַ֨יִם֙ וַ/יֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַ/תָּ֥שָׁב רוּח֖/וֹ וַ/יֶּ֑חִי עַל כֵּ֣ן קָרָ֣א שְׁמָ֗/הּ עֵ֤ין הַקּוֹרֵא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/לֶּ֔חִי עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vybq' 'lhym 't hmkhtsh 'shr blchy vyts'v mmnv mym vysht vtshb rvchv vychy 'l khn qr' shmh 'yn hqvr' 'shr blchy 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֧ט אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בִּ/ימֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyshpt 't yshr'l bymy plshtym 'shrym shnh
verses.translation: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ שִׁמְשׁ֖וֹן עַזָּ֑תָ/ה וַ/יַּרְא שָׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vylkh shmshvn 'zth vyr' shm 'shh zvnh vyb' 'lyh
verses.translation: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.

verses.original: לַֽ/עַזָּתִ֣ים לֵ/אמֹ֗ר בָּ֤א שִׁמְשׁוֹן֙ הֵ֔נָּה וַ/יָּסֹ֛בּוּ וַ/יֶּאֶרְבוּ ל֥/וֹ כָל הַ/לַּ֖יְלָה בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יִּתְחָרְשׁ֤וּ כָל הַ/לַּ֨יְלָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר עַד א֥וֹר הַ/בֹּ֖קֶר וַ/הֲרְגְנֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: l'ztym l'mr b' shmshvn hnh vysbv vy'rbv lv khl hlylh bsh'r h'yr vytchrshv khl hlylh l'mr 'd 'vr hbqr vhrgnhv
verses.translation: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֣ב שִׁמְשׁוֹן֮ עַד חֲצִ֣י הַ/לַּיְלָה֒ וַ/יָּ֣קָם בַּ/חֲצִ֣י הַ/לַּ֗יְלָה וַ/יֶּאֱחֹ֞ז בְּ/דַלְת֤וֹת שַֽׁעַר הָ/עִיר֙ וּ/בִ/שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/מְּזוּז֔וֹת וַ/יִּסָּעֵ/ם֙ עִֽם הַ/בְּרִ֔יחַ וַ/יָּ֖שֶׂם עַל כְּתֵפָ֑י/ו וַֽ/יַּעֲלֵ/ם֙ אֶל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/הָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyshkhb shmshvn 'd chtsy hlylh vyqm bchtsy hlylh vy'chz bdltvt sh'r h'yr vbshty hmzvzvt vys'm 'm hbrych vyshm 'l khtpyv vy'lm 'l r'sh hhr 'shr 'l pny chbrvn
verses.translation: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֥ב אִשָּׁ֖ה בְּ/נַ֣חַל שֹׂרֵ֑ק וּ/שְׁמָ֖/הּ דְּלִילָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vy'hb 'shh bnchl shrq vshmh dlylh
verses.translation: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֨וּ אֵלֶ֜י/הָ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמְרוּ לָ֜/הּ פַּתִּ֣י אוֹת֗/וֹ וּ/רְאִי֙ בַּ/מֶּה֙ כֹּח֣/וֹ גָד֔וֹל וּ/בַ/מֶּה֙ נ֣וּכַל ל֔/וֹ וַ/אֲסַרְנֻ֖/הוּ לְ/עַנֹּת֑/וֹ וַ/אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ נִתַּן לָ֔/ךְ אִ֕ישׁ אֶ֥לֶף וּ/מֵאָ֖ה כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: vy'lv 'lyh srny plshtym vy'mrv lh pty 'vtv vr'y bmh khchv gdvl vbmh nvkhl lv v'srnhv l'ntv v'nchnv ntn lkh 'ysh 'lf vm'h khsf
verses.translation: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth , and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר דְּלִילָה֙ אֶל שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן הַגִּֽידָ/ה נָּ֣א לִ֔/י בַּ/מֶּ֖ה כֹּחֲ/ךָ֣ גָד֑וֹל וּ/בַ/מֶּ֥ה תֵאָסֵ֖ר לְ/עַנּוֹתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vt'mr dlylh 'l shmshvn hgydh n' ly bmh khchkh gdvl vbmh t'sr l'nvtkh
verses.translation: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth , and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן אִם יַאַסְרֻ֗/נִי בְּ/שִׁבְעָ֛ה יְתָרִ֥ים לַחִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא חֹרָ֑בוּ וְ/חָלִ֥יתִי וְ/הָיִ֖יתִי כְּ/אַחַ֥ד הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh shmshvn 'm y'srny bshb'h ytrym lchym 'shr l' chrbv vchlyty vhyyty kh'chd h'dm
verses.translation: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲלוּ לָ֞/הּ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים שִׁבְעָ֛ה יְתָרִ֥ים לַחִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא חֹרָ֑בוּ וַ/תַּאַסְרֵ֖/הוּ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'lv lh srny plshtym shb'h ytrym lchym 'shr l' chrbv vt'srhv bhm
verses.translation: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֹרֵ֗ב יֹשֵׁ֥ב לָ/הּ֙ בַּ/חֶ֔דֶר וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו פְּלִשְׁתִּ֥ים עָלֶ֖י/ךָ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַ/יְנַתֵּק֙ אֶת הַ/יְתָרִ֔ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִנָּתֵ֤ק פְּתִֽיל הַ/נְּעֹ֨רֶת֙ בַּ/הֲרִיח֣/וֹ אֵ֔שׁ וְ/לֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖ע כֹּחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vh'rb yshb lh bchdr vt'mr 'lyv plshtym 'lykh shmshvn vyntq 't hytrym kh'shr yntq ptyl hn'rt bhrychv 'sh vl' nvd' khchv
verses.translation: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר דְּלִילָה֙ אֶל שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן הִנֵּה֙ הֵתַ֣לְתָּ בִּ֔/י וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖/י כְּזָבִ֑ים עַתָּה֙ הַגִּֽידָ/ה נָּ֣א לִ֔/י בַּ/מֶּ֖ה תֵּאָסֵֽר
verses.translit: vt'mr dlylh 'l shmshvn hnh htlt by vtdbr 'ly khzbym 'th hgydh n' ly bmh t'sr
verses.translation: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔י/הָ אִם אָס֤וֹר יַאַסְר֨וּ/נִי֙ בַּ/עֲבֹתִ֣ים חֲדָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא נַעֲשָׂ֥ה בָ/הֶ֖ם מְלָאכָ֑ה וְ/חָלִ֥יתִי וְ/הָיִ֖יתִי כְּ/אַחַ֥ד הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh 'm 'svr y'srvny b'btym chdshym 'shr l' n'shh bhm ml'khh vchlyty vhyyty kh'chd h'dm
verses.translation: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֣ח דְּלִילָה֩ עֲבֹתִ֨ים חֲדָשִׁ֜ים וַ/תַּאַסְרֵ֣/הוּ בָ/הֶ֗ם וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֤ים עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן וְ/הָ/אֹרֵ֖ב יֹשֵׁ֣ב בֶּ/חָ֑דֶר וַֽ/יְנַתְּקֵ֛/ם מֵ/עַ֥ל זְרֹעֹתָ֖י/ו כַּ/חֽוּט
verses.translit: vtqch dlylh 'btym chdshym vt'srhv bhm vt'mr 'lyv plshtym 'lykh shmshvn vh'rb yshb bchdr vyntqm m'l zr'tyv khchvt
verses.translation: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר דְּלִילָ֜ה אֶל שִׁמְשׁ֗וֹן עַד הֵ֜נָּה הֵתַ֤לְתָּ בִּ/י֙ וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֤ר אֵלַ/י֙ כְּזָבִ֔ים הַגִּ֣ידָ/ה לִּ֔/י בַּ/מֶּ֖ה תֵּאָסֵ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔י/הָ אִם תַּאַרְגִ֗י אֶת שֶׁ֛בַע מַחְלְפ֥וֹת רֹאשִׁ֖/י עִם הַ/מַּסָּֽכֶת
verses.translit: vt'mr dlylh 'l shmshvn 'd hnh htlt by vtdbr 'ly khzbym hgydh ly bmh t'sr vy'mr 'lyh 'm t'rgy 't shb' mchlpvt r'shy 'm hmskht
verses.translation: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתְקַע֙ בַּ/יָּתֵ֔ד וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו פְּלִשְׁתִּ֥ים עָלֶ֖י/ךָ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַ/יִּיקַץ֙ מִ/שְּׁנָת֔/וֹ וַ/יִּסַּ֛ע אֶת הַ/יְתַ֥ד הָ/אֶ֖רֶג וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּסָּֽכֶת
verses.translit: vttq' bytd vt'mr 'lyv plshtym 'lykh shmshvn vyyqts mshntv vys' 't hytd h'rg v't hmskht
verses.translation: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו אֵ֚יךְ תֹּאמַ֣ר אֲהַבְתִּ֔י/ךְ וְ/לִבְּ/ךָ֖ אֵ֣ין אִתִּ֑/י זֶ֣ה שָׁלֹ֤שׁ פְּעָמִים֙ הֵתַ֣לְתָּ בִּ֔/י וְ/לֹא הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֔/י בַּ/מֶּ֖ה כֹּחֲ/ךָ֥ גָדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyv 'ykh t'mr 'hbtykh vlbkh 'yn 'ty zh shlsh p'mym htlt by vl' hgdt ly bmh khchkh gdvl
verses.translation: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth .

verses.original: וַ֠/יְהִי כִּֽי הֵצִ֨יקָה לּ֧/וֹ בִ/דְבָרֶ֛י/הָ כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֖ים וַ/תְּאַֽלֲצֵ֑/הוּ וַ/תִּקְצַ֥ר נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ לָ/מֽוּת
verses.translit: vyhy khy htsyqh lv bdbryh khl hymym vt'ltshv vtqtsr npshv lmvt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֶּד לָ֣/הּ אֶת כָּל לִבּ֗/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הּ֙ מוֹרָה֙ לֹֽא עָלָ֣ה עַל רֹאשִׁ֔/י כִּֽי נְזִ֧יר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֲנִ֖י מִ/בֶּ֣טֶן אִמִּ֑/י אִם גֻּלַּ֨חְתִּי֙ וְ/סָ֣ר מִמֶּ֣/נִּי כֹחִ֔/י וְ/חָלִ֥יתִי וְ/הָיִ֖יתִי כְּ/כָל הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vygd lh 't khl lbv vy'mr lh mvrh l' 'lh 'l r'shy khy nzyr 'lhym 'ny mbtn 'my 'm glchty vsr mmny khchy vchlyty vhyyty khkhl h'dm
verses.translation: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother’s womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֣רֶא דְלִילָ֗ה כִּֽי הִגִּ֣יד לָ/הּ֮ אֶת כָּל לִבּ/וֹ֒ וַ/תִּשְׁלַ֡ח וַ/תִּקְרָא֩ לְ/סַרְנֵ֨י פְלִשְׁתִּ֤ים לֵ/אמֹר֙ עֲל֣וּ הַ/פַּ֔עַם כִּֽי הִגִּ֥יד ל/ה לִ֖/י אֶת כָּל לִבּ֑/וֹ וְ/עָל֤וּ אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף בְּ/יָדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vtr' dlylh khy hgyd lh 't khl lbv vtshlch vtqr' lsrny plshtym l'mr 'lv hp'm khy hgyd lh ly 't khl lbv v'lv 'lyh srny plshtym vy'lv hkhsf bydm
verses.translation: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.

verses.original: וַ/תְּיַשְּׁנֵ֨/הוּ֙ עַל בִּרְכֶּ֔י/הָ וַ/תִּקְרָ֣א לָ/אִ֔ישׁ וַ/תְּגַלַּ֕ח אֶת שֶׁ֖בַע מַחְלְפ֣וֹת רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/תָּ֨חֶל֙ לְ/עַנּוֹת֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֥סַר כֹּח֖/וֹ מֵ/עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vtyshnhv 'l brkhyh vtqr' l'ysh vtglch 't shb' mchlpvt r'shv vtchl l'nvtv vysr khchv m'lyv
verses.translation: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר פְּלִשְׁתִּ֥ים עָלֶ֖י/ךָ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַ/יִּקַ֣ץ מִ/שְּׁנָת֗/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵצֵ֞א כְּ/פַ֤עַם בְּ/פַ֨עַם֙ וְ/אִנָּעֵ֔ר וְ/הוּא֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה סָ֥ר מֵ/עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vt'mr plshtym 'lykh shmshvn vyqts mshntv vy'mr 'ts' khp'm bp'm v'n'r vhv' l' yd' khy yhvh sr m'lyv
verses.translation: And she said, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the LORD was departed from him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאחֲז֣וּ/הוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַֽ/יְנַקְּר֖וּ אֶת עֵינָ֑י/ו וַ/יּוֹרִ֨ידוּ אוֹת֜/וֹ עַזָּ֗תָ/ה וַ/יַּאַסְר֨וּ/הוּ֙ בַּֽ/נְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם וַ/יְהִ֥י טוֹחֵ֖ן בְּ/בֵ֥ית ה/אסירים הָ/אֲסוּרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'chzvhv plshtym vynqrv 't 'ynyv vyvrydv 'vtv 'zth vy'srvhv bnchshtym vyhy tvchn bbyt h'syrym h'svrym
verses.translation: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧חֶל שְׂעַר רֹאשׁ֛/וֹ לְ/צַמֵּ֖חַ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר גֻּלָּֽח
verses.translit: vychl sh'r r'shv ltsmch kh'shr glch
verses.translation: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.

verses.original: וְ/סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים נֶֽאֱסְפוּ֙ לִ/זְבֹּ֧חַ זֶֽבַח גָּד֛וֹל לְ/דָג֥וֹן אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/לְ/שִׂמְחָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נָתַ֤ן אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ בְּ/יָדֵ֔/נוּ אֵ֖ת שִׁמְשׁ֥וֹן אוֹיְבֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vsrny plshtym n'spv lzbch zbch gdvl ldgvn 'lhyhm vlshmchh vy'mrv ntn 'lhynv bydnv 't shmshvn 'vybynv
verses.translation: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ הָ/עָ֔ם וַֽ/יְהַלְל֖וּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמְר֗וּ נָתַ֨ן אֱלֹהֵ֤י/נוּ בְ/יָדֵ֨/נוּ֙ אֶת א֣וֹיְבֵ֔/נוּ וְ/אֵת֙ מַחֲרִ֣יב אַרְצֵ֔/נוּ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִרְבָּ֖ה אֶת חֲלָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vyr'v 'tv h'm vyhllv 't 'lhyhm khy 'mrv ntn 'lhynv bydnv 't 'vybnv v't mchryb 'rtsnv v'shr hrbh 't chllynv
verses.translation: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כי טוב כְּ/ט֣וֹב לִבָּ֔/ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ קִרְא֥וּ לְ/שִׁמְשׁ֖וֹן וִ/ישַֽׂחֶק לָ֑/נוּ וַ/יִּקְרְא֨וּ לְ/שִׁמְשׁ֜וֹן מִ/בֵּ֣ית ה/אסירים הָ/אֲסוּרִ֗ים וַ/יְצַחֵק֙ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּעֲמִ֥ידוּ אוֹת֖/וֹ בֵּ֥ין הָ/עַמּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy khy tvb khtvb lbm vy'mrv qr'v lshmshvn vyshchq lnv vyqr'v lshmshvn mbyt h'syrym h'svrym vytschq lpnyhm vy'mydv 'vtv byn h'mvdym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שִׁמְשׁ֜וֹן אֶל הַ/נַּ֨עַר הַ/מַּחֲזִ֣יק בְּ/יָד/וֹ֮ הַנִּ֣יחָ/ה אוֹתִ/י֒ ו/הימש/ני וַ/הֲמִשֵׁ֨/נִי֙ אֶת הָֽ/עַמֻּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַ/בַּ֖יִת נָכ֣וֹן עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֶשָּׁעֵ֖ן עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr shmshvn 'l hn'r hmchzyq bydv hnychh 'vty vhymshny vhmshny 't h'mdym 'shr hbyt nkhvn 'lyhm v'sh'n 'lyhm
verses.translation: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֤א הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ וְ/הַ/נָּשִׁ֔ים וְ/שָׁ֕מָּ/ה כֹּ֖ל סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וְ/עַל הַ/גָּ֗ג כִּ/שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ וְ/אִשָּׁ֔ה הָ/רֹאִ֖ים בִּ/שְׂח֥וֹק שִׁמְשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vhbyt ml' h'nshym vhnshym vshmh khl srny plshtym v'l hgg khshlsht 'lpym 'ysh v'shh hr'ym bshchvq shmshvn
verses.translation: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א שִׁמְשׁ֛וֹן אֶל יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יֱהֹוִ֡ה זָכְרֵ֣/נִי נָא֩ וְ/חַזְּקֵ֨/נִי נָ֜א אַ֣ךְ הַ/פַּ֤עַם הַ/זֶּה֙ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/אִנָּקְמָ֧ה נְקַם אַחַ֛ת מִ/שְּׁתֵ֥י עֵינַ֖/י מִ/פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyqr' shmshvn 'l yhvh vy'mr 'dny yhvh zkhrny n' vchzqny n' 'kh hp'm hzh h'lhym v'nqmh nqm 'cht mshty 'yny mplshtym
verses.translation: And Samson called unto the LORD , and said, O Lord GOD , remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְפֹּ֨ת שִׁמְשׁ֜וֹן אֶת שְׁנֵ֣י עַמּוּדֵ֣י הַ/תָּ֗וֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ נָכ֣וֹן עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּסָּמֵ֖ךְ עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד בִּ/ימִינ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶחָ֥ד בִּ/שְׂמֹאלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylpt shmshvn 't shny 'mvdy htvkh 'shr hbyt nkhvn 'lyhm vysmkh 'lyhm 'chd bymynv v'chd bshm'lv
verses.translation: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שִׁמְשׁ֗וֹן תָּמ֣וֹת נַפְשִׁ/י֮ עִם פְּלִשְׁתִּים֒ וַ/יֵּ֣ט בְּ/כֹ֔חַ וַ/יִּפֹּ֤ל הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ עַל הַ/סְּרָנִ֔ים וְ/עַל כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר בּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּהְי֤וּ הַ/מֵּתִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵמִ֣ית בְּ/מוֹת֔/וֹ רַבִּ֕ים מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵמִ֖ית בְּ/חַיָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr shmshvn tmvt npshy 'm plshtym vyt bkhch vypl hbyt 'l hsrnym v'l khl h'm 'shr bv vyhyv hmtym 'shr hmyt bmvtv rbym m'shr hmyt bchyyv
verses.translation: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרְד֨וּ אֶחָ֜י/ו וְ/כָל בֵּ֣ית אָבִי/הוּ֮ וַ/יִּשְׂא֣וּ אֹת/וֹ֒ וַֽ/יַּעֲל֣וּ וַ/יִּקְבְּר֣וּ אוֹת֗/וֹ בֵּ֤ין צָרְעָה֙ וּ/בֵ֣ין אֶשְׁתָּאֹ֔ל בְּ/קֶ֖בֶר מָנ֣וֹחַ אָבִ֑י/ו וְ/ה֛וּא שָׁפַ֥ט אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyrdv 'chyv vkhl byt 'byhv vysh'v 'tv vy'lv vyqbrv 'vtv byn tsr'h vbyn 'sht'l bqbr mnvch 'byv vhv' shpt 't yshr'l 'shrym shnh
verses.translation: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought him up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי אִ֥ישׁ מֵֽ/הַר אֶפְרָ֖יִם וּ/שְׁמ֥/וֹ מִיכָֽיְהוּ
verses.translit: vyhy 'ysh mhr 'prym vshmv mykhyhv
verses.translation: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/אִמּ֡/וֹ אֶלֶף֩ וּ/מֵאָ֨ה הַ/כֶּ֜סֶף אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֻֽקַּֽח לָ֗/ךְ ו/אתי וְ/אַ֤תְּ אָלִית֙ וְ/גַם֙ אָמַ֣רְתְּ בְּ/אָזְנַ֔/י הִנֵּֽה הַ/כֶּ֥סֶף אִתִּ֖/י אֲנִ֣י לְקַחְתִּ֑י/ו וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אִמּ֔/וֹ בָּר֥וּךְ בְּנִ֖/י לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr l'mv 'lf vm'h hkhsf 'shr lqch lkh v'ty v't 'lyt vgm 'mrt b'zny hnh hkhsf 'ty 'ny lqchtyv vt'mr 'mv brvkh bny lyhvh
verses.translation: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be thou of the LORD , my son.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛שֶׁב אֶת אֶֽלֶף וּ/מֵאָ֥ה הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף לְ/אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אִמּ֡/וֹ הַקְדֵּ֣שׁ הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת הַ/כֶּסֶף֩ לַ/יהוָ֨ה מִ/יָּדִ֜/י לִ/בְנִ֗/י לַֽ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ פֶּ֣סֶל וּ/מַסֵּכָ֔ה וְ/עַתָּ֖ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֥/נּוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyshb 't 'lf vm'h hkhsf l'mv vt'mr 'mv hqdsh hqdshty 't hkhsf lyhvh mydy lbny l'shvt psl vmskhh v'th 'shybnv lkh
verses.translation: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שֶׁב אֶת הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף לְ/אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/תִּקַּ֣ח אִמּ/וֹ֩ מָאתַ֨יִם כֶּ֜סֶף וַ/תִּתְּנֵ֣/הוּ לַ/צּוֹרֵ֗ף וַֽ/יַּעֲשֵׂ֨/הוּ֙ פֶּ֣סֶל וּ/מַסֵּכָ֔ה וַ/יְהִ֖י בְּ/בֵ֥ית מִיכָֽיְהוּ
verses.translit: vyshb 't hkhsf l'mv vtqch 'mv m'tym khsf vttnhv ltsvrf vy'shhv psl vmskhh vyhy bbyt mykhyhv
verses.translation: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אִ֣ישׁ מִיכָ֔ה ל֖/וֹ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ אֵפוֹד֙ וּ/תְרָפִ֔ים וַ/יְמַלֵּ֗א אֶת יַ֤ד אַחַד֙ מִ/בָּנָ֔י/ו וַ/יְהִי ל֖/וֹ לְ/כֹהֵֽן
verses.translit: vh'ysh mykhh lv byt 'lhym vy'sh 'pvd vtrpym vyml' 't yd 'chd mbnyv vyhy lv lkhhn
verses.translation: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֛ישׁ הַ/יָּשָׁ֥ר בְּ/עֵינָ֖י/ו יַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: bymym hhm 'yn mlkh byshr'l 'ysh hyshr b'ynyv y'shh
verses.translation: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי נַ֗עַר מִ/בֵּ֥ית לֶ֨חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֖חַת יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/ה֥וּא לֵוִ֖י וְ/ה֥וּא גָֽר שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyhy n'r mbyt lchm yhvdh mmshpcht yhvdh vhv' lvy vhv' gr shm
verses.translation: And there was a young man out of Beth-lehem-judah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ הָ/אִ֜ישׁ מֵ/הָ/עִ֗יר מִ/בֵּ֥ית לֶ֨חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה לָ/ג֖וּר בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִמְצָ֑א וַ/יָּבֹ֧א הַר אֶפְרַ֛יִם עַד בֵּ֥ית מִיכָ֖ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת דַּרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkh h'ysh mh'yr mbyt lchm yhvdh lgvr b'shr ymts' vyb' hr 'prym 'd byt mykhh l'shvt drkhv
verses.translation: And the man departed out of the city from Beth-lehem-judah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר ל֥/וֹ מִיכָ֖ה מֵ/אַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו לֵוִ֣י אָנֹ֗כִי מִ/בֵּ֥ית לֶ֨חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י הֹלֵ֔ךְ לָ/ג֖וּר בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶמְצָֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr lv mykhh m'yn tbv' vy'mr 'lyv lvy 'nkhy mbyt lchm yhvdh v'nkhy hlkh lgvr b'shr 'mts'
verses.translation: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Beth-lehem-judah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨/וֹ מִיכָ֜ה שְׁבָ֣/ה עִמָּדִ֗/י וֶֽ/הְיֵה לִ/י֮ לְ/אָ֣ב וּ/לְ/כֹהֵן֒ וְ/אָנֹכִ֨י אֶֽתֶּן לְ/ךָ֜ עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת כֶּ֨סֶף֙ לַ/יָּמִ֔ים וְ/עֵ֥רֶךְ בְּגָדִ֖ים וּ/מִחְיָתֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ הַ/לֵּוִֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr lv mykhh shbh 'mdy vhyh ly l'b vlkhhn v'nkhy 'tn lkh 'shrt khsf lymym v'rkh bgdym vmchytkh vylkh hlvy
verses.translation: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֥וֹאֶל הַ/לֵּוִ֖י לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת אֶת הָ/אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יְהִ֤י הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ ל֔/וֹ כְּ/אַחַ֖ד מִ/בָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyv'l hlvy lshbt 't h'ysh vyhy hn'r lv kh'chd mbnyv
verses.translation: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַלֵּ֤א מִיכָה֙ אֶת יַ֣ד הַ/לֵּוִ֔י וַ/יְהִי ל֥/וֹ הַ/נַּ֖עַר לְ/כֹהֵ֑ן וַ/יְהִ֖י בְּ/בֵ֥ית מִיכָֽה
verses.translit: vyml' mykhh 't yd hlvy vyhy lv hn'r lkhhn vyhy bbyt mykhh
verses.translation: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מִיכָ֔ה עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּֽי יֵיטִ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה לִ֑/י כִּ֧י הָיָה לִ֛/י הַ/לֵּוִ֖י לְ/כֹהֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhh 'th yd'ty khy yytyb yhvh ly khy hyh ly hlvy lkhhn
verses.translation: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/בַ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֗ם שֵׁ֣בֶט הַ/דָּנִ֞י מְבַקֶּשׁ ל֤/וֹ נַֽחֲלָה֙ לָ/שֶׁ֔בֶת כִּי֩ לֹֽא נָ֨פְלָה לּ֜/וֹ עַד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֛וּא בְּ/תוֹךְ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: bymym hhm 'yn mlkh byshr'l vbymym hhm shbt hdny mbqsh lv nchlh lshbt khy l' nplh lv 'd hyvm hhv' btvkh shbty yshr'l bnchlh
verses.translation: In those days there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֣וּ בְנֵי דָ֣ן מִֽ/מִּשְׁפַּחְתָּ֡/ם חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֣ים מִ/קְצוֹתָ/ם֩ אֲנָשִׁ֨ים בְּנֵי חַ֜יִל מִ/צָּרְעָ֣ה וּ/מֵֽ/אֶשְׁתָּאֹ֗ל לְ/רַגֵּ֤ל אֶת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ וּ/לְ/חָקְרָ֔/הּ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם לְכ֖וּ חִקְר֣וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ הַר אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד בֵּ֣ית מִיכָ֔ה וַ/יָּלִ֖ינוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyshlchv bny dn mmshpchtm chmshh 'nshym mqtsvtm 'nshym bny chyl mtsr'h vm'sht'l lrgl 't h'rts vlchqrh vy'mrv 'lhm lkhv chqrv 't h'rts vyb'v hr 'prym 'd byt mykhh vylynv shm
verses.translation: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.

verses.original: הֵ֚מָּה עִם בֵּ֣ית מִיכָ֔ה וְ/הֵ֣מָּה הִכִּ֔ירוּ אֶת ק֥וֹל הַ/נַּ֖עַר הַ/לֵּוִ֑י וַ/יָּס֣וּרוּ שָׁ֗ם וַ/יֹּ֤אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֙ מִֽי הֱבִיאֲ/ךָ֣ הֲלֹ֔ם וּ/מָֽה אַתָּ֥ה עֹשֶׂ֛ה בָּ/זֶ֖ה וּ/מַה לְּ/ךָ֥ פֹֽה
verses.translit: hmh 'm byt mykhh vhmh hkhyrv 't qvl hn'r hlvy vysvrv shm vy'mrv lv my hby'kh hlm vmh 'th 'shh bzh vmh lkh ph
verses.translation: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this place ? and what hast thou here?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם כָּ/זֹ֣ה וְ/כָ/זֶ֔ה עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖/י מִיכָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׂכְּרֵ֕/נִי וָ/אֱהִי ל֖/וֹ לְ/כֹהֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm khzh vkhzh 'shh ly mykhh vyshkhrny v'hy lv lkhhn
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמְרוּ ל֖/וֹ שְׁאַל נָ֣א בֵ/אלֹהִ֑ים וְ/נֵ֣דְעָ֔ה הֲ/תַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכֵּ֔/נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנַ֖חְנוּ הֹלְכִ֥ים עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv sh'l n' b'lhym vnd'h httslych drkhnv 'shr 'nchnv hlkhym 'lyh
verses.translation: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר לָ/הֶ֛ם הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לְכ֣וּ לְ/שָׁל֑וֹם נֹ֣כַח יְהוָ֔ה דַּרְכְּ/כֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּֽלְכוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm hkhhn lkhv lshlvm nkhch yhvh drkhkhm 'shr tlkhv bh
verses.translation: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכוּ֙ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ לָ֑יְשָׁ/ה וַ/יִּרְא֣וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר בְּ/קִרְבָּ֣/הּ יוֹשֶֽׁבֶת לָ֠/בֶטַח כְּ/מִשְׁפַּ֨ט צִדֹנִ֜ים שֹׁקֵ֣ט וּ/בֹטֵ֗חַ וְ/אֵין מַכְלִ֨ים דָּבָ֤ר בָּ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ יוֹרֵ֣שׁ עֶ֔צֶר וּ/רְחֹקִ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ מִ/צִּ֣דֹנִ֔ים וְ/דָבָ֥ר אֵין לָ/הֶ֖ם עִם אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vylkhv chmsht h'nshym vyb'v lyshh vyr'v 't h'm 'shr bqrbh yvshbt lbtch khmshpt tsdnym shqt vbtch v'yn mkhlym dbr b'rts yvrsh 'tsr vrchqym hmh mtsdnym vdbr 'yn lhm 'm 'dm
verses.translation: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶל אֲחֵי/הֶ֔ם צָרְעָ֖ה וְ/אֶשְׁתָּאֹ֑ל וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ לָ/הֶ֛ם אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם מָ֥ה אַתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l 'chyhm tsr'h v'sht'l vy'mrv lhm 'chyhm mh 'tm
verses.translation: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say ye?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ ק֚וּמָ/ה וְ/נַעֲלֶ֣ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּ֤י רָאִ֨ינוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה טוֹבָ֖ה מְאֹ֑ד וְ/אַתֶּ֣ם מַחְשִׁ֔ים אַל תֵּעָ֣צְל֔וּ לָ/לֶ֥כֶת לָ/בֹ֖א לָ/רֶ֥שֶׁת אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mrv qvmh vn'lh 'lyhm khy r'ynv 't h'rts vhnh tvbh m'd v'tm mchshym 'l t'tslv llkht lb' lrsht 't h'rts
verses.translation: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are ye still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.

verses.original: כְּ/בֹאֲ/כֶ֞ם תָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל עַ֣ם בֹּטֵ֗חַ וְ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ רַחֲבַ֣ת יָדַ֔יִם כִּֽי נְתָנָ֥/הּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶ֑ם מָקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין שָׁ֣ם מַחְס֔וֹר כָּל דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khb'khm tb'v 'l 'm btch vh'rts rchbt ydym khy ntnh 'lhym bydkhm mqvm 'shr 'yn shm mchsvr khl dbr 'shr b'rts
verses.translation: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֤וּ מִ/שָּׁם֙ מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַ/דָּנִ֔י מִ/צָּרְעָ֖ה וּ/מֵ/אֶשְׁתָּאֹ֑ל שֵֽׁשׁ מֵא֣וֹת אִ֔ישׁ חָג֖וּר כְּלֵ֥י מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mshm mmshpcht hdny mtsr'h vm'sht'l shsh m'vt 'ysh chgvr khly mlchmh
verses.translation: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲל֗וּ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּ/קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֡ן קָרְאוּ֩ לַ/מָּק֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא מַחֲנֵה דָ֗ן עַ֚ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה הִנֵּ֕ה אַחֲרֵ֖י קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'lv vychnv bqryt y'rym byhvdh 'l khn qr'v lmqvm hhv' mchnh dn 'd hyvm hzh hnh 'chry qryt y'rym
verses.translation: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjath-jearim.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַבְר֥וּ מִ/שָּׁ֖ם הַר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד בֵּ֥ית מִיכָֽה
verses.translit: vy'brv mshm hr 'prym vyb'v 'd byt mykhh
verses.translation: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲנ֞וּ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַ/הֹלְכִים֮ לְ/רַגֵּל֮ אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ לַיִשׁ֒ וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל אֲחֵי/הֶ֔ם הַ/יְדַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֠י יֵ֣שׁ בַּ/בָּתִּ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֵפ֣וֹד וּ/תְרָפִ֔ים וּ/פֶ֖סֶל וּ/מַסֵּכָ֑ה וְ/עַתָּ֖ה דְּע֥וּ מַֽה תַּעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vy'nv chmsht h'nshym hhlkhym lrgl 't h'rts lysh vy'mrv 'l 'chyhm hyd'tm khy ysh bbtym h'lh 'pvd vtrpym vpsl vmskhh v'th d'v mh t'shv
verses.translation: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.

verses.original: וַ/יָּס֣וּרוּ שָׁ֔מָּ/ה וַ/יָּבֹ֛אוּ אֶל בֵּֽית הַ/נַּ֥עַר הַ/לֵּוִ֖י בֵּ֣ית מִיכָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁאֲלוּ ל֖/וֹ לְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vysvrv shmh vyb'v 'l byt hn'r hlvy byt mykhh vysh'lv lv lshlvm
verses.translation: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁשׁ מֵא֣וֹת אִ֗ישׁ חֲגוּרִים֙ כְּלֵ֣י מִלְחַמְתָּ֔/ם נִצָּבִ֖ים פֶּ֣תַח הַ/שָּׁ֑עַר אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִ/בְּנֵי דָֽן
verses.translit: vshsh m'vt 'ysh chgvrym khly mlchmtm ntsbym ptch hsh'r 'shr mbny dn
verses.translation: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲל֞וּ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַ/הֹלְכִים֮ לְ/רַגֵּ֣ל אֶת הָ/אָרֶץ֒ בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔מָּ/ה לָקְח֗וּ אֶת הַ/פֶּ֨סֶל֙ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/אֵפ֔וֹד וְ/אֶת הַ/תְּרָפִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּסֵּכָ֑ה וְ/הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן נִצָּב֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר וְ/שֵׁשׁ מֵא֣וֹת הָ/אִ֔ישׁ הֶ/חָג֖וּר כְּלֵ֥י הַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'lv chmsht h'nshym hhlkhym lrgl 't h'rts b'v shmh lqchv 't hpsl v't h'pvd v't htrpym v't hmskhh vhkhhn ntsb ptch hsh'r vshsh m'vt h'ysh hchgvr khly hmlchmh
verses.translation: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה בָּ֚אוּ בֵּ֣ית מִיכָ֔ה וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת פֶּ֣סֶל הָ/אֵפ֔וֹד וְ/אֶת הַ/תְּרָפִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּסֵּכָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן מָ֥ה אַתֶּ֖ם עֹשִֽׂים
verses.translit: v'lh b'v byt mykhh vyqchv 't psl h'pvd v't htrpym v't hmskhh vy'mr 'lyhm hkhhn mh 'tm 'shym
verses.translation: And these went into Micah’s house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֩ ל֨/וֹ הַחֲרֵ֜שׁ שִֽׂים יָדְ/ךָ֤ עַל פִּ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/לֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֔/נוּ וֶֽ/הְיֵה לָ֖/נוּ לְ/אָ֣ב וּ/לְ/כֹהֵ֑ן הֲ/ט֣וֹב הֱיוֹתְ/ךָ֣ כֹהֵ֗ן לְ/בֵית֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֔ד א֚וֹ הֱיוֹתְ/ךָ֣ כֹהֵ֔ן לְ/שֵׁ֥בֶט וּ/לְ/מִשְׁפָּחָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv hchrsh shym ydkh 'l pykh vlkh 'mnv vhyh lnv l'b vlkhhn htvb hyvtkh khhn lbyt 'ysh 'chd 'v hyvtkh khhn lshbt vlmshpchh byshr'l
verses.translation: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּיטַב֙ לֵ֣ב הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וַ/יִּקַּח֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֵפ֔וֹד וְ/אֶת הַ/תְּרָפִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/פָּ֑סֶל וַ/יָּבֹ֖א בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyytb lb hkhhn vyqch 't h'pvd v't htrpym v't hpsl vyb' bqrb h'm
verses.translation: And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנ֖וּ וַ/יֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַ/יָּשִׂ֨ימוּ אֶת הַ/טַּ֧ף וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּקְנֶ֛ה וְ/אֶת הַ/כְּבוּדָּ֖ה לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vypnv vylkhv vyshymv 't htf v't hmqnh v't hkhbvdh lpnyhm
verses.translation: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.

verses.original: הֵ֥מָּה הִרְחִ֖יקוּ מִ/בֵּ֣ית מִיכָ֑ה וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ/בָּתִּים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עִם בֵּ֣ית מִיכָ֔ה נִֽזְעֲק֔וּ וַ/יַּדְבִּ֖יקוּ אֶת בְּנֵי דָֽן
verses.translit: hmh hrchyqv mbyt mykhh vh'nshym 'shr bbtym 'shr 'm byt mykhh nz'qv vydbyqv 't bny dn
verses.translation: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah’s house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּקְרְאוּ֙ אֶל בְּנֵי דָ֔ן וַ/יַּסֵּ֖בּוּ פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לְ/מִיכָ֔ה מַה לְּ/ךָ֖ כִּ֥י נִזְעָֽקְתָּ
verses.translit: vyqr'v 'l bny dn vysbv pnyhm vy'mrv lmykhh mh lkh khy nz'qt
verses.translation: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר אֶת אֱלֹהַ/י֩ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֨יתִי לְקַחְתֶּ֧ם וְֽ/אֶת הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן וַ/תֵּלְכ֖וּ וּ/מַה לִּ֣/י ע֑וֹד וּ/מַה זֶּ֛ה תֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלַ֖/י מַה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 't 'lhy 'shr 'shyty lqchtm v't hkhhn vtlkhv vmh ly 'vd vmh zh t'mrv 'ly mh lkh
verses.translation: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ אֵלָי/ו֙ בְּנֵי דָ֔ן אַל תַּשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹלְ/ךָ֖ עִמָּ֑/נוּ פֶּֽן יִפְגְּע֣וּ בָ/כֶ֗ם אֲנָשִׁים֙ מָ֣רֵי נֶ֔פֶשׁ וְ/אָסַפְתָּ֥ה נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ וְ/נֶ֥פֶשׁ בֵּיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv bny dn 'l tshm' qvlkh 'mnv pn ypg'v bkhm 'nshym mry npsh v'spth npshkh vnpsh bytkh
verses.translation: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ בְנֵי דָ֖ן לְ/דַרְכָּ֑/ם וַ/יַּ֣רְא מִיכָ֗ה כִּי חֲזָקִ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וַ/יִּ֖פֶן וַ/יָּ֥שָׁב אֶל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkhv bny dn ldrkhm vyr' mykhh khy chzqym hmh mmnv vypn vyshb 'l bytv
verses.translation: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֨מָּה לָקְח֜וּ אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה מִיכָ֗ה וְֽ/אֶת הַ/כֹּהֵן֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָה ל/וֹ֒ וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ עַל לַ֗יִשׁ עַל עַם֙ שֹׁקֵ֣ט וּ/בֹטֵ֔חַ וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖/ם לְ/פִי חָ֑רֶב וְ/אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר שָׂרְפ֥וּ בָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vhmh lqchv 't 'shr 'shh mykhh v't hkhhn 'shr hyh lv vyb'v 'l lysh 'l 'm shqt vbtch vykhv 'vtm lpy chrb v't h'yr shrpv b'sh
verses.translation: And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ין מַצִּ֜יל כִּ֧י רְֽחוֹקָה הִ֣יא מִ/צִּיד֗וֹן וְ/דָבָ֤ר אֵין לָ/הֶם֙ עִם אָדָ֔ם וְ/הִ֕יא בָּ/עֵ֖מֶק אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/בֵית רְח֑וֹב וַ/יִּבְנ֥וּ אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר וַ/יֵּ֥שְׁבוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'yn mtsyl khy rchvqh hy' mtsydvn vdbr 'yn lhm 'm 'dm vhy' b'mq 'shr lbyt rchvb vybnv 't h'yr vyshbv bh
verses.translation: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lieth by Beth-rehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרְא֤וּ שֵׁם הָ/עִיר֙ דָּ֔ן בְּ/שֵׁם֙ דָּ֣ן אֲבִי/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוּלַּ֖ד לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אוּלָ֛ם לַ֥יִשׁ שֵׁם הָ/עִ֖יר לָ/רִאשֹׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr'v shm h'yr dn bshm dn 'byhm 'shr yvld lyshr'l v'vlm lysh shm h'yr lr'shnh
verses.translation: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקִ֧ימוּ לָ/הֶ֛ם בְּנֵי דָ֖ן אֶת הַ/פָּ֑סֶל וִ֠/יהוֹנָתָן בֶּן גֵּרְשֹׁ֨ם בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה ה֣וּא וּ/בָנָ֗י/ו הָי֤וּ כֹהֲנִים֙ לְ/שֵׁ֣בֶט הַ/דָּנִ֔י עַד י֖וֹם גְּל֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyqymv lhm bny dn 't hpsl vyhvntn bn grshm bn mnshh hv' vbnyv hyv khhnym lshbt hdny 'd yvm glvt h'rts
verses.translation: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֣ימוּ לָ/הֶ֔ם אֶת פֶּ֥סֶל מִיכָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה כָּל יְמֵ֛י הֱי֥וֹת בֵּית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/שִׁלֹֽה
verses.translit: vyshymv lhm 't psl mykhh 'shr 'shh khl ymy hyvt byt h'lhym bshlh
verses.translation: And they set them up Micah’s graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם וּ/מֶ֖לֶךְ אֵ֣ין בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יְהִ֣י אִ֣ישׁ לֵוִ֗י גָּ֚ר בְּ/יַרְכְּתֵ֣י הַר אֶפְרַ֔יִם וַ/יִּֽקַּֽח ל/וֹ֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה פִילֶ֔גֶשׁ מִ/בֵּ֥ית לֶ֖חֶם יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bymym hhm vmlkh 'yn byshr'l vyhy 'ysh lvy gr byrkhty hr 'prym vyqch lv 'shh pylgsh mbyt lchm yhvdh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Beth-lehem-judah.

verses.original: וַ/תִּזְנֶ֤ה עָלָי/ו֙ פִּֽילַגְשׁ֔/וֹ וַ/תֵּ֤לֶךְ מֵֽ/אִתּ/וֹ֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔י/הָ אֶל בֵּ֥ית לֶ֖חֶם יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/תְּהִי שָׁ֕ם יָמִ֖ים אַרְבָּעָ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vtznh 'lyv pylgshv vtlkh m'tv 'l byt 'byh 'l byt lchm yhvdh vthy shm ymym 'rb'h chdshym
verses.translation: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father’s house to Beth-lehem-judah, and was there four whole months.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם אִישָׁ֜/הּ וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ אַחֲרֶ֗י/הָ לְ/דַבֵּ֤ר עַל לִבָּ/הּ֙ ל/השיב/ו לַ/הֲשִׁיבָ֔/הּ וְ/נַעֲר֥/וֹ עִמּ֖/וֹ וְ/צֶ֣מֶד חֲמֹרִ֑ים וַ/תְּבִיאֵ֨/הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔י/הָ וַ/יִּרְאֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֲבִ֣י הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֔ה וַ/יִּשְׂמַ֖ח לִ/קְרָאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqm 'yshh vylkh 'chryh ldbr 'l lbh lhshybv lhshybh vn'rv 'mv vtsmd chmrym vtby'hv byt 'byh vyr'hv 'by hn'rh vyshmch lqr'tv
verses.translation: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father’s house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּחֱזַק בּ֤/וֹ חֹֽתְנ/וֹ֙ אֲבִ֣י הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֔ה וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב אִתּ֖/וֹ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַ/יֹּאכְלוּ֙ וַ/יִּשְׁתּ֔וּ וַ/יָּלִ֖ינוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vychzq bv chtnv 'by hn'rh vyshb 'tv shlsht ymym vy'khlv vyshtv vylynv shm
verses.translation: And his father in law, the damsel’s father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הָ/רְבִיעִ֔י וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֥ימוּ בַ/בֹּ֖קֶר וַ/יָּ֣קָם לָ/לֶ֑כֶת וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אֲבִ֨י הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֜ה אֶל חֲתָנ֗/וֹ סְעָ֧ד לִבְּ/ךָ֛ פַּת לֶ֖חֶם וְ/אַחַ֥ר תֵּלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hrby'y vyshkhymv bbqr vyqm llkht vy'mr 'by hn'rh 'l chtnv s'd lbkh pt lchm v'chr tlkhv
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel’s father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשְׁב֗וּ וַ/יֹּאכְל֧וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֛ם יַחְדָּ֖ו וַ/יִּשְׁתּ֑וּ וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר אֲבִ֤י הַֽ/נַּעֲרָה֙ אֶל הָ/אִ֔ישׁ הֽוֹאֶל נָ֥א וְ/לִ֖ין וְ/יִטַ֥ב לִבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyshbv vy'khlv shnyhm ychdv vyshtv vy'mr 'by hn'rh 'l h'ysh hv'l n' vlyn vytb lbkh
verses.translation: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel’s father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥קָם הָ/אִ֖ישׁ לָ/לֶ֑כֶת וַ/יִּפְצַר בּ/וֹ֙ חֹתְנ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב וַ/יָּ֥לֶן שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyqm h'ysh llkht vyptsr bv chtnv vyshb vyln shm
verses.translation: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם בַּ/בֹּ֜קֶר בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/חֲמִישִׁי֮ לָ/לֶכֶת֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִ֣י הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֗ה סְעָד נָא֙ לְבָ֣בְ/ךָ֔ וְ/הִֽתְמַהְמְה֖וּ עַד נְט֣וֹת הַ/יּ֑וֹם וַ/יֹּאכְל֖וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshkhm bbqr byvm hchmyshy llkht vy'mr 'by hn'rh s'd n' lbbkh vhtmhmhv 'd ntvt hyvm vy'khlv shnyhm
verses.translation: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel’s father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤קָם הָ/אִישׁ֙ לָ/לֶ֔כֶת ה֥וּא וּ/פִילַגְשׁ֖/וֹ וְ/נַעֲר֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֣/וֹ חֹתְנ֣/וֹ אֲבִ֣י הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֡ה הִנֵּ֣ה נָא֩ רָפָ֨ה הַ/יּ֜וֹם לַ/עֲרֹ֗ב לִֽינוּ נָ֞א הִנֵּ֨ה חֲנ֤וֹת הַ/יּוֹם֙ לִ֥ין פֹּה֙ וְ/יִיטַ֣ב לְבָבֶ֔/ךָ וְ/הִשְׁכַּמְתֶּ֤ם מָחָר֙ לְ/דַרְכְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הָלַכְתָּ֖ לְ/אֹהָלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyqm h'ysh llkht hv' vpylgshv vn'rv vy'mr lv chtnv 'by hn'rh hnh n' rph hyvm l'rb lynv n' hnh chnvt hyvm lyn ph vyytb lbbkh vhshkhmtm mchr ldrkhkhm vhlkht l'hlkh
verses.translation: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel’s father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that thine heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.
