verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא אָבָ֤ה הָ/אִישׁ֙ לָ/ל֔וּן וַ/יָּ֣קָם וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יָּבֹא֙ עַד נֹ֣כַח יְב֔וּס הִ֖יא יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/עִמּ֗/וֹ צֶ֤מֶד חֲמוֹרִים֙ חֲבוּשִׁ֔ים וּ/פִילַגְשׁ֖/וֹ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' 'bh h'ysh llvn vyqm vylkh vyb' 'd nkhch ybvs hy' yrvshlm v'mv tsmd chmvrym chbvshym vpylgshv 'mv
verses.translation: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.

verses.original: הֵ֣ם עִם יְב֔וּס וְ/הַ/יּ֖וֹם רַ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/נַּ֜עַר אֶל אֲדֹנָ֗י/ו לְכָ/ה נָּ֛א וְ/נָס֛וּרָה אֶל עִֽיר הַ/יְבוּסִ֥י הַ/זֹּ֖את וְ/נָלִ֥ין בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hm 'm ybvs vhyvm rd m'd vy'mr hn'r 'l 'dnyv lkhh n' vnsvrh 'l 'yr hybvsy hz't vnlyn bh
verses.translation: And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ אֲדֹנָ֔י/ו לֹ֤א נָסוּר֙ אֶל עִ֣יר נָכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא מִ/בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵ֑נָּה וְ/עָבַ֖רְנוּ עַד גִּבְעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'dnyv l' nsvr 'l 'yr nkhry 'shr l' mbny yshr'l hnh v'brnv 'd gb'h
verses.translation: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/נַעֲר֔/וֹ לְךָ֥ וְ/נִקְרְבָ֖ה בְּ/אַחַ֣ד הַ/מְּקֹמ֑וֹת וְ/לַ֥נּוּ בַ/גִּבְעָ֖ה א֥וֹ בָ/רָמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr ln'rv lkh vnqrbh b'chd hmqmvt vlnv bgb'h 'v brmh
verses.translation: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַבְר֖וּ וַ/יֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַ/תָּבֹ֤א לָ/הֶם֙ הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ אֵ֥צֶל הַ/גִּבְעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/בִנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: vy'brv vylkhv vtb' lhm hshmsh 'tsl hgb'h 'shr lbnymn
verses.translation: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongeth to Benjamin.

verses.original: וַ/יָּסֻ֣רוּ שָׁ֔ם לָ/ב֖וֹא לָ/ל֣וּן בַּ/גִּבְעָ֑ה וַ/יָּבֹ֗א וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בִּ/רְח֣וֹב הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/אֵ֥ין אִ֛ישׁ מְאַסֵּֽף אוֹתָ֥/ם הַ/בַּ֖יְתָ/ה לָ/לֽוּן
verses.translit: vysrv shm lbv' llvn bgb'h vyb' vyshb brchvb h'yr v'yn 'ysh m'sf 'vtm hbyth llvn
verses.translation: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה אִ֣ישׁ זָקֵ֗ן בָּ֣א מִֽן מַעֲשֵׂ֤/הוּ מִן הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ בָּ/עֶ֔רֶב וְ/הָ/אִישׁ֙ מֵ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/הוּא גָ֖ר בַּ/גִּבְעָ֑ה וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַ/מָּק֖וֹם בְּנֵ֥י יְמִינִֽי
verses.translit: vhnh 'ysh zqn b' mn m'shhv mn hshdh b'rb vh'ysh mhr 'prym vhv' gr bgb'h v'nshy hmqvm bny ymyny
verses.translation: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֣א עֵינָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּ֛רְא אֶת הָ/אִ֥ישׁ הָ/אֹרֵ֖חַ בִּ/רְחֹ֣ב הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הָ/אִ֧ישׁ הַ/זָּקֵ֛ן אָ֥נָה תֵלֵ֖ךְ וּ/מֵ/אַ֥יִן תָּבֽוֹא
verses.translit: vysh' 'ynyv vyr' 't h'ysh h'rch brchb h'yr vy'mr h'ysh hzqn 'nh tlkh vm'yn tbv'
verses.translation: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו עֹבְרִ֨ים אֲנַ֜חְנוּ מִ/בֵּֽית לֶ֣חֶם יְהוּדָה֮ עַד יַרְכְּתֵ֣י הַר אֶפְרַיִם֒ מִ/שָּׁ֣ם אָנֹ֔כִי וָ/אֵלֵ֕ךְ עַד בֵּ֥ית לֶ֖חֶם יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֲנִ֣י הֹלֵ֔ךְ וְ/אֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ מְאַסֵּ֥ף אוֹתִ֖/י הַ/בָּֽיְתָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'brym 'nchnv mbyt lchm yhvdh 'd yrkhty hr 'prym mshm 'nkhy v'lkh 'd byt lchm yhvdh v't byt yhvh 'ny hlkh v'yn 'ysh m'sf 'vty hbyth
verses.translation: And he said unto him, We are passing from Beth-lehem-judah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Beth-lehem-judah, but I am now going to the house of the LORD ; and there is no man that receiveth me to house.

verses.original: וְ/גַם תֶּ֤בֶן גַּם מִסְפּוֹא֙ יֵ֣שׁ לַ/חֲמוֹרֵ֔י/נוּ וְ֠/גַם לֶ֣חֶם וָ/יַ֤יִן יֶשׁ לִ/י֙ וְ/לַֽ/אֲמָתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לַ/נַּ֖עַר עִם עֲבָדֶ֑י/ךָ אֵ֥ין מַחְס֖וֹר כָּל דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vgm tbn gm mspv' ysh lchmvrynv vgm lchm vyyn ysh ly vl'mtkh vln'r 'm 'bdykh 'yn mchsvr khl dbr
verses.translation: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַ/זָּקֵן֙ שָׁל֣וֹם לָ֔/ךְ רַ֥ק כָּל מַחְסוֹרְ/ךָ֖ עָלָ֑/י רַ֥ק בָּ/רְח֖וֹב אַל תָּלַֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr h'ysh hzqn shlvm lkh rq khl mchsvrkh 'ly rq brchvb 'l tln
verses.translation: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.

verses.original: וַ/יְבִיאֵ֣/הוּ לְ/בֵית֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֖בָול לַ/חֲמוֹרִ֑ים וַֽ/יִּרְחֲצוּ֙ רַגְלֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֹּאכְל֖וּ וַ/יִּשְׁתּֽוּ
verses.translit: vyby'hv lbytv vybvl lchmvrym vyrchtsv rglyhm vy'khlv vyshtv
verses.translation: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

verses.original: הֵמָּה֮ מֵיטִיבִ֣ים אֶת לִבָּ/ם֒ וְ/הִנֵּה֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הָ/עִ֜יר אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי בְלִיַּ֗עַל נָסַ֨בּוּ֙ אֶת הַ/בַּ֔יִת מִֽתְדַּפְּקִ֖ים עַל הַ/דָּ֑לֶת וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ אֶל הָ֠/אִישׁ בַּ֣עַל הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זָּקֵן֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הוֹצֵ֗א אֶת הָ/אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥א אֶל בֵּיתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/נֵדָעֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: hmh mytybym 't lbm vhnh 'nshy h'yr 'nshy bny bly'l nsbv 't hbyt mtdpqym 'l hdlt vy'mrv 'l h'ysh b'l hbyt hzqn l'mr hvts' 't h'ysh 'shr b' 'l bytkh vnd'nv
verses.translation: Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם הָ/אִישׁ֙ בַּ֣עַל הַ/בַּ֔יִת וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם אַל אַחַ֖/י אַל תָּרֵ֣עוּ נָ֑א אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר בָּ֞א הָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַ/זֶּה֙ אַל בֵּיתִ֔/י אַֽל תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת הַ/נְּבָלָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vyts' 'lyhm h'ysh b'l hbyt vy'mr 'lhm 'l 'chy 'l tr'v n' 'chry 'shr b' h'ysh hzh 'l byty 'l t'shv 't hnblh hz't
verses.translation: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay , I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֩ בִתִּ֨/י הַ/בְּתוּלָ֜ה וּ/פִֽילַגְשֵׁ֗/הוּ אוֹצִֽיאָה נָּ֤א אוֹתָ/ם֙ וְ/עַנּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔/ם וַ/עֲשׂ֣וּ לָ/הֶ֔ם הַ/טּ֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/לָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַ/זֶּה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ דְּבַ֖ר הַ/נְּבָלָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: hnh bty hbtvlh vpylgshhv 'vtsy'h n' 'vtm v'nv 'vtm v'shv lhm htvb b'ynykhm vl'ysh hzh l' t'shv dbr hnblh hz't
verses.translation: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא אָב֤וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ לִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַֽ ל֔/וֹ וַ/יַּחֲזֵ֤ק הָ/אִישׁ֙ בְּ/פִ֣ילַגְשׁ֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּצֵ֥א אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/ח֑וּץ וַ/יֵּדְע֣וּ א֠וֹתָ/הּ וַ/יִּֽתְעַלְּלוּ בָ֤/הּ כָּל הַ/לַּ֨יְלָה֙ עַד הַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּח֖וּ/הָ ב/עלות כַּ/עֲל֥וֹת הַ/שָּֽׁחַר
verses.translit: vl' 'bv h'nshym lshm' lv vychzq h'ysh bpylgshv vyts' 'lyhm hchvts vyd'v 'vth vyt'llv bh khl hlylh 'd hbqr vyshlchvh b'lvt kh'lvt hshchr
verses.translation: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֥א הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה לִ/פְנ֣וֹת הַ/בֹּ֑קֶר וַ/תִּפֹּ֞ל פֶּ֧תַח בֵּית הָ/אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֲדוֹנֶ֥י/הָ שָּׁ֖ם עַד הָ/אֽוֹר
verses.translit: vtb' h'shh lpnvt hbqr vtpl ptch byt h'ysh 'shr 'dvnyh shm 'd h'vr
verses.translation: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was , till it was light.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם אֲדֹנֶ֜י/הָ בַּ/בֹּ֗קֶר וַ/יִּפְתַּח֙ דַּלְת֣וֹת הַ/בַּ֔יִת וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א לָ/לֶ֣כֶת לְ/דַרְכּ֑/וֹ וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה הָ/אִשָּׁ֣ה פִֽילַגְשׁ֗/וֹ נֹפֶ֨לֶת֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַ/בַּ֔יִת וְ/יָדֶ֖י/הָ עַל הַ/סַּֽף
verses.translit: vyqm 'dnyh bbqr vyptch dltvt hbyt vyts' llkht ldrkhv vhnh h'shh pylgshv nplt ptch hbyt vydyh 'l hsf
verses.translation: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלֶ֛י/הָ ק֥וּמִי וְ/נֵלֵ֖כָה וְ/אֵ֣ין עֹנֶ֑ה וַ/יִּקָּחֶ֨/הָ֙ עַֽל הַ/חֲמ֔וֹר וַ/יָּ֣קָם הָ/אִ֔ישׁ וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ לִ/מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh qvmy vnlkhh v'yn 'nh vyqchh 'l hchmvr vyqm h'ysh vylkh lmqmv
verses.translation: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֶל בֵּית֗/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אֶת הַֽ/מַּאֲכֶ֨לֶת֙ וַ/יַּחֲזֵ֣ק בְּ/פִֽילַגְשׁ֔/וֹ וַֽ/יְנַתְּחֶ֨/הָ֙ לַ/עֲצָמֶ֔י/הָ לִ/שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר נְתָחִ֑ים וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֶ֔/הָ בְּ/כֹ֖ל גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyb' 'l bytv vyqch 't hm'khlt vychzq bpylgshv vyntchh l'tsmyh lshnym 'shr ntchym vyshlchh bkhl gbvl yshr'l
verses.translation: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה כָל הָ/רֹאֶ֗ה וְ/אָמַר֙ לֹֽא נִהְיְתָ֤ה וְ/לֹֽא נִרְאֲתָה֙ כָּ/זֹ֔את לְ/מִ/יּ֞וֹם עֲל֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה שִֽׂימוּ לָ/כֶ֥ם עָלֶ֖י/הָ עֻ֥צוּ וְ/דַבֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: vhyh khl hr'h v'mr l' nhyth vl' nr'th khz't lmyvm 'lvt bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym 'd hyvm hzh shymv lkhm 'lyh 'tsv vdbrv
verses.translation: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְאוּ֮ כָּל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/תִּקָּהֵ֨ל הָ/עֵדָ֜ה כְּ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֗ד לְ/מִ/דָּן֙ וְ/עַד בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע וְ/אֶ֖רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָ֑ד אֶל יְהוָ֖ה הַ/מִּצְפָּֽה
verses.translit: vyts'v khl bny yshr'l vtqhl h'dh kh'ysh 'chd lmdn v'd b'r shb' v'rts hgl'd 'l yhvh hmtsph
verses.translation: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְיַצְּב֞וּ פִּנּ֣וֹת כָּל הָ/עָ֗ם כֹּ֚ל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּ/קְהַ֖ל עַ֣ם הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֥ישׁ רַגְלִ֖י שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vytytsbv pnvt khl h'm khl shbty yshr'l bqhl 'm h'lhym 'rb' m'vt 'lf 'ysh rgly shlf chrb
verses.translation: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן כִּֽי עָל֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַ/מִּצְפָּ֑ה וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דַּבְּר֕וּ אֵיכָ֥ה נִהְיְתָ֖ה הָ/רָעָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vyshm'v bny bnymn khy 'lv bny yshr'l hmtsph vy'mrv bny yshr'l dbrv 'ykhh nhyth hr'h hz't
verses.translation: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell us , how was this wickedness?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַן הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/לֵּוִ֗י אִ֛ישׁ הָ/אִשָּׁ֥ה הַ/נִּרְצָחָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הַ/גִּבְעָ֨תָ/ה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן בָּ֛אתִי אֲנִ֥י וּ/פִֽילַגְשִׁ֖/י לָ/לֽוּן
verses.translit: vy'n h'ysh hlvy 'ysh h'shh hnrtschh vy'mr hgb'th 'shr lbnymn b'ty 'ny vpylgshy llvn
verses.translation: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֤מוּ עָלַ/י֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י הַ/גִּבְעָ֔ה וַ/יָּסֹ֧בּוּ עָלַ֛/י אֶת הַ/בַּ֖יִת לָ֑יְלָה אוֹתִ/י֙ דִּמּ֣וּ לַ/הֲרֹ֔ג וְ/אֶת פִּילַגְשִׁ֥/י עִנּ֖וּ וַ/תָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyqmv 'ly b'ly hgb'h vysbv 'ly 't hbyt lylh 'vty dmv lhrg v't pylgshy 'nv vtmt
verses.translation: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.

verses.original: וָֽ/אֹחֵ֤ז בְּ/פִֽילַגְשִׁ/י֙ וָֽ/אֲנַתְּחֶ֔/הָ וָֽ/אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔/הָ בְּ/כָל שְׂדֵ֖ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י עָשׂ֛וּ זִמָּ֥ה וּ/נְבָלָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'chz bpylgshy v'ntchh v'shlchh bkhl shdh nchlt yshr'l khy 'shv zmh vnblh byshr'l
verses.translation: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה כֻלְּ/כֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הָב֥וּ לָ/כֶ֛ם דָּבָ֥ר וְ/עֵצָ֖ה הֲלֹֽם
verses.translit: hnh khlkhm bny yshr'l hbv lkhm dbr v'tsh hlm
verses.translation: Behold, ye are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם כְּ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א נֵלֵךְ֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/אָהֳל֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א נָס֖וּר אִ֥ישׁ לְ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqm khl h'm kh'ysh 'chd l'mr l' nlkh 'ysh l'hlv vl' nsvr 'ysh lbytv
verses.translation: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַ/גִּבְעָ֑ה עָלֶ֖י/הָ בְּ/גוֹרָֽל
verses.translit: v'th zh hdbr 'shr n'shh lgb'h 'lyh bgvrl
verses.translation: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֣חְנוּ עֲשָׂרָה֩ אֲנָשִׁ֨ים לַ/מֵּאָ֜ה לְ/כֹ֣ל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּ/מֵאָ֤ה לָ/אֶ֨לֶף֙ וְ/אֶ֣לֶף לָ/רְבָבָ֔ה לָ/קַ֥חַת צֵדָ֖ה לָ/עָ֑ם לַ/עֲשׂ֗וֹת לְ/בוֹאָ/ם֙ לְ/גֶ֣בַע בִּנְיָמִ֔ן כְּ/כָל הַ֨/נְּבָלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vlqchnv 'shrh 'nshym lm'h lkhl shbty yshr'l vm'h l'lf v'lf lrbbh lqcht tsdh l'm l'shvt lbv'm lgb' bnymn khkhl hnblh 'shr 'shh byshr'l
verses.translation: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּֽאָסֵ֞ף כָּל אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל הָ/עִ֔יר כְּ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד חֲבֵרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sf khl 'ysh yshr'l 'l h'yr kh'ysh 'chd chbrym
verses.translation: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְח֞וּ שִׁבְטֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים בְּ/כָל שִׁבְטֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מָ֚ה הָ/רָעָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִהְיְתָ֖ה בָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshlchv shbty yshr'l 'nshym bkhl shbty bnymn l'mr mh hr'h hz't 'shr nhyth bkhm
verses.translation: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה תְּנוּ֩ אֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֨ים בְּנֵֽי בְלִיַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ/גִּבְעָה֙ וּ/נְמִיתֵ֔/ם וּ/נְבַעֲרָ֥ה רָעָ֖ה מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֤א אָבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִּנְיָמִ֔ן לִ/שְׁמֹ֕עַ בְּ/ק֖וֹל אֲחֵי/הֶ֥ם בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'th tnv 't h'nshym bny bly'l 'shr bgb'h vnmytm vnb'rh r'h myshr'l vl' 'bv bny bnymn lshm' bqvl 'chyhm bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּאָסְפ֧וּ בְנֵֽי בִנְיָמִ֛ן מִן הֶ/עָרִ֖ים הַ/גִּבְעָ֑תָ/ה לָ/צֵ֥את לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'spv bny bnymn mn h'rym hgb'th lts't lmlchmh 'm bny yshr'l
verses.translation: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפָּֽקְדוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י בִנְיָמִ֜ן בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ מֵ/הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חָ֑רֶב לְ֠/בַד מִ/יֹּשְׁבֵ֤י הַ/גִּבְעָה֙ הִתְפָּ֣קְד֔וּ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִ֥ישׁ בָּחֽוּר
verses.translit: vytpqdv bny bnymn byvm hhv' mh'rym 'shrym vshshh 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb lbd myshby hgb'h htpqdv shb' m'vt 'ysh bchvr
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

verses.original: מִ/כֹּ֣ל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֗ה שְׁבַ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ אִ֣ישׁ בָּח֔וּר אִטֵּ֖ר יַד יְמִינ֑/וֹ כָּל זֶ֗ה קֹלֵ֧עַ בָּ/אֶ֛בֶן אֶל הַֽ/שַּׂעֲרָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א יַחֲטִֽא
verses.translit: mkhl h'm hzh shb' m'vt 'ysh bchvr 'tr yd ymynv khl zh ql' b'bn 'l hsh'rh vl' ycht'
verses.translation: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הִתְפָּֽקְד֗וּ לְ/בַד֙ מִ/בִּנְיָמִ֔ן אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חָ֑רֶב כָּל זֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l htpqdv lbd mbnymn 'rb' m'vt 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb khl zh 'ysh mlchmh
verses.translation: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֜מוּ וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ בֵֽית אֵל֮ וַ/יִּשְׁאֲל֣וּ בֵ/אלֹהִים֒ וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ֚י יַעֲלֶה לָּ֣/נוּ בַ/תְּחִלָּ֔ה לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֥ה בַ/תְּחִלָּֽה
verses.translit: vyqmv vy'lv byt 'l vysh'lv b'lhym vy'mrv bny yshr'l my y'lh lnv btchlh lmlchmh 'm bny bnymn vy'mr yhvh yhvdh btchlh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah shall go up first.

verses.original: וַ/יָּק֥וּמוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר וַ/יַּֽחֲנ֖וּ עַל הַ/גִּבְעָֽה
verses.translit: vyqvmv bny yshr'l bbqr vychnv 'l hgb'h
verses.translation: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וַ/יַּעַרְכ֨וּ אִתָּ֧/ם אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִלְחָמָ֖ה אֶל הַ/גִּבְעָֽה
verses.translit: vyts' 'ysh yshr'l lmlchmh 'm bnymn vy'rkhv 'tm 'ysh yshr'l mlchmh 'l hgb'h
verses.translation: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֥וּ בְנֵֽי בִנְיָמִ֖ן מִן הַ/גִּבְעָ֑ה וַ/יַּשְׁחִ֨יתוּ בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא שְׁנַ֨יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyts'v bny bnymn mn hgb'h vyshchytv byshr'l byvm hhv' shnym v'shrym 'lf 'ysh 'rtsh
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְחַזֵּ֥ק הָ/עָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּסִ֨פוּ֙ לַ/עֲרֹ֣ךְ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בַּ/מָּק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁר עָ֥רְכוּ שָׁ֖ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הָ/רִאשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vytchzq h'm 'ysh yshr'l vyspv l'rkh mlchmh bmqvm 'shr 'rkhv shm byvm hr'shvn
verses.translation: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַ/יִּבְכּ֣וּ לִ/פְנֵֽי יְהוָה֮ עַד הָ/עֶרֶב֒ וַ/יִּשְׁאֲל֤וּ בַֽ/יהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַ/אוֹסִ֗יף לָ/גֶ֨שֶׁת֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה עִם בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן אָחִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה עֲל֥וּ אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'lv bny yshr'l vybkhv lpny yhvh 'd h'rb vysh'lv byhvh l'mr h'vsyf lgsht lmlchmh 'm bny bnymn 'chy vy'mr yhvh 'lv 'lyv
verses.translation: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרְב֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שֵּׁנִֽי
verses.translit: vyqrbv bny yshr'l 'l bny bnymn byvm hshny
verses.translation: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֩ בִנְיָמִ֨ן לִ/קְרָאתָ֥/ם מִֽן הַ/גִּבְעָה֮ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שֵּׁנִי֒ וַ/יַּשְׁחִיתוּ֩ בִ/בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל ע֗וֹד שְׁמֹנַ֨ת עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ אָ֑רְצָ/ה כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה שֹׁ֥לְפֵי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vyts' bnymn lqr'tm mn hgb'h byvm hshny vyshchytv bbny yshr'l 'vd shmnt 'shr 'lf 'ysh 'rtsh khl 'lh shlpy chrb
verses.translation: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ כָל בְּנֵי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֜ם וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ בֵֽית אֵ֗ל וַ/יִּבְכּוּ֙ וַ/יֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יָּצ֥וּמוּ בַ/יּוֹם הַ/ה֖וּא עַד הָ/עָ֑רֶב וַֽ/יַּעֲל֛וּ עֹל֥וֹת וּ/שְׁלָמִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'lv khl bny yshr'l vkhl h'm vyb'v byt 'l vybkhv vyshbv shm lpny yhvh vytsvmv byvm hhv' 'd h'rb vy'lv 'lvt vshlmym lpny yhvh
verses.translation: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD , and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּֽ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/שָׁ֗ם אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּ/יָּמִ֖ים הָ/הֵֽם
verses.translit: vysh'lv bny yshr'l byhvh vshm 'rvn bryt h'lhym bymym hhm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD , (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

verses.original: וּ֠/פִינְחָס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֨ר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֜ן עֹמֵ֣ד לְ/פָנָ֗י/ו בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵם֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ הַ/אוֹסִ֨ף ע֜וֹד לָ/צֵ֧את לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה עִם בְּנֵֽי בִנְיָמִ֥ן אָחִ֖/י אִם אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ עֲל֔וּ כִּ֥י מָחָ֖ר אֶתְּנֶ֥/נּוּ בְ/יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vpynchs bn 'l'zr bn 'hrn 'md lpnyv bymym hhm l'mr h'vsf 'vd lts't lmlchmh 'm bny bnymn 'chy 'm 'chdl vy'mr yhvh 'lv khy mchr 'tnnv bydkh
verses.translation: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹֽרְבִ֔ים אֶל הַ/גִּבְעָ֖ה סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyshm yshr'l 'rbym 'l hgb'h sbyb
verses.translation: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י וַ/יַּעַרְכ֥וּ אֶל הַ/גִּבְעָ֖ה כְּ/פַ֥עַם בְּ/פָֽעַם
verses.translit: vy'lv bny yshr'l 'l bny bnymn byvm hshlyshy vy'rkhv 'l hgb'h khp'm bp'm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי בִנְיָמִן֙ לִ/קְרַ֣את הָ/עָ֔ם הָנְתְּק֖וּ מִן הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יָּחֵ֡לּוּ לְ/הַכּוֹת֩ מֵ/הָ/עָ֨ם חֲלָלִ֜ים כְּ/פַ֣עַם בְּ/פַ֗עַם בַּֽ/מְסִלּוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַחַ֜ת עֹלָ֣ה בֵֽית אֵ֗ל וְ/אַחַ֤ת גִּבְעָ֨תָ/ה֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה כִּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyts'v bny bnymn lqr't h'm hntqv mn h'yr vychlv lhkhvt mh'm chllym khp'm bp'm bmslvt 'shr 'cht 'lh byt 'l v'cht gb'th bshdh khshlshym 'ysh byshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן נִגָּפִ֥ים הֵ֛ם לְ/פָנֵ֖י/נוּ כְּ/בָ/רִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וּ/בְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָמְר֗וּ נָנ֨וּסָה֙ וּֽ/נְתַקְּנֻ֔/הוּ מִן הָ/עִ֖יר אֶל הַֽ/מְסִלּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mrv bny bnymn ngpym hm lpnynv khbr'shnh vbny yshr'l 'mrv nnvsh vntqnhv mn h'yr 'l hmslvt
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֣ל אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל קָ֚מוּ מִ/מְּקוֹמ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּעַרְכ֖וּ בְּ/בַ֣עַל תָּמָ֑ר וְ/אֹרֵ֧ב יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵגִ֥יחַ מִ/מְּקֹמ֖/וֹ מִ/מַּֽעֲרֵה גָֽבַע
verses.translit: vkhl 'ysh yshr'l qmv mmqvmv vy'rkhv bb'l tmr v'rb yshr'l mgych mmqmv mm'rh gb'
verses.translation: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹאוּ֩ מִ/נֶּ֨גֶד לַ/גִּבְעָ֜ה עֲשֶׂרֶת֩ אֲלָפִ֨ים אִ֤ישׁ בָּחוּר֙ מִ/כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה כָּבֵ֑דָה וְ/הֵם֙ לֹ֣א יָדְע֔וּ כִּֽי נֹגַ֥עַת עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם הָ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v mngd lgb'h 'shrt 'lpym 'ysh bchvr mkhl yshr'l vhmlchmh khbdh vhm l' yd'v khy ng't 'lyhm hr'h
verses.translation: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגֹּ֨ף יְהוָ֥ה אֶֽת בִּנְיָמִן֮ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יַּשְׁחִיתוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל בְּ/בִנְיָמִן֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף וּ/מֵאָ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה שֹׁ֥לֵף חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vygf yhvh 't bnymn lpny yshr'l vyshchytv bny yshr'l bbnymn byvm hhv' 'shrym vchmshh 'lf vm'h 'ysh khl 'lh shlf chrb
verses.translation: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֥וּ בְנֵֽי בִנְיָמִ֖ן כִּ֣י נִגָּ֑פוּ וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל מָקוֹם֙ לְ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן כִּ֤י בָֽטְחוּ֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֹרֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֖מוּ אֶל הַ/גִּבְעָֽה
verses.translit: vyr'v bny bnymn khy ngpv vytnv 'ysh yshr'l mqvm lbnymn khy btchv 'l h'rb 'shr shmv 'l hgb'h
verses.translation: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֹרֵ֣ב הֵחִ֔ישׁוּ וַֽ/יִּפְשְׁט֖וּ אֶל הַ/גִּבְעָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְשֹׁךְ֙ הָ/אֹרֵ֔ב וַ/יַּ֥ךְ אֶת כָּל הָ/עִ֖יר לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vh'rb hchyshv vypshtv 'l hgb'h vymshkh h'rb vykh 't khl h'yr lpy chrb
verses.translation: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מּוֹעֵ֗ד הָיָ֛ה לְ/אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִם הָ/אֹרֵ֑ב הֶ֕רֶב לְ/הַעֲלוֹתָ֛/ם מַשְׂאַ֥ת הֶ/עָשָׁ֖ן מִן הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vhmv'd hyh l'ysh yshr'l 'm h'rb hrb lh'lvtm msh't h'shn mn h'yr
verses.translation: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.

verses.original: וַ/יַּהֲפֹ֥ךְ אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֡ן הֵחֵל֩ לְ/הַכּ֨וֹת חֲלָלִ֤ים בְּ/אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֣י אָמְר֔וּ אַךְ֩ נִגּ֨וֹף נִגָּ֥ף הוּא֙ לְ/פָנֵ֔י/נוּ כַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה הָ/רִאשֹׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyhpkh 'ysh yshr'l bmlchmh vbnymn hchl lhkhvt chllym b'ysh yshr'l khshlshym 'ysh khy 'mrv 'kh ngvf ngf hv' lpnynv khmlchmh hr'shnh
verses.translation: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מַּשְׂאֵ֗ת הֵחֵ֛לָּה לַ/עֲל֥וֹת מִן הָ/עִ֖יר עַמּ֣וּד עָשָׁ֑ן וַ/יִּ֤פֶן בִּנְיָמִן֙ אַחֲרָ֔י/ו וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה עָלָ֥ה כְלִיל הָ/עִ֖יר הַ/שָּׁמָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vhmsh't hchlh l'lvt mn h'yr 'mvd 'shn vypn bnymn 'chryv vhnh 'lh khlyl h'yr hshmymh
verses.translation: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הָפַ֔ךְ וַ/יִּבָּהֵ֖ל אִ֣ישׁ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן כִּ֣י רָאָ֔ה כִּֽי נָגְעָ֥ה עָלָ֖י/ו הָ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l hpkh vybhl 'ysh bnymn khy r'h khy ng'h 'lyv hr'h
verses.translation: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנ֞וּ לִ/פְנֵ֨י אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר וְ/הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה הִדְבִּיקָ֑תְ/הוּ וַ/אֲשֶׁר֙ מֵ/הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים מַשְׁחִיתִ֥ים אוֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/תוֹכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vypnv lpny 'ysh yshr'l 'l drkh hmdbr vhmlchmh hdbyqthv v'shr mh'rym mshchytym 'vtv btvkhv
verses.translation: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

verses.original: כִּתְּר֤וּ אֶת בִּנְיָמִן֙ הִרְדִיפֻ֔/הוּ מְנוּחָ֖ה הִדְרִיכֻ֑/הוּ עַ֛ד נֹ֥כַח הַ/גִּבְעָ֖ה מִ/מִּזְרַח שָֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: khtrv 't bnymn hrdyphv mnvchh hdrykhhv 'd nkhch hgb'h mmzrch shmsh
verses.translation: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּפְּלוּ֙ מִ/בִּנְיָמִ֔ן שְׁמֹנָֽה עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף אִ֑ישׁ אֶת כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁי חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vyplv mbnymn shmnh 'shr 'lf 'ysh 't khl 'lh 'nshy chyl
verses.translation: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנ֞וּ וַ/יָּנֻ֤סוּ הַ/מִּדְבָּ֨רָ/ה֙ אֶל סֶ֣לַע הָֽ/רִמּ֔וֹן וַ/יְעֹֽלְלֻ֨/הוּ֙ בַּֽ/מְסִלּ֔וֹת חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יַּדְבִּ֤יקוּ אַחֲרָי/ו֙ עַד גִּדְעֹ֔ם וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ אַלְפַּ֥יִם אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vypnv vynsv hmdbrh 'l sl' hrmvn vy'llhv bmslvt chmsht 'lpym 'ysh vydbyqv 'chryv 'd gd'm vykhv mmnv 'lpym 'ysh
verses.translation: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כָל הַ/נֹּ֨פְלִ֜ים מִ/בִּנְיָמִ֗ן עֶשְׂרִים֩ וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה אֶ֥לֶף אִ֛ישׁ שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חֶ֖רֶב בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא אֶֽת כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁי חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vyhy khl hnplym mbnymn 'shrym vchmshh 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb byvm hhv' 't khl 'lh 'nshy chyl
verses.translation: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנ֞וּ וַ/יָּנֻ֤סוּ הַ/מִּדְבָּ֨רָ/ה֙ אֶל סֶ֣לַע הָֽ/רִמּ֔וֹן שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּ/סֶ֣לַע רִמּ֔וֹן אַרְבָּעָ֖ה חֳדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vypnv vynsv hmdbrh 'l sl' hrmvn shsh m'vt 'ysh vyshbv bsl' rmvn 'rb'h chdshym
verses.translation: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל שָׁ֣בוּ אֶל בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ וַ/יַּכּ֣וּ/ם לְ/פִי חֶ֔רֶב מֵ/עִ֤יר מְתֹם֙ עַד בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַ֖ד כָּל הַ/נִּמְצָ֑א גַּ֛ם כָּל הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הַ/נִּמְצָא֖וֹת שִׁלְּח֥וּ בָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l shbv 'l bny bnymn vykhvm lpy chrb m'yr mtm 'd bhmh 'd khl hnmts' gm khl h'rym hnmts'vt shlchv b'sh
verses.translation: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נִשְׁבַּ֥ע בַּ/מִּצְפָּ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ לֹא יִתֵּ֥ן בִּתּ֛/וֹ לְ/בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l nshb' bmtsph l'mr 'ysh mmnv l' ytn btv lbnymn l'shh
verses.translation: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א הָ/עָם֙ בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל וַ/יֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ עַד הָ/עֶ֔רֶב לִ/פְנֵ֖י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יִּשְׂא֣וּ קוֹלָ֔/ם וַ/יִּבְכּ֖וּ בְּכִ֥י גָדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vyb' h'm byt 'l vyshbv shm 'd h'rb lpny h'lhym vysh'v qvlm vybkhv bkhy gdvl
verses.translation: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לָ/מָ֗ה יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָ֥יְתָה זֹּ֖את בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ/הִפָּקֵ֥ד הַ/יּ֛וֹם מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁ֥בֶט אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vy'mrv lmh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hyth z't byshr'l lhpqd hyvm myshr'l shbt 'chd
verses.translation: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יִּבְנוּ שָׁ֖ם מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ עֹל֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyshkhymv h'm vybnv shm mzbch vy'lv 'lvt vshlmym
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ֠י אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא עָלָ֧ה בַ/קָּהָ֛ל מִ/כָּל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְהוָ֑ה כִּי֩ הַ/שְּׁבוּעָ֨ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֜ה הָיְתָ֗ה לַ֠/אֲשֶׁר לֹא עָלָ֨ה אֶל יְהוָ֧ה הַ/מִּצְפָּ֛ה לֵ/אמֹ֖ר מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vy'mrv bny yshr'l my 'shr l' 'lh bqhl mkhl shbty yshr'l 'l yhvh khy hshbv'h hgdvlh hyth l'shr l' 'lh 'l yhvh hmtsph l'mr mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וַ/יִּנָּֽחֲמוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל בִּנְיָמִ֖ן אָחִ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נִגְדַּ֥ע הַ/יּ֛וֹם שֵׁ֥בֶט אֶחָ֖ד מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vynchmv bny yshr'l 'l bnymn 'chyv vy'mrv ngd' hyvm shbt 'chd myshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

verses.original: מַה נַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָ/הֶ֛ם לַ/נּוֹתָרִ֖ים לְ/נָשִׁ֑ים וַ/אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְנוּ בַֽ/יהוָ֔ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י תֵּת לָ/הֶ֥ם מִ/בְּנוֹתֵ֖י/נוּ לְ/נָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: mh n'shh lhm lnvtrym lnshym v'nchnv nshb'nv byhvh lblty tt lhm mbnvtynv lnshym
verses.translation: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֗י אֶחָד֙ מִ/שִּׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא עָלָ֥ה אֶל יְהוָ֖ה הַ/מִּצְפָּ֑ה וְ֠/הִנֵּה לֹ֣א בָא אִ֧ישׁ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֛ה מִ/יָּבֵ֥ישׁ גִּלְעָ֖ד אֶל הַ/קָּהָֽל
verses.translit: vy'mrv my 'chd mshbty yshr'l 'shr l' 'lh 'l yhvh hmtsph vhnh l' b' 'ysh 'l hmchnh mybysh gl'd 'l hqhl
verses.translation: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD ? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפָּקֵ֖ד הָ/עָ֑ם וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין שָׁם֙ אִ֔ישׁ מִ/יּוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יָבֵ֥שׁ גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vytpqd h'm vhnh 'yn shm 'ysh myvshby ybsh gl'd
verses.translation: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלְחוּ שָׁ֣ם הָ/עֵדָ֗ה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ מִ/בְּנֵ֣י הֶ/חָ֑יִל וַ/יְצַוּ֨וּ אוֹתָ֜/ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לְ֠כוּ וְ/הִכִּיתֶ֞ם אֶת יוֹשְׁבֵ֨י יָבֵ֤שׁ גִּלְעָד֙ לְ/פִי חֶ֔רֶב וְ/הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים וְ/הַ/טָּֽף
verses.translit: vyshlchv shm h'dh shnym 'shr 'lf 'ysh mbny hchyl vytsvv 'vtm l'mr lkhv vhkhytm 't yvshby ybsh gl'd lpy chrb vhnshym vhtf
verses.translation: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֥ה הַ/דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּל זָכָ֗ר וְ/כָל אִשָּׁ֛ה יֹדַ֥עַת מִשְׁכַּב זָכָ֖ר תַּחֲרִֽימוּ
verses.translit: vzh hdbr 'shr t'shv khl zkhr vkhl 'shh yd't mshkhb zkhr tchrymv
verses.translation: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּמְצְא֞וּ מִ/יּוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֗ד אַרְבַּ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה בְתוּלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יָדְעָ֛ה אִ֖ישׁ לְ/מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר וַ/יָּבִ֨יאוּ אוֹתָ֤/ם אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶה֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: vymts'v myvshby ybysh gl'd 'rb' m'vt n'rh btvlh 'shr l' yd'h 'ysh lmshkhb zkhr vyby'v 'vtm 'l hmchnh shlh 'shr b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה וַֽ/יְדַבְּרוּ֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/סֶ֣לַע רִמּ֑וֹן וַ/יִּקְרְא֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyshlchv khl h'dh vydbrv 'l bny bnymn 'shr bsl' rmvn vyqr'v lhm shlvm
verses.translation: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב בִּנְיָמִן֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא וַ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ הַ/נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר חִיּ֔וּ מִ/נְּשֵׁ֖י יָבֵ֣שׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד וְ/לֹֽא מָצְא֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyshb bnymn b't hhy' vytnv lhm hnshym 'shr chyv mnshy ybsh gl'd vl' mts'v lhm khn
verses.translation: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם נִחָ֖ם לְ/בִנְיָמִ֑ן כִּֽי עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּ/שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vh'm nchm lbnymn khy 'shh yhvh prts bshbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְר֨וּ זִקְנֵ֣י הָ/עֵדָ֔ה מַה נַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לַ/נּוֹתָרִ֖ים לְ/נָשִׁ֑ים כִּֽי נִשְׁמְדָ֥ה מִ/בִּנְיָמִ֖ן אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mrv zqny h'dh mh n'shh lnvtrym lnshym khy nshmdh mbnymn 'shh
verses.translation: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ יְרֻשַּׁ֥ת פְּלֵיטָ֖ה לְ/בִנְיָמִ֑ן וְ/לֹֽא יִמָּחֶ֥ה שֵׁ֖בֶט מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mrv yrsht plyth lbnymn vl' ymchh shbt myshr'l
verses.translation: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנַ֗חְנוּ לֹ֥א נוּכַ֛ל לָ/תֵת לָ/הֶ֥ם נָשִׁ֖ים מִ/בְּנוֹתֵ֑י/נוּ כִּֽי נִשְׁבְּע֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אָר֕וּר נֹתֵ֥ן אִשָּׁ֖ה לְ/בִנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: v'nchnv l' nvkhl ltt lhm nshym mbnvtynv khy nshb'v bny yshr'l l'mr 'rvr ntn 'shh lbnymn
verses.translation: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֡וּ הִנֵּה֩ חַג יְהוָ֨ה בְּ/שִׁל֜וֹ מִ/יָּמִ֣ים יָמִ֗ימָ/ה אֲשֶׁ֞ר מִ/צְּפ֤וֹנָ/ה לְ/בֵֽית אֵל֙ מִזְרְחָ֣/ה הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ לִ/מְסִלָּ֔ה הָ/עֹלָ֥ה מִ/בֵּֽית אֵ֖ל שְׁכֶ֑מָ/ה וּ/מִ/נֶּ֖גֶב לִ/לְבוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv hnh chg yhvh bshlv mymym ymymh 'shr mtspvnh lbyt 'l mzrchh hshmsh lmslh h'lh mbyt 'l shkhmh vmngb llbvnh
verses.translation: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

verses.original: ו/יצו וַ/יְצַוּ֕וּ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לְכ֖וּ וַ/אֲרַבְתֶּ֥ם בַּ/כְּרָמִֽים
verses.translit: vytsv vytsvv 't bny bnymn l'mr lkhv v'rbtm bkhrmym
verses.translation: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

verses.original: וּ/רְאִיתֶ֗ם וְ֠/הִנֵּה אִם יֵ֨צְא֥וּ בְנוֹת שִׁילוֹ֮ לָ/ח֣וּל בַּ/מְּחֹלוֹת֒ וִֽ/יצָאתֶם֙ מִן הַ/כְּרָמִ֔ים וַ/חֲטַפְתֶּ֥ם לָ/כֶ֛ם אִ֥ישׁ אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ מִ/בְּנ֣וֹת שִׁיל֑וֹ וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֖ם אֶ֥רֶץ בִּנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: vr'ytm vhnh 'm yts'v bnvt shylv lchvl bmchlvt vyts'tm mn hkhrmym vchtptm lkhm 'ysh 'shtv mbnvt shylv vhlkhtm 'rts bnymn
verses.translation: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֡ה כִּֽי יָבֹ֣אוּ אֲבוֹתָ/ם֩ א֨וֹ אֲחֵי/הֶ֜ם ל/רוב לָ/רִ֣יב אֵלֵ֗י/נוּ וְ/אָמַ֤רְנוּ אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ חָנּ֣וּ/נוּ אוֹתָ֔/ם כִּ֣י לֹ֥א לָקַ֛חְנוּ אִ֥ישׁ אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֣י לֹ֥א אַתֶּ֛ם נְתַתֶּ֥ם לָ/הֶ֖ם כָּ/עֵ֥ת תֶּאְשָֽׁמוּ
verses.translit: vhyh khy yb'v 'bvtm 'v 'chyhm lrvb lryb 'lynv v'mrnv 'lyhm chnvnv 'vtm khy l' lqchnv 'ysh 'shtv bmlchmh khy l' 'tm nttm lhm kh't t'shmv
verses.translation: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן וַ/יִּשְׂא֤וּ נָשִׁים֙ לְ/מִסְפָּרָ֔/ם מִן הַ/מְּחֹלְל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר גָּזָ֑לוּ וַ/יֵּלְכ֗וּ וַ/יָּשׁ֨וּבוּ֙ אֶל נַ֣חֲלָתָ֔/ם וַ/יִּבְנוּ֙ אֶת הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'shv khn bny bnymn vysh'v nshym lmsprm mn hmchllvt 'shr gzlv vylkhv vyshvbv 'l nchltm vybnv 't h'rym vyshbv bhm
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְהַלְּכ֨וּ מִ/שָּׁ֤ם בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא אִ֥ישׁ לְ/שִׁבְט֖/וֹ וּ/לְ/מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּצְא֣וּ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לְ/נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vythlkhv mshm bny yshr'l b't hhy' 'ysh lshbtv vlmshpchtv vyts'v mshm 'ysh lnchltv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֛ישׁ הַ/יָּשָׁ֥ר בְּ/עֵינָ֖י/ו יַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: bymym hhm 'yn mlkh byshr'l 'ysh hyshr b'ynyv y'shh
verses.translation: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ/ימֵי֙ שְׁפֹ֣ט הַ/שֹּׁפְטִ֔ים וַ/יְהִ֥י רָעָ֖ב בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ אִ֜ישׁ מִ/בֵּ֧ית לֶ֣חֶם יְהוּדָ֗ה לָ/גוּר֙ בִּ/שְׂדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב ה֥וּא וְ/אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ וּ/שְׁנֵ֥י בָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy bymy shpt hshptym vyhy r'b b'rts vylkh 'ysh mbyt lchm yhvdh lgvr bshdy mv'b hv' v'shtv vshny bnyv
verses.translation: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֣ם הָ/אִ֣ישׁ אֱֽלִימֶ֡לֶךְ וְ/שֵׁם֩ אִשְׁתּ֨/וֹ נָעֳמִ֜י וְ/שֵׁ֥ם שְׁנֵֽי בָנָ֣י/ו מַחְל֤וֹן וְ/כִלְיוֹן֙ אֶפְרָתִ֔ים מִ/בֵּ֥ית לֶ֖חֶם יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ שְׂדֵי מוֹאָ֖ב וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vshm h'ysh 'lymlkh vshm 'shtv n'my vshm shny bnyv mchlvn vkhlyvn 'prtym mbyt lchm yhvdh vyb'v shdy mv'b vyhyv shm
verses.translation: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥מָת אֱלִימֶ֖לֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ נָעֳמִ֑י וַ/תִּשָּׁאֵ֥ר הִ֖יא וּ/שְׁנֵ֥י בָנֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vymt 'lymlkh 'ysh n'my vtsh'r hy' vshny bnyh
verses.translation: And Elimelech Naomi’s husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂא֣וּ לָ/הֶ֗ם נָשִׁים֙ מֹֽאֲבִיּ֔וֹת שֵׁ֤ם הָֽ/אַחַת֙ עָרְפָּ֔ה וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית ר֑וּת וַ/יֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָׁ֖ם כְּ/עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vysh'v lhm nshym m'byvt shm h'cht 'rph vshm hshnyt rvt vyshbv shm kh'shr shnym
verses.translation: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.

verses.original: וַ/יָּמ֥וּתוּ גַם שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם מַחְל֣וֹן וְ/כִלְי֑וֹן וַ/תִּשָּׁאֵר֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה מִ/שְּׁנֵ֥י יְלָדֶ֖י/הָ וּ/מֵ/אִישָֽׁ/הּ
verses.translit: vymvtv gm shnyhm mchlvn vkhlyvn vtsh'r h'shh mshny yldyh vm'yshh
verses.translation: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֤קָם הִיא֙ וְ/כַלֹּתֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תָּ֖שָׁב מִ/שְּׂדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֑ב כִּ֤י שָֽׁמְעָה֙ בִּ/שְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב כִּֽי פָקַ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת עַמּ֔/וֹ לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/הֶ֖ם לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vtqm hy' vkhltyh vtshb mshdy mv'b khy shm'h bshdh mv'b khy pqd yhvh 't 'mv ltt lhm lchm
verses.translation: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּצֵ֗א מִן הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיְתָה שָׁ֔מָּ/ה וּ/שְׁתֵּ֥י כַלֹּתֶ֖י/הָ עִמָּ֑/הּ וַ/תֵּלַ֣כְנָה בַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ לָ/שׁ֖וּב אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vtts' mn hmqvm 'shr hyth shmh vshty khltyh 'mh vtlkhnh bdrkh lshvb 'l 'rts yhvdh
verses.translation: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר נָעֳמִי֙ לִ/שְׁתֵּ֣י כַלֹּתֶ֔י/הָ לֵ֣כְנָה שֹּׁ֔בְנָה אִשָּׁ֖ה לְ/בֵ֣ית אִמָּ֑/הּ יעשה יַ֣עַשׂ יְהוָ֤ה עִמָּ/כֶם֙ חֶ֔סֶד כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם עִם הַ/מֵּתִ֖ים וְ/עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr n'my lshty khltyh lkhnh shbnh 'shh lbyt 'mh y'shh y'sh yhvh 'mkhm chsd kh'shr 'shytm 'm hmtym v'mdy
verses.translation: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

verses.original: יִתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם וּ/מְצֶ֣אןָ מְנוּחָ֔ה אִשָּׁ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אִישָׁ֑/הּ וַ/תִּשַּׁ֣ק לָ/הֶ֔ן וַ/תִּשֶּׂ֥אנָה קוֹלָ֖/ן וַ/תִּבְכֶּֽינָה
verses.translit: ytn yhvh lkhm vmts'n mnvchh 'shh byt 'yshh vtshq lhn vtsh'nh qvln vtbkhynh
verses.translation: The LORD grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמַ֖רְנָה לָּ֑/הּ כִּי אִתָּ֥/ךְ נָשׁ֖וּב לְ/עַמֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vt'mrnh lh khy 'tkh nshvb l'mkh
verses.translation: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר נָעֳמִי֙ שֹׁ֣בְנָה בְנֹתַ֔/י לָ֥/מָּה תֵלַ֖כְנָה עִמִּ֑/י הַֽ/עֽוֹד לִ֤/י בָנִים֙ בְּֽ/מֵעַ֔/י וְ/הָי֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם לַ/אֲנָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vt'mr n'my shbnh bnty lmh tlkhnh 'my h'vd ly bnym bm'y vhyv lkhm l'nshym
verses.translation: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

verses.original: שֹׁ֤בְנָה בְנֹתַ/י֙ לֵ֔כְןָ כִּ֥י זָקַ֖נְתִּי מִ/הְי֣וֹת לְ/אִ֑ישׁ כִּ֤י אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ יֶשׁ לִ֣/י תִקְוָ֔ה גַּ֣ם הָיִ֤יתִי הַ/לַּ֨יְלָה֙ לְ/אִ֔ישׁ וְ/גַ֖ם יָלַ֥דְתִּי בָנִֽים
verses.translit: shbnh bnty lkhn khy zqnty mhyvt l'ysh khy 'mrty ysh ly tqvh gm hyyty hlylh l'ysh vgm yldty bnym
verses.translation: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;

verses.original: הֲ/לָהֵ֣ן תְּשַׂבֵּ֗רְנָה עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִגְדָּ֔לוּ הֲ/לָהֵן֙ תֵּֽעָגֵ֔נָה לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י הֱי֣וֹת לְ/אִ֑ישׁ אַ֣ל בְּנֹתַ֗/י כִּֽי מַר לִ֤/י מְאֹד֙ מִ/כֶּ֔ם כִּֽי יָצְאָ֥ה בִ֖/י יַד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hlhn tshbrnh 'd 'shr ygdlv hlhn t'gnh lblty hyvt l'ysh 'l bnty khy mr ly m'd mkhm khy yts'h by yd yhvh
verses.translation: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשֶּׂ֣נָה קוֹלָ֔/ן וַ/תִּבְכֶּ֖ינָה ע֑וֹד וַ/תִּשַּׁ֤ק עָרְפָּה֙ לַ/חֲמוֹתָ֔/הּ וְ/ר֖וּת דָּ֥בְקָה בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtshnh qvln vtbkhynh 'vd vtshq 'rph lchmvth vrvt dbqh bh
verses.translation: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּה֙ שָׁ֣בָה יְבִמְתֵּ֔/ךְ אֶל עַמָּ֖/הּ וְ/אֶל אֱלֹהֶ֑י/הָ שׁ֖וּבִי אַחֲרֵ֥י יְבִמְתֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr hnh shbh ybmtkh 'l 'mh v'l 'lhyh shvby 'chry ybmtkh
verses.translation: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר רוּת֙ אַל תִּפְגְּעִי בִ֔/י לְ/עָזְבֵ֖/ךְ לָ/שׁ֣וּב מֵ/אַחֲרָ֑יִ/ךְ כִּ֠י אֶל אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּלְכִ֜י אֵלֵ֗ךְ וּ/בַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּלִ֨ינִי֙ אָלִ֔ין עַמֵּ֣/ךְ עַמִּ֔/י וֵ/אלֹהַ֖יִ/ךְ אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr rvt 'l tpg'y by l'zbkh lshvb m'chrykh khy 'l 'shr tlkhy 'lkh vb'shr tlyny 'lyn 'mkh 'my v'lhykh 'lhy
verses.translation: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

verses.original: בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּמ֨וּתִי֙ אָמ֔וּת וְ/שָׁ֖ם אֶקָּבֵ֑ר כֹּה֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה יְהוָ֥ה לִ/י֙ וְ/כֹ֣ה יֹסִ֔יף כִּ֣י הַ/מָּ֔וֶת יַפְרִ֖יד בֵּינִ֥/י וּ/בֵינֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: b'shr tmvty 'mvt vshm 'qbr khh y'shh yhvh ly vkhh ysyf khy hmvt ypryd byny vbynkh
verses.translation: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֕רֶא כִּֽי מִתְאַמֶּ֥צֶת הִ֖יא לָ/לֶ֣כֶת אִתָּ֑/הּ וַ/תֶּחְדַּ֖ל לְ/דַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vtr' khy mt'mtst hy' llkht 'th vtchdl ldbr 'lyh
verses.translation: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּלַ֣כְנָה שְׁתֵּי/הֶ֔ם עַד בֹּאָ֖/נָה בֵּ֣ית לָ֑חֶם וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/בֹאָ֨/נָה֙ בֵּ֣ית לֶ֔חֶם וַ/תֵּהֹ֤ם כָּל הָ/עִיר֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ן וַ/תֹּאמַ֖רְנָה הֲ/זֹ֥את נָעֳמִֽי
verses.translit: vtlkhnh shtyhm 'd b'nh byt lchm vyhy khb'nh byt lchm vthm khl h'yr 'lyhn vt'mrnh hz't n'my
verses.translation: So they two went until they came to Beth-lehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth-lehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ן אַל תִּקְרֶ֥אנָה לִ֖/י נָעֳמִ֑י קְרֶ֤אןָ לִ/י֙ מָרָ֔א כִּי הֵמַ֥ר שַׁדַּ֛י לִ֖/י מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyhn 'l tqr'nh ly n'my qr'n ly mr' khy hmr shdy ly m'd
verses.translation: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ מְלֵאָ֣ה הָלַ֔כְתִּי וְ/רֵיקָ֖ם הֱשִׁיבַ֣/נִי יְהוָ֑ה לָ֣/מָּה תִקְרֶ֤אנָה לִ/י֙ נָעֳמִ֔י וַֽ/יהוָה֙ עָ֣נָה בִ֔/י וְ/שַׁדַּ֖י הֵ֥רַֽע לִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'ny ml'h hlkhty vryqm hshybny yhvh lmh tqr'nh ly n'my vyhvh 'nh by vshdy hr' ly
verses.translation: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֣שָׁב נָעֳמִ֗י וְ/ר֨וּת הַ/מּוֹאֲבִיָּ֤ה כַלָּתָ/הּ֙ עִמָּ֔/הּ הַ/שָּׁ֖בָה מִ/שְּׂדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֑ב וְ/הֵ֗מָּה בָּ֚אוּ בֵּ֣ית לֶ֔חֶם בִּ/תְחִלַּ֖ת קְצִ֥יר שְׂעֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vtshb n'my vrvt hmv'byh khlth 'mh hshbh mshdy mv'b vhmh b'v byt lchm btchlt qtsyr sh'rym
verses.translation: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth-lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

verses.original: וּֽ/לְ/נָעֳמִ֞י מידע מוֹדַ֣ע לְ/אִישָׁ֗/הּ אִ֚ישׁ גִּבּ֣וֹר חַ֔יִל מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֖חַת אֱלִימֶ֑לֶךְ וּ/שְׁמ֖/וֹ בֹּֽעַז
verses.translit: vln'my myd' mvd' l'yshh 'ysh gbvr chyl mmshpcht 'lymlkh vshmv b'z
verses.translation: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband’s, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name was Boaz.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמֶר֩ ר֨וּת הַ/מּוֹאֲבִיָּ֜ה אֶֽל נָעֳמִ֗י אֵֽלְכָה נָּ֤א הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ וַ/אֲלַקֳטָּ֣ה בַ/שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים אַחַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶמְצָא חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖/הּ לְכִ֥י בִתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr rvt hmv'byh 'l n'my 'lkhh n' hshdh v'lqth bshblym 'chr 'shr 'mts' chn b'ynyv vt'mr lh lkhy bty
verses.translation: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤לֶךְ וַ/תָּבוֹא֙ וַ/תְּלַקֵּ֣ט בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֖י הַ/קֹּצְרִ֑ים וַ/יִּ֣קֶר מִקְרֶ֔/הָ חֶלְקַ֤ת הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ לְ/בֹ֔עַז אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֥חַת אֱלִימֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vtlkh vtbv' vtlqt bshdh 'chry hqtsrym vyqr mqrh chlqt hshdh lb'z 'shr mmshpcht 'lymlkh
verses.translation: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה בֹ֗עַז בָּ֚א מִ/בֵּ֣ית לֶ֔חֶם וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לַ/קּוֹצְרִ֖ים יְהוָ֣ה עִמָּ/כֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֥אמְרוּ ל֖/וֹ יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhnh b'z b' mbyt lchm vy'mr lqvtsrym yhvh 'mkhm vy'mrv lv ybrkhkh yhvh
verses.translation: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said unto the reapers, The LORD be with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר בֹּ֨עַז֙ לְ/נַעֲר֔/וֹ הַ/נִּצָּ֖ב עַל הַ/קּֽוֹצְרִ֑ים לְ/מִ֖י הַ/נַּעֲרָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vy'mr b'z ln'rv hntsb 'l hqvtsrym lmy hn'rh hz't
verses.translation: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗עַן הַ/נַּ֛עַר הַ/נִּצָּ֥ב עַל הַ/קּוֹצְרִ֖ים וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר נַעֲרָ֤ה מֽוֹאֲבִיָּה֙ הִ֔יא הַ/שָּׁ֥בָה עִֽם נָעֳמִ֖י מִ/שְּׂדֵ֥ה מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vy'n hn'r hntsb 'l hqvtsrym vy'mr n'rh mv'byh hy' hshbh 'm n'my mshdh mv'b
verses.translation: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר אֲלַקֳטָה נָּא֙ וְ/אָסַפְתִּ֣י בָֽ/עֳמָרִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֖י הַ/קּוֹצְרִ֑ים וַ/תָּב֣וֹא וַֽ/תַּעֲמ֗וֹד מֵ/אָ֤ז הַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ וְ/עַד עַ֔תָּה זֶ֛ה שִׁבְתָּ֥/הּ הַ/בַּ֖יִת מְעָֽט
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lqth n' v'spty b'mrym 'chry hqvtsrym vtbv' vt'mvd m'z hbqr v'd 'th zh shbth hbyt m't
verses.translation: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ בֹּ֨עַז אֶל ר֜וּת הֲ/ל֧וֹא שָׁמַ֣עַתְּ בִּתִּ֗/י אַל תֵּלְכִי֙ לִ/לְקֹט֙ בְּ/שָׂדֶ֣ה אַחֵ֔ר וְ/גַ֛ם לֹ֥א תַעֲבוּרִ֖י מִ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/כֹ֥ה תִדְבָּקִ֖י/ן עִם נַעֲרֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr b'z 'l rvt hlv' shm't bty 'l tlkhy llqt bshdh 'chr vgm l' t'bvry mzh vkhh tdbqyn 'm n'rty
verses.translation: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:

verses.original: עֵינַ֜יִ/ךְ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֤ה אֲשֶׁר יִקְצֹרוּ/ן֙ וְ/הָלַ֣כְתִּ אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֔ן הֲ/ל֥וֹא צִוִּ֛יתִי אֶת הַ/נְּעָרִ֖ים לְ/בִלְתִּ֣י נָגְעֵ֑/ךְ וְ/צָמִ֗ת וְ/הָלַכְתְּ֙ אֶל הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים וְ/שָׁתִ֕ית מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁאֲב֖וּ/ן הַ/נְּעָרִֽים
verses.translit: 'ynykh bshdh 'shr yqtsrvn vhlkht 'chryhn hlv' tsvyty 't hn'rym lblty ng'kh vtsmt vhlkht 'l hkhlym vshtyt m'shr ysh'bvn hn'rym
verses.translation: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.

verses.original: וַ/תִּפֹּל֙ עַל פָּנֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָ֑רְצָ/ה וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו מַדּוּעַ֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לְ/הַכִּירֵ֔/נִי וְ/אָּנֹכִ֖י נָכְרִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vtpl 'l pnyh vtshtchv 'rtsh vt'mr 'lyv mdv' mts'ty chn b'ynykh lhkhyrny v'nkhy nkhryh
verses.translation: Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found grace in thine eyes, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I am a stranger?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַן בֹּ֨עַז֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֔/הּ הֻגֵּ֨ד הֻגַּ֜ד לִ֗/י כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂית֙ אֶת חֲמוֹתֵ֔/ךְ אַחֲרֵ֖י מ֣וֹת אִישֵׁ֑/ךְ וַ/תַּֽעַזְבִ֞י אָּבִ֣י/ךְ וְ/אִמֵּ֗/ךְ וְ/אֶ֨רֶץ֙ מֽוֹלַדְתֵּ֔/ךְ וַ/תֵּ֣לְכִ֔י אֶל עַ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָדַ֖עַתְּ תְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם
verses.translit: vy'n b'z vy'mr lh hgd hgd ly khl 'shr 'shyt 't chmvtkh 'chry mvt 'yshkh vt'zby 'bykh v'mkh v'rts mvldtkh vtlkhy 'l 'm 'shr l' yd't tmvl shlshvm
verses.translation: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband: and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore.

verses.original: יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה פָּעֳלֵ֑/ךְ וּ/תְהִ֨י מַשְׂכֻּרְתֵּ֜/ךְ שְׁלֵמָ֗ה מֵ/עִ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר בָּ֖את לַ/חֲס֥וֹת תַּֽחַת כְּנָפָֽי/ו
verses.translit: yshlm yhvh p'lkh vthy mshkhrtkh shlmh m'm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr b't lchsvt tcht khnpyv
verses.translation: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.

verses.original: וַ֠/תֹּאמֶר אֶמְצָא חֵ֨ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֤י/ךָ אֲדֹנִ/י֙ כִּ֣י נִֽחַמְתָּ֔/נִי וְ/כִ֥י דִבַּ֖רְתָּ עַל לֵ֣ב שִׁפְחָתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אָנֹכִי֙ לֹ֣א אֶֽהְיֶ֔ה כְּ/אַחַ֖ת שִׁפְחֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vt'mr 'mts' chn b'ynykh 'dny khy nchmtny vkhy dbrt 'l lb shpchtkh v'nkhy l' 'hyh kh'cht shpchtykh
verses.translation: Then she said, Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid, though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ לָ֨/ה בֹ֜עַז לְ/עֵ֣ת הָ/אֹ֗כֶל גֹּ֤שִֽׁי הֲלֹם֙ וְ/אָכַ֣לְתְּ מִן הַ/לֶּ֔חֶם וְ/טָבַ֥לְתְּ פִּתֵּ֖/ךְ בַּ/חֹ֑מֶץ וַ/תֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ מִ/צַּ֣ד הַ/קּֽוֹצְרִ֔ים וַ/יִּצְבָּט לָ֣/הּ קָלִ֔י וַ/תֹּ֥אכַל וַ/תִּשְׂבַּ֖ע וַ/תֹּתַֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr lh b'z l't h'khl gshy hlm v'khlt mn hlchm vtblt ptkh bchmts vtshb mtsd hqvtsrym vytsbt lh qly vt'khl vtshb' vttr
verses.translation: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn , and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֖קָם לְ/לַקֵּ֑ט וַ/יְצַו֩ בֹּ֨עַז אֶת נְעָרָ֜י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֗ר גַּ֣ם בֵּ֧ין הָֽ/עֳמָרִ֛ים תְּלַקֵּ֖ט וְ/לֹ֥א תַכְלִימֽוּ/הָ
verses.translit: vtqm llqt vytsv b'z 't n'ryv l'mr gm byn h'mrym tlqt vl' tkhlymvh
verses.translation: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:

verses.original: וְ/גַ֛ם שֹׁל תָּשֹׁ֥לּוּ לָ֖/הּ מִן הַ/צְּבָתִ֑ים וַ/עֲזַבְתֶּ֥ם וְ/לִקְּטָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א תִגְעֲרוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vgm shl tshlv lh mn htsbtym v'zbtm vlqth vl' tg'rv bh
verses.translation: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not.

verses.original: וַ/תְּלַקֵּ֥ט בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה עַד הָ/עָ֑רֶב וַ/תַּחְבֹּט֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר לִקֵּ֔טָה וַ/יְהִ֖י כְּ/אֵיפָ֥ה שְׂעֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vtlqt bshdh 'd h'rb vtchbt 't 'shr lqth vyhy kh'yph sh'rym
verses.translation: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשָּׂא֙ וַ/תָּב֣וֹא הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/תֵּ֥רֶא חֲמוֹתָ֖/הּ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר לִקֵּ֑טָה וַ/תּוֹצֵא֙ וַ/תִּתֶּן לָ֔/הּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר הוֹתִ֖רָה מִ/שָּׂבְעָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtsh' vtbv' h'yr vtr' chmvth 't 'shr lqth vtvts' vttn lh 't 'shr hvtrh mshb'h
verses.translation: And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמֶר֩ לָ֨/הּ חֲמוֹתָ֜/הּ אֵיפֹ֨ה לִקַּ֤טְתְּ הַ/יּוֹם֙ וְ/אָ֣נָה עָשִׂ֔ית יְהִ֥י מַכִּירֵ֖/ךְ בָּר֑וּךְ וַ/תַּגֵּ֣ד לַ/חֲמוֹתָ֗/הּ אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָה֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר שֵׁ֤ם הָ/אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֧יתִי עִמּ֛/וֹ הַ/יּ֖וֹם בֹּֽעַז
verses.translit: vt'mr lh chmvth 'yph lqtt hyvm v'nh 'shyt yhy mkhyrkh brvkh vtgd lchmvth 't 'shr 'shth 'mv vt'mr shm h'ysh 'shr 'shyty 'mv hyvm b'z
verses.translation: And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man’s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר נָעֳמִ֜י לְ/כַלָּתָ֗/הּ בָּר֥וּךְ הוּא֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא עָזַ֣ב חַסְדּ֔/וֹ אֶת הַ/חַיִּ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מֵּתִ֑ים וַ/תֹּ֧אמֶר לָ֣/הּ נָעֳמִ֗י קָר֥וֹב לָ֨/נוּ֙ הָ/אִ֔ישׁ מִֽ/גֹּאֲלֵ֖/נוּ הֽוּא
verses.translit: vt'mr n'my lkhlth brvkh hv' lyhvh 'shr l' 'zb chsdv 't hchyym v't hmtym vt'mr lh n'my qrvb lnv h'ysh mg'lnv hv'
verses.translation: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed be he of the LORD , who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר ר֣וּת הַ/מּוֹאֲבִיָּ֑ה גַּ֣ם כִּי אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֗/י עִם הַ/נְּעָרִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר לִ/י֙ תִּדְבָּקִ֔י/ן עַ֣ד אִם כִּלּ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/קָּצִ֖יר אֲשֶׁר לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr rvt hmv'byh gm khy 'mr 'ly 'm hn'rym 'shr ly tdbqyn 'd 'm khlv 't khl hqtsyr 'shr ly
verses.translation: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר נָעֳמִ֖י אֶל ר֣וּת כַּלָּתָ֑/הּ ט֣וֹב בִּתִּ֗/י כִּ֤י תֵֽצְאִי֙ עִם נַ֣עֲרוֹתָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יִפְגְּעוּ בָ֖/ךְ בְּ/שָׂדֶ֥ה אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: vt'mr n'my 'l rvt khlth tvb bty khy tts'y 'm n'rvtyv vl' ypg'v bkh bshdh 'chr
verses.translation: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law, It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.

verses.original: וַ/תִּדְבַּ֞ק בְּ/נַעֲר֥וֹת בֹּ֨עַז֙ לְ/לַקֵּ֔ט עַד כְּל֥וֹת קְצִֽיר הַ/שְּׂעֹרִ֖ים וּ/קְצִ֣יר הַֽ/חִטִּ֑ים וַ/תֵּ֖שֶׁב אֶת חֲמוֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtdbq bn'rvt b'z llqt 'd khlvt qtsyr hsh'rym vqtsyr hchtym vtshb 't chmvth
verses.translation: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖/הּ נָעֳמִ֣י חֲמוֹתָ֑/הּ בִּתִּ֞/י הֲ/לֹ֧א אֲבַקֶּשׁ לָ֛/ךְ מָנ֖וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽיטַב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr lh n'my chmvth bty hl' 'bqsh lkh mnvch 'shr yytb lkh
verses.translation: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הֲ/לֹ֥א בֹ֨עַז֙ מֹֽדַעְתָּ֔/נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֖ית אֶת נַעֲרוֹתָ֑י/ו הִנֵּה ה֗וּא זֹרֶ֛ה אֶת גֹּ֥רֶן הַ/שְּׂעֹרִ֖ים הַ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: v'th hl' b'z md'tnv 'shr hyyt 't n'rvtyv hnh hv' zrh 't grn hsh'rym hlylh
verses.translation: And now is not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.

verses.original: וְ/רָחַ֣צְתְּ וָ/סַ֗כְתְּ וְ/שַׂ֧מְתְּ שמלת/ך שִׂמְלֹתַ֛יִ/ךְ עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ ו/ירדתי וְ/יָרַ֣דְתְּ הַ/גֹּ֑רֶן אַל תִּוָּדְעִ֣י לָ/אִ֔ישׁ עַ֥ד כַּלֹּת֖/וֹ לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל וְ/לִ/שְׁתּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vrchtst vskht vshmt shmltkh shmltykh 'lykh vyrdty vyrdt hgrn 'l tvd'y l'ysh 'd khltv l'khl vlshtvt
verses.translation: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor: but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.

verses.original: וִ/יהִ֣י בְ/שָׁכְב֗/וֹ וְ/יָדַ֨עַתְּ֙ אֶת הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁכַּב שָׁ֔ם וּ/בָ֛את וְ/גִלִּ֥ית מַרְגְּלֹתָ֖י/ו ו/שכבתי וְ/שָׁכָ֑בְתְּ וְ/הוּא֙ יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔/ךְ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעַשִֽׂי/ן
verses.translit: vyhy bshkhbv vyd't 't hmqvm 'shr yshkhb shm vb't vglyt mrgltyv vshkhbty vshkhbt vhv' ygyd lkh 't 'shr t'shyn
verses.translation: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֶ֑י/הָ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמְרִ֥י אֵלַ֖/י אֶֽעֱשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyh khl 'shr t'mry 'ly ''shh
verses.translation: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֖רֶד הַ/גֹּ֑רֶן וַ/תַּ֕עַשׂ כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוַּ֖תָּ/ה חֲמוֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtrd hgrn vt'sh khkhl 'shr tsvth chmvth
verses.translation: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אכַל בֹּ֤עַז וַ/יֵּשְׁתְּ֙ וַ/יִּיטַ֣ב לִבּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֕א לִ/שְׁכַּ֖ב בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה הָ/עֲרֵמָ֑ה וַ/תָּבֹ֣א בַ/לָּ֔ט וַ/תְּגַ֥ל מַרְגְּלֹתָ֖י/ו וַ/תִּשְׁכָּֽב
verses.translit: vy'khl b'z vysht vyytb lbv vyb' lshkhb bqtsh h'rmh vtb' blt vtgl mrgltyv vtshkhb
verses.translation: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/חֲצִ֣י הַ/לַּ֔יְלָה וַ/יֶּחֱרַ֥ד הָ/אִ֖ישׁ וַ/יִּלָּפֵ֑ת וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה אִשָּׁ֔ה שֹׁכֶ֖בֶת מַרְגְּלֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy bchtsy hlylh vychrd h'ysh vylpt vhnh 'shh shkhbt mrgltyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מִי אָ֑תּ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר אָנֹכִי֙ ר֣וּת אֲמָתֶ֔/ךָ וּ/פָרַשְׂתָּ֤ כְנָפֶ֨/ךָ֙ עַל אֲמָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ כִּ֥י גֹאֵ֖ל אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vy'mr my 't vt'mr 'nkhy rvt 'mtkh vprsht khnpkh 'l 'mtkh khy g'l 'th
verses.translation: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר בְּרוּכָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ בִּתִּ֔/י הֵיטַ֛בְתְּ חַסְדֵּ֥/ךְ הָ/אַחֲר֖וֹן מִן הָ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן לְ/בִלְתִּי לֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵי֙ הַ/בַּ֣חוּרִ֔ים אִם דַּ֖ל וְ/אִם עָשִֽׁיר
verses.translit: vy'mr brvkhh 't lyhvh bty hytbt chsdkh h'chrvn mn hr'shvn lblty lkht 'chry hbchvrym 'm dl v'm 'shyr
verses.translation: And he said, Blessed be thou of the LORD , my daughter: for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה בִּתִּ/י֙ אַל תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמְרִ֖י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּ֑/ךְ כִּ֤י יוֹדֵ֨עַ֙ כָּל שַׁ֣עַר עַמִּ֔/י כִּ֛י אֵ֥שֶׁת חַ֖יִל אָֽתְּ
verses.translit: v'th bty 'l tyr'y khl 'shr t'mry ''shh lkh khy yvd' khl sh'r 'my khy 'sht chyl 't
verses.translation: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ כִּ֣י אָמְנָ֔ם כִּ֥י אם גֹאֵ֖ל אָנֹ֑כִי וְ/גַ֛ם יֵ֥שׁ גֹּאֵ֖ל קָר֥וֹב מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: v'th khy 'mnm khy 'm g'l 'nkhy vgm ysh g'l qrvb mmny
verses.translation: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.

verses.original: לִ֣ינִי הַ/לַּ֗יְלָה וְ/הָיָ֤ה בַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ אִם יִגְאָלֵ֥/ךְ טוֹב֙ יִגְאָ֔ל וְ/אִם לֹ֨א יַחְפֹּ֧ץ לְ/גָֽאֳלֵ֛/ךְ וּ/גְאַלְתִּ֥י/ךְ אָנֹ֖כִי חַי יְהוָ֑ה שִׁכְבִ֖י עַד הַ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: lyny hlylh vhyh bbqr 'm yg'lkh tvb yg'l v'm l' ychpts lg'lkh vg'ltykh 'nkhy chy yhvh shkhby 'd hbqr
verses.translation: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman’s part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as the LORD liveth: lie down until the morning.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מרגלת/ו מַרְגְּלוֹתָי/וֹ֙ עַד הַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/תָּ֕קָם ב/טרום בְּ/טֶ֛רֶם יַכִּ֥יר אִ֖ישׁ אֶת רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַל יִוָּדַ֔ע כִּי בָ֥אָה הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה הַ/גֹּֽרֶן
verses.translit: vtshkhb mrgltv mrglvtyv 'd hbqr vtqm btrvm btrm ykhyr 'ysh 't r'hv vy'mr 'l yvd' khy b'h h'shh hgrn
verses.translation: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הָ֠בִי הַ/מִּטְפַּ֧חַת אֲשֶׁר עָלַ֛יִ/ךְ וְ/אֶֽחֳזִי בָ֖/הּ וַ/תֹּ֣אחֶז בָּ֑/הּ וַ/יָּ֤מָד שֵׁשׁ שְׂעֹרִים֙ וַ/יָּ֣שֶׁת עָלֶ֔י/הָ וַ/יָּבֹ֖א הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vy'mr hby hmtpcht 'shr 'lykh v'chzy bh vt'chz bh vymd shsh sh'rym vysht 'lyh vyb' h'yr
verses.translation: Also he said, Bring the vail that thou hast upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her: and she went into the city.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבוֹא֙ אֶל חֲמוֹתָ֔/הּ וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר מִי אַ֣תְּ בִּתִּ֑/י וַ/תַּ֨גֶּד לָ֔/הּ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָֽשָׂה לָ֖/הּ הָ/אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vtbv' 'l chmvth vt'mr my 't bty vtgd lh 't khl 'shr 'shh lh h'ysh
verses.translation: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר שֵׁשׁ הַ/שְּׂעֹרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה נָ֣תַן לִ֑/י כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔/י אַל תָּב֥וֹאִי רֵיקָ֖ם אֶל חֲמוֹתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr shsh hsh'rym h'lh ntn ly khy 'mr 'ly 'l tbv'y ryqm 'l chmvtkh
verses.translation: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ שְׁבִ֣י בִתִּ֔/י עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽדְעִ֔י/ן אֵ֖יךְ יִפֹּ֣ל דָּבָ֑ר כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִשְׁקֹט֙ הָ/אִ֔ישׁ כִּֽי אִם כִּלָּ֥ה הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vt'mr shby bty 'd 'shr td'yn 'ykh ypl dbr khy l' yshqt h'ysh khy 'm khlh hdbr hyvm
verses.translation: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.

verses.original: וּ/בֹ֨עַז עָלָ֣ה הַ/שַּׁעַר֮ וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב שָׁם֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה הַ/גֹּאֵ֤ל עֹבֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר בֹּ֔עַז וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר ס֥וּרָ/ה שְׁבָ/ה פֹּ֖ה פְּלֹנִ֣י אַלְמֹנִ֑י וַ/יָּ֖סַר וַ/יֵּשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: vb'z 'lh hsh'r vyshb shm vhnh hg'l 'br 'shr dbr b'z vy'mr svrh shbh ph plny 'lmny vysr vyshb
verses.translation: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח עֲשָׂרָ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מִ/זִּקְנֵ֥י הָ/עִ֖יר וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁבוּ פֹ֑ה וַ/יֵּשֵֽׁבוּ
verses.translit: vyqch 'shrh 'nshym mzqny h'yr vy'mr shbv ph vyshbv
verses.translation: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לַ/גֹּאֵ֔ל חֶלְקַת֙ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/אָחִ֖י/נוּ לֶ/אֱלִימֶ֑לֶךְ מָכְרָ֣ה נָעֳמִ֔י הַ/שָּׁ֖בָה מִ/שְּׂדֵ֥ה מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr lg'l chlqt hshdh 'shr l'chynv l'lymlkh mkhrh n'my hshbh mshdh mv'b
verses.translation: And he said unto the kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s:

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֨י אָמַ֜רְתִּי אֶגְלֶ֧ה אָזְנְ/ךָ֣ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר קְ֠נֵה נֶ֥גֶד הַֽ/יֹּשְׁבִים֮ וְ/נֶ֣גֶד זִקְנֵ֣י עַמִּ/י֒ אִם תִּגְאַל֙ גְּאָ֔ל וְ/אִם לֹ֨א יִגְאַ֜ל הַגִּ֣ידָ/ה לִּ֗/י ו/אדע וְ/אֵֽדְעָה֙ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין זוּלָֽתְ/ךָ֙ לִ/גְא֔וֹל וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י אַחֲרֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אָנֹכִ֥י אֶגְאָֽל
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty 'glh 'znkh l'mr qnh ngd hyshbym vngd zqny 'my 'm tg'l g'l v'm l' yg'l hgydh ly v'd' v'd'h khy 'yn zvltkh lg'vl v'nkhy 'chrykh vy'mr 'nkhy 'g'l
verses.translation: And I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it , redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר בֹּ֔עַז בְּ/יוֹם קְנוֹתְ/ךָ֥ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה מִ/יַּ֣ד נָעֳמִ֑י וּ֠/מֵ/אֵת ר֣וּת הַ/מּוֹאֲבִיָּ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת הַ/מֵּת֙ קניתי קָנִ֔יתָה לְ/הָקִ֥ים שֵׁם הַ/מֵּ֖ת עַל נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr b'z byvm qnvtkh hshdh myd n'my vm't rvt hmv'byh 'sht hmt qnyty qnyth lhqym shm hmt 'l nchltv
verses.translation: Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/גֹּאֵ֗ל לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ ל/גאול לִ/גְאָל לִ֔/י פֶּן אַשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת נַחֲלָתִ֑/י גְּאַל לְ/ךָ֤ אַתָּה֙ אֶת גְּאֻלָּתִ֔/י כִּ֥י לֹא אוּכַ֖ל לִ/גְאֹֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr hg'l l' 'vkhl lg'vl lg'l ly pn 'shchyt 't nchlty g'l lkh 'th 't g'lty khy l' 'vkhl lg'l
verses.translation: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it .

verses.original: וְ/זֹאת֩ לְ/פָנִ֨ים בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל עַל הַ/גְּאוּלָּ֤ה וְ/עַל הַ/תְּמוּרָה֙ לְ/קַיֵּ֣ם כָּל דָּבָ֔ר שָׁלַ֥ף אִ֛ישׁ נַעֲל֖/וֹ וְ/נָתַ֣ן לְ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/זֹ֥את הַ/תְּעוּדָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vz't lpnym byshr'l 'l hg'vlh v'l htmvrh lqym khl dbr shlf 'ysh n'lv vntn lr'hv vz't ht'vdh byshr'l
verses.translation: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר הַ/גֹּאֵ֛ל לְ/בֹ֖עַז קְנֵה לָ֑/ךְ וַ/יִּשְׁלֹ֖ף נַעֲלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr hg'l lb'z qnh lkh vyshlf n'lv
verses.translation: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ בֹּ֨עַז לַ/זְּקֵנִ֜ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֗ם עֵדִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם כִּ֤י קָנִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֶֽ/אֱלִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/כִלְי֖וֹן וּ/מַחְל֑וֹן מִ/יַּ֖ד נָעֳמִֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr b'z lzqnym vkhl h'm 'dym 'tm hyvm khy qnyty 't khl 'shr l'lymlkh v't khl 'shr lkhlyvn vmchlvn myd n'my
verses.translation: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech’s, and all that was Chilion’s and Mahlon’s, of the hand of Naomi.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אֶת ר֣וּת הַ/מֹּאֲבִיָּה֩ אֵ֨שֶׁת מַחְל֜וֹן קָנִ֧יתִי לִ֣/י לְ/אִשָּׁ֗ה לְ/הָקִ֤ים שֵׁם הַ/מֵּת֙ עַל נַ֣חֲלָת֔/וֹ וְ/לֹא יִכָּרֵ֧ת שֵׁם הַ/מֵּ֛ת מֵ/עִ֥ם אֶחָ֖י/ו וּ/מִ/שַּׁ֣עַר מְקוֹמ֑/וֹ עֵדִ֥ים אַתֶּ֖ם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vgm 't rvt hm'byh 'sht mchlvn qnyty ly l'shh lhqym shm hmt 'l nchltv vl' ykhrt shm hmt m'm 'chyv vmsh'r mqvmv 'dym 'tm hyvm
verses.translation: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ כָּל הָ/עָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר בַּ/שַּׁ֛עַר וְ/הַ/זְּקֵנִ֖ים עֵדִ֑ים יִתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶֽת הָ/אִשָּׁ֜ה הַ/בָּאָ֣ה אֶל בֵּיתֶ֗/ךָ כְּ/רָחֵ֤ל וּ/כְ/לֵאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנ֤וּ שְׁתֵּי/הֶם֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/עֲשֵׂה חַ֣יִל בְּ/אֶפְרָ֔תָה וּ/קְרָא שֵׁ֖ם בְּ/בֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vy'mrv khl h'm 'shr bsh'r vhzqnym 'dym ytn yhvh 't h'shh hb'h 'l bytkh khrchl vkhl'h 'shr bnv shtyhm 't byt yshr'l v'shh chyl b'prth vqr' shm bbyt lchm
verses.translation: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. The LORD make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Beth-lehem:

verses.original: וִ/יהִ֤י בֵֽיתְ/ךָ֙ כְּ/בֵ֣ית פֶּ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָ֥ה תָמָ֖ר לִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה מִן הַ/זֶּ֗רַע אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְ/ךָ֔ מִן הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vyhy bytkh khbyt prts 'shr yldh tmr lyhvdh mn hzr' 'shr ytn yhvh lkh mn hn'rh hz't
verses.translation: And let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give thee of this young woman.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח בֹּ֤עַז אֶת רוּת֙ וַ/תְּהִי ל֣/וֹ לְ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה לָ֛/הּ הֵרָי֖וֹן וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyqch b'z 't rvt vthy lv l'shh vyb' 'lyh vytn yhvh lh hryvn vtld bn
verses.translation: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמַ֤רְנָה הַ/נָּשִׁים֙ אֶֽל נָעֳמִ֔י בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א הִשְׁבִּ֥ית לָ֛/ךְ גֹּאֵ֖ל הַ/יּ֑וֹם וְ/יִקָּרֵ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vt'mrnh hnshym 'l n'my brvkh yhvh 'shr l' hshbyt lkh g'l hyvm vyqr' shmv byshr'l
verses.translation: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD , which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֤יָה לָ/ךְ֙ לְ/מֵשִׁ֣יב נֶ֔פֶשׁ וּ/לְ/כַלְכֵּ֖ל אֶת שֵׂיבָתֵ֑/ךְ כִּ֣י כַלָּתֵ֤/ךְ אֲֽשֶׁר אֲהֵבַ֨תֶ/ךְ֙ יְלָדַ֔תּ/וּ אֲשֶׁר הִיא֙ ט֣וֹבָה לָ֔/ךְ מִ/שִּׁבְעָ֖ה בָּנִֽים
verses.translit: vhyh lkh lmshyb npsh vlkhlkhl 't shybtkh khy khltkh 'shr 'hbtkh yldtv 'shr hy' tvbh lkh mshb'h bnym
verses.translation: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֨ח נָעֳמִ֤י אֶת הַ/יֶּ֨לֶד֙ וַ/תְּשִׁתֵ֣/הוּ בְ/חֵיקָ֔/הּ וַ/תְּהִי ל֖/וֹ לְ/אֹמֶֽנֶת
verses.translit: vtqch n'my 't hyld vtshthv bchyqh vthy lv l'mnt
verses.translation: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרֶאנָה֩ ל֨/וֹ הַ/שְּׁכֵנ֥וֹת שֵׁם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יֻלַּד בֵּ֖ן לְ/נָעֳמִ֑י וַ/תִּקְרֶ֤אנָֽה שְׁמ/וֹ֙ עוֹבֵ֔ד ה֥וּא אֲבִי יִשַׁ֖י אֲבִ֥י דָוִֽד
verses.translit: vtqr'nh lv hshkhnvt shm l'mr yld bn ln'my vtqr'nh shmv 'vbd hv' 'by yshy 'by dvd
verses.translation: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְד֣וֹת פָּ֔רֶץ פֶּ֖רֶץ הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת חֶצְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'lh tvldvt prts prts hvlyd 't chtsrvn
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,

verses.original: וְ/חֶצְרוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת רָ֔ם וְ/רָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת עַמִּֽינָדָֽב
verses.translit: vchtsrvn hvlyd 't rm vrm hvlyd 't 'myndb
