verses.translation: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay; but we will have a king over us;

verses.original: וְ/הָיִ֥ינוּ גַם אֲנַ֖חְנוּ כְּ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וּ/שְׁפָטָ֤/נוּ מַלְכֵּ֨/נוּ֙ וְ/יָצָ֣א לְ/פָנֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/נִלְחַ֖ם אֶת מִלְחֲמֹתֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vhyynv gm 'nchnv khkhl hgvym vshptnv mlkhnv vyts' lpnynv vnlchm 't mlchmtnv
verses.translation: That we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם וַֽ/יְדַבְּרֵ֖/ם בְּ/אָזְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' shmv'l 't khl dbry h'm vydbrm b'zny yhvh
verses.translation: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל שְׁמוּאֵל֙ שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ/קוֹלָ֔/ם וְ/הִמְלַכְתָּ֥ לָ/הֶ֖ם מֶ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל אַנְשֵׁ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לְ/עִירֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l shmv'l shm' bqvlm vhmlkht lhm mlkh vy'mr shmv'l 'l 'nshy yshr'l lkhv 'ysh l'yrv
verses.translation: And the LORD said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי אִ֣ישׁ מ/בן ימין מִ/בִּנְיָמִ֗ין וּ֠/שְׁמ/וֹ קִ֣ישׁ בֶּן אֲבִיאֵ֞ל בֶּן צְר֧וֹר בֶּן בְּכוֹרַ֛ת בֶּן אֲפִ֖יחַ בֶּן אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינִ֑י גִּבּ֖וֹר חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vyhy 'ysh mbn ymyn mbnymyn vshmv qysh bn 'by'l bn tsrvr bn bkhvrt bn 'pych bn 'ysh ymyny gbvr chyl
verses.translation: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.

verses.original: וְ/ל/וֹ הָיָ֨ה בֵ֜ן וּ/שְׁמ֤/וֹ שָׁאוּל֙ בָּח֣וּר וָ/ט֔וֹב וְ/אֵ֥ין אִ֛ישׁ מִ/בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ט֣וֹב מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ מִ/שִּׁכְמ֣/וֹ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה גָּבֹ֖הַּ מִ/כָּל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vlv hyh bn vshmv sh'vl bchvr vtvb v'yn 'ysh mbny yshr'l tvb mmnv mshkhmv vm'lh gbh mkhl h'm
verses.translation: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאבַ֨דְנָה֙ הָ/אֲתֹנ֔וֹת לְ/קִ֖ישׁ אֲבִ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר קִ֜ישׁ אֶל שָׁא֣וּל בְּנ֗/וֹ קַח נָ֤א אִתְּ/ךָ֙ אֶת אַחַ֣ד מֵֽ/הַ/נְּעָרִ֔ים וְ/ק֣וּם לֵ֔ךְ בַּקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת הָ/אֲתֹנֹֽת
verses.translit: vt'bdnh h'tnvt lqysh 'by sh'vl vy'mr qysh 'l sh'vl bnv qch n' 'tkh 't 'chd mhn'rym vqvm lkh bqsh 't h'tnt
verses.translation: And the asses of Kish Saul’s father were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the asses.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֧ר בְּ/הַר אֶפְרַ֛יִם וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֥ר בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ שָׁלִ֖שָׁה וְ/לֹ֣א מָצָ֑אוּ וַ/יַּעַבְר֤וּ בְ/אֶֽרֶץ שַׁעֲלִים֙ וָ/אַ֔יִן וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֥ר בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ יְמִינִ֖י וְ/לֹ֥א מָצָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vy'br bhr 'prym vy'br b'rts shlshh vl' mts'v vy'brv b'rts sh'lym v'yn vy'br b'rts ymyny vl' mts'v
verses.translation: And he passed through mount Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalisha, but they found them not: then they passed through the land of Shalim, and there they were not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found them not.

verses.original: הֵ֗מָּה בָּ֚אוּ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ צ֔וּף וְ/שָׁא֥וּל אָמַ֛ר לְ/נַעֲר֥/וֹ אֲשֶׁר עִמּ֖/וֹ לְכָ֣/ה וְ/נָשׁ֑וּבָה פֶּן יֶחְדַּ֥ל אָבִ֛/י מִן הָ/אֲתֹנ֖וֹת וְ/דָ֥אַג לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: hmh b'v b'rts tsvf vsh'vl 'mr ln'rv 'shr 'mv lkhh vnshvbh pn ychdl 'by mn h'tnvt vd'g lnv
verses.translation: And when they were come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant that was with him, Come, and let us return; lest my father leave caring for the asses, and take thought for us.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ הִנֵּה נָ֤א אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים֙ בָּ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/הָ/אִ֣ישׁ נִכְבָּ֔ד כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּ֖ר בּ֣וֹא יָב֑וֹא עַתָּה֙ נֵ֣לֲכָה שָּׁ֔ם אוּלַי֙ יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔/נוּ אֶת דַּרְכֵּ֖/נוּ אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֥כְנוּ עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv hnh n' 'ysh 'lhym b'yr hz't vh'ysh nkhbd khl 'shr ydbr bv' ybv' 'th nlkhh shm 'vly ygyd lnv 't drkhnv 'shr hlkhnv 'lyh
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Behold now, there is in this city a man of God, and he is an honourable man; all that he saith cometh surely to pass: now let us go thither; peradventure he can shew us our way that we should go.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל לְ/נַעֲר֗/וֹ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה נֵלֵךְ֮ וּ/מַה נָּבִ֣יא לָ/אִישׁ֒ כִּ֤י הַ/לֶּ֨חֶם֙ אָזַ֣ל מִ/כֵּלֵ֔י/נוּ וּ/תְשׁוּרָ֥ה אֵין לְ/הָבִ֖יא לְ/אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים מָ֖ה אִתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl ln'rv vhnh nlkh vmh nby' l'ysh khy hlchm 'zl mkhlynv vtshvrh 'yn lhby' l'ysh h'lhym mh 'tnv
verses.translation: Then said Saul to his servant, But, behold, if we go, what shall we bring the man? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God: what have we?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤סֶף הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ לַ/עֲנ֣וֹת אֶת שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה֙ נִמְצָ֣א בְ/יָדִ֔/י רֶ֖בַע שֶׁ֣קֶל כָּ֑סֶף וְ/נָֽתַתִּי֙ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/הִגִּ֥יד לָ֖/נוּ אֶת דַּרְכֵּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vysf hn'r l'nvt 't sh'vl vy'mr hnh nmts' bydy rb' shql khsf vntty l'ysh h'lhym vhgyd lnv 't drkhnv
verses.translation: And the servant answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have here at hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver: that will I give to the man of God, to tell us our way.

verses.original: לְ/פָנִ֣ים בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר הָ/אִישׁ֙ בְּ/לֶכְתּ/וֹ֙ לִ/דְר֣וֹשׁ אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְכ֥וּ וְ/נֵלְכָ֖ה עַד הָ/רֹאֶ֑ה כִּ֤י לַ/נָּבִיא֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם יִקָּרֵ֥א לְ/פָנִ֖ים הָ/רֹאֶֽה
verses.translit: lpnym byshr'l khh 'mr h'ysh blkhtv ldrvsh 'lhym lkhv vnlkhh 'd hr'h khy lnby' hyvm yqr' lpnym hr'h
verses.translation: (Beforetime in Israel, when a man went to enquire of God, thus he spake, Come, and let us go to the seer: for he that is now called a Prophet was beforetime called a Seer.)

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֧וּל לְ/נַעֲר֛/וֹ ט֥וֹב דְּבָרְ/ךָ֖ לְכָ֣/ה נֵלֵ֑כָה וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל הָ/עִ֔יר אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl ln'rv tvb dbrkh lkhh nlkhh vylkhv 'l h'yr 'shr shm 'ysh h'lhym
verses.translation: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went unto the city where the man of God was .

verses.original: הֵ֗מָּה עֹלִים֙ בְּ/מַעֲלֵ֣ה הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ מָצְא֣וּ נְעָר֔וֹת יֹצְא֖וֹת לִ/שְׁאֹ֣ב מָ֑יִם וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ/הֶ֔ן הֲ/יֵ֥שׁ בָּ/זֶ֖ה הָ/רֹאֶֽה
verses.translit: hmh 'lym bm'lh h'yr vhmh mts'v n'rvt yts'vt lsh'b mym vy'mrv lhn hysh bzh hr'h
verses.translation: And as they went up the hill to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said unto them, Is the seer here?

verses.original: וַ/תַּעֲנֶ֧ינָה אוֹתָ֛/ם וַ/תֹּאמַ֥רְנָה יֵּ֖שׁ הִנֵּ֣ה לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ מַהֵ֣ר עַתָּ֗ה כִּ֤י הַ/יּוֹם֙ בָּ֣א לָ/עִ֔יר כִּ֣י זֶ֧בַח הַ/יּ֛וֹם לָ/עָ֖ם בַּ/בָּמָֽה
verses.translit: vt'nynh 'vtm vt'mrnh ysh hnh lpnykh mhr 'th khy hyvm b' l'yr khy zbch hyvm l'm bbmh
verses.translation: And they answered them, and said, He is; behold, he is before you: make haste now, for he came to day to the city; for there is a sacrifice of the people to day in the high place:

verses.original: כְּ/בֹאֲ/כֶ֣ם הָ/עִ֣יר כֵּ֣ן תִּמְצְא֣וּ/ן אֹת֡/וֹ בְּ/טֶרֶם֩ יַעֲלֶ֨ה הַ/בָּמָ֜תָ/ה לֶ/אֱכֹ֗ל כִּ֠י לֹֽא יֹאכַ֤ל הָ/עָם֙ עַד בֹּא֔/וֹ כִּֽי הוּא֙ יְבָרֵ֣ךְ הַ/זֶּ֔בַח אַחֲרֵי כֵ֖ן יֹאכְל֣וּ הַ/קְּרֻאִ֑ים וְ/עַתָּ֣ה עֲל֔וּ כִּֽי אֹת֥/וֹ כְ/הַ/יּ֖וֹם תִּמְצְא֥וּ/ן אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khb'khm h'yr khn tmts'vn 'tv btrm y'lh hbmth l'khl khy l' y'khl h'm 'd b'v khy hv' ybrkh hzbch 'chry khn y'khlv hqr'ym v'th 'lv khy 'tv khhyvm tmts'vn 'tv
verses.translation: As soon as ye be come into the city, ye shall straightway find him, before he go up to the high place to eat: for the people will not eat until he come, because he doth bless the sacrifice; and afterwards they eat that be bidden. Now therefore get you up; for about this time ye shall find him.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲל֖וּ הָ/עִ֑יר הֵ֗מָּה בָּאִים֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה שְׁמוּאֵל֙ יֹצֵ֣א לִ/קְרָאתָ֔/ם לַ/עֲל֖וֹת הַ/בָּמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'lv h'yr hmh b'ym btvkh h'yr vhnh shmv'l yts' lqr'tm l'lvt hbmh
verses.translation: And they went up into the city: and when they were come into the city, behold, Samuel came out against them, for to go up to the high place.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֔ה גָּלָ֖ה אֶת אֹ֣זֶן שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י בֽוֹא שָׁא֖וּל לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhvh glh 't 'zn shmv'l yvm 'chd lpny bv' sh'vl l'mr
verses.translation: Now the LORD had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, saying,

verses.original: כָּ/עֵ֣ת מָחָ֡ר אֶשְׁלַח֩ אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ אִ֜ישׁ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וּ/מְשַׁחְתּ֤/וֹ לְ/נָגִיד֙ עַל עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת עַמִּ֖/י מִ/יַּ֣ד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים כִּ֤י רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י כִּ֛י בָּ֥אָה צַעֲקָת֖/וֹ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: kh't mchr 'shlch 'lykh 'ysh m'rts bnymn vmshchtv lngyd 'l 'my yshr'l vhvshy' 't 'my myd plshtym khy r'yty 't 'my khy b'h ts'qtv 'ly
verses.translation: To morrow about this time I will send thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him to be captain over my people Israel, that he may save my people out of the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked upon my people, because their cry is come unto me.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל רָאָ֣ה אֶת שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יהוָ֣ה עָנָ֔/הוּ הִנֵּ֤ה הָ/אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ זֶ֖ה יַעְצֹ֥ר בְּ/עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vshmv'l r'h 't sh'vl vyhvh 'nhv hnh h'ysh 'shr 'mrty 'lykh zh y'tsr b'my
verses.translation: And when Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said unto him, Behold the man whom I spake to thee of! this same shall reign over my people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֥שׁ שָׁא֛וּל אֶת שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/שָּׁ֑עַר וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַגִּֽידָ/ה נָּ֣א לִ֔/י אֵי זֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ית הָ/רֹאֶֽה
verses.translit: vygsh sh'vl 't shmv'l btvkh hsh'r vy'mr hgydh n' ly 'y zh byt hr'h
verses.translation: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer’s house is .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶת שָׁא֗וּל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אָנֹכִ֣י הָ/רֹאֶ֔ה עֲלֵ֤ה לְ/פָנַ/י֙ הַ/בָּמָ֔ה וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖/י הַ/יּ֑וֹם וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּ֣י/ךָ בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ אַגִּ֥יד לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'n shmv'l 't sh'vl vy'mr 'nkhy hr'h 'lh lpny hbmh v'khltm 'my hyvm vshlchtykh bbqr vkhl 'shr blbbkh 'gyd lkh
verses.translation: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I am the seer: go up before me unto the high place; for ye shall eat with me to day, and to morrow I will let thee go, and will tell thee all that is in thine heart.

verses.original: וְ/לָ/אֲתֹנ֞וֹת הָ/אֹבְד֣וֹת לְ/ךָ֗ הַ/יּוֹם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַ/יָּמִ֔ים אַל תָּ֧שֶׂם אֶֽת לִבְּ/ךָ֛ לָ/הֶ֖ם כִּ֣י נִמְצָ֑אוּ וּ/לְ/מִי֙ כָּל חֶמְדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲ/ל֣וֹא לְ/ךָ֔ וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vl'tnvt h'bdvt lkh hyvm shlsht hymym 'l tshm 't lbkh lhm khy nmts'v vlmy khl chmdt yshr'l hlv' lkh vlkhl byt 'bykh
verses.translation: And as for thine asses that were lost three days ago, set not thy mind on them; for they are found. And on whom is all the desire of Israel? Is it not on thee, and on all thy father’s house?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן שָׁא֜וּל וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הֲ/ל֨וֹא בֶן יְמִינִ֤י אָ֨נֹכִי֙ מִ/קַּטַנֵּי֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ/י֙ הַ/צְּעִרָ֔ה מִ/כָּֽל מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת שִׁבְטֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וְ/לָ֨/מָּה֙ דִּבַּ֣רְתָּ אֵלַ֔/י כַּ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'n sh'vl vy'mr hlv' bn ymyny 'nkhy mqtny shbty yshr'l vmshpchty hts'rh mkhl mshpchvt shbty bnymn vlmh dbrt 'ly khdbr hzh
verses.translation: And Saul answered and said, Am not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? wherefore then speakest thou so to me?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת שָׁא֣וּל וְ/אֶֽת נַעֲר֔/וֹ וַ/יְבִיאֵ֖/ם לִשְׁכָּ֑תָ/ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן לָ/הֶ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/קְּרוּאִ֔ים וְ/הֵ֖מָּה כִּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vyqch shmv'l 't sh'vl v't n'rv vyby'm lshkhth vytn lhm mqvm br'sh hqrv'ym vhmh khshlshym 'ysh
verses.translation: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the parlour, and made them sit in the chiefest place among them that were bidden, which were about thirty persons.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ לַ/טַּבָּ֔ח תְּנָ/ה֙ אֶת הַ/מָּנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָ֑/ךְ אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ שִׂ֥ים אֹתָ֖/הּ עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l ltbch tnh 't hmnh 'shr ntty lkh 'shr 'mrty 'lykh shym 'th 'mkh
verses.translation: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣רֶם הַ֠/טַּבָּח אֶת הַ/שּׁ֨וֹק וְ/הֶ/עָלֶ֜י/הָ וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם לִ/פְנֵ֣י שָׁא֗וּל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/נִּשְׁאָר֙ שִׂים לְ/פָנֶ֣י/ךָ אֱכֹ֔ל כִּ֧י לַ/מּוֹעֵ֛ד שָֽׁמוּר לְ/ךָ֥ לֵ/אמֹ֖ר הָ/עָ֣ם קָרָ֑אתִי וַ/יֹּ֧אכַל שָׁא֛וּל עִם שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyrm htbch 't hshvq vh'lyh vyshm lpny sh'vl vy'mr hnh hnsh'r shym lpnykh 'khl khy lmv'd shmvr lkh l'mr h'm qr'ty vy'khl sh'vl 'm shmv'l byvm hhv'
verses.translation: And the cook took up the shoulder, and that which was upon it, and set it before Saul. And Samuel said, Behold that which is left! set it before thee, and eat: for unto this time hath it been kept for thee since I said, I have invited the people. So Saul did eat with Samuel that day.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרְד֥וּ מֵ/הַ/בָּמָ֖ה הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר עִם שָׁא֖וּל עַל הַ/גָּֽג
verses.translit: vyrdv mhbmh h'yr vydbr 'm sh'vl 'l hgg
verses.translation: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, Samuel communed with Saul upon the top of the house.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֗מוּ וַ/יְהִ֞י כַּ/עֲל֤וֹת הַ/שַּׁ֨חַר֙ וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל שָׁאוּל֙ ה/גג הַ/גָּ֣גָ/ה לֵ/אמֹ֔ר ק֖וּמָ/ה וַ/אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֑/ךָּ וַ/יָּ֣קָם שָׁא֗וּל וַ/יֵּצְא֧וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֛ם ה֥וּא וּ/שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הַ/חֽוּצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshkhmv vyhy kh'lvt hshchr vyqr' shmv'l 'l sh'vl hgg hggh l'mr qvmh v'shlchkh vyqm sh'vl vyts'v shnyhm hv' vshmv'l hchvtsh
verses.translation: And they arose early: and it came to pass about the spring of the day, that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Up, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.

verses.original: הֵ֗מָּה יֽוֹרְדִים֙ בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה הָ/עִ֔יר וּ/שְׁמוּאֵ֞ל אָמַ֣ר אֶל שָׁא֗וּל אֱמֹ֥ר לַ/נַּ֛עַר וְ/יַעֲבֹ֥ר לְ/פָנֵ֖י/נוּ וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֑ר וְ/אַתָּה֙ עֲמֹ֣ד כַּ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/אַשְׁמִיעֲ/ךָ֖ אֶת דְּבַ֥ר אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: hmh yvrdym bqtsh h'yr vshmv'l 'mr 'l sh'vl 'mr ln'r vy'br lpnynv vy'br v'th 'md khyvm v'shmy'kh 't dbr 'lhym
verses.translation: And as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on,) but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶת פַּ֥ךְ הַ/שֶּׁ֛מֶן וַ/יִּצֹ֥ק עַל רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ וַ/יִּשָּׁקֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הֲ/ל֗וֹא כִּֽי מְשָׁחֲ/ךָ֧ יְהוָ֛ה עַל נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ לְ/נָגִֽיד
verses.translit: vyqch shmv'l 't pkh hshmn vytsq 'l r'shv vyshqhv vy'mr hlv' khy mshchkh yhvh 'l nchltv lngyd
verses.translation: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?

verses.original: בְּ/לֶכְתְּ/ךָ֤ הַ/יּוֹם֙ מֵ/עִמָּדִ֔/י וּ/מָצָאתָ֩ שְׁנֵ֨י אֲנָשִׁ֜ים עִם קְבֻרַ֥ת רָחֵ֛ל בִּ/גְב֥וּל בִּנְיָמִ֖ן בְּ/צֶלְצַ֑ח וְ/אָמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ נִמְצְא֤וּ הָ/אֲתֹנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֣כְתָּ לְ/בַקֵּ֔שׁ וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה נָטַ֤שׁ אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י הָ/אֲתֹנ֔וֹת וְ/דָאַ֤ג לָ/כֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לִ/בְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: blkhtkh hyvm m'mdy vmts't shny 'nshym 'm qbrt rchl bgbvl bnymn btsltsch v'mrv 'lykh nmts'v h'tnvt 'shr hlkht lbqsh vhnh ntsh 'bykh 't dbry h'tnvt vd'g lkhm l'mr mh ''shh lbny
verses.translation: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel’s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?

verses.original: וְ/חָלַפְתָּ֨ מִ/שָּׁ֜ם וָ/הָ֗לְאָה וּ/בָ֨אתָ֙ עַד אֵל֣וֹן תָּב֔וֹר וּ/מְצָא֤וּ/ךָ שָּׁם֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים עֹלִ֥ים אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל אֶחָ֞ד נֹשֵׂ֣א שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְדָיִ֗ים וְ/אֶחָד֙ נֹשֵׂ֗א שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת֙ כִּכְּר֣וֹת לֶ֔חֶם וְ/אֶחָ֥ד נֹשֵׂ֖א נֵֽבֶל יָֽיִן
verses.translit: vchlpt mshm vhl'h vb't 'd 'lvn tbvr vmts'vkh shm shlshh 'nshym 'lym 'l h'lhym byt 'l 'chd nsh' shlshh gdyym v'chd nsh' shlsht khkhrvt lchm v'chd nsh' nbl yyn
verses.translation: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Beth-el, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁאֲל֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/שָׁל֑וֹם וְ/נָתְנ֤וּ לְ/ךָ֙ שְׁתֵּי לֶ֔חֶם וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֖ מִ/יָּדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vsh'lv lkh lshlvm vntnv lkh shty lchm vlqcht mydm
verses.translation: And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.

verses.original: אַ֣חַר כֵּ֗ן תָּבוֹא֙ גִּבְעַ֣ת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֖ם נְצִבֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וִ/יהִי֩ כְ/בֹאֲ/ךָ֨ שָׁ֜ם הָ/עִ֗יר וּ/פָגַעְתָּ֞ חֶ֤בֶל נְבִיאִים֙ יֹרְדִ֣ים מֵֽ/הַ/בָּמָ֔ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֞ם נֵ֤בֶל וְ/תֹף֙ וְ/חָלִ֣יל וְ/כִנּ֔וֹר וְ/הֵ֖מָּה מִֽתְנַבְּאִֽים
verses.translit: 'chr khn tbv' gb't h'lhym 'shr shm ntsby plshtym vyhy khb'kh shm h'yr vpg't chbl nby'ym yrdym mhbmh vlpnyhm nbl vtf vchlyl vkhnvr vhmh mtnb'ym
verses.translation: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:

verses.original: וְ/צָלְחָ֤ה עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הִתְנַבִּ֖יתָ עִמָּ֑/ם וְ/נֶהְפַּכְתָּ֖ לְ/אִ֥ישׁ אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: vtslchh 'lykh rvch yhvh vhtnbyt 'mm vnhpkht l'ysh 'chr
verses.translation: And the Spirit of the LORD will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּ֥י תבאינה תָבֹ֛אנָה הָ/אֹת֥וֹת הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑/ךְ עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּמְצָ֣א יָדֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֥י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhyh khy tb'ynh tb'nh h'tvt h'lh lkh 'shh lkh 'shr tmts' ydkh khy h'lhym 'mkh
verses.translation: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee.

verses.original: וְ/יָרַדְתָּ֣ לְ/פָנַ/י֮ הַ/גִּלְגָּל֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ יֹרֵ֣ד אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/הַעֲל֣וֹת עֹל֔וֹת לִ/זְבֹּ֖חַ זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֑ים שִׁבְעַ֨ת יָמִ֤ים תּוֹחֵל֙ עַד בּוֹאִ֣/י אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הוֹדַעְתִּ֣י לְ/ךָ֔ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vyrdt lpny hglgl vhnh 'nkhy yrd 'lykh lh'lvt 'lvt lzbch zbchy shlmym shb't ymym tvchl 'd bv'y 'lykh vhvd'ty lkh 't 'shr t'shh
verses.translation: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כְּ/הַפְנֹת֤/וֹ שִׁכְמ/וֹ֙ לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ מֵ/עִ֣ם שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּהֲפָךְ ל֥/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵ֣ב אַחֵ֑ר וַ/יָּבֹ֛אוּ כָּל הָ/אֹת֥וֹת הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vhyh khhpntv shkhmv llkht m'm shmv'l vyhpkh lv 'lhym lb 'chr vyb'v khl h'tvt h'lh byvm hhv'
verses.translation: And it was so , that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ שָׁם֙ הַ/גִּבְעָ֔תָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה חֶֽבֶל נְבִאִ֖ים לִ/קְרָאת֑/וֹ וַ/תִּצְלַ֤ח עָלָי/ו֙ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יִּתְנַבֵּ֖א בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyb'v shm hgb'th vhnh chbl nb'ym lqr'tv vttslch 'lyv rvch 'lhym vytnb' btvkhm
verses.translation: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כָּל יֽוֹדְע/וֹ֙ מֵ/אִתְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשׁ֔וֹם וַ/יִּרְא֕וּ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה עִם נְבִאִ֖ים נִבָּ֑א וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הָ/עָ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֗/הוּ מַה זֶּה֙ הָיָ֣ה לְ/בֶן קִ֔ישׁ הֲ/גַ֥ם שָׁא֖וּל בַּ/נְּבִיאִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy khl yvd'v m'tmvl shlshvm vyr'v vhnh 'm nb'ym nb' vy'mr h'm 'ysh 'l r'hv mh zh hyh lbn qysh hgm sh'vl bnby'ym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן אִ֥ישׁ מִ/שָּׁ֛ם וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר וּ/מִ֣י אֲבִי/הֶ֑ם עַל כֵּן֙ הָיְתָ֣ה לְ/מָשָׁ֔ל הֲ/גַ֥ם שָׁא֖וּל בַּ/נְּבִאִֽים
verses.translit: vy'n 'ysh mshm vy'mr vmy 'byhm 'l khn hyth lmshl hgm sh'vl bnb'ym
verses.translation: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?

verses.original: וַ/יְכַל֙ מֵֽ/הִתְנַבּ֔וֹת וַ/יָּבֹ֖א הַ/בָּמָֽה
verses.translit: vykhl mhtnbvt vyb' hbmh
verses.translation: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ דּ֨וֹד שָׁא֥וּל אֵלָ֛י/ו וְ/אֶֽל נַעֲר֖/וֹ אָ֣ן הֲלַכְתֶּ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לְ/בַקֵּשׁ֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֲתֹנ֔וֹת וַ/נִּרְאֶ֣ה כִי אַ֔יִן וַ/נָּב֖וֹא אֶל שְׁמוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd sh'vl 'lyv v'l n'rv 'n hlkhtm vy'mr lbqsh 't h'tnvt vnr'h khy 'yn vnbv' 'l shmv'l
verses.translation: And Saul’s uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that they were no where, we came to Samuel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר דּ֣וֹד שָׁא֑וּל הַגִּֽידָ/ה נָּ֣א לִ֔/י מָֽה אָמַ֥ר לָ/כֶ֖ם שְׁמוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd sh'vl hgydh n' ly mh 'mr lkhm shmv'l
verses.translation: And Saul’s uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל דּוֹד֔/וֹ הַגֵּ֤ד הִגִּיד֙ לָ֔/נוּ כִּ֥י נִמְצְא֖וּ הָ/אֲתֹנ֑וֹת וְ/אֶת דְּבַ֤ר הַ/מְּלוּכָה֙ לֹֽא הִגִּ֣יד ל֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֥ר שְׁמוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l dvdv hgd hgyd lnv khy nmts'v h'tnvt v't dbr hmlvkhh l' hgyd lv 'shr 'mr shmv'l
verses.translation: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצְעֵ֤ק שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם אֶל יְהוָ֖ה הַ/מִּצְפָּֽה
verses.translit: vyts'q shmv'l 't h'm 'l yhvh hmtsph
verses.translation: And Samuel called the people together unto the LORD to Mizpeh;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָנֹכִ֛י הֶעֱלֵ֥יתִי אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וָ/אַצִּ֤יל אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/מִ/יַּד֙ כָּל הַ/מַּמְלָכ֔וֹת הַ/לֹּחֲצִ֖ים אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l bny yshr'l khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'nkhy h'lyty 't yshr'l mmtsrym v'tsyl 'tkhm myd mtsrym vmyd khl hmmlkhvt hlchtsym 'tkhm
verses.translation: And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, and of them that oppressed you:

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֨ם הַ/יּ֜וֹם מְאַסְתֶּ֣ם אֶת אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר ה֣וּא מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ לָ/כֶם֮ מִ/כָּל רָעוֹתֵי/כֶ֣ם וְ/צָרֹֽתֵי/כֶם֒ וַ/תֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔/וֹ כִּי מֶ֖לֶךְ תָּשִׂ֣ים עָלֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הִֽתְיַצְּבוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְ/שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֖ם וּ/לְ/אַלְפֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tm hyvm m'stm 't 'lhykhm 'shr hv' mvshy' lkhm mkhl r'vtykhm vtsrtykhm vt'mrv lv khy mlkh tshym 'lynv v'th htytsbv lpny yhvh lshbtykhm vl'lpykhm
verses.translation: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him, Nay , but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֣ב שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת כָּל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּלָּכֵ֖ד שֵׁ֥בֶט בִּנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: vyqrb shmv'l 't khl shbty yshr'l vylkhd shbt bnymn
verses.translation: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת שֵׁ֤בֶט בִּנְיָמִן֙ ל/משפחת/ו לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/תִּלָּכֵ֖ד מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַ/מַּטְרִ֑י וַ/יִּלָּכֵד֙ שָׁא֣וּל בֶּן קִ֔ישׁ וַ/יְבַקְשֻׁ֖/הוּ וְ/לֹ֥א נִמְצָֽא
verses.translit: vyqrb 't shbt bnymn lmshpchtv lmshpchtyv vtlkhd mshpcht hmtry vylkhd sh'vl bn qysh vybqshhv vl' nmts'
verses.translation: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאֲלוּ עוֹד֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה הֲ/בָ֥א ע֖וֹד הֲלֹ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּה ה֥וּא נֶחְבָּ֖א אֶל הַ/כֵּלִֽים
verses.translit: vysh'lv 'vd byhvh hb' 'vd hlm 'ysh vy'mr yhvh hnh hv' nchb' 'l hkhlym
verses.translation: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the stuff.

verses.translit: vyrtsv vyqchhv mshm vytytsb btvkh h'm vygbh mkhl h'm mshkhmv vm'lh
verses.translation: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֗ם הַ/רְּאִיתֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר בּ֣/וֹ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין כָּמֹ֖/הוּ בְּ/כָל הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יָּרִ֧עוּ כָל הָ/עָ֛ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l khl h'm hr'ytm 'shr bchr bv yhvh khy 'yn khmhv bkhl h'm vyr'v khl h'm vy'mrv ychy hmlkh
verses.translation: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶל הָ/עָ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁפַּ֣ט הַ/מְּלֻכָ֔ה וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֣ב בַּ/סֵּ֔פֶר וַ/יַּנַּ֖ח לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֧ח שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ לְ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vydbr shmv'l 'l h'm 't mshpt hmlkhh vykhtb bspr vynch lpny yhvh vyshlch shmv'l 't khl h'm 'ysh lbytv
verses.translation: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the LORD . And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֨ם שָׁא֔וּל הָלַ֥ךְ לְ/בֵית֖/וֹ גִּבְעָ֑תָ/ה וַ/יֵּלְכ֣וּ עִמּ֔/וֹ הַ/חַ֕יִל אֲשֶׁר נָגַ֥ע אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/לִבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vgm sh'vl hlkh lbytv gb'th vylkhv 'mv hchyl 'shr ng' 'lhym blbm
verses.translation: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֧י בְלִיַּ֣עַל אָמְר֗וּ מַה יֹּשִׁעֵ֨/נוּ֙ זֶ֔ה וַ/יִּבְזֻ֕/הוּ וְ/לֹֽא הֵבִ֥יאוּ ל֖/וֹ מִנְחָ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֖י כְּ/מַחֲרִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vbny bly'l 'mrv mh ysh'nv zh vybzhv vl' hby'v lv mnchh vyhy khmchrysh
verses.translation: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗עַל נָחָשׁ֙ הָֽ/עַמּוֹנִ֔י וַ/יִּ֖חַן עַל יָבֵ֣שׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֤י יָבֵישׁ֙ אֶל נָחָ֔שׁ כְּרָת לָ֥/נוּ בְרִ֖ית וְ/נַעַבְדֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: vy'l nchsh h'mvny vychn 'l ybsh gl'd vy'mrv khl 'nshy ybysh 'l nchsh khrt lnv bryt vn'bdkh
verses.translation: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh-gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם נָחָשׁ֙ הָ/עַמּוֹנִ֔י בְּ/זֹאת֙ אֶכְרֹ֣ת לָ/כֶ֔ם בִּ/נְק֥וֹר לָ/כֶ֖ם כָּל עֵ֣ין יָמִ֑ין וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֥י/הָ חֶרְפָּ֖ה עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm nchsh h'mvny bz't 'khrt lkhm bnqvr lkhm khl 'yn ymyn vshmtyh chrph 'l khl yshr'l
verses.translation: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this condition will I make a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜י/ו זִקְנֵ֣י יָבֵ֗ישׁ הֶ֤רֶף לָ֨/נוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וְ/נִשְׁלְחָה֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים בְּ/כֹ֖ל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אִם אֵ֥ין מוֹשִׁ֛יעַ אֹתָ֖/נוּ וְ/יָצָ֥אנוּ אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv zqny ybysh hrf lnv shb't ymym vnshlchh ml'khym bkhl gbvl yshr'l v'm 'yn mvshy' 'tnv vyts'nv 'lykh
verses.translation: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days’ respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ הַ/מַּלְאָכִים֙ גִּבְעַ֣ת שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יְדַבְּר֥וּ הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׂא֧וּ כָל הָ/עָ֛ם אֶת קוֹלָ֖/ם וַ/יִּבְכּֽוּ
verses.translit: vyb'v hml'khym gb't sh'vl vydbrv hdbrym b'zny h'm vysh'v khl h'm 't qvlm vybkhv
verses.translation: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה שָׁא֗וּל בָּ֣א אַחֲרֵ֤י הַ/בָּקָר֙ מִן הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל מַה לָּ/עָ֖ם כִּ֣י יִבְכּ֑וּ וַ/יְסַ֨פְּרוּ ל֔/וֹ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֖י אַנְשֵׁ֥י יָבֵֽישׁ
verses.translit: vhnh sh'vl b' 'chry hbqr mn hshdh vy'mr sh'vl mh l'm khy ybkhv vysprv lv 't dbry 'nshy ybysh
verses.translation: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.

verses.original: וַ/תִּצְלַ֤ח רֽוּחַ אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל שָׁא֔וּל ב/שמע/ו כְּ/שָׁמְע֖/וֹ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יִּ֥חַר אַפּ֖/וֹ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vttslch rvch 'lhym 'l sh'vl bshm'v khshm'v 't hdbrym h'lh vychr 'pv m'd
verses.translation: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ צֶ֨מֶד בָּקָ֜ר וַֽ/יְנַתְּחֵ֗/הוּ וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֞ח בְּ/כָל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ בְּ/יַ֣ד הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֣ים לֵ/אמֹר֒ אֲשֶׁר֩ אֵינֶ֨/נּוּ יֹצֵ֜א אַחֲרֵ֤י שָׁאוּל֙ וְ/אַחַ֣ר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לִ/בְקָר֑/וֹ וַ/יִּפֹּ֤ל פַּֽחַד יְהוָה֙ עַל הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יֵּצְא֖וּ כְּ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vyqch tsmd bqr vyntchhv vyshlch bkhl gbvl yshr'l byd hml'khym l'mr 'shr 'ynnv yts' 'chry sh'vl v'chr shmv'l khh y'shh lbqrv vypl pchd yhvh 'l h'm vyts'v kh'ysh 'chd
verses.translation: And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּפְקְדֵ֖/ם בְּ/בָ֑זֶק וַ/יִּהְי֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֔לֶף וְ/אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vypqdm bbzq vyhyv bny yshr'l shlsh m'vt 'lf v'ysh yhvdh shlshym 'lf
verses.translation: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֞וּ לַ/מַּלְאָכִ֣ים הַ/בָּאִ֗ים כֹּ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּ/ן֙ לְ/אִישׁ֙ יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֔ד מָחָ֛ר תִּהְיֶֽה לָ/כֶ֥ם תְּשׁוּעָ֖ה ב/חם כְּ/חֹ֣ם הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֗ים וַ/יַּגִּ֛ידוּ לְ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י יָבֵ֖ישׁ וַ/יִּשְׂמָֽחוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv lml'khym hb'ym khh t'mrvn l'ysh ybysh gl'd mchr thyh lkhm tshv'h bchm khchm hshmsh vyb'v hml'khym vygydv l'nshy ybysh vyshmchv
verses.translation: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, To morrow, by that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

verses.original: וַֽ/יֹּאמְרוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יָבֵ֔ישׁ מָחָ֖ר נֵצֵ֣א אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָּ֔/נוּ כְּ/כָל הַ/טּ֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'nshy ybysh mchr nts' 'lykhm v'shytm lnv khkhl htvb b'ynykhm
verses.translation: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֗ת וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם שָׁא֣וּל אֶת הָ/עָם֮ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁים֒ וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ בְ/תוֹךְ הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶה֙ בְּ/אַשְׁמֹ֣רֶת הַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ אֶת עַמּ֖וֹן עַד חֹ֣ם הַ/יּ֑וֹם וַ/יְהִ֤י הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִים֙ וַ/יָּפֻ֔צוּ וְ/לֹ֥א נִשְׁאֲרוּ בָ֖/ם שְׁנַ֥יִם יָֽחַד
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyshm sh'vl 't h'm shlshh r'shym vyb'v btvkh hmchnh b'shmrt hbqr vykhv 't 'mvn 'd chm hyvm vyhy hnsh'rym vyptsv vl' nsh'rv bm shnym ychd
verses.translation: And it was so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הָ/עָם֙ אֶל שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל מִ֣י הָ/אֹמֵ֔ר שָׁא֖וּל יִמְלֹ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑י/נוּ תְּנ֥וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וּ/נְמִיתֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr h'm 'l shmv'l my h'mr sh'vl ymlkh 'lynv tnv h'nshym vnmytm
verses.translation: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל לֹֽא יוּמַ֥ת אִ֖ישׁ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ֥י הַ/יּ֛וֹם עָשָֽׂה יְהוָ֥ה תְּשׁוּעָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl l' yvmt 'ysh byvm hzh khy hyvm 'shh yhvh tshv'h byshr'l
verses.translation: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם לְכ֖וּ וְ/נֵלְכָ֣ה הַ/גִּלְגָּ֑ל וּ/נְחַדֵּ֥שׁ שָׁ֖ם הַ/מְּלוּכָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l h'm lkhv vnlkhh hglgl vnchdsh shm hmlvkhh
verses.translation: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֨וּ כָל הָ/עָ֜ם הַ/גִּלְגָּ֗ל וַ/יַּמְלִכוּ֩ שָׁ֨ם אֶת שָׁא֜וּל לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בַּ/גִּלְגָּ֔ל וַ/יִּזְבְּחוּ שָׁ֛ם זְבָחִ֥ים שְׁלָמִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׂמַ֨ח שָׁ֥ם שָׁא֛וּל וְ/כָל אַנְשֵׁ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vylkhv khl h'm hglgl vymlkhv shm 't sh'vl lpny yhvh bglgl vyzbchv shm zbchym shlmym lpny yhvh vyshmch shm sh'vl vkhl 'nshy yshr'l 'd m'd
verses.translation: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD ; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנֵּה֙ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי בְ/קֹֽלְ/כֶ֔ם לְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לִ֑/י וָ/אַמְלִ֥יךְ עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l khl yshr'l hnh shm'ty bqlkhm lkhl 'shr 'mrtm ly v'mlykh 'lykhm mlkh
verses.translation: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֗ם וַ/אֲנִי֙ זָקַ֣נְתִּי וָ/שַׂ֔בְתִּי וּ/בָנַ֖/י הִנָּ֣/ם אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם וַ/אֲנִי֙ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם מִ/נְּעֻרַ֖/י עַד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'th hnh hmlkh mthlkh lpnykhm v'ny zqnty vshbty vbny hnm 'tkhm v'ny hthlkhty lpnykhm mn'ry 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֣י עֲנ֣וּ בִ/י֩ נֶ֨גֶד יְהוָ֜ה וְ/נֶ֣גֶד מְשִׁיח֗/וֹ אֶת שׁוֹר֩ מִ֨י לָקַ֜חְתִּי וַ/חֲמ֧וֹר מִ֣י לָקַ֗חְתִּי וְ/אֶת מִ֤י עָשַׁ֨קְתִּי֙ אֶת מִ֣י רַצּ֔וֹתִי וּ/מִ/יַּד מִי֙ לָקַ֣חְתִּי כֹ֔פֶר וְ/אַעְלִ֥ים עֵינַ֖/י בּ֑/וֹ וְ/אָשִׁ֖יב לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hnny 'nv by ngd yhvh vngd mshychv 't shvr my lqchty vchmvr my lqchty v't my 'shqty 't my rtsvty vmyd my lqchty khpr v''lym 'yny bv v'shyb lkhm
verses.translation: Behold, here I am: witness against me before the LORD , and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א עֲשַׁקְתָּ֖/נוּ וְ/לֹ֣א רַצּוֹתָ֑/נוּ וְ/לֹֽא לָקַ֥חְתָּ מִ/יַּד אִ֖ישׁ מְאֽוּמָה
verses.translit: vy'mrv l' 'shqtnv vl' rtsvtnv vl' lqcht myd 'ysh m'vmh
verses.translation: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man’s hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם עֵ֧ד יְהוָ֣ה בָּ/כֶ֗ם וְ/עֵ֤ד מְשִׁיח/וֹ֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֧א מְצָאתֶ֛ם בְּ/יָדִ֖/י מְא֑וּמָה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר עֵֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm 'd yhvh bkhm v'd mshychv hyvm hzh khy l' mts'tm bydy m'vmh vy'mr 'd
verses.translation: And he said unto them, The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל הָ/עָ֑ם יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l h'm yhvh 'shr 'shh 't mshh v't 'hrn v'shr h'lh 't 'btykhm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Samuel said unto the people, It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הִֽתְיַצְּב֛וּ וְ/אִשָּׁפְטָ֥ה אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֚ת כָּל צִדְק֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th htytsbv v'shpth 'tkhm lpny yhvh 't khl tsdqvt yhvh 'shr 'shh 'tkhm v't 'bvtykhm
verses.translation: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD , which he did to you and to your fathers.

verses.original: כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יִּזְעֲק֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְהוָ֜ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַ/יּוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֶת אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יֹּשִׁב֖וּ/ם בַּ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: kh'shr b' y'qb mtsrym vyz'qv 'bvtykhm 'l yhvh vyshlch yhvh 't mshh v't 'hrn vyvtsy'v 't 'btykhm mmtsrym vyshbvm bmqvm hzh
verses.translation: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto the LORD , then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁכְּח֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּמְכֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֡/ם בְּ/יַ֣ד סִֽיסְרָא֩ שַׂר צְבָ֨א חָצ֜וֹר וּ/בְ/יַד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וּ/בְ/יַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וַ/יִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshkhchv 't yhvh 'lhyhm vymkhr 'tm byd sysr' shr tsb' chtsvr vbyd plshtym vbyd mlkh mv'b vylchmv bm
verses.translation: And when they forgat the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְעֲק֤וּ אֶל יְהוָה֙ ו/יאמר וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ חָטָ֔אנוּ כִּ֤י עָזַ֨בְנוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וַ/נַּעֲבֹ֥ד אֶת הַ/בְּעָלִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הָ/עַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הַצִּילֵ֛/נוּ מִ/יַּ֥ד אֹיְבֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/נַעַבְדֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: vyz'qv 'l yhvh vy'mr vy'mrv cht'nv khy 'zbnv 't yhvh vn'bd 't hb'lym v't h'shtrvt v'th htsylnv myd 'ybynv vn'bdkh
verses.translation: And they cried unto the LORD , and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD , and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת יְרֻבַּ֣עַל וְ/אֶת בְּדָ֔ן וְ/אֶת יִפְתָּ֖ח וְ/אֶת שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּצֵּ֨ל אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם מִ/יַּ֤ד אֹֽיְבֵי/כֶם֙ מִ/סָּבִ֔יב וַ/תֵּשְׁב֖וּ בֶּֽטַח
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh 't yrb'l v't bdn v't yptch v't shmv'l vytsl 'tkhm myd 'ybykhm msbyb vtshbv btch
verses.translation: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.

verses.original: וַ/תִּרְא֗וּ כִּֽי נָחָ֞שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵֽי עַמּוֹן֮ בָּ֣א עֲלֵי/כֶם֒ וַ/תֹּ֣אמְרוּ לִ֔/י לֹ֕א כִּי מֶ֖לֶךְ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם מַלְכְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vtr'v khy nchsh mlkh bny 'mvn b' 'lykhm vt'mrv ly l' khy mlkh ymlkh 'lynv vyhvh 'lhykhm mlkhkhm
verses.translation: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the LORD your God was your king.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁאֶלְתֶּ֑ם וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: v'th hnh hmlkh 'shr bchrtm 'shr sh'ltm vhnh ntn yhvh 'lykhm mlkh
verses.translation: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.

verses.original: אִם תִּֽירְא֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֗ה וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּ֤ם אֹת/וֹ֙ וּ/שְׁמַעְתֶּ֣ם בְּ/קֹל֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א תַמְר֖וּ אֶת פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וִ/הְיִתֶ֣ם גַּם אַתֶּ֗ם וְ/גַם הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלַ֣ךְ עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם אַחַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'm tyr'v 't yhvh v'bdtm 'tv vshm'tm bqlv vl' tmrv 't py yhvh vhytm gm 'tm vgm hmlkh 'shr mlkh 'lykhm 'chr yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: If ye will fear the LORD , and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD , then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מְרִיתֶ֖ם אֶת פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הָיְתָ֧ה יַד יְהוָ֛ה בָּ/כֶ֖ם וּ/בַ/אֲבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'm l' tshm'v bqvl yhvh vmrytm 't py yhvh vhyth yd yhvh bkhm vb'btykhm
verses.translation: But if ye will not obey the voice of the LORD , but rebel against the commandment of the LORD , then shall the hand of the LORD be against you, as it was against your fathers.

verses.original: גַּם עַתָּה֙ הִתְיַצְּב֣וּ וּ/רְא֔וּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/גָּד֖וֹל הַ/זֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עֹשֶׂ֖ה לְ/עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: gm 'th htytsbv vr'v 't hdbr hgdvl hzh 'shr yhvh 'shh l'ynykhm
verses.translation: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֤וֹא קְצִיר חִטִּים֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם אֶקְרָא֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/יִתֵּ֥ן קֹל֖וֹת וּ/מָטָ֑ר וּ/דְע֣וּ וּ/רְא֗וּ כִּֽי רָעַתְ/כֶ֤ם רַבָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲשִׂיתֶם֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לִ/שְׁא֥וֹל לָ/כֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: hlv' qtsyr chtym hyvm 'qr' 'l yhvh vytn qlvt vmtr vd'v vr'v khy r'tkhm rbh 'shr 'shytm b'yny yhvh lsh'vl lkhm mlkh
verses.translation: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the LORD , and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD , in asking you a king.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה קֹלֹ֥ת וּ/מָטָ֖ר בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יִּירָ֨א כָל הָ/עָ֥ם מְאֹ֛ד אֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֶת שְׁמוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqr' shmv'l 'l yhvh vytn yhvh qlt vmtr byvm hhv' vyyr' khl h'm m'd 't yhvh v't shmv'l
verses.translation: So Samuel called unto the LORD ; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ כָל הָ/עָ֜ם אֶל שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל הִתְפַּלֵּ֧ל בְּעַד עֲבָדֶ֛י/ךָ אֶל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/אַל נָמ֑וּת כִּֽי יָסַ֤פְנוּ עַל כָּל חַטֹּאתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ רָעָ֔ה לִ/שְׁאֹ֥ל לָ֖/נוּ מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mrv khl h'm 'l shmv'l htpll b'd 'bdykh 'l yhvh 'lhykh v'l nmvt khy yspnv 'l khl cht'tynv r'h lsh'l lnv mlkh
verses.translation: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל הָ/עָם֙ אַל תִּירָ֔אוּ אַתֶּ֣ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את אַ֗ךְ אַל תָּס֨וּרוּ֙ מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּ֥ם אֶת יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/כָל לְבַבְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l h'm 'l tyr'v 'tm 'shytm 't khl hr'h hz't 'kh 'l tsvrv m'chry yhvh v'bdtm 't yhvh bkhl lbbkhm
verses.translation: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD , but serve the LORD with all your heart;

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֖א תָּס֑וּרוּ כִּ֣י אַחֲרֵ֣י הַ/תֹּ֗הוּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יוֹעִ֛ילוּ וְ/לֹ֥א יַצִּ֖ילוּ כִּי תֹ֥הוּ הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vl' tsvrv khy 'chry hthv 'shr l' yv'ylv vl' ytsylv khy thv hmh
verses.translation: And turn ye not aside: for then should ye go after vain things , which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא יִטֹּ֤שׁ יְהוָה֙ אֶת עַמּ֔/וֹ בַּ/עֲב֖וּר שְׁמ֣/וֹ הַ/גָּד֑וֹל כִּ֚י הוֹאִ֣יל יְהוָ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם ל֖/וֹ לְ/עָֽם
verses.translit: khy l' ytsh yhvh 't 'mv b'bvr shmv hgdvl khy hv'yl yhvh l'shvt 'tkhm lv l'm
verses.translation: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י חָלִ֤ילָ/ה לִּ/י֙ מֵ/חֲטֹ֣א לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה מֵ/חֲדֹ֖ל לְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעַדְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הוֹרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ הַ/טּוֹבָ֖ה וְ/הַ/יְשָׁרָֽה
verses.translit: gm 'nkhy chlylh ly mcht' lyhvh mchdl lhtpll b'dkhm vhvryty 'tkhm bdrkh htvbh vhyshrh
verses.translation: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ יְר֣אוּ אֶת יְהוָ֗ה וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֛/וֹ בֶּ/אֱמֶ֖ת בְּ/כָל לְבַבְ/כֶ֑ם כִּ֣י רְא֔וּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר הִגְדִּ֖ל עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'kh yr'v 't yhvh v'bdtm 'tv b'mt bkhl lbbkhm khy r'v 't 'shr hgdl 'mkhm
verses.translation: Only fear the LORD , and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.

verses.original: וְ/אִם הָרֵ֖עַ תָּרֵ֑עוּ גַּם אַתֶּ֥ם גַּֽם מַלְכְּ/כֶ֖ם תִּסָּפֽוּ
verses.translit: v'm hr' tr'v gm 'tm gm mlkhkhm tspv
verses.translation: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.

verses.original: בֶּן שָׁנָ֖ה שָׁא֣וּל בְּ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁתֵּ֣י שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bn shnh sh'vl bmlkhv vshty shnym mlkh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְחַר ל֨/וֹ שָׁא֜וּל שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֮ מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יִּהְי֨וּ עִם שָׁא֜וּל אַלְפַּ֗יִם בְּ/מִכְמָשׂ֙ וּ/בְ/הַ֣ר בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל וְ/אֶ֗לֶף הָיוּ֙ עִם י֣וֹנָתָ֔ן בְּ/גִבְעַ֖ת בִּנְיָמִ֑ין וְ/יֶ֣תֶר הָ/עָ֔ם שִׁלַּ֖ח אִ֥ישׁ לְ/אֹהָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vybchr lv sh'vl shlsht 'lpym myshr'l vyhyv 'm sh'vl 'lpym bmkhmsh vbhr byt 'l v'lf hyv 'm yvntn bgb't bnymyn vytr h'm shlch 'ysh l'hlyv
verses.translation: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth-el, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣ךְ יוֹנָתָ֗ן אֵ֣ת נְצִ֤יב פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/גֶ֔בַע וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֖וּ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וְ/שָׁאוּל֩ תָּקַ֨ע בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֤ר בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יִשְׁמְע֖וּ הָ/עִבְרִֽים
verses.translit: vykh yvntn 't ntsyb plshtym 'shr bgb' vyshm'v plshtym vsh'vl tq' bshvpr bkhl h'rts l'mr yshm'v h'brym
verses.translation: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it . And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֞ל שָׁמְע֣וּ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הִכָּ֤ה שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת נְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/גַם נִבְאַשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יִּצָּעֲק֥וּ הָ/עָ֛ם אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל הַ/גִּלְגָּֽל
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l shm'v l'mr hkhh sh'vl 't ntsyb plshtym vgm nb'sh yshr'l bplshtym vyts'qv h'm 'chry sh'vl hglgl
verses.translation: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.

verses.original: וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֞ים נֶאֶסְפ֣וּ לְ/הִלָּחֵ֣ם עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֤לֶף רֶ֨כֶב֙ וְ/שֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ פָּרָשִׁ֔ים וְ/עָ֕ם כַּ/ח֛וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל שְׂפַֽת הַ/יָּ֖ם לָ/רֹ֑ב וַֽ/יַּעֲלוּ֙ וַ/יַּחֲנ֣וּ בְ/מִכְמָ֔שׂ קִדְמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: vplshtym n'spv lhlchm 'm yshr'l shlshym 'lf rkhb vshsht 'lpym prshym v'm khchvl 'shr 'l shpt hym lrb vy'lv vychnv bmkhmsh qdmt byt 'vn
verses.translation: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל רָאוּ֙ כִּ֣י צַר ל֔/וֹ כִּ֥י נִגַּ֖שׂ הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יִּֽתְחַבְּא֣וּ הָ/עָ֗ם בַּ/מְּעָר֤וֹת וּ/בַֽ/חֲוָחִים֙ וּ/בַ/סְּלָעִ֔ים וּ/בַ/צְּרִחִ֖ים וּ/בַ/בֹּרֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l r'v khy tsr lv khy ngsh h'm vytchb'v h'm bm'rvt vbchvchym vbsl'ym vbtsrchym vbbrvt
verses.translation: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.

verses.original: וְ/עִבְרִ֗ים עָֽבְרוּ֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶ֥רֶץ גָּ֖ד וְ/גִלְעָ֑ד וְ/שָׁאוּל֙ עוֹדֶ֣/נּוּ בַ/גִּלְגָּ֔ל וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם חָרְד֥וּ אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'brym 'brv 't hyrdn 'rts gd vgl'd vsh'vl 'vdnv bglgl vkhl h'm chrdv 'chryv
verses.translation: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

verses.original: ו/ייחל וַ/יּ֣וֹחֶל שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים לַ/מּוֹעֵד֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וְ/לֹא בָ֥א שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הַ/גִּלְגָּ֑ל וַ/יָּ֥פֶץ הָ/עָ֖ם מֵ/עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyychl vyvchl shb't ymym lmv'd 'shr shmv'l vl' b' shmv'l hglgl vypts h'm m'lyv
verses.translation: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל הַגִּ֣שׁוּ אֵלַ֔/י הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֖עַל הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl hgshv 'ly h'lh vhshlmym vy'l h'lh
verses.translation: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/כַלֹּת/וֹ֙ לְ/הַעֲל֣וֹת הָ/עֹלָ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בָּ֑א וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א שָׁא֛וּל לִ/קְרָאת֖/וֹ לְ/בָרֲכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khkhltv lh'lvt h'lh vhnh shmv'l b' vyts' sh'vl lqr'tv lbrkhv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֡וּל כִּֽי רָאִיתִי֩ כִֽי נָפַ֨ץ הָ/עָ֜ם מֵ/עָלַ֗/י וְ/אַתָּה֙ לֹא בָ֨אתָ֙ לְ/מוֹעֵ֣ד הַ/יָּמִ֔ים וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים נֶאֱסָפִ֥ים מִכְמָֽשׂ
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l mh 'shyt vy'mr sh'vl khy r'yty khy npts h'm m'ly v'th l' b't lmv'd hymym vplshtym n'spym mkhmsh
verses.translation: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר עַ֠תָּה יֵרְד֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֤ים אֵלַ/י֙ הַ/גִּלְגָּ֔ל וּ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א חִלִּ֑יתִי וָֽ/אֶתְאַפַּ֔ק וָ/אַעֲלֶ֖ה הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: v'mr 'th yrdv plshtym 'ly hglgl vpny yhvh l' chlyty v't'pq v''lh h'lh
verses.translation: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the LORD : I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל אֶל שָׁא֖וּל נִסְכָּ֑לְתָּ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗רְתָּ אֶת מִצְוַ֞ת יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔/ךְ כִּ֣י עַתָּ֗ה הֵכִ֨ין יְהוָ֧ה אֶת מַֽמְלַכְתְּ/ךָ֛ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l sh'vl nskhlt l' shmrt 't mtsvt yhvh 'lhykh 'shr tsvkh khy 'th hkhyn yhvh 't mmlkhtkh 'l yshr'l 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה מַמְלַכְתְּ/ךָ֣ לֹא תָק֑וּם בִּקֵּשׁ֩ יְהוָ֨ה ל֜/וֹ אִ֣ישׁ כִּ/לְבָב֗/וֹ וַ/יְצַוֵּ֨/הוּ יְהוָ֤ה לְ/נָגִיד֙ עַל עַמּ֔/וֹ כִּ֚י לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔רְתָּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶֽׁר צִוְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th mmlkhtkh l' tqvm bqsh yhvh lv 'ysh khlbbv vytsvhv yhvh lngyd 'l 'mv khy l' shmrt 't 'shr tsvkh yhvh
verses.translation: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל וַ/יַּ֛עַל מִן הַ/גִּלְגָּ֖ל גִּבְעַ֣ת בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וַ/יִּפְקֹ֣ד שָׁא֗וּל אֶת הָ/עָם֙ הַ/נִּמְצְאִ֣ים עִמּ֔/וֹ כְּ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vyqm shmv'l vy'l mn hglgl gb't bnymn vypqd sh'vl 't h'm hnmts'ym 'mv khshsh m'vt 'ysh
verses.translation: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁא֞וּל וְ/יוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֗/וֹ וְ/הָ/עָם֙ הַ/נִּמְצָ֣א עִמָּ֔/ם יֹשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/גֶ֣בַע בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים חָנ֥וּ בְ/מִכְמָֽשׂ
verses.translit: vsh'vl vyvntn bnv vh'm hnmts' 'mm yshbym bgb' bnymn vplshtym chnv bmkhmsh
verses.translation: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֧א הַ/מַּשְׁחִ֛ית מִ/מַּחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁ֑ים הָ/רֹ֨אשׁ אֶחָ֥ד יִפְנֶ֛ה אֶל דֶּ֥רֶךְ עָפְרָ֖ה אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ שׁוּעָֽל
verses.translit: vyts' hmshchyt mmchnh plshtym shlshh r'shym hr'sh 'chd ypnh 'l drkh 'prh 'l 'rts shv'l
verses.translation: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:

verses.original: וְ/הָ/רֹ֤אשׁ אֶחָד֙ יִפְנֶ֔ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית חֹר֑וֹן וְ/הָ/רֹ֨אשׁ אֶחָ֤ד יִפְנֶה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/גְּב֔וּל הַ/נִּשְׁקָ֛ף עַל גֵּ֥י הַצְּבֹעִ֖ים הַ/מִּדְבָּֽרָ/ה
verses.translit: vhr'sh 'chd ypnh drkh byt chrvn vhr'sh 'chd ypnh drkh hgbvl hnshqf 'l gy htsb'ym hmdbrh
verses.translation: And another company turned the way to Beth-horon: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

verses.original: וְ/חָרָשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יִמָּצֵ֔א בְּ/כֹ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי אמר אָמְר֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים פֶּ֚ן יַעֲשׂ֣וּ הָ/עִבְרִ֔ים חֶ֖רֶב א֥וֹ חֲנִֽית
verses.translit: vchrsh l' ymts' bkhl 'rts yshr'l khy 'mr 'mrv plshtym pn y'shv h'brym chrb 'v chnyt
verses.translation: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרְד֥וּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים לִ֠/לְטוֹשׁ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת מַחֲרַשְׁתּ֤/וֹ וְ/אֶת אֵת/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת קַרְדֻּמּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵ֖ת מַחֲרֵשָׁתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyrdv khl yshr'l hplshtym lltvsh 'ysh 't mchrshtv v't 'tv v't qrdmv v't mchrshtv
verses.translation: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.

verses.original: וְֽ/הָיְתָ֞ה הַ/פְּצִ֣ירָה פִ֗ים לַ/מַּֽחֲרֵשֹׁת֙ וְ/לָ֣/אֵתִ֔ים וְ/לִ/שְׁלֹ֥שׁ קִלְּשׁ֖וֹן וּ/לְ/הַ/קַּרְדֻּמִּ֑ים וּ/לְ/הַצִּ֖יב הַ/דָּרְבָֽן
verses.translit: vhyth hptsyrh pym lmchrsht vl'tym vlshlsh qlshvn vlhqrdmym vlhtsyb hdrbn
verses.translation: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם מִלְחֶ֔מֶת וְ/לֹ֨א נִמְצָ֜א חֶ֤רֶב וַ/חֲנִית֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶת שָׁא֖וּל וְ/אֶת יוֹנָתָ֑ן וַ/תִּמָּצֵ֣א לְ/שָׁא֔וּל וּ/לְ/יוֹנָתָ֖ן בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm mlchmt vl' nmts' chrb vchnyt byd khl h'm 'shr 't sh'vl v't yvntn vtmts' lsh'vl vlyvntn bnv
verses.translation: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ מַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אֶֽל מַעֲבַ֖ר מִכְמָֽשׂ
verses.translit: vyts' mtsb plshtym 'l m'br mkhmsh
verses.translation: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י הַ/יּ֗וֹם וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹנָתָ֤ן בֶּן שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔י/ו לְכָ֗/ה וְ/נַעְבְּרָה֙ אֶל מַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵ/עֵ֣בֶר הַלָּ֑ז וּ/לְ/אָבִ֖י/ו לֹ֥א הִגִּֽיד
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vy'mr yvntn bn sh'vl 'l hn'r nsh' khlyv lkhh vn'brh 'l mtsb plshtym 'shr m'br hlz vl'byv l' hgyd
verses.translation: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines’ garrison, that is on the other side. But he told not his father.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁא֗וּל יוֹשֵׁב֙ בִּ/קְצֵ֣ה הַ/גִּבְעָ֔ה תַּ֥חַת הָ/רִמּ֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/מִגְר֑וֹן וְ/הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֔/וֹ כְּ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vsh'vl yvshb bqtsh hgb'h tcht hrmvn 'shr bmgrvn vh'm 'shr 'mv khshsh m'vt 'ysh
verses.translation: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;

verses.original: וַ/אֲחִיָּ֣ה בֶן אֲחִט֡וּב אֲחִ֡י אִיכָב֣וֹד בֶּן פִּינְחָ֨ס בֶּן עֵלִ֜י כֹּהֵ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/שִׁל֖וֹ נֹשֵׂ֣א אֵפ֑וֹד וְ/הָ/עָם֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י הָלַ֖ךְ יוֹנָתָֽן
verses.translit: v'chyh bn 'chtvb 'chy 'ykhbvd bn pynchs bn 'ly khhn yhvh bshlv nsh' 'pvd vh'm l' yd' khy hlkh yvntn
verses.translation: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, I-chabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD’s priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

verses.original: וּ/בֵ֣ין הַֽ/מַּעְבְּר֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּקֵּ֤שׁ יֽוֹנָתָן֙ לַֽ/עֲבֹר֙ עַל מַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים שֵׁן הַ/סֶּ֤לַע מֵ/הָ/עֵ֨בֶר֙ מִ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/שֵׁן הַ/סֶּ֥לַע מֵ/הָ/עֵ֖בֶר מִ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/שֵׁ֤ם הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ בּוֹצֵ֔ץ וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הָ/אֶחָ֖ד סֶֽנֶּה
verses.translit: vbyn hm'brvt 'shr bqsh yvntn l'br 'l mtsb plshtym shn hsl' mh'br mzh vshn hsl' mh'br mzh vshm h'chd bvtsts vshm h'chd snh
verses.translation: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines’ garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

verses.original: הַ/שֵּׁ֧ן הָ/אֶחָ֛ד מָצ֥וּק מִ/צָּפ֖וֹן מ֣וּל מִכְמָ֑שׂ וְ/הָ/אֶחָ֥ד מִ/נֶּ֖גֶב מ֥וּל גָּֽבַע
verses.translit: hshn h'chd mtsvq mtspvn mvl mkhmsh vh'chd mngb mvl gb'
verses.translation: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹנָתָ֜ן אֶל הַ/נַּ֣עַר נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֗י/ו לְכָ/ה֙ וְ/נַעְבְּרָ֗ה אֶל מַצַּב֙ הָ/עֲרֵלִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אוּלַ֛י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לָ֑/נוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין לַֽ/יהוָה֙ מַעְצ֔וֹר לְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ בְּ/רַ֖ב א֥וֹ בִ/מְעָֽט
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvntn 'l hn'r nsh' khlyv lkhh vn'brh 'l mtsb h'rlym h'lh 'vly y'shh yhvh lnv khy 'yn lyhvh m'tsvr lhvshy' brb 'v bm't
verses.translation: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔י/ו עֲשֵׂ֖ה כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/לְבָבֶ֑/ךָ נְטֵ֣ה לָ֔/ךְ הִנְ/נִ֥י עִמְּ/ךָ֖ כִּ/לְבָבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv nsh' khlyv 'shh khl 'shr blbbkh nth lkh hnny 'mkh khlbbkh
verses.translation: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֹבְרִ֖ים אֶל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְ/נִגְלִ֖ינוּ אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvntn hnh 'nchnv 'brym 'l h'nshym vnglynv 'lyhm
verses.translation: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.

verses.original: אִם כֹּ֤ה יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔י/נוּ דֹּ֕מּוּ עַד הַגִּיעֵ֖/נוּ אֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/עָמַ֣דְנוּ תַחְתֵּ֔י/נוּ וְ/לֹ֥א נַעֲלֶ֖ה אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'm khh y'mrv 'lynv dmv 'd hgy'nv 'lykhm v'mdnv tchtynv vl' n'lh 'lyhm
verses.translation: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.

verses.original: וְ/אִם כֹּ֨ה יֹאמְר֜וּ עֲל֤וּ עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וְ/עָלִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי נְתָנָ֥/ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יָדֵ֑/נוּ וְ/זֶה לָּ֖/נוּ הָ/אֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'm khh y'mrv 'lv 'lynv v'lynv khy ntnm yhvh bydnv vzh lnv h'vt
verses.translation: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגָּל֣וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֔ם אֶל מַצַּ֖ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הִנֵּ֤ה עִבְרִים֙ יֹֽצְאִ֔ים מִן הַ/חֹרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִתְחַבְּאוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyglv shnyhm 'l mtsb plshtym vy'mrv plshtym hnh 'brym yts'ym mn hchrym 'shr htchb'v shm
verses.translation: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲנוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַ/מַּצָּבָ֜ה אֶת יוֹנָתָ֣ן וְ/אֶת נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֗י/ו וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ עֲל֣וּ אֵלֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/נוֹדִ֥יעָה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם דָּבָ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹנָתָ֜ן אֶל נֹשֵׂ֤א כֵלָי/ו֙ עֲלֵ֣ה אַחֲרַ֔/י כִּֽי נְתָנָ֥/ם יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַ֥ד יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'nv 'nshy hmtsbh 't yvntn v't nsh' khlyv vy'mrv 'lv 'lynv vnvdy'h 'tkhm dbr vy'mr yvntn 'l nsh' khlyv 'lh 'chry khy ntnm yhvh byd yshr'l
verses.translation: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל יוֹנָתָ֗ן עַל יָדָי/ו֙ וְ/עַל רַגְלָ֔י/ו וְ/נֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלָ֖י/ו אַחֲרָ֑י/ו וַֽ/יִּפְּלוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יוֹנָתָ֔ן וְ/נֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלָ֖י/ו מְמוֹתֵ֥ת אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'l yvntn 'l ydyv v'l rglyv vnsh' khlyv 'chryv vyplv lpny yvntn vnsh' khlyv mmvtt 'chryv
verses.translation: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֞י הַ/מַּכָּ֣ה הָ/רִאשֹׁנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֧ה יוֹנָתָ֛ן וְ/נֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלָ֖י/ו כְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אִ֑ישׁ כְּ/בַ/חֲצִ֥י מַעֲנָ֖ה צֶ֥מֶד שָׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vthy hmkhh hr'shnh 'shr hkhh yvntn vnsh' khlyv kh'shrym 'ysh khbchtsy m'nh tsmd shdh
verses.translation: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow .

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִי֩ חֲרָדָ֨ה בַ/מַּחֲנֶ֤ה בַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ וּ/בְ/כָל הָ/עָ֔ם הַ/מַּצָּב֙ וְ/הַ/מַּשְׁחִ֔ית חָרְד֖וּ גַּם הֵ֑מָּה וַ/תִּרְגַּ֣ז הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/תְּהִ֖י לְ/חֶרְדַּ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vthy chrdh bmchnh bshdh vbkhl h'm hmtsb vhmshchyt chrdv gm hmh vtrgz h'rts vthy lchrdt 'lhym
verses.translation: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֤וּ הַ/צֹּפִים֙ לְ/שָׁא֔וּל בְּ/גִבְעַ֖ת בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה הֶ/הָמ֛וֹן נָמ֖וֹג וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ וַ/הֲלֹֽם
verses.translit: vyr'v htspym lsh'vl bgb't bnymn vhnh hhmvn nmvg vylkh vhlm
verses.translation: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֗וּל לָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ פִּקְדוּ נָ֣א וּ/רְא֔וּ מִ֖י הָלַ֣ךְ מֵ/עִמָּ֑/נוּ וַֽ/יִּפְקְד֔וּ וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה אֵ֥ין יוֹנָתָ֖ן וְ/נֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl l'm 'shr 'tv pqdv n' vr'v my hlkh m'mnv vypqdv vhnh 'yn yvntn vnsh' khlyv
verses.translation: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שָׁאוּל֙ לַֽ/אֲחִיָּ֔ה הַגִּ֖ישָׁ/ה אֲר֣וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּֽי הָיָ֞ה אֲר֧וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא וּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl l'chyh hgyshh 'rvn h'lhym khy hyh 'rvn h'lhym byvm hhv' vbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י עַ֣ד דִּבֶּ֤ר שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הֶ/הָמ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ הָל֖וֹךְ וָ/רָ֑ב וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר שָׁא֛וּל אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן אֱסֹ֥ף יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyhy 'd dbr sh'vl 'l hkhhn vhhmvn 'shr bmchnh plshtym vylkh hlvkh vrb vy'mr sh'vl 'l hkhhn 'sf ydkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזָּעֵ֣ק שָׁא֗וּל וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה הָיְתָ֜ה חֶ֤רֶב אִישׁ֙ בְּ/רֵעֵ֔/הוּ מְהוּמָ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyz'q sh'vl vkhl h'm 'shr 'tv vyb'v 'd hmlchmh vhnh hyth chrb 'ysh br'hv mhvmh gdvlh m'd
verses.translation: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man’s sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עִבְרִ֗ים הָי֤וּ לַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ כְּ/אֶתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשׁ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָל֥וּ עִמָּ֛/ם בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה סָבִ֑יב וְ/גַם הֵ֗מָּה לִֽ/הְיוֹת֙ עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם שָׁא֖וּל וְ/יוֹנָתָֽן
verses.translit: vh'brym hyv lplshtym kh'tmvl shlshvm 'shr 'lv 'mm bmchnh sbyb vgm hmh lhyvt 'm yshr'l 'shr 'm sh'vl vyvntn
verses.translation: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֩ אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַ/מִּֽתְחַבְּאִ֤ים בְּ/הַר אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּֽי נָ֖סוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַֽ/יַּדְבְּק֥וּ גַם הֵ֛מָּה אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֖ם בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl 'ysh yshr'l hmtchb'ym bhr 'prym shm'v khy nsv plshtym vydbqv gm hmh 'chryhm bmlchmh
verses.translation: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֧וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֛ה בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הַ֨/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָבְרָ֖ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: vyvsh' yhvh byvm hhv' 't yshr'l vhmlchmh 'brh 't byt 'vn
verses.translation: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Beth-aven.

verses.original: וְ/אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל נִגַּ֖שׂ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יֹּאֶל֩ שָׁא֨וּל אֶת הָ/עָ֜ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אָר֣וּר הָ֠/אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יֹ֨אכַל לֶ֜חֶם עַד הָ/עֶ֗רֶב וְ/נִקַּמְתִּי֙ מֵ/אֹ֣יְבַ֔/י וְ/לֹֽא טָעַ֥ם כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: v'ysh yshr'l ngsh byvm hhv' vy'l sh'vl 't h'm l'mr 'rvr h'ysh 'shr y'khl lchm 'd h'rb vnqmty m'yby vl' t'm khl h'm lchm
verses.translation: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּ֣אוּ בַ/יָּ֑עַר וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַ֖שׁ עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vkhl h'rts b'v by'r vyhy dbsh 'l pny hshdh
verses.translation: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א הָ/עָם֙ אֶל הַ/יַּ֔עַר וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה הֵ֣לֶךְ דְּבָ֑שׁ וְ/אֵין מַשִּׂ֤יג יָד/וֹ֙ אֶל פִּ֔י/ו כִּֽי יָרֵ֥א הָ/עָ֖ם אֶת הַ/שְּׁבֻעָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' h'm 'l hy'r vhnh hlkh dbsh v'yn mshyg ydv 'l pyv khy yr' h'm 't hshb'h
verses.translation: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹנָתָ֣ן לֹֽא שָׁמַ֗ע בְּ/הַשְׁבִּ֣יעַ אָבִי/ו֮ אֶת הָ/עָם֒ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶת קְצֵ֤ה הַ/מַּטֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וַ/יִּטְבֹּ֥ל אוֹתָ֖/הּ בְּ/יַעְרַ֣ת הַ/דְּבָ֑שׁ וַ/יָּ֤שֶׁב יָד/וֹ֙ אֶל פִּ֔י/ו ו/תראנה וַ/תָּאֹ֖רְנָה עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyvntn l' shm' bhshby' 'byv 't h'm vyshlch 't qtsh hmth 'shr bydv vytbl 'vth by'rt hdbsh vyshb ydv 'l pyv vtr'nh vt'rnh 'ynyv
verses.translation: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַן֩ אִ֨ישׁ מֵֽ/הָ/עָ֜ם וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הַשְׁבֵּעַ֩ הִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ אָבִ֤י/ךָ אֶת הָ/עָם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אָר֥וּר הָ/אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יֹ֥אכַל לֶ֖חֶם הַ/יּ֑וֹם וַ/יָּ֖עַף הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'n 'ysh mh'm vy'mr hshb' hshby' 'bykh 't h'm l'mr 'rvr h'ysh 'shr y'khl lchm hyvm vy'f h'm
verses.translation: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יֽוֹנָתָ֔ן עָכַ֥ר אָבִ֖/י אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ רְאוּ נָא֙ כִּֽי אֹ֣רוּ עֵינַ֔/י כִּ֣י טָעַ֔מְתִּי מְעַ֖ט דְּבַ֥שׁ הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yvntn 'khr 'by 't h'rts r'v n' khy 'rv 'yny khy t'mty m't dbsh hzh
verses.translation: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.

verses.original: אַ֗ף כִּ֡י לוּא֩ אָכֹ֨ל אָכַ֤ל הַ/יּוֹם֙ הָ/עָ֔ם מִ/שְּׁלַ֥ל אֹיְבָ֖י/ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָצָ֑א כִּ֥י עַתָּ֛ה לֹֽא רָבְתָ֥ה מַכָּ֖ה בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: 'f khy lv' 'khl 'khl hyvm h'm mshll 'ybyv 'shr mts' khy 'th l' rbth mkhh bplshtym
verses.translation: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּ֞וּ בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִ/מִּכְמָ֖שׂ אַיָּלֹ֑נָ/ה וַ/יָּ֥עַף הָ/עָ֖ם מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vykhv byvm hhv' bplshtym mmkhmsh 'ylnh vy'f h'm m'd
verses.translation: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.

verses.original: ו/יעש וַ/יַּ֤עַט הָ/עָם֙ אֶל שלל הַ/שָּׁלָ֔ל וַ/יִּקְח֨וּ צֹ֧אן וּ/בָקָ֛ר וּ/בְנֵ֥י בָקָ֖ר וַ/יִּשְׁחֲטוּ אָ֑רְצָ/ה וַ/יֹּ֥אכַל הָ/עָ֖ם עַל הַ/דָּֽם
verses.translit: vy'sh vy't h'm 'l shll hshll vyqchv ts'n vbqr vbny bqr vyshchtv 'rtsh vy'khl h'm 'l hdm
verses.translation: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground: and the people did eat them with the blood.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֤ידוּ לְ/שָׁאוּל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֥ה הָ/עָ֛ם חֹטִ֥אים לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל עַל הַ/דָּ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר בְּגַדְתֶּ֔ם גֹּֽלּוּ אֵלַ֥/י הַ/יּ֖וֹם אֶ֥בֶן גְּדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vygydv lsh'vl l'mr hnh h'm cht'ym lyhvh l'khl 'l hdm vy'mr bgdtm glv 'ly hyvm 'bn gdvlh
verses.translation: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD , in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֣וּל פֻּ֣צוּ בָ/עָ֡ם וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֣ם לָ/הֶ֡ם הַגִּ֣ישׁוּ אֵלַ/י֩ אִ֨ישׁ שׁוֹר֜/וֹ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ שְׂיֵ֗/הוּ וּ/שְׁחַטְתֶּ֤ם בָּ/זֶה֙ וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא תֶחֶטְא֥וּ לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל אֶל הַ/דָּ֑ם וַ/יַּגִּ֨שׁוּ כָל הָ/עָ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ שׁוֹר֧/וֹ בְ/יָד֛/וֹ הַ/לַּ֖יְלָה וַ/יִּשְׁחֲטוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl ptsv b'm v'mrtm lhm hgyshv 'ly 'ysh shvrv v'ysh shyhv vshchttm bzh v'khltm vl' tcht'v lyhvh l'khl 'l hdm vygshv khl h'm 'ysh shvrv bydv hlylh vyshchtv shm
verses.translation: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew them there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֧בֶן שָׁא֛וּל מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה אֹת֣/וֹ הֵחֵ֔ל לִ/בְנ֥וֹת מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vybn sh'vl mzbch lyhvh 'tv hchl lbnvt mzbch lyhvh
verses.translation: And Saul built an altar unto the LORD : the same was the first altar that he built unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֡וּל נֵרְדָ֣ה אַחֲרֵי֩ פְלִשְׁתִּ֨ים לַ֜יְלָה וְֽ/נָבֹ֥זָה בָ/הֶ֣ם עַד א֣וֹר הַ/בֹּ֗קֶר וְ/לֹֽא נַשְׁאֵ֤ר בָּ/הֶם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כָּל הַ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ עֲשֵׂ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן נִקְרְבָ֥ה הֲלֹ֖ם אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl nrdh 'chry plshtym lylh vnbzh bhm 'd 'vr hbqr vl' nsh'r bhm 'ysh vy'mrv khl htvb b'ynykh 'shh vy'mr hkhhn nqrbh hlm 'l h'lhym
verses.translation: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֤ל שָׁאוּל֙ בֵּֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים הַֽ/אֵרֵד֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הֲ/תִתְּנֵ֖/ם בְּ/יַ֣ד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֥א עָנָ֖/הוּ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vysh'l sh'vl b'lhym h'rd 'chry plshtym httnm byd yshr'l vl' 'nhv byvm hhv'
verses.translation: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל גֹּ֣שֽׁוּ הֲלֹ֔ם כֹּ֖ל פִּנּ֣וֹת הָ/עָ֑ם וּ/דְע֣וּ וּ/רְא֔וּ בַּ/מָּ֗ה הָֽיְתָ֛ה הַ/חַטָּ֥את הַ/זֹּ֖את הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl gshv hlm khl pnvt h'm vd'v vr'v bmh hyth hcht't hz't hyvm
verses.translation: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.

verses.original: כִּ֣י חַי יְהוָ֗ה הַ/מּוֹשִׁ֨יעַ֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֧י אִם יֶשְׁנ֛/וֹ בְּ/יוֹנָתָ֥ן בְּנִ֖/י כִּ֣י מ֣וֹת יָמ֑וּת וְ/אֵ֥ין עֹנֵ֖/הוּ מִ/כָּל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: khy chy yhvh hmvshy' 't yshr'l khy 'm yshnv byvntn bny khy mvt ymvt v'yn 'nhv mkhl h'm
verses.translation: For, as the LORD liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people that answered him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַתֶּם֙ תִּֽהְיוּ֙ לְ/עֵ֣בֶר אֶחָ֔ד וַֽ/אֲנִי֙ וְ/יוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנִ֔/י נִהְיֶ֖ה לְ/עֵ֣בֶר אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ הָ/עָם֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל הַ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ עֲשֵֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l khl yshr'l 'tm thyv l'br 'chd v'ny vyvntn bny nhyh l'br 'chd vy'mrv h'm 'l sh'vl htvb b'ynykh 'shh
verses.translation: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֗וּל אֶל יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָ֣בָ/ה תָמִ֑ים וַ/יִּלָּכֵ֧ד יוֹנָתָ֛ן וְ/שָׁא֖וּל וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם יָצָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hbh tmym vylkhd yvntn vsh'vl vh'm yts'v
verses.translation: Therefore Saul said unto the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect lot . And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל הַפִּ֕ילוּ בֵּינִ֕/י וּ/בֵ֖ין יוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנִ֑/י וַ/יִּלָּכֵ֖ד יוֹנָתָֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl hpylv byny vbyn yvntn bny vylkhd yvntn
verses.translation: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל י֣וֹנָתָ֔ן הַגִּ֥ידָ/ה לִּ֖/י מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָה וַ/יַּגֶּד ל֣/וֹ יוֹנָתָ֗ן וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ טָעֹ֨ם טָעַ֜מְתִּי בִּ/קְצֵ֨ה הַ/מַּטֶּ֧ה אֲשֶׁר בְּ/יָדִ֛/י מְעַ֥ט דְּבַ֖שׁ הִנְ/נִ֥י אָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l yvntn hgydh ly mh 'shyth vygd lv yvntn vy'mr t'm t'mty bqtsh hmth 'shr bydy m't dbsh hnny 'mvt
verses.translation: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and , lo, I must die.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל כֹּֽה יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/כֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֑ף כִּֽי מ֥וֹת תָּמ֖וּת יוֹנָתָֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl khh y'shh 'lhym vkhh yvsf khy mvt tmvt yvntn
verses.translation: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הָ/עָ֜ם אֶל שָׁא֗וּל הֲֽ/יוֹנָתָ֤ן יָמוּת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָ֠שָׂה הַ/יְשׁוּעָ֨ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֣ה הַ/זֹּאת֮ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ חָלִ֗ילָ/ה חַי יְהוָה֙ אִם יִפֹּ֞ל מִ/שַּׂעֲרַ֤ת רֹאשׁ/וֹ֙ אַ֔רְצָ/ה כִּֽי עִם אֱלֹהִ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ה הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יִּפְדּ֥וּ הָ/עָ֛ם אֶת יוֹנָתָ֖ן וְ/לֹא מֵֽת
verses.translit: vy'mr h'm 'l sh'vl hyvntn ymvt 'shr 'shh hyshv'h hgdvlh hz't byshr'l chlylh chy yhvh 'm ypl msh'rt r'shv 'rtsh khy 'm 'lhym 'shh hyvm hzh vypdv h'm 't yvntn vl' mt
verses.translation: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל שָׁא֔וּל מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֖י פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים הָלְכ֥וּ לִ/מְקוֹמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'l sh'vl m'chry plshtym vplshtym hlkhv lmqvmm
verses.translation: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁא֛וּל לָכַ֥ד הַ/מְּלוּכָ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּלָּ֣חֶם סָבִ֣יב בְּֽ/כָל אֹיְבָ֡י/ו בְּ/מוֹאָ֣ב וּ/בִ/בְנֵי עַמּ֨וֹן וּ/בֶ/אֱד֜וֹם וּ/בְ/מַלְכֵ֤י צוֹבָה֙ וּ/בַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּ/בְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יִפְנֶ֖ה יַרְשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: vsh'vl lkhd hmlvkhh 'l yshr'l vylchm sbyb bkhl 'ybyv bmv'b vbbny 'mvn vb'dvm vbmlkhy tsvbh vbplshtym vbkhl 'shr ypnh yrshy'
verses.translation: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ חַ֔יִל וַ/יַּ֖ךְ אֶת עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַ/יַּצֵּ֥ל אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/יַּ֥ד שֹׁסֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'sh chyl vykh 't 'mlq vytsl 't yshr'l myd shshv
verses.translation: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל יוֹנָתָ֥ן וְ/יִשְׁוִ֖י וּ/מַלְכִּי שׁ֑וּעַ וְ/שֵׁם֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י בְנֹתָ֔י/ו שֵׁ֤ם הַ/בְּכִירָה֙ מֵרַ֔ב וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/קְּטַנָּ֖ה מִיכַֽל
verses.translit: vyhyv bny sh'vl yvntn vyshvy vmlkhy shv' vshm shty bntyv shm hbkhyrh mrb vshm hqtnh mykhl
