verses.translation: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchi-shua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁם֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת שָׁא֔וּל אֲחִינֹ֖עַם בַּת אֲחִימָ֑עַץ וְ/שֵׁ֤ם שַׂר צְבָא/וֹ֙ אֲבִינֵ֔ר בֶּן נֵ֖ר דּ֥וֹד שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vshm 'sht sh'vl 'chyn'm bt 'chym'ts vshm shr tsb'v 'bynr bn nr dvd sh'vl
verses.translation: And the name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

verses.original: וְ/קִ֧ישׁ אֲבִֽי שָׁא֛וּל וְ/נֵ֥ר אֲבִֽי אַבְנֵ֖ר בֶּן אֲבִיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vqysh 'by sh'vl vnr 'by 'bnr bn 'by'l
verses.translation: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֤י הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ חֲזָקָ֣ה עַל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וְ/רָאָ֨ה שָׁא֜וּל כָּל אִ֤ישׁ גִּבּוֹר֙ וְ/כָל בֶּן חַ֔יִל וַ/יַּאַסְפֵ֖/הוּ אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vthy hmlchmh chzqh 'l plshtym khl ymy sh'vl vr'h sh'vl khl 'ysh gbvr vkhl bn chyl vy'sphv 'lyv
verses.translation: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל אֹתִ֨/י שָׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ לִ/מְשָׁחֳ/ךָ֣ לְ/מֶ֔לֶךְ עַל עַמּ֖/וֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/עַתָּ֣ה שְׁמַ֔ע לְ/ק֖וֹל דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l sh'vl 'ty shlch yhvh lmshchkh lmlkh 'l 'mv 'l yshr'l v'th shm' lqvl dbry yhvh
verses.translation: Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת פָּקַ֕דְתִּי אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה עֲמָלֵ֖ק לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֥ם ל/וֹ֙ בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ בַּ/עֲלֹת֖/וֹ מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt pqdty 't 'shr 'shh 'mlq lyshr'l 'shr shm lv bdrkh b'ltv mmtsrym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

verses.original: עַתָּה֩ לֵ֨ךְ וְ/הִכִּֽיתָ֜ה אֶת עֲמָלֵ֗ק וְ/הַֽחֲרַמְתֶּם֙ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ל עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/הֵמַתָּ֞ה מֵ/אִ֣ישׁ עַד אִשָּׁ֗ה מֵֽ/עֹלֵל֙ וְ/עַד יוֹנֵ֔ק מִ/שּׁ֣וֹר וְ/עַד שֶׂ֔ה מִ/גָּמָ֖ל וְ/עַד חֲמֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'th lkh vhkhyth 't 'mlq vhchrmtm 't khl 'shr lv vl' tchml 'lyv vhmth m'ysh 'd 'shh m'll v'd yvnq mshvr v'd shh mgml v'd chmvr
verses.translation: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁמַּ֤ע שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וַֽ/יִּפְקְדֵ/ם֙ בַּ/טְּלָאִ֔ים מָאתַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף רַגְלִ֑י וַ/עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים אֶת אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' sh'vl 't h'm vypqdm btl'ym m'tym 'lf rgly v'shrt 'lpym 't 'ysh yhvdh
verses.translation: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א שָׁא֖וּל עַד עִ֣יר עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַ/יָּ֖רֶב בַּ/נָּֽחַל
verses.translit: vyb' sh'vl 'd 'yr 'mlq vyrb bnchl
verses.translation: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֣וּל אֶֽל הַ/קֵּינִ֡י לְכוּ֩ סֻּ֨רוּ רְד֜וּ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ עֲמָלֵקִ֗י פֶּן אֹֽסִפְ/ךָ֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וְ/אַתָּ֞ה עָשִׂ֤יתָה חֶ֨סֶד֙ עִם כָּל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּ/עֲלוֹתָ֖/ם מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יָּ֥סַר קֵינִ֖י מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ עֲמָלֵֽק
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l hqyny lkhv srv rdv mtvkh 'mlqy pn 'spkh 'mv v'th 'shyth chsd 'm khl bny yshr'l b'lvtm mmtsrym vysr qyny mtvkh 'mlq
verses.translation: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥ךְ שָׁא֖וּל אֶת עֲמָלֵ֑ק מֵֽ/חֲוִילָה֙ בּוֹאֲ/ךָ֣ שׁ֔וּר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vykh sh'vl 't 'mlq mchvylh bv'kh shvr 'shr 'l pny mtsrym
verses.translation: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur, that is over against Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפֹּ֛שׂ אֶת אֲגַ֥ג מֶֽלֶךְ עֲמָלֵ֖ק חָ֑י וְ/אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם הֶחֱרִ֥ים לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vytpsh 't 'gg mlkh 'mlq chy v't khl h'm hchrym lpy chrb
verses.translation: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחְמֹל֩ שָׁא֨וּל וְ/הָ/עָ֜ם עַל אֲגָ֗ג וְ/עַל מֵיטַ֣ב הַ/צֹּאן֩ וְ/הַ/בָּקָ֨ר וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁנִ֤ים וְ/עַל הַ/כָּרִים֙ וְ/עַל כָּל הַ/טּ֔וֹב וְ/לֹ֥א אָב֖וּ הַחֲרִימָ֑/ם וְ/כָל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֛ה נְמִבְזָ֥ה וְ/נָמֵ֖ס אֹתָ֥/הּ הֶחֱרִֽימוּ
verses.translit: vychml sh'vl vh'm 'l 'gg v'l mytb hts'n vhbqr vhmshnym v'l hkhrym v'l khl htvb vl' 'bv hchrymm vkhl hml'khh nmbzh vnms 'th hchrymv
verses.translation: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l shmv'l l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,

verses.original: נִחַ֗מְתִּי כִּֽי הִמְלַ֤כְתִּי אֶת שָׁאוּל֙ לְ/מֶ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי שָׁב֙ מֵ/אַֽחֲרַ֔/י וְ/אֶת דְּבָרַ֖/י לֹ֣א הֵקִ֑ים וַ/יִּ֨חַר֙ לִ/שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּזְעַ֥ק אֶל יְהוָ֖ה כָּל הַ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: nchmty khy hmlkhty 't sh'vl lmlkh khy shb m'chry v't dbry l' hqym vychr lshmv'l vyz'q 'l yhvh khl hlylh
verses.translation: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֧ם שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל לִ/קְרַ֥את שָׁא֖וּל בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר וַ/יֻּגַּ֨ד לִ/שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל לֵ/אמֹ֗ר בָּֽא שָׁא֤וּל הַ/כַּרְמֶ֨לָ/ה֙ וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה מַצִּ֥יב ל/וֹ֙ יָ֔ד וַ/יִּסֹּב֙ וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֔ר וַ/יֵּ֖רֶד הַ/גִּלְגָּֽל
verses.translit: vyshkhm shmv'l lqr't sh'vl bbqr vygd lshmv'l l'mr b' sh'vl hkhrmlh vhnh mtsyb lv yd vysb vy'br vyrd hglgl
verses.translation: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣/וֹ שָׁא֗וּל בָּר֤וּךְ אַתָּה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה הֲקִימֹ֖תִי אֶת דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' shmv'l 'l sh'vl vy'mr lv sh'vl brvkh 'th lyhvh hqymty 't dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the LORD : I have performed the commandment of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וּ/מֶ֛ה קֽוֹל הַ/צֹּ֥אן הַ/זֶּ֖ה בְּ/אָזְנָ֑/י וְ/ק֣וֹל הַ/בָּקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁמֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l vmh qvl hts'n hzh b'zny vqvl hbqr 'shr 'nkhy shm'
verses.translation: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל מֵ/עֲמָלֵקִ֣י הֱבִיא֗וּ/ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָמַ֤ל הָ/עָם֙ עַל מֵיטַ֤ב הַ/צֹּאן֙ וְ/הַ/בָּקָ֔ר לְמַ֥עַן זְבֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/אֶת הַ/יּוֹתֵ֖ר הֶחֱרַֽמְנוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl m'mlqy hby'vm 'shr chml h'm 'l mytb hts'n vhbqr lm'n zbch lyhvh 'lhykh v't hyvtr hchrmnv
verses.translation: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל הֶ֚רֶף וְ/אַגִּ֣ידָה לְּ/ךָ֔ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖/י הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה ו/יאמרו וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖/וֹ דַּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l sh'vl hrf v'gydh lkh 't 'shr dbr yhvh 'ly hlylh vy'mrv vy'mr lv dbr
verses.translation: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל הֲ/ל֗וֹא אִם קָטֹ֤ן אַתָּה֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ רֹ֛אשׁ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אָ֑תָּה וַ/יִּמְשָׁחֲ/ךָ֧ יְהוָ֛ה לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l hlv' 'm qtn 'th b'ynykh r'sh shbty yshr'l 'th vymshchkh yhvh lmlkh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלָחֲ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/דָ֑רֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ וְ/הַחֲרַמְתָּ֞ה אֶת הַֽ/חַטָּאִים֙ אֶת עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְ/נִלְחַמְתָּ֣ ב֔/וֹ עַ֥ד כַּלּוֹתָ֖/ם אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshlchkh yhvh bdrkh vy'mr lkh vhchrmth 't hcht'ym 't 'mlq vnlchmt bv 'd khlvtm 'tm
verses.translation: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

verses.original: וְ/לָ֥/מָּה לֹא שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַ/תַּ֨עַט֙ אֶל הַ/שָּׁלָ֔ל וַ/תַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlmh l' shm't bqvl yhvh vt't 'l hshll vt'sh hr' b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD , but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD ?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל אֶל שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וָ/אֵלֵ֕ךְ בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי יְהוָ֑ה וָ/אָבִ֗יא אֶת אֲגַג֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְ/אֶת עֲמָלֵ֖ק הֶחֱרַֽמְתִּי
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l shmv'l 'shr shm'ty bqvl yhvh v'lkh bdrkh 'shr shlchny yhvh v'by' 't 'gg mlkh 'mlq v't 'mlq hchrmty
verses.translation: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD , and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח הָ/עָ֧ם מֵ/הַ/שָּׁלָ֛ל צֹ֥אן וּ/בָקָ֖ר רֵאשִׁ֣ית הַ/חֵ֑רֶם לִ/זְבֹּ֛חַ לַֽ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בַּ/גִּלְגָּֽל
verses.translit: vyqch h'm mhshll ts'n vbqr r'shyt hchrm lzbch lyhvh 'lhykh bglgl
verses.translation: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God in Gilgal.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל הַ/חֵ֤פֶץ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ בְּ/עֹל֣וֹת וּ/זְבָחִ֔ים כִּ/שְׁמֹ֖עַ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֤ה שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ מִ/זֶּ֣בַח ט֔וֹב לְ/הַקְשִׁ֖יב מֵ/חֵ֥לֶב אֵילִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l hchpts lyhvh b'lvt vzbchym khshm' bqvl yhvh hnh shm' mzbch tvb lhqshyb mchlb 'ylym
verses.translation: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD ? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

verses.original: כִּ֤י חַטַּאת קֶ֨סֶם֙ מֶ֔רִי וְ/אָ֥וֶן וּ/תְרָפִ֖ים הַפְצַ֑ר יַ֗עַן מָאַ֨סְתָּ֙ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּמְאָסְ/ךָ֖ מִ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: khy cht't qsm mry v'vn vtrpym hptsr y'n m'st 't dbr yhvh vym'skh mmlkh
verses.translation: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD , he hath also rejected thee from being king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֤וּל אֶל שְׁמוּאֵל֙ חָטָ֔אתִי כִּֽי עָבַ֥רְתִּי אֶת פִּֽי יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֶת דְּבָרֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֤י יָרֵ֨אתִי֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֖ע בְּ/קוֹלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l shmv'l cht'ty khy 'brty 't py yhvh v't dbrykh khy yr'ty 't h'm v'shm' bqvlm
verses.translation: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD , and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה שָׂ֥א נָ֖א אֶת חַטָּאתִ֑/י וְ/שׁ֣וּב עִמִּ֔/י וְ/אֶֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th sh' n' 't cht'ty vshvb 'my v'shtchvh lyhvh
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל לֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עִמָּ֑/ךְ כִּ֤י מָאַ֨סְתָּה֙ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּמְאָסְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/הְי֥וֹת מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l sh'vl l' 'shvb 'mkh khy m'sth 't dbr yhvh vym'skh yhvh mhyvt mlkh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD , and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסֹּ֥ב שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל לָ/לֶ֑כֶת וַ/יַּחֲזֵ֥ק בִּ/כְנַף מְעִיל֖/וֹ וַ/יִּקָּרַֽע
verses.translit: vysb shmv'l llkht vychzq bkhnf m'ylv vyqr'
verses.translation: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל קָרַ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽת מַמְלְכ֧וּת יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵ/עָלֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/יּ֑וֹם וּ/נְתָנָ֕/הּ לְ/רֵעֲ/ךָ֖ הַ/טּ֥וֹב מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv shmv'l qr' yhvh 't mmlkhvt yshr'l m'lykh hyvm vntnh lr'kh htvb mmkh
verses.translation: And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.

verses.original: וְ/גַם֙ נֵ֣צַח יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יְשַׁקֵּ֖ר וְ/לֹ֣א יִנָּחֵ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֥א אָדָ֛ם ה֖וּא לְ/הִנָּחֵֽם
verses.translit: vgm ntsch yshr'l l' yshqr vl' ynchm khy l' 'dm hv' lhnchm
verses.translation: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חָטָ֔אתִי עַתָּ֗ה כַּבְּדֵ֥/נִי נָ֛א נֶ֥גֶד זִקְנֵֽי עַמִּ֖/י וְ/נֶ֣גֶד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/שׁ֣וּב עִמִּ֔/י וְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֵ֖יתִי לַֽ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr cht'ty 'th khbdny n' ngd zqny 'my vngd yshr'l vshvb 'my vhshtchvyty lyhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שָׁב שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ שָׁא֖וּל לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshb shmv'l 'chry sh'vl vyshtchv sh'vl lyhvh
verses.translation: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל הַגִּ֤ישׁוּ אֵלַ/י֙ אֶת אֲגַג֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ אֵלָ֔י/ו אֲגַ֖ג מַעֲדַנֹּ֑ת וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲגָ֔ג אָכֵ֖ן סָ֥ר מַר הַ/מָּֽוֶת
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l hgyshv 'ly 't 'gg mlkh 'mlq vylkh 'lyv 'gg m'dnt vy'mr 'gg 'khn sr mr hmvt
verses.translation: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁכְּלָ֤ה נָשִׁים֙ חַרְבֶּ֔/ךָ כֵּן תִּשְׁכַּ֥ל מִ/נָּשִׁ֖ים אִמֶּ֑/ךָ וַ/יְשַׁסֵּ֨ף שְׁמוּאֵ֧ל אֶת אֲגָ֛ג לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/גִּלְגָּֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l kh'shr shkhlh nshym chrbkh khn tshkhl mnshym 'mkh vyshsf shmv'l 't 'gg lpny yhvh bglgl
verses.translation: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הָ/רָמָ֑תָ/ה וְ/שָׁא֛וּל עָלָ֥ה אֶל בֵּית֖/וֹ גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vylkh shmv'l hrmth vsh'vl 'lh 'l bytv gb't sh'vl
verses.translation: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יָסַ֨ף שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל לִ/רְא֤וֹת אֶת שָׁאוּל֙ עַד י֣וֹם מוֹת֔/וֹ כִּֽי הִתְאַבֵּ֥ל שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יהוָ֣ה נִחָ֔ם כִּֽי הִמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת שָׁא֖וּל עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' ysf shmv'l lr'vt 't sh'vl 'd yvm mvtv khy ht'bl shmv'l 'l sh'vl vyhvh nchm khy hmlykh 't sh'vl 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל עַד מָתַי֙ אַתָּה֙ מִתְאַבֵּ֣ל אֶל שָׁא֔וּל וַ/אֲנִ֣י מְאַסְתִּ֔י/ו מִ/מְּלֹ֖ךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מַלֵּ֨א קַרְנְ/ךָ֜ שֶׁ֗מֶן וְ/לֵ֤ךְ אֶֽשְׁלָחֲ/ךָ֙ אֶל יִשַׁ֣י בֵּֽית הַלַּחְמִ֔י כִּֽי רָאִ֧יתִי בְּ/בָנָ֛י/ו לִ֖/י מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l shmv'l 'd mty 'th mt'bl 'l sh'vl v'ny m'styv mmlkh 'l yshr'l ml' qrnkh shmn vlkh 'shlchkh 'l yshy byt hlchmy khy r'yty bbnyv ly mlkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Beth-lehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֵ֣יךְ אֵלֵ֔ךְ וְ/שָׁמַ֥ע שָׁא֖וּל וַ/הֲרָגָ֑/נִי וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה עֶגְלַ֤ת בָּקָר֙ תִּקַּ֣ח בְּ/יָדֶ֔/ךָ וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ לִ/זְבֹּ֥חַ לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה בָּֽאתִי
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'ykh 'lkh vshm' sh'vl vhrgny vy'mr yhvh 'glt bqr tqch bydkh v'mrt lzbch lyhvh b'ty
verses.translation: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it , he will kill me. And the LORD said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/קָרָ֥אתָ לְ/יִשַׁ֖י בַּ/זָּ֑בַח וְ/אָֽנֹכִ֗י אוֹדִֽיעֲ/ךָ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶֽׁר תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וּ/מָשַׁחְתָּ֣ לִ֔/י אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר אֹמַ֖ר אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vqr't lyshy bzbch v'nkhy 'vdy'kh 't 'shr t'shh vmshcht ly 't 'shr 'mr 'lykh
verses.translation: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֣ית לָ֑חֶם וַ/יֶּחֶרְד֞וּ זִקְנֵ֤י הָ/עִיר֙ לִ/קְרָאת֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֹ֥ם בּוֹאֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'sh shmv'l 't 'shr dbr yhvh vyb' byt lchm vychrdv zqny h'yr lqr'tv vy'mr shlm bv'kh
verses.translation: And Samuel did that which the LORD spake, and came to Beth-lehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁל֗וֹם לִ/זְבֹּ֤חַ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ בָּ֔אתִי הִֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וּ/בָאתֶ֥ם אִתִּ֖/י בַּ/זָּ֑בַח וַ/יְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֶת יִשַׁי֙ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א לָ/הֶ֖ם לַ/זָּֽבַח
verses.translit: vy'mr shlvm lzbch lyhvh b'ty htqdshv vb'tm 'ty bzbch vyqdsh 't yshy v't bnyv vyqr' lhm lzbch
verses.translation: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the LORD : sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בְּ/בוֹאָ֔/ם וַ/יַּ֖רְא אֶת אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אַ֛ךְ נֶ֥גֶד יְהוָ֖ה מְשִׁיחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy bbv'm vyr' 't 'ly'b vy'mr 'kh ngd yhvh mshychv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD’s anointed is before him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אַל תַּבֵּ֧ט אֶל מַרְאֵ֛/הוּ וְ/אֶל גְּבֹ֥הַּ קוֹמָת֖/וֹ כִּ֣י מְאַסְתִּ֑י/הוּ כִּ֣י לֹ֗א אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִרְאֶה֙ הָ/אָדָ֔ם כִּ֤י הָֽ/אָדָם֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה לַ/עֵינַ֔יִם וַ/יהוָ֖ה יִרְאֶ֥ה לַ/לֵּבָֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l shmv'l 'l tbt 'l mr'hv v'l gbh qvmtv khy m'styhv khy l' 'shr yr'h h'dm khy h'dm yr'h l'ynym vyhvh yr'h llbb
verses.translation: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א יִשַׁי֙ אֶל אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב וַ/יַּעֲבִרֵ֖/הוּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם בָּ/זֶ֖ה לֹֽא בָחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' yshy 'l 'byndb vy'brhv lpny shmv'l vy'mr gm bzh l' bchr yhvh
verses.translation: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֵ֥ר יִשַׁ֖י שַׁמָּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם בָּ/זֶ֖ה לֹא בָחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'br yshy shmh vy'mr gm bzh l' bchr yhvh
verses.translation: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֵ֥ר יִשַׁ֛י שִׁבְעַ֥ת בָּנָ֖י/ו לִ/פְנֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל יִשַׁ֔י לֹא בָחַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בָּ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vy'br yshy shb't bnyv lpny shmv'l vy'mr shmv'l 'l yshy l' bchr yhvh b'lh
verses.translation: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The LORD hath not chosen these.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל אֶל יִשַׁי֮ הֲ/תַ֣מּוּ הַ/נְּעָרִים֒ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר ע֚וֹד שָׁאַ֣ר הַ/קָּטָ֔ן וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה רֹעֶ֖ה בַּ/צֹּ֑אן וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל יִשַׁי֙ שִׁלְחָ֣/ה וְ/קָחֶ֔/נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא נָסֹ֖ב עַד בֹּא֥/וֹ פֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l yshy htmv hn'rym vy'mr 'vd sh'r hqtn vhnh r'h bts'n vy'mr shmv'l 'l yshy shlchh vqchnv khy l' nsb 'd b'v ph
verses.translation: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח וַ/יְבִיאֵ֨/הוּ֙ וְ/ה֣וּא אַדְמוֹנִ֔י עִם יְפֵ֥ה עֵינַ֖יִם וְ/ט֣וֹב רֹ֑אִי וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה ק֥וּם מְשָׁחֵ֖/הוּ כִּֽי זֶ֥ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyshlch vyby'hv vhv' 'dmvny 'm yph 'ynym vtvb r'y vy'mr yhvh qvm mshchhv khy zh hv'
verses.translation: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶת קֶ֣רֶן הַ/שֶּׁ֗מֶן וַ/יִּמְשַׁ֣ח אֹת/וֹ֮ בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב אֶחָי/ו֒ וַ/תִּצְלַ֤ח רֽוּחַ יְהוָה֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד מֵ/הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וַ/יָּ֣קָם שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ הָ/רָמָֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: vyqch shmv'l 't qrn hshmn vymshch 'tv bqrb 'chyv vttslch rvch yhvh 'l dvd mhyvm hhv' vm'lh vyqm shmv'l vylkh hrmth
verses.translation: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

verses.original: וְ/ר֧וּחַ יְהוָ֛ה סָ֖רָה מֵ/עִ֣ם שָׁא֑וּל וּ/בִֽעֲתַ֥תּ/וּ רֽוּחַ רָעָ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vrvch yhvh srh m'm sh'vl vb'ttv rvch r'h m't yhvh
verses.translation: But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ עַבְדֵֽי שָׁא֖וּל אֵלָ֑י/ו הִנֵּה נָ֧א רֽוּחַ אֱלֹהִ֛ים רָעָ֖ה מְבַעִתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'bdy sh'vl 'lyv hnh n' rvch 'lhym r'h mb'tkh
verses.translation: And Saul’s servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.

verses.original: יֹאמַר נָ֤א אֲדֹנֵ֨/נוּ֙ עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ יְבַקְשׁ֕וּ אִ֕ישׁ יֹדֵ֖עַ מְנַגֵּ֣ן בַּ/כִּנּ֑וֹר וְ/הָיָ֗ה בִּֽ/הְי֨וֹת עָלֶ֤י/ךָ רֽוּחַ אֱלֹהִים֙ רָעָ֔ה וְ/נִגֵּ֥ן בְּ/יָד֖/וֹ וְ/ט֥וֹב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: y'mr n' 'dnnv 'bdykh lpnykh ybqshv 'ysh yd' mngn bkhnvr vhyh bhyvt 'lykh rvch 'lhym r'h vngn bydv vtvb lkh
verses.translation: Let our lord now command thy servants, which are before thee, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר שָׁא֖וּל אֶל עֲבָדָ֑י/ו רְאוּ נָ֣א לִ֗/י אִ֚ישׁ מֵיטִ֣יב לְ/נַגֵּ֔ן וַ/הֲבִיאוֹתֶ֖ם אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l 'bdyv r'v n' ly 'ysh mytyb lngn vhby'vtm 'ly
verses.translation: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַן֩ אֶחָ֨ד מֵ/הַ/נְּעָרִ֜ים וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֨ה רָאִ֜יתִי בֵּ֣ן לְ/יִשַׁי֮ בֵּ֣ית הַלַּחְמִי֒ יֹדֵ֣עַ נַ֠גֵּן וְ/גִבּ֨וֹר חַ֜יִל וְ/אִ֧ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֛ה וּ/נְב֥וֹן דָּבָ֖ר וְ/אִ֣ישׁ תֹּ֑אַר וַ/יהוָ֖ה עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'n 'chd mhn'rym vy'mr hnh r'yty bn lyshy byt hlchmy yd' ngn vgbvr chyl v'ysh mlchmh vnbvn dbr v'ysh t'r vyhvh 'mv
verses.translation: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Beth-lehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the LORD is with him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח שָׁא֛וּל מַלְאָכִ֖ים אֶל יִשָׁ֑י וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁלְחָ֥/ה אֵלַ֛/י אֶת דָּוִ֥ד בִּנְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: vyshlch sh'vl ml'khym 'l yshy vy'mr shlchh 'ly 't dvd bnkh 'shr bts'n
verses.translation: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David thy son, which is with the sheep.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח יִשַׁ֜י חֲמ֥וֹר לֶ֨חֶם֙ וְ/נֹ֣אד יַ֔יִן וּ/גְדִ֥י עִזִּ֖ים אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֛ח בְּ/יַד דָּוִ֥ד בְּנ֖/וֹ אֶל שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vyqch yshy chmvr lchm vn'd yyn vgdy 'zym 'chd vyshlch byd dvd bnv 'l sh'vl
verses.translation: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א דָוִד֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֖ד לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יֶּאֱהָבֵ֣/הֽוּ מְאֹ֔ד וַֽ/יְהִי ל֖/וֹ נֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלִֽים
verses.translit: vyb' dvd 'l sh'vl vy'md lpnyv vy'hbhv m'd vyhy lv nsh' khlym
verses.translation: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח שָׁא֔וּל אֶל יִשַׁ֖י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יַעֲמָד נָ֤א דָוִד֙ לְ/פָנַ֔/י כִּֽי מָ֥צָא חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshlch sh'vl 'l yshy l'mr y'md n' dvd lpny khy mts' chn b'yny
verses.translation: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה בִּֽ/הְי֤וֹת רֽוּחַ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל וְ/לָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת הַ/כִּנּ֖וֹר וְ/נִגֵּ֣ן בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וְ/רָוַ֤ח לְ/שָׁאוּל֙ וְ/ט֣וֹב ל֔/וֹ וְ/סָ֥רָה מֵ/עָלָ֖י/ו ר֥וּחַ הָ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh bhyvt rvch 'lhym 'l sh'vl vlqch dvd 't hkhnvr vngn bydv vrvch lsh'vl vtvb lv vsrh m'lyv rvch hr'h
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּאַסְפ֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֤ים אֶת מַֽחֲנֵי/הֶם֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַ/יֵּאָ֣סְפ֔וּ שֹׂכֹ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ/יהוּדָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֛וּ בֵּין שׂוֹכֹ֥ה וּ/בֵין עֲזֵקָ֖ה בְּ/אֶ֥פֶס דַּמִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'spv plshtym 't mchnyhm lmlchmh vy'spv shkhh 'shr lyhvdh vychnv byn shvkhh vbyn 'zqh b'ps dmym
verses.translation: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁא֤וּל וְ/אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נֶאֶסְפ֔וּ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/עֵ֣מֶק הָאֵלָ֑ה וַ/יַּעַרְכ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה לִ/קְרַ֥את פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vsh'vl v'ysh yshr'l n'spv vychnv b'mq h'lh vy'rkhv mlchmh lqr't plshtym
verses.translation: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

verses.original: וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֞ים עֹמְדִ֤ים אֶל הָ/הָר֙ מִ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֹמְדִ֥ים אֶל הָ/הָ֖ר מִ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/הַ/גַּ֖יְא בֵּינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vplshtym 'mdym 'l hhr mzh vyshr'l 'mdym 'l hhr mzh vhgy' bynyhm
verses.translation: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א אִֽישׁ הַ/בֵּנַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מַּחֲנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים גָּלְיָ֥ת שְׁמ֖/וֹ מִ/גַּ֑ת גָּבְה֕/וֹ שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת וָ/זָֽרֶת
verses.translit: vyts' 'ysh hbnym mmchnvt plshtym glyt shmv mgt gbhv shsh 'mvt vzrt
verses.translation: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

verses.original: וְ/כ֤וֹבַע נְחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ עַל רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וְ/שִׁרְי֥וֹן קַשְׂקַשִּׂ֖ים ה֣וּא לָב֑וּשׁ וּ/מִשְׁקַל֙ הַ/שִּׁרְי֔וֹן חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִ֥ים שְׁקָלִ֖ים נְחֹֽשֶֽׁת
verses.translit: vkhvb' nchsht 'l r'shv vshryvn qshqshym hv' lbvsh vmshql hshryvn chmsht 'lpym shqlym nchsht
verses.translation: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.

verses.original: וּ/מִצְחַ֥ת נְחֹ֖שֶׁת עַל רַגְלָ֑י/ו וְ/כִיד֥וֹן נְחֹ֖שֶׁת בֵּ֥ין כְּתֵפָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmtscht nchsht 'l rglyv vkhydvn nchsht byn khtpyv
verses.translation: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.

verses.original: ו/חץ וְ/עֵ֣ץ חֲנִית֗/וֹ כִּ/מְנוֹר֙ אֹֽרְגִ֔ים וְ/לַהֶ֣בֶת חֲנִית֔/וֹ שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת שְׁקָלִ֖ים בַּרְזֶ֑ל וְ/נֹשֵׂ֥א הַ/צִּנָּ֖ה הֹלֵ֥ךְ לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vchts v'ts chnytv khmnvr 'rgym vlhbt chnytv shsh m'vt shqlym brzl vnsh' htsnh hlkh lpnyv
verses.translation: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֗ד וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ אֶל מַעַרְכֹ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֔ם לָ֥/מָּה תֵצְא֖וּ לַ/עֲרֹ֣ךְ מִלְחָמָ֑ה הֲ/ל֧וֹא אָנֹכִ֣י הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗י וְ/אַתֶּם֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְ/שָׁא֔וּל בְּרוּ לָ/כֶ֥ם אִ֖ישׁ וְ/יֵרֵ֥ד אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'md vyqr' 'l m'rkht yshr'l vy'mr lhm lmh tts'v l'rkh mlchmh hlv' 'nkhy hplshty v'tm 'bdym lsh'vl brv lkhm 'ysh vyrd 'ly
verses.translation: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.

verses.original: אִם יוּכַ֞ל לְ/הִלָּחֵ֤ם אִתִּ/י֙ וְ/הִכָּ֔/נִי וְ/הָיִ֥ינוּ לָ/כֶ֖ם לַ/עֲבָדִ֑ים וְ/אִם אֲנִ֤י אֽוּכַל ל/וֹ֙ וְ/הִכִּיתִ֔י/ו וִ/הְיִ֤יתֶם לָ֨/נוּ֙ לַ/עֲבָדִ֔ים וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם אֹתָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'm yvkhl lhlchm 'ty vhkhny vhyynv lkhm l'bdym v'm 'ny 'vkhl lv vhkhytyv vhyytm lnv l'bdym v'bdtm 'tnv
verses.translation: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י אֲנִ֗י חֵרַ֛פְתִּי אֶת מַעַרְכ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה תְּנוּ לִ֣/י אִ֔ישׁ וְ/נִֽלָּחֲמָ֖ה יָֽחַד
verses.translit: vy'mr hplshty 'ny chrpty 't m'rkhvt yshr'l hyvm hzh tnv ly 'ysh vnlchmh ychd
verses.translation: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע שָׁאוּל֙ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יֵּחַ֥תּוּ וַ/יִּֽרְא֖וּ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyshm' sh'vl vkhl yshr'l 't dbry hplshty h'lh vychtv vyr'v m'd
verses.translation: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִד֩ בֶּן אִ֨ישׁ אֶפְרָתִ֜י הַ/זֶּ֗ה מִ/בֵּ֥ית לֶ֨חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/שְׁמ֣/וֹ יִשַׁ֔י וְ/ל֖/וֹ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה בָנִ֑ים וְ/הָ/אִישׁ֙ בִּ/ימֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל זָקֵ֖ן בָּ֥א בַ/אֲנָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vdvd bn 'ysh 'prty hzh mbyt lchm yhvdh vshmv yshy vlv shmnh bnym vh'ysh bymy sh'vl zqn b' b'nshym
verses.translation: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת בְּנֵֽי יִשַׁי֙ הַ/גְּדֹלִ֔ים הָלְכ֥וּ אַחֲרֵי שָׁא֖וּל לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְ/שֵׁ֣ם שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָ֗י/ו אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלְכוּ֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֱלִיאָ֣ב הַ/בְּכ֗וֹר וּ/מִשְׁנֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֖י שַׁמָּֽה
verses.translit: vylkhv shlsht bny yshy hgdlym hlkhv 'chry sh'vl lmlchmh vshm shlsht bnyv 'shr hlkhv bmlchmh 'ly'b hbkhvr vmshnhv 'byndb vhshlshy shmh
verses.translation: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֖ד ה֣וּא הַ/קָּטָ֑ן וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ הַ/גְּדֹלִ֔ים הָלְכ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vdvd hv' hqtn vshlshh hgdlym hlkhv 'chry sh'vl
verses.translation: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֛ד הֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ/שָׁ֖ב מֵ/עַ֣ל שָׁא֑וּל לִ/רְע֛וֹת אֶת צֹ֥אן אָבִ֖י/ו בֵּֽית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vdvd hlkh vshb m'l sh'vl lr'vt 't ts'n 'byv byt lchm
verses.translation: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Beth-lehem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֥שׁ הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְ/הַעֲרֵ֑ב וַ/יִּתְיַצֵּ֖ב אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יֽוֹם
verses.translit: vygsh hplshty hshkhm vh'rb vytytsb 'rb'ym yvm
verses.translation: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יִשַׁ֜י לְ/דָוִ֣ד בְּנ֗/וֹ קַח נָ֤א לְ/אַחֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֵיפַ֤ת הַ/קָּלִיא֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה וַ/עֲשָׂרָ֥ה לֶ֖חֶם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/הָרֵ֥ץ הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה לְ/אַחֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yshy ldvd bnv qch n' l'chykh 'ypt hqly' hzh v'shrh lchm hzh vhrts hmchnh l'chykh
verses.translation: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn , and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren;

verses.original: וְ֠/אֵת עֲשֶׂ֜רֶת חֲרִצֵ֤י הֶֽ/חָלָב֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה תָּבִ֖יא לְ/שַׂר הָ/אָ֑לֶף וְ/אֶת אַחֶ֨י/ךָ֙ תִּפְקֹ֣ד לְ/שָׁל֔וֹם וְ/אֶת עֲרֻבָּתָ֖/ם תִּקָּֽח
verses.translit: v't 'shrt chrtsy hchlb h'lh tby' lshr h'lf v't 'chykh tpqd lshlvm v't 'rbtm tqch
verses.translation: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁא֤וּל וְ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ וְ/כָל אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/עֵ֖מֶק הָֽאֵלָ֑ה נִלְחָמִ֖ים עִם פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vsh'vl vhmh vkhl 'ysh yshr'l b'mq h'lh nlchmym 'm plshtym
verses.translation: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם דָּוִ֜ד בַּ/בֹּ֗קֶר וַ/יִּטֹּ֤שׁ אֶת הַ/צֹּאן֙ עַל שֹׁמֵ֔ר וַ/יִּשָּׂ֣א וַ/יֵּ֔לֶךְ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖/הוּ יִשָׁ֑י וַ/יָּבֹא֙ הַ/מַּעְגָּ֔לָ/ה וְ/הַ/חַ֗יִל הַ/יֹּצֵא֙ אֶל הַ/מַּ֣עֲרָכָ֔ה וְ/הֵרֵ֖עוּ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyshkhm dvd bbqr vytsh 't hts'n 'l shmr vysh' vylkh kh'shr tsvhv yshy vyb' hm'glh vhchyl hyts' 'l hm'rkhh vhr'v bmlchmh
verses.translation: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.

verses.original: וַ/תַּעֲרֹ֤ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מַעֲרָכָ֖ה לִ/קְרַ֥את מַעֲרָכָֽה
verses.translit: vt'rkh yshr'l vplshtym m'rkhh lqr't m'rkhh
verses.translation: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.

verses.original: וַ/יִּטֹּשׁ֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶת הַ/כֵּלִ֜ים מֵ/עָלָ֗י/ו עַל יַד֙ שׁוֹמֵ֣ר הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים וַ/יָּ֖רָץ הַ/מַּעֲרָכָ֑ה וַ/יָּבֹ֕א וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֥ל לְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו לְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vytsh dvd 't hkhlym m'lyv 'l yd shvmr hkhlym vyrts hm'rkhh vyb' vysh'l l'chyv lshlvm
verses.translation: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.

verses.original: וְ/ה֣וּא מְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמָּ֗/ם וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה אִ֣ישׁ הַ/בֵּנַ֡יִם עוֹלֶ֞ה גָּלְיָת֩ הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֨י שְׁמ֤/וֹ מִ/גַּת֙ מ/מערות מִ/מַּעַרְכ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יְדַבֵּ֖ר כַּ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֖ע דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vhv' mdbr 'mm vhnh 'ysh hbnym 'vlh glyt hplshty shmv mgt mm'rvt mm'rkhvt plshtym vydbr khdbrym h'lh vyshm' dvd
verses.translation: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them .

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּ/רְאוֹתָ֖/ם אֶת הָ/אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יָּנֻ֨סוּ֙ מִ/פָּנָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּֽירְא֖וּ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vkhl 'ysh yshr'l br'vtm 't h'ysh vynsv mpnyv vyyr'v m'd
verses.translation: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַ/רְּאִיתֶם֙ הָ/אִ֤ישׁ הָֽ/עֹלֶה֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֛י לְ/חָרֵ֥ף אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹלֶ֑ה וְֽ֠/הָיָה הָ/אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַכֶּ֜/נּוּ יַעְשְׁרֶ֥/נּוּ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ עֹ֣שֶׁר גָּד֗וֹל וְ/אֶת בִּתּ/וֹ֙ יִתֶּן ל֔/וֹ וְ/אֵת֙ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔י/ו יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה חָפְשִׁ֖י בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ysh yshr'l hr'ytm h'ysh h'lh hzh khy lchrf 't yshr'l 'lh vhyh h'ysh 'shr ykhnv y'shrnv hmlkh 'shr gdvl v't btv ytn lv v't byt 'byv y'shh chpshy byshr'l
verses.translation: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father’s house free in Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗ד אֶֽל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֞ים הָ/עֹמְדִ֣ים עִמּ/וֹ֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ מַה יֵּעָשֶׂ֗ה לָ/אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַכֶּה֙ אֶת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֣י הַלָּ֔ז וְ/הֵסִ֥יר חֶרְפָּ֖ה מֵ/עַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י מִ֗י הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֤י הֶֽ/עָרֵל֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י חֵרֵ֔ף מַעַרְכ֖וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l h'nshym h'mdym 'mv l'mr mh y'shh l'ysh 'shr ykhh 't hplshty hlz vhsyr chrph m'l yshr'l khy my hplshty h'rl hzh khy chrf m'rkhvt 'lhym chyym
verses.translation: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ הָ/עָ֔ם כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּ֣ה יֵעָשֶׂ֔ה לָ/אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַכֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv h'm khdbr hzh l'mr khh y'shh l'ysh 'shr ykhnv
verses.translation: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֱלִיאָב֙ אָחִ֣י/ו הַ/גָּד֔וֹל בְּ/דַבְּר֖/וֹ אֶל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יִּֽחַר אַף֩ אֱלִיאָ֨ב בְּ/דָוִ֜ד וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/מָּה זֶּ֣ה יָרַ֗דְתָּ וְ/עַל מִ֨י נָטַ֜שְׁתָּ מְעַ֨ט הַ/צֹּ֤אן הָ/הֵ֨נָּה֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר אֲנִ֧י יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶת זְדֹנְ/ךָ֗ וְ/אֵת֙ רֹ֣עַ לְבָבֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֗י לְמַ֛עַן רְא֥וֹת הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה יָרָֽדְתָּ
verses.translit: vyshm' 'ly'b 'chyv hgdvl bdbrv 'l h'nshym vychr 'f 'ly'b bdvd vy'mr lmh zh yrdt v'l my ntsht m't hts'n hhnh bmdbr 'ny yd'ty 't zdnkh v't r' lbbkh khy lm'n r'vt hmlchmh yrdt
verses.translation: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab’s anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד מֶ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתִי עָ֑תָּה הֲ/ל֖וֹא דָּבָ֥ר הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd mh 'shyty 'th hlv' dbr hv'
verses.translation: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?

verses.original: וַ/יִּסֹּ֤ב מֵֽ/אֶצְל/וֹ֙ אֶל מ֣וּל אַחֵ֔ר וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר כַּ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יְשִׁבֻ֤/הוּ הָ/עָם֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּ/דָּבָ֖ר הָ/רִאשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vysb m'tslv 'l mvl 'chr vy'mr khdbr hzh vyshbhv h'm dbr khdbr hr'shvn
verses.translation: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.

verses.original: וַ/יְּשָּֽׁמְעוּ֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יַּגִּ֥דוּ לִ/פְנֵֽי שָׁא֖וּל וַ/יִּקָּחֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyshm'v hdbrym 'shr dbr dvd vygdv lpny sh'vl vyqchhv
verses.translation: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל אַל יִפֹּ֥ל לֵב אָדָ֖ם עָלָ֑י/ו עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ יֵלֵ֔ךְ וְ/נִלְחַ֖ם עִם הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֥י הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l sh'vl 'l ypl lb 'dm 'lyv 'bdkh ylkh vnlchm 'm hplshty hzh
verses.translation: And David said to Saul, Let no man’s heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל אֶל דָּוִ֗ד לֹ֤א תוּכַל֙ לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ אֶל הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֣י הַ/זֶּ֔ה לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם עִמּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי נַ֣עַר אַ֔תָּה וְ/ה֛וּא אִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֖ה מִ/נְּעֻרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l dvd l' tvkhl llkht 'l hplshty hzh lhlchm 'mv khy n'r 'th vhv' 'ysh mlchmh mn'ryv
verses.translation: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל רֹעֶ֨ה הָיָ֧ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ לְ/אָבִ֖י/ו בַּ/צֹּ֑אן וּ/בָ֤א הָֽ/אֲרִי֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/דּ֔וֹב וְ/נָשָׂ֥א שֶׂ֖ה מֵ/הָ/עֵֽדֶר
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l sh'vl r'h hyh 'bdkh l'byv bts'n vb' h'ry v't hdvb vnsh' shh mh'dr
verses.translation: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֧אתִי אַחֲרָ֛י/ו וְ/הִכִּתִ֖י/ו וְ/הִצַּ֣לְתִּי מִ/פִּ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֣קָם עָלַ֔/י וְ/הֶחֱזַ֨קְתִּי֙ בִּ/זְקָנ֔/וֹ וְ/הִכִּתִ֖י/ו וַ/הֲמִיתִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyts'ty 'chryv vhkhtyv vhtslty mpyv vyqm 'ly vhchzqty bzqnv vhkhtyv vhmytyv
verses.translation: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

verses.original: גַּ֧ם אֶֽת הָ/אֲרִ֛י גַּם הַ/דּ֖וֹב הִכָּ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְֽ֠/הָיָה הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֨י הֶ/עָרֵ֤ל הַ/זֶּה֙ כְּ/אַחַ֣ד מֵ/הֶ֔ם כִּ֣י חֵרֵ֔ף מַעַרְכֹ֖ת אֱלֹהִ֥ים חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: gm 't h'ry gm hdvb hkhh 'bdkh vhyh hplshty h'rl hzh kh'chd mhm khy chrf m'rkht 'lhym chyym
verses.translation: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ דָּוִד֒ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצִּלַ֜/נִי מִ/יַּ֤ד הָֽ/אֲרִי֙ וּ/מִ/יַּ֣ד הַ/דֹּ֔ב ה֣וּא יַצִּילֵ֔/נִי מִ/יַּ֥ד הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֤וּל אֶל דָּוִד֙ לֵ֔ךְ וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd yhvh 'shr htslny myd h'ry vmyd hdb hv' ytsylny myd hplshty hzh vy'mr sh'vl 'l dvd lkh vyhvh yhyh 'mkh
verses.translation: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יַּלְבֵּ֨שׁ שָׁא֤וּל אֶת דָּוִד֙ מַדָּ֔י/ו וְ/נָתַ֛ן ק֥וֹבַע נְחֹ֖שֶׁת עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֹת֖/וֹ שִׁרְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: vylbsh sh'vl 't dvd mdyv vntn qvb' nchsht 'l r'shv vylbsh 'tv shryvn
verses.translation: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחְגֹּ֣ר דָּוִ֣ד אֶת חַ֠רְבּ/וֹ מֵ/עַ֨ל לְ/מַדָּ֜י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אֶל לָ/לֶכֶת֮ כִּ֣י לֹֽא נִסָּה֒ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל שָׁא֗וּל לֹ֥א אוּכַ֛ל לָ/לֶ֥כֶת בָּ/אֵ֖לֶּה כִּ֣י לֹ֣א נִסִּ֑יתִי וַ/יְסִרֵ֥/ם דָּוִ֖ד מֵ/עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vychgr dvd 't chrbv m'l lmdyv vy'l llkht khy l' nsh vy'mr dvd 'l sh'vl l' 'vkhl llkht b'lh khy l' nsyty vysrm dvd m'lyv
verses.translation: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it . And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them . And David put them off him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מַקְל֜/וֹ בְּ/יָד֗/וֹ וַ/יִּבְחַר ל֣/וֹ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה חַלֻּקֵֽי אֲבָנִ֣ים מִן הַ/נַּ֡חַל וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם אֹ֠תָ/ם בִּ/כְלִ֨י הָ/רֹעִ֧ים אֲשֶׁר ל֛/וֹ וּ/בַ/יַּלְק֖וּט וְ/קַלְּע֣/וֹ בְ/יָד֑/וֹ וַ/יִּגַּ֖שׁ אֶל הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּֽי
verses.translit: vyqch mqlv bydv vybchr lv chmshh chlqy 'bnym mn hnchl vyshm 'tm bkhly hr'ym 'shr lv vbylqvt vql'v bydv vygsh 'l hplshty
verses.translation: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd’s bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י הֹלֵ֥ךְ וְ/קָרֵ֖ב אֶל דָּוִ֑ד וְ/הָ/אִ֛ישׁ נֹשֵׂ֥א הַ/צִּנָּ֖ה לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vylkh hplshty hlkh vqrb 'l dvd vh'ysh nsh' htsnh lpnyv
verses.translation: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּבֵּ֧ט הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֛י וַ/יִּרְאֶ֥ה אֶת דָּוִ֖ד וַ/יִּבְזֵ֑/הוּ כִּֽי הָיָ֣ה נַ֔עַר וְ/אַדְמֹנִ֖י עִם יְפֵ֥ה מַרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: vybt hplshty vyr'h 't dvd vybzhv khy hyh n'r v'dmny 'm yph mr'h
verses.translation: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּי֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד הֲ/כֶ֣לֶב אָנֹ֔כִי כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה בָֽא אֵלַ֖/י בַּ/מַּקְל֑וֹת וַ/יְקַלֵּ֧ל הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת דָּוִ֖ד בֵּ/אלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr hplshty 'l dvd hkhlb 'nkhy khy 'th b' 'ly bmqlvt vyqll hplshty 't dvd b'lhyv
verses.translation: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י אֶל דָּוִ֑ד לְכָ֣/ה אֵלַ֔/י וְ/אֶתְּנָה֙ אֶת בְּשָׂ֣רְ/ךָ֔ לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hplshty 'l dvd lkhh 'ly v'tnh 't bshrkh l'vf hshmym vlbhmt hshdh
verses.translation: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י אַתָּה֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔/י בְּ/חֶ֖רֶב וּ/בַ/חֲנִ֣ית וּ/בְ/כִיד֑וֹן וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י בָֽא אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ בְּ/שֵׁם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֛י מַעַרְכ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵרַֽפְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l hplshty 'th b' 'ly bchrb vbchnyt vbkhydvn v'nkhy b' 'lykh bshm yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy m'rkhvt yshr'l 'shr chrpt
verses.translation: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

verses.original: הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֡ה יְסַגֶּרְ/ךָ֩ יְהוָ֨ה בְּ/יָדִ֜/י וְ/הִכִּיתִ֗/ךָ וַ/הֲסִרֹתִ֤י אֶת רֹֽאשְׁ/ךָ֙ מֵ/עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/נָ֨תַתִּ֜י פֶּ֣גֶר מַחֲנֵ֤ה פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/חַיַּ֣ת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/יֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hyvm hzh ysgrkh yhvh bydy vhkhytkh vhsrty 't r'shkh m'lykh vntty pgr mchnh plshtym hyvm hzh l'vf hshmym vlchyt h'rts vyd'v khl h'rts khy ysh 'lhym lyshr'l
verses.translation: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.

verses.original: וְ/יֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל הַ/קָּהָ֣ל הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּֽי לֹ֛א בְּ/חֶ֥רֶב וּ/בַ/חֲנִ֖ית יְהוֹשִׁ֣יעַ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י לַֽ/יהוָה֙ הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/נָתַ֥ן אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/יָדֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vyd'v khl hqhl hzh khy l' bchrb vbchnyt yhvshy' yhvh khy lyhvh hmlchmh vntn 'tkhm bydnv
verses.translation: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s , and he will give you into our hands.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ כִּֽי קָ֣ם הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ וַ/יִּקְרַ֖ב לִ/קְרַ֣את דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יְמַהֵ֣ר דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יָּ֥רָץ הַ/מַּעֲרָכָ֖ה לִ/קְרַ֥את הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּֽי
verses.translit: vhyh khy qm hplshty vylkh vyqrb lqr't dvd vymhr dvd vyrts hm'rkhh lqr't hplshty
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶת יָד֜/וֹ אֶל הַ/כֶּ֗לִי וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מִ/שָּׁ֥ם אֶ֨בֶן֙ וַ/יְקַלַּ֔ע וַ/יַּ֥ךְ אֶת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י אֶל מִצְח֑/וֹ וַ/תִּטְבַּ֤ע הָ/אֶ֨בֶן֙ בְּ/מִצְח֔/וֹ וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל עַל פָּנָ֖י/ו אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd 't ydv 'l hkhly vyqch mshm 'bn vyql' vykh 't hplshty 'l mtschv vttb' h'bn bmtschv vypl 'l pnyv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it , and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֨ק דָּוִ֤ד מִן הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּי֙ בַּ/קֶּ֣לַע וּ/בָ/אֶ֔בֶן וַ/יַּ֥ךְ אֶת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י וַ/יְמִיתֵ֑/הוּ וְ/חֶ֖רֶב אֵ֥ין בְּ/יַד דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vychzq dvd mn hplshty bql' vb'bn vykh 't hplshty vymythv vchrb 'yn byd dvd
verses.translation: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣רָץ דָּ֠וִד וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֨ד אֶל הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֜י וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת חַ֠רְבּ/וֹ וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְפָ֤/הּ מִ/תַּעְרָ/הּ֙ וַ/יְמֹ֣תְתֵ֔/הוּ וַ/יִּכְרָת בָּ֖/הּ אֶת רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּרְא֧וּ הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֛ים כִּֽי מֵ֥ת גִּבּוֹרָ֖/ם וַ/יָּנֻֽסוּ
verses.translit: vyrts dvd vy'md 'l hplshty vyqch 't chrbv vyshlph mt'rh vymtthv vykhrt bh 't r'shv vyr'v hplshtym khy mt gbvrm vynsv
verses.translation: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֣מוּ אַנְשֵׁי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל וִ/יהוּדָ֜ה וַ/יָּרִ֗עוּ וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפוּ֙ אֶת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים עַד בּוֹאֲ/ךָ֣ גַ֔יְא וְ/עַ֖ד שַׁעֲרֵ֣י עֶקְר֑וֹן וַֽ/יִּפְּל֞וּ חַֽלְלֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ שַׁעֲרַ֔יִם וְ/עַד גַּ֖ת וְ/עַד עֶקְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyqmv 'nshy yshr'l vyhvdh vyr'v vyrdpv 't hplshtym 'd bv'kh gy' v'd sh'ry 'qrvn vyplv chlly plshtym bdrkh sh'rym v'd gt v'd 'qrvn
verses.translation: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/דְּלֹ֖ק אַחֲרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יָּשֹׁ֖סּוּ אֶת מַחֲנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshbv bny yshr'l mdlq 'chry plshtym vyshsv 't mchnyhm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח דָּוִד֙ אֶת רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י וַ/יְבִאֵ֖/הוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/אֶת כֵּלָ֖י/ו שָׂ֥ם בְּ/אָהֳלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqch dvd 't r'sh hplshty vyb'hv yrvshlm v't khlyv shm b'hlv
verses.translation: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

verses.original: וְ/כִ/רְא֨וֹת שָׁא֜וּל אֶת דָּוִ֗ד יֹצֵא֙ לִ/קְרַ֣את הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י אָמַ֗ר אֶל אַבְנֵר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַ/צָּבָ֔א בֶּן מִי זֶ֥ה הַ/נַּ֖עַר אַבְנֵ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְנֵ֔ר חֵֽי נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֥ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אִם יָדָֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: vkhr'vt sh'vl 't dvd yts' lqr't hplshty 'mr 'l 'bnr shr htsb' bn my zh hn'r 'bnr vy'mr 'bnr chy npshkh hmlkh 'm yd'ty
verses.translation: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ שְׁאַ֣ל אַתָּ֔ה בֶּן מִי זֶ֖ה הָ/עָֽלֶם
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh sh'l 'th bn my zh h'lm
verses.translation: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is .

verses.original: וּ/כְ/שׁ֣וּב דָּוִ֗ד מֵֽ/הַכּוֹת֙ אֶת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אֹת/וֹ֙ אַבְנֵ֔ר וַ/יְבִאֵ֖/הוּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וְ/רֹ֥אשׁ הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhshvb dvd mhkhvt 't hplshty vyqch 'tv 'bnr vyb'hv lpny sh'vl vr'sh hplshty bydv
verses.translation: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ שָׁא֔וּל בֶּן מִ֥י אַתָּ֖ה הַ/נָּ֑עַר וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד בֶּֽן עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ יִשַׁ֖י בֵּ֥ית הַלַּחְמִֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv sh'vl bn my 'th hn'r vy'mr dvd bn 'bdkh yshy byt hlchmy
verses.translation: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth-lehemite.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/כַלֹּת/וֹ֙ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֶל שָׁא֔וּל וְ/נֶ֨פֶשׁ֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן נִקְשְׁרָ֖ה בְּ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ דָּוִ֑ד ו/יאהבו וַ/יֶּאֱהָבֵ֥/הוּ יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן כְּ/נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khkhltv ldbr 'l sh'vl vnpsh yhvntn nqshrh bnpsh dvd vy'hbv vy'hbhv yhvntn khnpshv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּחֵ֥/הוּ שָׁא֖וּל בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וְ/לֹ֣א נְתָנ֔/וֹ לָ/שׁ֖וּב בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqchhv sh'vl byvm hhv' vl' ntnv lshvb byt 'byv
verses.translation: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרֹ֧ת יְהוֹנָתָ֛ן וְ/דָוִ֖ד בְּרִ֑ית בְּ/אַהֲבָת֥/וֹ אֹת֖/וֹ כְּ/נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vykhrt yhvntn vdvd bryt b'hbtv 'tv khnpshv
verses.translation: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפַּשֵּׁ֣ט יְהוֹנָתָ֗ן אֶֽת הַ/מְּעִיל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔י/ו וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/הוּ לְ/דָוִ֑ד וּ/מַדָּ֕י/ו וְ/עַד חַרְבּ֥/וֹ וְ/עַד קַשְׁתּ֖/וֹ וְ/עַד חֲגֹרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytpsht yhvntn 't hm'yl 'shr 'lyv vytnhv ldvd vmdyv v'd chrbv v'd qshtv v'd chgrv
verses.translation: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א דָוִ֜ד בְּ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁלָחֶ֤/נּוּ שָׁאוּל֙ יַשְׂכִּ֔יל וַ/יְשִׂמֵ֣/הוּ שָׁא֔וּל עַ֖ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַ/יִּיטַב֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י כָל הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/גַ֕ם בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vyts' dvd bkhl 'shr yshlchnv sh'vl yshkhyl vyshmhv sh'vl 'l 'nshy hmlchmh vyytb b'yny khl h'm vgm b'yny 'bdy sh'vl
verses.translation: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בְּ/בוֹאָ֗/ם בְּ/שׁ֤וּב דָּוִד֙ מֵ/הַכּ֣וֹת אֶת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י וַ/תֵּצֶ֨אנָה הַ/נָּשִׁ֜ים מִ/כָּל עָרֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ל/שור לָ/שִׁ֣יר וְ/הַ/מְּחֹל֔וֹת לִ/קְרַ֖את שָׁא֣וּל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ בְּ/תֻפִּ֥ים בְּ/שִׂמְחָ֖ה וּ/בְ/שָׁלִשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyhy bbv'm bshvb dvd mhkhvt 't hplshty vtts'nh hnshym mkhl 'ry yshr'l lshvr lshyr vhmchlvt lqr't sh'vl hmlkh btpym bshmchh vbshlshym
verses.translation: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.

verses.original: וַֽ/תַּעֲנֶ֛ינָה הַ/נָּשִׁ֥ים הַֽ/מְשַׂחֲק֖וֹת וַ/תֹּאמַ֑רְןָ הִכָּ֤ה שָׁאוּל֙ ב/אלפ/ו בַּ/אֲלָפָ֔י/ו וְ/דָוִ֖ד בְּ/רִבְבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vt'nynh hnshym hmshchqvt vt'mrn hkhh sh'vl b'lpv b'lpyv vdvd brbbtyv
verses.translation: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨חַר לְ/שָׁא֜וּל מְאֹ֗ד וַ/יֵּ֤רַע בְּ/עֵינָי/ו֙ הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר נָתְנ֤וּ לְ/דָוִד֙ רְבָב֔וֹת וְ/לִ֥/י נָתְנ֖וּ הָ/אֲלָפִ֑ים וְ/ע֥וֹד ל֖/וֹ אַ֥ךְ הַ/מְּלוּכָֽה
verses.translit: vychr lsh'vl m'd vyr' b'ynyv hdbr hzh vy'mr ntnv ldvd rbbvt vly ntnv h'lpym v'vd lv 'kh hmlvkhh
verses.translation: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י שָׁא֖וּל עון עוֹיֵ֣ן אֶת דָּוִ֑ד מֵ/הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא וָ/הָֽלְאָה
verses.translit: vyhy sh'vl 'vn 'vyn 't dvd mhyvm hhv' vhl'h
verses.translation: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֗ת וַ/תִּצְלַ֣ח רוּחַ֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים רָעָ֤ה אֶל שָׁאוּל֙ וַ/יִּתְנַבֵּ֣א בְ/תוֹךְ הַ/בַּ֔יִת וְ/דָוִ֛ד מְנַגֵּ֥ן בְּ/יָד֖/וֹ כְּ/י֣וֹם בְּ/י֑וֹם וְ/הַ/חֲנִ֖ית בְּ/יַד שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vttslch rvch 'lhym r'h 'l sh'vl vytnb' btvkh hbyt vdvd mngn bydv khyvm byvm vhchnyt byd sh'vl
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul’s hand.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤טֶל שָׁאוּל֙ אֶֽת הַ/חֲנִ֔ית וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אַכֶּ֥ה בְ/דָוִ֖ד וּ/בַ/קִּ֑יר וַ/יִּסֹּ֥ב דָּוִ֛ד מִ/פָּנָ֖י/ו פַּעֲמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vytl sh'vl 't hchnyt vy'mr 'khh bdvd vbqyr vysb dvd mpnyv p'mym
verses.translation: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it . And David avoided out of his presence twice.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרָ֥א שָׁא֖וּל מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י דָוִ֑ד כִּֽי הָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וּ/מֵ/עִ֥ם שָׁא֖וּל סָֽר
verses.translit: vyr' sh'vl mlpny dvd khy hyh yhvh 'mv vm'm sh'vl sr
verses.translation: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and was departed from Saul.

verses.original: וַ/יְסִרֵ֤/הוּ שָׁאוּל֙ מֵֽ/עִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יְשִׂמֵ֥/הוּ ל֖/וֹ שַׂר אָ֑לֶף וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א וַ/יָּבֹ֖א לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vysrhv sh'vl m'mv vyshmhv lv shr 'lf vyts' vyb' lpny h'm
verses.translation: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דָוִ֛ד לְ/כָל דָּרְכָ֖/ו מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וַֽ/יהוָ֖ה עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy dvd lkhl drkhv mshkhyl vyhvh 'mv
verses.translation: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא שָׁא֔וּל אֲשֶׁר ה֖וּא מַשְׂכִּ֣יל מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יָּ֖גָר מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyr' sh'vl 'shr hv' mshkhyl m'd vygr mpnyv
verses.translation: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִ/יהוּדָ֔ה אֹהֵ֖ב אֶת דָּוִ֑ד כִּֽי ה֛וּא יוֹצֵ֥א וָ/בָ֖א לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l vyhvdh 'hb 't dvd khy hv' yvts' vb' lpnyhm
verses.translation: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל אֶל דָּוִ֗ד הִנֵּה֩ בִתִּ֨/י הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֤ה מֵרַב֙ אֹתָ/הּ֙ אֶתֶּן לְ/ךָ֣ לְ/אִשָּׁ֔ה אַ֚ךְ הֱיֵה לִּ֣/י לְ/בֶן חַ֔יִל וְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם מִלְחֲמ֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/שָׁא֣וּל אָמַ֗ר אַל תְּהִ֤י יָדִ/י֙ בּ֔/וֹ וּ/תְהִי ב֖/וֹ יַד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l dvd hnh bty hgdvlh mrb 'th 'tn lkh l'shh 'kh hyh ly lbn chyl vhlchm mlchmvt yhvh vsh'vl 'mr 'l thy ydy bv vthy bv yd plshtym
verses.translation: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the LORD’s battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל שָׁא֗וּל מִ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ וּ/מִ֣י חַיַּ֔/י מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת אָבִ֖/י בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי אֶהְיֶ֥ה חָתָ֖ן לַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l sh'vl my 'nkhy vmy chyy mshpcht 'by byshr'l khy 'hyh chtn lmlkh
verses.translation: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/עֵ֥ת תֵּ֛ת אֶת מֵרַ֥ב בַּת שָׁא֖וּל לְ/דָוִ֑ד וְ/הִ֧יא נִתְּנָ֛ה לְ/עַדְרִיאֵ֥ל הַ/מְּחֹלָתִ֖י לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vyhy b't tt 't mrb bt sh'vl ldvd vhy' ntnh l'dry'l hmchlty l'shh
verses.translation: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul’s daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.

verses.original: וַ/תֶּאֱהַ֛ב מִיכַ֥ל בַּת שָׁא֖וּל אֶת דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יַּגִּ֣דוּ לְ/שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יִּשַׁ֥ר הַ/דָּבָ֖ר בְּ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vt'hb mykhl bt sh'vl 't dvd vygdv lsh'vl vyshr hdbr b'ynyv
verses.translation: And Michal Saul’s daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל אֶתְּנֶ֤/נָּה לּ/וֹ֙ וּ/תְהִי ל֣/וֹ לְ/מוֹקֵ֔שׁ וּ/תְהִי ב֖/וֹ יַד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד בִּ/שְׁתַּ֛יִם תִּתְחַתֵּ֥ן בִּ֖/י הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'tnnh lv vthy lv lmvqsh vthy bv yd plshtym vy'mr sh'vl 'l dvd bshtym ttchtn by hyvm
verses.translation: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֨ו שָׁא֜וּל אֶת עֲבָדָ֗/ו דַּבְּר֨וּ אֶל דָּוִ֤ד בַּ/לָּט֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֨ה חָפֵ֤ץ בְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֖י/ו אֲהֵב֑וּ/ךָ וְ/עַתָּ֖ה הִתְחַתֵּ֥ן בַּ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vytsv sh'vl 't 'bdv dbrv 'l dvd blt l'mr hnh chpts bkh hmlkh vkhl 'bdyv 'hbvkh v'th htchtn bmlkh
verses.translation: And Saul commanded his servants, saying , Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king’s son in law.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֞וּ עַבְדֵ֤י שָׁאוּל֙ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗ד הַֽ/נְקַלָּ֤ה בְ/עֵֽינֵי/כֶם֙ הִתְחַתֵּ֣ן בַּ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י אִֽישׁ רָ֥שׁ וְ/נִקְלֶֽה
verses.translit: vydbrv 'bdy sh'vl b'zny dvd 't hdbrym h'lh vy'mr dvd hnqlh b'ynykhm htchtn bmlkh v'nkhy 'ysh rsh vnqlh
verses.translation: And Saul’s servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king’s son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֜דוּ עַבְדֵ֥י שָׁא֛וּל ל֖/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כַּ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה דִּבֶּ֥ר דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vygdv 'bdy sh'vl lv l'mr khdbrym h'lh dbr dvd
verses.translation: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל כֹּֽה תֹאמְר֣וּ לְ/דָוִ֗ד אֵֽין חֵ֤פֶץ לַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּ/מֹ֔הַר כִּ֗י בְּ/מֵאָה֙ עָרְל֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְ/הִנָּקֵ֖ם בְּ/אֹיְבֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/שָׁא֣וּל חָשַׁ֔ב לְ/הַפִּ֥יל אֶת דָּוִ֖ד בְּ/יַד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl khh t'mrv ldvd 'yn chpts lmlkh bmhr khy bm'h 'rlvt plshtym lhnqm b'yby hmlkh vsh'vl chshb lhpyl 't dvd byd plshtym
verses.translation: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֨דוּ עֲבָדָ֤י/ו לְ/דָוִד֙ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וַ/יִּשַׁ֤ר הַ/דָּבָר֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד לְ/הִתְחַתֵּ֖ן בַּ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/לֹ֥א מָלְא֖וּ הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vygdv 'bdyv ldvd 't hdbrym h'lh vyshr hdbr b'yny dvd lhtchtn bmlkh vl' ml'v hymym
verses.translation: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son in law: and the days were not expired.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֜ד וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ ה֣וּא וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֗י/ו וַ/יַּ֣ךְ בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּים֮ מָאתַ֣יִם אִישׁ֒ וַ/יָּבֵ֤א דָוִד֙ אֶת עָרְלֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יְמַלְא֣וּ/ם לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לְ/הִתְחַתֵּ֖ן בַּ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֥/וֹ שָׁא֛וּל אֶת מִיכַ֥ל בִּתּ֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vyqm dvd vylkh hv' v'nshyv vykh bplshtym m'tym 'ysh vyb' dvd 't 'rltyhm vyml'vm lmlkh lhtchtn bmlkh vytn lv sh'vl 't mykhl btv l'shh
verses.translation: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king’s son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא שָׁאוּל֙ וַ/יֵּ֔דַע כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם דָּוִ֑ד וּ/מִיכַ֥ל בַּת שָׁא֖וּל אֲהֵבַֽתְ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyr' sh'vl vyd' khy yhvh 'm dvd vmykhl bt sh'vl 'hbthv
verses.translation: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David, and that Michal Saul’s daughter loved him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אסֶף שָׁא֗וּל לֵ/רֹ֛א מִ/פְּנֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד ע֑וֹד וַ/יְהִ֥י שָׁא֛וּל אֹיֵ֥ב אֶת דָּוִ֖ד כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sf sh'vl lr' mpny dvd 'vd vyhy sh'vl 'yb 't dvd khl hymym
verses.translation: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David’s enemy continually.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֖וּ שָׂרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יְהִ֣י מִ/דֵּ֣י צֵאתָ֗/ם שָׂכַ֤ל דָּוִד֙ מִ/כֹּל֙ עַבְדֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יִּיקַ֥ר שְׁמ֖/וֹ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyts'v shry plshtym vyhy mdy ts'tm shkhl dvd mkhl 'bdy sh'vl vyyqr shmv m'd
verses.translation: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר שָׁא֗וּל אֶל יוֹנָתָ֤ן בְּנ/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶל כָּל עֲבָדָ֔י/ו לְ/הָמִ֖ית אֶת דָּוִ֑ד וִ/יהֽוֹנָתָן֙ בֶּן שָׁא֔וּל חָפֵ֥ץ בְּ/דָוִ֖ד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vydbr sh'vl 'l yvntn bnv v'l khl 'bdyv lhmyt 't dvd vyhvntn bn sh'vl chpts bdvd m'd
verses.translation: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֤ד יְהוֹנָתָן֙ לְ/דָוִ֣ד לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מְבַקֵּ֛שׁ שָׁא֥וּל אָבִ֖/י לַ/הֲמִיתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/עַתָּה֙ הִשָּֽׁמֶר נָ֣א בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/יָשַׁבְתָּ֥ בַ/סֵּ֖תֶר וְ/נַחְבֵּֽאתָ
verses.translit: vygd yhvntn ldvd l'mr mbqsh sh'vl 'by lhmytkh v'th hshmr n' bbqr vyshbt bstr vnchb't
verses.translation: But Jonathan Saul’s son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place , and hide thyself:

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֨י אֵצֵ֜א וְ/עָמַדְתִּ֣י לְ/יַד אָבִ֗/י בַּ/שָּׂדֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה שָׁ֔ם וַ/אֲנִ֕י אֲדַבֵּ֥ר בְּ/ךָ֖ אֶל אָבִ֑/י וְ/רָאִ֥יתִי מָ֖ה וְ/הִגַּ֥דְתִּי לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'ny 'ts' v'mdty lyd 'by bshdh 'shr 'th shm v'ny 'dbr bkh 'l 'by vr'yty mh vhgdty lkh
verses.translation: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art , and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוֹנָתָ֤ן בְּ/דָוִד֙ ט֔וֹב אֶל שָׁא֖וּל אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵ֠לָי/ו אַל יֶחֱטָ֨א הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ בְּ/עַבְדּ֣/וֹ בְ/דָוִ֗ד כִּ֣י ל֤וֹא חָטָא֙ לָ֔/ךְ וְ/כִ֥י מַעֲשָׂ֖י/ו טוֹב לְ/ךָ֥ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vydbr yhvntn bdvd tvb 'l sh'vl 'byv vy'mr 'lyv 'l ycht' hmlkh b'bdv bdvd khy lv' cht' lkh vkhy m'shyv tvb lkh m'd
verses.translation: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֶׂם֩ אֶת נַפְשׁ֨/וֹ בְ/כַפּ֜/וֹ וַ/יַּ֣ךְ אֶת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗י וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ יְהוָ֜ה תְּשׁוּעָ֤ה גְדוֹלָה֙ לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאִ֖יתָ וַ/תִּשְׂמָ֑ח וְ/לָ֤/מָּה תֶֽחֱטָא֙ בְּ/דָ֣ם נָקִ֔י לְ/הָמִ֥ית אֶת דָּוִ֖ד חִנָּֽם
verses.translit: vyshm 't npshv bkhpv vykh 't hplshty vy'sh yhvh tshv'h gdvlh lkhl yshr'l r'yt vtshmch vlmh tcht' bdm nqy lhmyt 't dvd chnm
verses.translation: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the LORD wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it , and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע שָׁא֖וּל בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוֹנָתָ֑ן וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֣ע שָׁא֔וּל חַי יְהוָ֖ה אִם יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vyshm' sh'vl bqvl yhvntn vyshb' sh'vl chy yhvh 'm yvmt
verses.translation: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the LORD liveth, he shall not be slain.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א יְהוֹנָתָן֙ לְ/דָוִ֔ד וַ/יַּגֶּד ל/וֹ֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יָּבֵ֨א יְהוֹנָתָ֤ן אֶת דָּוִד֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יְהִ֥י לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו כְּ/אֶתְמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvntn ldvd vygd lv yhvntn 't khl hdbrym h'lh vyb' yhvntn 't dvd 'l sh'vl vyhy lpnyv kh'tmvl shlshvm
verses.translation: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.

verses.original: וַ/תּ֥וֹסֶף הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה לִֽ/הְי֑וֹת וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א דָוִ֜ד וַ/יִּלָּ֣חֶם בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַ/יַּ֤ךְ בָּ/הֶם֙ מַכָּ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַ/יָּנֻ֖סוּ מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vtvsf hmlchmh lhyvt vyts' dvd vylchm bplshtym vykh bhm mkhh gdvlh vynsv mpnyv
verses.translation: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִי֩ ר֨וּחַ יְהוָ֤ה רָעָה֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל וְ/הוּא֙ בְּ/בֵית֣/וֹ יוֹשֵׁ֔ב וַ/חֲנִית֖/וֹ בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וְ/דָוִ֖ד מְנַגֵּ֥ן בְּ/יָֽד
verses.translit: vthy rvch yhvh r'h 'l sh'vl vhv' bbytv yvshb vchnytv bydv vdvd mngn byd
verses.translation: And the evil spirit from the LORD was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יְבַקֵּ֨שׁ שָׁא֜וּל לְ/הַכּ֤וֹת בַּֽ/חֲנִית֙ בְּ/דָוִ֣ד וּ/בַ/קִּ֔יר וַ/יִּפְטַר֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יַּ֥ךְ אֶֽת הַ/חֲנִ֖ית בַּ/קִּ֑יר וְ/דָוִ֛ד נָ֥ס וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֖ט בַּ/לַּ֥יְלָה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vybqsh sh'vl lhkhvt bchnyt bdvd vbqyr vyptr mpny sh'vl vykh 't hchnyt bqyr vdvd ns vymlt blylh hv'
verses.translation: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin; but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ שָׁא֨וּל מַלְאָכִ֜ים אֶל בֵּ֤ית דָּוִד֙ לְ/שָׁמְר֔/וֹ וְ/לַ/הֲמִית֖/וֹ בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר וַ/תַּגֵּ֣ד לְ/דָוִ֗ד מִיכַ֤ל אִשְׁתּ/וֹ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אִם אֵ֨ינְ/ךָ֜ מְמַלֵּ֤ט אֶֽת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֙ הַ/לַּ֔יְלָה מָחָ֖ר אַתָּ֥ה מוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vyshlch sh'vl ml'khym 'l byt dvd lshmrv vlhmytv bbqr vtgd ldvd mykhl 'shtv l'mr 'm 'ynkh mmlt 't npshkh hlylh mchr 'th mvmt
verses.translation: Saul also sent messengers unto David’s house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David’s wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֧רֶד מִיכַ֛ל אֶת דָּוִ֖ד בְּעַ֣ד הַ/חַלּ֑וֹן וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ וַ/יִּבְרַ֖ח וַ/יִּמָּלֵֽט
verses.translit: vtrd mykhl 't dvd b'd hchlvn vylkh vybrch vymlt
verses.translation: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֨ח מִיכַ֜ל אֶת הַ/תְּרָפִ֗ים וַ/תָּ֨שֶׂם֙ אֶל הַ/מִּטָּ֔ה וְ/אֵת֙ כְּבִ֣יר הָֽ/עִזִּ֔ים שָׂ֖מָה מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָ֑י/ו וַ/תְּכַ֖ס בַּ/בָּֽגֶד
verses.translit: vtqch mykhl 't htrpym vtshm 'l hmth v't khbyr h'zym shmh mr'shtyv vtkhs bbgd
verses.translation: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח שָׁא֛וּל מַלְאָכִ֖ים לָ/קַ֣חַת אֶת דָּוִ֑ד וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר חֹלֶ֥ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyshlch sh'vl ml'khym lqcht 't dvd vt'mr chlh hv'
verses.translation: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֔ים לִ/רְא֥וֹת אֶת דָּוִ֖ד לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הַעֲל֨וּ אֹת֧/וֹ בַ/מִּטָּ֛ה אֵלַ֖/י לַ/הֲמִתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch sh'vl 't hml'khym lr'vt 't dvd l'mr h'lv 'tv bmth 'ly lhmtv
verses.translation: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֔ים וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/תְּרָפִ֖ים אֶל הַ/מִּטָּ֑ה וּ/כְבִ֥יר הָ/עִזִּ֖ים מְרַאֲשֹׁתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyb'v hml'khym vhnh htrpym 'l hmth vkhbyr h'zym mr'shtyv
verses.translation: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל אֶל מִיכַ֗ל לָ֤/מָּה כָּ֨כָה֙ רִמִּיתִ֔/נִי וַ/תְּשַׁלְּחִ֥י אֶת אֹיְבִ֖/י וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֑ט וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר מִיכַל֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל הוּא אָמַ֥ר אֵלַ֛/י שַׁלְּחִ֖/נִי לָ/מָ֥ה אֲמִיתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l mykhl lmh khkhh rmytny vtshlchy 't 'yby vymlt vt'mr mykhl 'l sh'vl hv' 'mr 'ly shlchny lmh 'mytkh
verses.translation: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֨ד בָּרַ֜ח וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֗ט וַ/יָּבֹ֤א אֶל שְׁמוּאֵל֙ הָ/רָמָ֔תָ/ה וַ/יַּ֨גֶּד ל֔/וֹ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָֽשָׂה ל֖/וֹ שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ הוּא֙ וּ/שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ ב/נוית בְּ/נָֽיוֹת
verses.translit: vdvd brch vymlt vyb' 'l shmv'l hrmth vygd lv 't khl 'shr 'shh lv sh'vl vylkh hv' vshmv'l vyshbv bnvyt bnyvt
verses.translation: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֥ד לְ/שָׁא֖וּל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד ב/נוית בְּ/נָי֖וֹת בָּ/רָמָֽה
verses.translit: vygd lsh'vl l'mr hnh dvd bnvyt bnyvt brmh
verses.translation: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח שָׁא֣וּל מַלְאָכִים֮ לָ/קַ֣חַת אֶת דָּוִד֒ וַ/יַּ֗רְא אֶֽת לַהֲקַ֤ת הַ/נְּבִיאִים֙ נִבְּאִ֔ים וּ/שְׁמוּאֵ֕ל עֹמֵ֥ד נִצָּ֖ב עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/תְּהִ֞י עַֽל מַלְאֲכֵ֤י שָׁאוּל֙ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ גַּם הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vyshlch sh'vl ml'khym lqcht 't dvd vyr' 't lhqt hnby'ym nb'ym vshmv'l 'md ntsb 'lyhm vthy 'l ml'khy sh'vl rvch 'lhym vytnb'v gm hmh
verses.translation: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֣דוּ לְ/שָׁא֗וּל וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ מַלְאָכִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ/יִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ גַּם הֵ֑מָּה וַ/יֹּ֣סֶף שָׁא֗וּל וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ מַלְאָכִ֣ים שְׁלִשִׁ֔ים וַ/יִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ גַּם הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vygdv lsh'vl vyshlch ml'khym 'chrym vytnb'v gm hmh vysf sh'vl vyshlch ml'khym shlshym vytnb'v gm hmh
verses.translation: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ גַּם ה֜וּא הָ/רָמָ֗תָ/ה וַ/יָּבֹא֙ עַד בּ֤וֹר הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שֶּׂ֔כוּ וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֣ל וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר אֵיפֹ֥ה שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וְ/דָוִ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֖ה ב/נוית בְּ/נָי֥וֹת בָּ/רָמָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh gm hv' hrmth vyb' 'd bvr hgdvl 'shr bshkhv vysh'l vy'mr 'yph shmv'l vdvd vy'mr hnh bnvyt bnyvt brmh
verses.translation: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ שָׁ֔ם אֶל נוית נָי֖וֹת בָּ/רָמָ֑ה וַ/תְּהִי֩ עָלָ֨י/ו גַּם ה֜וּא ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֗ים וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ הָלוֹךְ֙ וַ/יִּתְנַבֵּ֔א עַד בֹּא֖/וֹ ב/נוית בְּ/נָי֥וֹת בָּ/רָמָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh shm 'l nvyt nyvt brmh vthy 'lyv gm hv' rvch 'lhym vylkh hlvkh vytnb' 'd b'v bnvyt bnyvt brmh
verses.translation: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְשַׁ֨ט גַּם ה֜וּא בְּגָדָ֗י/ו וַ/יִּתְנַבֵּ֤א גַם הוּא֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּפֹּ֣ל עָרֹ֔ם כָּל הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא וְ/כָל הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה עַל כֵּן֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ הֲ/גַ֥ם שָׁא֖וּל בַּ/נְּבִיאִֽם
verses.translit: vypsht gm hv' bgdyv vytnb' gm hv' lpny shmv'l vypl 'rm khl hyvm hhv' vkhl hlylh 'l khn y'mrv hgm sh'vl bnby'm
verses.translation: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְרַ֣ח דָּוִ֔ד מ/נוות מִ/נָּי֖וֹת בָּ/רָמָ֑ה וַ/יָּבֹ֞א וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוֹנָתָ֗ן מֶ֤ה עָשִׂ֨יתִי֙ מֶֽה עֲוֺנִ֤/י וּ/מֶֽה חַטָּאתִ/י֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אָבִ֔י/ךָ כִּ֥י מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: vybrch dvd mnvvt mnyvt brmh vyb' vy'mr lpny yhvntn mh 'shyty mh 'vny vmh cht'ty lpny 'bykh khy mbqsh 't npshy
verses.translation: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר ל֣/וֹ חָלִילָ/ה֮ לֹ֣א תָמוּת֒ הִנֵּ֡ה ל/ו עשה לֹֽא יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה אָבִ֜/י דָּבָ֣ר גָּד֗וֹל א֚וֹ דָּבָ֣ר קָטֹ֔ן וְ/לֹ֥א יִגְלֶ֖ה אֶת אָזְנִ֑/י וּ/מַדּוּעַ֩ יַסְתִּ֨יר אָבִ֥/י מִמֶּ֛/נִּי אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֵ֥ין זֹֽאת
verses.translit: vy'mr lv chlylh l' tmvt hnh lv 'shh l' y'shh 'by dbr gdvl 'v dbr qtn vl' yglh 't 'zny vmdv' ystyr 'by mmny 't hdbr hzh 'yn z't
verses.translation: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֨ע ע֜וֹד דָּוִ֗ד וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יָדֹ֨עַ יָדַ֜ע אָבִ֗י/ךָ כִּֽי מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר אַל יֵֽדַע זֹ֥את יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן פֶּן יֵֽעָצֵ֑ב וְ/אוּלָ֗ם חַי יְהוָה֙ וְ/חֵ֣י נַפְשֶׁ֔/ךָ כִּ֣י כְ/פֶ֔שַׂע בֵּינִ֖/י וּ/בֵ֥ין הַ/מָּֽוֶת
verses.translit: vyshb' 'vd dvd vy'mr yd' yd' 'bykh khy mts'ty chn b'ynykh vy'mr 'l yd' z't yhvntn pn y'tsb v'vlm chy yhvh vchy npshkh khy khpsh' byny vbyn hmvt
verses.translation: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן אֶל דָּוִ֑ד מַה תֹּאמַ֥ר נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvntn 'l dvd mh t'mr npshkh v''shh lkh
verses.translation: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל יְהוֹנָתָ֗ן הִֽנֵּה חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ מָחָ֔ר וְ/אָנֹכִ֛י יָשֹׁב אֵשֵׁ֥ב עִם הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֶ/אֱכ֑וֹל וְ/שִׁלַּחְתַּ֨/נִי֙ וְ/נִסְתַּרְתִּ֣י בַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה עַ֖ד הָ/עֶ֥רֶב הַ/שְּׁלִשִֽׁית
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l yhvntn hnh chdsh mchr v'nkhy yshb 'shb 'm hmlkh l'khvl vshlchtny vnstrty bshdh 'd h'rb hshlshyt
verses.translation: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.

verses.original: אִם פָּקֹ֥ד יִפְקְדֵ֖/נִי אָבִ֑י/ךָ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ נִשְׁאֹל֩ נִשְׁאַ֨ל מִמֶּ֤/נִּי דָוִד֙ לָ/רוּץ֙ בֵּֽית לֶ֣חֶם עִיר֔/וֹ כִּ֣י זֶ֧בַח הַ/יָּמִ֛ים שָׁ֖ם לְ/כָל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּחָֽה
verses.translit: 'm pqd ypqdny 'bykh v'mrt nsh'l nsh'l mmny dvd lrvts byt lchm 'yrv khy zbch hymym shm lkhl hmshpchh
verses.translation: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth-lehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

verses.original: אִם כֹּ֥ה יֹאמַ֛ר ט֖וֹב שָׁל֣וֹם לְ/עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/אִם חָרֹ֤ה יֶֽחֱרֶה֙ ל֔/וֹ דַּ֕ע כִּֽי כָלְתָ֥ה הָ/רָעָ֖ה מֵ/עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm khh y'mr tvb shlvm l'bdkh v'm chrh ychrh lv d' khy khlth hr'h m'mv
verses.translation: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.
