verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ חֶ֨סֶד֙ עַל עַבְדֶּ֔/ךָ כִּ֚י בִּ/בְרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הֵבֵ֥אתָ אֶֽת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ עִמָּ֑/ךְ וְ/אִם יֶשׁ בִּ֤/י עָוֺן֙ הֲמִיתֵ֣/נִי אַ֔תָּה וְ/עַד אָבִ֖י/ךָ לָ/מָּה זֶּ֥ה תְבִיאֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'shyt chsd 'l 'bdkh khy bbryt yhvh hb't 't 'bdkh 'mkh v'm ysh by 'vn hmytny 'th v'd 'bykh lmh zh tby'ny
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן חָלִ֣ילָ/ה לָּ֑/ךְ כִּ֣י אִם יָדֹ֣עַ אֵדַ֗ע כִּֽי כָלְתָ֨ה הָ/רָעָ֜ה מֵ/עִ֤ם אָבִ/י֙ לָ/ב֣וֹא עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/לֹ֥א אֹתָ֖/הּ אַגִּ֥יד לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvntn chlylh lkh khy 'm yd' 'd' khy khlth hr'h m'm 'by lbv' 'lykh vl' 'th 'gyd lkh
verses.translation: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן מִ֖י יַגִּ֣יד לִ֑/י א֛וֹ מַה יַּעַנְ/ךָ֥ אָבִ֖י/ךָ קָשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l yhvntn my ygyd ly 'v mh y'nkh 'bykh qshh
verses.translation: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד לְכָ֖/ה וְ/נֵצֵ֣א הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וַ/יֵּצְא֥וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvntn 'l dvd lkhh vnts' hshdh vyts'v shnyhm hshdh
verses.translation: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹנָתָ֜ן אֶל דָּוִ֗ד יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּֽי אֶחְקֹ֣ר אֶת אָבִ֗/י כָּ/עֵ֤ת מָחָר֙ הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֔ית וְ/הִנֵּה ט֖וֹב אֶל דָּוִ֑ד וְ/לֹֽא אָז֙ אֶשְׁלַ֣ח אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/גָלִ֖יתִי אֶת אָזְנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvntn 'l dvd yhvh 'lhy yshr'l khy 'chqr 't 'by kh't mchr hshlshyt vhnh tvb 'l dvd vl' 'z 'shlch 'lykh vglyty 't 'znkh
verses.translation: And Jonathan said unto David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day , and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;

verses.original: כֹּֽה יַעֲשֶׂה֩ יְהוָ֨ה לִֽ/יהוֹנָתָ֜ן וְ/כֹ֣ה יֹסִ֗יף כִּֽי יֵיטִ֨ב אֶל אָבִ֤/י אֶת הָֽ/רָעָה֙ עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/גָלִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת אָזְנֶ֔/ךָ וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּ֖י/ךָ וְ/הָלַכְתָּ֣ לְ/שָׁל֑וֹם וִ/יהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: khh y'shh yhvh lyhvntn vkhh ysyf khy yytb 'l 'by 't hr'h 'lykh vglyty 't 'znkh vshlchtykh vhlkht lshlvm vyhy yhvh 'mkh kh'shr hyh 'm 'by
verses.translation: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֖א אִם עוֹדֶ֣/נִּי חָ֑י וְ/לֹֽא תַעֲשֶׂ֧ה עִמָּדִ֛/י חֶ֥סֶד יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א אָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vl' 'm 'vdny chy vl' t'shh 'mdy chsd yhvh vl' 'mvt
verses.translation: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the LORD , that I die not:

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תַכְרִ֧ת אֶֽת חַסְדְּ/ךָ֛ מֵ/עִ֥ם בֵּיתִ֖/י עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/לֹ֗א בְּ/הַכְרִ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֶת אֹיְבֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד אִ֕ישׁ מֵ/עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vl' tkhrt 't chsdkh m'm byty 'd 'vlm vl' bhkhrt yhvh 't 'yby dvd 'ysh m'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרֹ֥ת יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן עִם בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד וּ/בִקֵּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/יַּ֖ד אֹיְבֵ֥י דָוִֽד
verses.translit: vykhrt yhvntn 'm byt dvd vbqsh yhvh myd 'yby dvd
verses.translation: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying , Let the LORD even require it at the hand of David’s enemies.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֤וֹסֶף יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ לְ/הַשְׁבִּ֣יעַ אֶת דָּוִ֔ד בְּ/אַהֲבָת֖/וֹ אֹת֑/וֹ כִּֽי אַהֲבַ֥ת נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ אֲהֵבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyvsf yhvntn lhshby' 't dvd b'hbtv 'tv khy 'hbt npshv 'hbv
verses.translation: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר ל֥/וֹ יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מָחָ֣ר חֹ֑דֶשׁ וְ/נִפְקַ֕דְתָּ כִּ֥י יִפָּקֵ֖ד מוֹשָׁבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv yhvntn mchr chdsh vnpqdt khy ypqd mvshbkh
verses.translation: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּשְׁתָּ֙ תֵּרֵ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וּ/בָאתָ֙ אֶל הַ/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר נִסְתַּ֥רְתָּ שָּׁ֖ם בְּ/י֣וֹם הַֽ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְ/יָ֣שַׁבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖צֶל הָ/אֶ֥בֶן הָ/אָֽזֶל
verses.translit: vshlsht trd m'd vb't 'l hmqvm 'shr nstrt shm byvm hm'shh vyshbt 'tsl h'bn h'zl
verses.translation: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand , and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֕י שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הַ/חִצִּ֖ים צִדָּ֣/ה אוֹרֶ֑ה לְ/שַֽׁלַּֽח לִ֖/י לְ/מַטָּרָֽה
verses.translit: v'ny shlsht hchtsym tsdh 'vrh lshlch ly lmtrh
verses.translation: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof , as though I shot at a mark.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֙ אֶשְׁלַ֣ח אֶת הַ/נַּ֔עַר לֵ֖ךְ מְצָ֣א אֶת הַ/חִצִּ֑ים אִם אָמֹר֩ אֹמַ֨ר לַ/נַּ֜עַר הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/חִצִּ֣ים מִמְּ/ךָ֣ וָ/הֵ֗נָּה קָחֶ֧/נּוּ וָ/בֹ֛אָ/ה כִּֽי שָׁל֥וֹם לְ/ךָ֛ וְ/אֵ֥ין דָּבָ֖ר חַי יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhnh 'shlch 't hn'r lkh mts' 't hchtsym 'm 'mr 'mr ln'r hnh hchtsym mmkh vhnh qchnv vb'h khy shlvm lkh v'yn dbr chy yhvh
verses.translation: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying , Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the LORD liveth.

verses.original: וְ/אִם כֹּ֤ה אֹמַר֙ לָ/עֶ֔לֶם הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/חִצִּ֖ים מִמְּ/ךָ֣ וָ/הָ֑לְאָה לֵ֕ךְ כִּ֥י שִֽׁלַּחֲ/ךָ֖ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm khh 'mr l'lm hnh hchtsym mmkh vhl'h lkh khy shlchkh yhvh
verses.translation: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְנוּ אֲנִ֣י וָ/אָ֑תָּה הִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בֵּינִ֥/י וּ/בֵינְ/ךָ֖ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vhdbr 'shr dbrnv 'ny v'th hnh yhvh byny vbynkh 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD be between thee and me for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסָּתֵ֥ר דָּוִ֖ד בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֣י הַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ וַ/יֵּ֧שֶׁב הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ על אֶל הַ/לֶּ֖חֶם לֶ/אֱכֽוֹל
verses.translit: vystr dvd bshdh vyhy hchdsh vyshb hmlkh 'l 'l hlchm l'khvl
verses.translation: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ עַל מ֨וֹשָׁב֜/וֹ כְּ/פַ֣עַם בְּ/פַ֗עַם אֶל מוֹשַׁב֙ הַ/קִּ֔יר וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב אַבְנֵ֖ר מִ/צַּ֣ד שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יִּפָּקֵ֖ד מְק֥וֹם דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vyshb hmlkh 'l mvshbv khp'm bp'm 'l mvshb hqyr vyqm yhvntn vyshb 'bnr mtsd sh'vl vypqd mqvm dvd
verses.translation: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא דִבֶּ֥ר שָׁא֛וּל מְא֖וּמָה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא כִּ֤י אָמַר֙ מִקְרֶ֣ה ה֔וּא בִּלְתִּ֥י טָה֛וֹר ה֖וּא כִּֽי לֹ֥א טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: vl' dbr sh'vl m'vmh byvm hhv' khy 'mr mqrh hv' blty thvr hv' khy l' thvr
verses.translation: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מִֽ/מָּחֳרַ֤ת הַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י וַ/יִּפָּקֵ֖ד מְק֣וֹם דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֔/וֹ מַדּ֜וּעַ לֹא בָ֧א בֶן יִשַׁ֛י גַּם תְּמ֥וֹל גַּם הַ/יּ֖וֹם אֶל הַ/לָּֽחֶם
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt hchdsh hshny vypqd mqvm dvd vy'mr sh'vl 'l yhvntn bnv mdv' l' b' bn yshy gm tmvl gm hyvm 'l hlchm
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן אֶת שָׁא֑וּל נִשְׁאֹ֨ל נִשְׁאַ֥ל דָּוִ֛ד מֵ/עִמָּדִ֖/י עַד בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vy'n yhvntn 't sh'vl nsh'l nsh'l dvd m'mdy 'd byt lchm
verses.translation: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth-lehem:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר שַׁלְּחֵ֣/נִי נָ֡א כִּ֣י זֶבַח֩ מִשְׁפָּחָ֨ה לָ֜/נוּ בָּ/עִ֗יר וְ/ה֤וּא צִוָּֽה לִ/י֙ אָחִ֔/י וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אִם מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ אִמָּ֥לְטָה נָּ֖א וְ/אֶרְאֶ֣ה אֶת אֶחָ֑/י עַל כֵּ֣ן לֹא בָ֔א אֶל שֻׁלְחַ֖ן הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr shlchny n' khy zbch mshpchh lnv b'yr vhv' tsvh ly 'chy v'th 'm mts'ty chn b'ynykh 'mlth n' v'r'h 't 'chy 'l khn l' b' 'l shlchn hmlkh
verses.translation: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king’s table.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֤ף שָׁאוּל֙ בִּ/יה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ בֶּֽן נַעֲוַ֖ת הַ/מַּרְדּ֑וּת הֲ/ל֣וֹא יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי בֹחֵ֤ר אַתָּה֙ לְ/בֶן יִשַׁ֔י לְ/בָ֨שְׁתְּ/ךָ֔ וּ/לְ/בֹ֖שֶׁת עֶרְוַ֥ת אִמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vychr 'f sh'vl byhvntn vy'mr lv bn n'vt hmrdvt hlv' yd'ty khy bchr 'th lbn yshy lbshtkh vlbsht 'rvt 'mkh
verses.translation: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman , do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother’s nakedness?

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל הַ/יָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בֶּן יִשַׁי֙ חַ֣י עַל הָ/אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִכּ֖וֹן אַתָּ֣ה וּ/מַלְכוּתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שְׁלַ֨ח וְ/קַ֤ח אֹת/וֹ֙ אֵלַ֔/י כִּ֥י בֶן מָ֖וֶת הֽוּא
verses.translit: khy khl hymym 'shr bn yshy chy 'l h'dmh l' tkhvn 'th vmlkhvtkh v'th shlch vqch 'tv 'ly khy bn mvt hv'
verses.translation: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן אֶת שָׁא֖וּל אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלָ֛י/ו לָ֥/מָּה יוּמַ֖ת מֶ֥ה עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'n yhvntn 't sh'vl 'byv vy'mr 'lyv lmh yvmt mh 'shh
verses.translation: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨טֶל שָׁא֧וּל אֶֽת הַ/חֲנִ֛ית עָלָ֖י/ו לְ/הַכֹּת֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֨דַע֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן כִּֽי כָ֥לָה הִ֛יא מֵ/עִ֥ם אָבִ֖י/ו לְ/הָמִ֥ית אֶת דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vytl sh'vl 't hchnyt 'lyv lhkhtv vyd' yhvntn khy khlh hy' m'm 'byv lhmyt 't dvd
verses.translation: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧קָם יְהוֹנָתָ֛ן מֵ/עִ֥ם הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֖ן בָּ/חֳרִי אָ֑ף וְ/לֹא אָכַ֞ל בְּ/יוֹם הַ/חֹ֤דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִי֙ לֶ֔חֶם כִּ֤י נֶעְצַב֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד כִּ֥י הִכְלִמ֖/וֹ אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqm yhvntn m'm hshlchn bchry 'f vl' 'khl byvm hchdsh hshny lchm khy n'tsb 'l dvd khy hkhlmv 'byv
verses.translation: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יֵּצֵ֧א יְהוֹנָתָ֛ן הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה לְ/מוֹעֵ֣ד דָּוִ֑ד וְ/נַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr vyts' yhvntn hshdh lmv'd dvd vn'r qtn 'mv
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/נַעֲר֔/וֹ רֻ֗ץ מְצָ֥א נָא֙ אֶת הַ֣/חִצִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מוֹרֶ֑ה הַ/נַּ֣עַר רָ֔ץ וְ/הֽוּא יָרָ֥ה הַ/חֵ֖צִי לְ/הַעֲבִרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr ln'rv rts mts' n' 't hchtsym 'shr 'nkhy mvrh hn'r rts vhv' yrh hchtsy lh'brv
verses.translation: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ עַד מְק֣וֹם הַ/חֵ֔צִי אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָרָ֖ה יְהוֹנָתָ֑ן וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א יְהוֹנָתָ֜ן אַחֲרֵ֤י הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר הֲ/ל֥וֹא הַ/חֵ֖צִי מִמְּ/ךָ֥ וָ/הָֽלְאָה
verses.translit: vyb' hn'r 'd mqvm hchtsy 'shr yrh yhvntn vyqr' yhvntn 'chry hn'r vy'mr hlv' hchtsy mmkh vhl'h
verses.translation: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַ/נַּ֔עַר מְהֵרָ֥ה ח֖וּשָׁ/ה אַֽל תַּעֲמֹ֑ד וַ/יְלַקֵּ֞ט נַ֤עַר יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ אֶת ה/חצי הַ֣/חִצִּ֔ים וַ/יָּבֹ֖א אֶל אֲדֹנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvntn 'chry hn'r mhrh chvshh 'l t'md vylqt n'r yhvntn 't hchtsy hchtsym vyb' 'l 'dnyv
verses.translation: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נַּ֖עַר לֹֽא יָדַ֣ע מְא֑וּמָה אַ֤ךְ יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְ/דָוִ֔ד יָדְע֖וּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vhn'r l' yd' m'vmh 'kh yhvntn vdvd yd'v 't hdbr
verses.translation: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ אֶת כֵּלָ֔י/ו אֶל הַ/נַּ֖עַר אֲשֶׁר ל֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ לֵ֖ךְ הָבֵ֥יא הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vytn yhvntn 't khlyv 'l hn'r 'shr lv vy'mr lv lkh hby' h'yr
verses.translation: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.

verses.original: הַ/נַּעַר֮ בָּא֒ וְ/דָוִ֗ד קָ֚ם מֵ/אֵ֣צֶל הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב וַ/יִּפֹּ֨ל לְ/אַפָּ֥י/ו אַ֛רְצָ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ פְּעָמִ֑ים וַֽ/יִּשְּׁק֣וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת רֵעֵ֗/הוּ וַ/יִּבְכּוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת רֵעֵ֔/הוּ עַד דָּוִ֖ד הִגְדִּֽיל
verses.translit: hn'r b' vdvd qm m'tsl hngb vypl l'pyv 'rtsh vyshtchv shlsh p'mym vyshqv 'ysh 't r'hv vybkhv 'ysh 't r'hv 'd dvd hgdyl
verses.translation: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוֹנָתָ֛ן לְ/דָוִ֖ד לֵ֣ךְ לְ/שָׁל֑וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨עְנוּ שְׁנֵ֜י/נוּ אֲנַ֗חְנוּ בְּ/שֵׁ֤ם יְהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֞ה יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵינֶ֗/ךָ וּ/בֵ֥ין זַרְעִ֛/י וּ/בֵ֥ין זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvntn ldvd lkh lshlvm 'shr nshb'nv shnynv 'nchnv bshm yhvh l'mr yhvh yhyh byny vbynkh vbyn zr'y vbyn zr'kh 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD , saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city. be witness of that which etc

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖קָם וַ/יֵּלַ֑ךְ וִ/יהוֹנָתָ֖ן בָּ֥א הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyqm vylkh vyhvntn b' h'yr
verses.translation: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א דָוִד֙ נֹ֔בֶ/ה אֶל אֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וַ/יֶּחֱרַ֨ד אֲחִימֶ֜לֶךְ לִ/קְרַ֣את דָּוִ֗ד וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ מַדּ֤וּעַ אַתָּה֙ לְ/בַדֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/אִ֖ישׁ אֵ֥ין אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyb' dvd nbh 'l 'chymlkh hkhhn vychrd 'chymlkh lqr't dvd vy'mr lv mdv' 'th lbdkh v'ysh 'yn 'tkh
verses.translation: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד לַ/אֲחִימֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֮ צִוַּ֣/נִי דָבָר֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י אִ֣ישׁ אַל יֵ֧דַע מְא֛וּמָה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִ֥י שֹׁלֵֽחֲ/ךָ֖ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑/ךָ וְ/אֶת הַ/נְּעָרִ֣ים יוֹדַ֔עְתִּי אֶל מְק֥וֹם פְּלֹנִ֖י אַלְמוֹנִֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd l'chymlkh hkhhn hmlkh tsvny dbr vy'mr 'ly 'ysh 'l yd' m'vmh 't hdbr 'shr 'nkhy shlchkh v'shr tsvytkh v't hn'rym yvd'ty 'l mqvm plny 'lmvny
verses.translation: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה מַה יֵּ֧שׁ תַּֽחַת יָדְ/ךָ֛ חֲמִשָּׁה לֶ֖חֶם תְּנָ֣/ה בְ/יָדִ֑/י א֖וֹ הַ/נִּמְצָֽא
verses.translit: v'th mh ysh tcht ydkh chmshh lchm tnh bydy 'v hnmts'
verses.translation: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת דָּוִד֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר אֵֽין לֶ֥חֶם חֹ֖ל אֶל תַּ֣חַת יָדִ֑/י כִּֽי אִם לֶ֤חֶם קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יֵ֔שׁ אִם נִשְׁמְר֥וּ הַ/נְּעָרִ֖ים אַ֥ךְ מֵ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'n hkhhn 't dvd vy'mr 'yn lchm chl 'l tcht ydy khy 'm lchm qdsh ysh 'm nshmrv hn'rym 'kh m'shh
verses.translation: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַן֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶת הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ כִּ֣י אִם אִשָּׁ֤ה עֲצֻֽרָה לָ֨/נוּ֙ כִּ/תְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם בְּ/צֵאתִ֕/י וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ כְלֵֽי הַ/נְּעָרִ֖ים קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְ/הוּא֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ חֹ֔ל וְ/אַ֕ף כִּ֥י הַ/יּ֖וֹם יִקְדַּ֥שׁ בַּ/כֶּֽלִי
verses.translit: vy'n dvd 't hkhhn vy'mr lv khy 'm 'shh 'tsrh lnv khtmvl shlshm bts'ty vyhyv khly hn'rym qdsh vhv' drkh chl v'f khy hyvm yqdsh bkhly
verses.translation: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the LORD , to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֥/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן קֹ֑דֶשׁ כִּי֩ לֹא הָ֨יָה שָׁ֜ם לֶ֗חֶם כִּֽי אִם לֶ֤חֶם הַ/פָּנִים֙ הַ/מּֽוּסָרִים֙ מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לָ/שׂוּם֙ לֶ֣חֶם חֹ֔ם בְּ/י֖וֹם הִלָּקְחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytn lv hkhhn qdsh khy l' hyh shm lchm khy 'm lchm hpnym hmvsrym mlpny yhvh lshvm lchm chm byvm hlqchv
verses.translation: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD ; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֡ם אִישׁ֩ מֵ/עַבְדֵ֨י שָׁא֜וּל בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא נֶעְצָר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּ/שְׁמ֖/וֹ דֹּאֵ֣ג הָ/אֲדֹמִ֑י אַבִּ֥יר הָ/רֹעִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vshm 'ysh m'bdy sh'vl byvm hhv' n'tsr lpny yhvh vshmv d'g h'dmy 'byr hr'ym 'shr lsh'vl
verses.translation: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ לַ/אֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְ/אִ֛ין יֶשׁ פֹּ֥ה תַֽחַת יָדְ/ךָ֖ חֲנִ֣ית אוֹ חָ֑רֶב כִּ֣י גַם חַרְבִּ֤/י וְ/גַם כֵּלַ/י֙ לֹֽא לָקַ֣חְתִּי בְ/יָדִ֔/י כִּֽי הָיָ֥ה דְבַר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ נָחֽוּץ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd l'chymlkh v'yn ysh ph tcht ydkh chnyt 'v chrb khy gm chrby vgm khly l' lqchty bydy khy hyh dbr hmlkh nchvts
verses.translation: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן חֶרֶב֩ גָּלְיָ֨ת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֜י אֲשֶׁר הִכִּ֣יתָ בְּ/עֵ֣מֶק הָאֵלָ֗ה הִנֵּה הִ֞יא לוּטָ֣ה בַ/שִּׂמְלָה֮ אַחֲרֵ֣י הָ/אֵפוֹד֒ אִם אֹתָ֤/הּ תִּֽקַּח לְ/ךָ֙ קָ֔ח כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין אַחֶ֛רֶת זוּלָתָ֖/הּ בָּ/זֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֵ֥ין כָּמ֖וֹ/הָ תְּנֶ֥/נָּה לִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr hkhhn chrb glyt hplshty 'shr hkhyt b'mq h'lh hnh hy' lvth bshmlh 'chry h'pvd 'm 'th tqch lkh qch khy 'yn 'chrt zvlth bzh vy'mr dvd 'yn khmvh tnnh ly
verses.translation: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יִּבְרַ֥ח בַּ/יּוֹם הַ/ה֖וּא מִ/פְּנֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יָּבֹ֕א אֶל אָכִ֖ישׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ גַּֽת
verses.translit: vyqm dvd vybrch byvm hhv' mpny sh'vl vyb' 'l 'khysh mlkh gt
verses.translation: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ עַבְדֵ֤י אָכִישׁ֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו הֲ/לוֹא זֶ֥ה דָוִ֖ד מֶ֣לֶךְ הָ/אָ֑רֶץ הֲ/ל֣וֹא לָ/זֶ֗ה יַעֲנ֤וּ בַ/מְּחֹלוֹת֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִכָּ֤ה שָׁאוּל֙ ב/אלפ/ו בַּ/אֲלָפָ֔י/ו וְ/דָוִ֖ד ב/רבבת/ו בְּ/רִבְבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'bdy 'khysh 'lyv hlv' zh dvd mlkh h'rts hlv' lzh y'nv bmchlvt l'mr hkhh sh'vl b'lpv b'lpyv vdvd brbbtv brbbtyv
verses.translation: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧שֶׂם דָּוִ֛ד אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה בִּ/לְבָב֑/וֹ וַ/יִּרָ֣א מְאֹ֔ד מִ/פְּנֵ֖י אָכִ֥ישׁ מֶֽלֶךְ גַּֽת
verses.translit: vyshm dvd 't hdbrym h'lh blbbv vyr' m'd mpny 'khysh mlkh gt
verses.translation: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁנּ֤/וֹ אֶת טַעְמ/וֹ֙ בְּ/עֵ֣ינֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּתְהֹלֵ֖ל בְּ/יָדָ֑/ם ו/יתו וַ/יְתָיו֙ עַל דַּלְת֣וֹת הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר וַ/יּ֥וֹרֶד רִיר֖/וֹ אֶל זְקָנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshnv 't t'mv b'ynyhm vythll bydm vytv vytyv 'l dltvt hsh'r vyvrd ryrv 'l zqnv
verses.translation: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אָכִ֖ישׁ אֶל עֲבָדָ֑י/ו הִנֵּ֤ה תִרְאוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּ֔עַ לָ֛/מָּה תָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖/וֹ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'khysh 'l 'bdyv hnh tr'v 'ysh mshtg' lmh tby'v 'tv 'ly
verses.translation: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֖ט אֶל מְעָרַ֣ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֤וּ אֶחָי/ו֙ וְ/כָל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔י/ו וַ/יֵּרְד֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vylkh dvd mshm vymlt 'l m'rt 'dlm vyshm'v 'chyv vkhl byt 'byv vyrdv 'lyv shmh
verses.translation: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father’s house heard it , they went down thither to him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְקַבְּצ֣וּ אֵ֠לָי/ו כָּל אִ֨ישׁ מָצ֜וֹק וְ/כָל אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר ל֤/וֹ נֹשֶׁא֙ וְ/כָל אִ֣ישׁ מַר נֶ֔פֶשׁ וַ/יְהִ֥י עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/שָׂ֑ר וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ עִמּ֔/וֹ כְּ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vytqbtsv 'lyv khl 'ysh mtsvq vkhl 'ysh 'shr lv nsh' vkhl 'ysh mr npsh vyhy 'lyhm lshr vyhyv 'mv kh'rb' m'vt 'ysh
verses.translation: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧לֶךְ דָּוִ֛ד מִ/שָּׁ֖ם מִצְפֵּ֣ה מוֹאָ֑ב וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֗ב יֵֽצֵא נָ֞א אָבִ֤/י וְ/אִמִּ/י֙ אִתְּ/כֶ֔ם עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵדַ֔ע מַה יַּֽעֲשֶׂה לִּ֖/י אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vylkh dvd mshm mtsph mv'b vy'mr 'l mlkh mv'b yts' n' 'by v'my 'tkhm 'd 'shr 'd' mh y'shh ly 'lhym
verses.translation: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.

verses.original: וַ/יַּנְחֵ֕/ם אֶת פְּנֵ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֑ב וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ עִמּ֔/וֹ כָּל יְמֵ֥י הֱיוֹת דָּוִ֖ד בַּ/מְּצוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vynchm 't pny mlkh mv'b vyshbv 'mv khl ymy hyvt dvd bmtsvdh
verses.translation: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ גָּ֨ד הַ/נָּבִ֜יא אֶל דָּוִ֗ד לֹ֤א תֵשֵׁב֙ בַּ/מְּצוּדָ֔ה לֵ֥ךְ וּ/בָֽאתָ לְּ/ךָ֖ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יָּבֹ֖א יַ֥עַר חָֽרֶת
verses.translit: vy'mr gd hnby' 'l dvd l' tshb bmtsvdh lkh vb't lkh 'rts yhvdh vylkh dvd vyb' y'r chrt
verses.translation: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע שָׁא֔וּל כִּ֚י נוֹדַ֣ע דָּוִ֔ד וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁאוּל֩ יוֹשֵׁ֨ב בַּ/גִּבְעָ֜ה תַּֽחַת הָ/אֶ֤שֶׁל בָּֽ/רָמָה֙ וַ/חֲנִית֣/וֹ בְ/יָד֔/וֹ וְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֖י/ו נִצָּבִ֥ים עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshm' sh'vl khy nvd' dvd v'nshym 'shr 'tv vsh'vl yvshb bgb'h tcht h'shl brmh vchnytv bydv vkhl 'bdyv ntsbym 'lyv
verses.translation: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֗וּל לַֽ/עֲבָדָי/ו֙ הַ/נִּצָּבִ֣ים עָלָ֔י/ו שִׁמְעוּ נָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י יְמִינִ֑י גַּם לְ/כֻלְּ/כֶ֗ם יִתֵּ֤ן בֶּן יִשַׁי֙ שָׂד֣וֹת וּ/כְרָמִ֔ים לְ/כֻלְּ/כֶ֣ם יָשִׂ֔ים שָׂרֵ֥י אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl l'bdyv hntsbym 'lyv shm'v n' bny ymyny gm lkhlkhm ytn bn yshy shdvt vkhrmym lkhlkhm yshym shry 'lpym vshry m'vt
verses.translation: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;

verses.original: כִּי֩ קְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם כֻּלְּ/כֶ֜ם עָלַ֗/י וְ/אֵין גֹּלֶ֤ה אֶת אָזְנִ/י֙ בִּ/כְרָת בְּנִ֣/י עִם בֶּן יִשַׁ֔י וְ/אֵין חֹלֶ֥ה מִ/כֶּ֛ם עָלַ֖/י וְ/גֹלֶ֣ה אֶת אָזְנִ֑/י כִּ֣י הֵקִים֩ בְּנִ֨/י אֶת עַבְדִּ֥/י עָלַ֛/י לְ/אֹרֵ֖ב כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy qshrtm khlkhm 'ly v'yn glh 't 'zny bkhrt bny 'm bn yshy v'yn chlh mkhm 'ly vglh 't 'zny khy hqym bny 't 'bdy 'ly l'rb khyvm hzh
verses.translation: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַן דֹּאֵ֣ג הָ/אֲדֹמִ֗י וְ/ה֛וּא נִצָּ֥ב עַל עַבְדֵֽי שָׁא֖וּל וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת בֶּן יִשַׁ֔י בָּ֣א נֹ֔בֶ/ה אֶל אֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ בֶּן אֲחִטֽוּב
verses.translit: vy'n d'g h'dmy vhv' ntsb 'l 'bdy sh'vl vy'mr r'yty 't bn yshy b' nbh 'l 'chymlkh bn 'chtvb
verses.translation: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַל ל/וֹ֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/צֵידָ֖ה נָ֣תַן ל֑/וֹ וְ/אֵ֗ת חֶ֛רֶב גָּלְיָ֥ת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י נָ֥תַן לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vysh'l lv byhvh vtsydh ntn lv v't chrb glyt hplshty ntn lv
verses.translation: And he enquired of the LORD for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ לִ/קְרֹא֩ אֶת אֲחִימֶ֨לֶךְ בֶּן אֲחִיט֜וּב הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל בֵּ֥ית אָבִ֛י/ו הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/נֹ֑ב וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ כֻלָּ֖/ם אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh lqr' 't 'chymlkh bn 'chytvb hkhhn v't khl byt 'byv hkhhnym 'shr bnb vyb'v khlm 'l hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל שְֽׁמַֽע נָ֖א בֶּן אֲחִיט֑וּב וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הִנְ/נִ֥י אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl shm' n' bn 'chytvb vy'mr hnny 'dny
verses.translation: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am , my lord.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אל/ו אֵלָי/ו֙ שָׁא֔וּל לָ֚/מָּה קְשַׁרְתֶּ֣ם עָלַ֔/י אַתָּ֖ה וּ/בֶן יִשָׁ֑י בְּ/תִתְּ/ךָ֨ ל֜/וֹ לֶ֣חֶם וְ/חֶ֗רֶב וְ/שָׁא֥וֹל ל/וֹ֙ בֵּֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים לָ/ק֥וּם אֵלַ֛/י לְ/אֹרֵ֖ב כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lv 'lyv sh'vl lmh qshrtm 'ly 'th vbn yshy bttkh lv lchm vchrb vsh'vl lv b'lhym lqvm 'ly l'rb khyvm hzh
verses.translation: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַן אֲחִימֶ֛לֶךְ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר וּ/מִ֤י בְ/כָל עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ כְּ/דָוִ֣ד נֶאֱמָ֔ן וַ/חֲתַ֥ן הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/סָ֥ר אֶל מִשְׁמַעְתֶּ֖/ךָ וְ/נִכְבָּ֥ד בְּ/בֵיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'n 'chymlkh 't hmlkh vy'mr vmy bkhl 'bdykh khdvd n'mn vchtn hmlkh vsr 'l mshm'tkh vnkhbd bbytkh
verses.translation: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king’s son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?

verses.original: הַ/יּ֧וֹם הַחִלֹּ֛תִי ל/שאול לִ/שְׁאָל ל֥/וֹ בֵ/אלֹהִ֖ים חָלִ֣ילָ/ה לִּ֑/י אַל יָשֵׂם֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ בְּ/עַבְדּ֤/וֹ דָבָר֙ בְּ/כָל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔/י כִּ֠י לֹֽא יָדַ֤ע עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ בְּ/כָל זֹ֔את דָּבָ֥ר קָטֹ֖ן א֥וֹ גָדֽוֹל
verses.translit: hyvm hchlty lsh'vl lsh'l lv b'lhym chlylh ly 'l yshm hmlkh b'bdv dbr bkhl byt 'by khy l' yd' 'bdkh bkhl z't dbr qtn 'v gdvl
verses.translation: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ מ֥וֹת תָּמ֖וּת אֲחִימֶ֑לֶךְ אַתָּ֖ה וְ/כָל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh mvt tmvt 'chymlkh 'th vkhl byt 'bykh
verses.translation: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ לָ/רָצִים֩ הַ/נִּצָּבִ֨ים עָלָ֜י/ו סֹ֥בּוּ וְ/הָמִ֣יתוּ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י גַם יָדָ/ם֙ עִם דָּוִ֔ד וְ/כִ֤י יָֽדְעוּ֙ כִּֽי בֹרֵ֣חַ ה֔וּא וְ/לֹ֥א גָל֖וּ אֶת אזנ/ו אָזְנִ֑/י וְ/לֹֽא אָב֞וּ עַבְדֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לִ/שְׁלֹ֣חַ אֶת יָדָ֔/ם לִ/פְגֹ֖עַ בְּ/כֹהֲנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lrtsym hntsbym 'lyv sbv vhmytv khhny yhvh khy gm ydm 'm dvd vkhy yd'v khy brch hv' vl' glv 't 'znv 'zny vl' 'bv 'bdy hmlkh lshlch 't ydm lpg' bkhhny yhvh
verses.translation: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the LORD ; because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ ל/דויג לְ/דוֹאֵ֔ג סֹ֣ב אַתָּ֔ה וּ/פְגַ֖ע בַּ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וַ/יִּסֹּ֞ב דויג דּוֹאֵ֣ג הָ/אֲדֹמִ֗י וַ/יִּפְגַּע הוּא֙ בַּ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַ/יָּ֣מֶת בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא שְׁמֹנִ֤ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁה֙ אִ֔ישׁ נֹשֵׂ֖א אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh ldvyg ldv'g sb 'th vpg' bkhhnym vysb dvyg dv'g h'dmy vypg' hv' bkhhnym vymt byvm hhv' shmnym vchmshh 'ysh nsh' 'pvd bd
verses.translation: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת נֹ֤ב עִיר הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ הִכָּ֣ה לְ/פִי חֶ֔רֶב מֵ/אִישׁ֙ וְ/עַד אִשָּׁ֔ה מֵ/עוֹלֵ֖ל וְ/עַד יוֹנֵ֑ק וְ/שׁ֧וֹר וַ/חֲמ֛וֹר וָ/שֶׂ֖ה לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v't nb 'yr hkhhnym hkhh lpy chrb m'ysh v'd 'shh m'vll v'd yvnq vshvr vchmvr vshh lpy chrb
verses.translation: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֣ט בֵּן אֶחָ֗ד לַ/אֲחִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ בֶּן אֲחִט֔וּב וּ/שְׁמ֖/וֹ אֶבְיָתָ֑ר וַ/יִּבְרַ֖ח אַחֲרֵ֥י דָוִֽד
verses.translit: vymlt bn 'chd l'chymlkh bn 'chtvb vshmv 'bytr vybrch 'chry dvd
verses.translation: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֥ד אֶבְיָתָ֖ר לְ/דָוִ֑ד כִּ֚י הָרַ֣ג שָׁא֔וּל אֵ֖ת כֹּהֲנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vygd 'bytr ldvd khy hrg sh'vl 't khhny yhvh
verses.translation: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the LORD’s priests.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד לְ/אֶבְיָתָ֗ר יָדַ֜עְתִּי בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ כִּֽי שָׁם֙ דויג דּוֹאֵ֣ג הָ/אֲדֹמִ֔י כִּֽי הַגֵּ֥ד יַגִּ֖יד לְ/שָׁא֑וּל אָנֹכִ֣י סַבֹּ֔תִי בְּ/כָל נֶ֖פֶשׁ בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd l'bytr yd'ty byvm hhv' khy shm dvyg dv'g h'dmy khy hgd ygyd lsh'vl 'nkhy sbty bkhl npsh byt 'bykh
verses.translation: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father’s house.

verses.original: שְׁבָ֤/ה אִתִּ/י֙ אַל תִּירָ֔א כִּ֛י אֲשֶׁר יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת נַפְשִׁ֖/י יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת נַפְשֶׁ֑/ךָ כִּֽי מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת אַתָּ֖ה עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: shbh 'ty 'l tyr' khy 'shr ybqsh 't npshy ybqsh 't npshkh khy mshmrt 'th 'mdy
verses.translation: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֥דוּ לְ/דָוִ֖ד לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֤ה פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ נִלְחָמִ֣ים בִּ/קְעִילָ֔ה וְ/הֵ֖מָּה שֹׁסִ֥ים אֶת הַ/גֳּרָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vygdv ldvd l'mr hnh plshtym nlchmym bq'ylh vhmh shsym 't hgrnvt
verses.translation: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤ד בַּֽ/יהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַ/אֵלֵ֣ךְ וְ/הִכֵּ֔יתִי בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל דָּוִ֗ד לֵ֚ךְ וְ/הִכִּ֣יתָ בַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתָּ֖ אֶת קְעִילָֽה
verses.translit: vysh'l dvd byhvh l'mr h'lkh vhkhyty bplshtym h'lh vy'mr yhvh 'l dvd lkh vhkhyt bplshtym vhvsh't 't q'ylh
verses.translation: Therefore David enquired of the LORD , saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the LORD said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י דָוִד֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ פֹ֛ה בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה יְרֵאִ֑ים וְ/אַף֙ כִּֽי נֵלֵ֣ךְ קְעִלָ֔ה אֶל מַֽעַרְכ֖וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'nshy dvd 'lyv hnh 'nchnv ph byhvdh yr'ym v'f khy nlkh q'lh 'l m'rkhvt plshtym
verses.translation: And David’s men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

verses.original: וַ/יּ֨וֹסֶף ע֤וֹד דָּוִד֙ לִ/שְׁאֹ֣ל בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה וַֽ/יַּעֲנֵ֖/הוּ יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר ק֚וּם רֵ֣ד קְעִילָ֔ה כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בְּ/יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyvsf 'vd dvd lsh'l byhvh vy'nhv yhvh vy'mr qvm rd q'ylh khy 'ny ntn 't plshtym bydkh
verses.translation: Then David enquired of the LORD yet again. And the LORD answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֩ ו/אנש/ו וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֨י/ו קְעִילָ֜ה וַ/יִּלָּ֣חֶם בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַ/יִּנְהַג֙ אֶת מִקְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּ֥ךְ בָּ/הֶ֖ם מַכָּ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣שַׁע דָּוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת יֹשְׁבֵ֥י קְעִילָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh dvd v'nshv v'nshyv q'ylh vylchm bplshtym vynhg 't mqnyhm vykh bhm mkhh gdvlh vysh' dvd 't yshby q'ylh
verses.translation: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ֠/בְרֹחַ אֶבְיָתָ֧ר בֶּן אֲחִימֶ֛לֶךְ אֶל דָּוִ֖ד קְעִילָ֑ה אֵפ֖וֹד יָרַ֥ד בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy bbrch 'bytr bn 'chymlkh 'l dvd q'ylh 'pvd yrd bydv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֣ד לְ/שָׁא֔וּל כִּי בָ֥א דָוִ֖ד קְעִילָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֗וּל נִכַּ֨ר אֹת֤/וֹ אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּ/יָדִ֔/י כִּ֚י נִסְגַּ֣ר לָ/ב֔וֹא בְּ/עִ֖יר דְּלָתַ֥יִם וּ/בְרִֽיחַ
verses.translit: vygd lsh'vl khy b' dvd q'ylh vy'mr sh'vl nkhr 'tv 'lhym bydy khy nsgr lbv' b'yr dltym vbrych
verses.translation: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁמַּ֥ע שָׁא֛וּל אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה לָ/רֶ֣דֶת קְעִילָ֔ה לָ/צ֥וּר אֶל דָּוִ֖ד וְ/אֶל אֲנָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vyshm' sh'vl 't khl h'm lmlchmh lrdt q'ylh ltsvr 'l dvd v'l 'nshyv
verses.translation: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣דַע דָּוִ֔ד כִּ֣י עָלָ֔י/ו שָׁא֖וּל מַחֲרִ֣ישׁ הָ/רָעָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן הַגִּ֖ישָׁ/ה הָ/אֵפֽוֹד
verses.translit: vyd' dvd khy 'lyv sh'vl mchrysh hr'h vy'mr 'l 'bytr hkhhn hgyshh h'pvd
verses.translation: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ דָּוִד֒ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שָׁמֹ֤עַ שָׁמַע֙ עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ כִּֽי מְבַקֵּ֥שׁ שָׁא֖וּל לָ/ב֣וֹא אֶל קְעִילָ֑ה לְ/שַׁחֵ֥ת לָ/עִ֖יר בַּ/עֲבוּרִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd yhvh 'lhy yshr'l shm' shm' 'bdkh khy mbqsh sh'vl lbv' 'l q'ylh lshcht l'yr b'bvry
verses.translation: Then said David, O LORD God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

verses.original: הֲ/יַסְגִּרֻ֣/נִי בַעֲלֵי֩ קְעִילָ֨ה בְ/יָד֜/וֹ הֲ/יֵרֵ֣ד שָׁא֗וּל כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁמַ֣ע עַבְדֶּ֔/ךָ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַגֶּד נָ֖א לְ/עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה יֵרֵֽד
verses.translit: hysgrny b'ly q'ylh bydv hyrd sh'vl kh'shr shm' 'bdkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hgd n' l'bdkh vy'mr yhvh yrd
verses.translation: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד הֲ/יַסְגִּ֜רוּ בַּעֲלֵ֧י קְעִילָ֛ה אֹתִ֥/י וְ/אֶת אֲנָשַׁ֖/י בְּ/יַד שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה יַסְגִּֽירוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd hysgrv b'ly q'ylh 'ty v't 'nshy byd sh'vl vy'mr yhvh ysgyrv
verses.translation: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the LORD said, They will deliver thee up.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקָם֩ דָּוִ֨ד וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֜י/ו כְּ/שֵׁשׁ מֵא֣וֹת אִ֗ישׁ וַ/יֵּצְאוּ֙ מִ/קְּעִלָ֔ה וַ/יִּֽתְהַלְּכ֖וּ בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ וּ/לְ/שָׁא֣וּל הֻגַּ֗ד כִּֽי נִמְלַ֤ט דָּוִד֙ מִ/קְּעִילָ֔ה וַ/יֶּחְדַּ֖ל לָ/צֵֽאת
verses.translit: vyqm dvd v'nshyv khshsh m'vt 'ysh vyts'v mq'lh vythlkhv b'shr ythlkhv vlsh'vl hgd khy nmlt dvd mq'ylh vychdl lts't
verses.translation: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב דָּוִ֤ד בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֙ בַּ/מְּצָד֔וֹת וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב בָּ/הָ֖ר בְּ/מִדְבַּר זִ֑יף וַ/יְבַקְשֵׁ֤/הוּ שָׁאוּל֙ כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֔ים וְ/לֹֽא נְתָנ֥/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshb dvd bmdbr bmtsdvt vyshb bhr bmdbr zyf vybqshhv sh'vl khl hymym vl' ntnv 'lhym bydv
verses.translation: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא דָוִ֔ד כִּֽי יָצָ֥א שָׁא֖וּל לְ/בַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ וְ/דָוִ֥ד בְּ/מִדְבַּר זִ֖יף בַּ/חֹֽרְשָׁה
verses.translit: vyr' dvd khy yts' sh'vl lbqsh 't npshv vdvd bmdbr zyf bchrshh
verses.translation: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בֶּן שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ אֶל דָּוִ֖ד חֹ֑רְשָׁה וַ/יְחַזֵּ֥ק אֶת יָד֖/וֹ בֵּ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyqm yhvntn bn sh'vl vylkh 'l dvd chrshh vychzq 't ydv b'lhym
verses.translation: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו אַל תִּירָ֗א כִּ֠י לֹ֤א תִֽמְצָאֲ/ךָ֙ יַ֚ד שָׁא֣וּל אָבִ֔/י וְ/אַתָּה֙ תִּמְלֹ֣ךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶה לְּ/ךָ֣ לְ/מִשְׁנֶ֑ה וְ/גַם שָׁא֥וּל אָבִ֖/י יֹדֵ֥עַ כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'l tyr' khy l' tmts'kh yd sh'vl 'by v'th tmlkh 'l yshr'l v'nkhy 'hyh lkh lmshnh vgm sh'vl 'by yd' khn
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרְת֧וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֛ם בְּרִ֖ית לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב דָּוִד֙ בַּ/חֹ֔רְשָׁה וִ/יהוֹנָתָ֖ן הָלַ֥ךְ לְ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vykhrtv shnyhm bryt lpny yhvh vyshb dvd bchrshh vyhvntn hlkh lbytv
verses.translation: And they two made a covenant before the LORD : and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֤וּ זִפִים֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל הַ/גִּבְעָ֖תָ/ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הֲ/ל֣וֹא דָ֠וִד מִסְתַּתֵּ֨ר עִמָּ֤/נוּ בַ/מְּצָדוֹת֙ בַּ/חֹ֔רְשָׁה בְּ/גִבְעַת֙ הַֽ/חֲכִילָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִ/ימִ֥ין הַ/יְשִׁימֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'lv zpym 'l sh'vl hgb'th l'mr hlv' dvd msttr 'mnv bmtsdvt bchrshh bgb't hchkhylh 'shr mymyn hyshymvn
verses.translation: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?

verses.original: וְ֠/עַתָּה לְ/כָל אַוַּ֨ת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֥ הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ לָ/רֶ֖דֶת רֵ֑ד וְ/לָ֥/נוּ הַסְגִּיר֖/וֹ בְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: v'th lkhl 'vt npshkh hmlkh lrdt rd vlnv hsgyrv byd hmlkh
verses.translation: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king’s hand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל בְּרוּכִ֥ים אַתֶּ֖ם לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י חֲמַלְתֶּ֖ם עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl brvkhym 'tm lyhvh khy chmltm 'ly
verses.translation: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the LORD ; for ye have compassion on me.

verses.original: לְכוּ נָ֞א הָכִ֣ינוּ ע֗וֹד וּ/דְע֤וּ וּ/רְאוּ֙ אֶת מְקוֹמ/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה רַגְל֔/וֹ מִ֥י רָאָ֖/הוּ שָׁ֑ם כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔/י עָר֥וֹם יַעְרִ֖ם הֽוּא
verses.translit: lkhv n' hkhynv 'vd vd'v vr'v 't mqvmv 'shr thyh rglv my r'hv shm khy 'mr 'ly 'rvm y'rm hv'
verses.translation: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.

verses.original: וּ/רְא֣וּ וּ/דְע֗וּ מִ/כֹּ֤ל הַ/מַּֽחֲבֹאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְחַבֵּ֣א שָׁ֔ם וְ/שַׁבְתֶּ֤ם אֵלַ/י֙ אֶל נָכ֔וֹן וְ/הָלַכְתִּ֖י אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָיָה֙ אִם יֶשְׁנ֣/וֹ בָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/חִפַּשְׂתִּ֣י אֹת֔/וֹ בְּ/כֹ֖ל אַלְפֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vr'v vd'v mkhl hmchb'ym 'shr ytchb' shm vshbtm 'ly 'l nkhvn vhlkhty 'tkhm vhyh 'm yshnv b'rts vchpshty 'tv bkhl 'lpy yhvdh
verses.translation: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּק֛וּמוּ וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ זִ֖יפָ/ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וְ/דָוִ֨ד וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֜י/ו בְּ/מִדְבַּ֤ר מָעוֹן֙ בָּ/עֲרָבָ֔ה אֶ֖ל יְמִ֥ין הַ/יְשִׁימֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyqvmv vylkhv zyph lpny sh'vl vdvd v'nshyv bmdbr m'vn b'rbh 'l ymyn hyshymvn
verses.translation: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ שָׁא֣וּל וַ/אֲנָשָׁי/ו֮ לְ/בַקֵּשׁ֒ וַ/יַּגִּ֣דוּ לְ/דָוִ֔ד וַ/יֵּ֣רֶד הַ/סֶּ֔לַע וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּ/מִדְבַּ֣ר מָע֑וֹן וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֥ף אַחֲרֵֽי דָוִ֖ד מִדְבַּ֥ר מָעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vylkh sh'vl v'nshyv lbqsh vygdv ldvd vyrd hsl' vyshb bmdbr m'vn vyshm' sh'vl vyrdf 'chry dvd mdbr m'vn
verses.translation: Saul also and his men went to seek him . And they told David: wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ שָׁא֜וּל מִ/צַּ֤ד הָ/הָר֙ מִ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/דָוִ֧ד וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֛י/ו מִ/צַּ֥ד הָ/הָ֖ר מִ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֨י דָוִ֜ד נֶחְפָּ֤ז לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל וְ/שָׁא֣וּל וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֗י/ו עֹֽטְרִ֛ים אֶל דָּוִ֥ד וְ/אֶל אֲנָשָׁ֖י/ו לְ/תָפְשָֽׂ/ם
verses.translit: vylkh sh'vl mtsd hhr mzh vdvd v'nshyv mtsd hhr mzh vyhy dvd nchpz llkht mpny sh'vl vsh'vl v'nshyv 'trym 'l dvd v'l 'nshyv ltpshm
verses.translation: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְאָ֣ךְ בָּ֔א אֶל שָׁא֖וּל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מַהֲרָ֣/ה וְ/לֵ֔כָ/ה כִּֽי פָשְׁט֥וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vml'kh b' 'l sh'vl l'mr mhrh vlkhh khy pshtv plshtym 'l h'rts
verses.translation: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב שָׁא֗וּל מִ/רְדֹף֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ לִ/קְרַ֣את פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים עַל כֵּ֗ן קָֽרְאוּ֙ לַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא סֶ֖לַע הַֽמַּחְלְקֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyshb sh'vl mrdf 'chry dvd vylkh lqr't plshtym 'l khn qr'v lmqvm hhv' sl' hmchlqvt
verses.translation: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.
And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at En-gedi.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַל דָּוִ֖ד מִ/שָּׁ֑ם וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בִּ/מְצָד֥וֹת עֵֽין גֶּֽדִי
verses.translit: vy'l dvd mshm vyshb bmtsdvt 'yn gdy
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁ֣ב שָׁא֔וּל מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֖י פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יַּגִּ֤דוּ ל/וֹ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד בְּ/מִדְבַּ֖ר עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr shb sh'vl m'chry plshtym vygdv lv l'mr hnh dvd bmdbr 'yn gdy
verses.translation: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח שָׁא֗וּל שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ בָּח֖וּר מִ/כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ לְ/בַקֵּ֤שׁ אֶת דָּוִד֙ וַֽ/אֲנָשָׁ֔י/ו עַל פְּנֵ֖י צוּרֵ֥י הַ/יְּעֵלִֽים
verses.translit: vyqch sh'vl shlsht 'lpym 'ysh bchvr mkhl yshr'l vylkh lbqsh 't dvd v'nshyv 'l pny tsvry hy'lym
verses.translation: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּבֹא אֶל גִּדְר֨וֹת הַ/צֹּ֤אן עַל הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ וְ/שָׁ֣ם מְעָרָ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֥א שָׁא֖וּל לְ/הָסֵ֣ךְ אֶת רַגְלָ֑י/ו וְ/דָוִד֙ וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֔י/ו בְּ/יַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַ/מְּעָרָ֖ה יֹשְׁבִֽים
verses.translit: vyb' 'l gdrvt hts'n 'l hdrkh vshm m'rh vyb' sh'vl lhskh 't rglyv vdvd v'nshyv byrkhty hm'rh yshbym
verses.translation: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י דָוִ֜ד אֵלָ֗י/ו הִנֵּ֨ה הַ/יּ֜וֹם אֲֽשֶׁר אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י נֹתֵ֤ן אֶת איבי/ך אֹֽיִבְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/יָדֶ֔/ךָ וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִטַ֣ב בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֗ד וַ/יִּכְרֹ֛ת אֶת כְּנַֽף הַ/מְּעִ֥יל אֲשֶׁר לְ/שָׁא֖וּל בַּ/לָּֽט
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'nshy dvd 'lyv hnh hyvm 'shr 'mr yhvh 'lykh hnh 'nkhy ntn 't 'ybykh 'ybkh bydkh v'shyt lv kh'shr ytb b'ynykh vyqm dvd vykhrt 't khnf hm'yl 'shr lsh'vl blt
verses.translation: And it came to pass afterward, that David’s heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יַּ֥ךְ לֵב דָּוִ֖ד אֹת֑/וֹ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֔ת אֶת כָּנָ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vykh lb dvd 'tv 'l 'shr khrt 't khnf 'shr lsh'vl
verses.translation: And he said unto his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD’s anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לַ/אֲנָשָׁ֜י/ו חָלִ֧ילָ/ה לִּ֣/י מֵֽ/יהוָ֗ה אִם אֶעֱשֶׂה֩ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֨ר הַ/זֶּ֤ה לַֽ/אדֹנִ/י֙ לִ/מְשִׁ֣יחַ יְהוָ֔ה לִ/שְׁלֹ֥חַ יָדִ֖/י בּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mr l'nshyv chlylh ly myhvh 'm ''shh 't hdbr hzh l'dny lmshych yhvh lshlch ydy bv khy mshych yhvh hv'
verses.translation: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁסַּ֨ע דָּוִ֤ד אֶת אֲנָשָׁי/ו֙ בַּ/דְּבָרִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א נְתָנָ֖/ם לָ/ק֣וּם אֶל שָׁא֑וּל וְ/שָׁא֛וּל קָ֥ם מֵ/הַ/מְּעָרָ֖ה וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ בַּ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vyshs' dvd 't 'nshyv bdbrym vl' ntnm lqvm 'l sh'vl vsh'vl qm mhm'rh vylkh bdrkh
verses.translation: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֜ד אַחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ מן ה/מערה מֵֽ/הַ/מְּעָרָ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֧א אַֽחֲרֵי שָׁא֛וּל לֵ/אמֹ֖ר אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יַּבֵּ֤ט שָׁאוּל֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקֹּ֨ד דָּוִ֥ד אַפַּ֛יִם אַ֖רְצָ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: vyqm dvd 'chry khn vyts' mn hm'rh mhm'rh vyqr' 'chry sh'vl l'mr 'dny hmlkh vybt sh'vl 'chryv vyqd dvd 'pym 'rtsh vyshtchv
verses.translation: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men’s words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ לְ/שָׁא֔וּל לָ֧/מָּה תִשְׁמַ֛ע אֶת דִּבְרֵ֥י אָדָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd lsh'vl lmh tshm' 't dbry 'dm l'mr hnh dvd mbqsh r'tkh
verses.translation: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the LORD had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the LORD’s anointed.

verses.original: הִנֵּה֩ הַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/זֶּ֜ה רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר נְתָנְ/ךָ֩ יְהוָ֨ה הַ/יּ֤וֹם בְּ/יָדִ/י֙ בַּ/מְּעָרָ֔ה וְ/אָמַ֥ר לַ/הֲרָגֲ/ךָ֖ וַ/תָּ֣חָס עָלֶ֑י/ךָ וָ/אֹמַ֗ר לֹא אֶשְׁלַ֤ח יָדִ/י֙ בַּֽ/אדֹנִ֔/י כִּי מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: hnh hyvm hzh r'v 'ynykh 't 'shr ntnkh yhvh hyvm bydy bm'rh v'mr lhrgkh vtchs 'lykh v'mr l' 'shlch ydy b'dny khy mshych yhvh hv'
verses.translation: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.

verses.original: וְ/אָבִ֣/י רְאֵ֔ה גַּ֗ם רְאֵ֛ה אֶת כְּנַ֥ף מְעִילְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/יָדִ֑/י כִּ֡י בְּ/כָרְתִ/י֩ אֶת כְּנַ֨ף מְעִֽילְ/ךָ֜ וְ/לֹ֣א הֲרַגְתִּ֗י/ךָ דַּ֤ע וּ/רְאֵה֙ כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין בְּ/יָדִ֜/י רָעָ֤ה וָ/פֶ֨שַׁע֙ וְ/לֹא חָטָ֣אתִי לָ֔/ךְ וְ/אַתָּ֛ה צֹדֶ֥ה אֶת נַפְשִׁ֖/י לְ/קַחְתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'by r'h gm r'h 't khnf m'ylkh bydy khy bkhrty 't khnf m'ylkh vl' hrgtykh d' vr'h khy 'yn bydy r'h vpsh' vl' cht'ty lkh v'th tsdh 't npshy lqchth
verses.translation: The LORD judge between me and thee, and the LORD avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

verses.original: יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט יְהוָה֙ בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵינֶ֔/ךָ וּ/נְקָמַ֥/נִי יְהוָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑/ךָּ וְ/יָדִ֖/י לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶה בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: yshpt yhvh byny vbynkh vnqmny yhvh mmkh vydy l' thyh bkh
verses.translation: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאמַ֗ר מְשַׁל֙ הַ/קַּדְמֹנִ֔י מֵ/רְשָׁעִ֖ים יֵ֣צֵא רֶ֑שַׁע וְ/יָדִ֖/י לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶה בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: kh'shr y'mr mshl hqdmny mrsh'ym yts' rsh' vydy l' thyh bkh
verses.translation: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֨י מִ֤י יָצָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַחֲרֵ֥י מִ֖י אַתָּ֣ה רֹדֵ֑ף אַֽחֲרֵי֙ כֶּ֣לֶב מֵ֔ת אַחֲרֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֥שׁ אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: 'chry my yts' mlkh yshr'l 'chry my 'th rdf 'chry khlb mt 'chry pr'sh 'chd
verses.translation: The LORD therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְ/דַיָּ֔ן וְ/שָׁפַ֖ט בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵינֶ֑/ךָ וְ/יֵ֨רֶא֙ וְ/יָרֵ֣ב אֶת רִיבִ֔/י וְ/יִשְׁפְּטֵ֖/נִי מִ/יָּדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyh yhvh ldyn vshpt byny vbynkh vyr' vyrb 't ryby vyshptny mydkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְּ/כַלּ֣וֹת דָּוִ֗ד לְ/דַבֵּ֞ר אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל הֲ/קֹלְ/ךָ֥ זֶ֖ה בְּנִ֣/י דָוִ֑ד וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א שָׁא֛וּל קֹל֖/וֹ וַ/יֵּֽבְךְּ
verses.translit: vyhy khkhlvt dvd ldbr 't hdbrym h'lh 'l sh'vl vy'mr sh'vl hqlkh zh bny dvd vysh' sh'vl qlv vybkh
verses.translation: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד צַדִּ֥יק אַתָּ֖ה מִמֶּ֑/נִּי כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ גְּמַלְתַּ֣/נִי הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה וַ/אֲנִ֖י גְּמַלְתִּ֥י/ךָ הָ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l dvd tsdyq 'th mmny khy 'th gmltny htvbh v'ny gmltykh hr'h
verses.translation: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the LORD had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.

verses.original: ו/את וְ/אַתָּה֙ הִגַּ֣דְתָּ הַ/יּ֔וֹם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֥יתָה אִתִּ֖/י טוֹבָ֑ה אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר סִגְּרַ֧/נִי יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יָדְ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֥א הֲרַגְתָּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v't v'th hgdt hyvm 't 'shr 'shyth 'ty tvbh 't 'shr sgrny yhvh bydkh vl' hrgtny
verses.translation: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the LORD reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִמְצָ֥א אִישׁ֙ אֶת אֹ֣יְב֔/וֹ וְ/שִׁלְּח֖/וֹ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבָ֑ה וַֽ/יהוָה֙ יְשַׁלֶּמְ/ךָ֣ טוֹבָ֔ה תַּ֚חַת הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתָה לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vkhy ymts' 'ysh 't 'ybv vshlchv bdrkh tvbh vyhvh yshlmkh tvbh tcht hyvm hzh 'shr 'shyth ly
verses.translation: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י מָלֹ֖ךְ תִּמְל֑וֹךְ וְ/קָ֨מָה֙ בְּ/יָ֣דְ/ךָ֔ מַמְלֶ֖כֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'th hnh yd'ty khy mlkh tmlvkh vqmh bydkh mmlkht yshr'l
verses.translation: Swear now therefore unto me by the LORD , that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father’s house.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הִשָּׁ֤בְעָ/ה לִּ/י֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה אִם תַּכְרִ֥ית אֶת זַרְעִ֖/י אַֽחֲרָ֑/י וְ/אִם תַּשְׁמִ֥יד אֶת שְׁמִ֖/י מִ/בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th hshb'h ly byhvh 'm tkhryt 't zr'y 'chry v'm tshmyd 't shmy mbyt 'by
verses.translation: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּקָּבְצ֤וּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יִּסְפְּדוּ ל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֥/הוּ בְּ/בֵית֖/וֹ בָּ/רָמָ֑ה וַ/יָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יֵּ֖רֶד אֶל מִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן
verses.translit: vymt shmv'l vyqbtsv khl yshr'l vyspdv lv vyqbrhv bbytv brmh vyqm dvd vyrd 'l mdbr p'rn
verses.translation: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ישׁ בְּ/מָע֜וֹן וּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣/הוּ בַ/כַּרְמֶ֗ל וְ/הָ/אִישׁ֙ גָּד֣וֹל מְאֹ֔ד וְ/ל֛/וֹ צֹ֥אן שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/אֶ֣לֶף עִזִּ֑ים וַ/יְהִ֛י בִּ/גְזֹ֥ז אֶת צֹאנ֖/וֹ בַּ/כַּרְמֶֽל
verses.translit: v'ysh bm'vn vm'shhv bkhrml vh'ysh gdvl m'd vlv ts'n shlsht 'lpym v'lf 'zym vyhy bgzz 't ts'nv bkhrml
verses.translation: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֤ם הָ/אִישׁ֙ נָבָ֔ל וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ אֲבִגָ֑יִל וְ/הָ/אִשָּׁ֤ה טֽוֹבַת שֶׂ֨כֶל֙ וִ֣/יפַת תֹּ֔אַר וְ/הָ/אִ֥ישׁ קָשֶׁ֛ה וְ/רַ֥ע מַעֲלָלִ֖ים וְ/ה֥וּא כ/לב/ו כָלִבִּֽי
verses.translit: vshm h'ysh nbl vshm 'shtv 'bgyl vh'shh tvbt shkhl vypt t'r vh'ysh qshh vr' m'llym vhv' khlbv khlby
verses.translation: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע דָּוִ֖ד בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּֽי גֹזֵ֥ז נָבָ֖ל אֶת צֹאנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshm' dvd bmdbr khy gzz nbl 't ts'nv
verses.translation: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֖ד עֲשָׂרָ֣ה נְעָרִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד לַ/נְּעָרִ֗ים עֲל֤וּ כַרְמֶ֨לָ/ה֙ וּ/בָאתֶ֣ם אֶל נָבָ֔ל וּ/שְׁאֶלְתֶּם ל֥/וֹ בִ/שְׁמִ֖/י לְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd 'shrh n'rym vy'mr dvd ln'rym 'lv khrmlh vb'tm 'l nbl vsh'ltm lv bshmy lshlvm
verses.translation: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֥ם כֹּ֖ה לֶ/חָ֑י וְ/אַתָּ֤ה שָׁלוֹם֙ וּ/בֵיתְ/ךָ֣ שָׁל֔וֹם וְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר לְ/ךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'mrtm khh lchy v'th shlvm vbytkh shlvm vkhl 'shr lkh shlvm
verses.translation: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity , Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י גֹזְזִ֖ים לָ֑/ךְ עַתָּ֗ה הָ/רֹעִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר לְ/ךָ֙ הָי֣וּ עִמָּ֔/נוּ לֹ֣א הֶכְלַמְנ֗וּ/ם וְ/לֹֽא נִפְקַ֤ד לָ/הֶם֙ מְא֔וּמָה כָּל יְמֵ֖י הֱיוֹתָ֥/ם בַּ/כַּרְמֶֽל
verses.translit: v'th shm'ty khy gzzym lkh 'th hr'ym 'shr lkh hyv 'mnv l' hkhlmnvm vl' npqd lhm m'vmh khl ymy hyvtm bkhrml
verses.translation: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

verses.original: שְׁאַ֨ל אֶת נְעָרֶ֜י/ךָ וְ/יַגִּ֣ידוּ לָ֗/ךְ וְ/יִמְצְא֨וּ הַ/נְּעָרִ֥ים חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ כִּֽי עַל י֥וֹם ט֖וֹב בָּ֑נוּ תְּנָ/ה נָּ֗א אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּמְצָ֤א יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ לַ/עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/לְ/בִנְ/ךָ֖ לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: sh'l 't n'rykh vygydv lkh vymts'v hn'rym chn b'ynykh khy 'l yvm tvb bnv tnh n' 't 'shr tmts' ydkh l'bdykh vlbnkh ldvd
verses.translation: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ נַעֲרֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד וַ/יְדַבְּר֧וּ אֶל נָבָ֛ל כְּ/כָל הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יָּנֽוּחוּ
verses.translit: vyb'v n'ry dvd vydbrv 'l nbl khkhl hdbrym h'lh bshm dvd vynvchv
verses.translation: And when David’s young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן נָבָ֜ל אֶת עַבְדֵ֤י דָוִד֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר מִ֥י דָוִ֖ד וּ/מִ֣י בֶן יִשָׁ֑י הַ/יּוֹם֙ רַבּ֣וּ עֲבָדִ֔ים הַ/מִּתְפָּ֣רְצִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ מִ/פְּנֵ֥י אֲדֹנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'n nbl 't 'bdy dvd vy'mr my dvd vmy bn yshy hyvm rbv 'bdym hmtprtsym 'ysh mpny 'dnyv
verses.translation: And Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֤י אֶת לַחְמִ/י֙ וְ/אֶת מֵימַ֔/י וְ/אֵת֙ טִבְחָתִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר טָבַ֖חְתִּי לְ/גֹֽזְזָ֑/י וְ/נָֽתַתִּי֙ לַֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי אֵ֥י מִ/זֶּ֖ה הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vlqchty 't lchmy v't mymy v't tbchty 'shr tbchty lgzzy vntty l'nshym 'shr l' yd'ty 'y mzh hmh
verses.translation: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be ?

verses.original: וַ/יַּהַפְכ֥וּ נַעֲרֵֽי דָוִ֖ד לְ/דַרְכָּ֑/ם וַ/יָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ וַ/יָּבֹ֔אוּ וַ/יַּגִּ֣דוּ ל֔/וֹ כְּ/כֹ֖ל הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyhpkhv n'ry dvd ldrkhm vyshbv vyb'v vygdv lv khkhl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: So David’s young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ דָּוִ֨ד לַ/אֲנָשָׁ֜י/ו חִגְר֣וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת חַרְבּ֗/וֹ וַֽ/יַּחְגְּרוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת חַרְבּ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּחְגֹּ֥ר גַּם דָּוִ֖ד אֶת חַרְבּ֑/וֹ וַֽ/יַּעֲל֣וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י דָוִ֗ד כְּ/אַרְבַּ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ אִ֔ישׁ וּ/מָאתַ֖יִם יָשְׁב֥וּ עַל הַ/כֵּלִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd l'nshyv chgrv 'ysh 't chrbv vychgrv 'ysh 't chrbv vychgr gm dvd 't chrbv vy'lv 'chry dvd kh'rb' m'vt 'ysh vm'tym yshbv 'l hkhlym
verses.translation: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.

verses.original: וְ/לַ/אֲבִיגַ֨יִל֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת נָבָ֔ל הִגִּ֧יד נַֽעַר אֶחָ֛ד מֵ/הַ/נְּעָרִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה שָׁלַח֩ דָּוִ֨ד מַלְאָכִ֧ים מֵֽ/הַ/מִּדְבָּ֛ר לְ/בָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת אֲדֹנֵ֖י/נוּ וַ/יָּ֥עַט בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vl'bygyl 'sht nbl hgyd n'r 'chd mhn'rym l'mr hnh shlch dvd ml'khym mhmdbr lbrkh 't 'dnynv vy't bhm
verses.translation: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֣/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים טֹבִ֥ים לָ֖/נוּ מְאֹ֑ד וְ/לֹ֤א הָכְלַ֨מְנוּ֙ וְ/לֹֽא פָקַ֣דְנוּ מְא֔וּמָה כָּל יְמֵי֙ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְנוּ אִתָּ֔/ם בִּֽ/הְיוֹתֵ֖/נוּ בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vh'nshym tbym lnv m'd vl' hkhlmnv vl' pqdnv m'vmh khl ymy hthlkhnv 'tm bhyvtnv bshdh
verses.translation: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:

verses.original: חוֹמָה֙ הָי֣וּ עָלֵ֔י/נוּ גַּם לַ֖יְלָה גַּם יוֹמָ֑ם כָּל יְמֵ֛י הֱיוֹתֵ֥/נוּ עִמָּ֖/ם רֹעִ֥ים הַ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: chvmh hyv 'lynv gm lylh gm yvmm khl ymy hyvtnv 'mm r'ym hts'n
verses.translation: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה דְּעִ֤י וּ/רְאִי֙ מַֽה תַּעֲשִׂ֔י כִּֽי כָלְתָ֧ה הָ/רָעָ֛ה אֶל אֲדֹנֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/עַ֣ל כָּל בֵּית֑/וֹ וְ/הוּא֙ בֶּן בְּלִיַּ֔עַל מִ/דַּבֵּ֖ר אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'th d'y vr'y mh t'shy khy khlth hr'h 'l 'dnynv v'l khl bytv vhv' bn bly'l mdbr 'lyv
verses.translation: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.

verses.original: וַ/תְּמַהֵ֣ר אבוגיל אֲבִיגַ֡יִל וַ/תִּקַּח֩ מָאתַ֨יִם לֶ֜חֶם וּ/שְׁנַ֣יִם נִבְלֵי יַ֗יִן וְ/חָמֵ֨שׁ צֹ֤אן עשוות עֲשׂוּיֹת֙ וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ סְאִים֙ קָלִ֔י וּ/מֵאָ֥ה צִמֻּקִ֖ים וּ/מָאתַ֣יִם דְּבֵלִ֑ים וַ/תָּ֖שֶׂם עַל הַ/חֲמֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vtmhr 'bvgyl 'bygyl vtqch m'tym lchm vshnym nbly yyn vchmsh ts'n 'shvvt 'shvyt vchmsh s'ym qly vm'h tsmqym vm'tym dblym vtshm 'l hchmrym
verses.translation: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn , and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר לִ/נְעָרֶ֨י/הָ֙ עִבְר֣וּ לְ/פָנַ֔/י הִנְ/נִ֖י אַחֲרֵי/כֶ֣ם בָּאָ֑ה וּ/לְ/אִישָׁ֥/הּ נָבָ֖ל לֹ֥א הִגִּֽידָה
verses.translit: vt'mr ln'ryh 'brv lpny hnny 'chrykhm b'h vl'yshh nbl l' hgydh
verses.translation: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה הִ֣יא רֹכֶ֣בֶת עַֽל הַ/חֲמ֗וֹר וְ/יֹרֶ֨דֶת֙ בְּ/סֵ֣תֶר הָ/הָ֔ר וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה דָוִד֙ וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֔י/ו יֹרְדִ֖ים לִ/קְרָאתָ֑/הּ וַ/תִּפְגֹּ֖שׁ אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyh hy' rkhbt 'l hchmvr vyrdt bstr hhr vhnh dvd v'nshyv yrdym lqr'th vtpgsh 'tm
verses.translation: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֣ד אָמַ֗ר אַךְ֩ לַ/שֶּׁ֨קֶר שָׁמַ֜רְתִּי אֶֽת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לָ/זֶה֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר וְ/לֹא נִפְקַ֥ד מִ/כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֖/וֹ מְא֑וּמָה וַ/יָּֽשֶׁב לִ֥/י רָעָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: vdvd 'mr 'kh lshqr shmrty 't khl 'shr lzh bmdbr vl' npqd mkhl 'shr lv m'vmh vyshb ly r'h tcht tvbh
verses.translation: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.

verses.original: כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים לְ/אֹיְבֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד וְ/כֹ֣ה יֹסִ֑יף אִם אַשְׁאִ֧יר מִ/כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֛/וֹ עַד הַ/בֹּ֖קֶר מַשְׁתִּ֥ין בְּ/קִֽיר
verses.translit: khh y'shh 'lhym l'yby dvd vkhh ysyf 'm 'sh'yr mkhl 'shr lv 'd hbqr mshtyn bqyr
verses.translation: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤רֶא אֲבִיגַ֨יִל֙ אֶת דָּוִ֔ד וַ/תְּמַהֵ֕ר וַ/תֵּ֖רֶד מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/חֲמ֑וֹר וַ/תִּפֹּ֞ל לְ/אַפֵּ֤י דָוִד֙ עַל פָּנֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vtr' 'bygyl 't dvd vtmhr vtrd m'l hchmvr vtpl l'py dvd 'l pnyh vtshtchv 'rts
verses.translation: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,

verses.original: וַ/תִּפֹּל֙ עַל רַגְלָ֔י/ו וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר בִּ/י אֲנִ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖/י הֶֽ/עָוֺ֑ן וּֽ/תְדַבֶּר נָ֤א אֲמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/אָזְנֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/שְׁמַ֕ע אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י אֲמָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vtpl 'l rglyv vt'mr by 'ny 'dny h'vn vtdbr n' 'mtkh b'znykh vshm' 't dbry 'mtkh
verses.translation: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.

verses.original: אַל נָ֣א יָשִׂ֣ים אֲדֹנִ֣/י אֶת לִבּ֡/וֹ אֶל אִישׁ֩ הַ/בְּלִיַּ֨עַל הַ/זֶּ֜ה עַל נָבָ֗ל כִּ֤י כִ/שְׁמ/וֹ֙ כֶּן ה֔וּא נָבָ֣ל שְׁמ֔/וֹ וּ/נְבָלָ֖ה עִמּ֑/וֹ וַֽ/אֲנִי֙ אֲמָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ לֹ֥א רָאִ֛יתִי אֶת נַעֲרֵ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלָֽחְתָּ
verses.translit: 'l n' yshym 'dny 't lbv 'l 'ysh hbly'l hzh 'l nbl khy khshmv khn hv' nbl shmv vnblh 'mv v'ny 'mtkh l' r'yty 't n'ry 'dny 'shr shlcht
verses.translation: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is , so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה אֲדֹנִ֗/י חַי יְהוָ֤ה וְ/חֵֽי נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מְנָעֲ/ךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ מִ/בּ֣וֹא בְ/דָמִ֔ים וְ/הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ יָדְ/ךָ֖ לָ֑/ךְ וְ/עַתָּ֗ה יִֽהְי֤וּ כְ/נָבָל֙ אֹיְבֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הַֽ/מְבַקְשִׁ֥ים אֶל אֲדֹנִ֖/י רָעָֽה
verses.translit: v'th 'dny chy yhvh vchy npshkh 'shr mn'kh yhvh mbv' bdmym vhvsh' ydkh lkh v'th yhyv khnbl 'ybykh vhmbqshym 'l 'dny r'h
verses.translation: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הַ/בְּרָכָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֥יא שִׁפְחָתְ/ךָ֖ לַֽ/אדֹנִ֑/י וְ/נִתְּנָה֙ לַ/נְּעָרִ֔ים הַ/מִּֽתְהַלְּכִ֖ים בְּ/רַגְלֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th hbrkhh hz't 'shr hby' shpchtkh l'dny vntnh ln'rym hmthlkhym brgly 'dny
verses.translation: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.

verses.original: שָׂ֥א נָ֖א לְ/פֶ֣שַׁע אֲמָתֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֣י עָשֹֽׂה יַעֲשֶׂה֩ יְהוָ֨ה לַֽ/אדֹנִ֜/י בַּ֣יִת נֶאֱמָ֗ן כִּי מִלְחֲמ֤וֹת יְהוָה֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י נִלְחָ֔ם וְ/רָעָ֛ה לֹא תִמָּצֵ֥א בְ/ךָ֖ מִ/יָּמֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: sh' n' lpsh' 'mtkh khy 'shh y'shh yhvh l'dny byt n'mn khy mlchmvt yhvh 'dny nlchm vr'h l' tmts' bkh mymykh
verses.translation: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the LORD , and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤קָם אָדָם֙ לִ/רְדָפְ/ךָ֔ וּ/לְ/בַקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת נַפְשֶׁ֑/ךָ וְֽ/הָיְתָה֩ נֶ֨פֶשׁ אֲדֹנִ֜/י צְרוּרָ֣ה בִּ/צְר֣וֹר הַ/חַיִּ֗ים אֵ֚ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אֵ֨ת נֶ֤פֶשׁ אֹיְבֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יְקַלְּעֶ֔/נָּה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ כַּ֥ף הַ/קָּֽלַע
verses.translit: vyqm 'dm lrdpkh vlbqsh 't npshkh vhyth npsh 'dny tsrvrh btsrvr hchyym 't yhvh 'lhykh v't npsh 'ybykh yql'nh btvkh khf hql'
verses.translation: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּֽי יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לַֽ/אדֹנִ֔/י כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֶת הַ/טּוֹבָ֖ה עָלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/צִוְּ/ךָ֥ לְ/נָגִ֖יד עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhyh khy y'shh yhvh l'dny khkhl 'shr dbr 't htvbh 'lykh vtsvkh lngyd 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א תִהְיֶ֣ה זֹ֣את לְ/ךָ֡ לְ/פוּקָה֩ וּ/לְ/מִכְשׁ֨וֹל לֵ֜ב לַ/אדֹנִ֗/י וְ/לִ/שְׁפָּךְ דָּם֙ חִנָּ֔ם וּ/לְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֲדֹנִ֖/י ל֑/וֹ וְ/הֵיטִ֤ב יְהוָה֙ לַֽ/אדֹנִ֔/י וְ/זָכַרְתָּ֖ אֶת אֲמָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vl' thyh z't lkh lpvqh vlmkhshvl lb l'dny vlshpkh dm chnm vlhvshy' 'dny lv vhytb yhvh l'dny vzkhrt 't 'mtkh
verses.translation: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the LORD shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר דָּוִ֖ד לַ/אֲבִיגַ֑ל בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר שְׁלָחֵ֛/ךְ הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה לִ/קְרָאתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd l'bygl brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr shlchkh hyvm hzh lqr'ty
verses.translation: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:

verses.original: וּ/בָר֥וּךְ טַעְמֵ֖/ךְ וּ/בְרוּכָ֣ה אָ֑תְּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר כְּלִתִ֜/נִי הַ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ מִ/בּ֣וֹא בְ/דָמִ֔ים וְ/הֹשֵׁ֥עַ יָדִ֖/י לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vbrvkh t'mkh vbrvkhh 't 'shr khltny hyvm hzh mbv' bdmym vhsh' ydy ly
verses.translation: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

verses.original: וְ/אוּלָ֗ם חַי יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְנָעַ֔/נִי מֵ/הָרַ֖ע אֹתָ֑/ךְ כִּ֣י לוּלֵ֣י מִהַ֗רְתְּ ו/תבאתי וַ/תָּבֹאת֙ לִ/קְרָאתִ֔/י כִּ֣י אִם נוֹתַ֧ר לְ/נָבָ֛ל עַד א֥וֹר הַ/בֹּ֖קֶר מַשְׁתִּ֥ין בְּ/קִֽיר
verses.translit: v'vlm chy yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr mn'ny mhr' 'tkh khy lvly mhrt vtb'ty vtb't lqr'ty khy 'm nvtr lnbl 'd 'vr hbqr mshtyn bqyr
verses.translation: For in very deed, as the LORD God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח דָּוִד֙ מִ/יָּדָ֔/הּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֖יאָה ל֑/וֹ וְ/לָ֣/הּ אָמַ֗ר עֲלִ֤י לְ/שָׁלוֹם֙ לְ/בֵיתֵ֔/ךְ רְאִי֙ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי בְ/קוֹלֵ֔/ךְ וָ/אֶשָּׂ֖א פָּנָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyqch dvd mydh 't 'shr hby'h lv vlh 'mr 'ly lshlvm lbytkh r'y shm'ty bqvlkh v'sh' pnykh
verses.translation: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֣א אֲבִיגַ֣יִל אֶל נָבָ֡ל וְ/הִנֵּה ל/וֹ֩ מִשְׁתֶּ֨ה בְּ/בֵית֜/וֹ כְּ/מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וְ/לֵ֤ב נָבָל֙ ט֣וֹב עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/ה֥וּא שִׁכֹּ֖ר עַד מְאֹ֑ד וְ/לֹֽא הִגִּ֣ידָה לּ֗/וֹ דָּבָ֥ר קָטֹ֛ן וְ/גָד֖וֹל עַד א֥וֹר הַ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vtb' 'bygyl 'l nbl vhnh lv mshth bbytv khmshth hmlkh vlb nbl tvb 'lyv vhv' shkhr 'd m'd vl' hgydh lv dbr qtn vgdvl 'd 'vr hbqr
verses.translation: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַ/בֹּ֗קֶר בְּ/צֵ֤את הַ/יַּ֨יִן֙ מִ/נָּבָ֔ל וַ/תַּגֶּד ל֣/וֹ אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יָּ֤מָת לִבּ/וֹ֙ בְּ/קִרְבּ֔/וֹ וְ/ה֖וּא הָיָ֥ה לְ/אָֽבֶן
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr bts't hyyn mnbl vtgd lv 'shtv 't hdbrym h'lh vymt lbv bqrbv vhv' hyh l'bn
verses.translation: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י כַּ/עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַ/יָּמִ֑ים וַ/יִּגֹּ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת נָבָ֖ל וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrt hymym vygf yhvh 't nbl vymt
verses.translation: And it came to pass about ten days after , that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע דָּוִד֮ כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת נָבָל֒ וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָב֩ אֶת רִ֨יב חֶרְפָּתִ֜/י מִ/יַּ֣ד נָבָ֗ל וְ/אֶת עַבְדּ/וֹ֙ חָשַׂ֣ךְ מֵֽ/רָעָ֔ה וְ/אֵת֙ רָעַ֣ת נָבָ֔ל הֵשִׁ֥יב יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח דָּוִד֙ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר בַּ/אֲבִיגַ֔יִל לְ/קַחְתָּ֥/הּ ל֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vyshm' dvd khy mt nbl vy'mr brvkh yhvh 'shr rb 't ryb chrpty myd nbl v't 'bdv chshkh mr'h v't r't nbl hshyb yhvh br'shv vyshlch dvd vydbr b'bygyl lqchth lv l'shh
verses.translation: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the LORD , that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ עַבְדֵ֥י דָוִ֛ד אֶל אֲבִיגַ֖יִל הַ/כַּרְמֶ֑לָ/ה וַ/יְדַבְּר֤וּ אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר דָּוִד֙ שְׁלָחָ֣/נוּ אֵלַ֔יִ/ךְ לְ/קַחְתֵּ֥/ךְ ל֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vyb'v 'bdy dvd 'l 'bygyl hkhrmlh vydbrv 'lyh l'mr dvd shlchnv 'lykh lqchtkh lv l'shh
verses.translation: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֕קָם וַ/תִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַפַּ֖יִם אָ֑רְצָ/ה וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה אֲמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ לְ/שִׁפְחָ֔ה לִ/רְחֹ֕ץ רַגְלֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vtqm vtshtchv 'pym 'rtsh vt'mr hnh 'mtkh lshpchh lrchts rgly 'bdy 'dny
verses.translation: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

verses.original: וַ/תְּמַהֵ֞ר וַ/תָּ֣קָם אֲבִיגַ֗יִל וַ/תִּרְכַּב֙ עַֽל הַ/חֲמ֔וֹר וְ/חָמֵשׁ֙ נַעֲרֹתֶ֔י/הָ הַ/הֹלְכ֖וֹת לְ/רַגְלָ֑/הּ וַ/תֵּ֗לֶךְ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ מַלְאֲכֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד וַ/תְּהִי ל֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vtmhr vtqm 'bygyl vtrkhb 'l hchmvr vchmsh n'rtyh hhlkhvt lrglh vtlkh 'chry ml'khy dvd vthy lv l'shh
verses.translation: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אֲחִינֹ֛עַם לָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֖ד מִֽ/יִּזְרְעֶ֑אל וַ/תִּהְיֶ֛יןָ גַּֽם שְׁתֵּי/הֶ֥ן ל֖/וֹ לְ/נָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: v't 'chyn'm lqch dvd myzr''l vthyyn gm shtyhn lv lnshym
verses.translation: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁא֗וּל נָתַ֛ן אֶת מִיכַ֥ל בִּתּ֖/וֹ אֵ֣שֶׁת דָּוִ֑ד לְ/פַלְטִ֥י בֶן לַ֖יִשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִ/גַּלִּֽים
verses.translit: vsh'vl ntn 't mykhl btv 'sht dvd lplty bn lysh 'shr mglym
verses.translation: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ הַ/זִּפִים֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל הַ/גִּבְעָ֖תָ/ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הֲ/ל֨וֹא דָוִ֤ד מִסְתַּתֵּר֙ בְּ/גִבְעַ֣ת הַ/חֲכִילָ֔ה עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/יְשִׁימֹֽן
verses.translit: vyb'v hzpym 'l sh'vl hgb'th l'mr hlv' dvd msttr bgb't hchkhylh 'l pny hyshymn
verses.translation: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם שָׁא֗וּל וַ/יֵּ֨רֶד֙ אֶל מִדְבַּר זִ֔יף וְ/אִתּ֛/וֹ שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת אֲלָפִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ בְּחוּרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ/בַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת דָּוִ֖ד בְּ/מִדְבַּר זִֽיף
verses.translit: vyqm sh'vl vyrd 'l mdbr zyf v'tv shlsht 'lpym 'ysh bchvry yshr'l lbqsh 't dvd bmdbr zyf
verses.translation: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨חַן שָׁא֜וּל בְּ/גִבְעַ֣ת הַ/חֲכִילָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/יְשִׁימֹ֖ן עַל הַ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ/דָוִד֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר וַ/יַּ֕רְא כִּ֣י בָ֥א שָׁא֛וּל אַחֲרָ֖י/ו הַ/מִּדְבָּֽרָ/ה
verses.translit: vychn sh'vl bgb't hchkhylh 'shr 'l pny hyshymn 'l hdrkh vdvd yshb bmdbr vyr' khy b' sh'vl 'chryv hmdbrh
verses.translation: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֖ד מְרַגְּלִ֑ים וַ/יֵּ֕דַע כִּֽי בָ֥א שָׁא֖וּל אֶל נָכֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd mrglym vyd' khy b' sh'vl 'l nkhvn
verses.translation: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֗ד וַ/יָּבֹא֮ אֶֽל הַ/מָּקוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָנָה שָׁ֣ם שָׁאוּל֒ וַ/יַּ֣רְא דָּוִ֗ד אֶת הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָֽׁכַב שָׁ֣ם שָׁא֔וּל וְ/אַבְנֵ֥ר בֶּן נֵ֖ר שַׂר צְבָא֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁאוּל֙ שֹׁכֵ֣ב בַּ/מַּעְגָּ֔ל וְ/הָ/עָ֖ם חֹנִ֥ים סביבת/ו סְבִיבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqm dvd vyb' 'l hmqvm 'shr chnh shm sh'vl vyr' dvd 't hmqvm 'shr shkhb shm sh'vl v'bnr bn nr shr tsb'v vsh'vl shkhb bm'gl vh'm chnym sbybtv sbybtyv
verses.translation: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן דָּוִ֜ד וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל אֲחִימֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/חִתִּ֗י וְ/אֶל אֲבִישַׁ֨י בֶּן צְרוּיָ֜ה אֲחִ֤י יוֹאָב֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מִֽי יֵרֵ֥ד אִתִּ֛/י אֶל שָׁא֖וּל אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִישַׁ֔י אֲנִ֖י אֵרֵ֥ד עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'n dvd vy'mr 'l 'chymlkh hchty v'l 'byshy bn tsrvyh 'chy yv'b l'mr my yrd 'ty 'l sh'vl 'l hmchnh vy'mr 'byshy 'ny 'rd 'mkh
