verses.translation: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֩ דָוִ֨ד וַ/אֲבִישַׁ֥י אֶל הָ/עָם֮ לַיְלָה֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה שָׁא֗וּל שֹׁכֵ֤ב יָשֵׁן֙ בַּ/מַּעְגָּ֔ל וַ/חֲנִית֥/וֹ מְעוּכָֽה בָ/אָ֖רֶץ מראשת/ו מְרַאֲשֹׁתָ֑י/ו וְ/אַבְנֵ֣ר וְ/הָ/עָ֔ם שֹׁכְבִ֖ים סביבת/ו סְבִיבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyb' dvd v'byshy 'l h'm lylh vhnh sh'vl shkhb yshn bm'gl vchnytv m'vkhh b'rts mr'shtv mr'shtyv v'bnr vh'm shkhbym sbybtv sbybtyv
verses.translation: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲבִישַׁי֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד סִגַּ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֥ים הַ/יּ֛וֹם אֶת אוֹיִבְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/עַתָּה֩ אַכֶּ֨/נּוּ נָ֜א בַּ/חֲנִ֤ית וּ/בָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ פַּ֣עַם אַחַ֔ת וְ/לֹ֥א אֶשְׁנֶ֖ה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'byshy 'l dvd sgr 'lhym hyvm 't 'vybkh bydkh v'th 'khnv n' bchnyt vb'rts p'm 'cht vl' 'shnh lv
verses.translation: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֶל אֲבִישַׁ֖י אַל תַּשְׁחִיתֵ֑/הוּ כִּ֠י מִ֣י שָׁלַ֥ח יָד֛/וֹ בִּ/מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה וְ/נִקָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'byshy 'l tshchythv khy my shlch ydv bmshych yhvh vnqh
verses.translation: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD’s anointed, and be guiltless?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ חַי יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אִם יְהוָ֖ה יִגָּפֶ֑/נּוּ אֽוֹ יוֹמ֤/וֹ יָבוֹא֙ וָ/מֵ֔ת א֧וֹ בַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה יֵרֵ֖ד וְ/נִסְפָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd chy yhvh khy 'm yhvh ygpnv 'v yvmv ybv' vmt 'v bmlchmh yrd vnsph
verses.translation: David said furthermore, As the LORD liveth, the LORD shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.

verses.original: חָלִ֤ילָ/ה לִּ/י֙ מֵֽ/יהוָ֔ה מִ/שְּׁלֹ֥חַ יָדִ֖/י בִּ/מְשִׁ֣יחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְ֠/עַתָּה קַח נָ֨א אֶֽת הַ/חֲנִ֜ית אֲשֶׁ֧ר מראשת/ו מְרַאֲשֹׁתָ֛י/ו וְ/אֶת צַפַּ֥חַת הַ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/נֵ֥לֲכָה לָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: chlylh ly myhvh mshlch ydy bmshych yhvh v'th qch n' 't hchnyt 'shr mr'shtv mr'shtyv v't tspcht hmym vnlkhh lnv
verses.translation: The LORD forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the LORD’s anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶֽת הַ/חֲנִ֜ית וְ/אֶת צַפַּ֤חַת הַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ מֵרַאֲשֹׁתֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֵ֣ין רֹאֶה֩ וְ/אֵ֨ין יוֹדֵ֜עַ וְ/אֵ֣ין מֵקִ֗יץ כִּ֤י כֻלָּ/ם֙ יְשֵׁנִ֔ים כִּ֚י תַּרְדֵּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה נָפְלָ֖ה עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqch dvd 't hchnyt v't tspcht hmym mr'shty sh'vl vylkhv lhm v'yn r'h v'yn yvd' v'yn mqyts khy khlm yshnym khy trdmt yhvh nplh 'lyhm
verses.translation: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul’s bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it , nor knew it , neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ר דָּוִד֙ הָ/עֵ֔בֶר וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֥ד עַל רֹאשׁ הָ/הָ֖ר מֵֽ/רָחֹ֑ק רַ֥ב הַ/מָּק֖וֹם בֵּינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'br dvd h'br vy'md 'l r'sh hhr mrchq rb hmqvm bynyhm
verses.translation: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א דָוִ֜ד אֶל הָ/עָ֗ם וְ/אֶל אַבְנֵ֤ר בֶּן נֵר֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הֲ/ל֥וֹא תַעֲנֶ֖ה אַבְנֵ֑ר וַ/יַּ֤עַן אַבְנֵר֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר מִ֥י אַתָּ֖ה קָרָ֥אתָ אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyqr' dvd 'l h'm v'l 'bnr bn nr l'mr hlv' t'nh 'bnr vy'n 'bnr vy'mr my 'th qr't 'l hmlkh
verses.translation: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶל אַבְנֵ֜ר הֲ/לוֹא אִ֣ישׁ אַתָּ֗ה וּ/מִ֤י כָמ֨וֹ/ךָ֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לָ֨/מָּה֙ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔רְתָּ אֶל אֲדֹנֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ כִּי בָא֙ אַחַ֣ד הָ/עָ֔ם לְ/הַשְׁחִ֖ית אֶת הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲדֹנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'bnr hlv' 'ysh 'th vmy khmvkh byshr'l vlmh l' shmrt 'l 'dnykh hmlkh khy b' 'chd h'm lhshchyt 't hmlkh 'dnykh
verses.translation: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.

verses.original: לֹא ט֞וֹב הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּה֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂיתָ֒ חַי יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י בְנֵי מָ֨וֶת֙ אַתֶּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא שְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם עַל אֲדֹנֵי/כֶ֖ם עַל מְשִׁ֣יחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְ/עַתָּ֣ה רְאֵ֗ה אֵֽי חֲנִ֥ית הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/אֶת צַפַּ֥חַת הַ/מַּ֖יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מראשת/ו מְרַאֲשֹׁתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: l' tvb hdbr hzh 'shr 'shyt chy yhvh khy bny mvt 'tm 'shr l' shmrtm 'l 'dnykhm 'l mshych yhvh v'th r'h 'y chnyt hmlkh v't tspcht hmym 'shr mr'shtv mr'shtyv
verses.translation: This thing is not good that thou hast done. As the LORD liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the LORD’s anointed. And now see where the king’s spear is , and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֵּ֤ר שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת ק֣וֹל דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הֲ/קוֹלְ/ךָ֥ זֶ֖ה בְּנִ֣/י דָוִ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד קוֹלִ֖/י אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vykhr sh'vl 't qvl dvd vy'mr hqvlkh zh bny dvd vy'mr dvd qvly 'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: And Saul knew David’s voice, and said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לָ֥/מָּה זֶּ֛ה אֲדֹנִ֥/י רֹדֵ֖ף אַחֲרֵ֣י עַבְדּ֑/וֹ כִּ֚י מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתִי וּ/מַה בְּ/יָדִ֖/י רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr lmh zh 'dny rdf 'chry 'bdv khy mh 'shyty vmh bydy r'h
verses.translation: And he said, Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה יִֽשְׁמַֽע נָא֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י עַבְדּ֑/וֹ אִם יְהוָ֞ה הֱסִֽיתְ/ךָ֥ בִ/י֙ יָרַ֣ח מִנְחָ֔ה וְ/אִ֣ם בְּנֵ֣י הָ/אָדָ֗ם אֲרוּרִ֥ים הֵם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי גֵרְשׁ֣וּ/נִי הַ/יּ֗וֹם מֵ/הִסְתַּפֵּ֜חַ בְּ/נַחֲלַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֵ֥ךְ עֲבֹ֖ד אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: v'th yshm' n' 'dny hmlkh 't dbry 'bdv 'm yhvh hsytkh by yrch mnchh v'm bny h'dm 'rvrym hm lpny yhvh khy grshvny hyvm mhstpch bnchlt yhvh l'mr lkh 'bd 'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray thee, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If the LORD have stirred thee up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before the LORD ; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the LORD , saying, Go, serve other gods.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אַל יִפֹּ֤ל דָּֽמִ/י֙ אַ֔רְצָ/ה מִ/נֶּ֖גֶד פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי יָצָ֞א מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְ/בַקֵּשׁ֙ אֶת פַּרְעֹ֣שׁ אֶחָ֔ד כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יִרְדֹּ֥ף הַ/קֹּרֵ֖א בֶּ/הָרִֽים
verses.translit: v'th 'l ypl dmy 'rtsh mngd pny yhvh khy yts' mlkh yshr'l lbqsh 't pr'sh 'chd kh'shr yrdf hqr' bhrym
verses.translation: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the LORD : for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ שָׁא֨וּל חָטָ֜אתִי שׁ֣וּב בְּנִֽ/י דָוִ֗ד כִּ֠י לֹֽא אָרַ֤ע לְ/ךָ֙ ע֔וֹד תַּ֠חַת אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָקְרָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֛/י בְּ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה הִנֵּ֥ה הִסְכַּ֛לְתִּי וָ/אֶשְׁגֶּ֖ה הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl cht'ty shvb bny dvd khy l' 'r' lkh 'vd tcht 'shr yqrh npshy b'ynykh hyvm hzh hnh hskhlty v'shgh hrbh m'd
verses.translation: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַן דָּוִד֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר הִנֵּ֖ה ה/חנית חֲנִ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/יַעֲבֹ֛ר אֶחָ֥ד מֵֽ/הַ/נְּעָרִ֖ים וְ/יִקָּחֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: vy'n dvd vy'mr hnh hchnyt chnyt hmlkh vy'br 'chd mhn'rym vyqchh
verses.translation: And David answered and said, Behold the king’s spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָה֙ יָשִׁ֣יב לָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֶת צִדְקָת֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת אֱמֻנָת֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁר֩ נְתָנְ/ךָ֨ יְהוָ֤ה הַ/יּוֹם֙ בְּ/יָ֔ד וְ/לֹ֣א אָבִ֔יתִי לִ/שְׁלֹ֥חַ יָדִ֖/י בִּ/מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhvh yshyb l'ysh 't tsdqtv v't 'mntv 'shr ntnkh yhvh hyvm byd vl' 'byty lshlch ydy bmshych yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness: for the LORD delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the LORD’s anointed.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֗ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר גָּדְלָ֧ה נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֛ הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה בְּ/עֵינָ֑/י כֵּ֣ן תִּגְדַּ֤ל נַפְשִׁ/י֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/יַצִּלֵ֖/נִי מִ/כָּל צָרָֽה
verses.translit: vhnh kh'shr gdlh npshkh hyvm hzh b'yny khn tgdl npshy b'yny yhvh vytslny mkhl tsrh
verses.translation: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the LORD , and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל אֶל דָּוִ֗ד בָּר֤וּךְ אַתָּה֙ בְּנִ֣/י דָוִ֔ד גַּ֚ם עָשֹׂ֣ה תַעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְ/גַ֖ם יָכֹ֣ל תּוּכָ֑ל וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ לְ/דַרְכּ֔/וֹ וְ/שָׁא֖וּל שָׁ֥ב לִ/מְקוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l dvd brvkh 'th bny dvd gm 'shh t'shh vgm ykhl tvkhl vylkh dvd ldrkhv vsh'vl shb lmqvmv
verses.translation: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be thou, my son David: thou shalt both do great things , and also shalt still prevail. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל לִבּ֔/וֹ עַתָּ֛ה אֶסָּפֶ֥ה יוֹם אֶחָ֖ד בְּ/יַד שָׁא֑וּל אֵֽין לִ֨/י ט֜וֹב כִּ֣י הִמָּלֵ֥ט אִמָּלֵ֣ט אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וְ/נוֹאַ֨שׁ מִמֶּ֤/נִּי שָׁאוּל֙ לְ/בַקְשֵׁ֤/נִי עוֹד֙ בְּ/כָל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/נִמְלַטְתִּ֖י מִ/יָּדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l lbv 'th 'sph yvm 'chd byd sh'vl 'yn ly tvb khy hmlt 'mlt 'l 'rts plshtym vnv'sh mmny sh'vl lbqshny 'vd bkhl gbvl yshr'l vnmltty mydv
verses.translation: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ר ה֔וּא וְ/שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑/וֹ אֶל אָכִ֥ישׁ בֶּן מָע֖וֹךְ מֶ֥לֶךְ גַּֽת
verses.translit: vyqm dvd vy'br hv' vshsh m'vt 'ysh 'shr 'mv 'l 'khysh bn m'vkh mlkh gt
verses.translation: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשֶׁב֩ דָּוִ֨ד עִם אָכִ֥ישׁ בְּ/גַ֛ת ה֥וּא וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֖י/ו אִ֣ישׁ וּ/בֵית֑/וֹ דָּוִד֙ וּ/שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשָׁ֔י/ו אֲחִינֹ֨עַם֙ הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔ית וַ/אֲבִיגַ֥יִל אֵֽשֶׁת נָבָ֖ל הַֽ/כַּרְמְלִֽית
verses.translit: vyshb dvd 'm 'khysh bgt hv' v'nshyv 'ysh vbytv dvd vshty nshyv 'chyn'm hyzr''lyt v'bygyl 'sht nbl hkhrmlyt
verses.translation: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֣ד לְ/שָׁא֔וּל כִּֽי בָרַ֥ח דָּוִ֖ד גַּ֑ת וְ/לֹֽא יוסף יָסַ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְ/בַקְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vygd lsh'vl khy brch dvd gt vl' yvsf ysf 'vd lbqshv
verses.translation: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל אָכִ֗ישׁ אִם נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יִתְּנוּ לִ֣/י מָק֗וֹם בְּ/אַחַ֛ת עָרֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה וְ/אֵ֣שְׁבָה שָּׁ֑ם וְ/לָ֨/מָּה יֵשֵׁ֧ב עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ בְּ/עִ֥יר הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'khysh 'm n' mts'ty chn b'ynykh ytnv ly mqvm b'cht 'ry hshdh v'shbh shm vlmh yshb 'bdkh b'yr hmmlkhh 'mkh
verses.translation: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֥/וֹ אָכִ֛ישׁ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא אֶת צִֽקְלָ֑ג לָ/כֵ֞ן הָיְתָ֤ה צִֽקְלַג֙ לְ/מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vytn lv 'khysh byvm hhv' 't tsqlg lkhn hyth tsqlg lmlkhy yhvdh 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִסְפַּ֣ר הַ/יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁ֥ב דָּוִ֖ד בִּ/שְׂדֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים יָמִ֖ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyhy mspr hymym 'shr yshb dvd bshdh plshtym ymym v'rb'h chdshym
verses.translation: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַל דָּוִד֙ וַֽ/אֲנָשָׁ֔י/ו וַֽ/יִּפְשְׁט֛וּ אֶל הַ/גְּשׁוּרִ֥י ו/ה/גרזי וְ/הַ/גִּזְרִ֖י וְ/הָ/עֲמָלֵקִ֑י כִּ֣י הֵ֜נָּה יֹשְׁב֤וֹת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מֵֽ/עוֹלָ֔ם בּוֹאֲ/ךָ֥ שׁ֖וּרָ/ה וְ/עַד אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'l dvd v'nshyv vypshtv 'l hgshvry vhgrzy vhgzry vh'mlqy khy hnh yshbvt h'rts 'shr m'vlm bv'kh shvrh v'd 'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/הִכָּ֤ה דָוִד֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/לֹ֥א יְחַיֶּ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ וְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וְ/לָקַח֩ צֹ֨אן וּ/בָקָ֜ר וַ/חֲמֹרִ֤ים וּ/גְמַלִּים֙ וּ/בְגָדִ֔ים וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֶל אָכִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vhkhh dvd 't h'rts vl' ychyh 'ysh v'shh vlqch ts'n vbqr vchmrym vgmlym vbgdym vyshb vyb' 'l 'khysh
verses.translation: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אָכִ֔ישׁ אַל פְּשַׁטְתֶּ֖ם הַ/יּ֑וֹם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗ד עַל נֶ֤גֶב יְהוּדָה֙ וְ/עַל נֶ֣גֶב הַ/יַּרְחְמְאֵלִ֔י וְ/אֶל נֶ֖גֶב הַ/קֵּינִֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'khysh 'l pshttm hyvm vy'mr dvd 'l ngb yhvdh v'l ngb hyrchm'ly v'l ngb hqyny
verses.translation: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ישׁ וְ/אִשָּׁ֜ה לֹֽא יְחַיֶּ֣ה דָוִ֗ד לְ/הָבִ֥יא גַת֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר פֶּן יַגִּ֥דוּ עָלֵ֖י/נוּ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה עָשָׂ֤ה דָוִד֙ וְ/כֹ֣ה מִשְׁפָּט֔/וֹ כָּל הַ֨/יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשַׁ֖ב בִּ/שְׂדֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: v'ysh v'shh l' ychyh dvd lhby' gt l'mr pn ygdv 'lynv l'mr khh 'shh dvd vkhh mshptv khl hymym 'shr yshb bshdh plshtym
verses.translation: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יַּאֲמֵ֥ן אָכִ֖ישׁ בְּ/דָוִ֣ד לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הַבְאֵ֤שׁ הִבְאִישׁ֙ בְּ/עַמּ֣/וֹ בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/הָ֥יָה לִ֖/י לְ/עֶ֥בֶד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mn 'khysh bdvd l'mr hb'sh hb'ysh b'mv byshr'l vhyh ly l'bd 'vlm
verses.translation: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם וַ/יִּקְבְּצ֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֤ים אֶת מַֽחֲנֵי/הֶם֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אָכִישׁ֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּדַ֗ע כִּ֤י אִתִּ/י֙ תֵּצֵ֣א בַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה אַתָּ֖ה וַ/אֲנָשֶֽׁי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyhy bymym hhm vyqbtsv plshtym 't mchnyhm ltsb' lhlchm byshr'l vy'mr 'khysh 'l dvd yd' td' khy 'ty tts' bmchnh 'th v'nshykh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל אָכִ֔ישׁ לָ/כֵן֙ אַתָּ֣ה תֵדַ֔ע אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אָכִישׁ֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד לָ/כֵ֗ן שֹׁמֵ֧ר לְ/רֹאשִׁ֛/י אֲשִֽׂימְ/ךָ֖ כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'khysh lkhn 'th td' 't 'shr y'shh 'bdkh vy'mr 'khysh 'l dvd lkhn shmr lr'shy 'shymkh khl hymym
verses.translation: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל מֵ֔ת וַ/יִּסְפְּדוּ ל/וֹ֙ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֥/הוּ בָ/רָמָ֖ה וּ/בְ/עִיר֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁא֗וּל הֵסִ֛יר הָ/אֹב֥וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/יִּדְּעֹנִ֖ים מֵ/הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vshmv'l mt vyspdv lv khl yshr'l vyqbrhv brmh vb'yrv vsh'vl hsyr h'bvt v't hyd'nym mh'rts
verses.translation: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּבְצ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ וַ/יַּחֲנ֣וּ בְ/שׁוּנֵ֑ם וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֤ץ שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּ/גִּלְבֹּֽעַ
verses.translit: vyqbtsv plshtym vyb'v vychnv bshvnm vyqbts sh'vl 't khl yshr'l vychnv bglb'
verses.translation: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא שָׁא֖וּל אֶת מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יִּרָ֕א וַ/יֶּחֱרַ֥ד לִבּ֖/וֹ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyr' sh'vl 't mchnh plshtym vyr' vychrd lbv m'd
verses.translation: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֤ל שָׁאוּל֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א עָנָ֖/הוּ יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֧ם בַּ/חֲלֹמ֛וֹת גַּ֥ם בָּ/אוּרִ֖ים גַּ֥ם בַּ/נְּבִיאִֽם
verses.translit: vysh'l sh'vl byhvh vl' 'nhv yhvh gm bchlmvt gm b'vrym gm bnby'm
verses.translation: And when Saul enquired of the LORD , the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל לַ/עֲבָדָ֗י/ו בַּקְּשׁוּ לִ/י֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת בַּעֲלַת א֔וֹב וְ/אֵלְכָ֥ה אֵלֶ֖י/הָ וְ/אֶדְרְשָׁה בָּ֑/הּ וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ עֲבָדָי/ו֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו הִנֵּ֛ה אֵ֥שֶׁת בַּֽעֲלַת א֖וֹב בְּ/עֵ֥ין דּֽוֹר
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl l'bdyv bqshv ly 'sht b'lt 'vb v'lkhh 'lyh v'drshh bh vy'mrv 'bdyv 'lyv hnh 'sht b'lt 'vb b'yn dvr
verses.translation: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ שָׁא֗וּל וַ/יִּלְבַּשׁ֙ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ ה֗וּא וּ/שְׁנֵ֤י אֲנָשִׁים֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר קסומי קָֽסֳמִי נָ֥א לִ/י֙ בָּ/א֔וֹב וְ/הַ֣עֲלִי לִ֔/י אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר אֹמַ֖ר אֵלָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vytchpsh sh'vl vylbsh bgdym 'chrym vylkh hv' vshny 'nshym 'mv vyb'v 'l h'shh lylh vy'mr qsvmy qsmy n' ly b'vb vh'ly ly 't 'shr 'mr 'lykh
verses.translation: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֜ה אֵלָ֗י/ו הִנֵּ֨ה אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֨עְתָּ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה שָׁא֔וּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִכְרִ֛ית אֶת הָ/אֹב֥וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/יִּדְּעֹנִ֖י מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/לָ/מָ֥ה אַתָּ֛ה מִתְנַקֵּ֥שׁ בְּ/נַפְשִׁ֖/י לַ/הֲמִיתֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh 'lyv hnh 'th yd't 't 'shr 'shh sh'vl 'shr hkhryt 't h'bvt v't hyd'ny mn h'rts vlmh 'th mtnqsh bnpshy lhmytny
verses.translation: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׁ֤בַֽע לָ/הּ֙ שָׁא֔וּל בַּֽ/יהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר חַי יְהוָ֕ה אִֽם יִקְּרֵ֥/ךְ עָוֺ֖ן בַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyshb' lh sh'vl byhvh l'mr chy yhvh 'm yqrkh 'vn bdbr hzh
verses.translation: And Saul sware to her by the LORD , saying, As the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת מִ֖י אַֽעֲלֶה לָּ֑/ךְ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אֶת שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הַֽעֲלִי לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh 't my ''lh lkh vy'mr 't shmv'l h'ly ly
verses.translation: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤רֶא הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ אֶת שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַ/תִּזְעַ֖ק בְּ/ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל וַ/תֹּאמֶר֩ הָ/אִשָּׁ֨ה אֶל שָׁא֧וּל לֵ/אמֹ֛ר לָ֥/מָּה רִמִּיתָ֖/נִי וְ/אַתָּ֥ה שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vtr' h'shh 't shmv'l vtz'q bqvl gdvl vt'mr h'shh 'l sh'vl l'mr lmh rmytny v'th sh'vl
verses.translation: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לָ֥/הּ הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אַל תִּֽירְאִ֖י כִּ֣י מָ֣ה רָאִ֑ית וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל אֱלֹהִ֥ים רָאִ֖יתִי עֹלִ֥ים מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr lh hmlkh 'l tyr'y khy mh r'yt vt'mr h'shh 'l sh'vl 'lhym r'yty 'lym mn h'rts
verses.translation: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הּ֙ מַֽה תָּאֳר֔/וֹ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר אִ֤ישׁ זָקֵן֙ עֹלֶ֔ה וְ/ה֥וּא עֹטֶ֖ה מְעִ֑יל וַ/יֵּ֤דַע שָׁאוּל֙ כִּֽי שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל ה֔וּא וַ/יִּקֹּ֥ד אַפַּ֛יִם אַ֖רְצָ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lh mh t'rv vt'mr 'ysh zqn 'lh vhv' 'th m'yl vyd' sh'vl khy shmv'l hv' vyqd 'pym 'rtsh vyshtchv
verses.translation: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל לָ֥/מָּה הִרְגַּזְתַּ֖/נִי לְ/הַעֲל֣וֹת אֹתִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁ֠אוּל צַר לִ֨/י מְאֹ֜ד וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֣ים נִלְחָמִ֣ים בִּ֗/י וֵֽ/אלֹהִ֞ים סָ֤ר מֵֽ/עָלַ/י֙ וְ/לֹֽא עָנָ֣/נִי ע֗וֹד גַּ֤ם בְּ/יַֽד הַ/נְּבִיאִם֙ גַּם בַּ֣/חֲלֹמ֔וֹת וָ/אֶקְרָאֶ֣/ה לְ/ךָ֔ לְ/הוֹדִיעֵ֖/נִי מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l 'l sh'vl lmh hrgztny lh'lvt 'ty vy'mr sh'vl tsr ly m'd vplshtym nlchmym by v'lhym sr m'ly vl' 'nny 'vd gm byd hnby'm gm bchlmvt v'qr'h lkh lhvdy'ny mh ''shh
verses.translation: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וְ/לָ֖/מָּה תִּשְׁאָלֵ֑/נִי וַ/יהוָ֛ה סָ֥ר מֵ/עָלֶ֖י/ךָ וַ/יְהִ֥י עָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr shmv'l vlmh tsh'lny vyhvh sr m'lykh vyhy 'rkh
verses.translation: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ יְהוָה֙ ל֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר בְּ/יָדִ֑/י וַ/יִּקְרַ֨ע יְהוָ֤ה אֶת הַ/מַּמְלָכָה֙ מִ/יָּדֶ֔/ךָ וַֽ/יִּתְּנָ֖/הּ לְ/רֵעֲ/ךָ֥ לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: vy'sh yhvh lv kh'shr dbr bydy vyqr' yhvh 't hmmlkhh mydkh vytnh lr'kh ldvd
verses.translation: And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא שָׁמַ֨עְתָּ֙ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא עָשִׂ֥יתָ חֲרוֹן אַפּ֖/וֹ בַּ/עֲמָלֵ֑ק עַל כֵּן֙ הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה עָשָֽׂה לְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: kh'shr l' shm't bqvl yhvh vl' 'shyt chrvn 'pv b'mlq 'l khn hdbr hzh 'shh lkh yhvh hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD , nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.

verses.original: וְ/יִתֵּ֣ן יְ֠הוָה גַּ֣ם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל עִמְּ/ךָ֙ בְּ/יַד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּ/מָחָ֕ר אַתָּ֥ה וּ/בָנֶ֖י/ךָ עִמִּ֑/י גַּ֚ם אֶת מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִתֵּ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vytn yhvh gm 't yshr'l 'mkh byd plshtym vmchr 'th vbnykh 'my gm 't mchnh yshr'l ytn yhvh byd plshtym
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַהֵ֣ר שָׁא֗וּל וַ/יִּפֹּ֤ל מְלֹא קֽוֹמָת/וֹ֙ אַ֔רְצָ/ה וַ/יִּרָ֥א מְאֹ֖ד מִ/דִּבְרֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל גַּם כֹּ֨חַ֙ לֹא הָ֣יָה ב֔/וֹ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אָכַל֙ לֶ֔חֶם כָּל הַ/יּ֖וֹם וְ/כָל הַ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vymhr sh'vl vypl ml' qvmtv 'rtsh vyr' m'd mdbry shmv'l gm khch l' hyh bv khy l' 'khl lchm khl hyvm vkhl hlylh
verses.translation: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

verses.original: וַ/תָּב֤וֹא הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל וַ/תֵּ֖רֶא כִּי נִבְהַ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁמְעָ֤ה שִׁפְחָֽתְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/קוֹלֶ֔/ךָ וָ/אָשִׂ֤ים נַפְשִׁ/י֙ בְּ/כַפִּ֔/י וָֽ/אֶשְׁמַע֙ אֶת דְּבָרֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vtbv' h'shh 'l sh'vl vtr' khy nbhl m'd vt'mr 'lyv hnh shm'h shpchtkh bqvlkh v'shym npshy bkhpy v'shm' 't dbrykh 'shr dbrt 'ly
verses.translation: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שְׁמַֽע נָ֤א גַם אַתָּה֙ בְּ/ק֣וֹל שִׁפְחָתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/אָשִׂ֧מָה לְ/פָנֶ֛י/ךָ פַּת לֶ֖חֶם וֶ/אֱכ֑וֹל וִ/יהִ֤י בְ/ךָ֙ כֹּ֔חַ כִּ֥י תֵלֵ֖ךְ בַּ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: v'th shm' n' gm 'th bqvl shpchtkh v'shmh lpnykh pt lchm v'khvl vyhy bkh khch khy tlkh bdrkh
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.

verses.original: וַ/יְמָאֵ֗ן וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֹכַ֔ל וַ/יִּפְרְצוּ ב֤/וֹ עֲבָדָי/ו֙ וְ/גַם הָ֣/אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֖ע לְ/קֹלָ֑/ם וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ מֵֽ/הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב אֶל הַ/מִּטָּֽה
verses.translit: vym'n vy'mr l' 'khl vyprtsv bv 'bdyv vgm h'shh vyshm' lqlm vyqm mh'rts vyshb 'l hmth
verses.translation: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.

verses.original: וְ/לָ/אִשָּׁ֤ה עֵֽגֶל מַרְבֵּק֙ בַּ/בַּ֔יִת וַ/תְּמַהֵ֖ר וַ/תִּזְבָּחֵ֑/הוּ וַ/תִּקַּח קֶ֣מַח וַ/תָּ֔לָשׁ וַ/תֹּפֵ֖/הוּ מַצּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vl'shh 'gl mrbq bbyt vtmhr vtzbchhv vtqch qmch vtlsh vtphv mtsvt
verses.translation: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it , and did bake unleavened bread thereof:

verses.original: וַ/תַּגֵּ֧שׁ לִ/פְנֵֽי שָׁא֛וּל וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וַ/יֹּאכֵ֑לוּ וַ/יָּקֻ֥מוּ וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ בַּ/לַּ֥יְלָה הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vtgsh lpny sh'vl vlpny 'bdyv vy'khlv vyqmv vylkhv blylh hhv'
verses.translation: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְּצ֧וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֛ים אֶת כָּל מַחֲנֵי/הֶ֖ם אֲפֵ֑קָ/ה וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל חֹנִ֔ים בַּ/עַ֖יִן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/יִזְרְעֶֽאל
verses.translit: vyqbtsv plshtym 't khl mchnyhm 'pqh vyshr'l chnym b'yn 'shr byzr''l
verses.translation: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.

verses.original: וְ/סַרְנֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ עֹֽבְרִ֔ים לְ/מֵא֖וֹת וְ/לַ/אֲלָפִ֑ים וְ/דָוִ֣ד וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֗י/ו עֹֽבְרִ֛ים בָּ/אַחֲרֹנָ֖ה עִם אָכִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vsrny plshtym 'brym lm'vt vl'lpym vdvd v'nshyv 'brym b'chrnh 'm 'khysh
verses.translation: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מָ֖ה הָ/עִבְרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אָכִ֜ישׁ אֶל שָׂרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים הֲ/לֽוֹא זֶ֨ה דָוִ֜ד עֶ֣בֶד שָׁא֣וּל מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה אִתִּ/י֙ זֶ֤ה יָמִים֙ אוֹ זֶ֣ה שָׁנִ֔ים וְ/לֹֽא מָצָ֤אתִי ב/וֹ֙ מְא֔וּמָה מִ/יּ֥וֹם נָפְל֖/וֹ עַד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv shry plshtym mh h'brym h'lh vy'mr 'khysh 'l shry plshtym hlv' zh dvd 'bd sh'vl mlkh yshr'l 'shr hyh 'ty zh ymym 'v zh shnym vl' mts'ty bv m'vmh myvm nplv 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here ? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְצְפ֨וּ עָלָ֜י/ו שָׂרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל/וֹ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים הָשֵׁ֣ב אֶת הָ/אִ֗ישׁ וְ/יָשֹׁב֙ אֶל מְקוֹמ/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִפְקַדְתּ֣/וֹ שָׁ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא יֵרֵ֤ד עִמָּ֨/נוּ֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/לֹא יִֽהְיֶה לָּ֥/נוּ לְ/שָׂטָ֖ן בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וּ/בַ/מֶּ֗ה יִתְרַצֶּ֥ה זֶה֙ אֶל אֲדֹנָ֔י/ו הֲ/ל֕וֹא בְּ/רָאשֵׁ֖י הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָ/הֵֽם
verses.translit: vyqtspv 'lyv shry plshtym vy'mrv lv shry plshtym hshb 't h'ysh vyshb 'l mqvmv 'shr hpqdtv shm vl' yrd 'mnv bmlchmh vl' yhyh lnv lshtn bmlchmh vbmh ytrtsh zh 'l 'dnyv hlv' br'shy h'nshym hhm
verses.translation: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?

verses.original: הֲ/לוֹא זֶ֣ה דָוִ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר יַעֲנוּ ל֛/וֹ בַּ/מְּחֹל֖וֹת לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִכָּ֤ה שָׁאוּל֙ בַּֽ/אֲלָפָ֔י/ו וְ/דָוִ֖ד ב/רבבת/ו בְּ/רִבְבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hlv' zh dvd 'shr y'nv lv bmchlvt l'mr hkhh sh'vl b'lpyv vdvd brbbtv brbbtyv
verses.translation: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אָכִ֜ישׁ אֶל דָּוִ֗ד וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵ֠לָי/ו חַי יְהוָ֞ה כִּי יָשָׁ֣ר אַתָּ֗ה וְ/ט֣וֹב בְּ֠/עֵינַ/י צֵאתְ/ךָ֨ וּ/בֹאֲ/ךָ֤ אִתִּ/י֙ בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה כִּ֠י לֹֽא מָצָ֤אתִֽי בְ/ךָ֙ רָעָ֔ה מִ/יּ֛וֹם בֹּאֲ/ךָ֥ אֵלַ֖/י עַד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֥י הַ/סְּרָנִ֖ים לֹֽא ט֥וֹב אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vyqr' 'khysh 'l dvd vy'mr 'lyv chy yhvh khy yshr 'th vtvb b'yny ts'tkh vb'kh 'ty bmchnh khy l' mts'ty bkh r'h myvm b'kh 'ly 'd hyvm hzh vb'yny hsrnym l' tvb 'th
verses.translation: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֥ה שׁ֖וּב וְ/לֵ֣ךְ בְּ/שָׁל֑וֹם וְ/לֹֽא תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה רָ֔ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י סַרְנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: v'th shvb vlkh bshlvm vl' t'shh r' b'yny srny plshtym
verses.translation: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל אָכִ֗ישׁ כִּ֣י מֶ֤ה עָשִׂ֨יתִי֙ וּ/מַה מָּצָ֣אתָ בְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ מִ/יּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיִ֣יתִי לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אָבוֹא֙ וְ/נִלְחַ֔מְתִּי בְּ/אֹיְבֵ֖י אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'khysh khy mh 'shyty vmh mts't b'bdkh myvm 'shr hyyty lpnykh 'd hyvm hzh khy l' 'bv' vnlchmty b'yby 'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן אָכִישׁ֮ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל דָּוִד֒ יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב אַתָּ֛ה בְּ/עֵינַ֖/י כְּ/מַלְאַ֣ךְ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אַ֣ךְ שָׂרֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹֽא יַעֲלֶ֥ה עִמָּ֖/נוּ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'n 'khysh vy'mr 'l dvd yd'ty khy tvb 'th b'yny khml'kh 'lhym 'kh shry plshtym 'mrv l' y'lh 'mnv bmlchmh
verses.translation: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/עַבְדֵ֥י אֲדֹנֶ֖י/ךָ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣אוּ אִתָּ֑/ךְ וְ/הִשְׁכַּמְתֶּ֣ם בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/א֥וֹר לָ/כֶ֖ם וָ/לֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: v'th hshkhm bbqr v'bdy 'dnykh 'shr b'v 'tkh vhshkhmtm bbqr v'vr lkhm vlkhv
verses.translation: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master’s servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם דָּוִ֜ד ה֤וּא וַֽ/אֲנָשָׁי/ו֙ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר לָ/שׁ֖וּב אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים עָל֥וּ יִזְרְעֶֽאל
verses.translit: vyshkhm dvd hv' v'nshyv llkht bbqr lshvb 'l 'rts plshtym vplshtym 'lv yzr''l
verses.translation: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י בְּ/בֹ֨א דָוִ֧ד וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֛י/ו צִֽקְלַ֖ג בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י וַ/עֲמָלֵקִ֣י פָֽשְׁט֗וּ אֶל נֶ֨גֶב֙ וְ/אֶל צִ֣קְלַ֔ג וַ/יַּכּוּ֙ אֶת צִ֣קְלַ֔ג וַ/יִּשְׂרְפ֥וּ אֹתָ֖/הּ בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyhy bb' dvd v'nshyv tsqlg byvm hshlyshy v'mlqy pshtv 'l ngb v'l tsqlg vykhv 't tsqlg vyshrpv 'th b'sh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁבּ֨וּ אֶת הַ/נָּשִׁ֤ים אֲשֶׁר בָּ/הּ֙ מִ/קָּטֹ֣ן וְ/עַד גָּד֔וֹל לֹ֥א הֵמִ֖יתוּ אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יִּֽנְהֲג֔וּ וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ לְ/דַרְכָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshbv 't hnshym 'shr bh mqtn v'd gdvl l' hmytv 'ysh vynhgv vylkhv ldrkhm
verses.translation: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א דָוִ֤ד וַֽ/אֲנָשָׁי/ו֙ אֶל הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה שְׂרוּפָ֖ה בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ וּ/נְשֵׁי/הֶ֛ם וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֥ם וּ/בְנֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם נִשְׁבּֽוּ
verses.translit: vyb' dvd v'nshyv 'l h'yr vhnh shrvph b'sh vnshyhm vbnyhm vbntyhm nshbv
verses.translation: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֨א דָוִ֜ד וְ/הָ/עָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֛/וֹ אֶת קוֹלָ֖/ם וַ/יִּבְכּ֑וּ עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֵין בָּ/הֶ֛ם כֹּ֖חַ לִ/בְכּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vysh' dvd vh'm 'shr 'tv 't qvlm vybkhv 'd 'shr 'yn bhm khch lbkhvt
verses.translation: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּ֥י נְשֵֽׁי דָוִ֖ד נִשְׁבּ֑וּ אֲחִינֹ֨עַם֙ הַ/יִּזְרְעֵלִ֔ית וַ/אֲבִיגַ֕יִל אֵ֖שֶׁת נָבָ֥ל הַֽ/כַּרְמְלִֽי
verses.translit: vshty nshy dvd nshbv 'chyn'm hyzr'lyt v'bygyl 'sht nbl hkhrmly
verses.translation: And David’s two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨צֶר לְ/דָוִ֜ד מְאֹ֗ד כִּֽי אָמְר֤וּ הָ/עָם֙ לְ/סָקְל֔/וֹ כִּֽי מָ֨רָה֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ עַל בנ/ו בָּנָ֣י/ו וְ/עַל בְּנֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתְחַזֵּ֣ק דָּוִ֔ד בַּ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vttsr ldvd m'd khy 'mrv h'm lsqlv khy mrh npsh khl h'm 'ysh 'l bnv bnyv v'l bntyv vytchzq dvd byhvh 'lhyv
verses.translation: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗ד אֶל אֶבְיָתָ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ בֶּן אֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ הַגִּֽישָׁ/ה נָּ֥א לִ֖/י הָ/אֵפֹ֑ד וַ/יַּגֵּ֧שׁ אֶבְיָתָ֛ר אֶת הָ/אֵפֹ֖ד אֶל דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'bytr hkhhn bn 'chymlkh hgyshh n' ly h'pd vygsh 'bytr 't h'pd 'l dvd
verses.translation: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech’s son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤ד בַּֽ/יהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אֶרְדֹּ֛ף אַחֲרֵ֥י הַ/גְּדוּד הַ/זֶּ֖ה הַֽ/אַשִּׂגֶ֑/נּוּ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ רְדֹ֔ף כִּֽי הַשֵּׂ֥ג תַּשִּׂ֖יג וְ/הַצֵּ֥ל תַּצִּֽיל
verses.translit: vysh'l dvd byhvh l'mr 'rdf 'chry hgdvd hzh h'shgnv vy'mr lv rdf khy hshg tshyg vhtsl ttsyl
verses.translation: And David enquired at the LORD , saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד ה֚וּא וְ/שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד נַ֣חַל הַ/בְּשׂ֑וֹר וְ/הַ/נּֽוֹתָרִ֖ים עָמָֽדוּ
verses.translit: vylkh dvd hv' vshsh m'vt 'ysh 'shr 'tv vyb'v 'd nchl hbshvr vhnvtrym 'mdv
verses.translation: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֣ף דָּוִ֔ד ה֖וּא וְ/אַרְבַּע מֵא֣וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ מָאתַ֣יִם אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּגְּר֔וּ מֵ/עֲבֹ֖ר אֶת נַ֥חַל הַ/בְּשֽׂוֹר
verses.translit: vyrdf dvd hv' v'rb' m'vt 'ysh vy'mdv m'tym 'ysh 'shr pgrv m'br 't nchl hbshvr
verses.translation: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּמְצְא֤וּ אִישׁ מִצְרִי֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וַ/יִּקְח֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ אֶל דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יִּתְּנוּ ל֥/וֹ לֶ֨חֶם֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אכַל וַ/יַּשְׁקֻ֖/הוּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vymts'v 'ysh mtsry bshdh vyqchv 'tv 'l dvd vytnv lv lchm vy'khl vyshqhv mym
verses.translation: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנוּ ל/וֹ֩ פֶ֨לַח דְּבֵלָ֜ה וּ/שְׁנֵ֤י צִמֻּקִים֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אכַל וַ/תָּ֥שָׁב רוּח֖/וֹ אֵלָ֑י/ו כִּ֠י לֹֽא אָ֤כַל לֶ֨חֶם֙ וְ/לֹא שָׁ֣תָה מַ֔יִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יָמִ֖ים וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה לֵילֽוֹת
verses.translit: vytnv lv plch dblh vshny tsmqym vy'khl vtshb rvchv 'lyv khy l' 'khl lchm vl' shth mym shlshh ymym vshlshh lylvt
verses.translation: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר ל֤/וֹ דָוִד֙ לְֽ/מִי אַ֔תָּה וְ/אֵ֥י מִ/זֶּ֖ה אָ֑תָּה וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר נַ֧עַר מִצְרִ֣י אָנֹ֗כִי עֶ֚בֶד לְ/אִ֣ישׁ עֲמָֽלֵקִ֔י וַ/יַּעַזְבֵ֧/נִי אֲדֹנִ֛/י כִּ֥י חָלִ֖יתִי הַ/יּ֥וֹם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr lv dvd lmy 'th v'y mzh 'th vy'mr n'r mtsry 'nkhy 'bd l'ysh 'mlqy vy'zbny 'dny khy chlyty hyvm shlshh
verses.translation: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.

verses.original: אֲנַ֡חְנוּ פָּשַׁ֜טְנוּ נֶ֧גֶב הַ/כְּרֵתִ֛י וְ/עַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה וְ/עַל נֶ֣גֶב כָּלֵ֑ב וְ/אֶת צִקְלַ֖ג שָׂרַ֥פְנוּ בָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'nchnv pshtnv ngb hkhrty v'l 'shr lyhvdh v'l ngb khlb v't tsqlg shrpnv b'sh
verses.translation: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ דָּוִ֔ד הֲ/תוֹרִדֵ֖/נִי אֶל הַ/גְּד֣וּד הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר הִשָּׁבְעָ/ה֩ לִּ֨/י בֵֽ/אלֹהִ֜ים אִם תְּמִיתֵ֗/נִי וְ/אִם תַּסְגִּרֵ֨/נִי֙ בְּ/יַד אֲדֹנִ֔/י וְ/אוֹרִֽדְ/ךָ֖ אֶל הַ/גְּד֥וּד הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv dvd htvrdny 'l hgdvd hzh vy'mr hshb'h ly b'lhym 'm tmytny v'm tsgrny byd 'dny v'vrdkh 'l hgdvd hzh
verses.translation: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣רִדֵ֔/הוּ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה נְטֻשִׁ֖ים עַל פְּנֵ֣י כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֹכְלִ֤ים וְ/שֹׁתִים֙ וְ/חֹ֣גְגִ֔ים בְּ/כֹל֙ הַ/שָּׁלָ֣ל הַ/גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקְח֛וּ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּ/מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyrdhv vhnh ntshym 'l pny khl h'rts 'khlym vshtym vchggym bkhl hshll hgdvl 'shr lqchv m'rts plshtym vm'rts yhvdh
verses.translation: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/ם דָּוִ֛ד מֵ/הַ/נֶּ֥שֶׁף וְ/עַד הָ/עֶ֖רֶב לְ/מָֽחֳרָתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹֽא נִמְלַ֤ט מֵ/הֶם֙ אִ֔ישׁ כִּי֩ אִם אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵא֧וֹת אִֽישׁ נַ֛עַר אֲשֶׁר רָכְב֥וּ עַל הַ/גְּמַלִּ֖ים וַ/יָּנֻֽסוּ
verses.translit: vykhm dvd mhnshf v'd h'rb lmchrtm vl' nmlt mhm 'ysh khy 'm 'rb' m'vt 'ysh n'r 'shr rkhbv 'l hgmlym vynsv
verses.translation: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצֵּ֣ל דָּוִ֔ד אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקְח֖וּ עֲמָלֵ֑ק וְ/אֶת שְׁתֵּ֥י נָשָׁ֖י/ו הִצִּ֥יל דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vytsl dvd 't khl 'shr lqchv 'mlq v't shty nshyv htsyl dvd
verses.translation: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א נֶעְדַּר לָ֠/הֶם מִן הַ/קָּטֹ֨ן וְ/עַד הַ/גָּד֜וֹל וְ/עַד בָּנִ֤ים וּ/בָנוֹת֙ וּ/מִ/שָּׁלָ֔ל וְ/עַ֛ד כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקְח֖וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם הַ/כֹּ֖ל הֵשִׁ֥יב דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vl' n'dr lhm mn hqtn v'd hgdvl v'd bnym vbnvt vmshll v'd khl 'shr lqchv lhm hkhl hshyb dvd
verses.translation: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֔ד אֶת כָּל הַ/צֹּ֖אן וְ/הַ/בָּקָ֑ר נָהֲג֗וּ לִ/פְנֵי֙ הַ/מִּקְנֶ֣ה הַ/ה֔וּא וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ זֶ֖ה שְׁלַ֥ל דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vyqch dvd 't khl hts'n vhbqr nhgv lpny hmqnh hhv' vy'mrv zh shll dvd
verses.translation: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David’s spoil.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א דָוִ֗ד אֶל מָאתַ֨יִם הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֜ים אֲשֶֽׁר פִּגְּר֣וּ מִ/לֶּ֣כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י דָוִ֗ד וַ/יֹּֽשִׁיבֻ/ם֙ בְּ/נַ֣חַל הַ/בְּשׂ֔וֹר וַ/יֵּֽצְאוּ֙ לִ/קְרַ֣את דָּוִ֔ד וְ/לִ/קְרַ֖את הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּגַּ֤שׁ דָּוִד֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֥ל לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyb' dvd 'l m'tym h'nshym 'shr pgrv mlkht 'chry dvd vyshybm bnchl hbshvr vyts'v lqr't dvd vlqr't h'm 'shr 'tv vygsh dvd 't h'm vysh'l lhm lshlvm
verses.translation: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַן כָּל אִֽישׁ רָ֣ע וּ/בְלִיַּ֗עַל מֵֽ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלְכ֣וּ עִם דָּוִד֒ וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא הָלְכ֣וּ עִמִּ֔/י לֹֽא נִתֵּ֣ן לָ/הֶ֔ם מֵ/הַ/שָּׁלָ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִצַּ֑לְנוּ כִּֽי אִם אִ֤ישׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּ/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֔י/ו וְ/יִנְהֲג֖וּ וְ/יֵלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: vy'n khl 'ysh r' vbly'l mh'nshym 'shr hlkhv 'm dvd vy'mrv y'n 'shr l' hlkhv 'my l' ntn lhm mhshll 'shr htslnv khy 'm 'ysh 't 'shtv v't bnyv vynhgv vylkhv
verses.translation: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד לֹֽא תַעֲשׂ֥וּ כֵ֖ן אֶחָ֑/י אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה לָ֨/נוּ֙ וַ/יִּשְׁמֹ֣ר אֹתָ֔/נוּ וַ/יִּתֵּ֗ן אֶֽת הַ/גְּד֛וּד הַ/בָּ֥א עָלֵ֖י/נוּ בְּ/יָדֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd l' t'shv khn 'chy 't 'shr ntn yhvh lnv vyshmr 'tnv vytn 't hgdvd hb' 'lynv bydnv
verses.translation: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.

verses.original: וּ/מִי֙ יִשְׁמַ֣ע לָ/כֶ֔ם לַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ֞י כְּ/חֵ֣לֶק הַ/יֹּרֵ֣ד בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה וּֽ/כְ/חֵ֛לֶק הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֥ב עַל הַ/כֵּלִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֥ו יַחֲלֹֽקוּ
verses.translit: vmy yshm' lkhm ldbr hzh khy khchlq hyrd bmlchmh vkhchlq hyshb 'l hkhlym ychdv ychlqv
verses.translation: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י מֵֽ/הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וַ/יְשִׂמֶ֜/הָ לְ/חֹ֤ק וּ/לְ/מִשְׁפָּט֙ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyhy mhyvm hhv' vm'lh vyshmh lchq vlmshpt lyshr'l 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א דָוִד֙ אֶל צִ֣קְלַ֔ג וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֧ח מֵֽ/הַ/שָּׁלָ֛ל לְ/זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה לְ/רֵעֵ֣/הוּ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ בְּרָכָ֔ה מִ/שְּׁלַ֖ל אֹיְבֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' dvd 'l tsqlg vyshlch mhshll lzqny yhvdh lr'hv l'mr hnh lkhm brkhh mshll 'yby yhvh
verses.translation: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD ;

verses.original: לַ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֛ל וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/רָמֽוֹת נֶ֖גֶב וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/יַתִּֽר
verses.translit: l'shr bbyt 'l vl'shr brmvt ngb vl'shr bytr
verses.translation: To them which were in Beth-el, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,

verses.translit: vl'shr b'r'r vl'shr bshpmvt vl'shr b'shtm'
verses.translation: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,

verses.original: וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/רָכָ֗ל וְ/לַֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י הַ/יְּרַחְמְאֵלִ֔י וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עָרֵ֥י הַ/קֵּינִֽי
verses.translit: vl'shr brkhl vl'shr b'ry hyrchm'ly vl'shr b'ry hqyny
verses.translation: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,

verses.original: וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּ/חָרְמָ֛ה וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/בוֹר עָשָׁ֖ן וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/עֲתָֽךְ
verses.translit: vl'shr bchrmh vl'shr bbvr 'shn vl'shr b'tkh
verses.translation: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chor-ashan, and to them which were in Athach,

verses.original: וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/חֶבְר֑וֹן וּֽ/לְ/כָל הַ/מְּקֹמ֛וֹת אֲשֶֽׁר הִתְהַלֶּךְ שָׁ֥ם דָּוִ֖ד ה֥וּא וַ/אֲנָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vl'shr bchbrvn vlkhl hmqmvt 'shr hthlkh shm dvd hv' v'nshyv
verses.translation: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.

verses.original: וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים נִלְחָמִ֣ים בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּנֻ֜סוּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּ/הַ֥ר הַ/גִּלְבֹּֽעַ
verses.translit: vplshtym nlchmym byshr'l vynsv 'nshy yshr'l mpny plshtym vyplv chllym bhr hglb'
verses.translation: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

verses.original: וַ/יַּדְבְּק֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אֶת שָׁא֖וּל וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּכּ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים אֶת יְהוֹנָתָ֧ן וְ/אֶת אֲבִינָדָ֛ב וְ/אֶת מַלְכִּי שׁ֖וּעַ בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vydbqv plshtym 't sh'vl v't bnyv vykhv plshtym 't yhvntn v't 'byndb v't mlkhy shv' bny sh'vl
verses.translation: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, Saul’s sons.

verses.original: וַ/תִּכְבַּ֤ד הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ אֶל שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יִּמְצָאֻ֥/הוּ הַ/מּוֹרִ֖ים אֲנָשִׁ֣ים בַּ/קָּ֑שֶׁת וַ/יָּ֥חֶל מְאֹ֖ד מֵ/הַ/מּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vtkhbd hmlchmh 'l sh'vl vymts'hv hmvrym 'nshym bqsht vychl m'd mhmvrym
verses.translation: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁאוּל֩ לְ/נֹשֵׂ֨א כֵלָ֜י/ו שְׁלֹ֥ף חַרְבְּ/ךָ֣ וְ/דָקְרֵ֣/נִי בָ֗/הּ פֶּן יָ֠בוֹאוּ הָ/עֲרֵלִ֨ים הָ/אֵ֤לֶּה וּ/דְקָרֻ֨/נִי֙ וְ/הִתְעַלְּלוּ בִ֔/י וְ/לֹ֤א אָבָה֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔י/ו כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת הַ/חֶ֔רֶב וַ/יִּפֹּ֖ל עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl lnsh' khlyv shlf chrbkh vdqrny bh pn ybv'v h'rlym h'lh vdqrny vht'llv by vl' 'bh nsh' khlyv khy yr' m'd vyqch sh'vl 't hchrb vypl 'lyh
verses.translation: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא נֹשֵֽׂא כֵלָ֖י/ו כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל גַּם ה֛וּא עַל חַרְבּ֖/וֹ וַ/יָּ֥מָת עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' nsh' khlyv khy mt sh'vl vypl gm hv' 'l chrbv vymt 'mv
verses.translation: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת שָׁא֡וּל וּ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָי/ו֩ וְ/נֹשֵׂ֨א כֵלָ֜י/ו גַּ֧ם כָּל אֲנָשָׁ֛י/ו בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: vymt sh'vl vshlsht bnyv vnsh' khlyv gm khl 'nshyv byvm hhv' ychdv
verses.translation: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֣וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּ/עֵ֨בֶר הָ/עֵ֜מֶק וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן כִּֽי נָ֨סוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/כִי מֵ֖תוּ שָׁא֣וּל וּ/בָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּעַזְב֤וּ אֶת הֶֽ/עָרִים֙ וַ/יָּנֻ֔סוּ וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יֵּֽשְׁב֖וּ בָּ/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vyr'v 'nshy yshr'l 'shr b'br h'mq v'shr b'br hyrdn khy nsv 'nshy yshr'l vkhy mtv sh'vl vbnyv vy'zbv 't h'rym vynsv vyb'v plshtym vyshbv bhn
verses.translation: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְ/פַשֵּׁ֖ט אֶת הַ/חֲלָלִ֑ים וַֽ/יִּמְצְא֤וּ אֶת שָׁאוּל֙ וְ/אֶת שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָ֔י/ו נֹפְלִ֖ים בְּ/הַ֥ר הַ/גִּלְבֹּֽעַ
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyb'v plshtym lpsht 't hchllym vymts'v 't sh'vl v't shlsht bnyv nplym bhr hglb'
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּכְרְתוּ֙ אֶת רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּפְשִׁ֖יטוּ אֶת כֵּלָ֑י/ו וַ/יְשַׁלְּח֨וּ בְ/אֶֽרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֜ים סָבִ֗יב לְ/בַשֵּׂ֛ר בֵּ֥ית עֲצַבֵּי/הֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vykhrtv 't r'shv vypshytv 't khlyv vyshlchv b'rts plshtym sbyb lbshr byt 'tsbyhm v't h'm
verses.translation: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֨מוּ֙ אֶת כֵּלָ֔י/ו בֵּ֖ית עַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְ/אֶת גְּוִיָּת/וֹ֙ תָּקְע֔וּ בְּ/חוֹמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית שָֽׁן
verses.translit: vyshmv 't khlyv byt 'shtrvt v't gvytv tq'v bchvmt byt shn
verses.translation: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֣וּ אֵלָ֔י/ו יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֥וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְ/שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vyshm'v 'lyv yshby ybysh gl'd 't 'shr 'shv plshtym lsh'vl
verses.translation: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;

verses.original: וַ/יָּק֜וּמוּ כָּל אִ֣ישׁ חַיִל֮ וַ/יֵּלְכ֣וּ כָל הַ/לַּיְלָה֒ וַ/יִּקְח֞וּ אֶת גְּוִיַּ֣ת שָׁא֗וּל וְ/אֵת֙ גְּוִיֹּ֣ת בָּנָ֔י/ו מֵ/חוֹמַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית שָׁ֑ן וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ יָבֵ֔שָׁ/ה וַ/יִּשְׂרְפ֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyqvmv khl 'ysh chyl vylkhv khl hlylh vyqchv 't gvyt sh'vl v't gvyt bnyv mchvmt byt shn vyb'v ybshh vyshrpv 'tm shm
verses.translation: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת עַצְמֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ תַֽחַת הָ/אֶ֖שֶׁל בְּ/יָבֵ֑שָׁ/ה וַ/יָּצֻ֖מוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyqchv 't 'tsmtyhm vyqbrv tcht h'shl bybshh vytsmv shb't ymym
verses.translation: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַֽחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת שָׁא֔וּל וְ/דָוִ֣ד שָׁ֔ב מֵ/הַכּ֖וֹת אֶת הָ/עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַ/יֵּ֧שֶׁב דָּוִ֛ד בְּ/צִקְלָ֖ג יָמִ֥ים שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry mvt sh'vl vdvd shb mhkhvt 't h'mlq vyshb dvd btsqlg ymym shnym
verses.translation: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֗י וְ/הִנֵּה֩ אִ֨ישׁ בָּ֤א מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶה֙ מֵ/עִ֣ם שָׁא֔וּל וּ/בְגָדָ֣י/ו קְרֻעִ֔ים וַ/אֲדָמָ֖ה עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יְהִי֙ בְּ/בֹא֣/וֹ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל אַ֖רְצָ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshlyshy vhnh 'ysh b' mn hmchnh m'm sh'vl vbgdyv qr'ym v'dmh 'l r'shv vyhy bb'v 'l dvd vypl 'rtsh vyshtchv
verses.translation: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ דָּוִ֔ד אֵ֥י מִ/זֶּ֖ה תָּב֑וֹא וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו מִ/מַּחֲנֵ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִמְלָֽטְתִּי
verses.translit: vy'mr lv dvd 'y mzh tbv' vy'mr 'lyv mmchnh yshr'l nmltty
verses.translation: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֥י/ו דָּוִ֛ד מֶה הָיָ֥ה הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַגֶּד נָ֣א לִ֑/י וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר אֲשֶׁר נָ֨ס הָ/עָ֜ם מִן הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְ/גַם הַרְבֵּ֞ה נָפַ֤ל מִן הָ/עָם֙ וַ/יָּמֻ֔תוּ וְ/גַ֗ם שָׁא֛וּל וִ/יהוֹנָתָ֥ן בְּנ֖/וֹ מֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv dvd mh hyh hdbr hgd n' ly vy'mr 'shr ns h'm mn hmlchmh vgm hrbh npl mn h'm vymtv vgm sh'vl vyhvntn bnv mtv
verses.translation: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד אֶל הַ/נַּ֖עַר הַ/מַּגִּ֣יד ל֑/וֹ אֵ֣יךְ יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּי מֵ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל וִ/יהֽוֹנָתָ֥ן בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l hn'r hmgyd lv 'ykh yd't khy mt sh'vl vyhvntn bnv
verses.translation: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר הַ/נַּ֣עַר הַ/מַּגִּ֣יד ל֗/וֹ נִקְרֹ֤א נִקְרֵ֨יתִי֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר הַ/גִּלְבֹּ֔עַ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה שָׁא֖וּל נִשְׁעָ֣ן עַל חֲנִית֑/וֹ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה הָ/רֶ֛כֶב וּ/בַעֲלֵ֥י הַ/פָּרָשִׁ֖ים הִדְבִּקֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr hn'r hmgyd lv nqr' nqryty bhr hglb' vhnh sh'vl nsh'n 'l chnytv vhnh hrkhb vb'ly hprshym hdbqhv
verses.translation: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥פֶן אַחֲרָ֖י/ו וַ/יִּרְאֵ֑/נִי וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א אֵלָ֔/י וָ/אֹמַ֖ר הִנֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vypn 'chryv vyr'ny vyqr' 'ly v'mr hnny
verses.translation: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֖/י מִי אָ֑תָּה ו/יאמר וָ/אֹמַ֣ר אֵלָ֔י/ו עֲמָלֵקִ֖י אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: vy'mr ly my 'th vy'mr v'mr 'lyv 'mlqy 'nkhy
verses.translation: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗/י עֲמָד נָ֤א עָלַ/י֙ וּ/מֹ֣תְתֵ֔/נִי כִּ֥י אֲחָזַ֖/נִי הַ/שָּׁבָ֑ץ כִּֽי כָל ע֥וֹד נַפְשִׁ֖/י בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'md n' 'ly vmttny khy 'chzny hshbts khy khl 'vd npshy by
verses.translation: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.

verses.original: וָ/אֶעֱמֹ֤ד עָלָי/ו֙ וַ/אֲמֹ֣תְתֵ֔/הוּ כִּ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִֽחְיֶ֖ה אַחֲרֵ֣י נִפְל֑/וֹ וָ/אֶקַּ֞ח הַ/נֵּ֣זֶר אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל רֹאשׁ֗/וֹ וְ/אֶצְעָדָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל זְרֹע֔/וֹ וָ/אֲבִיאֵ֥/ם אֶל אֲדֹנִ֖/י הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: v''md 'lyv v'mtthv khy yd'ty khy l' ychyh 'chry nplv v'qch hnzr 'shr 'l r'shv v'ts'dh 'shr 'l zr'v v'by'm 'l 'dny hnh
verses.translation: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחֲזֵ֥ק דָּוִ֛ד ב/בגד/ו בִּ/בְגָדָ֖י/ו וַ/יִּקְרָעֵ֑/ם וְ/גַ֥ם כָּל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychzq dvd bbgdv bbgdyv vyqr'm vgm khl h'nshym 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּסְפְּדוּ֙ וַ/יִּבְכּ֔וּ וַ/יָּצֻ֖מוּ עַד הָ/עָ֑רֶב עַל שָׁא֞וּל וְ/עַל יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֗/וֹ וְ/עַל עַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ וְ/עַל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י נָפְל֖וּ בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vyspdv vybkhv vytsmv 'd h'rb 'l sh'vl v'l yhvntn bnv v'l 'm yhvh v'l byt yshr'l khy nplv bchrb
verses.translation: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD , and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗ד אֶל הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ הַ/מַּגִּ֣יד ל֔/וֹ אֵ֥י מִ/זֶּ֖ה אָ֑תָּה וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר בֶּן אִ֛ישׁ גֵּ֥ר עֲמָלֵקִ֖י אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l hn'r hmgyd lv 'y mzh 'th vy'mr bn 'ysh gr 'mlqy 'nkhy
verses.translation: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖י/ו דָּוִ֑ד אֵ֚יךְ לֹ֣א יָרֵ֔אתָ לִ/שְׁלֹ֨חַ֙ יָֽדְ/ךָ֔ לְ/שַׁחֵ֖ת אֶת מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv dvd 'ykh l' yr't lshlch ydkh lshcht 't mshych yhvh
verses.translation: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א דָוִ֗ד לְ/אַחַד֙ מֵֽ/הַ/נְּעָרִ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר גַּ֣שׁ פְּגַע בּ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּכֵּ֖/הוּ וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyqr' dvd l'chd mhn'rym vy'mr gsh pg' bv vykhhv vymt
verses.translation: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ דָּוִ֔ד דמי/ך דָּמְ/ךָ֖ עַל רֹאשֶׁ֑/ךָ כִּ֣י פִ֗י/ךָ עָנָ֤ה בְ/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אָנֹכִ֥י מֹתַ֖תִּי אֶת מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv dvd dmykh dmkh 'l r'shkh khy pykh 'nh bkh l'mr 'nkhy mtty 't mshych yhvh
verses.translation: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD’s anointed.

verses.original: וַ/יְקֹנֵ֣ן דָּוִ֔ד אֶת הַ/קִּינָ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את עַל שָׁא֖וּל וְ/עַל יְהוֹנָתָ֥ן בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqnn dvd 't hqynh hz't 'l sh'vl v'l yhvntn bnv
verses.translation: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לְ/לַמֵּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֖ה קָ֑שֶׁת הִנֵּ֥ה כְתוּבָ֖ה עַל סֵ֥פֶר הַ/יָּשָֽׁר
verses.translit: vy'mr llmd bny yhvdh qsht hnh khtvbh 'l spr hyshr
verses.translation: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

verses.original: הַ/צְּבִי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל בָּמוֹתֶ֖י/ךָ חָלָ֑ל אֵ֖יךְ נָפְל֥וּ גִבּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: htsby yshr'l 'l bmvtykh chll 'ykh nplv gbvrym
verses.translation: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!

verses.original: אַל תַּגִּ֣ידוּ בְ/גַ֔ת אַֽל תְּבַשְּׂר֖וּ בְּ/חוּצֹ֣ת אַשְׁקְל֑וֹן פֶּן תִּשְׂמַ֨חְנָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים פֶּֽן תַּעֲלֹ֖זְנָה בְּנ֥וֹת הָ/עֲרֵלִֽים
verses.translit: 'l tgydv bgt 'l tbshrv bchvtst 'shqlvn pn tshmchnh bnvt plshtym pn t'lznh bnvt h'rlym
verses.translation: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

verses.original: הָרֵ֣י בַ/גִּלְבֹּ֗עַ אַל טַ֧ל וְ/אַל מָטָ֛ר עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם וּ/שְׂדֵ֣י תְרוּמֹ֑ת כִּ֣י שָׁ֤ם נִגְעַל֙ מָגֵ֣ן גִּבּוֹרִ֔ים מָגֵ֣ן שָׁא֔וּל בְּלִ֖י מָשִׁ֥יחַ בַּ/שָּֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: hry bglb' 'l tl v'l mtr 'lykhm vshdy trvmt khy shm ng'l mgn gbvrym mgn sh'vl bly mshych bshmn
verses.translation: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.

verses.original: מִ/דַּ֣ם חֲלָלִ֗ים מֵ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ גִּבּוֹרִ֔ים קֶ֚שֶׁת יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן לֹ֥א נָשׂ֖וֹג אָח֑וֹר וְ/חֶ֣רֶב שָׁא֔וּל לֹ֥א תָשׁ֖וּב רֵיקָֽם
verses.translit: mdm chllym mchlb gbvrym qsht yhvntn l' nshvg 'chvr vchrb sh'vl l' tshvb ryqm
verses.translation: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

verses.original: שָׁא֣וּל וִ/יהוֹנָתָ֗ן הַ/נֶּאֱהָבִ֤ים וְ/הַ/נְּעִימִם֙ בְּ/חַיֵּי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/מוֹתָ֖/ם לֹ֣א נִפְרָ֑דוּ מִ/נְּשָׁרִ֣ים קַ֔לּוּ מֵ/אֲרָי֖וֹת גָּבֵֽרוּ
verses.translit: sh'vl vyhvntn hn'hbym vhn'ymm bchyyhm vbmvtm l' nprdv mnshrym qlv m'ryvt gbrv
verses.translation: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

verses.original: בְּנוֹת֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל שָׁא֖וּל בְּכֶ֑ינָה הַ/מַּלְבִּֽשְׁ/כֶ֤ם שָׁנִי֙ עִם עֲדָנִ֔ים הַֽ/מַּעֲלֶה֙ עֲדִ֣י זָהָ֔ב עַ֖ל לְבוּשְׁ/כֶֽן
verses.translit: bnvt yshr'l 'l sh'vl bkhynh hmlbshkhm shny 'm 'dnym hm'lh 'dy zhb 'l lbvshkhn
verses.translation: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ נָפְל֣וּ גִבֹּרִ֔ים בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן עַל בָּמוֹתֶ֖י/ךָ חָלָֽל
verses.translit: 'ykh nplv gbrym btvkh hmlchmh yhvntn 'l bmvtykh chll
verses.translation: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.

verses.original: צַר לִ֣/י עָלֶ֗י/ךָ אָחִ/י֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן נָעַ֥מְתָּ לִּ֖/י מְאֹ֑ד נִפְלְאַ֤תָה אַהֲבָֽתְ/ךָ֙ לִ֔/י מֵ/אַהֲבַ֖ת נָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: tsr ly 'lykh 'chy yhvntn n'mt ly m'd npl'th 'hbtkh ly m'hbt nshym
verses.translation: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ נָפְל֣וּ גִבּוֹרִ֔ים וַ/יֹּאבְד֖וּ כְּלֵ֥י מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: 'ykh nplv gbvrym vy'bdv khly mlchmh
verses.translation: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן וַ/יִּשְׁאַל֩ דָּוִ֨ד בַּֽ/יהוָ֤ה לֵ/אמֹר֙ הַ/אֶעֱלֶ֗ה בְּ/אַחַת֙ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלָ֖י/ו עֲלֵ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אָ֥נָה אֶעֱלֶ֖ה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר חֶבְרֹֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vysh'l dvd byhvh l'mr h''lh b'cht 'ry yhvdh vy'mr yhvh 'lyv 'lh vy'mr dvd 'nh ''lh vy'mr chbrnh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַל שָׁם֙ דָּוִ֔ד וְ/גַ֖ם שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשָׁ֑י/ו אֲחִינֹ֨עַם֙ הַ/יִּזְרְעֵלִ֔ית וַ/אֲבִיגַ֕יִל אֵ֖שֶׁת נָבָ֥ל הַֽ/כַּרְמְלִֽי
verses.translit: vy'l shm dvd vgm shty nshyv 'chyn'm hyzr'lyt v'bygyl 'sht nbl hkhrmly
verses.translation: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal’s wife the Carmelite.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֧י/ו אֲשֶׁר עִמּ֛/וֹ הֶעֱלָ֥ה דָוִ֖ד אִ֣ישׁ וּ/בֵית֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ בְּ/עָרֵ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'nshyv 'shr 'mv h'lh dvd 'ysh vbytv vyshbv b'ry chbrvn
verses.translation: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יִּמְשְׁחוּ שָׁ֧ם אֶת דָּוִ֛ד לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יַּגִּ֤דוּ לְ/דָוִד֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַנְשֵׁי֙ יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר קָבְר֖וּ אֶת שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vyb'v 'nshy yhvdh vymshchv shm 't dvd lmlkh 'l byt yhvdh vygdv ldvd l'mr 'nshy ybysh gl'd 'shr qbrv 't sh'vl
verses.translation: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabesh-gilead were they that buried Saul.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח דָּוִד֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל אַנְשֵׁ֖י יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם בְּרֻכִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֜ם הַ/חֶ֣סֶד הַ/זֶּ֗ה עִם אֲדֹֽנֵי/כֶם֙ עִם שָׁא֔וּל וַֽ/תִּקְבְּר֖וּ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd ml'khym 'l 'nshy ybysh gl'd vy'mr 'lyhm brkhym 'tm lyhvh 'shr 'shytm hchsd hzh 'm 'dnykhm 'm sh'vl vtqbrv 'tv
verses.translation: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD , that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה יַֽעַשׂ יְהוָ֥ה עִמָּ/כֶ֖ם חֶ֣סֶד וֶ/אֱמֶ֑ת וְ/גַ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה אִתְּ/כֶם֙ הַ/טּוֹבָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'th y'sh yhvh 'mkhm chsd v'mt vgm 'nkhy ''shh 'tkhm htvbh hz't 'shr 'shytm hdbr hzh
verses.translation: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יְדֵי/כֶ֗ם וִֽ/הְיוּ֙ לִ/בְנֵי חַ֔יִל כִּי מֵ֖ת אֲדֹנֵי/כֶ֣ם שָׁא֑וּל וְ/גַם אֹתִ֗/י מָשְׁח֧וּ בֵית יְהוּדָ֛ה לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th tchzqnh ydykhm vhyv lbny chyl khy mt 'dnykhm sh'vl vgm 'ty mshchv byt yhvdh lmlkh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן נֵ֔ר שַׂר צָבָ֖א אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/שָׁא֑וּל לָקַ֗ח אֶת אִ֥ישׁ בֹּ֨שֶׁת֙ בֶּן שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יַּעֲבִרֵ֖/הוּ מַחֲנָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'bnr bn nr shr tsb' 'shr lsh'vl lqch 't 'ysh bsht bn sh'vl vy'brhv mchnym
verses.translation: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s host, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְלִכֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֶל הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד וְ/אֶל הָ/אֲשׁוּרִ֖י וְ/אֶֽל יִזְרְעֶ֑אל וְ/עַל אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ וְ/עַל בִּנְיָמִ֔ן וְ/עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּֽ/ה
verses.translit: vymlkhhv 'l hgl'd v'l h'shvry v'l yzr''l v'l 'prym v'l bnymn v'l yshr'l khlh
verses.translation: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

verses.original: בֶּן אַרְבָּעִ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה אִֽישׁ בֹּ֣שֶׁת בֶּן שָׁא֗וּל בְּ/מָלְכ/וֹ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/שְׁתַּ֥יִם שָׁנִ֖ים מָלָ֑ךְ אַ֚ךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה הָי֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י דָוִֽד
verses.translit: bn 'rb'ym shnh 'ysh bsht bn sh'vl bmlkhv 'l yshr'l vshtym shnym mlkh 'kh byt yhvdh hyv 'chry dvd
verses.translation: Ish-bosheth Saul’s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִסְפַּ֣ר הַ/יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיָ֨ה דָוִ֥ד מֶ֛לֶךְ בְּ/חֶבְר֖וֹן עַל בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyhy mspr hymym 'shr hyh dvd mlkh bchbrvn 'l byt yhvdh shb' shnym vshshh chdshym
verses.translation: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ אַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן נֵ֔ר וְ/עַבְדֵ֖י אִֽישׁ בֹּ֣שֶׁת בֶּן שָׁא֑וּל מִֽ/מַּחֲנַ֖יִם גִּבְעֽוֹנָ/ה
verses.translit: vyts' 'bnr bn nr v'bdy 'ysh bsht bn sh'vl mmchnym gb'vnh
verses.translation: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹאָ֨ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֜ה וְ/עַבְדֵ֤י דָוִד֙ יָֽצְא֔וּ וַֽ/יִּפְגְּשׁ֛וּ/ם עַל בְּרֵכַ֥ת גִּבְע֖וֹן יַחְדָּ֑ו וַ/יֵּ֨שְׁב֜וּ אֵ֤לֶּה עַל הַ/בְּרֵכָה֙ מִ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה עַל הַ/בְּרֵכָ֖ה מִ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyv'b bn tsrvyh v'bdy dvd yts'v vypgshvm 'l brkht gb'vn ychdv vyshbv 'lh 'l hbrkhh mzh v'lh 'l hbrkhh mzh
verses.translation: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אַבְנֵר֙ אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב יָק֤וּמוּ נָא֙ הַ/נְּעָרִ֔ים וִֽ/ישַׂחֲק֖וּ לְ/פָנֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יוֹאָ֖ב יָקֻֽמוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bnr 'l yv'b yqvmv n' hn'rym vyshchqv lpnynv vy'mr yv'b yqmv
verses.translation: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֖מוּ וַ/יַּעַבְר֣וּ בְ/מִסְפָּ֑ר שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר לְ/בִנְיָמִ֗ן וּ/לְ/אִ֥ישׁ בֹּ֨שֶׁת֙ בֶּן שָׁא֔וּל וּ/שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר מֵ/עַבְדֵ֥י דָוִֽד
verses.translit: vyqmv vy'brv bmspr shnym 'shr lbnymn vl'ysh bsht bn sh'vl vshnym 'shr m'bdy dvd
verses.translation: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּחֲזִ֜קוּ אִ֣ישׁ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ רֵעֵ֗/הוּ וְ/חַרְבּ/וֹ֙ בְּ/צַ֣ד רֵעֵ֔/הוּ וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ לַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא חֶלְקַ֥ת הַצֻּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/גִבְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vychzqv 'ysh br'sh r'hv vchrbv btsd r'hv vyplv ychdv vyqr' lmqvm hhv' chlqt htsrym 'shr bgb'vn
verses.translation: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֧י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה קָשָׁ֥ה עַד מְאֹ֖ד בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יִּנָּ֤גֶף אַבְנֵר֙ וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ/פְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֥י דָוִֽד
verses.translit: vthy hmlchmh qshh 'd m'd byvm hhv' vyngf 'bnr v'nshy yshr'l lpny 'bdy dvd
verses.translation: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ שָׁ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ בְּנֵ֣י צְרוּיָ֔ה יוֹאָ֥ב וַ/אֲבִישַׁ֖י וַ/עֲשָׂהאֵ֑ל וַ/עֲשָׂהאֵל֙ קַ֣ל בְּ/רַגְלָ֔י/ו כְּ/אַחַ֥ד הַ/צְּבָיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhyv shm shlshh bny tsrvyh yv'b v'byshy v'shh'l v'shh'l ql brglyv kh'chd htsbym 'shr bshdh
verses.translation: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֥ף עֲשָׂהאֵ֖ל אַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֑ר וְ/לֹֽא נָטָ֣ה לָ/לֶ֗כֶת עַל הַ/יָּמִין֙ וְ/עַֽל הַ/שְּׂמֹ֔אול מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֖י אַבְנֵֽר
verses.translit: vyrdf 'shh'l 'chry 'bnr vl' nth llkht 'l hymyn v'l hshm'vl m'chry 'bnr
verses.translation: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤פֶן אַבְנֵר֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הַ/אַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה עֲשָׂהאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: vypn 'bnr 'chryv vy'mr h'th zh 'shh'l vy'mr 'nkhy
verses.translation: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣/וֹ אַבְנֵ֗ר נְטֵ֤ה לְ/ךָ֙ עַל יְמִֽינְ/ךָ֙ א֣וֹ עַל שְׂמֹאלֶ֔/ךָ וֶ/אֱחֹ֣ז לְ/ךָ֗ אֶחָד֙ מֵֽ/הַ/נְּעָרִ֔ים וְ/קַח לְ/ךָ֖ אֶת חֲלִצָת֑/וֹ וְ/לֹֽא אָבָ֣ה עֲשָׂהאֵ֔ל לָ/ס֖וּר מֵ/אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'bnr nth lkh 'l ymynkh 'v 'l shm'lkh v'chz lkh 'chd mhn'rym vqch lkh 't chltstv vl' 'bh 'shh'l lsvr m'chryv
verses.translation: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧סֶף ע֣וֹד אַבְנֵ֗ר לֵ/אמֹר֙ אֶל עֲשָׂהאֵ֔ל ס֥וּר לְ/ךָ֖ מֵ/אַֽחֲרָ֑/י לָ֤/מָּה אַכֶּ֨/כָּה֙ אַ֔רְצָ/ה וְ/אֵיךְ֙ אֶשָּׂ֣א פָנַ֔/י אֶל יוֹאָ֖ב אָחִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vysf 'vd 'bnr l'mr 'l 'shh'l svr lkh m'chry lmh 'khkhh 'rtsh v'ykh 'sh' pny 'l yv'b 'chykh
verses.translation: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?

verses.original: וַ/יְמָאֵ֣ן לָ/ס֗וּר וַ/יַּכֵּ֣/הוּ אַבְנֵר֩ בְּ/אַחֲרֵ֨י הַ/חֲנִ֜ית אֶל הַ/חֹ֗מֶשׁ וַ/תֵּצֵ֤א הַֽ/חֲנִית֙ מֵ/אַחֲרָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּפָּל שָׁ֖ם וַ/יָּ֣מָת תחת/ו תַּחְתָּ֑י/ו וַ/יְהִ֡י כָּל הַ/בָּ֣א אֶֽל הַ/מָּקוֹם֩ אֲשֶׁר נָ֨פַל שָׁ֧ם עֲשָׂהאֵ֛ל וַ/יָּמֹ֖ת וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹֽדוּ
verses.translit: vym'n lsvr vykhhv 'bnr b'chry hchnyt 'l hchmsh vtts' hchnyt m'chryv vypl shm vymt tchtv tchtyv vyhy khl hb' 'l hmqvm 'shr npl shm 'shh'l vymt vy'mdv
verses.translation: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפ֛וּ יוֹאָ֥ב וַ/אֲבִישַׁ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֑ר וְ/הַ/שֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ בָּ֔אָה וְ/הֵ֗מָּה בָּ֚אוּ עַד גִּבְעַ֣ת אַמָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל פְּנֵי גִ֔יחַ דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר גִּבְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyrdpv yv'b v'byshy 'chry 'bnr vhshmsh b'h vhmh b'v 'd gb't 'mh 'shr 'l pny gych drkh mdbr gb'vn
verses.translation: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְקַבְּצ֤וּ בְנֵֽי בִנְיָמִן֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֔ר וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ לַ/אֲגֻדָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וַ/יַּ֣עַמְד֔וּ עַ֥ל רֹאשׁ גִּבְעָ֖ה אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: vytqbtsv bny bnymn 'chry 'bnr vyhyv l'gdh 'cht vy'mdv 'l r'sh gb'h 'cht
verses.translation: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אַבְנֵ֜ר אֶל יוֹאָ֗ב וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הֲ/לָ/נֶ֨צַח֙ תֹּ֣אכַל חֶ֔רֶב הֲ/ל֣וֹא יָדַ֔עְתָּה כִּֽי מָרָ֥ה תִהְיֶ֖ה בָּ/אַחֲרוֹנָ֑ה וְ/עַד מָתַי֙ לֹֽא תֹאמַ֣ר לָ/עָ֔ם לָ/שׁ֖וּב מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֥י אֲחֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqr' 'bnr 'l yv'b vy'mr hlntsch t'khl chrb hlv' yd'th khy mrh thyh b'chrvnh v'd mty l' t'mr l'm lshvb m'chry 'chyhm
verses.translation: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֔ב חַ֚י הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֥י לוּלֵ֖א דִּבַּ֑רְתָּ כִּ֣י אָ֤ז מֵֽ/הַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ נַעֲלָ֣ה הָ/עָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֥י אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'b chy h'lhym khy lvl' dbrt khy 'z mhbqr n'lh h'm 'ysh m'chry 'chyv
verses.translation: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְקַ֤ע יוֹאָב֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַ/יַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא יִרְדְּפ֥וּ ע֖וֹד אַחֲרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹֽא יָסְפ֥וּ ע֖וֹד לְ/הִלָּחֵֽם
verses.translit: vytq' yv'b bshvpr vy'mdv khl h'm vl' yrdpv 'vd 'chry yshr'l vl' yspv 'vd lhlchm
verses.translation: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְנֵ֣ר וַֽ/אֲנָשָׁ֗י/ו הָֽלְכוּ֙ בָּֽ/עֲרָבָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל הַ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ כָּל הַ/בִּתְר֔וֹן וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ מַחֲנָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'bnr v'nshyv hlkhv b'rbh khl hlylh hhv' vy'brv 't hyrdn vylkhv khl hbtrvn vyb'v mchnym
verses.translation: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹאָ֗ב שָׁ֚ב מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֔ר וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֖ץ אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יִּפָּ֨קְד֜וּ מֵ/עַבְדֵ֥י דָוִ֛ד תִּשְׁעָֽה עָשָׂ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ וַ/עֲשָׂה אֵֽל
verses.translit: vyv'b shb m'chry 'bnr vyqbts 't khl h'm vypqdv m'bdy dvd tsh'h 'shr 'ysh v'shh 'l
verses.translation: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David’s servants nineteen men and Asahel.

verses.original: וְ/עַבְדֵ֣י דָוִ֗ד הִכּוּ֙ מִ/בִּנְיָמִ֔ן וּ/בְ/אַנְשֵׁ֖י אַבְנֵ֑ר שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֧וֹת וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֛ים אִ֖ישׁ מֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: v'bdy dvd hkhv mbnymn vb'nshy 'bnr shlsh m'vt vshshym 'ysh mtv
verses.translation: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner’s men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת עֲשָׂהאֵ֔ל וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/קֶ֣בֶר אָבִ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית לָ֑חֶם וַ/יֵּלְכ֣וּ כָל הַ/לַּ֗יְלָה יוֹאָב֙ וַֽ/אֲנָשָׁ֔י/ו וַ/יֵּאֹ֥ר לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/חֶבְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vysh'v 't 'shh'l vyqbrhv bqbr 'byv 'shr byt lchm vylkhv khl hlylh yv'b v'nshyv vy'r lhm bchbrvn
verses.translation: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Beth-lehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֤י הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ אֲרֻכָּ֔ה בֵּ֚ין בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֔וּל וּ/בֵ֖ין בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד וְ/דָוִד֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ וְ/חָזֵ֔ק וּ/בֵ֥ית שָׁא֖וּל הֹלְכִ֥ים וְ/דַלִּֽים
verses.translit: vthy hmlchmh 'rkhh byn byt sh'vl vbyn byt dvd vdvd hlkh vchzq vbyt sh'vl hlkhym vdlym
verses.translation: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

verses.original: ו/ילדו וַ/יִּוָּלְד֧וּ לְ/דָוִ֛ד בָּנִ֖ים בְּ/חֶבְר֑וֹן וַ/יְהִ֤י בְכוֹר/וֹ֙ אַמְנ֔וֹן לַ/אֲחִינֹ֖עַם הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִֽת
verses.translit: vyldv vyvldv ldvd bnym bchbrvn vyhy bkhvrv 'mnvn l'chyn'm hyzr''lt
verses.translation: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

verses.original: וּ/מִשְׁנֵ֣/הוּ כִלְאָ֔ב ל/אביגל לַ/אֲֽבִיגַ֕יִל אֵ֖שֶׁת נָבָ֣ל הַֽ/כַּרְמְלִ֑י וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁי֙ אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בֶּֽן מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ גְּשֽׁוּר
verses.translit: vmshnhv khl'b l'bygl l'bygyl 'sht nbl hkhrmly vhshlshy 'bshlvm bn m'khh bt tlmy mlkh gshvr
verses.translation: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
