verses.original: וְ/הָ/רְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֣ה בֶן חַגִּ֑ית וְ/הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֖י שְׁפַטְיָ֥ה בֶן אֲבִיטָֽל
verses.translit: vhrby'y 'dnyh bn chgyt vhchmyshy shptyh bn 'bytl
verses.translation: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֣י יִתְרְעָ֔ם לְ/עֶגְלָ֖ה אֵ֣שֶׁת דָּוִ֑ד אֵ֛לֶּה יֻלְּד֥וּ לְ/דָוִ֖ד בְּ/חֶבְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vhshshy ytr'm l'glh 'sht dvd 'lh yldv ldvd bchbrvn
verses.translation: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּֽ/הְיוֹת֙ הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֔וּל וּ/בֵ֖ין בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד וְ/אַבְנֵ֛ר הָיָ֥ה מִתְחַזֵּ֖ק בְּ/בֵ֥ית שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vyhy bhyvt hmlchmh byn byt sh'vl vbyn byt dvd v'bnr hyh mtchzq bbyt sh'vl
verses.translation: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/שָׁא֣וּל פִּלֶ֔גֶשׁ וּ/שְׁמָ֖/הּ רִצְפָּ֣ה בַת אַיָּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אַבְנֵ֔ר מַדּ֥וּעַ בָּ֖אתָה אֶל פִּילֶ֥גֶשׁ אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vlsh'vl plgsh vshmh rtsph bt 'yh vy'mr 'l 'bnr mdv' b'th 'l pylgsh 'by
verses.translation: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father’s concubine?

verses.original: וַ/יִּחַר֩ לְ/אַבְנֵ֨ר מְאֹ֜ד עַל דִּבְרֵ֣י אִֽישׁ בֹּ֗שֶׁת וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הֲ/רֹ֨אשׁ כֶּ֥לֶב אָנֹ֘כִי֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִֽ/יהוּדָה֒ הַ/יּ֨וֹם אֶֽעֱשֶׂה חֶ֜סֶד עִם בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֣וּל אָבִ֗י/ךָ אֶל אֶחָי/ו֙ וְ/אֶל מֵ֣רֵעֵ֔/הוּ וְ/לֹ֥א הִמְצִיתִ֖/ךָ בְּ/יַד דָּוִ֑ד וַ/תִּפְקֹ֥ד עָלַ֛/י עֲוֺ֥ן הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vychr l'bnr m'd 'l dbry 'ysh bsht vy'mr hr'sh khlb 'nkhy 'shr lyhvdh hyvm ''shh chsd 'm byt sh'vl 'bykh 'l 'chyv v'l mr'hv vl' hmtsytkh byd dvd vtpqd 'ly 'vn h'shh hyvm
verses.translation: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish-bosheth, and said, Am I a dog’s head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

verses.original: כֹּֽה יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לְ/אַבְנֵ֔ר וְ/כֹ֖ה יֹסִ֣יף ל֑/וֹ כִּ֗י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָה֙ לְ/דָוִ֔ד כִּֽי כֵ֖ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khh y'shh 'lhym l'bnr vkhh ysyf lv khy kh'shr nshb' yhvh ldvd khy khn ''shh lv
verses.translation: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;

verses.original: לְ/הַֽעֲבִ֥יר הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה מִ/בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֑וּל וּ/לְ/הָקִ֞ים אֶת כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֗ד עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה מִ/דָּ֖ן וְ/עַד בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע
verses.translit: lh'byr hmmlkhh mbyt sh'vl vlhqym 't khs' dvd 'l yshr'l v'l yhvdh mdn v'd b'r shb'
verses.translation: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beer-sheba.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יָכֹ֣ל ע֔וֹד לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב אֶת אַבְנֵ֖ר דָּבָ֑ר מִ/יִּרְאָת֖/וֹ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' ykhl 'vd lhshyb 't 'bnr dbr myr'tv 'tv
verses.translation: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ אַבְנֵ֨ר מַלְאָכִ֧ים אֶל דָּוִ֛ד תחת/ו תַּחְתָּ֥י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֖ר לְ/מִי אָ֑רֶץ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כָּרְתָ֤/ה בְרִֽיתְ/ךָ֙ אִתִּ֔/י וְ/הִנֵּה֙ יָדִ֣/י עִמָּ֔/ךְ לְ/הָסֵ֥ב אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshlch 'bnr ml'khym 'l dvd tchtv tchtyv l'mr lmy 'rts l'mr khrth brytkh 'ty vhnh ydy 'mkh lhsb 'lykh 't khl yshr'l
verses.translation: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also , Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ט֔וֹב אֲנִ֕י אֶכְרֹ֥ת אִתְּ/ךָ֖ בְּרִ֑ית אַ֣ךְ דָּבָ֣ר אֶחָ֡ד אָנֹכִי֩ שֹׁאֵ֨ל מֵ/אִתְּ/ךָ֤ לֵ/אמֹר֙ לֹא תִרְאֶ֣ה אֶת פָּנַ֔/י כִּ֣י אִם לִ/פְנֵ֣י הֱבִיאֲ/ךָ֗ אֵ֚ת מִיכַ֣ל בַּת שָׁא֔וּל בְּ/בֹאֲ/ךָ֖ לִ/רְא֥וֹת אֶת פָּנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr tvb 'ny 'khrt 'tkh bryt 'kh dbr 'chd 'nkhy sh'l m'tkh l'mr l' tr'h 't pny khy 'm lpny hby'kh 't mykhl bt sh'vl bb'kh lr'vt 't pny
verses.translation: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul’s daughter, when thou comest to see my face.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח דָּוִד֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל אִֽישׁ בֹּ֥שֶׁת בֶּן שָׁא֖וּל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר תְּנָ֤/ה אֶת אִשְׁתִּ/י֙ אֶת מִיכַ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ אֵרַ֣שְׂתִּי לִ֔/י בְּ/מֵאָ֖ה עָרְל֥וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd ml'khym 'l 'ysh bsht bn sh'vl l'mr tnh 't 'shty 't mykhl 'shr 'rshty ly bm'h 'rlvt plshtym
verses.translation: And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth Saul’s son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ אִ֣ישׁ בֹּ֔שֶׁת וַ/יִּקָּחֶ֖/הָ מֵ֣/עִֽם אִ֑ישׁ מֵ/עִ֖ם פַּלְטִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן לוש לָֽיִשׁ
verses.translit: vyshlch 'ysh bsht vyqchh m'm 'ysh m'm plty'l bn lvsh lysh
verses.translation: And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ אִתָּ֜/הּ אִישָׁ֗/הּ הָל֧וֹךְ וּ/בָכֹ֛ה אַחֲרֶ֖י/הָ עַד בַּֽחֻרִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֥י/ו אַבְנֵ֛ר לֵ֥ךְ שׁ֖וּב וַ/יָּשֹֽׁב
verses.translit: vylkh 'th 'yshh hlvkh vbkhh 'chryh 'd bchrym vy'mr 'lyv 'bnr lkh shvb vyshb
verses.translation: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.

verses.original: וּ/דְבַר אַבְנֵ֣ר הָיָ֔ה עִם זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר גַּם תְּמוֹל֙ גַּם שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם הֱיִיתֶ֞ם מְבַקְשִׁ֧ים אֶת דָּוִ֛ד לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vdbr 'bnr hyh 'm zqny yshr'l l'mr gm tmvl gm shlshm hyytm mbqshym 't dvd lmlkh 'lykhm
verses.translation: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה עֲשׂ֑וּ כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֤ר אֶל דָּוִד֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בְּ/יַ֣ד דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֗/י הוֹשִׁ֜יעַ אֶת עַמִּ֤/י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּ/מִ/יַּ֖ד כָּל אֹיְבֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th 'shv khy yhvh 'mr 'l dvd l'mr byd dvd 'bdy hvshy' 't 'my yshr'l myd plshtym vmyd khl 'ybyhm
verses.translation: Now then do it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר גַּם אַבְנֵ֖ר בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ין וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ גַּם אַבְנֵ֗ר לְ/דַבֵּ֞ר בְּ/אָזְנֵ֤י דָוִד֙ בְּ/חֶבְר֔וֹן אֵ֤ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר טוֹב֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל בֵּ֥ית בִּנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: vydbr gm 'bnr b'zny bnymyn vylkh gm 'bnr ldbr b'zny dvd bchbrvn 't khl 'shr tvb b'yny yshr'l vb'yny khl byt bnymn
verses.translation: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א אַבְנֵ֤ר אֶל דָּוִד֙ חֶבְר֔וֹן וְ/אִתּ֖/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ דָּוִ֧ד לְ/אַבְנֵ֛ר וְ/לַ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֖/וֹ מִשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyb' 'bnr 'l dvd chbrvn v'tv 'shrym 'nshym vy'sh dvd l'bnr vl'nshym 'shr 'tv mshth
verses.translation: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְנֵ֣ר אֶל דָּוִ֡ד אָק֣וּמָה וְֽ/אֵלֵ֡כָה וְ/אֶקְבְּצָה֩ אֶל אֲדֹנִ֨/י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/יִכְרְת֤וּ אִתְּ/ךָ֙ בְּרִ֔ית וּ/מָ֣לַכְתָּ֔ בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר תְּאַוֶּ֖ה נַפְשֶׁ֑/ךָ וַ/יְּשַׁלַּ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת אַבְנֵ֖ר וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bnr 'l dvd 'qvmh v'lkhh v'qbtsh 'l 'dny hmlkh 't khl yshr'l vykhrtv 'tkh bryt vmlkht bkhl 'shr t'vh npshkh vyshlch dvd 't 'bnr vylkh bshlvm
verses.translation: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֩ עַבְדֵ֨י דָוִ֤ד וְ/יוֹאָב֙ בָּ֣א מֵֽ/הַ/גְּד֔וּד וְ/שָׁלָ֥ל רָ֖ב עִמָּ֣/ם הֵבִ֑יאוּ וְ/אַבְנֵ֗ר אֵינֶ֤/נּוּ עִם דָּוִד֙ בְּ/חֶבְר֔וֹן כִּ֥י שִׁלְּח֖/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vhnh 'bdy dvd vyv'b b' mhgdvd vshll rb 'mm hby'v v'bnr 'ynnv 'm dvd bchbrvn khy shlchv vylkh bshlvm
verses.translation: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹאָ֛ב וְ/כָל הַ/צָּבָ֥א אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֖/וֹ בָּ֑אוּ וַ/יַּגִּ֤דוּ לְ/יוֹאָב֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בָּֽא אַבְנֵ֤ר בֶּן נֵר֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֖/הוּ וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyv'b vkhl htsb' 'shr 'tv b'v vygdv lyv'b l'mr b' 'bnr bn nr 'l hmlkh vyshlchhv vylkh bshlvm
verses.translation: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א יוֹאָב֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָה הִנֵּה בָ֤א אַבְנֵר֙ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ לָ/מָּה זֶּ֥ה שִׁלַּחְתּ֖/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ הָלֽוֹךְ
verses.translit: vyb' yv'b 'l hmlkh vy'mr mh 'shyth hnh b' 'bnr 'lykh lmh zh shlchtv vylkh hlvkh
verses.translation: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?

verses.original: יָדַ֨עְתָּ֙ אֶת אַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן נֵ֔ר כִּ֥י לְ/פַתֹּתְ/ךָ֖ בָּ֑א וְ/לָ/דַ֜עַת אֶת מוֹצָֽאֲ/ךָ֙ וְ/אֶת מבוא/ך מ֣וֹבָאֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לָ/דַ֕עַת אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: yd't 't 'bnr bn nr khy lpttkh b' vld't 't mvts'kh v't mbv'kh mvb'kh vld't 't khl 'shr 'th 'shh
verses.translation: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א יוֹאָב֙ מֵ/עִ֣ם דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֔ר וַ/יָּשִׁ֥בוּ אֹת֖/וֹ מִ/בּ֣וֹר הַסִּרָ֑ה וְ/דָוִ֖ד לֹ֥א יָדָֽע
verses.translit: vyts' yv'b m'm dvd vyshlch ml'khym 'chry 'bnr vyshbv 'tv mbvr hsrh vdvd l' yd'
verses.translation: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב אַבְנֵר֙ חֶבְר֔וֹן וַ/יַּטֵּ֤/הוּ יוֹאָב֙ אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר לְ/דַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ בַּ/שֶּׁ֑לִי וַ/יַּכֵּ֤/הוּ שָׁם֙ הַ/חֹ֔מֶשׁ וַ/יָּ֕מָת בְּ/דַ֖ם עֲשָׂה אֵ֥ל אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshb 'bnr chbrvn vythv yv'b 'l tvkh hsh'r ldbr 'tv bshly vykhhv shm hchmsh vymt bdm 'shh 'l 'chyv
verses.translation: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib , that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע דָּוִד֙ מֵ/אַ֣חֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר נָקִ֨י אָנֹכִ֧י וּ/מַמְלַכְתִּ֛/י מֵ/עִ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַד עוֹלָ֑ם מִ/דְּמֵ֖י אַבְנֵ֥ר בֶּן נֵֽר
verses.translit: vyshm' dvd m'chry khn vy'mr nqy 'nkhy vmmlkhty m'm yhvh 'd 'vlm mdmy 'bnr bn nr
verses.translation: And afterward when David heard it , he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:

verses.original: יָחֻ֨לוּ֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ יוֹאָ֔ב וְ/אֶ֖ל כָּל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י/ו וְֽ/אַל יִכָּרֵ֣ת מִ/בֵּ֣ית יוֹאָ֡ב זָ֠ב וּ/מְצֹרָ֞ע וּ/מַחֲזִ֥יק בַּ/פֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/נֹפֵ֥ל בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב וַ/חֲסַר לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: ychlv 'l r'sh yv'b v'l khl byt 'byv v'l ykhrt mbyt yv'b zb vmtsr' vmchzyq bplkh vnpl bchrb vchsr lchm
verses.translation: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹאָב֙ וַ/אֲבִישַׁ֣י אָחִ֔י/ו הָרְג֖וּ לְ/אַבְנֵ֑ר עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵמִ֜ית אֶת עֲשָׂהאֵ֧ל אֲחִי/הֶ֛ם בְּ/גִבְע֖וֹן בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyv'b v'byshy 'chyv hrgv l'bnr 'l 'shr hmyt 't 'shh'l 'chyhm bgb'vn bmlchmh
verses.translation: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶל יוֹאָ֜ב וְ/אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֗/וֹ קִרְע֤וּ בִגְדֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/חִגְר֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים וְ/סִפְד֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אַבְנֵ֑ר וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔ד הֹלֵ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַ/מִּטָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l yv'b v'l khl h'm 'shr 'tv qr'v bgdykhm vchgrv shqym vspdv lpny 'bnr vhmlkh dvd hlkh 'chry hmth
verses.translation: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֶת אַבְנֵ֖ר בְּ/חֶבְר֑וֹן וַ/יִשָּׂ֧א הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֶת קוֹל֗/וֹ וַ/יֵּבְךְּ֙ אֶל קֶ֣בֶר אַבְנֵ֔ר וַ/יִּבְכּ֖וּ כָּל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyqbrv 't 'bnr bchbrvn vysh' hmlkh 't qvlv vybkh 'l qbr 'bnr vybkhv khl h'm
verses.translation: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

verses.original: וַ/יְקֹנֵ֥ן הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶל אַבְנֵ֖ר וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הַ/כְּ/מ֥וֹת נָבָ֖ל יָמ֥וּת אַבְנֵֽר
verses.translit: vyqnn hmlkh 'l 'bnr vy'mr hkhmvt nbl ymvt 'bnr
verses.translation: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

verses.original: יָדֶ֣/ךָ לֹֽא אֲסֻר֗וֹת וְ/רַגְלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לֹא לִ/נְחֻשְׁתַּ֣יִם הֻגָּ֔שׁוּ כִּ/נְפ֛וֹל לִ/פְנֵ֥י בְנֵֽי עַוְלָ֖ה נָפָ֑לְתָּ וַ/יֹּסִ֥פוּ כָל הָ/עָ֖ם לִ/בְכּ֥וֹת עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: ydkh l' 'srvt vrglykh l' lnchshtym hgshv khnpvl lpny bny 'vlh nplt vyspv khl h'm lbkhvt 'lyv
verses.translation: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א כָל הָ/עָ֗ם לְ/הַבְר֧וֹת אֶת דָּוִ֛ד לֶ֖חֶם בְּ/ע֣וֹד הַ/יּ֑וֹם וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֨ע דָּוִ֜ד לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה לִּ֤/י אֱלֹהִים֙ וְ/כֹ֣ה יֹסִ֔יף כִּ֣י אִם לִ/פְנֵ֧י בֽוֹא הַ/שֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ אֶטְעַם לֶ֖חֶם א֥וֹ כָל מְאֽוּמָה
verses.translit: vyb' khl h'm lhbrvt 't dvd lchm b'vd hyvm vyshb' dvd l'mr khh y'shh ly 'lhym vkhh ysyf khy 'm lpny bv' hshmsh 't'm lchm 'v khl m'vmh
verses.translation: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֣ם הִכִּ֔ירוּ וַ/יִּיטַ֖ב בְּ/עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֑ם כְּ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י כָל הָ/עָ֖ם טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vkhl h'm hkhyrv vyytb b'ynyhm khkhl 'shr 'shh hmlkh b'yny khl h'm tvb
verses.translation: And all the people took notice of it , and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּדְע֧וּ כָל הָ/עָ֛ם וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א הָיְתָה֙ מֵֽ/הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לְ/הָמִ֖ית אֶת אַבְנֵ֥ר בֶּן נֵֽר
verses.translit: vyd'v khl h'm vkhl yshr'l byvm hhv' khy l' hyth mhmlkh lhmyt 't 'bnr bn nr
verses.translation: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל עֲבָדָ֑י/ו הֲ/ל֣וֹא תֵדְע֔וּ כִּי שַׂ֣ר וְ/גָד֗וֹל נָפַ֛ל הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l 'bdyv hlv' td'v khy shr vgdvl npl hyvm hzh byshr'l
verses.translation: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֨י הַ/יּ֥וֹם רַךְ֙ וּ/מָשׁ֣וּחַ מֶ֔לֶךְ וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָ/אֵ֛לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י צְרוּיָ֖ה קָשִׁ֣ים מִמֶּ֑/נִּי יְשַׁלֵּ֧ם יְהוָ֛ה לְ/עֹשֵׂ֥ה הָ/רָעָ֖ה כְּ/רָעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'nkhy hyvm rkh vmshvch mlkh vh'nshym h'lh bny tsrvyh qshym mmny yshlm yhvh l'shh hr'h khr'tv
verses.translation: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע בֶּן שָׁא֗וּל כִּ֣י מֵ֤ת אַבְנֵר֙ בְּ/חֶבְר֔וֹן וַ/יִּרְפּ֖וּ יָדָ֑י/ו וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִבְהָֽלוּ
verses.translit: vyshm' bn sh'vl khy mt 'bnr bchbrvn vyrpv ydyv vkhl yshr'l nbhlv
verses.translation: And when Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י אֲנָשִׁ֣ים שָׂרֵֽי גְדוּדִ֣ים הָי֪וּ בֶן שָׁא֟וּל שֵׁם֩ הָ/אֶחָ֨ד בַּֽעֲנָ֜ה וְ/שֵׁ֧ם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֣י רֵכָ֗ב בְּנֵ֛י רִמּ֥וֹן הַ/בְּאֶֽרֹתִ֖י מִ/בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן כִּ֚י גַּם בְּאֵר֔וֹת תֵּחָשֵׁ֖ב עַל בִּנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: vshny 'nshym shry gdvdym hyv bn sh'vl shm h'chd b'nh vshm hshny rkhb bny rmvn hb'rty mbny bnymn khy gm b'rvt tchshb 'l bnymn
verses.translation: And Saul’s son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְרְח֥וּ הַ/בְּאֵרֹתִ֖ים גִּתָּ֑יְמָ/ה וַֽ/יִּהְיוּ שָׁ֣ם גָּרִ֔ים עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vybrchv hb'rtym gtymh vyhyv shm grym 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)

verses.original: וְ/לִ/יהֽוֹנָתָן֙ בֶּן שָׁא֔וּל בֵּ֖ן נְכֵ֣ה רַגְלָ֑יִם בֶּן חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֣ים הָיָ֡ה בְּ/בֹ֣א שְׁמֻעַת֩ שָׁא֨וּל וִ/יהֽוֹנָתָ֜ן מִֽ/יִּזְרְעֶ֗אל וַ/תִּשָּׂאֵ֤/הוּ אֹֽמַנְתּ/וֹ֙ וַ/תָּנֹ֔ס וַ/יְהִ֞י בְּ/חָפְזָ֥/הּ לָ/נ֛וּס וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל וַ/יִּפָּסֵ֖חַ וּ/שְׁמ֥/וֹ מְפִיבֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vlyhvntn bn sh'vl bn nkhh rglym bn chmsh shnym hyh bb' shm't sh'vl vyhvntn myzr''l vtsh'hv 'mntv vtns vyhy bchpzh lnvs vypl vypsch vshmv mpybsht
verses.translation: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ בְּנֵֽי רִמּ֤וֹן הַ/בְּאֵֽרֹתִי֙ רֵכָ֣ב וּ/בַעֲנָ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ כְּ/חֹ֣ם הַ/יּ֔וֹם אֶל בֵּ֖ית אִ֣ישׁ בֹּ֑שֶׁת וְ/ה֣וּא שֹׁכֵ֔ב אֵ֖ת מִשְׁכַּ֥ב הַֽ/צָּהֳרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vylkhv bny rmvn hb'rty rkhb vb'nh vyb'v khchm hyvm 'l byt 'ysh bsht vhv' shkhb 't mshkhb htshrym
verses.translation: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish-bosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

verses.original: וְ֠/הֵנָּה בָּ֜אוּ עַד תּ֤וֹךְ הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ לֹקְחֵ֣י חִטִּ֔ים וַ/יַּכֻּ֖/הוּ אֶל הַ/חֹ֑מֶשׁ וְ/רֵכָ֛ב וּ/בַעֲנָ֥ה אָחִ֖י/ו נִמְלָֽטוּ
verses.translit: vhnh b'v 'd tvkh hbyt lqchy chtym vykhhv 'l hchmsh vrkhb vb'nh 'chyv nmltv
verses.translation: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ הַ/בַּ֗יִת וְ/הֽוּא שֹׁכֵ֤ב עַל מִטָּת/וֹ֙ בַּ/חֲדַ֣ר מִשְׁכָּב֔/וֹ וַ/יַּכֻּ֨/הוּ֙ וַ/יְמִתֻ֔/הוּ וַ/יָּסִ֖ירוּ אֶת רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וַ/יֵּֽלְכ֛וּ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הָ/עֲרָבָ֖ה כָּל הַ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vyb'v hbyt vhv' shkhb 'l mttv bchdr mshkhbv vykhhv vymthv vysyrv 't r'shv vyqchv 't r'shv vylkhv drkh h'rbh khl hlylh
verses.translation: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּבִאוּ אֶת רֹ֨אשׁ אִֽישׁ בֹּ֥שֶׁת אֶל דָּוִד֮ חֶבְרוֹן֒ וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הִנֵּֽה רֹ֣אשׁ אִֽישׁ בֹּ֗שֶׁת בֶּן שָׁאוּל֙ אֹֽיִבְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת נַפְשֶׁ֑/ךָ וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֠הוָה לַֽ/אדֹנִ֨/י הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ נְקָמוֹת֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה מִ/שָּׁא֖וּל וּ/מִ/זַּרְעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb'v 't r'sh 'ysh bsht 'l dvd chbrvn vy'mrv 'l hmlkh hnh r'sh 'ysh bsht bn sh'vl 'ybkh 'shr bqsh 't npshkh vytn yhvh l'dny hmlkh nqmvt hyvm hzh msh'vl vmzr'v
verses.translation: And they brought the head of Ish-bosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן דָּוִ֜ד אֶת רֵכָ֣ב וְ/אֶת בַּעֲנָ֣ה אָחִ֗י/ו בְּנֵ֛י רִמּ֥וֹן הַ/בְּאֵֽרֹתִ֖י וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֑ם חַי יְהוָ֕ה אֲשֶׁר פָּדָ֥ה אֶת נַפְשִׁ֖/י מִ/כָּל צָרָֽה
verses.translit: vy'n dvd 't rkhb v't b'nh 'chyv bny rmvn hb'rty vy'mr lhm chy yhvh 'shr pdh 't npshy mkhl tsrh
verses.translation: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ/מַּגִּיד֩ לִ֨/י לֵ/אמֹ֜ר הִנֵּה מֵ֣ת שָׁא֗וּל וְ/הֽוּא הָיָ֤ה כִ/מְבַשֵּׂר֙ בְּ/עֵינָ֔י/ו וָ/אֹחֲזָ֣/ה ב֔/וֹ וָ/אֶהְרְגֵ֖/הוּ בְּ/צִֽקְלָ֑ג אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/תִתִּ/י ל֖/וֹ בְּשֹׂרָֽה
verses.translit: khy hmgyd ly l'mr hnh mt sh'vl vhv' hyh khmbshr b'ynyv v'chzh bv v'hrghv btsqlg 'shr ltty lv bshrh
verses.translation: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:

verses.original: אַ֞ף כִּֽי אֲנָשִׁ֣ים רְשָׁעִ֗ים הָרְג֧וּ אֶת אִישׁ צַדִּ֛יק בְּ/בֵית֖/וֹ עַל מִשְׁכָּב֑/וֹ וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הֲ/ל֨וֹא אֲבַקֵּ֤שׁ אֶת דָּמ/וֹ֙ מִ/יֶּדְ/כֶ֔ם וּ/בִעַרְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'f khy 'nshym rsh'ym hrgv 't 'ysh tsdyq bbytv 'l mshkhbv v'th hlv' 'bqsh 't dmv mydkhm vb'rty 'tkhm mn h'rts
verses.translation: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?

verses.original: וַ/יְצַו֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶת הַ/נְּעָרִ֜ים וַ/יַּהַרְג֗וּ/ם וַֽ/יְקַצְּצ֤וּ אֶת יְדֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/אֶת רַגְלֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּתְל֥וּ עַל הַ/בְּרֵכָ֖ה בְּ/חֶבְר֑וֹן וְ/אֵ֨ת רֹ֤אשׁ אִֽישׁ בֹּ֨שֶׁת֙ לָקָ֔חוּ וַ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ בְ/קֶֽבֶר אַבְנֵ֖ר בְּ/חֶבְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vytsv dvd 't hn'rym vyhrgvm vyqtstsv 't ydyhm v't rglyhm vytlv 'l hbrkhh bchbrvn v't r'sh 'ysh bsht lqchv vyqbrv bqbr 'bnr bchbrvn
verses.translation: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ כָּל שִׁבְטֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל דָּוִ֖ד חֶבְר֑וֹנָ/ה וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנְ/נ֛וּ עַצְמְ/ךָ֥ וּֽ/בְשָׂרְ/ךָ֖ אֲנָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: vyb'v khl shbty yshr'l 'l dvd chbrvnh vy'mrv l'mr hnnv 'tsmkh vbshrkh 'nchnv
verses.translation: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

verses.original: גַּם אֶתְמ֣וֹל גַּם שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם בִּ/הְי֨וֹת שָׁא֥וּל מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עָלֵ֔י/נוּ אַתָּ֗ה הייתה הָיִ֛יתָ מוציא הַ/מּוֹצִ֥יא ו/ה/מבי וְ/הַ/מֵּבִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לְ/ךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת עַמִּ/י֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אַתָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְ/נָגִ֖יד עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: gm 'tmvl gm shlshvm bhyvt sh'vl mlkh 'lynv 'th hyyth hyyt mvtsy' hmvtsy' vhmby vhmby' 't yshr'l vy'mr yhvh lkh 'th tr'h 't 'my 't yshr'l v'th thyh lngyd 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּבֹאוּ כָּל זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָ/ה וַ/יִּכְרֹ֣ת לָ/הֶם֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֥ד בְּרִ֛ית בְּ/חֶבְר֖וֹן לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְשְׁח֧וּ אֶת דָּוִ֛ד לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyb'v khl zqny yshr'l 'l hmlkh chbrvnh vykhrt lhm hmlkh dvd bryt bchbrvn lpny yhvh vymshchv 't dvd lmlkh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD : and they anointed David king over Israel.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה דָּוִ֖ד בְּ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה מָלָֽךְ
verses.translit: bn shlshym shnh dvd bmlkhv 'rb'ym shnh mlkh
verses.translation: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

verses.original: בְּ/חֶבְרוֹן֙ מָלַ֣ךְ עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם מָלַ֗ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְ/שָׁלֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: bchbrvn mlkh 'l yhvdh shb' shnym vshshh chdshym vbyrvshlm mlkh shlshym vshlsh shnh 'l khl yshr'l vyhvdh
verses.translation: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ וַֽ/אֲנָשָׁי/ו֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֶל הַ/יְבֻסִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לְ/דָוִ֤ד לֵ/אמֹר֙ לֹא תָב֣וֹא הֵ֔נָּה כִּ֣י אִם הֱסִֽירְ/ךָ֗ הַ/עִוְרִ֤ים וְ/הַ/פִּסְחִים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹֽא יָב֥וֹא דָוִ֖ד הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: vylkh hmlkh v'nshyv yrvshlm 'l hybsy yvshb h'rts vy'mr ldvd l'mr l' tbv' hnh khy 'm hsyrkh h'vrym vhpschym l'mr l' ybv' dvd hnh
verses.translation: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֣ד דָּוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vylkhd dvd 't mtsdt tsyvn hy' 'yr dvd
verses.translation: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא כָּל מַכֵּ֤ה יְבֻסִי֙ וְ/יִגַּ֣ע בַּ/צִּנּ֔וֹר וְ/אֶת הַ/פִּסְחִים֙ וְ/אֶת הַ֣/עִוְרִ֔ים שנאו שְׂנֻאֵ֖י נֶ֣פֶשׁ דָּוִ֑ד עַל כֵּן֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ עִוֵּ֣ר וּ/פִסֵּ֔חַ לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd byvm hhv' khl mkhh ybsy vyg' btsnvr v't hpschym v't h'vrym shn'v shn'y npsh dvd 'l khn y'mrv 'vr vpsch l' ybv' 'l hbyt
verses.translation: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain . Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב דָּוִד֙ בַּ/מְּצֻדָ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרָא לָ֖/הּ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יִּ֤בֶן דָּוִד֙ סָבִ֔יב מִן הַ/מִּלּ֖וֹא וָ/בָֽיְתָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshb dvd bmtsdh vyqr' lh 'yr dvd vybn dvd sbyb mn hmlv' vbyth
verses.translation: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד הָל֣וֹךְ וְ/גָד֑וֹל וַ/יהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkh dvd hlvkh vgdvl vyhvh 'lhy tsb'vt 'mv
verses.translation: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּשְׁלַח חִירָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ צֹ֥ר מַלְאָכִים֮ אֶל דָּוִד֒ וַ/עֲצֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וְ/חָרָשֵׁ֣י עֵ֔ץ וְ/חָֽרָשֵׁ֖י אֶ֣בֶן קִ֑יר וַ/יִּבְנֽוּ בַ֖יִת לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: vyshlch chyrm mlkh tsr ml'khym 'l dvd v'tsy 'rzym vchrshy 'ts vchrshy 'bn qyr vybnv byt ldvd
verses.translation: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣דַע דָּוִ֔ד כִּֽי הֱכִינ֧/וֹ יְהוָ֛ה לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/כִי֙ נִשֵּׂ֣א מַמְלַכְתּ֔/וֹ בַּ/עֲב֖וּר עַמּ֥/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyd' dvd khy hkhynv yhvh lmlkh 'l yshr'l vkhy nsh' mmlkhtv b'bvr 'mv yshr'l
verses.translation: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ דָּוִ֨ד ע֜וֹד פִּֽלַגְשִׁ֤ים וְ/נָשִׁים֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י בֹּא֣/וֹ מֵ/חֶבְר֑וֹן וַ/יִּוָּ֥לְדּוּ ע֛וֹד לְ/דָוִ֖ד בָּנִ֥ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqch dvd 'vd plgshym vnshym myrvshlm 'chry b'v mchbrvn vyvldv 'vd ldvd bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמ֛וֹת הַ/יִּלֹּדִ֥ים ל֖/וֹ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְ/שׁוֹבָ֔ב וְ/נָתָ֖ן וּ/שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt hyldym lv byrvshlm shmv' vshvbb vntn vshlmh
verses.translation: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

verses.original: וְ/יִבְחָ֥ר וֶ/אֱלִישׁ֖וּעַ וְ/נֶ֥פֶג וְ/יָפִֽיעַ
verses.translit: vybchr v'lyshv' vnpg vypy'
verses.translation: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.original: וֶ/אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וְ/אֶלְיָדָ֖ע וֶ/אֱלִיפָֽלֶט
verses.translit: v'lyshm' v'lyd' v'lyplt
verses.translation: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּי מָשְׁח֨וּ אֶת דָּוִ֤ד לְ/מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ כָל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְ/בַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יֵּ֖רֶד אֶל הַ/מְּצוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm'v plshtym khy mshchv 't dvd lmlkh 'l yshr'l vy'lv khl plshtym lbqsh 't dvd vyshm' dvd vyrd 'l hmtsvdh
verses.translation: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold.

verses.original: וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַ/יִּנָּטְשׁ֖וּ בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים
verses.translit: vplshtym b'v vyntshv b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤ד בַּֽ/יהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַ/אֶֽעֱלֶה֙ אֶל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הֲ/תִתְּנֵ֖/ם בְּ/יָדִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל דָּוִד֙ עֲלֵ֔ה כִּֽי נָתֹ֥ן אֶתֵּ֛ן אֶת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בְּ/יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vysh'l dvd byhvh l'mr h''lh 'l plshtym httnm bydy vy'mr yhvh 'l dvd 'lh khy ntn 'tn 't hplshtym bydkh
verses.translation: And David enquired of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א דָוִ֥ד בְּ/בַֽעַל פְּרָצִים֮ וַ/יַּכֵּ֣/ם שָׁ֣ם דָּוִד֒ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר פָּרַ֨ץ יְהוָ֧ה אֶת אֹיְבַ֛/י לְ/פָנַ֖/י כְּ/פֶ֣רֶץ מָ֑יִם עַל כֵּ֗ן קָרָ֛א שֵֽׁם הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא בַּ֥עַל פְּרָצִֽים
verses.translit: vyb' dvd bb'l prtsym vykhm shm dvd vy'mr prts yhvh 't 'yby lpny khprts mym 'l khn qr' shm hmqvm hhv' b'l prtsym
verses.translation: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַזְבוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת עֲצַבֵּי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּשָּׂאֵ֥/ם דָּוִ֖ד וַ/אֲנָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vy'zbv shm 't 'tsbyhm vysh'm dvd v'nshyv
verses.translation: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּסִ֥פוּ ע֛וֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לַֽ/עֲל֑וֹת וַ/יִּנָּֽטְשׁ֖וּ בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים
verses.translit: vyspv 'vd plshtym l'lvt vyntshv b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֤ל דָּוִד֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א תַעֲלֶ֑ה הָסֵב֙ אֶל אַ֣חֲרֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בָ֥אתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם מִ/מּ֥וּל בְּכָאִֽים
verses.translit: vysh'l dvd byhvh vy'mr l' t'lh hsb 'l 'chryhm vb't lhm mmvl bkh'ym
verses.translation: And when David enquired of the LORD , he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

verses.original: וִ֠/יהִי ב/שמע/ך כְּֽ/שָׁמְעֲ/ךָ֞ אֶת ק֧וֹל צְעָדָ֛ה בְּ/רָאשֵׁ֥י הַ/בְּכָאִ֖ים אָ֣ז תֶּחֱרָ֑ץ כִּ֣י אָ֗ז יָצָ֤א יְהוָה֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/הַכּ֖וֹת בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyhy bshm'kh khshm'kh 't qvl ts'dh br'shy hbkh'ym 'z tchrts khy 'z yts' yhvh lpnykh lhkhvt bmchnh plshtym
verses.translation: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ דָּוִד֙ כֵּ֔ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖/הוּ יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּךְ֙ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִ/גֶּ֖בַע עַד בֹּאֲ/ךָ֥ גָֽזֶר
verses.translit: vy'sh dvd khn kh'shr tsvhv yhvh vykh 't plshtym mgb' 'd b'kh gzr
verses.translation: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨סֶף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛ד אֶת כָּל בָּח֥וּר בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vysf 'vd dvd 't khl bchvr byshr'l shlshym 'lf
verses.translation: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ מִֽ/בַּעֲלֵ֖י יְהוּדָ֑ה לְ/הַעֲל֣וֹת מִ/שָּׁ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָ֣א שֵׁ֗ם שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יֹשֵׁ֥ב הַ/כְּרֻבִ֖ים עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqm vylkh dvd vkhl h'm 'shr 'tv mb'ly yhvdh lh'lvt mshm 't 'rvn h'lhym 'shr nqr' shm shm yhvh tsb'vt yshb hkhrbym 'lyv
verses.translation: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims. of hosts, was called upon

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְכִּ֜בוּ אֶת אֲר֤וֹן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל עֲגָלָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וַ/יִּשָּׂאֻ֔/הוּ מִ/בֵּ֥ית אֲבִינָדָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/גִּבְעָ֑ה וְ/עֻזָּ֣א וְ/אַחְי֗וֹ בְּנֵי֙ אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב נֹהֲגִ֖ים אֶת הָ/עֲגָלָ֥ה חֲדָשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vyrkhbv 't 'rvn h'lhym 'l 'glh chdshh vysh'hv mbyt 'byndb 'shr bgb'h v'z' v'chyv bny 'byndb nhgym 't h'glh chdshh
verses.translation: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂאֻ֗/הוּ מִ/בֵּ֤ית אֲבִֽינָדָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/גִּבְעָ֔ה עִ֖ם אֲר֣וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/אַחְי֕וֹ הֹלֵ֖ךְ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/אָרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vysh'hv mbyt 'byndb 'shr bgb'h 'm 'rvn h'lhym v'chyv hlkh lpny h'rvn
verses.translation: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֣ד וְ/כָל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַֽׂחֲקִים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/כֹ֖ל עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים וּ/בְ/כִנֹּר֤וֹת וּ/בִ/נְבָלִים֙ וּ/בְ/תֻפִּ֔ים וּ/בִ/מְנַֽעַנְעִ֖ים וּֽ/בְ/צֶלְצֶלִֽים
verses.translit: vdvd vkhl byt yshr'l mshchqym lpny yhvh bkhl 'tsy brvshym vbkhnrvt vbnblym vbtpym vbmn'n'ym vbtsltslym
verses.translation: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד גֹּ֣רֶן נָכ֑וֹן וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶל אֲר֤וֹן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אחֶז בּ֔/וֹ כִּ֥י שָׁמְט֖וּ הַ/בָּקָֽר
verses.translit: vyb'v 'd grn nkhvn vyshlch 'z' 'l 'rvn h'lhym vy'chz bv khy shmtv hbqr
verses.translation: And when they came to Nachon’s threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it .

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּ/עֻזָּ֔ה וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/הוּ שָׁ֛ם הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל הַ/שַּׁ֑ל וַ/יָּ֣מָת שָׁ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh b'zh vykhhv shm h'lhym 'l hshl vymt shm 'm 'rvn h'lhym
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣חַר לְ/דָוִ֔ד עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּרַ֧ץ יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּ/עֻזָּ֑ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֞א לַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vychr ldvd 'l 'shr prts yhvh prts b'zh vyqr' lmqvm hhv' prts 'zh 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perez-uzzah to this day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרָ֥א דָוִ֛ד אֶת יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אֵ֛יךְ יָב֥וֹא אֵלַ֖/י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyr' dvd 't yhvh byvm hhv' vy'mr 'ykh ybv' 'ly 'rvn yhvh
verses.translation: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא אָבָ֣ה דָוִ֗ד לְ/הָסִ֥יר אֵלָ֛י/ו אֶת אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה עַל עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יַּטֵּ֣/הוּ דָוִ֔ד בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד אֱד֖וֹם הַ/גִּתִּֽי
verses.translit: vl' 'bh dvd lhsyr 'lyv 't 'rvn yhvh 'l 'yr dvd vythv dvd byt 'bd 'dvm hgty
verses.translation: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה בֵּ֣ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם הַ/גִּתִּ֖י שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם וְ/אֶת כָּל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshb 'rvn yhvh byt 'bd 'dm hgty shlshh chdshym vybrkh yhvh 't 'bd 'dm v't khl bytv
verses.translation: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obed-edom, and all his household.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֗ד לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ בֵּרַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה אֶת בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ בַּ/עֲב֖וּר אֲר֣וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וַ/יַּעַל֩ אֶת אֲר֨וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִ/בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם עִ֥יר דָּוִ֖ד בְּ/שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: vygd lmlkh dvd l'mr brkh yhvh 't byt 'bd 'dm v't khl 'shr lv b'bvr 'rvn h'lhym vylkh dvd vy'l 't 'rvn h'lhym mbyt 'bd 'dm 'yr dvd bshmchh
verses.translation: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the city of David with gladness.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּ֧י צָעֲד֛וּ נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרוֹן יְהוָ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֣ה צְעָדִ֑ים וַ/יִּזְבַּ֥ח שׁ֖וֹר וּ/מְרִֽיא
verses.translit: vyhy khy ts'dv nsh'y 'rvn yhvh shshh ts'dym vyzbch shvr vmry'
verses.translation: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֛ד מְכַרְכֵּ֥ר בְּ/כָל עֹ֖ז לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/דָוִ֕ד חָג֖וּר אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד
verses.translit: vdvd mkhrkhr bkhl 'z lpny yhvh vdvd chgvr 'pvd bd
verses.translation: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִד֙ וְ/כָל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַעֲלִ֖ים אֶת אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה בִּ/תְרוּעָ֖ה וּ/בְ/ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר
verses.translit: vdvd vkhl byt yshr'l m'lym 't 'rvn yhvh btrv'h vbqvl shvpr
verses.translation: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה בָּ֖א עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וּ/מִיכַ֨ל בַּת שָׁא֜וּל נִשְׁקְפָ֣ה בְּעַ֣ד הַ/חַלּ֗וֹן וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא אֶת הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ מְפַזֵּ֤ז וּ/מְכַרְכֵּר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תִּ֥בֶז ל֖/וֹ בְּ/לִבָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhyh 'rvn yhvh b' 'yr dvd vmykhl bt sh'vl nshqph b'd hchlvn vtr' 't hmlkh dvd mpzz vmkhrkhr lpny yhvh vtbz lv blbh
verses.translation: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul’s daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD ; and she despised him in her heart.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֜אוּ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יַּצִּ֤גוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ בִּ/מְקוֹמ֔/וֹ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/אֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָטָה ל֖/וֹ דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יַּ֨עַל דָּוִ֥ד עֹל֛וֹת לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וּ/שְׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyb'v 't 'rvn yhvh vytsgv 'tv bmqvmv btvkh h'hl 'shr nth lv dvd vy'l dvd 'lvt lpny yhvh vshlmym
verses.translation: And they brought in the ark of the LORD , and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔ד מֵ/הַעֲל֥וֹת הָ/עוֹלָ֖ה וְ/הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַ/יְבָ֣רֶךְ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם בְּ/שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vykhl dvd mh'lvt h'vlh vhshlmym vybrkh 't h'm bshm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַלֵּ֨ק לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֜ם לְ/כָל הֲמ֣וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְ/מֵ/אִ֣ישׁ וְ/עַד אִשָּׁה֒ לְ/אִ֗ישׁ חַלַּ֥ת לֶ֨חֶם֙ אַחַ֔ת וְ/אֶשְׁפָּ֣ר אֶחָ֔ד וַ/אֲשִׁישָׁ֖ה אֶחָ֑ת וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ לְ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychlq lkhl h'm lkhl hmvn yshr'l lm'ysh v'd 'shh l'ysh chlt lchm 'cht v'shpr 'chd v'shyshh 'cht vylkh khl h'm 'ysh lbytv
verses.translation: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine . So all the people departed every one to his house.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שָׁב דָּוִ֖ד לְ/בָרֵ֣ךְ אֶת בֵּית֑/וֹ וַ/תֵּצֵ֞א מִיכַ֤ל בַּת שָׁאוּל֙ לִ/קְרַ֣את דָּוִ֔ד וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר מַה נִּכְבַּ֨ד הַ/יּ֜וֹם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִגְלָ֤ה הַ/יּוֹם֙ לְ/עֵינֵ֨י אַמְה֣וֹת עֲבָדָ֔י/ו כְּ/הִגָּל֥וֹת נִגְל֖וֹת אַחַ֥ד הָ/רֵקִֽים
verses.translit: vyshb dvd lbrkh 't bytv vtts' mykhl bt sh'vl lqr't dvd vt'mr mh nkhbd hyvm mlkh yshr'l 'shr nglh hyvm l'yny 'mhvt 'bdyv khhglvt nglvt 'chd hrqym
verses.translation: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִד֮ אֶל מִיכַל֒ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּֽחַר בִּ֤/י מֵֽ/אָבִי/ךְ֙ וּ/מִ/כָּל בֵּית֔/וֹ לְ/צַוֺּ֨ת אֹתִ֥/י נָגִ֛יד עַל עַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/שִׂחַקְתִּ֖י לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l mykhl lpny yhvh 'shr bchr by m'bykh vmkhl bytv ltsvt 'ty ngyd 'l 'm yhvh 'l yshr'l vshchqty lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD , which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD , over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/נְקַלֹּ֤תִי עוֹד֙ מִ/זֹּ֔את וְ/הָיִ֥יתִי שָׁפָ֖ל בְּ/עֵינָ֑/י וְ/עִם הָֽ/אֲמָהוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתְּ עִמָּ֖/ם אִכָּבֵֽדָה
verses.translit: vnqlty 'vd mz't vhyyty shpl b'yny v'm h'mhvt 'shr 'mrt 'mm 'khbdh
verses.translation: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מִיכַל֙ בַּת שָׁא֔וּל לֹֽא הָ֥יָה לָ֖/הּ יָ֑לֶד עַ֖ד י֥וֹם מוֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vlmykhl bt sh'vl l' hyh lh yld 'd yvm mvth
verses.translation: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כִּי יָשַׁ֥ב הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/בֵית֑/וֹ וַ/יהוָ֛ה הֵנִֽיחַ ל֥/וֹ מִ/סָּבִ֖יב מִ/כָּל אֹיְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy khy yshb hmlkh bbytv vyhvh hnych lv msbyb mkhl 'ybyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֔יא רְאֵ֣ה נָ֔א אָנֹכִ֥י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/בֵ֣ית אֲרָזִ֑ים וַֽ/אֲרוֹן֙ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים יֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/יְרִיעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l ntn hnby' r'h n' 'nkhy yvshb bbyt 'rzym v'rvn h'lhym yshb btvkh hyry'h
verses.translation: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר נָתָן֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ לֵ֣ךְ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr ntn 'l hmlkh khl 'shr blbbkh lkh 'shh khy yhvh 'mkh
verses.translation: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/ה֑וּא וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל נָתָ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy blylh hhv' vyhy dbr yhvh 'l ntn l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,

verses.original: לֵ֤ךְ וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ אֶל עַבְדִּ֣/י אֶל דָּוִ֔ד כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הַ/אַתָּ֛ה תִּבְנֶה לִּ֥/י בַ֖יִת לְ/שִׁבְתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: lkh v'mrt 'l 'bdy 'l dvd khh 'mr yhvh h'th tbnh ly byt lshbty
verses.translation: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD , Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֨בְתִּי֙ בְּ/בַ֔יִת לְ֠/מִ/יּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִ֞/י אֶת בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וְ/עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וָ/אֶֽהְיֶה֙ מִתְהַלֵּ֔ךְ בְּ/אֹ֖הֶל וּ/בְ/מִשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: khy l' yshbty bbyt lmyvm h'lty 't bny yshr'l mmtsrym v'd hyvm hzh v'hyh mthlkh b'hl vbmshkhn
verses.translation: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

verses.original: בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֮ בְּ/כָל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ הֲ/דָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת אַחַד֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֗יתִי לִ/רְע֛וֹת אֶת עַמִּ֥/י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לָ֛/מָּה לֹֽא בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖/י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים
verses.translit: bkhl 'shr hthlkhty bkhl bny yshr'l hdbr dbrty 't 'chd shbty yshr'l 'shr tsvyty lr'vt 't 'my 't yshr'l l'mr lmh l' bnytm ly byt 'rzym
verses.translation: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?

verses.original: וְ֠/עַתָּה כֹּֽה תֹאמַ֞ר לְ/עַבְדִּ֣/י לְ/דָוִ֗ד כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ מִן הַ/נָּוֶ֔ה מֵ/אַחַ֖ר הַ/צֹּ֑אן לִֽ/הְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַל עַמִּ֖/י עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'th khh t'mr l'bdy ldvd khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'ny lqchtykh mn hnvh m'chr hts'n lhyvt ngyd 'l 'my 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:

verses.original: וָ/אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּ/ךָ֗ בְּ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ וָ/אַכְרִ֥תָ/ה אֶת כָּל אֹיְבֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/פָּנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/עָשִׂ֤תִֽי לְ/ךָ֙ שֵׁ֣ם גָּד֔וֹל כְּ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/גְּדֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'hyh 'mkh bkhl 'shr hlkht v'khrth 't khl 'ybykh mpnykh v'shty lkh shm gdvl khshm hgdlym 'shr b'rts
verses.translation: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְ/עַמִּ֨/י לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּ/נְטַעְתִּי/ו֙ וְ/שָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד וְ/לֹֽא יֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵֽי עַוְלָה֙ לְ/עַנּוֹת֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּ/רִאשׁוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vshmty mqvm l'my lyshr'l vnt'tyv vshkhn tchtyv vl' yrgz 'vd vl' ysypv bny 'vlh l'nvtv kh'shr br'shvnh
verses.translation: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מִן הַ/יּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/הֲנִיחֹ֥תִי לְ/ךָ֖ מִ/כָּל אֹיְבֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הִגִּ֤יד לְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּי בַ֖יִת יַעֲשֶׂה לְּ/ךָ֥ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlmn hyvm 'shr tsvyty shptym 'l 'my yshr'l vhnychty lkh mkhl 'ybykh vhgyd lkh yhvh khy byt y'shh lkh yhvh
verses.translation: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יִמְלְא֣וּ יָמֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/שָֽׁכַבְתָּ֙ אֶת אֲבֹתֶ֔י/ךָ וַ/הֲקִימֹתִ֤י אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֙ אַחֲרֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵצֵ֖א מִ/מֵּעֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/הֲכִינֹתִ֖י אֶת מַמְלַכְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy yml'v ymykh vshkhbt 't 'btykh vhqymty 't zr'kh 'chrykh 'shr yts' mm'ykh vhkhynty 't mmlkhtv
verses.translation: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.original: ה֥וּא יִבְנֶה בַּ֖יִת לִ/שְׁמִ֑/י וְ/כֹנַנְתִּ֛י אֶת כִּסֵּ֥א מַמְלַכְתּ֖/וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: hv' ybnh byt lshmy vkhnnty 't khs' mmlkhtv 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶה לּ֣/וֹ לְ/אָ֔ב וְ/ה֖וּא יִהְיֶה לִּ֣/י לְ/בֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/הַ֣עֲוֺת֔/וֹ וְ/הֹֽכַחְתִּי/ו֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣בֶט אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וּ/בְ/נִגְעֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: 'ny 'hyh lv l'b vhv' yhyh ly lbn 'shr bh'vtv vhkhchtyv bshbt 'nshym vbng'y bny 'dm
verses.translation: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:

verses.original: וְ/חַסְדִּ֖/י לֹא יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֲסִרֹ֨תִי֙ מֵ/עִ֣ם שָׁא֔וּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲסִרֹ֖תִי מִ/לְּ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vchsdy l' ysvr mmnv kh'shr hsrty m'm sh'vl 'shr hsrty mlpnykh
verses.translation: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

verses.original: וְ/נֶאְמַ֨ן בֵּיתְ/ךָ֧ וּ/מַֽמְלַכְתְּ/ךָ֛ עַד עוֹלָ֖ם לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ כִּֽסְאֲ/ךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vn'mn bytkh vmmlkhtkh 'd 'vlm lpnykh khs'kh yhyh nkhvn 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

verses.original: כְּ/כֹל֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וּ/כְ/כֹ֖ל הַ/חִזָּי֣וֹן הַ/זֶּ֑ה כֵּ֛ן דִּבֶּ֥ר נָתָ֖ן אֶל דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: khkhl hdbrym h'lh vkhkhl hchzyvn hzh khn dbr ntn 'l dvd
verses.translation: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מִ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ וּ/מִ֣י בֵיתִ֔/י כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖/נִי עַד הֲלֹֽם
verses.translit: vyb' hmlkh dvd vyshb lpny yhvh vy'mr my 'nkhy 'dny yhvh vmy byty khy hby'tny 'd hlm
verses.translation: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD , and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD ? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְטַן֩ ע֨וֹד זֹ֤את בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֛ר גַּ֥ם אֶל בֵּֽית עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/מֵֽ/רָח֑וֹק וְ/זֹ֛את תּוֹרַ֥ת הָ/אָדָ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vtqtn 'vd z't b'ynykh 'dny yhvh vtdbr gm 'l byt 'bdkh lmrchvq vz't tvrt h'dm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD ; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant’s house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord GOD ?

verses.original: וּ/מַה יּוֹסִ֥יף דָּוִ֛ד ע֖וֹד לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/אַתָּ֛ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ אֶֽת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: vmh yvsyf dvd 'vd ldbr 'lykh v'th yd't 't 'bdkh 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD , knowest thy servant.

verses.original: בַּ/עֲב֤וּר דְּבָֽרְ/ךָ֙ וּֽ/כְ/לִבְּ/ךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/גְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את לְ/הוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: b'bvr dbrkh vkhlbkh 'shyt 't khl hgdvlh hz't lhvdy' 't 'bdkh
verses.translation: For thy word’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them .

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֥ן גָּדַ֖לְתָּ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה כִּֽי אֵ֣ין כָּמ֗וֹ/ךָ וְ/אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהִים֙ זֽוּלָתֶ֔/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּ/אָזְנֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: 'l khn gdlt 'dny yhvh khy 'yn khmvkh v'yn 'lhym zvltkh bkhl 'shr shm'nv b'znynv
verses.translation: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.original: וּ/מִ֤י כְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֙ כְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלְכֽוּ אֱ֠לֹהִים לִ/פְדּֽוֹת ל֨/וֹ לְ/עָ֜ם וְ/לָ/שׂ֧וּם ל֣/וֹ שֵׁ֗ם וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֨וֹת לָ/כֶ֜ם הַ/גְּדוּלָּ֤ה וְ/נֹֽרָאוֹת֙ לְ/אַרְצֶ֔/ךָ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י עַמְּ/ךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּדִ֤יתָ לְּ/ךָ֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם גּוֹיִ֖ם וֵ/אלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmy kh'mkh khyshr'l gvy 'chd b'rts 'shr hlkhv 'lhym lpdvt lv l'm vlshvm lv shm vl'shvt lkhm hgdvlh vnr'vt l'rtskh mpny 'mkh 'shr pdyt lkh mmtsrym gvym v'lhyv
verses.translation: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

verses.original: וַ/תְּכ֣וֹנֵֽן לְ֠/ךָ אֶת עַמְּ/ךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לְ/ךָ֛ לְ/עָ֖ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vtkhvnn lkh 't 'mkh yshr'l lkh l'm 'd 'vlm v'th yhvh hyyt lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD , art become their God.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/עַל בֵּית֔/וֹ הָקֵ֖ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וַ/עֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhym hdbr 'shr dbrt 'l 'bdkh v'l bytv hqm 'd 'vlm v'shh kh'shr dbrt
verses.translation: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.

verses.original: וְ/יִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְ/ךָ֤ עַד עוֹלָם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/בֵית֙ עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ דָוִ֔ד יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vygdl shmkh 'd 'vlm l'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhym 'l yshr'l vbyt 'bdkh dvd yhyh nkhvn lpnykh
verses.translation: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּה֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּלִ֜יתָה אֶת אֹ֤זֶן עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בַּ֖יִת אֶבְנֶה לָּ֑/ךְ עַל כֵּ֗ן מָצָ֤א עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ אֶת לִבּ֔/וֹ לְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ אֶת הַ/תְּפִלָּ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khy 'th yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l glyth 't 'zn 'bdkh l'mr byt 'bnh lkh 'l khn mts' 'bdkh 't lbv lhtpll 'lykh 't htplh hz't
verses.translation: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה אַתָּה הוּא֙ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּ/דְבָרֶ֖י/ךָ יִהְי֣וּ אֱמֶ֑ת וַ/תְּדַבֵּר֙ אֶֽל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ אֶת הַ/טּוֹבָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: v'th 'dny yhvh 'th hv' h'lhym vdbrykh yhyv 'mt vtdbr 'l 'bdkh 't htvbh hz't
verses.translation: And now, O Lord GOD , thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הוֹאֵל֙ וּ/בָרֵךְ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ לִ/הְי֥וֹת לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ כִּֽי אַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ וּ/מִ/בִּרְכָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ יְבֹרַ֥ךְ בֵּֽית עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'th hv'l vbrkh 't byt 'bdkh lhyvt l'vlm lpnykh khy 'th 'dny yhvh dbrt vmbrkhtkh ybrkh byt 'bdkh l'vlm
verses.translation: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD , hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛ד אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַ/יַּכְנִיעֵ֑/ם וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת מֶ֥תֶג הָ/אַמָּ֖ה מִ/יַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vykh dvd 't plshtym vykhny'm vyqch dvd 't mtg h'mh myd plshtym
verses.translation: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣ךְ אֶת מוֹאָ֗ב וַֽ/יְמַדְּדֵ֤/ם בַּ/חֶ֨בֶל֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ב אוֹתָ֣/ם אַ֔רְצָ/ה וַ/יְמַדֵּ֤ד שְׁנֵֽי חֲבָלִים֙ לְ/הָמִ֔ית וּ/מְלֹ֥א הַ/חֶ֖בֶל לְ/הַחֲי֑וֹת וַ/תְּהִ֤י מוֹאָב֙ לְ/דָוִ֔ד לַ/עֲבָדִ֖ים נֹשְׂאֵ֥י מִנְחָֽה
verses.translit: vykh 't mv'b vymddm bchbl hshkhb 'vtm 'rtsh vymdd shny chblym lhmyt vml' hchbl lhchyvt vthy mv'b ldvd l'bdym nsh'y mnchh
verses.translation: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣ךְ דָּוִ֔ד אֶת הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר בֶּן רְחֹ֖ב מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה בְּ/לֶכְתּ֕/וֹ לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב יָד֖/וֹ בִּֽ/נְהַר פְּרָֽת
verses.translit: vykh dvd 't hdd'zr bn rchb mlkh tsvbh blkhtv lhshyb ydv bnhr prt
verses.translation: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֨ד דָּוִ֜ד מִמֶּ֗/נּוּ אֶ֤לֶף וּ/שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת֙ פָּרָשִׁ֔ים וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וַ/יְעַקֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/רֶ֔כֶב וַ/יּוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ מֵ֥אָה רָֽכֶב
verses.translit: vylkhd dvd mmnv 'lf vshb' m'vt prshym v'shrym 'lf 'ysh rgly vy'qr dvd 't khl hrkhb vyvtr mmnv m'h rkhb
verses.translation: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק לַ/עְזֹ֕ר לַ/הֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה וַ/יַּ֤ךְ דָּוִד֙ בַּֽ/אֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים וּ/שְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vtb' 'rm dmshq l'zr lhdd'zr mlkh tsvbh vykh dvd b'rm 'shrym vshnym 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם דָּוִ֤ד נְצִבִים֙ בַּ/אֲרַ֣ם דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וַ/תְּהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְ/דָוִ֔ד לַ/עֲבָדִ֖ים נוֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֤שַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת דָּוִ֔ד בְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ
verses.translit: vyshm dvd ntsbym b'rm dmshq vthy 'rm ldvd l'bdym nvsh'y mnchh vysh' yhvh 't dvd bkhl 'shr hlkh
verses.translation: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֗ד אֵ֚ת שִׁלְטֵ֣י הַ/זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ אֶ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַ/יְבִיאֵ֖/ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyqch dvd 't shlty hzhb 'shr hyv 'l 'bdy hdd'zr vyby'm yrvshlm
verses.translation: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בֶּ֥טַח וּ/מִ/בֵּֽרֹתַ֖י עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר לָקַ֞ח הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ דָּוִ֛ד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vmbtch vmbrty 'ry hdd'zr lqch hmlkh dvd nchsht hrbh m'd
verses.translation: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֕ע תֹּ֖עִי מֶ֣לֶךְ חֲמָ֑ת כִּ֚י הִכָּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל חֵ֥יל הֲדַדְעָֽזֶר
verses.translit: vyshm' t'y mlkh chmt khy hkhh dvd 't khl chyl hdd'zr
verses.translation: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח תֹּ֣עִי אֶת יֽוֹרָם בְּנ֣/וֹ אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ דָּ֠וִד לִ/שְׁאָל ל֨/וֹ לְ/שָׁל֜וֹם וּֽ/לְ/בָרֲכ֗/וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם בַּ/הֲדַדְעֶ֨זֶר֙ וַ/יַּכֵּ֔/הוּ כִּי אִ֛ישׁ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עִי הָיָ֣ה הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וּ/בְ/יָד֗/וֹ הָי֛וּ כְּלֵֽי כֶ֥סֶף וּ/כְלֵֽי זָהָ֖ב וּ/כְלֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vyshlch t'y 't yvrm bnv 'l hmlkh dvd lsh'l lv lshlvm vlbrkhv 'l 'shr nlchm bhdd'zr vykhhv khy 'ysh mlchmvt t'y hyh hdd'zr vbydv hyv khly khsf vkhly zhb vkhly nchsht
verses.translation: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

verses.original: גַּם אֹתָ֕/ם הִקְדִּ֛ישׁ הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה עִם הַ/כֶּ֤סֶף וְ/הַ/זָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדִּ֔ישׁ מִ/כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כִּבֵּֽשׁ
verses.translit: gm 'tm hqdysh hmlkh dvd lyhvh 'm hkhsf vhzhb 'shr hqdysh mkhl hgvym 'shr khbsh
verses.translation: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;

verses.original: מֵ/אֲרָ֤ם וּ/מִ/מּוֹאָב֙ וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּ/מִ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּ/מֵֽ/עֲמָלֵ֑ק וּ/מִ/שְּׁלַ֛ל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר בֶּן רְחֹ֖ב מֶ֥לֶךְ צוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: m'rm vmmv'b vmbny 'mvn vmplshtym vm'mlq vmshll hdd'zr bn rchb mlkh tsvbh
verses.translation: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ דָּוִד֙ שֵׁ֔ם בְּ/שֻׁב֕/וֹ מֵ/הַכּוֹת֥/וֹ אֶת אֲרָ֖ם בְּ/גֵיא מֶ֑לַח שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vy'sh dvd shm bshbv mhkhvtv 't 'rm bgy' mlch shmvnh 'shr 'lf
verses.translation: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם בֶּ/אֱד֜וֹם נְצִבִ֗ים בְּ/כָל אֱדוֹם֙ שָׂ֣ם נְצִבִ֔ים וַ/יְהִ֥י כָל אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְ/דָוִ֑ד וַ/יּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת דָּוִ֔ד בְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ
verses.translit: vyshm b'dvm ntsbym bkhl 'dvm shm ntsbym vyhy khl 'dvm 'bdym ldvd vyvsh' yhvh 't dvd bkhl 'shr hlkh
verses.translation: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David’s servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖ד עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יְהִ֣י דָוִ֗ד עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה לְ/כָל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vymlkh dvd 'l khl yshr'l vyhy dvd 'shh mshpt vtsdqh lkhl 'mv
verses.translation: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל הַ/צָּבָ֑א וִ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר
verses.translit: vyv'b bn tsrvyh 'l htsb' vyhvshpt bn 'chylvd mzkhyr
verses.translation: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

verses.original: וְ/צָד֧וֹק בֶּן אֲחִיט֛וּב וַ/אֲחִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וּ/שְׂרָיָ֖ה סוֹפֵֽר
verses.translit: vtsdvq bn 'chytvb v'chymlkh bn 'bytr khhnym vshryh svpr
verses.translation: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

verses.original: וּ/בְנָיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וְ/הַ/כְּרֵתִ֖י וְ/הַ/פְּלֵתִ֑י וּ/בְנֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד כֹּהֲנִ֥ים הָיֽוּ
verses.translit: vbnyhv bn yhvyd' vhkhrty vhplty vbny dvd khhnym hyv
verses.translation: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief rulers.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד הֲ/כִ֣י יֶשׁ ע֔וֹד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נוֹתַ֖ר לְ/בֵ֣ית שָׁא֑וּל וְ/אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה עִמּ/וֹ֙ חֶ֔סֶד בַּ/עֲב֖וּר יְהוֹנָתָֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd hkhy ysh 'vd 'shr nvtr lbyt sh'vl v''shh 'mv chsd b'bvr yhvntn
verses.translation: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?

verses.original: וּ/לְ/בֵ֨ית שָׁא֥וּל עֶ֨בֶד֙ וּ/שְׁמ֣/וֹ צִיבָ֔א וַ/יִּקְרְאוּ ל֖/וֹ אֶל דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ אֵלָ֛י/ו הַ/אַתָּ֥ה צִיבָ֖א וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vlbyt sh'vl 'bd vshmv tsyb' vyqr'v lv 'l dvd vy'mr hmlkh 'lyv h'th tsyb' vy'mr 'bdkh
verses.translation: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ הַ/אֶ֨פֶס ע֥וֹד אִישׁ֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית שָׁא֔וּל וְ/אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה עִמּ֖/וֹ חֶ֣סֶד אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר צִיבָא֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ ע֛וֹד בֵּ֥ן לִ/יהוֹנָתָ֖ן נְכֵ֥ה רַגְלָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh h'ps 'vd 'ysh lbyt sh'vl v''shh 'mv chsd 'lhym vy'mr tsyb' 'l hmlkh 'vd bn lyhvntn nkhh rglym
verses.translation: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר ל֥/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֵיפֹ֣ה ה֑וּא וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר צִיבָא֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הִנֵּה ה֗וּא בֵּ֛ית מָכִ֥יר בֶּן עַמִּיאֵ֖ל בְּ/ל֥וֹ דְבָֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr lv hmlkh 'yph hv' vy'mr tsyb' 'l hmlkh hnh hv' byt mkhyr bn 'my'l blv dbr
verses.translation: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יִּקָּחֵ֗/הוּ מִ/בֵּ֛ית מָכִ֥יר בֶּן עַמִּיאֵ֖ל מִ/לּ֥וֹ דְבָֽר
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh dvd vyqchhv mbyt mkhyr bn 'my'l mlv dbr
verses.translation: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lo-debar.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּבֹא מְפִיבֹ֨שֶׁת בֶּן יְהוֹנָתָ֤ן בֶּן שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל עַל פָּנָ֖י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁתָּ֑חוּ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ מְפִיבֹ֔שֶׁת וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyb' mpybsht bn yhvntn bn sh'vl 'l dvd vypl 'l pnyv vyshtchv vy'mr dvd mpybsht vy'mr hnh 'bdkh
verses.translation: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨/וֹ דָוִ֜ד אַל תִּירָ֗א כִּ֣י עָשֹׂה֩ אֶעֱשֶׂ֨ה עִמְּ/ךָ֥ חֶ֨סֶד֙ בַּֽ/עֲבוּר֙ יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן אָבִ֔י/ךָ וַ/הֲשִׁבֹתִ֣י לְ/ךָ֔ אֶֽת כָּל שְׂדֵ֖ה שָׁא֣וּל אָבִ֑י/ךָ וְ/אַתָּ֗ה תֹּ֥אכַל לֶ֛חֶם עַל שֻׁלְחָנִ֖/י תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: vy'mr lv dvd 'l tyr' khy 'shh ''shh 'mkh chsd b'bvr yhvntn 'bykh vhshbty lkh 't khl shdh sh'vl 'bykh v'th t'khl lchm 'l shlchny tmyd
verses.translation: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father’s sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֕חוּ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ כִּ֣י פָנִ֔יתָ אֶל הַ/כֶּ֥לֶב הַ/מֵּ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּמֽוֹ/נִי
verses.translit: vyshtchv vy'mr mh 'bdkh khy pnyt 'l hkhlb hmt 'shr khmvny
verses.translation: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am ?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶל צִיבָ֛א נַ֥עַר שָׁא֖וּל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֑י/ו כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה לְ/שָׁאוּל֙ וּ/לְ/כָל בֵּית֔/וֹ נָתַ֖תִּי לְ/בֶן אֲדֹנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyqr' hmlkh 'l tsyb' n'r sh'vl vy'mr 'lyv khl 'shr hyh lsh'vl vlkhl bytv ntty lbn 'dnykh
verses.translation: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master’s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.

verses.original: וְ/עָבַ֣דְתָּ לּ֣/וֹ אֶֽת הָ/אֲדָמָ֡ה אַתָּה֩ וּ/בָנֶ֨י/ךָ וַ/עֲבָדֶ֜י/ךָ וְ/הֵבֵ֗אתָ וְ/הָיָ֨ה לְ/בֶן אֲדֹנֶ֤י/ךָ לֶּ֨חֶם֙ וַ/אֲכָל֔/וֹ וּ/מְפִיבֹ֨שֶׁת֙ בֶּן אֲדֹנֶ֔י/ךָ יֹאכַ֥ל תָּמִ֛יד לֶ֖חֶם עַל שֻׁלְחָנִ֑/י וּ/לְ/צִיבָ֗א חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר בָּנִ֖ים וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: v'bdt lv 't h'dmh 'th vbnykh v'bdykh vhb't vhyh lbn 'dnykh lchm v'khlv vmpybsht bn 'dnykh y'khl tmyd lchm 'l shlchny vltsyb' chmshh 'shr bnym v'shrym 'bdym
verses.translation: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master’s son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master’s son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר צִיבָא֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כְּ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצַוֶּ֜ה אֲדֹנִ֤/י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶת עַבְדּ֔/וֹ כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וּ/מְפִיבֹ֗שֶׁת אֹכֵל֙ עַל שֻׁלְחָנִ֔/י כְּ/אַחַ֖ד מִ/בְּנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr tsyb' 'l hmlkh khkhl 'shr ytsvh 'dny hmlkh 't 'bdv khn y'shh 'bdkh vmpybsht 'khl 'l shlchny kh'chd mbny hmlkh
verses.translation: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king , he shall eat at my table, as one of the king’s sons.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/מְפִיבֹ֥שֶׁת בֵּן קָטָ֖ן וּ/שְׁמ֣/וֹ מִיכָ֑א וְ/כֹל֙ מוֹשַׁ֣ב בֵּית צִיבָ֔א עֲבָדִ֖ים לִ/מְפִיבֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vlmpybsht bn qtn vshmv mykh' vkhl mvshb byt tsyb' 'bdym lmpybsht
verses.translation: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.

verses.original: וּ/מְפִיבֹ֗שֶׁת יֹשֵׁב֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּ֣י עַל שֻׁלְחַ֥ן הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ תָּמִ֖יד ה֣וּא אֹכֵ֑ל וְ/ה֥וּא פִסֵּ֖חַ שְׁתֵּ֥י רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmpybsht yshb byrvshlm khy 'l shlchn hmlkh tmyd hv' 'khl vhv' psch shty rglyv
verses.translation: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king’s table; and was lame on both his feet.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יָּ֕מָת מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ חָנ֥וּן בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vymt mlkh bny 'mvn vymlkh chnvn bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶעֱשֶׂה חֶ֣סֶד עִם חָנ֣וּן בֶּן נָחָ֗שׁ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ עָשָׂ֨ה אָבִ֤י/ו עִמָּדִ/י֙ חֶ֔סֶד וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח דָּוִ֧ד לְ/נַחֲמ֛/וֹ בְּ/יַד עֲבָדָ֖י/ו אֶל אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ עַבְדֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd ''shh chsd 'm chnvn bn nchsh kh'shr 'shh 'byv 'mdy chsd vyshlch dvd lnchmv byd 'bdyv 'l 'byv vyb'v 'bdy dvd 'rts bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י בְנֵֽי עַמּ֜וֹן אֶל חָנ֣וּן אֲדֹֽנֵי/הֶ֗ם הַֽ/מְכַבֵּ֨ד דָּוִ֤ד אֶת אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ כִּֽי שָׁלַ֥ח לְ/ךָ֖ מְנַֽחֲמִ֑ים הֲ֠/לוֹא בַּ/עֲב֞וּר חֲק֤וֹר אֶת הָ/עִיר֙ וּ/לְ/רַגְּלָ֣/הּ וּ/לְ/הָפְכָ֔/הּ שָׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת עֲבָדָ֖י/ו אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mrv shry bny 'mvn 'l chnvn 'dnyhm hmkhbd dvd 't 'bykh b'ynykh khy shlch lkh mnchmym hlv' b'bvr chqvr 't h'yr vlrglh vlhpkhh shlch dvd 't 'bdyv 'lykh
verses.translation: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח חָנ֜וּן אֶת עַבְדֵ֣י דָוִ֗ד וַ/יְגַלַּח֙ אֶת חֲצִ֣י זְקָנָ֔/ם וַ/יִּכְרֹ֧ת אֶת מַדְוֵי/הֶ֛ם בַּ/חֵ֖צִי עַ֣ד שְׁתֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqch chnvn 't 'bdy dvd vyglch 't chtsy zqnm vykhrt 't mdvyhm bchtsy 'd shtvtyhm vyshlchm
verses.translation: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֤דוּ לְ/דָוִד֙ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח לִ/קְרָאתָ֔/ם כִּֽי הָי֥וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים נִכְלָמִ֣ים מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ שְׁב֣וּ בִֽ/ירֵח֔וֹ עַד יְצַמַּ֥ח זְקַנְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/שַׁבְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vygdv ldvd vyshlch lqr'tm khy hyv h'nshym nkhlmym m'd vy'mr hmlkh shbv byrchv 'd ytsmch zqnkhm vshbtm
verses.translation: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן כִּ֥י נִבְאֲשׁ֖וּ בְּ/דָוִ֑ד וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֣וּ בְנֵֽי עַמּ֡וֹן וַ/יִּשְׂכְּרוּ֩ אֶת אֲרַ֨ם בֵּית רְח֜וֹב וְ/אֶת אֲרַ֣ם צוֹבָ֗א עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ רַגְלִ֔י וְ/אֶת מֶ֤לֶךְ מַֽעֲכָה֙ אֶ֣לֶף אִ֔ישׁ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ ט֔וֹב שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vyr'v bny 'mvn khy nb'shv bdvd vyshlchv bny 'mvn vyshkhrv 't 'rm byt rchvb v't 'rm tsvb' 'shrym 'lf rgly v't mlkh m'khh 'lf 'ysh v'ysh tvb shnym 'shr 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth-rehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ish-tob twelve thousand men.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֖ע דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ אֶת יוֹאָ֔ב וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/צָּבָ֖א הַ/גִּבֹּרִֽים
verses.translit: vyshm' dvd vyshlch 't yv'b v't khl htsb' hgbrym
verses.translation: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּֽצְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַ/יַּעַרְכ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה פֶּ֣תַח הַ/שָּׁ֑עַר וַ/אֲרַ֨ם צוֹבָ֤א וּ/רְחוֹב֙ וְ/אִֽישׁ ט֣וֹב וּ/מַֽעֲכָ֔ה לְ/בַדָּ֖/ם בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vyts'v bny 'mvn vy'rkhv mlchmh ptch hsh'r v'rm tsvb' vrchvb v'ysh tvb vm'khh lbdm bshdh
verses.translation: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ish-tob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא יוֹאָ֗ב כִּֽי הָיְתָ֤ה אֵלָי/ו֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה מִ/פָּנִ֖ים וּ/מֵֽ/אָח֑וֹר וַ/יִּבְחַ֗ר מִ/כֹּל֙ בְּחוּרֵ֣י ב/ישראל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽ/יַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ לִ/קְרַ֥את אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vyr' yv'b khy hyth 'lyv pny hmlchmh mpnym vm'chvr vybchr mkhl bchvry byshr'l yshr'l vy'rkh lqr't 'rm
verses.translation: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ יֶ֣תֶר הָ/עָ֔ם נָתַ֕ן בְּ/יַ֖ד אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֑י/ו וַֽ/יַּעֲרֹ֕ךְ לִ/קְרַ֖את בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: v't ytr h'm ntn byd 'bshy 'chyv vy'rkh lqr't bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אִם תֶּחֱזַ֤ק אֲרָם֙ מִמֶּ֔/נִּי וְ/הָיִ֥תָה לִּ֖/י לִֽ/ישׁוּעָ֑ה וְ/אִם בְּנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ יֶחֱזְק֣וּ מִמְּ/ךָ֔ וְ/הָלַכְתִּ֖י לְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יעַֽ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'm tchzq 'rm mmny vhyth ly lyshv'h v'm bny 'mvn ychzqv mmkh vhlkhty lhvshy' lkh
verses.translation: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.

verses.original: חֲזַ֤ק וְ/נִתְחַזַּק֙ בְּעַד עַמֵּ֔/נוּ וּ/בְעַ֖ד עָרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וַֽ/יהוָ֔ה יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַ/טּ֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: chzq vntchzq b'd 'mnv vb'd 'ry 'lhynv vyhvh y'shh htvb b'ynyv
verses.translation: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֣שׁ יוֹאָ֗ב וְ/הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֔/וֹ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה בַּֽ/אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יָּנֻ֖סוּ מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vygsh yv'b vh'm 'shr 'mv lmlchmh b'rm vynsv mpnyv
verses.translation: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֨י עַמּ֤וֹן רָאוּ֙ כִּי נָ֣ס אֲרָ֔ם וַ/יָּנֻ֨סוּ֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י אֲבִישַׁ֔י וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב יוֹאָ֗ב מֵ/עַל֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַ/יָּבֹ֖א יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vbny 'mvn r'v khy ns 'rm vynsv mpny 'byshy vyb'v h'yr vyshb yv'b m'l bny 'mvn vyb' yrvshlm
verses.translation: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא אֲרָ֔ם כִּ֥י נִגַּ֖ף לִ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֵּאָסְפ֖וּ יָֽחַד
verses.translit: vyr' 'rm khy ngf lpny yshr'l vy'spv ychd
verses.translation: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח הֲדַדְעֶ֗זֶר וַ/יֹּצֵ֤א אֶת אֲרָם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מֵ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֔ר וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ חֵילָ֑ם וְ/שׁוֹבַ֛ךְ שַׂר צְבָ֥א הֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshlch hdd'zr vyts' 't 'rm 'shr m'br hnhr vyb'v chylm vshvbkh shr tsb' hdd'zr lpnyhm
verses.translation: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֣ד לְ/דָוִ֗ד וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֤ף אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ר אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַ/יָּבֹ֖א חֵלָ֑אמָ/ה וַ/יַּעַרְכ֤וּ אֲרָם֙ לִ/קְרַ֣את דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יִּלָּחֲמ֖וּ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vygd ldvd vy'sf 't khl yshr'l vy'br 't hyrdn vyb' chl'mh vy'rkhv 'rm lqr't dvd vylchmv 'mv
verses.translation: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣נָס אֲרָם֮ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יַּהֲרֹ֨ג דָּוִ֜ד מֵ/אֲרָ֗ם שְׁבַ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְ/אֵ֨ת שׁוֹבַ֧ךְ שַׂר צְבָא֛/וֹ הִכָּ֖ה וַ/יָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyns 'rm mpny yshr'l vyhrg dvd m'rm shb' m'vt rkhb v'rb'ym 'lf prshym v't shvbkh shr tsb'v hkhh vymt shm
verses.translation: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֨וּ כָֽל הַ/מְּלָכִ֜ים עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֗זֶר כִּ֤י נִגְּפוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֥מוּ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַ/יַּֽעַבְד֑וּ/ם וַ/יִּֽרְא֣וּ אֲרָ֔ם לְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ ע֖וֹד אֶת בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyr'v khl hmlkhym 'bdy hdd'zr khy ngpv lpny yshr'l vyshlmv 't yshr'l vy'bdvm vyr'v 'rm lhvshy' 'vd 't bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ לִ/תְשׁוּבַ֨ת הַ/שָּׁנָ֜ה לְ/עֵ֣ת צֵ֣את הַ/מַּלְאֿכִ֗ים וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח דָּוִ֡ד אֶת יוֹאָב֩ וְ/אֶת עֲבָדָ֨י/ו עִמּ֜/וֹ וְ/אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַ/יַּשְׁחִ֨תוּ֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַ/יָּצֻ֖רוּ עַל רַבָּ֑ה וְ/דָוִ֖ד יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy ltshvbt hshnh l't ts't hml'khym vyshlch dvd 't yv'b v't 'bdyv 'mv v't khl yshr'l vyshchtv 't bny 'mvn vytsrv 'l rbh vdvd yvshb byrvshlm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle , that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י לְ/עֵ֣ת הָ/עֶ֗רֶב וַ/יָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֜ד מֵ/עַ֤ל מִשְׁכָּב/וֹ֙ וַ/יִּתְהַלֵּךְ֙ עַל גַּ֣ג בֵּית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יַּ֥רְא אִשָּׁ֛ה רֹחֶ֖צֶת מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/גָּ֑ג וְ/הָ֣/אִשָּׁ֔ה טוֹבַ֥ת מַרְאֶ֖ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyhy l't h'rb vyqm dvd m'l mshkhbv vythlkh 'l gg byt hmlkh vyr' 'shh rchtst m'l hgg vh'shh tvbt mr'h m'd
