verses.translation: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יִּדְרֹ֖שׁ לָֽ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הֲ/לוֹא זֹאת֙ בַּת שֶׁ֣בַע בַּת אֱלִיעָ֔ם אֵ֖שֶׁת אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַ/חִתִּֽי
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd vydrsh l'shh vy'mr hlv' z't bt shb' bt 'ly'm 'sht 'vryh hchty
verses.translation: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ דָּוִ֨ד מַלְאָכִ֜ים וַ/יִּקָּחֶ֗/הָ וַ/תָּב֤וֹא אֵלָי/ו֙ וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמָּ֔/הּ וְ/הִ֥יא מִתְקַדֶּ֖שֶׁת מִ/טֻּמְאָתָ֑/הּ וַ/תָּ֖שָׁב אֶל בֵּיתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd ml'khym vyqchh vtbv' 'lyv vyshkhb 'mh vhy' mtqdsht mtm'th vtshb 'l byth
verses.translation: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֖הַר הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/תִּשְׁלַח֙ וַ/תַּגֵּ֣ד לְ/דָוִ֔ד וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר הָרָ֥ה אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: vthr h'shh vtshlch vtgd ldvd vt'mr hrh 'nkhy
verses.translation: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח דָּוִד֙ אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב שְׁלַ֣ח אֵלַ֔/י אֶת אֽוּרִיָּ֖ה הַ/חִתִּ֑י וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת אֽוּרִיָּ֖ה אֶל דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd 'l yv'b shlch 'ly 't 'vryh hchty vyshlch yv'b 't 'vryh 'l dvd
verses.translation: And David sent to Joab, saying , Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אוּרִיָּ֖ה אֵלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֣ל דָּוִ֗ד לִ/שְׁל֤וֹם יוֹאָב֙ וְ/לִ/שְׁל֣וֹם הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/לִ/שְׁל֖וֹם הַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' 'vryh 'lyv vysh'l dvd lshlvm yv'b vlshlvm h'm vlshlvm hmlchmh
verses.translation: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ לְ/א֣וּרִיָּ֔ה רֵ֥ד לְ/בֵיתְ/ךָ֖ וּ/רְחַ֣ץ רַגְלֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א אֽוּרִיָּה֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/תֵּצֵ֥א אַחֲרָ֖י/ו מַשְׂאַ֥ת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd l'vryh rd lbytkh vrchts rglykh vyts' 'vryh mbyt hmlkh vtts' 'chryv msh't hmlkh
verses.translation: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֣ב אוּרִיָּ֗ה פֶּ֚תַח בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יָרַ֖ד אֶל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'vryh ptch byt hmlkh 't khl 'bdy 'dnyv vl' yrd 'l bytv
verses.translation: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֤דוּ לְ/דָוִד֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹֽא יָרַ֥ד אוּרִיָּ֖ה אֶל בֵּית֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל אוּרִיָּ֗ה הֲ/ל֤וֹא מִ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אַתָּ֣ה בָ֔א מַדּ֖וּעַ לֹֽא יָרַ֥דְתָּ אֶל בֵּיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vygdv ldvd l'mr l' yrd 'vryh 'l bytv vy'mr dvd 'l 'vryh hlv' mdrkh 'th b' mdv' l' yrdt 'l bytkh
verses.translation: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אוּרִיָּ֜ה אֶל דָּוִ֗ד הָ֠/אָרוֹן וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל וִֽ/יהוּדָ֜ה יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בַּ/סֻּכּ֗וֹת וַ/אדֹנִ֨/י יוֹאָ֜ב וְ/עַבְדֵ֤י אֲדֹנִ֨/י עַל פְּנֵ֤י הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ חֹנִ֔ים וַ/אֲנִ֞י אָב֧וֹא אֶל בֵּיתִ֛/י לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל וְ/לִ/שְׁתּ֖וֹת וְ/לִ/שְׁכַּ֣ב עִם אִשְׁתִּ֑/י חַיֶּ֨/ךָ֙ וְ/חֵ֣י נַפְשֶׁ֔/ךָ אִֽם אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'vryh 'l dvd h'rvn vyshr'l vyhvdh yshbym bskhvt v'dny yv'b v'bdy 'dny 'l pny hshdh chnym v'ny 'bv' 'l byty l'khl vlshtvt vlshkhb 'm 'shty chykh vchy npshkh 'm ''shh 't hdbr hzh
verses.translation: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל אוּרִיָּ֗ה שֵׁ֥ב בָּ/זֶ֛ה גַּם הַ/יּ֖וֹם וּ/מָחָ֣ר אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֑/ךָּ וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב אוּרִיָּ֧ה בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא וּ/מִֽ/מָּחֳרָֽת
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'vryh shb bzh gm hyvm vmchr 'shlchkh vyshb 'vryh byrvshlm byvm hhv' vmmchrt
verses.translation: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא ל֣/וֹ דָוִ֗ד וַ/יֹּ֧אכַל לְ/פָנָ֛י/ו וַ/יֵּ֖שְׁתְּ וַֽ/יְשַׁכְּרֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א בָ/עֶ֗רֶב לִ/שְׁכַּ֤ב בְּ/מִשְׁכָּב/וֹ֙ עִם עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶל בֵּית֖/וֹ לֹ֥א יָרָֽד
verses.translit: vyqr' lv dvd vy'khl lpnyv vysht vyshkhrhv vyts' b'rb lshkhb bmshkhbv 'm 'bdy 'dnyv v'l bytv l' yrd
verses.translation: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֥ב דָּוִ֛ד סֵ֖פֶר אֶל יוֹאָ֑ב וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֖ח בְּ/יַ֥ד אוּרִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr vykhtb dvd spr 'l yv'b vyshlch byd 'vryh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֥ב בַּ/סֵּ֖פֶר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הָב֣וּ אֶת אֽוּרִיָּ֗ה אֶל מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֤י הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ הַֽ/חֲזָקָ֔ה וְ/שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם מֵ/אַחֲרָ֖י/ו וְ/נִכָּ֥ה וָ/מֵֽת
verses.translit: vykhtb bspr l'mr hbv 't 'vryh 'l mvl pny hmlchmh hchzqh vshbtm m'chryv vnkhh vmt
verses.translation: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י בִּ/שְׁמ֥וֹר יוֹאָ֖ב אֶל הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶת א֣וּרִיָּ֔ה אֶל הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י אַנְשֵׁי חַ֖יִל שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyhy bshmvr yv'b 'l h'yr vytn 't 'vryh 'l hmqvm 'shr yd' khy 'nshy chyl shm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨צְא֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָ/עִיר֙ וַ/יִּלָּחֲמ֣וּ אֶת יוֹאָ֔ב וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל מִן הָ/עָ֖ם מֵ/עַבְדֵ֣י דָוִ֑ד וַ/יָּ֕מָת גַּ֖ם אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַ/חִתִּֽי
verses.translit: vyts'v 'nshy h'yr vylchmv 't yv'b vypl mn h'm m'bdy dvd vymt gm 'vryh hchty
verses.translation: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֖ח יוֹאָ֑ב וַ/יַּגֵּ֣ד לְ/דָוִ֔ד אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֖י הַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch yv'b vygd ldvd 't khl dbry hmlchmh
verses.translation: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֥ו אֶת הַ/מַּלְאָ֖ךְ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כְּ/כַלּוֹתְ/ךָ֗ אֵ֛ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה לְ/דַבֵּ֥ר אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vytsv 't hml'kh l'mr khkhlvtkh 't khl dbry hmlchmh ldbr 'l hmlkh
verses.translation: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִֽם תַּעֲלֶה֙ חֲמַ֣ת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/אָמַ֣ר לְ/ךָ֔ מַדּ֛וּעַ נִגַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֶל הָ/עִ֖יר לְ/הִלָּחֵ֑ם הֲ/ל֣וֹא יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר יֹר֖וּ מֵ/עַ֥ל הַ/חוֹמָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh 'm t'lh chmt hmlkh v'mr lkh mdv' ngshtm 'l h'yr lhlchm hlv' yd'tm 't 'shr yrv m'l hchvmh
verses.translation: And if so be that the king’s wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?

verses.original: מִֽי הִכָּ֞ה אֶת אֲבִימֶ֣לֶךְ בֶּן יְרֻבֶּ֗שֶׁת הֲ/לֽוֹא אִשָּׁ֡ה הִשְׁלִ֣יכָה עָלָי/ו֩ פֶּ֨לַח רֶ֜כֶב מֵ/עַ֤ל הַֽ/חוֹמָה֙ וַ/יָּ֣מָת בְּ/תֵבֵ֔ץ לָ֥/מָּה נִגַּשְׁתֶּ֖ם אֶל הַֽ/חוֹמָ֑ה וְ/אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ גַּ֗ם עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַ/חִתִּ֖י מֵֽת
verses.translit: my hkhh 't 'bymlkh bn yrbsht hlv' 'shh hshlykhh 'lyv plch rkhb m'l hchvmh vymt btbts lmh ngshtm 'l hchvmh v'mrt gm 'bdkh 'vryh hchty mt
verses.translation: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ הַ/מַּלְאָ֑ךְ וַ/יָּבֹא֙ וַ/יַּגֵּ֣ד לְ/דָוִ֔ד אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁלָח֖/וֹ יוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vylkh hml'kh vyb' vygd ldvd 't khl 'shr shlchv yv'b
verses.translation: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מַּלְאָךְ֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד כִּֽי גָבְר֤וּ עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַ/יֵּצְא֥וּ אֵלֵ֖י/נוּ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וַ/נִּהְיֶ֥ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם עַד פֶּ֥תַח הַ/שָּֽׁעַר
verses.translit: vy'mr hml'kh 'l dvd khy gbrv 'lynv h'nshym vyts'v 'lynv hshdh vnhyh 'lyhm 'd ptch hsh'r
verses.translation: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.

verses.original: ו/יראו וַ/יֹּר֨וּ ה/מוראים הַ/מּוֹרִ֤ים אֶל עֲבָדֶ֨/ךָ֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל הַ/חוֹמָ֔ה וַ/יָּמ֖וּתוּ מֵ/עַבְדֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/גַ֗ם עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַ/חִתִּ֖י מֵֽת
verses.translit: vyr'v vyrv hmvr'ym hmvrym 'l 'bdkh m'l hchvmh vymvtv m'bdy hmlkh vgm 'bdkh 'vryh hchty mt
verses.translation: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king’s servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל הַ/מַּלְאָ֗ךְ כֹּֽה תֹאמַ֤ר אֶל יוֹאָב֙ אַל יֵרַ֤ע בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּֽי כָ/זֹ֥ה וְ/כָ/זֶ֖ה תֹּאכַ֣ל הֶ/חָ֑רֶב הַחֲזֵ֨ק מִלְחַמְתְּ/ךָ֧ אֶל הָ/עִ֛יר וְ/הָרְסָ֖/הּ וְ/חַזְּקֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l hml'kh khh t'mr 'l yv'b 'l yr' b'ynykh 't hdbr hzh khy khzh vkhzh t'khl hchrb hchzq mlchmtkh 'l h'yr vhrsh vchzqhv
verses.translation: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁמַע֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת אֽוּרִיָּ֔ה כִּי מֵ֖ת אוּרִיָּ֣ה אִישָׁ֑/הּ וַ/תִּסְפֹּ֖ד עַל בַּעְלָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtshm' 'sht 'vryh khy mt 'vryh 'yshh vtspd 'l b'lh
verses.translation: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ר הָ/אֵ֗בֶל וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח דָּוִ֜ד וַ/יַּאַסְפָ֤/הּ אֶל בֵּית/וֹ֙ וַ/תְּהִי ל֣/וֹ לְ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד ל֖/וֹ בֵּ֑ן וַ/יֵּ֧רַע הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה דָוִ֖ד בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'br h'bl vyshlch dvd vy'sph 'l bytv vthy lv l'shh vtld lv bn vyr' hdbr 'shr 'shh dvd b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֧ח יְהוָ֛ה אֶת נָתָ֖ן אֶל דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֵלָ֗י/ו וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ שְׁנֵ֣י אֲנָשִׁ֗ים הָיוּ֙ בְּ/עִ֣יר אֶחָ֔ת אֶחָ֥ד עָשִׁ֖יר וְ/אֶחָ֥ד רָֽאשׁ
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh 't ntn 'l dvd vyb' 'lyv vy'mr lv shny 'nshym hyv b'yr 'cht 'chd 'shyr v'chd r'sh
verses.translation: And the LORD sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.

verses.original: לְ/עָשִׁ֗יר הָיָ֛ה צֹ֥אן וּ/בָקָ֖ר הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: l'shyr hyh ts'n vbqr hrbh m'd
verses.translation: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:

verses.original: וְ/לָ/רָ֣שׁ אֵֽין כֹּ֗ל כִּי֩ אִם כִּבְשָׂ֨ה אַחַ֤ת קְטַנָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָנָ֔ה וַ/יְחַיֶּ֕/הָ וַ/תִּגְדַּ֥ל עִמּ֛/וֹ וְ/עִם בָּנָ֖י/ו יַחְדָּ֑ו מִ/פִּתּ֨/וֹ תֹאכַ֜ל וּ/מִ/כֹּס֤/וֹ תִשְׁתֶּה֙ וּ/בְ/חֵיק֣/וֹ תִשְׁכָּ֔ב וַ/תְּהִי ל֖/וֹ כְּ/בַֽת
verses.translit: vlrsh 'yn khl khy 'm khbshh 'cht qtnh 'shr qnh vychyh vtgdl 'mv v'm bnyv ychdv mptv t'khl vmkhsv tshth vbchyqv tshkhb vthy lv khbt
verses.translation: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣בֹא הֵלֶךְ֮ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ הֶֽ/עָשִׁיר֒ וַ/יַּחְמֹ֗ל לָ/קַ֤חַת מִ/צֹּאנ/וֹ֙ וּ/מִ/בְּקָר֔/וֹ לַ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת לָ/אֹרֵ֖חַ הַ/בָּא ל֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֗ח אֶת כִּבְשַׂת֙ הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הָ/רָ֔אשׁ וַֽ/יַּעֲשֶׂ֔/הָ לָ/אִ֖ישׁ הַ/בָּ֥א אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyb' hlkh l'ysh h'shyr vychml lqcht mts'nv vmbqrv l'shvt l'rch hb' lv vyqch 't khbsht h'ysh hr'sh vy'shh l'ysh hb' 'lyv
verses.translation: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man’s lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף דָּוִ֛ד בָּ/אִ֖ישׁ מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל נָתָ֔ן חַי יְהוָ֕ה כִּ֣י בֶן מָ֔וֶת הָ/אִ֖ישׁ הָ/עֹשֶׂ֥ה זֹֽאת
verses.translit: vychr 'f dvd b'ysh m'd vy'mr 'l ntn chy yhvh khy bn mvt h'ysh h'shh z't
verses.translation: And David’s anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/כִּבְשָׂ֖ה יְשַׁלֵּ֣ם אַרְבַּעְתָּ֑יִם עֵ֗קֶב אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/עַ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא חָמָֽל
verses.translit: v't hkhbshh yshlm 'rb'tym 'qb 'shr 'shh 't hdbr hzh v'l 'shr l' chml
verses.translation: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר נָתָ֛ן אֶל דָּוִ֖ד אַתָּ֣ה הָ/אִ֑ישׁ כֹּה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָנֹכִ֞י מְשַׁחְתִּ֤י/ךָֽ לְ/מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָנֹכִ֥י הִצַּלְתִּ֖י/ךָ מִ/יַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vy'mr ntn 'l dvd 'th h'ysh khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'nkhy mshchtykh lmlkh 'l yshr'l v'nkhy htsltykh myd sh'vl
verses.translation: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;

verses.original: וָ/אֶתְּנָ֨/ה לְ/ךָ֜ אֶת בֵּ֣ית אֲדֹנֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/אֶת נְשֵׁ֤י אֲדֹנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/חֵיקֶ֔/ךָ וָ/אֶתְּנָ֣/ה לְ/ךָ֔ אֶת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אִ֨ם מְעָ֔ט וְ/אֹסִ֥פָה לְּ/ךָ֖ כָּ/הֵ֥נָּה וְ/כָ/הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: v'tnh lkh 't byt 'dnykh v't nshy 'dnykh bchyqkh v'tnh lkh 't byt yshr'l vyhvdh v'm m't v'sph lkh khhnh vkhhnh
verses.translation: And I gave thee thy master’s house, and thy master’s wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.

verses.original: מַדּ֜וּעַ בָּזִ֣יתָ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת הָ/רַע֮ ב/עינ/ו בְּ/עֵינַ/י֒ אֵ֣ת אוּרִיָּ֤ה הַֽ/חִתִּי֙ הִכִּ֣יתָ בַ/חֶ֔רֶב וְ/אֶ֨ת אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ לָקַ֥חְתָּ לְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וְ/אֹת֣/וֹ הָרַ֔גְתָּ בְּ/חֶ֖רֶב בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: mdv' bzyt 't dbr yhvh l'shvt hr' b'ynv b'yny 't 'vryh hchty hkhyt bchrb v't 'shtv lqcht lkh l'shh v'tv hrgt bchrb bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the LORD , to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה לֹא תָס֥וּר חֶ֛רֶב מִ/בֵּיתְ/ךָ֖ עַד עוֹלָ֑ם עֵ֚קֶב כִּ֣י בְזִתָ֔/נִי וַ/תִּקַּ֗ח אֶת אֵ֨שֶׁת֙ אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַ/חִתִּ֔י לִ/הְי֥וֹת לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: v'th l' tsvr chrb mbytkh 'd 'vlm 'qb khy bztny vtqch 't 'sht 'vryh hchty lhyvt lkh l'shh
verses.translation: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְ/נִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים עָלֶ֤י/ךָ רָעָה֙ מִ/בֵּיתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֤י אֶת נָשֶׁ֨י/ךָ֙ לְ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/נָתַתִּ֖י לְ/רֵעֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/שָׁכַב֙ עִם נָשֶׁ֔י/ךָ לְ/עֵינֵ֖י הַ/שֶּׁ֥מֶשׁ הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnny mqym 'lykh r'h mbytkh vlqchty 't nshykh l'ynykh vntty lr'ykh vshkhb 'm nshykh l'yny hshmsh hz't
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give them unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.

verses.original: כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה עָשִׂ֣יתָ בַ/סָּ֑תֶר וַ/אֲנִ֗י אֶעֱשֶׂה֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה נֶ֥גֶד כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/נֶ֥גֶד הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: khy 'th 'shyt bstr v'ny ''shh 't hdbr hzh ngd khl yshr'l vngd hshmsh
verses.translation: For thou didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל נָתָ֔ן חָטָ֖אתִי לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר נָתָ֜ן אֶל דָּוִ֗ד גַּם יְהוָ֛ה הֶעֱבִ֥יר חַטָּאתְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א תָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l ntn cht'ty lyhvh vy'mr ntn 'l dvd gm yhvh h'byr cht'tkh l' tmvt
verses.translation: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD . And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

verses.original: אֶ֗פֶס כִּֽי נִאֵ֤ץ נִאַ֨צְתָּ֙ אֶת אֹיְבֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בַּ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה גַּ֗ם הַ/בֵּ֛ן הַ/יִּלּ֥וֹד לְ/ךָ֖ מ֥וֹת יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: 'ps khy n'ts n'tst 't 'yby yhvh bdbr hzh gm hbn hylvd lkh mvt ymvt
verses.translation: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ נָתָ֖ן אֶל בֵּית֑/וֹ וַ/יִּגֹּ֣ף יְהוָ֗ה אֶת הַ/יֶּ֜לֶד אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֧ה אֵֽשֶׁת אוּרִיָּ֛ה לְ/דָוִ֖ד וַ/יֵּאָנַֽשׁ
verses.translit: vylkh ntn 'l bytv vygf yhvh 't hyld 'shr yldh 'sht 'vryh ldvd vy'nsh
verses.translation: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.

verses.original: וַ/יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ דָּוִ֛ד אֶת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּעַ֣ד הַ/נָּ֑עַר וַ/יָּ֤צָם דָּוִד֙ צ֔וֹם וּ/בָ֥א וְ/לָ֖ן וְ/שָׁכַ֥ב אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vybqsh dvd 't h'lhym b'd hn'r vytsm dvd tsvm vb' vln vshkhb 'rtsh
verses.translation: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֜מוּ זִקְנֵ֤י בֵית/וֹ֙ עָלָ֔י/ו לַ/הֲקִימ֖/וֹ מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/לֹ֣א אָבָ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא בָרָ֥א אִתָּ֖/ם לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vyqmv zqny bytv 'lyv lhqymv mn h'rts vl' 'bh vl' br' 'tm lchm
verses.translation: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י וַ/יָּ֣מָת הַ/יָּ֑לֶד וַ/יִּֽרְאוּ֩ עַבְדֵ֨י דָוִ֜ד לְ/הַגִּ֥יד ל֣/וֹ כִּי מֵ֣ת הַ/יֶּ֗לֶד כִּ֤י אָֽמְרוּ֙ הִנֵּה֩ בִ/הְי֨וֹת הַ/יֶּ֜לֶד חַ֗י דִּבַּ֤רְנוּ אֵלָי/ו֙ וְ/לֹא שָׁמַ֣ע בְּ/קוֹלֵ֔/נוּ וְ/אֵ֨יךְ נֹאמַ֥ר אֵלָ֛י/ו מֵ֥ת הַ/יֶּ֖לֶד וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshby'y vymt hyld vyr'v 'bdy dvd lhgyd lv khy mt hyld khy 'mrv hnh bhyvt hyld chy dbrnv 'lyv vl' shm' bqvlnv v'ykh n'mr 'lyv mt hyld v'shh r'h
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא דָּוִ֗ד כִּ֤י עֲבָדָי/ו֙ מִֽתְלַחֲשִׁ֔ים וַ/יָּ֥בֶן דָּוִ֖ד כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת הַ/יָּ֑לֶד וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֧ד אֶל עֲבָדָ֛י/ו הֲ/מֵ֥ת הַ/יֶּ֖לֶד וַ/יֹּ֥אמְרוּ מֵֽת
verses.translit: vyr' dvd khy 'bdyv mtlchshym vybn dvd khy mt hyld vy'mr dvd 'l 'bdyv hmt hyld vy'mrv mt
verses.translation: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקָם֩ דָּוִ֨ד מֵ/הָ/אָ֜רֶץ וַ/יִּרְחַ֣ץ וַ/יָּ֗סֶךְ וַ/יְחַלֵּף֙ שמלת/ו שִׂמְלֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יָּבֹ֥א בֵית יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יִּשְׁתָּ֑חוּ וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֶל בֵּית֔/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֕ל וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ ל֛/וֹ לֶ֖חֶם וַ/יֹּאכַֽל
verses.translit: vyqm dvd mh'rts vyrchts vyskh vychlf shmltv shmltyv vyb' byt yhvh vyshtchv vyb' 'l bytv vysh'l vyshymv lv lchm vy'khl
verses.translation: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself , and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the LORD , and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ עֲבָדָי/ו֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו מָֽה הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתָה בַּ/עֲב֞וּר הַ/יֶּ֤לֶד חַי֙ צַ֣מְתָּ וַ/תֵּ֔בְךְּ וְ/כַֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ מֵ֣ת הַ/יֶּ֔לֶד קַ֖מְתָּ וַ/תֹּ֥אכַל לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'bdyv 'lyv mh hdbr hzh 'shr 'shyth b'bvr hyld chy tsmt vtbkh vkh'shr mt hyld qmt vt'khl lchm
verses.translation: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר בְּ/עוֹד֙ הַ/יֶּ֣לֶד חַ֔י צַ֖מְתִּי וָֽ/אֶבְכֶּ֑ה כִּ֤י אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ מִ֣י יוֹדֵ֔עַ יחנ/ני וְ/חַנַּ֥/נִי יְהוָ֖ה וְ/חַ֥י הַ/יָּֽלֶד
verses.translit: vy'mr b'vd hyld chy tsmty v'bkhh khy 'mrty my yvd' ychnny vchnny yhvh vchy hyld
verses.translation: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה מֵ֗ת לָ֤/מָּה זֶּה֙ אֲנִ֣י צָ֔ם הַ/אוּכַ֥ל לַ/הֲשִׁיב֖/וֹ ע֑וֹד אֲנִי֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ אֵלָ֔י/ו וְ/ה֖וּא לֹֽא יָשׁ֥וּב אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th mt lmh zh 'ny tsm h'vkhl lhshybv 'vd 'ny hlkh 'lyv vhv' l' yshvb 'ly
verses.translation: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

verses.original: וַ/יְנַחֵ֣ם דָּוִ֗ד אֵ֚ת בַּת שֶׁ֣בַע אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶ֖י/הָ וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמָּ֑/הּ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֗ן ו/יקרא וַ/תִּקְרָ֤א אֶת שְׁמ/וֹ֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַ/יהוָ֖ה אֲהֵבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vynchm dvd 't bt shb' 'shtv vyb' 'lyh vyshkhb 'mh vtld bn vyqr' vtqr' 't shmv shlmh vyhvh 'hbv
verses.translation: And David comforted Bath-sheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח בְּ/יַד֙ נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֔יא וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ יְדִ֣ידְיָ֑הּ בַּ/עֲב֖וּר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch byd ntn hnby' vyqr' 't shmv ydydyh b'bvr yhvh
verses.translation: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּלָּ֣חֶם יוֹאָ֔ב בְּ/רַבַּ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֖ד אֶת עִ֥יר הַ/מְּלוּכָֽה
verses.translit: vylchm yv'b brbt bny 'mvn vylkhd 't 'yr hmlvkhh
verses.translation: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח יוֹאָ֛ב מַלְאָכִ֖ים אֶל דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ נִלְחַ֣מְתִּי בְ/רַבָּ֔ה גַּם לָכַ֖דְתִּי אֶת עִ֥יר הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vyshlch yv'b ml'khym 'l dvd vy'mr nlchmty brbh gm lkhdty 't 'yr hmym
verses.translation: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אֱסֹף֙ אֶת יֶ֣תֶר הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/חֲנֵ֥ה עַל הָ/עִ֖יר וְ/לָכְדָ֑/הּ פֶּן אֶלְכֹּ֤ד אֲנִי֙ אֶת הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמִ֖/י עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'th 'sf 't ytr h'm vchnh 'l h'yr vlkhdh pn 'lkhd 'ny 't h'yr vnqr' shmy 'lyh
verses.translation: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.

verses.translit: vy'sf dvd 't khl h'm vylkh rbth vylchm bh vylkhdh
verses.translation: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת עֲטֶֽרֶת מַלְכָּ/ם֩ מֵ/עַ֨ל רֹאשׁ֜/וֹ וּ/מִשְׁקָלָ֨/הּ כִּכַּ֤ר זָהָב֙ וְ/אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֔ה וַ/תְּהִ֖י עַל רֹ֣אשׁ דָּוִ֑ד וּ/שְׁלַ֥ל הָ/עִ֛יר הוֹצִ֖יא הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyqch 't 'trt mlkhm m'l r'shv vmshqlh khkhr zhb v'bn yqrh vthy 'l r'sh dvd vshll h'yr hvtsy' hrbh m'd
verses.translation: And he took their king’s crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on David’s head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/עָ֨ם אֲשֶׁר בָּ֜/הּ הוֹצִ֗יא וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם בַּ֠/מְּגֵרָה וּ/בַ/חֲרִצֵ֨י הַ/בַּרְזֶ֜ל וּֽ/בְ/מַגְזְרֹ֣ת הַ/בַּרְזֶ֗ל וְ/הֶעֱבִ֤יר אוֹתָ/ם֙ ב/מלכן בַּ/מַּלְבֵּ֔ן וְ/כֵ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל עָרֵ֣י בְנֵֽי עַמּ֑וֹן וַ/יָּ֧שָׁב דָּוִ֛ד וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: v't h'm 'shr bh hvtsy' vyshm bmgrh vbchrtsy hbrzl vbmgzrt hbrzl vh'byr 'vtm bmlkhn bmlbn vkhn y'shh lkhl 'ry bny 'mvn vyshb dvd vkhl h'm yrvshlm
verses.translation: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן וּ/לְ/אַבְשָׁל֧וֹם בֶּן דָּוִ֛ד אָח֥וֹת יָפָ֖ה וּ/שְׁמָ֣/הּ תָּמָ֑ר וַ/יֶּאֱהָבֶ֖/הָ אַמְנ֥וֹן בֶּן דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vl'bshlvm bn dvd 'chvt yph vshmh tmr vy'hbh 'mnvn bn dvd
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨צֶר לְ/אַמְנ֜וֹן לְ/הִתְחַלּ֗וֹת בַּֽ/עֲבוּר֙ תָּמָ֣ר אֲחֹת֔/וֹ כִּ֥י בְתוּלָ֖ה הִ֑יא וַ/יִּפָּלֵא֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י אַמְנ֔וֹן לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ֖/הּ מְאֽוּמָה
verses.translit: vytsr l'mnvn lhtchlvt b'bvr tmr 'chtv khy btvlh hy' vypl' b'yny 'mnvn l'shvt lh m'vmh
verses.translation: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אַמְנ֣וֹן רֵ֗עַ וּ/שְׁמ/וֹ֙ יֽוֹנָדָ֔ב בֶּן שִׁמְעָ֖ה אֲחִ֣י דָוִ֑ד וְ/י֣וֹנָדָ֔ב אִ֥ישׁ חָכָ֖ם מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vl'mnvn r' vshmv yvndb bn shm'h 'chy dvd vyvndb 'ysh chkhm m'd
verses.translation: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ מַדּ֣וּעַ אַ֠תָּה כָּ֣כָה דַּ֤ל בֶּן הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר הֲ/ל֖וֹא תַּגִּ֣יד לִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ אַמְנ֔וֹן אֶת תָּמָ֗ר אֲח֛וֹת אַבְשָׁלֹ֥ם אָחִ֖/י אֲנִ֥י אֹהֵֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr lv mdv' 'th khkhh dl bn hmlkh bbqr bbqr hlv' tgyd ly vy'mr lv 'mnvn 't tmr 'chvt 'bshlm 'chy 'ny 'hb
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king’s son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ יְה֣וֹנָדָ֔ב שְׁכַ֥ב עַל מִשְׁכָּבְ/ךָ֖ וְ/הִתְחָ֑ל וּ/בָ֧א אָבִ֣י/ךָ לִ/רְאוֹתֶ֗/ךָ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֡י/ו תָּ֣בֹא נָא֩ תָמָ֨ר אֲחוֹתִ֜/י וְ/תַבְרֵ֣/נִי לֶ֗חֶם וְ/עָשְׂתָ֤ה לְ/עֵינַ/י֙ אֶת הַ/בִּרְיָ֔ה לְמַ֨עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶרְאֶ֔ה וְ/אָכַלְתִּ֖י מִ/יָּדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv yhvndb shkhb 'l mshkhbkh vhtchl vb' 'bykh lr'vtkh v'mrt 'lyv tb' n' tmr 'chvty vtbrny lchm v'shth l'yny 't hbryh lm'n 'shr 'r'h v'khlty mydh
verses.translation: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it , and eat it at her hand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אַמְנ֖וֹן וַ/יִּתְחָ֑ל וַ/יָּבֹ֨א הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לִ/רְאֹת֗/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אַמְנ֤וֹן אֶל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ תָּֽבוֹא נָ֞א תָּמָ֣ר אֲחֹתִ֗/י וּ/תְלַבֵּ֤ב לְ/עֵינַ/י֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י לְבִב֔וֹת וְ/אֶבְרֶ֖ה מִ/יָּדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'mnvn vytchl vyb' hmlkh lr'tv vy'mr 'mnvn 'l hmlkh tbv' n' tmr 'chty vtlbb l'yny shty lbbvt v'brh mydh
verses.translation: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶל תָּמָ֖ר הַ/בַּ֣יְתָ/ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לְכִ֣י נָ֗א בֵּ֚ית אַמְנ֣וֹן אָחִ֔י/ךְ וַ/עֲשִׂי ל֖/וֹ הַ/בִּרְיָֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd 'l tmr hbyth l'mr lkhy n' byt 'mnvn 'chykh v'shy lv hbryh
verses.translation: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon’s house, and dress him meat.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֣לֶךְ תָּמָ֗ר בֵּ֛ית אַמְנ֥וֹן אָחִ֖י/הָ וְ/ה֣וּא שֹׁכֵ֑ב וַ/תִּקַּ֨ח אֶת הַ/בָּצֵ֤ק ו/תלוש וַ/תָּ֨לָשׁ֙ וַ/תְּלַבֵּ֣ב לְ/עֵינָ֔י/ו וַ/תְּבַשֵּׁ֖ל אֶת הַ/לְּבִבֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtlkh tmr byt 'mnvn 'chyh vhv' shkhb vtqch 't hbtsq vtlvsh vtlsh vtlbb l'ynyv vtbshl 't hlbbvt
verses.translation: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it , and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֤ח אֶת הַ/מַּשְׂרֵת֙ וַ/תִּצֹ֣ק לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו וַ/יְמָאֵ֖ן לֶ/אֱכ֑וֹל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אַמְנ֗וֹן הוֹצִ֤יאוּ כָל אִישׁ֙ מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י וַ/יֵּצְא֥וּ כָל אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vtqch 't hmshrt vttsq lpnyv vym'n l'khvl vy'mr 'mnvn hvtsy'v khl 'ysh m'ly vyts'v khl 'ysh m'lyv
verses.translation: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אַמְנ֜וֹן אֶל תָּמָ֗ר הָבִ֤יאִי הַ/בִּרְיָה֙ הַ/חֶ֔דֶר וְ/אֶבְרֶ֖ה מִ/יָּדֵ֑/ךְ וַ/תִּקַּ֣ח תָּמָ֗ר אֶת הַ/לְּבִבוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔תָה וַ/תָּבֵ֛א לְ/אַמְנ֥וֹן אָחִ֖י/הָ הֶ/חָֽדְרָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'mnvn 'l tmr hby'y hbryh hchdr v'brh mydkh vtqch tmr 't hlbbvt 'shr 'shth vtb' l'mnvn 'chyh hchdrh
verses.translation: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.

verses.original: וַ/תַּגֵּ֥שׁ אֵלָ֖י/ו לֶֽ/אֱכֹ֑ל וַ/יַּֽחֲזֶק בָּ/הּ֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֔/הּ בּ֛וֹאִי שִׁכְבִ֥י עִמִּ֖/י אֲחוֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vtgsh 'lyv l'khl vychzq bh vy'mr lh bv'y shkhby 'my 'chvty
verses.translation: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ אַל אָחִ/י֙ אַל תְּעַנֵּ֔/נִי כִּ֛י לֹא יֵֽעָשֶׂ֥ה כֵ֖ן בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַֽל תַּעֲשֵׂ֖ה אֶת הַ/נְּבָלָ֥ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vt'mr lv 'l 'chy 'l t'nny khy l' y'shh khn byshr'l 'l t'shh 't hnblh hz't
verses.translation: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י אָ֤נָה אוֹלִיךְ֙ אֶת חֶרְפָּתִ֔/י וְ/אַתָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֛ה כְּ/אַחַ֥ד הַ/נְּבָלִ֖ים בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/עַתָּה֙ דַּבֶּר נָ֣א אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִמְנָעֵ֖/נִי מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: v'ny 'nh 'vlykh 't chrpty v'th thyh kh'chd hnblym byshr'l v'th dbr n' 'l hmlkh khy l' ymn'ny mmkh
verses.translation: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.

verses.translit: vl' 'bh lshm' bqvlh vychzq mmnh vy'nh vyshkhb 'th
verses.translation: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂנָאֶ֣/הָ אַמְנ֗וֹן שִׂנְאָה֙ גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד כִּ֣י גְדוֹלָ֗ה הַ/שִּׂנְאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׂנֵאָ֔/הּ מֵ/אַהֲבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲהֵבָ֑/הּ וַֽ/יֹּאמֶר לָ֥/הּ אַמְנ֖וֹן ק֥וּמִי לֵֽכִי
verses.translit: vyshn'h 'mnvn shn'h gdvlh m'd khy gdvlh hshn'h 'shr shn'h m'hbh 'shr 'hbh vy'mr lh 'mnvn qvmy lkhy
verses.translation: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ אַל אוֹדֹ֞ת הָ/רָעָ֤ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָה֙ הַ/זֹּ֔את מֵ/אַחֶ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֥יתָ עִמִּ֖/י לְ/שַׁלְּחֵ֑/נִי וְ/לֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִ/שְׁמֹ֥עַֽ לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vt'mr lv 'l 'vdt hr'h hgdvlh hz't m'chrt 'shr 'shyt 'my lshlchny vl' 'bh lshm' lh
verses.translation: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֗א אֶֽת נַעֲר/וֹ֙ מְשָׁ֣רְת֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁלְחוּ נָ֥א אֶת זֹ֛את מֵ/עָלַ֖/י הַ/ח֑וּצָ/ה וּ/נְעֹ֥ל הַ/דֶּ֖לֶת אַחֲרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyqr' 't n'rv mshrtv vy'mr shlchv n' 't z't m'ly hchvtsh vn'l hdlt 'chryh
verses.translation: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.

verses.original: וְ/עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ כְּתֹ֣נֶת פַּסִּ֔ים כִּי֩ כֵ֨ן תִּלְבַּ֧שְׁןָ בְנוֹת הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ הַ/בְּתוּלֹ֖ת מְעִילִ֑ים וַ/יֹּצֵ֨א אוֹתָ֤/הּ מְשָֽׁרְת/וֹ֙ הַ/ח֔וּץ וְ/נָעַ֥ל הַ/דֶּ֖לֶת אַחֲרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'lyh khtnt psym khy khn tlbshn bnvt hmlkh hbtvlt m'ylym vyts' 'vth mshrtv hchvts vn'l hdlt 'chryh
verses.translation: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king’s daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֨ח תָּמָ֥ר אֵ֨פֶר֙ עַל רֹאשָׁ֔/הּ וּ/כְתֹ֧נֶת הַ/פַּסִּ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלֶ֖י/הָ קָרָ֑עָה וַ/תָּ֤שֶׂם יָדָ/הּ֙ עַל רֹאשָׁ֔/הּ וַ/תֵּ֥לֶךְ הָל֖וֹךְ וְ/זָעָֽקָה
verses.translit: vtqch tmr 'pr 'l r'shh vkhtnt hpsym 'shr 'lyh qr'h vtshm ydh 'l r'shh vtlkh hlvkh vz'qh
verses.translation: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֜י/הָ אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם אָחִ֗י/הָ הַ/אֲמִינ֣וֹן אָחִי/ךְ֮ הָיָ֣ה עִמָּ/ךְ֒ וְ/עַתָּ֞ה אֲחוֹתִ֤/י הַחֲרִ֨ישִׁי֙ אָחִ֣י/ךְ ה֔וּא אַל תָּשִׁ֥יתִי אֶת לִבֵּ֖/ךְ לַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/תֵּ֤שֶׁב תָּמָר֙ וְ/שֹׁ֣מֵמָ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אַבְשָׁל֥וֹם אָחִֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh 'bshlvm 'chyh h'mynvn 'chykh hyh 'mkh v'th 'chvty hchryshy 'chykh hv' 'l tshyty 't lbkh ldbr hzh vtshb tmr vshmmh byt 'bshlvm 'chyh
verses.translation: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔ד שָׁמַ֕ע אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יִּ֥חַר ל֖/וֹ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vhmlkh dvd shm' 't khl hdbrym h'lh vychr lv m'd
verses.translation: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא דִבֶּ֧ר אַבְשָׁל֛וֹם עִם אַמְנ֖וֹן לְ/מֵ/רָ֣ע וְ/עַד ט֑וֹב כִּֽי שָׂנֵ֤א אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶת אַמְנ֔וֹן עַל דְּבַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִנָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת תָּמָ֥ר אֲחֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' dbr 'bshlvm 'm 'mnvn lmr' v'd tvb khy shn' 'bshlvm 't 'mnvn 'l dbr 'shr 'nh 't tmr 'chtv
verses.translation: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ לִ/שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֔ים וַ/יִּהְי֤וּ גֹֽזְזִים֙ לְ/אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם בְּ/בַ֥עַל חָצ֖וֹר אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִם אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם לְ/כָל בְּנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhy lshntym ymym vyhyv gzzym l'bshlvm bb'l chtsvr 'shr 'm 'prym vyqr' 'bshlvm lkhl bny hmlkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal-hazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה נָ֥א גֹזְזִ֖ים לְ/עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ יֵֽלֶךְ נָ֥א הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וַ/עֲבָדָ֖י/ו עִם עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyb' 'bshlvm 'l hmlkh vy'mr hnh n' gzzym l'bdkh ylkh n' hmlkh v'bdyv 'm 'bdkh
verses.translation: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם אַל בְּנִ/י֙ אַל נָ֤א נֵלֵךְ֙ כֻּלָּ֔/נוּ וְ/לֹ֥א נִכְבַּ֖ד עָלֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יִּפְרָץ בּ֛/וֹ וְ/לֹֽא אָבָ֥ה לָ/לֶ֖כֶת וַֽ/יְבָרֲכֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l 'bshlvm 'l bny 'l n' nlkh khlnv vl' nkhbd 'lykh vyprts bv vl' 'bh llkht vybrkhhv
verses.translation: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם וָ/לֹ֕א יֵֽלֶךְ נָ֥א אִתָּ֖/נוּ אַמְנ֣וֹן אָחִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ֥/מָּה יֵלֵ֖ךְ עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bshlvm vl' ylkh n' 'tnv 'mnvn 'chy vy'mr lv hmlkh lmh ylkh 'mkh
verses.translation: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְרָץ בּ֖/וֹ אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח אִתּ/וֹ֙ אֶת אַמְנ֔וֹן וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל בְּנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyprts bv 'bshlvm vyshlch 'tv 't 'mnvn v't khl bny hmlkh
verses.translation: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַו֩ אַבְשָׁל֨וֹם אֶת נְעָרָ֜י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֗ר רְא֣וּ נָ֠א כְּ/ט֨וֹב לֵב אַמְנ֤וֹן בַּ/יַּ֨יִן֙ וְ/אָמַרְתִּ֣י אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם הַכּ֧וּ אֶת אַמְנ֛וֹן וַ/הֲמִתֶּ֥ם אֹת֖/וֹ אַל תִּירָ֑אוּ הֲ/ל֗וֹא כִּ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ צִוִּ֣יתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם חִזְק֖וּ וִ/הְי֥וּ לִ/בְנֵי חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vytsv 'bshlvm 't n'ryv l'mr r'v n' khtvb lb 'mnvn byyn v'mrty 'lykhm hkhv 't 'mnvn vhmtm 'tv 'l tyr'v hlv' khy 'nkhy tsvyty 'tkhm chzqv vhyv lbny chyl
verses.translation: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֞וּ נַעֲרֵ֤י אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ לְ/אַמְנ֔וֹן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יָּקֻ֣מוּ כָּל בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וַֽ/יִּרְכְּב֛וּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל פִּרְדּ֖/וֹ וַ/יָּנֻֽסוּ
verses.translit: vy'shv n'ry 'bshlvm l'mnvn kh'shr tsvh 'bshlvm vyqmv khl bny hmlkh vyrkhbv 'ysh 'l prdv vynsv
verses.translation: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ הֵ֣מָּה בַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/הַ/שְּׁמֻעָ֣ה בָ֔אָה אֶל דָּוִ֖ד לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִכָּ֤ה אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶת כָּל בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/לֹֽא נוֹתַ֥ר מֵ/הֶ֖ם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vyhy hmh bdrkh vhshm'h b'h 'l dvd l'mr hkhh 'bshlvm 't khl bny hmlkh vl' nvtr mhm 'chd
verses.translation: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧קָם הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וַ/יִּקְרַ֥ע אֶת בְּגָדָ֖י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֣ב אָ֑רְצָ/ה וְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֥י/ו נִצָּבִ֖ים קְרֻעֵ֥י בְגָדִֽים
verses.translit: vyqm hmlkh vyqr' 't bgdyv vyshkhb 'rtsh vkhl 'bdyv ntsbym qr'y bgdym
verses.translation: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֡עַן יוֹנָדָ֣ב בֶּן שִׁמְעָ֨ה אֲחִֽי דָוִ֜ד וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אַל יֹאמַ֤ר אֲדֹנִ/י֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/נְּעָרִ֤ים בְּנֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הֵמִ֔יתוּ כִּֽי אַמְנ֥וֹן לְ/בַדּ֖/וֹ מֵ֑ת כִּֽי עַל פִּ֤י אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ הָיְתָ֣ה שׂוּמָ֔ה מִ/יּוֹם֙ עַנֹּת֔/וֹ אֵ֖ת תָּמָ֥ר אֲחֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'n yvndb bn shm'h 'chy dvd vy'mr 'l y'mr 'dny 't khl hn'rym bny hmlkh hmytv khy 'mnvn lbdv mt khy 'l py 'bshlvm hyth shvmh myvm 'ntv 't tmr 'chtv
verses.translation: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king’s sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה אַל יָשֵׂם֩ אֲדֹנִ֨/י הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֶל לִבּ/וֹ֙ דָּבָ֣ר לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כָּל בְּנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מֵ֑תוּ כִּֽי אִם אַמְנ֥וֹן לְ/בַדּ֖/וֹ מֵֽת
verses.translit: v'th 'l yshm 'dny hmlkh 'l lbv dbr l'mr khl bny hmlkh mtv khy 'm 'mnvn lbdv mt
verses.translation: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְרַ֖ח אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יִּשָּׂ֞א הַ/נַּ֤עַר הַ/צֹּפֶה֙ אֶת עינ/ו עֵינָ֔י/ו וַ/יַּ֗רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה עַם רַ֜ב הֹלְכִ֥ים מִ/דֶּ֛רֶךְ אַחֲרָ֖י/ו מִ/צַּ֥ד הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vybrch 'bshlvm vysh' hn'r htsph 't 'ynv 'ynyv vyr' vhnh 'm rb hlkhym mdrkh 'chryv mtsd hhr
verses.translation: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יֽוֹנָדָב֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הִנֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בָּ֑אוּ כִּ/דְבַ֥ר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ כֵּ֥ן הָיָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yvndb 'l hmlkh hnh bny hmlkh b'v khdbr 'bdkh khn hyh
verses.translation: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king’s sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְּ/כַלֹּת֣/וֹ לְ/דַבֵּ֗ר וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה בְנֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ בָּ֔אוּ וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖/ם וַ/יִּבְכּ֑וּ וְ/גַם הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֔י/ו בָּכ֕וּ בְּכִ֖י גָּד֥וֹל מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyhy khkhltv ldbr vhnh bny hmlkh b'v vysh'v qvlm vybkhv vgm hmlkh vkhl 'bdyv bkhv bkhy gdvl m'd
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בָּרַ֔ח וַ/יֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל תַּלְמַ֥י בֶּן עמיחור עַמִּיה֖וּד מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר וַ/יִּתְאַבֵּ֥ל עַל בְּנ֖/וֹ כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: v'bshlvm brch vylkh 'l tlmy bn 'mychvr 'myhvd mlkh gshvr vyt'bl 'l bnv khl hymym
verses.translation: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְשָׁל֥וֹם בָּרַ֖ח וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר וַ/יְהִי שָׁ֖ם שָׁלֹ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: v'bshlvm brch vylkh gshvr vyhy shm shlsh shnym
verses.translation: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

verses.original: וַ/תְּכַל֙ דָּוִ֣ד הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ/צֵ֖את אֶל אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם כִּֽי נִחַ֥ם עַל אַמְנ֖וֹן כִּֽי מֵֽת
verses.translit: vtkhl dvd hmlkh lts't 'l 'bshlvm khy nchm 'l 'mnvn khy mt
verses.translation: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
